teaching_sense.en_definition: Without having eaten; on an empty stomach.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在没有吃过东西、肚子空着的状态下。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mingħajr ma wieħed ikun kiel; bi stonku vojt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 空腹地；在没有进食的情况下。

collocations.en: drink coffee on an empty stomach

formal.mt: L-istudent wasal għall-eżami għar-riq, għax ma kienx kiel il-kolazzjon.
formal.en: The student arrived for the exam on an empty stomach because he had not eaten breakfast.
formal.zh: 这名学生没有吃早餐，空着肚子来参加考试。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħadt il-kolazzjon? Ben: Le, ħriġt għar-riq. Maja: Ejja nieklu xi ħaġa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you have breakfast? Ben: No, I went out on an empty stomach. Maja: Let's get something to eat.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你吃早餐了吗？本：没有，我空着肚子就出门了。玛雅：我们去吃点东西吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你吃早餐了吗？
messages.en: Did you have breakfast?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 没有，我空着肚子就出门了。
messages.en: No, I went out on an empty stomach.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们去吃点东西吧。
messages.en: Let's get something to eat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语连着记成“早餐没吃就出门”，连字符也一起记住，用它说明动作发生时空腹。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To touch someone lightly in a way that produces a tickling feeling and may make them laugh.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 轻轻触碰某人，使其感到痒，有时引起发笑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imiss ħafif lil xi ħadd b'mod li jġiegħlu jħoss il-ħakk u jista' jġiegħlu jidħaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给某人挠痒痒；轻触而使其感到痒。

collocations.en: tickled the boy on the soles of his feet

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-missier għarax lit-tifel taħt saqajh u t-tifel beda jidħaq.
formal.en: In the story, the father tickled the boy on the soles of his feet, and the boy began to laugh.
formal.zh: 故事中，父亲挠了男孩的脚底，男孩便笑了起来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex daħak daqshekk Ben? Mark: Għax ħuh għarax lilu waqt li kienu qed jilagħbu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Ben laugh so much? Mark: Because his brother tickled him while they were playing.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Ben为什么笑得那么厉害？Mark：因为他们玩的时候，他的兄弟给他挠痒痒。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Ben为什么笑得那么厉害？
messages.en: Why did Ben laugh so much?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ħuh għarax lilu waqt li kienu qed jilagħbu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ħuh għarax lilu waqt li kienu qed jilagħbu.
messages.zh: 因为他们玩的时候，他的兄弟给他挠痒痒。
messages.en: Because his brother tickled him while they were playing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għarax 配上“手指轻轻挠脚底，对方忍不住笑”的画面，记住它表示挠痒痒这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To walk with an uneven step because one leg or foot is painful or difficult to use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因一条腿或一只脚疼痛或活动不便而一瘸一拐地走。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimxi b'pass mhux indaqs għax sieq waħda tweġġgħu jew ma jistax jużaha sew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 跛行；一瘸一拐地走。
跛行；一瘸一拐地走的动作或状态。

collocations.zh: 因疼痛而一瘸一拐地走

formal.mt: Wara li weġġa' siequ, il-pazjent għaraġ sal-kamra tal-eżami.
formal.en: After injuring his foot, the patient limped to the examination room.
formal.zh: 患者的脚受伤后，一瘸一拐地走到了检查室。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu għaraġ sal-bieb? Lara: Għax weġġa' siequ waqt il-logħba.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu limp to the door? Lara: Because he hurt his foot during the game.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu为什么一瘸一拐地走到门口？Lara：因为他比赛时弄伤了脚。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu为什么一瘸一拐地走到门口？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu limp to the door?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为他比赛时弄伤了脚。
messages.en: Because he hurt his foot during the game.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象脚痛时左右脚步不均的画面，把 għaraġ 和“一瘸一拐地走”连起来；同形名词表示“跛行”这一动作或状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The covering of land, roads, or buildings with water that has overflowed or accumulated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 水溢出或积聚，淹没土地、道路或建筑物的现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fenomenu ta' ilma li jfawwar jew jinġabar u jgħatti l-art, it-toroq jew il-bini.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 洪水泛滥；土地或建筑物等被水淹没的现象。

formal.mt: Il-pjan ta' emerġenza jinkludi miżuri biex titnaqqas il-ħsara minħabba l-għargħir.
formal.en: The emergency plan includes measures to reduce damage caused by flooding.
formal.zh: 应急计划包括减少水淹损失的措施。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għalqu t-triq? Pawlu: Hemm għargħir wara x-xita qawwija; ejja ngħaddu minn triq oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why have they closed the road? Pawlu: There is flooding after the heavy rain; let's take another road.
colloquial.zh: Maja：为什么封路了？Pawlu：大雨过后那里被水淹了；我们走另一条路吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 为什么封路了？
messages.en: Why have they closed the road?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm għargħir wara x-xita qawwija; ejja ngħaddu minn triq oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm għargħir wara x-xita qawwija; ejja ngħaddu minn triq oħra.
messages.zh: 大雨过后那里被水淹了；我们走另一条路吧。
messages.en: There is flooding after the heavy rain; let's take another road.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“大雨后整条街被水覆盖”的画面记 għargħir，注意它描述水淹现象；与表示溺水的 għarq 分开记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone or something that comes from or is connected with Għargħur.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人或事物来自Għargħur，或与该地方有关。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej minn Għargħur jew li għandu x'jaqsam ma' Għargħur.

sense_translations.en_definition: of, from or relating to Għargħur
sense_translations.zh_definition: Għargħur的；来自Għargħur的；与Għargħur有关的。

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-wirja jinkludi xogħol ta' artist Għargħuri.
formal.en: The exhibition programme includes work by an artist from Għargħur.
formal.zh: 展览安排中包括一位来自Għargħur的艺术家的作品。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-grupp ġej minn Għargħur? Mark: Iva, huwa grupp Għargħuri, u llejla se jdoqq hawn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this group come from Għargħur? Mark: Yes, it is a group from Għargħur, and it will play here tonight.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这个团体来自Għargħur吗？Mark：是的，这是一个来自Għargħur的团体，今晚会在这里演奏。

messages.speaker: Lara (观众)
messages.zh: 这个团体来自Għargħur吗？
messages.en: Does this group come from Għargħur?

messages.speaker: Mark (活动工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa grupp Għargħuri, u llejla se jdoqq hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa grupp Għargħuri, u llejla se jdoqq hawn.
messages.zh: 是的，这是一个来自Għargħur的团体，今晚会在这里演奏。
messages.en: Yes, it is a group from Għargħur, and it will play here tonight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把地名 Għargħur 与形容词 Għargħuri 并排写，再给人物或团体贴上“来自这里”的标签，帮助记住地点关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a dark or dusky skin tone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 肤色较深或呈黝黑色的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ġilda skura jew kannella skura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肤色深的；黝黑的。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, l-awtriċi tiddeskrivi lill-protagonist bħala raġel għariem b'għajnejh kannella.
formal.en: In the novel, the author describes the protagonist as a dark-skinned man with brown eyes.
formal.zh: 小说中，作者将主人公描写为一名肤色深、眼睛呈棕色的男子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu Ben fir-ritratt? Lara: Hu t-tifel għariem bil-flokk aħdar, ħdejn in-nanna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which one is Ben in the photograph? Lara: He is the dark-skinned boy in the green shirt, next to Grandma.
colloquial.zh: Maja：照片里哪个是Ben？Lara：就是奶奶旁边那个肤色深、穿绿色上衣的男孩。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 照片里哪个是Ben？
messages.en: Which one is Ben in the photograph?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu t-tifel għariem bil-flokk aħdar, ħdejn in-nanna.
messages.mt_standard: Hu t-tifel għariem bil-flokk aħdar, ħdejn in-nanna.
messages.zh: 就是奶奶旁边那个肤色深、穿绿色上衣的男孩。
messages.en: He is the dark-skinned boy in the green shirt, next to Grandma.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在人物素描旁写上 għariem，并用深浅色卡标记肤色；把这个词牢牢记作外貌描写中的“肤色深的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of cleaning a surface by rubbing it firmly or repeatedly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过用力或反复摩擦来清洁表面的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tnaddaf wiċċ billi togħorku bis-saħħa jew kemm-il darba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刷洗；通过用力摩擦去除污垢的擦洗动作。

formal.mt: Il-proċedura tat-tindif tinkludi għarik tal-art biex jitneħħa t-tajn niexef.
formal.en: The cleaning procedure includes scrubbing the floor to remove dried mud.
formal.zh: 清洁程序包括刷洗地板，以去除干结的泥土。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Din it-tebgħa ma tridx titlaq! Lara: Hemm bżonn ftit għarik b'din ix-xkupilja.
colloquial.en: Mark: This stain won't come off! Lara: It needs a little scrubbing with this brush.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这块污渍怎么也去不掉！Lara：得用这把刷子刷洗一下。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 这块污渍怎么也去不掉！
messages.en: This stain won't come off!

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm bżonn ftit għarik b'din ix-xkupilja.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm bżonn ftit għarik b'din ix-xkupilja.
messages.zh: 得用这把刷子刷洗一下。
messages.en: It needs a little scrubbing with this brush.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿刷子来回用力清除顽固污渍，把 għarik 对应到整个“刷洗动作”，再用 għarik tal-art 记住刷洗地板。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of being unable to breathe because of being submerged in water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因身体没入水中而无法呼吸的过程或状况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih persuna ma tkunx tista' tieħu n-nifs minħabba li tkun mgħaddsa fl-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 溺水；因没入水中而无法呼吸。

formal.mt: Il-kors dwar is-sigurtà fl-ilma jinkludi lezzjoni dwar il-prevenzjoni tal-għarq.
formal.en: The water safety course includes a lesson on drowning prevention.
formal.zh: 水上安全课程包括一节预防溺水的课。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu s-suġġett tal-lezzjoni llum? Pawlu: Il-prevenzjoni tal-għarq u kif nitolbu l-għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is today's lesson about? Pawlu: Drowning prevention and how to ask for help.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今天这节课讲什么？Pawlu：预防溺水，以及如何求助。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 今天这节课讲什么？
messages.en: What is today's lesson about?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-prevenzjoni tal-għarq u kif nitolbu l-għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Il-prevenzjoni tal-għarq u kif nitolbu l-għajnuna.
messages.zh: 预防溺水，以及如何求助。
messages.en: Drowning prevention and how to ask for help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għarq 放在“预防溺水”的课堂标题中记忆，关注人在水中无法呼吸的情境，并与表示水淹现象的 għargħir 区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Morally bad and willing to harm others or act cruelly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 品行邪恶，存心伤害他人或行为残忍的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħażin ħafna fl-imġiba u lest li jagħmel il-ħsara lil ħaddieħor jew jaġixxi bi krudeltà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 邪恶的；恶毒的；存心作恶的。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-re għarr jhedded lin-nies biex jobdu l-ordnijiet tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the wicked king threatens the people to make them obey his orders.
formal.zh: 故事中，邪恶的国王威胁百姓，逼迫他们服从他的命令。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Għaliex kulħadd jibża' mir-re f'din l-istorja? Maja: Għax hu re għarr li jagħmel il-ħsara lin-nies.
colloquial.en: Ben: Why is everyone afraid of the king in this story? Maja: Because he is a wicked king who harms people.
colloquial.zh: Ben：这个故事里，为什么大家都怕国王？Maja：因为他是个伤害百姓的邪恶国王。

messages.speaker: Ben (孩子)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex kulħadd jibża' mir-re f'din l-istorja?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex kulħadd jibża' mir-re f'din l-istorja?
messages.zh: 这个故事里，为什么大家都怕国王？
messages.en: Why is everyone afraid of the king in this story?

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu re għarr li jagħmel il-ħsara lin-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu re għarr li jagħmel il-ħsara lin-nies.
messages.zh: 因为他是个伤害百姓的邪恶国王。
messages.en: Because he is a wicked king who harms people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għarr 写在童话里故意伤害百姓的国王旁边，用 re għarr 这个短语记住“邪恶的国王”，突出存心作恶的含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give something an Arabic form or character.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某事物具有阿拉伯语的形式或阿拉伯文化的特征。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti lil xi ħaġa forma Għarbija jew karattru Għarbi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使阿拉伯化；使具有阿拉伯语形式或阿拉伯文化特征。

formal.mt: It-traduttur għarrab l-ismijiet tal-karattri biex jaqblu mal-ambjent tal-istorja.
formal.en: The translator Arabicized the characters' names to fit the setting of the story.
formal.zh: 译者将人物名字阿拉伯化，使其符合故事的背景。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dawn l-ismijiet huma differenti? Pawlu: It-traduttur għarrab l-ismijiet għall-verżjoni Għarbija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are these names different? Pawlu: The translator Arabicized the names for the Arabic version.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些名字为什么不一样？保罗：译者为阿拉伯语版本把名字作了阿拉伯化处理。

messages.speaker: Maja (读者)
messages.zh: 这些名字为什么不一样？
messages.en: Why are these names different?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (译者)
messages.zh: 译者为阿拉伯语版本把名字作了阿拉伯化处理。
messages.en: The translator Arabicized the names for the Arabic version.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上“人物名字换成阿拉伯语形式”的画面来记，并留意它与 għarreb 的元音不同。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To gather things into a heap or arrange them in a pile or stack.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西聚成一堆，或将物品逐件堆放、码放起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġbor l-affarijiet f'gozz jew iqegħedhom waħda fuq l-oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把东西聚拢、堆成一堆。
把东西堆放起来。
将物品逐件叠放或码放起来。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem għarram il-kaxxi ħdejn il-ħajt biex iħalli l-passaġġ vojt.
formal.en: The worker stacked the boxes beside the wall to keep the passage clear.
formal.zh: 工人把箱子码在墙边，以保持通道畅通。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn poġġa l-kaxxi Mark? Toni: Għarram il-kaxxi ħdejn il-bieb. Sara: Mela se nċaqlaqhom biex inkunu nistgħu ngħaddu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where did Mark put the boxes? Toni: He stacked the boxes beside the door. Sara: Then I'll move them so we can get through.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克把箱子放哪儿了？托尼：他把箱子堆在门边了。萨拉：那我把它们挪开，好让我们过去。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 马克把箱子放哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did Mark put the boxes?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.zh: 他把箱子堆在门边了。
messages.en: He stacked the boxes beside the door.

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela se nċaqlaqhom biex inkunu nistgħu ngħaddu.
messages.mt_standard: Mela se nċaqlaqhom biex inkunu nistgħu ngħaddu.
messages.zh: 那我把它们挪开，好让我们过去。
messages.en: Then I'll move them so we can get through.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象石头聚成一堆、箱子逐个码高，用同一幅“堆起来”的动作画面串联三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To tickle someone physically, or to try to arouse someone's curiosity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 触碰某人使其发痒，或设法勾起某人的好奇心。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imiss lil xi ħadd b'mod li jġiegħlu jħoss it-tmelles jew jidħaq, jew jipprova jqanqallu l-kurżità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挠痒；用轻触使人产生痒感。

sense_translations.en_definition: to seek to provoke sb.'s curiosity
sense_translations.zh_definition: 设法勾起某人的好奇心。

collocations.en: tickle his brother with a feather
arouse the reader's curiosity with a question
collocations.zh: 用一个问题勾起读者的好奇心

formal.mt: L-awtur għarrax lill-qarrej b'mistoqsija fil-bidu tal-kapitlu u ta t-tweġiba fl-aħħar.
formal.en: The author aroused the reader's curiosity with a question at the beginning of the chapter and gave the answer at the end.
formal.zh: 作者在章首用一个问题勾起读者的好奇心，并在章末给出答案。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed jidħaq Ben? Mark: Toni għarrax lil Ben b'rixa. Lara: Issa nifhem!
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is Ben laughing? Mark: Toni tickled Ben with a feather. Lara: Now I understand!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：本为什么在笑？马克：托尼用羽毛给本挠痒了。拉拉：这下我明白了！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 本为什么在笑？
messages.en: Why is Ben laughing?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 托尼用羽毛给本挠痒了。
messages.en: Toni tickled Ben with a feather.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这下我明白了！
messages.en: Now I understand!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个义项想成“身体被挠得痒”和“心里好奇得痒”，这是帮助记忆的比喻。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To treat someone as a foreigner or as a stranger who does not belong.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某人当成外国人或陌生的外人来对待。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittratta lil xi ħadd bħala barrani jew bħala persuna li ma tagħmilx parti mill-grupp.

sense_translations.en_definition: to treat sb. as a foreigner or stranger
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某人当作外国人或陌生人对待。

collocations.en: treat the neighbour as a stranger
treat his companion as an outsider

formal.mt: Il-grupp għarreb lill-membru l-ġdid billi ħallieh barra mid-diskussjonijiet kollha.
formal.en: The group treated the new member as an outsider by leaving him out of all the discussions.
formal.zh: 这个团体将新成员排除在所有讨论之外，把他当作外人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex telaq Pawlu daqshekk kmieni? Sara: Il-grupp għarreb lil Pawlu; ħadd ma tkellem miegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu leave so early? Sara: The group treated Pawlu as an outsider; nobody spoke to him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么这么早就走了？萨拉：大家把保罗当作外人，谁也没跟他说话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么这么早就走了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu leave so early?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-grupp għarreb lil Pawlu; ħadd ma tkellem miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-grupp għarreb lil Pawlu; ħadd ma tkellem miegħu.
messages.zh: 大家把保罗当作外人，谁也没跟他说话。
messages.en: The group treated Pawlu as an outsider; nobody spoke to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人被挡在聊天圈外，记住“当作外人”；再用末尾的 eb 与 għarrab 的 ab 作拼写对照。

gloss_zh: 使跛行；使走路一瘸一拐

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to limp or walk unevenly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人走路时跛行、一瘸一拐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd izappap waqt il-mixi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使跛行；使走路一瘸一拐。

formal.mt: Żarbun issikkat għarreġ lil Mark waqt il-mixja.
formal.en: A tight shoe caused Mark to limp during the walk.
formal.zh: 一只过紧的鞋让马克在步行时一瘸一拐。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed izappap Mark? Toni: Żarbun ġdid għarreġ lil Mark. Issa se jibdel iż-żraben.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is Mark limping? Toni: A new shoe made Mark limp. He's going to change his shoes now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克为什么走路一瘸一拐？托尼：一只新鞋让他走路发跛。他现在要换鞋了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么走路一瘸一拐？
messages.en: Why is Mark limping?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żarbun ġdid għarreġ lil Mark. Issa se jibdel iż-żraben.
messages.mt_standard: Żarbun ġdid għarreġ lil Mark. Issa se jibdel iż-żraben.
messages.zh: 一只新鞋让他走路发跛。他现在要换鞋了。
messages.en: A new shoe made Mark limp. He's going to change his shoes now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“紧鞋让人一瘸一拐”的因果画面记忆，重点记住这个动词表示“使人跛行”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An engagement or betrothal: a mutual promise to marry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 双方约定将来结婚的订婚关系或婚约。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-wegħda bejn żewġ persuni li jiżżewġu lil xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 订婚；双方约定结婚的关系。
订立婚约；约定将来结婚的承诺。

formal.mt: Il-koppja ħabbret l-għars tagħha waqt laqgħa mal-familji.
formal.en: The couple announced their engagement during a gathering with their families.
formal.zh: 这对伴侣在双方家庭聚会时宣布订婚。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'se niċċelebraw is-Sibt? Mark: L-għars ta' Lara u Ben! Sara: Mela rridu nifirħulhom.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are we celebrating on Saturday? Mark: Lara and Ben's engagement! Sara: Then we must congratulate them.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：星期六我们要庆祝什么？马克：拉拉和本订婚！萨拉：那我们得恭喜他们。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 星期六我们要庆祝什么？
messages.en: What are we celebrating on Saturday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 拉拉和本订婚！
messages.en: Lara and Ben's engagement!

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们得恭喜他们。
messages.en: Then we must congratulate them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两人向家人宣布“我们约定结婚”，把这个名词固定在订婚与婚约的场景中。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woman who is getting married or has just married.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正在举行婚礼或刚刚结婚的女子，即新娘。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mara li tkun se tiżżewweġ jew li tkun għadha kemm iżżewġet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 新娘；正在结婚或新近结婚的女子。

formal.mt: L-għarusa daħlet fis-sala b'bukkett fjuri bojod f'idejha.
formal.en: The bride entered the hall holding a bouquet of white flowers.
formal.zh: 新娘手捧一束白花走进大厅。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hi l-għarusa? Sara: Qiegħda ħdejn it-tieqa mal-fotografu. Maja: Se nistenna sakemm jispiċċaw ir-ritratti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the bride? Sara: She's beside the window with the photographer. Maja: I'll wait until they finish taking the photos.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：新娘在哪里？萨拉：她在窗边，和摄影师在一起。玛雅：我等他们拍完照片吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (婚礼宾客)
messages.zh: 新娘在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the bride?

messages.speaker: Sara (新娘的朋友)
messages.zh: 她在窗边，和摄影师在一起。
messages.en: She's beside the window with the photographer.

messages.speaker: Maja (婚礼宾客)
messages.zh: 我等他们拍完照片吧。
messages.en: I'll wait until they finish taking the photos.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għarusa 和“礼服、捧花、婚礼照片”放在同一幅画面里，牢牢记住它指新娘。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To flit about, especially of insects, or to move in a swarm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指昆虫轻快地飞来飞去，也可指昆虫成群聚集飞动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża għall-insetti meta jtiru minn naħa għal oħra jew jinġabru u jiċċaqalqu fi grupp kbir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: （用于昆虫）飞来飞去，轻快地四处飞动。
成群聚集、飞动或涌动。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, insett żgħir għarwel madwar il-fanal għal diversi minuti.
formal.en: During the observation, a small insect flitted about around the lamp for several minutes.
formal.zh: 观察期间，一只小昆虫围着灯飞了好几分钟。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt dak l-insett ħdejn it-tieqa? Mark: Iva, għarwel ftit u mbagħad ħareġ barra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see that insect near the window? Mark: Yes, it flitted about for a bit and then went outside.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你看到窗边那只昆虫了吗？Mark：看到了，它飞来飞去了一会儿，然后飞到外面去了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到窗边那只昆虫了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that insect near the window?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għarwel ftit u mbagħad ħareġ barra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għarwel ftit u mbagħad ħareġ barra.
messages.zh: 看到了，它飞来飞去了一会儿，然后飞到外面去了。
messages.en: Yes, it flitted about for a bit and then went outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象灯旁昆虫不停换方向飞动，再把画面扩展成一群昆虫，串起两个动词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A name for a type of small fish.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指一种小型鱼；学习时将它作为鱼类名称记忆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem għal tip ta' ħuta żgħira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种小鱼。

collocations.zh: 一条小小的 għarwiela 鱼

collocations.en: an għarwiela fish in the water
collocations.zh: 水中的一条 għarwiela 鱼

formal.mt: L-istudent osserva għarwiela fl-ilma u ddeskriva d-daqs tagħha fin-noti tiegħu.
formal.en: The student observed an għarwiela fish in the water and described its size in his notes.
formal.zh: 学生观察了水中的一条 għarwiela 鱼，并在笔记中描述了它的大小。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'inhi dik il-ħuta żgħira? Pawlu: Dik għarwiela. Ara kif qed tgħum!
colloquial.en: Lina: What is that little fish? Pawlu: That's an għarwiela. Look at it swimming!
colloquial.zh: Lina：那条小鱼是什么鱼？Pawlu：那是 għarwiela。你看它游泳的样子！

messages.speaker: Lina (同学)
messages.zh: 那条小鱼是什么鱼？
messages.en: What is that little fish?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik għarwiela. Ara kif qed tgħum!
messages.mt_standard: Dik għarwiela. Ara kif qed tgħum!
messages.zh: 那是 għarwiela。你看它游泳的样子！
messages.en: That's an għarwiela. Look at it swimming!

cognitive_memory_aid: 在学习卡片上画一条小鱼，旁边写上本词；记住它是鱼名，不必猜测具体鱼种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stick or staff, including one used for support while walking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 棍状物或手杖，也可指走路时用来支撑身体的杖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bastun jew virga, li jistgħu jintużaw ukoll bħala appoġġ waqt il-mixi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 棍，杖；手杖。

formal.mt: Ir-raġel uża għasa tal-injam bħala appoġġ waqt li mexa tul il-mogħdija.
formal.en: The man used a wooden staff for support as he walked along the path.
formal.zh: 那名男子沿着小路行走时，用一根木杖支撑身体。

colloquial.mt: Ġużeppi: Fejn ħallejt l-għasa tiegħi? Marija: Ħallejtha ħdejn il-bieb; se nġibhielek.
colloquial.en: Ġużeppi: Where did you leave my walking stick? Marija: I left it by the door; I'll bring it to you.
colloquial.zh: Ġużeppi：你把我的手杖放哪儿了？Marija：我把它放在门边了；我给你拿来。

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (祖父)
messages.zh: 你把我的手杖放哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did you leave my walking stick?

messages.speaker: Marija (孙女)
messages.zh: 我把它放在门边了；我给你拿来。
messages.en: I left it by the door; I'll bring it to you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一根木棍和拄杖行走的画面放在一起记忆，同一词可以对应棍和手杖。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The penis, an external male genital organ.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 阴茎，即男性的外生殖器官之一。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pene, organu ġenitali estern maskili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阴茎，男性生殖器官。

formal.mt: Fit-test tal-anatomija, l-għasfura hija deskritta bħala organu ġenitali estern maskili.
formal.en: In the anatomy text, the penis is described as an external male genital organ.
formal.zh: 在解剖学课文中，阴茎被描述为男性的外生殖器官。

colloquial.mt: Daniel: X'tfisser 'għasfura' f'dan it-test? Rita: Hawnhekk tfisser il-pene, organu ġenitali maskili.
colloquial.en: Daniel: What does 'għasfura' mean in this text? Rita: Here it means the penis, a male genital organ.
colloquial.zh: Daniel：这篇课文里的 għasfura 是什么意思？Rita：这里指阴茎，是男性的生殖器官。

messages.speaker: Daniel (成年学生)
messages.zh: 这篇课文里的 għasfura 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'għasfura' mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk tfisser il-pene, organu ġenitali maskili.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk tfisser il-pene, organu ġenitali maskili.
messages.zh: 这里指阴茎，是男性的生殖器官。
messages.en: Here it means the penis, a male genital organ.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将本词放进人体解剖词汇卡，与中文阴茎直接配对，用中性的器官名称帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A kind of soft pudding prepared quickly, known as a hasty pudding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种快速煮成、质地柔软呈糊状的布丁食品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' pudina ratba li titħejja malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种速煮糊状布丁。

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta tispjega kif titħejja l-għasida u meta għandha titqiegħed fl-iskutelli.
formal.en: The recipe explains how to prepare the hasty pudding and when to put it into bowls.
formal.zh: 食谱说明了这种速煮糊状布丁的制作方法，以及何时将它盛入碗中。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Trid skutella għasida? Pietru: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Għadha sħuna?
colloquial.en: Anna: Would you like a bowl of hasty pudding? Pietru: Yes, please. Is it still warm?
colloquial.zh: Anna：你想来一碗速煮糊状布丁吗？Pietru：好的，谢谢。它还热着吗？

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想来一碗速煮糊状布丁吗？
messages.en: Would you like a bowl of hasty pudding?

messages.speaker: Pietru (朋友)
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢。它还热着吗？
messages.en: Yes, please. Is it still warm?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一碗刚煮好的柔软糊状布丁，用温热、盛碗、快速煮成三个画面记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action or process of squeezing, especially squeezing fruit to obtain its juice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 挤压这一动作或过程，尤其指挤压水果以取得果汁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tagħfas xi ħaġa, speċjalment frott biex joħroġ il-meraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挤压，尤指挤压水果、榨取果汁的过程。

formal.mt: L-għasir tal-larinġ isir biex jinkiseb il-meraq mill-frott.
formal.en: Oranges are squeezed to extract the juice from the fruit.
formal.zh: 挤压橙子是为了从果实中榨取果汁。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Lestejt l-għasir tal-larinġ? Mark: Iva, u l-meraq lest biex nixorbuh.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you finished squeezing the oranges? Mark: Yes, and the juice is ready for us to drink.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你把橙子榨好了吗？Mark：榨好了，果汁可以喝了。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 你把橙子榨好了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished squeezing the oranges?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u l-meraq lest biex nixorbuh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u l-meraq lest biex nixorbuh.
messages.zh: 榨好了，果汁可以喝了。
messages.en: Yes, and the juice is ready for us to drink.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手挤橙子、果汁流进杯中；本词记的是挤压过程，果汁则是过程的产物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put out new twigs, or to walk with the support of a stick.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指植物萌生嫩枝，也可指人借助手杖行走；使用时根据主语和语境区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża għal pjanta li toħroġ friegħi ġodda, jew għal persuna li timxi bl-għajnuna ta' bastun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长出嫩枝，萌生新枝。

sense_translations.en_definition: to walk with the aid of a stick
sense_translations.zh_definition: 借助手杖行走，拄杖走路。

collocations.en: walked with the aid of a stick

formal.mt: Fir-rebbiegħa, l-arbuxxell għasleġ u dehru friegħi ġodda.
formal.en: In spring, the shrub sprouted twigs, and new branches appeared.
formal.zh: 春天，灌木萌生嫩枝，长出了新的枝条。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Kif wasal Ġużeppi sal-bieb? Pawlu: Għasleġ bil-mod, b'għasa f'idu.
colloquial.en: Lina: How did Ġużeppi get to the door? Pawlu: He walked slowly with the aid of a stick, holding it in his hand.
colloquial.zh: Lina：Ġużeppi 是怎么走到门口的？Pawlu：他手里拄着一根杖，慢慢走过去的。

messages.speaker: Lina (邻居)
messages.zh: Ġużeppi 是怎么走到门口的？
messages.en: How did Ġużeppi get to the door?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 他手里拄着一根杖，慢慢走过去的。
messages.en: He walked slowly with the aid of a stick, holding it in his hand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做两张场景卡：一张画植物发新枝，一张画人拄杖走路；这是记忆联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Honeyed or sweet like honey; also tawny, a yellowish-brown colour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 像蜂蜜一样甜的，可形容甜美的话语；也可表示黄褐色的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħelu bħall-għasel, ukoll meta jiddeskrivi kliem; jew ta' lewn bejn l-isfar u l-kannella.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜜甜的，像蜂蜜一样甜美的；也可形容甜美动听的话语。
黄褐色的，呈黄色与棕色之间的色调。

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni tad-drapp issemmi lewn għasli, bejn l-isfar u l-kannella.
formal.en: The description of the fabric mentions a tawny colour, between yellow and brown.
formal.zh: 布料说明中提到一种介于黄色与棕色之间的黄褐色。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qallek xi ħaġa sabiħa? Rita: Iva, qalli ħafna kliem għasli.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did he say anything nice to you? Rita: Yes, he said lots of sweet things to me.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他对你说什么好听的话了吗？Rita：说了，他对我说了好多甜言蜜语。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他对你说什么好听的话了吗？
messages.en: Did he say anything nice to you?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 说了，他对我说了好多甜言蜜语。
messages.en: Yes, he said lots of sweet things to me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用蜂蜜作学习联想：想到甜味就记甜美的话语，想到黄褐色就记颜色义；这不是词源说明。

gloss_zh: 湿透的；榨出的汁液或油

teaching_sense.en_definition: Thoroughly wet or soaked, especially in the expression 'imxarrab għasra'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 完全浸湿、湿得透透的，尤其用于 imxarrab għasra，表示湿透甚至滴水。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imxarrab ħafna, saħansitra jqattar l-ilma, speċjalment fl-espressjoni 'imxarrab għasra'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 浸满水而湿软的；湿漉漉的。

sense_translations.en_definition: dripping wet (often used in the expression 'imxarrab għasra' - to be dripping wet)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 湿透而滴水的，常用于 imxarrab għasra，形容全身或物品湿得透透的。

sense_translations.en_definition: the product of squeezing (e.g. olives or fruit to obtain oil or juice)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 挤压或压榨所得的产物，例如榨橄榄所得的油或榨水果所得的汁。

collocations.en: the liquid obtained by squeezing fruit

formal.mt: Wara li mexa fix-xita, il-ħaddiem wasal l-uffiċċju bil-kowt imxarrab għasra.
formal.en: After walking in the rain, the worker arrived at the office with his coat soaking wet.
formal.zh: 那名员工冒雨步行后到达办公室，外套已经湿透了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara l-ġakketta tiegħi! Imxarrba għasra. Lara: Idħol ġewwa u ibdilha qabel taqbad il-bard.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at my jacket! It's soaking wet. Lara: Come inside and change it before you catch a cold.
colloquial.zh: Maja：看看我的夹克！都湿透了。Lara：快进来换掉，免得着凉。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看看我的夹克！都湿透了。
messages.en: Look at my jacket! It's soaking wet.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Idħol ġewwa u ibdilha qabel taqbad il-bard.
messages.mt_standard: Idħol ġewwa u ibdilha qabel taqbad il-bard.
messages.zh: 快进来换掉，免得着凉。
messages.en: Come inside and change it before you catch a cold.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imxarrab għasra 整块记成“湿透了”：想象外套不断滴水；另给名词义画一杯榨出的果汁，分开记住两种词性。

gloss_zh: 偏晚的；接近较晚时段的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Toward a late time; relatively late in timing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 时间上偏晚、接近较晚时段的，用来描述安排或发生的时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun lejn ħin tard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 朝向较晚时段的；时间偏晚的。

collocations.en: an appointment at a late time
collocations.zh: 安排在偏晚时间的约会

formal.mt: Il-kumitat għażel ħin għasri għal-laqgħa biex il-membri jkunu jistgħu jattendu wara x-xogħol.
formal.en: The committee chose a late time for the meeting so that members could attend after work.
formal.zh: 委员会把会议安排在偏晚的时间，以便成员下班后参加。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-ħin għasri wisq għalija. Nista' niġi qabel? Rita: Iva, ejja siegħa qabel.
colloquial.en: Mark: This time is too late for me. Can I come earlier? Rita: Yes, come an hour earlier.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这个时间对我来说太晚了。我能早点来吗？Rita：可以，提前一个小时来吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ħin għasri wisq għalija. Nista' niġi qabel?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ħin għasri wisq għalija. Nista' niġi qabel?
messages.zh: 这个时间对我来说太晚了。我能早点来吗？
messages.en: This time is too late for me. Can I come earlier?

messages.speaker: Rita (接待员)
messages.zh: 可以，提前一个小时来吧。
messages.en: Yes, come an hour earlier.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在日程表上把 għasri 写在偏晚的时间格里，连同 ħin għasri 一起记，重点记住“时间偏晚”这个方向感。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To keep watch over a person, place, or thing, especially to protect it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 持续留意某人、某处或某物的情况，尤其指为了保护而看守、守卫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jo qgħod attent għal persuna, post jew ħaġa biex iħarishom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 守望；保持警觉，持续察看周围或某个对象的情况。
看守；守卫，保护人或事物免受伤害或未经许可的接近。

collocations.en: kept watch over the building during the night

formal.mt: Il-gwardjan għass id-daħla tal-maħżen matul il-lejl biex jipprevjeni dħul mingħajr permess.
formal.en: The guard watched the warehouse entrance during the night to prevent unauthorized entry.
formal.zh: 警卫夜间看守仓库入口，以防有人未经许可进入。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min għass il-bieb waqt li konna ġewwa? Pawlu: Mark. Baqa' hemm sakemm ħriġna lkoll.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who guarded the door while we were inside? Pawlu: Mark. He stayed there until we had all come out.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们在里面的时候，谁守着门？Pawlu：Mark。他一直待在那里，直到我们全都出来。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min għass il-bieb waqt li konna ġewwa?
messages.mt_standard: Min għass il-bieb waqt li konna ġewwa?
messages.zh: 我们在里面的时候，谁守着门？
messages.en: Who guarded the door while we were inside?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark. Baqa' hemm sakemm ħriġna lkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Mark. Baqa' hemm sakemm ħriġna lkoll.
messages.zh: Mark。他一直待在那里，直到我们全都出来。
messages.en: Mark. He stayed there until we had all come out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għass 配上一幅门口守卫的画：眼睛观察表示“守望”，身体守住入口表示“守卫”，两个义项共用同一场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To produce honey, as bees do.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产生或酿成蜂蜜，描述蜜蜂产蜜的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jipproduċi l-għasel, bħalma jagħmel in-naħal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 产蜜；酿蜜，即产生蜂蜜。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport tal-apikultur, in-naħal għassel tajjeb din is-sena.
formal.en: According to the beekeeper's report, the bees produced honey well this year.
formal.zh: 根据养蜂人的报告，今年蜜蜂的产蜜情况良好。

colloquial.mt: Maja: In-naħal għassel tajjeb din is-sena? Toni: Iva, ġbarna ħafna għasel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the bees produce honey well this year? Toni: Yes, we collected a lot of honey.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今年蜜蜂产蜜情况好吗？Toni：好，我们收了很多蜂蜜。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 今年蜜蜂产蜜情况好吗？
messages.en: Did the bees produce honey well this year?

messages.speaker: Toni (养蜂人)
messages.zh: 好，我们收了很多蜂蜜。
messages.en: Yes, we collected a lot of honey.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għassel 放在“蜜蜂忙碌，蜂蜜增加”的连续画面中，记成一个产蜜动作；练习时整句说 in-naħal għassel。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feed or nourish someone, or to restore strength or a former condition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给人或动物食物、提供滋养，也可指使力量或原有状态得到恢复。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti l-ikel jew in-nutriment, jew iġib lura s-saħħa jew il-qagħda ta' qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喂食；给人或动物食物。
滋养；提供维持生命、成长或健康所需的营养。
使恢复；使重新获得原有的力量或状态。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi għat lill-annimali qabel beda x-xogħol fl-għalqa.
formal.en: The farmer fed the animals before beginning work in the field.
formal.zh: 农夫开始下田干活之前，先给动物喂了食。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Min għat lill-annimali dalgħodu? Pawlu: Toni. Jien imlejt il-bwieqi bl-ilma.
colloquial.en: Rita: Who fed the animals this morning? Pawlu: Toni. I filled the bowls with water.
colloquial.zh: Rita：今天早上谁给动物喂了食？Pawlu：Toni。我给碗里装满了水。

messages.speaker: Rita (农场主人)
messages.zh: 今天早上谁给动物喂了食？
messages.en: Who fed the animals this morning?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场帮工)
messages.zh: Toni。我给碗里装满了水。
messages.en: Toni. I filled the bowls with water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“喂进食物、获得滋养、恢复力量”三幅学习画面串起 għat 的三个义项；这是记忆顺序，不是词源说明。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel thirsty, or figuratively to feel a strong longing for something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到需要喝水，也可比喻强烈地想得到某物或实现某种愿望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss il-bżonn li jixrob, jew, b'mod figurattiv, iħoss xewqa qawwija għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到口渴；产生需要喝水的感觉。
感到渴望；产生强烈的向往或企盼。

formal.mt: Wara mixja twila fix-xemx, it-tifel għatax u talab tazza ilma.
formal.en: After a long walk in the sun, the boy became thirsty and asked for a glass of water.
formal.zh: 在阳光下走了很长一段路后，男孩感到口渴，便要了一杯水。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark għatax wara l-ġiri? Maja: Iva, u xorob żewġ tazzi ilma.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Mark get thirsty after running? Maja: Yes, and he drank two glasses of water.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark 跑步后口渴了吗？Maja：是啊，他喝了两杯水。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 跑步后口渴了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark get thirsty after running?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u xorob żewġ tazzi ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u xorob żewġ tazzi ilma.
messages.zh: 是啊，他喝了两杯水。
messages.en: Yes, and he drank two glasses of water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想“身体想喝水”，再想“心里想求知”，用中文共有的“渴”字连接 għatax 的口渴义和渴望义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Stumbling or an episode in which a person's legs give way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 走动时绊顿、踉跄的现象，也可指双腿突然无力而无法稳稳支撑身体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tfixkil waqt il-mixi jew ċediment tar-riġlejn li jwassal biex persuna titlef il-bilanċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绊顿；踉跄，走动时脚步不稳、失去平衡的现象。
腿软失稳；双腿突然无力，不能继续支撑身体的情况。

collocations.en: the legs giving way because of weakness
collocations.zh: 因虚弱而双腿失去支撑

formal.mt: Fir-rapport ġie deskritt għatir waqt il-mixi, mingħajr waqgħa.
formal.en: The report described stumbling while walking, without a fall.
formal.zh: 报告描述了行走时出现踉跄、但没有跌倒的情况。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'ġara? Rajt dak l-għatir. Toni: Ir-riġlejn ċedewli għal mument. Ħa noqgħod bilqiegħda.
colloquial.en: Rita: What happened? I saw you stumble. Toni: My legs gave way for a moment. Let me sit down.
colloquial.zh: Rita：怎么了？我看到你踉跄了一下。Toni：我的腿刚才软了一下。我坐一会儿。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 怎么了？我看到你踉跄了一下。
messages.en: What happened? I saw you stumble.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-riġlejn ċedewli għal mument. Ħa noqgħod bilqiegħda.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-riġlejn ċedewli għal mument. Ħa noqgħod bilqiegħda.
messages.zh: 我的腿刚才软了一下。我坐一会儿。
messages.en: My legs gave way for a moment. Let me sit down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għatir 记成镜头里“脚步一晃、双腿一软”的那个现象；它是名词，可以描述失稳而尚未跌倒的情况。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or occurrence of sneezing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 打喷嚏这一动作或现象，指空气突然从鼻口喷出的反应。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-fenomenu li fih l-arja toħroġ f'daqqa mill-imnieħer u mill-ħalq meta persuna tagħtas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打喷嚏；喷嚏这一动作或现象。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanta semmiet għatis frekwenti waqt it-tindif tal-kamra mimlija trab.
formal.en: The participant reported frequent sneezing while cleaning the dusty room.
formal.zh: 这名参与者提到，她打扫满是灰尘的房间时频繁打喷嚏。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-għatis ma jieqaf xejn! Lara: Hawn ħafna trab. Ejja noħorġu ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: This sneezing just won't stop! Lara: There's a lot of dust here. Let's step outside for a bit.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这喷嚏怎么一直打个不停！Lara：这里灰尘很多。我们出去待一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 这喷嚏怎么一直打个不停！
messages.en: This sneezing just won't stop!

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ħafna trab. Ejja noħorġu ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ħafna trab. Ejja noħorġu ftit.
messages.zh: 这里灰尘很多。我们出去待一会儿吧。
messages.en: There's a lot of dust here. Let's step outside for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 għatis 时配上“阿嚏”的动作，把它记成“打喷嚏这件事”的名词；再用 frekwenti 联想连续打喷嚏。

gloss_zh: 企图掩盖终将暴露的事实；欲盖弥彰

teaching_sense.en_definition: To try to hide a fact or problem that will inevitably become known.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 试图掩盖一个终究会被人知道的事实或问题。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tipprova taħbi fatt jew problema li bilfors se jsiru magħrufa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to (try to) conceal something that is bound to come out
sense_translations.zh_definition: 试图隐瞒终究会暴露的事情；徒劳地掩盖事实。

collocations.en: tried to conceal the inevitable truth with numerous excuses
collocations.zh: 用许多借口企图掩盖终将暴露的真相

collocations.mt: għatta x-xemx bl-għarbiel billi ċaħad kollox
collocations.en: tried to conceal the inevitable truth by denying everything
collocations.zh: 以全盘否认的方式企图掩盖终将暴露的真相

formal.mt: Il-maniġer għatta x-xemx bl-għarbiel meta ċaħad it-telf, għalkemm iċ-ċifri kienu diġà ppubblikati.
formal.en: The manager tried to conceal the inevitable truth by denying the losses, although the figures had already been published.
formal.zh: 尽管相关数字已经公布，经理仍否认亏损，企图掩盖终将暴露的事实。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qal li ma kisser xejn, imma kulħadd rah. Mark: Għatta x-xemx bl-għarbiel; il-verità se toħroġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: He said he hadn't broken anything, but everyone saw him. Mark: He tried to hide the obvious; the truth will come out.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他说自己什么也没打碎，可大家都看见了。马克：他这是欲盖弥彰，真相总会出来的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qal li ma kisser xejn, imma kulħadd rah.
messages.mt_standard: Qal li ma kisser xejn, imma kulħadd rah.
messages.zh: 他说自己什么也没打碎，可大家都看见了。
messages.en: He said he hadn't broken anything, but everyone saw him.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għatta x-xemx bl-għarbiel; il-verità se toħroġ.
messages.mt_standard: Għatta x-xemx bl-għarbiel; il-verità se toħroġ.
messages.zh: 他这是欲盖弥彰，真相总会出来的。
messages.en: He tried to hide the obvious; the truth will come out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“明明人人看见，却还全盘否认”的场景记整句，抓住“真相终将暴露”这一关键意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To raise and care for a child as the child grows up.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在孩子成长过程中照顾、养育他，使其长大。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Trabbi tifel jew tifla u tieħu ħsiebhom sakemm jikbru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 养育；把孩子抚养长大。

collocations.zh: 把自己的孩子抚养长大
把自己的孙子抚养长大

formal.mt: Wara l-mewt ta' bintu, in-nannu għattaq lin-neputi tiegħu b'ħafna mħabba.
formal.en: After his daughter's death, the grandfather brought up his grandson with great love.
formal.zh: 女儿去世后，祖父满怀慈爱地把孙子抚养长大。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min għattaq lil Pawlu? Rita: In-nannu tiegħu għattaq lilu u lil oħtu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who brought Pawlu up? Rita: His grandfather brought up both him and his sister.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：是谁把保罗养大的？丽塔：他祖父把他和他姐姐都养大了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 是谁把保罗养大的？
messages.en: Who brought Pawlu up?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nannu tiegħu għattaq lilu u lil oħtu.
messages.mt_standard: In-nannu tiegħu għattaq lilu u lil oħtu.
messages.zh: 他祖父把他和他姐姐都养大了。
messages.en: His grandfather brought up both him and his sister.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与“祖父牵着孩子慢慢长大”的画面绑定，记住这里的 bring up 是抚养长大。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone sneeze, for example through dust or another irritant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人打喷嚏，例如灰尘或其他刺激物引发喷嚏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jagħtas, pereżempju minħabba t-trab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人打喷嚏；引起喷嚏。

collocations.en: the dust made the boy sneeze
the pepper made the cook sneeze

formal.mt: It-trab li tela' waqt it-tindif għattas lil diversi ħaddiema.
formal.en: The dust that rose during cleaning made several workers sneeze.
formal.zh: 清洁时扬起的灰尘使几名工人打了喷嚏。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'għattas lil Rita? Lara: It-trab minn dak il-ktieb qadim.
colloquial.en: Mark: What made Rita sneeze? Lara: The dust from that old book.
colloquial.zh: 马克：什么让丽塔打喷嚏了？劳拉：那本旧书上的灰尘。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 什么让丽塔打喷嚏了？
messages.en: What made Rita sneeze?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那本旧书上的灰尘。
messages.en: The dust from that old book.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象翻开旧书，灰尘扑来让人连打喷嚏；把这个词记成“使别人打喷嚏”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To visit a person or place frequently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经常去探望某人，或频繁到某处拜访。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iżżur lil xi ħadd jew tmur f'xi post ta' spiss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经常探访；频繁拜访。

formal.mt: Matul ix-xitwa, Pawlu għatteb għand zijuh biex jagħmillu kumpanija.
formal.en: Throughout the winter, Pawlu frequently visited his uncle to keep him company.
formal.zh: 整个冬天，保罗经常去探望叔叔，陪他作伴。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Pawlu għatteb għand in-nannu dan l-aħħar? Maja: Iva, kważi kuljum; joqgħod jitkellem miegħu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Has Pawlu been visiting his grandfather often lately? Maja: Yes, almost every day; he stays and chats with him.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：保罗最近常去探望祖父吗？玛雅：是啊，几乎每天都去，还会留下来陪他聊天。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu għatteb għand in-nannu dan l-aħħar?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu għatteb għand in-nannu dan l-aħħar?
messages.zh: 保罗最近常去探望祖父吗？
messages.en: Has Pawlu been visiting his grandfather often lately?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kważi kuljum; joqgħod jitkellem miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kważi kuljum; joqgħod jitkellem miegħu.
messages.zh: 是啊，几乎每天都去，还会留下来陪他聊天。
messages.en: Yes, almost every day; he stays and chats with him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历上连续多天都画着“去探望祖父”，把这个词与反复登门的频率联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To scrape a surface or remove material from it by scraping.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刮擦一个表面，或用刮擦的方式去掉表面的材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Togħrok wiċċ b'għodda biex tneħħi saff jew materjal minn fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刮；刮擦；刮去表面的东西。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem għattel iż-żebgħa l-qadima mill-bieb qabel ma żebgħu mill-ġdid.
formal.en: The worker scraped the old paint off the door before repainting it.
formal.zh: 工人在重新刷漆前，先把门上的旧油漆刮掉。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark għattel il-ħajt diġà? Rita: Iva, u issa lest għaż-żebgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has Mark scraped the wall already? Rita: Yes, and now it's ready for painting.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：马克已经把墙面刮好了吗？丽塔：是的，现在可以刷漆了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 马克已经把墙面刮好了吗？
messages.en: Has Mark scraped the wall already?

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 是的，现在可以刷漆了。
messages.en: Yes, and now it's ready for painting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刮刀贴着旧门移动，油漆一片片落下；用这个动作记住“刮、刮除”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A young female chicken that has not yet reached full maturity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尚未完全长成的年轻母鸡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiġieġa żgħira li għadha ma kibritx għal kollox.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小母鸡；尚未完全长成的母鸡。

collocations.en: a pullet in the chicken coop

formal.mt: Il-bidwi poġġa l-għattuqa f'gallinar nadif u pprovda ilma frisk kuljum.
formal.en: The farmer placed the pullet in a clean chicken coop and provided fresh water every day.
formal.zh: 农民把小母鸡安置在干净的鸡舍里，每天提供新鲜饮水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dik tiġieġa kbira? Pawlu: Le, għadha għattuqa; għadha żgħira.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is that a fully grown hen? Pawlu: No, she's still a pullet; she's still young.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那是成年母鸡吗？保罗：不是，还是只小母鸡，年纪还小。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 那是成年母鸡吗？
messages.en: Is that a fully grown hen?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (养鸡人)
messages.zh: 不是，还是只小母鸡，年纪还小。
messages.en: No, she's still a pullet; she's still young.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中给一只还没完全长大的母鸡挂上词卡，记牢这个词同时包含“年轻”和“母鸡”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The movable fold of skin that covers and protects the eye when it closes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够活动、闭合时覆盖并保护眼睛的皮肤褶层，即眼皮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti tal-ġilda li tiċċaqlaq biex tgħatti u tipproteġi l-għajn meta tingħalaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 眼睑；眼皮。

formal.mt: Fl-istampa, l-għalliem indika l-għatu tal-għajn u spjega kif jagħlaq fuq l-għajn.
formal.en: In the picture, the teacher pointed out the eyelid and explained how it closes over the eye.
formal.zh: 老师在图片上指出眼睑的位置，并解释它如何闭合、覆盖眼睛。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn għandek iż-żebgħa? Mark: Fuq l-għatu tal-għajn; nara fil-mera u nneħħiha bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where have you got the paint? Mark: On my eyelid; I'll look in the mirror and gently remove it.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你哪里沾到颜料了？马克：眼皮上；我照一下镜子，轻轻把它擦掉。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哪里沾到颜料了？
messages.en: Where have you got the paint?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq l-għatu tal-għajn; nara fil-mera u nneħħiha bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq l-għatu tal-għajn; nara fil-mera u nneħħiha bil-mod.
messages.zh: 眼皮上；我照一下镜子，轻轻把它擦掉。
messages.en: On my eyelid; I'll look in the mirror and gently remove it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 闭眼再睁眼，感受眼球前那层会活动的皮肤；把整个短语与“眼皮”这个具体部位绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short sleep, or a small amount of food or drink taken as a refreshment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指短时间的小睡，也可指用来稍作补充的少量食物或饮品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raħda qasira ta' rqad, jew ftit ikel jew xorb biex tieħu xi ħaġa ħafifa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小睡；短暂的睡眠。
少量茶点或饮品；稍作补充的轻食或饮料。

collocations.en: a light snack of bread and cheese
collocations.zh: 由面包和奶酪组成的一份小点心

formal.mt: Wara l-ikel, il-vjaġġatur ħa għatwa qasira qabel kompla bil-vjaġġ tiegħu.
formal.en: After the meal, the traveller took a short nap before continuing his journey.
formal.zh: 饭后，旅人小睡了一会儿，然后继续赶路。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nieħdu għatwa ħafifa qabel nitilqu? Mark: Iva, ftit ħobż u ġobon u tazza te jkunu biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we have a light refreshment before we leave? Mark: Yes, a little bread and cheese and a cup of tea will be enough.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：出发前吃点简单茶点，好吗？马克：好，一点面包和奶酪，再来杯茶就够了。

messages.speaker: Maja (旅伴)
messages.zh: 出发前吃点简单茶点，好吗？
messages.en: Shall we have a light refreshment before we leave?

messages.speaker: Mark (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ftit ħobż u ġobon u tazza te jkunu biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ftit ħobż u ġobon u tazza te jkunu biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 好，一点面包和奶酪，再来杯茶就够了。
messages.en: Yes, a little bread and cheese and a cup of tea will be enough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两张并列词卡：一张是枕头旁的短时钟，另一张是茶杯和小点心；分别记住“小睡”和“茶点”两个义项。

gloss_zh: 变成独眼；一只眼失明（旧用）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An obsolete verb meaning to become one-eyed, losing sight in one eye.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 旧用动词，指变成独眼，即一只眼睛失去视力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Verb antikwat li jfisser li wieħed tilef id-dawl minn għajn waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变成独眼；一只眼失明（旧用）。

collocations.en: became one-eyed after an accident (obsolete usage)
collocations.zh: 事故后一只眼失明（旧用表达）

collocations.en: lost sight in one eye because of an injury (obsolete usage)
collocations.zh: 因受伤而一只眼失明（旧用表达）

formal.mt: Il-verb antikwat 'għawar' ifisser li persuna tilfet id-dawl minn għajn waħda.
formal.en: The obsolete verb 'għawar' means that a person lost sight in one eye.
formal.zh: 旧用动词“għawar”表示一个人的一只眼睛失去了视力。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'għawar'? Pawlu: Li xi ħadd tilef id-dawl minn għajn waħda. Hija kelma antikwata.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'għawar' mean? Pawlu: That someone lost sight in one eye. It is an obsolete word.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：għawar是什么意思？保罗：指某人的一只眼睛失去了视力。这是个旧词。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: għawar是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'għawar' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Li xi ħadd tilef id-dawl minn għajn waħda. Hija kelma antikwata.
messages.mt_standard: Li xi ħadd tilef id-dawl minn għajn waħda. Hija kelma antikwata.
messages.zh: 指某人的一只眼睛失去了视力。这是个旧词。
messages.en: That someone lost sight in one eye. It is an obsolete word.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把għawar与“一只眼看不见”的画面相连，并在词卡上标注“旧用”，同时记住词义和使用限制。

gloss_zh: 戈佐岛女性；戈佐岛女子

teaching_sense.en_definition: A female person from Gozo; a Gozitan woman or girl.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自戈佐岛的女性，可以指成年女子或女孩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mara jew tifla li hija minn Għawdex.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 戈佐岛人；此词形指女性。

collocations.zh: 来自维多利亚的戈佐岛女子

collocations.en: a Gozitan woman who lives in Malta
collocations.zh: 住在马耳他的戈佐岛女子

formal.mt: Il-kelliema hija Għawdxija li taħdem fil-qasam tal-edukazzjoni.
formal.en: The speaker is a Gozitan woman who works in education.
formal.zh: 这位发言者是一名从事教育工作的戈佐岛女性。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Int Għawdxija? Rita: Iva, jien minn Għawdex, imma issa ngħix Malta.
colloquial.en: Mark: Are you from Gozo? Rita: Yes, I am from Gozo, but I live in Malta now.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你是戈佐岛人吗？丽塔：是的，我来自戈佐岛，不过现在住在马耳他。

messages.speaker: Mark (新同学)
messages.zh: 你是戈佐岛人吗？
messages.en: Are you from Gozo?

messages.speaker: Rita (女学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jien minn Għawdex, imma issa ngħix Malta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jien minn Għawdex, imma issa ngħix Malta.
messages.zh: 是的，我来自戈佐岛，不过现在住在马耳他。
messages.en: Yes, I am from Gozo, but I live in Malta now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位女子自我介绍“我是戈佐岛人”，把Għawdxija整词与这位女子相连，记住这里指女性。

gloss_zh: 改变主意；撤回言论；（动物）未能受孕

teaching_sense.en_definition: To change one's mind or withdraw a previous statement; also used of an animal that fails to become pregnant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指改变原来的想法，或撤回先前的言论；也可用于动物，表示未能受孕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ibiddel fehmtu jew jirtira dak li jkun qal; jintuża wkoll għal annimal femminili li ma joħroġx tqil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 改变主意；改变原来的想法。
撤回或收回先前表达的言论、观点或主张。

sense_translations.en_definition: to fail to be impregnated (used of animals)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 未能受孕，未能怀上幼崽（用于动物）。

collocations.en: changed his mind after thinking again
collocations.zh: 重新考虑后改变了主意

collocations.mt: għawed u rtira dak li kien qal
collocations.en: recanted and withdrew what he had said
collocations.zh: 改口并撤回了先前的言论

formal.mt: Wara li qara r-rapport il-ġdid, id-direttur għawed u ddeċieda li jappoġġja l-proposta.
formal.en: After reading the new report, the director changed his mind and decided to support the proposal.
formal.zh: 读完新报告后，主任改变了主意，决定支持这项提案。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Pawlu għadu ma jridx jiġi magħna? Mark: Le, għawed. Issa qal li ġej.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does Pawlu still not want to come with us? Mark: No, he changed his mind. Now he says he is coming.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗还是不想和我们一起去吗？马克：不是，他改变主意了。现在他说要来。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu għadu ma jridx jiġi magħna?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu għadu ma jridx jiġi magħna?
messages.zh: 保罗还是不想和我们一起去吗？
messages.en: Does Pawlu still not want to come with us?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għawed. Issa qal li ġej.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għawed. Issa qal li ġej.
messages.zh: 不是，他改变主意了。现在他说要来。
messages.en: No, he changed his mind. Now he says he is coming.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张情境卡记għawed：人物卡写“改主意、收回话”，动物卡写“未受孕”；凭上下文选择义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Howling: a long, drawn-out cry, such as the sound made by a dog.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拖长声音的嚎叫或嗥叫声，例如狗发出的长声叫唤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għajta twila u miġbuda, bħall-ħoss li jagħmel kelb meta jgħajjat fit-tul.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嚎叫；拖长声音的嗥叫声。

formal.mt: Matul il-lejl, l-għawi tal-klieb instema' minn diversi toroq tar-raħal.
formal.en: During the night, the howling of dogs could be heard from several streets in the village.
formal.zh: 夜间，从村里的几条街道都能听见狗的嚎叫声。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qed tisma' l-għawi tal-kelb? Toni: Iva, ġej mill-ġnien tal-ġar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you hear the dog's howling? Toni: Yes, it is coming from the neighbour's garden.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你听见狗的嚎叫声了吗？托尼：听见了，是从邻居的花园里传来的。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 你听见狗的嚎叫声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear the dog's howling?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.zh: 听见了，是从邻居的花园里传来的。
messages.en: Yes, it is coming from the neighbour's garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读għawi时想象狗把“呜——”拖得很长，用长音画面记住“嚎叫声”；这个词在这里是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Swimming as an activity or skill: moving through water using the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 游泳这项活动或技能，即利用身体动作在水中移动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività jew il-ħila li wieħed jimxi fl-ilma permezz tal-movimenti ta' ġismu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 游泳；游泳这项活动或技能。

formal.mt: L-iskola toffri lezzjonijiet tal-għawm għat-tfal kull nhar ta' Sibt.
formal.en: The school offers swimming lessons for children every Saturday.
formal.zh: 学校每周六为儿童开设游泳课。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tħobb l-għawm? Ben: Iva, immur il-pixxina darbtejn fil-ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you like swimming? Ben: Yes, I go to the pool twice a week.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你喜欢游泳吗？本：喜欢，我每周去游泳池两次。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢游泳吗？
messages.en: Do you like swimming?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 喜欢，我每周去游泳池两次。
messages.en: Yes, I go to the pool twice a week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把għawm放在“游泳课、游泳比赛”的画面中，记住它表示游泳这项活动；再与表示“一次游泳”的għawma对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A swim: one particular occasion or session of swimming.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次具体的游泳活动，强调游了一次或一趟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Darba waħda li wieħed jgħum, jew ħin partikolari li jqatta' jgħum.

sense_translations.en_definition: a swim, an instance of swimming
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次游泳；一趟游泳活动。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti temmew il-ġurnata b'għawma qasira fil-baħar.
formal.en: The participants ended the day with a short swim in the sea.
formal.zh: 参与者在海里短暂游了一次泳，以此结束当天的活动。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Trid tieħu għawma qabel nitilqu? Luka: Iva, imma waħda qasira għax dalwaqt irrid immur.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you want to have a swim before we leave? Luka: Yes, but a short one because I have to go soon.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们离开前，你想游一趟吗？卢卡：想，不过只能游一小会儿，因为我很快就得走。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们离开前，你想游一趟吗？
messages.en: Do you want to have a swim before we leave?

messages.speaker: Luka (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma waħda qasira għax dalwaqt irrid immur.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma waħda qasira għax dalwaqt irrid immur.
messages.zh: 想，不过只能游一小会儿，因为我很快就得走。
messages.en: Yes, but a short one because I have to go soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给għawma配一张“一次下水、一次上岸”的小图，记住它是一次具体游泳；għawm则表示游泳这项活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: European box-thorn, the plant species Lycium europaeum.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指学名为Lycium europaeum的欧洲枸杞这一植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pjanta magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Lycium europaeum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欧洲枸杞，学名为Lycium europaeum的植物。

formal.mt: L-istudenti qabblu l-weraq tal-għawseġ ma' dawk tal-pjanti l-oħra fil-ġnien.
formal.en: The students compared the leaves of European box-thorn with those of the other plants in the garden.
formal.zh: 学生们把欧洲枸杞的叶子与花园里其他植物的叶子作了比较。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-pjanta x'jisimha? Toni: Għawseġ. Fuq it-tikketta hemm ukoll l-isem Lycium europaeum.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this plant called? Toni: European box-thorn. The label also gives the name Lycium europaeum.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这株植物叫什么？托尼：欧洲枸杞。标签上还写着学名Lycium europaeum。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 这株植物叫什么？
messages.en: What is this plant called?

messages.speaker: Toni (园艺师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għawseġ. Fuq it-tikketta hemm ukoll l-isem Lycium europaeum.
messages.mt_standard: Għawseġ. Fuq it-tikketta hemm ukoll l-isem Lycium europaeum.
messages.zh: 欧洲枸杞。标签上还写着学名Lycium europaeum。
messages.en: European box-thorn. The label also gives the name Lycium europaeum.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象植物标签上并排写着“għawseġ—欧洲枸杞—Lycium europaeum”，用同一株植物把三个名称连起来记忆。

gloss_zh: 使眯眼；挖入；翻找；掏耳或抠鼻

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone screw up their eyes or squint; also to dig into something, rummage around, or pick one's ears or nose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指使某人紧眯双眼或眯眼看；也可指挖入某物、翻找东西，或掏耳朵、抠鼻子，具体含义由语境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd idejjaq jew jagħlaq għajnejh; jista' jfisser ukoll iħaffer f'xi ħaġa, iqalleb biex ifittex, jew idaħħal subgħajh f'widnejh jew f'imnieħru biex inaddafhom.

sense_translations.en_definition: to cause sb. to screw their eyes
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人紧眯双眼或用力眯起眼睛。
使某人眯眼看。
挖入某物；向某物内部挖掘。
翻找；翻来翻去地寻找东西。

sense_translations.en_definition: to pick one's ears or nose
sense_translations.zh_definition: 掏耳朵或抠鼻子。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem għawwar fl-art b'għodda żgħira biex jikxef il-pajp.
formal.en: The worker dug into the ground with a small tool to uncover the pipe.
formal.zh: 工人用一件小工具往地里挖，让管道露出来。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-kexxun kollu mqalleb? Mark: Pawlu għawwar fih biex ifittex iċ-ċwievet.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is the drawer all messed up? Mark: Pawlu rummaged through it looking for the keys.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：抽屉怎么被翻得乱七八糟的？马克：保罗为了找钥匙，在里面翻了一遍。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 抽屉怎么被翻得乱七八糟的？
messages.en: Why is the drawer all messed up?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu għawwar fih biex ifittex iċ-ċwievet.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu għawwar fih biex ifittex iċ-ċwievet.
messages.zh: 保罗为了找钥匙，在里面翻了一遍。
messages.en: Pawlu rummaged through it looking for the keys.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用五格画面记għawwar的不同义项：紧眯双眼、眯眼看、往里挖、翻抽屉、掏耳抠鼻；这是情境记忆法，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who instigates others to act, especially by stirring up trouble.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 挑动或怂恿别人采取行动的人，尤其指煽动事端的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqanqal lil ħaddieħor biex jaġixxi, speċjalment biex iqajjem l-inkwiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挑唆、怂恿或煽动他人行动的人。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi lil Pawlu bħala għawwej li ħeġġeġ lill-oħrajn jibdew il-ġlied.
formal.en: The report describes Pawlu as an instigator who encouraged the others to start the fight.
formal.zh: 报告将保罗描述为怂恿其他人开始打架的挑唆者。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex kulħadd beda jargumenta? Toni: Kien hemm għawwej fil-grupp li baqa' jqajjem l-inkwiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did everyone start arguing? Toni: There was an instigator in the group who kept stirring up trouble.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：大家为什么吵起来了？托尼：群里有个挑唆者，一直在挑起事端。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 大家为什么吵起来了？
messages.en: Why did everyone start arguing?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm għawwej fil-grupp li baqa' jqajjem l-inkwiet.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm għawwej fil-grupp li baqa' jqajjem l-inkwiet.
messages.zh: 群里有个挑唆者，一直在挑起事端。
messages.en: There was an instigator in the group who kept stirring up trouble.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象争吵背后不断怂恿别人的那个人，把这个词与“挑唆者”这一人物角色联系起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To act deceitfully by misleading someone or concealing the truth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以误导他人或隐瞒真相的方式耍诈、行骗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaġixxi bil-qerq billi jqarraq b'xi ħadd jew jaħbi l-verità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 行为欺诈；以不诚实的方式待人。

collocations.en: acted deceitfully to hide the truth

formal.mt: Il-bejjiegħ għawwel mal-klijenti billi ħeba l-ispiża vera tas-servizz.
formal.en: The seller acted deceitfully towards the customers by hiding the true cost of the service.
formal.zh: 卖方隐瞒了服务的真实费用，以此欺骗顾客。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak il-bejjiegħ? Toni: Għax għawwel miegħi u ma qallix il-prezz veru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why don't you trust that seller? Toni: Because he deceived me and didn't tell me the real price.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么不信任那个卖家？托尼：因为他骗过我，没有告诉我真实价格。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak il-bejjiegħ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak il-bejjiegħ?
messages.zh: 你为什么不信任那个卖家？
messages.en: Why don't you trust that seller?

messages.speaker: Toni (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għawwel miegħi u ma qallix il-prezz veru.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għawwel miegħi u ma qallix il-prezz veru.
messages.zh: 因为他骗过我，没有告诉我真实价格。
messages.en: Because he deceived me and didn't tell me the real price.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“卖家故意隐瞒真实价格”的画面作为提示：这个词强调耍诈、不诚实的行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number one million, written as 1,000,000.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数词，表示一百万，即1,000,000。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru miljun, miktub 1,000,000.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 百万；一百万。

formal.mt: Il-baġit totali tal-proġett huwa ta' għaxar mitt elf ewro.
formal.en: The project's total budget is one million euros.
formal.zh: 该项目的总预算为一百万欧元。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm jiswa l-proġett kollu? Toni: Għaxar mitt elf ewro. Maja: Mela miljun ewro!
colloquial.en: Maja: How much does the whole project cost? Toni: One million euros. Maja: So, a million euros!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：整个项目要花多少钱？托尼：一百万欧元。玛雅：也就是一百万欧元啊！

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 整个项目要花多少钱？
messages.en: How much does the whole project cost?

messages.speaker: Toni (项目负责人)
messages.zh: 一百万欧元。
messages.en: One million euros.

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 也就是一百万欧元啊！
messages.en: So, a million euros!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用数值乘法辅助记忆：għaxar是十，mitt是百，elf是千；十乘百乘千，结果是一百万。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number ten thousand, written as 10,000.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数词，表示一万，即10,000。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 10,000, jiġifieri għaxar darbiet elf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一万；十个一千。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, għaxart elef persuna attendew għall-avveniment.
formal.en: According to the report, ten thousand people attended the event.
formal.zh: 根据报告，一万人参加了这次活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm trid tiffranka għall-karozza? Toni: Għaxart elef ewro. Maja: Diġà ffrankajt xi ħaġa?
colloquial.en: Maja: How much do you want to save for the car? Toni: Ten thousand euros. Maja: Have you saved anything yet?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想为买车存多少钱？托尼：一万欧元。玛雅：你已经存下一些了吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想为买车存多少钱？
messages.en: How much do you want to save for the car?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 一万欧元。
messages.en: Ten thousand euros.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你已经存下一些了吗？
messages.en: Have you saved anything yet?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和数字10,000一起记：十个一千就是一万，再用“一万欧元”的购物情境巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The evening; commonly used in filgħaxija, meaning in the evening.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 傍晚或晚间；常见于连写形式filgħaxija，表示“在晚上”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħin lejn tmiem il-jum; normalment tintuża fil-forma filgħaxija.

sense_translations.en_definition: evening (usually preceded by the preposition 'fil-', orthographically rendered as a single word)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 傍晚；晚上。通常前接介词形式fil-，并连写为filgħaxija。

collocations.zh: 傍晚时分；晚上较早的时候

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir fis-sebgħa ta' filgħaxija fis-sala prinċipali.
formal.en: The meeting will take place at seven in the evening in the main hall.
formal.zh: 会议将于晚上七点在主厅举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Niltaqgħu filgħaxija? Toni: Iva, fis-sebgħa tajjeb għalik? Maja: Iva, narak hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we meet in the evening? Toni: Yes, does seven work for you? Maja: Yes, see you there.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们晚上见面好吗？托尼：好，七点你方便吗？玛雅：方便，到时见。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们晚上见面好吗？
messages.en: Shall we meet in the evening?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，七点你方便吗？
messages.en: Yes, does seven work for you?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 方便，到时见。
messages.en: Yes, see you there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“晚上七点见”的约会画面与filgħaxija一起记；词条是għaxija，常用时间表达连写成一个词。

gloss_zh: 令人愉悦之物；赏心乐事

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that causes delight or gives pleasure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带来喜悦、令人感到愉悦的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tagħti gost jew tqanqal pjaċir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人愉悦的事物；能带来喜悦。

formal.mt: Il-ġnien, bil-fjuri mlewna tiegħu, huwa għaxq għall-għajnejn.
formal.en: The garden, with its colourful flowers, is a delight to the eyes.
formal.zh: 花园里鲜花色彩缤纷，令人赏心悦目。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara kemm hemm fjuri! Toni: Dan il-ġnien huwa għaxq għall-għajnejn. Maja: Ejja noqogħdu ftit hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at all the flowers! Toni: This garden is a delight to the eyes. Maja: Let's stay here for a bit.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看，这里有这么多花！托尼：这座花园真让人赏心悦目。玛雅：我们在这里待一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 看，这里有这么多花！
messages.en: Look at all the flowers!

messages.speaker: Toni (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 这座花园真让人赏心悦目。
messages.en: This garden is a delight to the eyes.

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 我们在这里待一会儿吧。
messages.en: Let's stay here for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象看花时眼睛愉悦、听音乐时耳朵愉悦，用“令人赏心悦目的事物”来记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To experience discomfort or feel physically uneasy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到不舒服、难受或身体不自在。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss skumdità jew ma jkunx komdu fiżikament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到不适；经历不舒服的感觉。

collocations.en: felt uncomfortable on the hard chair
collocations.zh: 坐在硬椅子上感到难受

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa twila, Mark għaxwex fuq is-siġġu iebes u talab siġġu ieħor.
formal.en: During the long meeting, Mark felt uncomfortable on the hard chair and asked for another chair.
formal.zh: 漫长的会议期间，马克坐在硬椅子上感到难受，便请求换一把椅子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark qam mis-siġġu? Toni: Għax għaxwex; is-siġġu kien iebes wisq. Maja: Mela nagħtuh ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark get up from the chair? Toni: Because he felt uncomfortable; the chair was too hard. Maja: Then let's give him another one.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么从椅子上站起来了？托尼：因为坐着难受，那把椅子太硬了。玛雅：那我们给他换一把吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 马克为什么从椅子上站起来了？
messages.en: Why did Mark get up from the chair?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għaxwex; is-siġġu kien iebes wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għaxwex; is-siġġu kien iebes wisq.
messages.zh: 因为坐着难受，那把椅子太硬了。
messages.en: Because he felt uncomfortable; the chair was too hard.

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 那我们给他换一把吧。
messages.en: Then let's give him another one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象坐在硬椅子上不断挪动、怎么坐都不舒服的感觉，用这个身体画面记住“感到不适”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pay the traditional tithe to the Church.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向教会缴纳传统的什一税。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti lill-knisja l-għexur skont it-tradizzjoni.

sense_translations.en_definition: tithe traditionally paid to the church
sense_translations.zh_definition: 传统上向教会缴纳的什一税。

collocations.en: paid the tithe to the Church
paid the tithe out of the harvest

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-bidwi għaxxar lill-knisja minn dak li ħasad.
formal.en: In the story, the farmer paid the tithe to the Church out of his harvest.
formal.zh: 故事中，农民从自己的收成中向教会缴纳了什一税。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel il-bidwi f'dan ir-rakkont? Toni: Għaxxar lill-knisja mill-ħsad tiegħu. Maja: Jiġifieri ta l-għexur lill-knisja?
colloquial.en: Maja: What did the farmer do in this story? Toni: He paid the tithe to the Church out of his harvest. Maja: So he gave the Church the tithe?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个故事里的农民做了什么？托尼：他从收成中向教会缴纳了什一税。玛雅：也就是说，他把什一税交给了教会？

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个故事里的农民做了什么？
messages.en: What did the farmer do in this story?

messages.speaker: Toni (老师)
messages.zh: 他从收成中向教会缴纳了什一税。
messages.en: He paid the tithe to the Church out of his harvest.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 也就是说，他把什一税交给了教会？
messages.en: So he gave the Church the tithe?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用课文中的画面辅助记忆：农民把收成的一份交给教会，抓住“缴纳什一税”这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of twisting fibres into yarn or thread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把纤维捻成纱或线的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li biha l-fibri jitgħawġu flimkien biex isiru ħajt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纺纱；将纤维捻成线的活动。

formal.mt: Il-kors jintroduċi lill-istudenti għall-għażil tas-suf bl-idejn.
formal.en: The course introduces students to spinning wool by hand.
formal.zh: 这门课程让学生初步学习手工纺羊毛。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed titgħallem fil-kors? Rita: L-għażil tas-suf. Qed nitgħallem nagħmel il-ħajt bl-idejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you learning on the course? Rita: Wool spinning. I'm learning to make yarn by hand.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在课程里学什么？丽塔：纺羊毛。我正在学着用手把羊毛纺成线。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在课程里学什么？
messages.en: What are you learning on the course?

messages.speaker: Rita (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: L-għażil tas-suf. Qed nitgħallem nagħmel il-ħajt bl-idejn.
messages.mt_standard: L-għażil tas-suf. Qed nitgħallem nagħmel il-ħajt bl-idejn.
messages.zh: 纺羊毛。我正在学着用手把羊毛纺成线。
messages.en: Wool spinning. I'm learning to make yarn by hand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与双手捻纤维、长线慢慢形成的画面绑定，记住它表示纺纱这项活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of turning over or digging soil with a tool such as a hoe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 翻动土壤，或使用锄头等工具挖土的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li biha wieħed jaqleb jew iħaffer il-ħamrija b'għodda bħal mgħażqa.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of turning over soil
sense_translations.zh_definition: 翻土；把土壤翻动、翻过来的行为。

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of digging with an implement (such as a hoe)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用工具挖土的行为，例如用锄头锄挖。

formal.mt: L-għażiq tal-ħamrija bil-mgħażqa sar qabel it-tħawwil tal-ħxejjex.
formal.en: The soil was dug over with a hoe before the vegetables were planted.
formal.zh: 种植蔬菜之前，先用锄头翻了土。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'se nagħmlu fil-ġnien illum? Pawlu: Nibdew bl-għażiq, imbagħad inħawlu l-ħass.
colloquial.en: Mark: What are we going to do in the garden today? Pawlu: We'll start by digging over the soil, then plant the lettuce.
colloquial.zh: 马克：今天我们在菜园里做什么？保罗：先翻土，然后种生菜。

messages.speaker: Mark (园艺新手)
messages.zh: 今天我们在菜园里做什么？
messages.en: What are we going to do in the garden today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园艺伙伴)
messages.zh: 先翻土，然后种生菜。
messages.en: We'll start by digging over the soil, then plant the lettuce.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象锄头落地后把一块土翻起来：既可记翻土，也可记用工具挖土这两个相邻义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Choosing or including only certain people or things according to particular criteria.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按一定标准只挑选或纳入某些人或事物的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħżel jew jinkludi biss ċerti persuni jew affarijiet skont kriterji partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有选择性的；按标准有所挑选的。

formal.mt: Il-programm juża proċess għażli biex jaċċetta studenti li jissodisfaw il-kriterji.
formal.en: The programme uses a selective process to admit students who meet the criteria.
formal.zh: 该项目通过有选择性的程序录取符合标准的学生。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Se ninkludu r-ritratti kollha fl-album? Maja: Le, nużaw approċċ għażli u nżommu biss l-aħjar għoxrin.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are we going to include all the photos in the album? Maja: No, let's take a selective approach and keep only the best twenty.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们要把所有照片都放进相册吗？玛雅：不，我们挑选一下，只留下最好的二十张。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们要把所有照片都放进相册吗？
messages.en: Are we going to include all the photos in the album?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, nużaw approċċ għażli u nżommu biss l-aħjar għoxrin.
messages.mt_standard: Le, nużaw approċċ għażli u nżommu biss l-aħjar għoxrin.
messages.zh: 不，我们挑选一下，只留下最好的二十张。
messages.en: No, let's take a selective approach and keep only the best twenty.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用挑选相册照片来记：面对一大堆材料，按标准只留下部分，就是有选择性的。

gloss_zh: 吊唁探访；慰问丧家的拜访

teaching_sense.en_definition: A visit to someone who has lost a loved one, made to express sympathy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为向失去亲人的人表达哀悼与慰问而进行的探访。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żjara lil min tilef persuna għażiża biex wieħed jesprimi s-sogħba tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吊唁探访；前往丧家表达哀悼和慰问的拜访。

collocations.en: to go on a condolence visit
a condolence visit to the family

formal.mt: Ir-rappreżentanti tal-għaqda marru għal għażwa għand il-familja biex jesprimu s-sogħba tagħhom.
formal.en: The association's representatives paid a condolence visit to the family to express their sympathy.
formal.zh: 协会代表前往丧家吊唁，表达慰问。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn sejrin illejla? Mark: Għal għażwa għand il-familja ta' Pawlu. Miet missieru.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where are we going this evening? Mark: On a condolence visit to Pawlu's family. His father died.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：今晚我们去哪里？马克：去保罗家吊唁。他父亲去世了。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 今晚我们去哪里？
messages.en: Where are we going this evening?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal għażwa għand il-familja ta' Pawlu. Miet missieru.
messages.mt_standard: Għal għażwa għand il-familja ta' Pawlu. Miet missieru.
messages.zh: 去保罗家吊唁。他父亲去世了。
messages.en: On a condolence visit to Pawlu's family. His father died.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词义放进安静探访丧家的场景：登门表达哀悼与关怀，重点是这次慰问拜访。

gloss_zh: 像孩子般歇斯底里地哭喊（可能为方言用法）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cry hysterically like a child; this use may be dialectal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 像孩子一样歇斯底里地哭喊；这一用法可能属于方言。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jibki b'mod isteriku bħal tifel; dan l-użu jista' jkun djalettali.

sense_translations.en_definition: according to Aquilina, to cry hysterically like a child (possibly dialectal)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 据 Aquilina，指像孩子一样歇斯底里地哭喊，可能为方言用法。

collocations.zh: 因害怕而歇斯底里地哭喊
像孩子般歇斯底里地哭喊

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel għażżar bil-biża' meta sab ruħu waħdu.
formal.en: In the story, the boy cried hysterically out of fear when he found himself alone.
formal.zh: 故事中，男孩发现自己孤身一人时，害怕得歇斯底里地哭喊。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ġara lit-tifel meta sema' l-ħoss? Rita: Għażżar bil-biża', imma kkalma meta waslet ommu.
colloquial.en: Sara: What happened to the boy when he heard the noise? Rita: He cried hysterically out of fear, but calmed down when his mother arrived.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：男孩听到那声音后怎么了？丽塔：他吓得歇斯底里地哭喊，不过妈妈来了以后就平静了。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 男孩听到那声音后怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the boy when he heard the noise?

messages.speaker: Rita (照看者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għażżar bil-biża', imma kkalma meta waslet ommu.
messages.mt_standard: Għażżar bil-biża', imma kkalma meta waslet ommu.
messages.zh: 他吓得歇斯底里地哭喊，不过妈妈来了以后就平静了。
messages.en: He cried hysterically out of fear, but calmed down when his mother arrived.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用孩子受惊后失控哭喊的画面记住强烈程度，同时把可能为方言用法的提示一起记住。

gloss_zh: 使某人感到无聊；使厌烦

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone feel bored or uninterested.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人觉得无聊、乏味或失去兴趣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħoss id-dwejjaq jew jitlef l-interess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人感到无聊；使某人厌烦。

formal.mt: Id-diskors twil u ripetittiv għażżeb lill-udjenza.
formal.en: The long, repetitive speech bored the audience.
formal.zh: 那篇冗长而重复的演讲使听众感到无聊。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għoġbok id-diskors? Mark: Le, kien twil wisq u għażżeb lil kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you like the speech? Mark: No, it was too long and bored everyone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你喜欢那场演讲吗？马克：不喜欢，太长了，大家都听得很无聊。

messages.speaker: Maja (听众)
messages.zh: 你喜欢那场演讲吗？
messages.en: Did you like the speech?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kien twil wisq u għażżeb lil kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kien twil wisq u għażżeb lil kulħadd.
messages.zh: 不喜欢，太长了，大家都听得很无聊。
messages.en: No, it was too long and bored everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象冗长演讲让听众频频看钟，记成某件事使人无聊，并留意动作影响的是人。

gloss_zh: 使磨散；使边缘起毛或散线

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make the threads at the edge of cloth or rope become loose or worn.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使布料或绳索边缘的纤维磨损、松散或散开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħmel il-ħjut fit-tarf ta' drapp jew ħabel jinħallu jew jitmermru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使纤维磨散、起毛或散线，尤指布料或绳索的边缘。

collocations.en: frayed the edge of the fabric

formal.mt: Il-ħakk kontinwu mal-ġebla għażżel il-ħabel.
formal.en: Constant rubbing against the stone frayed the rope.
formal.zh: 绳索不断与石头摩擦，纤维被磨得松散起毛。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex hemm tant ħjut maħlula fit-tarf? Sara: Il-ħakk għażżel it-tarf tad-drapp. Irridu nsewwuh.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why are there so many loose threads at the edge? Sara: Rubbing frayed the edge of the fabric. We need to mend it.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：边上怎么有这么多松散的线头？萨拉：摩擦把布边磨散了，我们得把它缝好。

messages.speaker: Rita (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm tant ħjut maħlula fit-tarf?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm tant ħjut maħlula fit-tarf?
messages.zh: 边上怎么有这么多松散的线头？
messages.en: Why are there so many loose threads at the edge?

messages.speaker: Sara (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħakk għażżel it-tarf tad-drapp. Irridu nsewwuh.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħakk għażżel it-tarf tad-drapp. Irridu nsewwuh.
messages.zh: 摩擦把布边磨散了，我们得把它缝好。
messages.en: Rubbing frayed the edge of the fabric. We need to mend it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象布边被反复摩擦后冒出零散线头，用这个具体画面记住磨散、起毛和散线。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to become lazy or less willing to make an effort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人变得懒散，或不愿付出努力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħmel lil xi ħadd għażżien jew inqas lest li jagħmel sforz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人变懒；使某人变得懒散。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, in-nuqqas ta' responsabbiltajiet għażżen lit-tifel.
formal.en: In the story, the lack of responsibilities made the boy lazy.
formal.zh: 故事中，由于没有需要承担的责任，男孩变得懒散了。
