colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark m'għadux jgħin fid-dar? Rita: Kulħadd jagħmel kollox għalih, u dan għażżen lil Mark.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why doesn't Mark help at home anymore? Rita: Everyone does everything for him, and that has made Mark lazy.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克怎么不再帮忙做家务了？丽塔：大家什么都替他做，这让马克变懒了。

messages.speaker: Maja (姐姐)
messages.zh: 马克怎么不再帮忙做家务了？
messages.en: Why doesn't Mark help at home anymore?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Kulħadd jagħmel kollox għalih, u dan għażżen lil Mark.
messages.mt_standard: Kulħadd jagħmel kollox għalih, u dan għażżen lil Mark.
messages.zh: 大家什么都替他做，这让马克变懒了。
messages.en: Everyone does everything for him, and that has made Mark lazy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人事事被代劳，渐渐不愿动手；把这个词记成某种情况使人变懒的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A gazelle, or a cicada; the intended animal is identified from the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指瞪羚，也可指蝉；需要根据草地、树木、鸣声等语境判断具体所指。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal li jista' jkun gazzella jew insett li jgħanni fis-siġar, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 瞪羚，一种身形轻巧的羚羊。
蝉，会发出明显鸣声的昆虫。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt tidher għażżiela tiġri fil-mergħa ħdejn annimali oħra.
formal.en: The photograph shows a gazelle running in the meadow near other animals.
formal.zh: 照片中，一只瞪羚正在其他动物附近的草地上奔跑。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Tisma' dak il-ħoss fis-siġra? Mark: Iva, hemm għażżiela fuq il-fergħa. Anna: Mela hawn qed nitkellmu dwar l-insett.
colloquial.en: Anna: Can you hear that sound in the tree? Mark: Yes, there is a cicada on the branch. Anna: So here we are talking about the insect.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你听见树上的声音了吗？Mark：听见了，树枝上有一只蝉。Anna：所以这里说的是那种昆虫。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听见树上的声音了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that sound in the tree?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 听见了，树枝上有一只蝉。
messages.en: Yes, there is a cicada on the branch.

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela hawn qed nitkellmu dwar l-insett.
messages.mt_standard: Mela hawn qed nitkellmu dwar l-insett.
messages.zh: 所以这里说的是那种昆虫。
messages.en: So here we are talking about the insect.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给这个词画两张语境卡：草地上奔跑的是瞪羚，树枝上鸣叫的是蝉；靠场景区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Eden, the paradise associated with Adam and Eve.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 伊甸园，指亚当与夏娃所在的乐园，是一个专有名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem tal-ġenna ta' Adam u Eva.

sense_translations.en_definition: Eden (the paradise of Adam and Eve)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 伊甸园，即亚当与夏娃所在的乐园。

collocations.zh: 伊甸园中的亚当与夏娃

formal.mt: Fit-test, Għeden jissemma bħala l-ġenna ta' Adam u Eva.
formal.en: In the text, Eden is mentioned as the paradise of Adam and Eve.
formal.zh: 文中提到，伊甸园是亚当与夏娃所在的乐园。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu Għeden f'din l-istorja? Pawlu: Huwa l-ġenna ta' Adam u Eva. Lara: Issa nifhem għaliex jissemmew it-tnejn.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is Eden in this story? Pawlu: It is the paradise of Adam and Eve. Lara: Now I understand why both of them are mentioned.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这个故事里的伊甸园是什么？Pawlu：就是亚当与夏娃所在的乐园。Lara：现在我明白为什么两个人都会被提到了。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这个故事里的伊甸园是什么？
messages.en: What is Eden in this story?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa l-ġenna ta' Adam u Eva.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa l-ġenna ta' Adam u Eva.
messages.zh: 就是亚当与夏娃所在的乐园。
messages.en: It is the paradise of Adam and Eve.

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 现在我明白为什么两个人都会被提到了。
messages.en: Now I understand why both of them are mentioned.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把大写的 Għeden 想成乐园入口的地名牌，旁边写着亚当与夏娃，帮助记住它是专有名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To identify or distinguish something by giving it a label, tag, or mark.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给事物贴上标签、附上识别标记或作出记号，以便识别或区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Poġġa tikketta jew marka fuq xi ħaġa biex tingħaraf jew tintgħaraf minn oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贴标签；用标签注明名称、内容或类别。
附上识别标签或标记，以便辨认或追踪。
作记号；在事物上标明位置、区别或其他信息。

collocations.en: marked the spot with a cross
collocations.zh: 用十字记号标出了位置

formal.mt: L-assistent għelem kull kaxxa b'tikketta li turi x'hemm ġewwa.
formal.en: The assistant labeled each box with a label showing what was inside.
formal.zh: 助手给每个箱子贴上了注明箱内物品的标签。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif se nagħrfu l-kaxxi tagħna? Mark: Pawlu għelem kull kaxxa b'isimna. Sara: Tajjeb, mela faċli nsibuhom.
colloquial.en: Sara: How will we recognize our boxes? Mark: Pawlu marked each box with our names. Sara: Good, then they will be easy to find.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们怎么认出自己的箱子？Mark：Pawlu 已经在每个箱子上标了我们的名字。Sara：好，那就容易找到了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 我们怎么认出自己的箱子？
messages.en: How will we recognize our boxes?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: Pawlu 已经在每个箱子上标了我们的名字。
messages.en: Pawlu marked each box with our names.

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 好，那就容易找到了。
messages.en: Good, then they will be easy to find.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整理箱子的三个动作连起来：贴名称标签、挂识别牌、画位置记号，都是为了让东西容易辨认。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a mistake or be wrong in an action, answer, or judgment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在行动、回答或判断中出现错误；犯错或弄错。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel żball f'azzjoni, fi tweġiba jew f'ġudizzju.

sense_translations.en_definition: to make a mistake, to err
sense_translations.zh_definition: 犯错误；弄错；作出错误的判断或行为。

collocations.en: made a mistake in the calculation

formal.mt: L-istudent għelet fil-kalkolu, iżda kkoreġa l-iżball wara li reġa' qara l-mistoqsija.
formal.en: The student made a mistake in the calculation but corrected it after reading the question again.
formal.zh: 这名学生计算时出了错，但重新阅读题目后改正了错误。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex it-total mhux tajjeb? Toni: Mark għelet fil-kalkolu; għodd darbtejn l-istess numru. Nina: Mela nerġgħu niċċekkjawh flimkien.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is the total wrong? Toni: Mark made a mistake in the calculation; he counted the same number twice. Nina: Then let us check it again together.
colloquial.zh: Nina：总数为什么不对？Toni：Mark 算错了，同一个数算了两次。Nina：那我们一起再检查一遍。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 总数为什么不对？
messages.en: Why is the total wrong?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark għelet fil-kalkolu; għodd darbtejn l-istess numru.
messages.mt_standard: Mark għelet fil-kalkolu; għodd darbtejn l-istess numru.
messages.zh: Mark 算错了，同一个数算了两次。
messages.en: Mark made a mistake in the calculation; he counted the same number twice.

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 那我们一起再检查一遍。
messages.en: Then let us check it again together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象算总数时把同一个数字算了两遍，再用红笔圈出错误，把这个词与犯错的动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A servant, or an enslaved person; the context determines which status is meant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指为他人服役的仆人，也可指被奴役、没有自由的奴隶；应根据语境区分身份。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taqdi lil ħaddieħor, jew persuna fil-jasar, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仆人，为他人提供家务或其他服侍工作的人。
奴隶，被他人控制并剥夺自由的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, l-għeliem jieħu ħsieb ix-xogħol tad-dar u jaqdi lill-familja.
formal.en: In the story, the servant takes care of the housework and serves the family.
formal.zh: 故事中，这名仆人负责家务并服侍这家人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hawn 'għeliem' tfisser qaddej jew skjav? Pawlu: Hawn tfisser skjav, għax it-test jgħid li ma kienx ħieles. Lara: Mela rridu nħarsu lejn il-kuntest.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does 'għeliem' mean a servant or a slave here? Pawlu: Here it means a slave, because the text says he was not free. Lara: So we need to look at the context.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这里的 għeliem 是指仆人还是奴隶？Pawlu：这里指奴隶，因为文中说他没有自由。Lara：所以我们得看上下文。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 għeliem 是指仆人还是奴隶？
messages.en: Does 'għeliem' mean a servant or a slave here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser skjav, għax it-test jgħid li ma kienx ħieles.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser skjav, għax it-test jgħid li ma kienx ħieles.
messages.zh: 这里指奴隶，因为文中说他没有自由。
messages.en: Here it means a slave, because the text says he was not free.

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 所以我们得看上下文。
messages.en: So we need to look at the context.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做两张人物卡：一张写仆人，一张写失去自由的奴隶；阅读时用上下文判断这个词对应哪张卡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sticky, glue-like substance that clings to a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 像胶一样黏稠、容易附着在物体表面的物质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza twaħħal li tibqa' mwaħħla ma' wiċċ jew ma' oġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胶状的黏性物质；黏乎乎的东西。

collocations.en: a gluey substance on the table
a gluey substance sticking to the hands

formal.mt: Qabel it-tindif, kien hemm għelk fuq il-wiċċ tal-mejda.
formal.en: Before cleaning, there was a gluey substance on the surface of the table.
formal.zh: 清洁前，桌面上有一层胶状黏物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawn għelk fuq il-mejda. Mark: Ġib drapp biex inneħħuh. Maja: Tajjeb, imma oqgħod attent għax jeħel mal-idejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: There is a gluey substance on the table. Mark: Bring a cloth so we can remove it. Maja: All right, but be careful because it sticks to your hands.
colloquial.zh: Maja：桌上有黏乎乎的东西。Mark：拿块布来，我们把它擦掉。Maja：好，不过小心，它会黏手。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 桌上有黏乎乎的东西。
messages.en: There is a gluey substance on the table.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 拿块布来，我们把它擦掉。
messages.en: Bring a cloth so we can remove it.

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, imma oqgħod attent għax jeħel mal-idejn.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, imma oqgħod attent għax jeħel mal-idejn.
messages.zh: 好，不过小心，它会黏手。
messages.en: All right, but be careful because it sticks to your hands.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手碰到桌上一团黏物，抬起来还有黏连的感觉，用这种触觉画面记住胶状黏性物质。

gloss_zh: 关闭；闷热不通风；污浊闷气；缺气感；作品结尾

teaching_sense.en_definition: Closure; stuffiness or stale, enclosed air; a feeling of lacking air; or the concluding part of a written work or performance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指关闭，也可指空气不流通的闷感、污浊闷气或感觉缺少空气，还可指文章或表演的结尾。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għeluq ta' xi ħaġa; nuqqas ta' arja friska jew sensazzjoni li jonqos l-arja; jew il-parti finali ta' kitba jew wirja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 关闭；使某处或某物停止开放的状态或行为。
空气不流通造成的闷热、憋闷状态。
封闭空间内积聚的污浊闷气。
感觉空气不足、呼吸憋闷的感觉。

sense_translations.en_definition: conclusion to a piece of writing or performance
sense_translations.zh_definition: 文章、文字作品或表演的结尾、收尾部分。

collocations.en: the conclusion of the written piece

formal.mt: Fl-għeluq tal-kitba, l-awtur jiġbor il-punti ewlenin u jippreżenta l-konklużjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: In the conclusion of the written piece, the author brings together the main points and presents his conclusion.
formal.zh: 在文章结尾，作者归纳了主要观点，并提出自己的结论。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hawn ħafna għeluq; qed inħoss li jonqosni l-arja. Toni: Niftaħ it-tieqa biex tidħol arja friska. Sara: Grazzi. U t-triq għadha magħluqa? Toni: Iva, l-għeluq tat-triq jibqa' sa għada.
colloquial.en: Sara: It is very stuffy here; I feel as though I do not have enough air. Toni: I will open the window to let in fresh air. Sara: Thanks. And is the road still closed? Toni: Yes, the road closure will remain in place until tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这里太闷了，我感觉空气不够。Toni：我把窗户打开，让新鲜空气进来。Sara：谢谢。对了，那条路还封着吗？Toni：是的，道路封闭会持续到明天。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ħafna għeluq; qed inħoss li jonqosni l-arja.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ħafna għeluq; qed inħoss li jonqosni l-arja.
messages.zh: 这里太闷了，我感觉空气不够。
messages.en: It is very stuffy here; I feel as though I do not have enough air.

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Niftaħ it-tieqa biex tidħol arja friska.
messages.mt_standard: Niftaħ it-tieqa biex tidħol arja friska.
messages.zh: 我把窗户打开，让新鲜空气进来。
messages.en: I will open the window to let in fresh air.

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 谢谢。对了，那条路还封着吗？
messages.en: Thanks. And is the road still closed?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, l-għeluq tat-triq jibqa' sa għada.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, l-għeluq tat-triq jibqa' sa għada.
messages.zh: 是的，道路封闭会持续到明天。
messages.en: Yes, the road closure will remain in place until tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅画面串记：道路关闭、房间空气不通而憋闷、文章或表演收尾；闷的语境再区分环境、闷气和个人缺气感。这只是记忆联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The anniversary of the day on which a person was born.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 每年纪念一个人出生日期的日子，即生日。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-jum li fih persuna tfakkar kull sena d-data tat-twelid tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生日；每年与出生日期相同的日子。

formal.mt: Fl-okkażjoni ta' għeluq sninha, l-istudenta rċeviet ktieb mingħand sħabha tal-klassi.
formal.en: On her birthday, the student received a book from her classmates.
formal.zh: 这名女学生在生日当天收到了同班同学送的一本书。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta hu għeluq sninek? Mark: Għada! Se nagħmel festa żgħira d-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: When is your birthday? Mark: Tomorrow! I'm having a small party at home.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你什么时候过生日？Mark：明天！我会在家办个小聚会。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你什么时候过生日？
messages.en: When is your birthday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għada! Se nagħmel festa żgħira d-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Għada! Se nagħmel festa żgħira d-dar.
messages.zh: 明天！我会在家办个小聚会。
messages.en: Tomorrow! I'm having a small party at home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和生日蛋糕、蜡烛、礼物一起记忆；问朋友生日时练习说“Meta hu għeluq sninek?”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being narrow, with little space across or between the sides.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宽度小、两侧之间空间有限的状态或程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-karatteristika ta' xi ħaġa li tkun dejqa, bi ftit spazju bejn il-ġnub tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狭窄；宽度或横向空间有限的状态。

formal.mt: Minħabba l-għeluqija tat-triq, vetturi kbar ma jistgħux jgħaddu minnha.
formal.en: Because of the narrowness of the road, large vehicles cannot pass along it.
formal.zh: 由于道路狭窄，大型车辆无法通行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma nistgħux ngħaddu t-tnejn flimkien? Pawlu: Minħabba l-għeluqija tal-passaġġ. Għaddi int l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why can't we both go through together? Pawlu: Because of the narrowness of the passage. You go first.
colloquial.zh: Maja：为什么我们不能一起过去？Pawlu：因为通道太窄。你先过吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistgħux ngħaddu t-tnejn flimkien?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistgħux ngħaddu t-tnejn flimkien?
messages.zh: 为什么我们不能一起过去？
messages.en: Why can't we both go through together?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba l-għeluqija tal-passaġġ. Għaddi int l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba l-għeluqija tal-passaġġ. Għaddi int l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 因为通道太窄。你先过吧。
messages.en: Because of the narrowness of the passage. You go first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两人走到窄通道前，必须一前一后通过，用这个画面记住“狭窄”的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something a person does, or the way a person behaves, especially as judged by its effects or moral quality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人做出的事情、采取的行动或表现出的行为，尤其用于评价其影响或好坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dak li persuna tagħmel, jew il-mod kif iġġib ruħha, speċjalment meta jitqies jekk huwiex tajjeb jew ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一件做过的事；一项行为，常带有善恶评价。
一次行动；实际做出的举动。
行为表现；一个人的处事方式或所作所为。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jenfasizza li l-għemil ta' kull membru jista' jinfluwenza l-fiduċja tal-pubbliku fl-organizzazzjoni.
formal.en: The report emphasizes that each member's behaviour can influence public trust in the organization.
formal.zh: 报告强调，每位成员的行为都可能影响公众对该组织的信任。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark jgħid li dejjem jgħin lil kulħadd. Pawlu: Jien inħares lejn l-għemil tiegħu. Ilbieraħ għen lill-ġara ġġorr ix-xiri.
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark says he always helps everyone. Pawlu: I look at his actions. Yesterday he helped the neighbour carry her shopping.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark说他总是帮助大家。Pawlu：我看他的实际行动。昨天他帮邻居搬了买回来的东西。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark jgħid li dejjem jgħin lil kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Mark jgħid li dejjem jgħin lil kulħadd.
messages.zh: Mark说他总是帮助大家。
messages.en: Mark says he always helps everyone.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien inħares lejn l-għemil tiegħu. Ilbieraħ għen lill-ġara ġġorr ix-xiri.
messages.mt_standard: Jien inħares lejn l-għemil tiegħu. Ilbieraħ għen lill-ġara ġġorr ix-xiri.
messages.zh: 我看他的实际行动。昨天他帮邻居搬了买回来的东西。
messages.en: I look at his actions. Yesterday he helped the neighbour carry her shopping.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“看他做了什么”来记这个词：可以指一件事、一次行动，也可以概括一个人的行为表现。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A quick closing and opening of one eye to communicate a signal, joke, or shared understanding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 迅速闭合再睁开一只眼睛的动作，用来示意、开玩笑或表达彼此心照不宣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għeluq u ftuħ malajr ta' għajn waħda biex jingħata sinjal jew tintwera ċajta jew fehma komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次眨眼示意；通过眨一只眼睛来传递意思的动作。

collocations.zh: 眨着眼示意；带着一个眼色

formal.mt: Fi tmiem ir-rakkont, il-karattru jagħmel għemża biex juri li l-aħħar kumment kien ċajta.
formal.en: At the end of the story, the character gives a wink to show that the last comment was a joke.
formal.zh: 故事结尾，人物眨了一下眼，表示最后那句话是在开玩笑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għamiltli għemża? Mark: Biex tifhem li kont qed niċċajta!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you wink at me? Mark: So you'd understand that I was joking!
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么朝我眨眼？Mark：为了让你明白我是在开玩笑！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么朝我眨眼？
messages.en: Why did you wink at me?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex tifhem li kont qed niċċajta!
messages.mt_standard: Biex tifhem li kont qed niċċajta!
messages.zh: 为了让你明白我是在开玩笑！
messages.en: So you'd understand that I was joking!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友讲完笑话后朝你眨一只眼，把这个无声的小信号和“għemża”一起记住。

gloss_zh: 我觉得；在我看来；我看似乎

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression introducing something as the speaker's impression or personal judgment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 引出说话者个人印象或判断的表达，相当于“我觉得”或“在我看来”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintuża biex wieħed juri kif tidhirlu xi ħaġa jew x'jaħseb dwarha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我觉得；在我看来似乎如此，表示个人印象或判断。

collocations.en: it seems to me that everything is fine

formal.mt: Għenelli li din il-proposta tagħti tweġiba ċara għall-mistoqsija ewlenija.
formal.en: It seems to me that this proposal gives a clear answer to the main question.
formal.zh: 在我看来，这项提议对主要问题给出了明确的回答。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għenelli li se tagħmel ix-xita. Mark: Iva, ħu umbrella miegħek.
colloquial.en: Maja: It seems to me that it's going to rain. Mark: Yes, take an umbrella with you.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我看好像要下雨了。Mark：是啊，带把伞吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我看好像要下雨了。
messages.en: It seems to me that it's going to rain.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，带把伞吧。
messages.en: Yes, take an umbrella with you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它当作句首的“个人看法提示牌”：看到乌云时先说“我看好像”，再接自己的判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A male goat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 雄性的山羊，即公山羊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-maskil tal-mogħża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公山羊；雄性山羊。

formal.mt: Waqt iż-żjara fir-razzett, l-istudenti raw għens ħdejn l-ilqugħ.
formal.en: During the farm visit, the students saw a billygoat beside the fence.
formal.zh: 参观农场时，学生们在围栏旁看到了一只公山羊。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dak l-għens għandu qrun kbar! Pawlu: Iva, ejja narawh minn hawn, wara l-ilqugħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: That billygoat has big horns! Pawlu: Yes, let's watch him from here, behind the fence.
colloquial.zh: Lara：那只公山羊的角好大！Pawlu：是啊，我们就站在围栏后面这里看它吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.zh: 那只公山羊的角好大！
messages.en: That billygoat has big horns!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja narawh minn hawn, wara l-ilqugħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja narawh minn hawn, wara l-ilqugħ.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们就站在围栏后面这里看它吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's watch him from here, behind the fence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给农场里的雄性山羊挂上写有“għens”的学习标签，重点记住它明确指“公山羊”。

gloss_zh: 幼犬短促的尖叫声；幼犬尖叫

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short, high-pitched cry or bark, especially from a young puppy that has not yet learned to bark properly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 短促而尖细的叫声，尤其指尚未学会正常吠叫的幼犬发出的声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għajta jew inbiħ qasir u rqiq, speċjalment ta' ġeru li jkun għadu ma tgħallimx jinbaħ sew.

sense_translations.en_definition: yelp (a short, high-pitched cry or bark, especially made by a young puppy before it learns to bark properly)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 短促尖细的叫声或吠声，尤其指幼犬尚未学会正常吠叫时发出的声音。
发出短促尖细的叫声，指幼犬的叫声。

formal.mt: Meta nfetaħ il-bieb, instema' għepp qasir mill-ġeru li kien fil-kamra.
formal.en: When the door opened, a short yelp was heard from the puppy in the room.
formal.zh: 门打开时，房间里的幼犬发出了一声短促的尖叫。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt dak l-għepp? Mark: Iva, il-ġeru qam. Ejja naraw jekk għandux bżonn xi ħaġa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear that yelp? Mark: Yes, the puppy woke up. Let's see if he needs anything.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你听到那声尖叫了吗？Mark：听到了，小狗醒了。我们去看看它是不是需要什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听到那声尖叫了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that yelp?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-ġeru qam. Ejja naraw jekk għandux bżonn xi ħaġa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-ġeru qam. Ejja naraw jekk għandux bżonn xi ħaġa.
messages.zh: 听到了，小狗醒了。我们去看看它是不是需要什么。
messages.en: Yes, the puppy woke up. Let's see if he needs anything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象幼犬突然发出一声短而尖的叫声：名词记“这一声”，动词记“发出这种叫声”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A male personal name corresponding to Esau in English.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 男性人名，英语对应 Esau，中文通常译为“以扫”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' raġel, li bl-Ingliż jinkiteb Esau.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以扫，男性人名，英语写作 Esau。

formal.mt: Fil-lista tal-parteċipanti, l-isem Għesaw jidher fit-tielet post.
formal.en: In the list of participants, the name Esau appears in third place.
formal.zh: 在参与者名单上，以扫这个名字排在第三位。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif jismu l-istudent il-ġdid? Mark: Jismu Għesaw. Se niltaqgħu miegħu għada.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's the new student's name? Mark: His name is Esau. We're meeting him tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Maja：新来的学生叫什么名字？Mark：他叫以扫。我们明天会见到他。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 新来的学生叫什么名字？
messages.en: What's the new student's name?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jismu Għesaw. Se niltaqgħu miegħu għada.
messages.mt_standard: Jismu Għesaw. Se niltaqgħu miegħu għada.
messages.zh: 他叫以扫。我们明天会见到他。
messages.en: His name is Esau. We're meeting him tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张三语姓名卡“Għesaw—Esau—以扫”，把三种写法看作同一个男性人名来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To strongly desire something that belongs to someone else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强烈想要别人拥有的东西，带有觊觎或贪求的意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xtaq ħafna xi ħaġa li kienet ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 觊觎；贪求别人拥有的东西。

formal.mt: Ir-raġel għeteb il-ġid tal-ġar tiegħu u ma baqax kuntent b'dak li kellu.
formal.en: The man coveted his neighbour's wealth and was no longer content with what he had.
formal.zh: 这个男人觊觎邻居的财富，不再满足于自己拥有的东西。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark irid il-kariga ta' sieħbu? Lara: Għeteb dik il-kariga għax jaħseb li tagħtih aktar poter.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does Mark want his colleague's position? Lara: He coveted that position because he thinks it would give him more power.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么想要同事的职位？拉拉：他觊觎那个职位，因为他觉得那会给他更大的权力。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark irid il-kariga ta' sieħbu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark irid il-kariga ta' sieħbu?
messages.zh: 马克为什么想要同事的职位？
messages.en: Why does Mark want his colleague's position?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għeteb dik il-kariga għax jaħseb li tagħtih aktar poter.
messages.mt_standard: Għeteb dik il-kariga għax jaħseb li tagħtih aktar poter.
messages.zh: 他觊觎那个职位，因为他觉得那会给他更大的权力。
messages.en: He coveted that position because he thinks it would give him more power.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għeteb 配上“盯着别人财富或职位”的画面，记住它比普通的“想要”更带有觊觎意味。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To instigate an action or prompt someone to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 唆使某人采取行动，或推动、促使某人做某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħeġġeġ jew wassal lil xi ħadd biex jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 唆使；煽动某人采取行动。

sense_translations.en_definition: to prompt sb. to do sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 促使某人做某事；推动某人采取某种行动。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, ir-raġel għewa lil sieħbu biex jibda ġlieda.
formal.en: According to the report, the man instigated his friend to start a fight.
formal.zh: 报告指出，这名男子唆使朋友挑起打斗。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex beda jiġġieled Pawlu? Lara: Mark għewa lil Pawlu biex jiġġieled, imma Pawlu seta' qal le.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu start fighting? Lara: Mark instigated Pawlu to fight, but Pawlu could have said no.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么打起架来了？拉拉：马克唆使保罗打架，不过保罗本来可以拒绝。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么打起架来了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu start fighting?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark għewa lil Pawlu biex jiġġieled, imma Pawlu seta' qal le.
messages.mt_standard: Mark għewa lil Pawlu biex jiġġieled, imma Pawlu seta' qal le.
messages.zh: 马克唆使保罗打架，不过保罗本来可以拒绝。
messages.en: Mark instigated Pawlu to fight, but Pawlu could have said no.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“某人 għewa 某人 biex 做某事”作记忆框架：前者推动，后者行动；语境决定是一般促使还是负面的唆使。

gloss_zh: 令人惊叹的特质；奇观，奇迹般的事物

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being astonishing, or a thing that inspires amazement, such as a marvel or wonder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某事物令人惊叹、惊奇的特质，也可指让人惊叹的具体事物，即奇观或奇迹般的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' xi ħaġa li tgħaġġeb, jew ħaġa li tqajjem stagħġib.

sense_translations.en_definition: the quality of being amazing, astonishing, surprising
sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人惊叹、震惊或感到意外的特质。

sense_translations.en_definition: something amazing, astonishing, surprising; a marvel, wonder
sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人惊叹、震惊或感到意外的事物；奇观，奇迹般的事物。

collocations.en: the beauty and wondrous quality of the place
collocations.zh: 这个地方的美丽与奇妙

formal.mt: Il-kittieb jiddeskrivi s-sbuħija u l-għeġubija tal-għar, u jsejjaħlu għeġubija tan-natura.
formal.en: The writer describes the beauty and wondrous quality of the cave and calls it a wonder of nature.
formal.zh: 作者描写了洞穴的美丽与奇妙，并称它为一处自然奇观。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara kemm hu sabiħ dan l-għar! Toni: Veru, din għeġubija tan-natura. Maja: Qatt ma rajt post bħalu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look how beautiful this cave is! Toni: It really is a wonder of nature. Maja: I have never seen a place like it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你看，这个洞穴多美啊！Toni：确实，这是一处自然奇观。Maja：我从来没见过这样的地方。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm hu sabiħ dan l-għar!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm hu sabiħ dan l-għar!
messages.zh: 你看，这个洞穴多美啊！
messages.en: Look how beautiful this cave is!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 确实，这是一处自然奇观。
messages.en: It really is a wonder of nature.

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 我从来没见过这样的地方。
messages.en: I have never seen a place like it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象参观洞穴时惊叹的画面：既能说它具有令人惊叹的特质，也能直接称它为一个奇观。

gloss_zh: 男子未婚状态；单身汉生活

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state or period of being an unmarried man.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 男子尚未结婚的状态或时期，也可指单身汉的生活。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat jew il-perjodu li fih raġel ma jkunx miżżewweġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 男子的未婚状态；单身汉生活或时期。

formal.mt: Fl-awtobijografija tiegħu, l-awtur jiddeskrivi s-snin ta' għeżubija qabel iż-żwieġ.
formal.en: In his autobiography, the author describes his years of bachelorhood before marriage.
formal.zh: 作者在自传中描述了自己结婚前的单身汉岁月。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark jixtieq jiżżewweġ? Lara: Għalissa le; jgħid li jħobb il-ħajja tal-għeżubija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does Mark want to get married? Lara: Not for now; he says he likes bachelor life.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克想结婚吗？拉拉：暂时不想；他说他喜欢单身汉生活。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克想结婚吗？
messages.en: Does Mark want to get married?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għalissa le; jgħid li jħobb il-ħajja tal-għeżubija.
messages.mt_standard: Għalissa le; jgħid li jħobb il-ħajja tal-għeżubija.
messages.zh: 暂时不想；他说他喜欢单身汉生活。
messages.en: Not for now; he says he likes bachelor life.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għeżubija 放进“结婚前的单身汉岁月”这个场景，记的是男子未婚状态，不必联想到孤独或禁欲。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be lazy or avoid making an effort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现得懒惰，不愿费力或动手做事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ma riedx jagħmel sforz jew jaħdem minħabba l-għażż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 懒惰；犯懒，不愿努力做事。

collocations.en: was lazy and stayed in bed

collocations.mt: għeżż u ħalla x-xogħol għal għada
collocations.en: was lazy and left the work until tomorrow

formal.mt: L-istudent għeżż u ma lestiex l-eżerċizzji minkejja li kellu biżżejjed ħin.
formal.en: The student was lazy and did not finish the exercises even though he had enough time.
formal.zh: 这个学生犯懒，尽管时间充足，仍没有完成练习。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu lesta x-xogħol? Lara: Le, illum għeżż u ħallieh għal għada.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu finish the work? Lara: No, he was lazy today and left it until tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗完成工作了吗？拉拉：没有，他今天犯懒，把工作留到明天了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗完成工作了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu finish the work?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, illum għeżż u ħallieh għal għada.
messages.mt_standard: Le, illum għeżż u ħallieh għal għada.
messages.zh: 没有，他今天犯懒，把工作留到明天了。
messages.en: No, he was lazy today and left it until tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 għeżż，就想象“有时间却赖床、把工作推到明天”的人；用具体行为记住“自己犯懒”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone lazy or less willing to make an effort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人变得懒惰，降低其主动做事或付出努力的意愿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġiegħel lil xi ħadd isir għażżien jew inqas lest li jagħmel sforz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人变懒；使某人养成懒散、不愿费力的习惯。

collocations.mt: in-nuqqas ta' responsabbiltà għeżżeż lil Mark
collocations.en: the lack of responsibility made Mark lazy
collocations.zh: 无需承担责任使马克变懒

formal.mt: Il-fatt li ħaddieħor dejjem għamel kollox għalih għeżżeż lit-tifel.
formal.en: The fact that others always did everything for him made the boy lazy.
formal.zh: 别人总是替男孩包办一切，这使他变懒了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark m'għadux jagħmel xejn waħdu? Lara: Il-fatt li dejjem għamilna kollox għalih għeżżeż lil Mark.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why doesn't Mark do anything on his own anymore? Lara: The fact that we always did everything for him made Mark lazy.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么现在什么事都不自己做了？拉拉：我们总是替他包办一切，这使马克变懒了。

messages.speaker: Maja (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark m'għadux jagħmel xejn waħdu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark m'għadux jagħmel xejn waħdu?
messages.zh: 马克为什么现在什么事都不自己做了？
messages.en: Why doesn't Mark do anything on his own anymore?

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-fatt li dejjem għamilna kollox għalih għeżżeż lil Mark.
messages.mt_standard: Il-fatt li dejjem għamilna kollox għalih għeżżeż lil Mark.
messages.zh: 我们总是替他包办一切，这使马克变懒了。
messages.en: The fact that we always did everything for him made Mark lazy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għeżż“自己犯懒”和 għeżżeż“使别人变懒”并排记：后者用“长期包办让孩子变懒”的画面帮助区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The disappearance of a person or thing from sight or from a known location.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或物不再出现、看不见或找不到的情况；消失或失踪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li persuna jew ħaġa ma tibqax tidher jew ma tkunx tista' tinstab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消失；不见；人的失踪或物品的失落不见。

formal.mt: Il-pulizija qed tinvestiga l-għibien ta' raġel li ma rritornax id-dar.
formal.en: The police are investigating the disappearance of a man who did not return home.
formal.zh: 警方正在调查一名未归家男子的失踪事件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek qed tfittex iċ-ċwievet? Lara: Iva, dan l-għibien tagħhom qed iħawwadni; ħallejthom hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you still looking for the keys? Lara: Yes, their disappearance is puzzling me; I left them here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还在找钥匙吗？拉拉：是啊，钥匙就这么不见了，真让我摸不着头脑；我明明把它们放在这里。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你还在找钥匙吗？
messages.en: Are you still looking for the keys?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dan l-għibien tagħhom qed iħawwadni; ħallejthom hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dan l-għibien tagħhom qed iħawwadni; ħallejthom hawn.
messages.zh: 是啊，钥匙就这么不见了，真让我摸不着头脑；我明明把它们放在这里。
messages.en: Yes, their disappearance is puzzling me; I left them here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“刚才还在桌上的钥匙，现在找不到了”记 għibien；对象是物时可译消失，对象是人时常译失踪。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Christian feast called Epiphany.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基督教节日名称，指主显节。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-festa Nisranija magħrufa bħala l-Epifanija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 主显节，基督教节日名称。

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-parroċċa jinkludi ċelebrazzjoni ta' Għid il-Ħamiem.
formal.en: The parish programme includes a celebration of Epiphany.
formal.zh: 堂区的活动安排包括主显节庆祝活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi din iċ-ċelebrazzjoni fil-programm? Lara: Hija ċ-ċelebrazzjoni ta' Għid il-Ħamiem; nistgħu mmorru flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this celebration in the programme? Lara: It's the celebration of Epiphany; we can go together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：活动安排里的这个庆典是什么？拉拉：是主显节庆祝活动；我们可以一起去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 活动安排里的这个庆典是什么？
messages.en: What is this celebration in the programme?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija ċ-ċelebrazzjoni ta' Għid il-Ħamiem; nistgħu mmorru flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Hija ċ-ċelebrazzjoni ta' Għid il-Ħamiem; nistgħu mmorru flimkien.
messages.zh: 是主显节庆祝活动；我们可以一起去。
messages.en: It's the celebration of Epiphany; we can go together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Għid il-Ħamiem 当作完整节名，制作“Għid il-Ħamiem—Epiphany—主显节”三语卡片，整组对应记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Christian feast called Pentecost or Whitsunday.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基督教节日名称，指圣灵降临节，也称五旬节。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-festa Nisranija magħrufa bħala Pentekoste.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣灵降临节；五旬节，英语称 Whitsunday 或 Pentecost。

formal.mt: Il-parroċċa ħabbret il-programm taċ-ċelebrazzjoni ta' Għid il-Ħamsin.
formal.en: The parish announced the programme for the celebration of Pentecost.
formal.zh: 堂区公布了圣灵降临节庆祝活动的安排。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tmur għaċ-ċelebrazzjoni ta' Għid il-Ħamsin? Lara: Iva, se mmur mal-familja; trid tiġi magħna?
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you going to the Pentecost celebration? Lara: Yes, I'm going with my family; would you like to come with us?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你会去参加圣灵降临节庆祝活动吗？拉拉：会，我会和家人一起去；你想和我们一起去吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tmur għaċ-ċelebrazzjoni ta' Għid il-Ħamsin?
messages.mt_standard: Se tmur għaċ-ċelebrazzjoni ta' Għid il-Ħamsin?
messages.zh: 你会去参加圣灵降临节庆祝活动吗？
messages.en: Are you going to the Pentecost celebration?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se mmur mal-familja; trid tiġi magħna?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se mmur mal-familja; trid tiġi magħna?
messages.zh: 会，我会和家人一起去；你想和我们一起去吗？
messages.en: Yes, I'm going with my family; would you like to come with us?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Għid il-Ħamsin 与“圣灵降临节／五旬节”整组记忆，再把 Pentecost 和 Whitsunday 放在同一张卡上，记住两个英语名称对应同一节日。

gloss_zh: 耶稣；约书亚（人名，依语境区分）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A personal name referring to Jesus or Joshua, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人名，可指耶稣或约书亚，具体所指须根据上下文判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' persuna li jista' jirreferi għal Ġesù jew għal Ġożwè, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 耶稣。
约书亚。

formal.mt: F'dan it-test, l-isem Għisa jirreferi għal Ġesù; f'kuntest ieħor jista' jirreferi għal Ġożwè.
formal.en: In this text, the name Għisa refers to Jesus; in another context it may refer to Joshua.
formal.zh: 在这篇文本中，Għisa 指耶稣；在其他语境中，它也可能指约书亚。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għisa hawnhekk jirreferi għal Ġesù jew għal Ġożwè? Mark: Għal Ġesù. Aqra s-sentenza ta' qabel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does Għisa here refer to Jesus or Joshua? Mark: Jesus. Read the preceding sentence.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里的 Għisa 指耶稣还是约书亚？Mark：耶稣。读一下前一句。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għisa hawnhekk jirreferi għal Ġesù jew għal Ġożwè?
messages.mt_standard: Għisa hawnhekk jirreferi għal Ġesù jew għal Ġożwè?
messages.zh: 这里的 Għisa 指耶稣还是约书亚？
messages.en: Does Għisa here refer to Jesus or Joshua?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal Ġesù. Aqra s-sentenza ta' qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Għal Ġesù. Aqra s-sentenza ta' qabel.
messages.zh: 耶稣。读一下前一句。
messages.en: Jesus. Read the preceding sentence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Għisa 写在人名卡中央，旁边分别标注“耶稣”和“约书亚”；每次阅读先看上下文，再决定对应哪一个人名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The early part of the day, before noon.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一天中午以前的时段，常指早晨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti tal-ġurnata qabel nofsinhar, speċjalment is-sigħat bikrin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 早晨；上午。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir għada filgħodu fid-disgħa.
formal.en: The meeting will take place tomorrow morning at nine.
formal.zh: 会议将于明天上午九点举行。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Niltaqgħu għada filgħodu? Pawlu: Iva, fit-tmienja ħdejn il-kafetterija.
colloquial.en: Sara: Shall we meet tomorrow morning? Pawlu: Yes, at eight by the café.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们明天早上见面好吗？Pawlu：好，八点在咖啡馆旁边见。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们明天早上见面好吗？
messages.en: Shall we meet tomorrow morning?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，八点在咖啡馆旁边见。
messages.en: Yes, at eight by the café.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għodu 放在一天时间轴的前半段，配上早餐和晨光；再用 għada filgħodu“明天早上”整块记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Early in the morning, near the beginning of the day.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在早晨很早的时候，用来说明动作发生的时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kmieni ħafna filgħodu, fil-bidu tal-ġurnata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在清晨；一大早。

collocations.en: we go out early in the morning
we start early in the morning

formal.mt: Il-grupp telaq għodu għodu sabiex jasal qabel ma tibda s-sħana.
formal.en: The group left early in the morning to arrive before the heat began.
formal.zh: 团队一大早便出发，以便在天气热起来之前抵达。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex se noħorġu għodu għodu? Lara: Biex naslu qabel it-traffiku.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are we going out so early in the morning? Lara: To get there before the traffic builds up.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们为什么要一大早出门？Lara：为了赶在交通拥堵之前到达。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们为什么要一大早出门？
messages.en: Why are we going out so early in the morning?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 为了赶在交通拥堵之前到达。
messages.en: To get there before the traffic builds up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个 għodu għodu 当作“一大早”的时间标签，想象天刚亮就背包出门；成组记忆，不逐词翻译。

gloss_zh: 发痒；惯用语中表示起疑心

teaching_sense.en_definition: To itch; used almost exclusively in the idiom għokritu għajnu to express becoming suspicious.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本义为发痒，实际几乎只用于 għokritu għajnu 这一惯用表达，表示某人起了疑心。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jindika ħakk, iżda jintuża kważi biss fl-espressjoni għokritu għajnu, jiġifieri beda jissuspetta.

sense_translations.en_definition: itch (used practically exclusively in the idiom 'għokritu għajnu', meaning 'to be suspicious')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发痒；实际几乎只用于惯用语 għokritu għajnu，意为起疑心、感到可疑。

collocations.en: he became suspicious when he heard the story
collocations.zh: 他听到这个说法时起了疑心

collocations.en: he became suspicious about the price
collocations.zh: 他对这个价格起了疑心

formal.mt: Meta l-ispettur innota żewġ dati differenti fuq id-dokument, għokritu għajnu u talab spjegazzjoni.
formal.en: When the inspector noticed two different dates on the document, he became suspicious and requested an explanation.
formal.zh: 检查员发现文件上有两个不同的日期后起了疑心，要求对方作出解释。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark ma ħallasx mill-ewwel? Pawlu: Għokritu għajnu meta ra kemm kien baxx il-prezz.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why didn't Mark pay straight away? Pawlu: He became suspicious when he saw how low the price was.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark 为什么没有马上付款？Pawlu：他看到价格那么低，就起了疑心。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 为什么没有马上付款？
messages.en: Why didn't Mark pay straight away?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għokritu għajnu meta ra kemm kien baxx il-prezz.
messages.mt_standard: Għokritu għajnu meta ra kemm kien baxx il-prezz.
messages.zh: 他看到价格那么低，就起了疑心。
messages.en: He became suspicious when he saw how low the price was.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“看到异常，心里打问号”的画面记住 għokritu għajnu；学习重点是整句表示起疑心，不要只按眼睛发痒理解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become weak or feeble, with less physical strength than before.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体力量比原先减弱，变得虚弱或衰弱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir dgħajjef u jkollu inqas saħħa minn qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得虚弱；衰弱下来。

collocations.en: he became feeble after the illness

formal.mt: Wara l-marda twila, ir-raġel għokos u kellu bżonn l-għajnuna fil-ħajja ta' kuljum.
formal.en: After the long illness, the man became feeble and needed help with daily life.
formal.zh: 久病之后，这名男子变得虚弱，日常生活需要别人帮助。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhu n-nannu wara l-marda? Ben: Għokos ftit, imma llum ħareġ jimxi magħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is Grandpa after his illness? Ben: He became a little weaker, but today he went out for a walk with us.
colloquial.zh: Maja：爷爷病后怎么样？Ben：身体虚弱了一些，不过今天他和我们一起出去散步了。

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.zh: 爷爷病后怎么样？
messages.en: How is Grandpa after his illness?

messages.speaker: Ben (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Għokos ftit, imma llum ħareġ jimxi magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Għokos ftit, imma llum ħareġ jimxi magħna.
messages.zh: 身体虚弱了一些，不过今天他和我们一起出去散步了。
messages.en: He became a little weaker, but today he went out for a walk with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 għokos 配一幅“原先有力、后来乏力”的前后对比图，记住它强调力量减弱和状态变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tie used to fasten or hold something in place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于系住、固定物品的绑结。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rabta li tintuża biex iżżomm xi ħaġa f'postha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 系结；用于系住或固定东西的绑结。

formal.mt: Qabel iċċaqlaq il-pakkett, iċċekkja li l-għollieqa tkun soda.
formal.en: Before moving the parcel, check that the tie is secure.
formal.zh: 移动包裹之前，检查绑结是否牢固。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din l-għollieqa ma żżommx sew. Mark: Sewwa, nerġa' norbot il-ħabel.
colloquial.en: Sara: This tie isn't holding properly. Mark: All right, I'll tie the rope again.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这个绑结固定得不牢。Mark：好，我把绳子重新系一下。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 这个绑结固定得不牢。
messages.en: This tie isn't holding properly.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 好，我把绳子重新系一下。
messages.en: All right, I'll tie the rope again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għollieqa 联想成包裹上固定绳子的绑结，再配合 għollieqa soda“牢固的绑结”一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 变瘦；体重减轻；变得消瘦

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become thinner or lose weight, sometimes becoming noticeably skinny.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得比以前瘦、体重减轻，也可指变得明显消瘦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir irqaq jew jitlef il-piż, xi drabi sakemm jidher irqiq ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变瘦；身形变得比以前纤瘦。
体重减轻；体重下降。
变得消瘦；身形变得很瘦。

formal.mt: Matul ix-xhur li għaddew, Pawlu għolob u l-ħwejjeġ tiegħu saru wesgħin wisq għalih.
formal.en: Over the past few months, Pawlu became thinner, and his clothes became too loose for him.
formal.zh: 过去几个月里，Pawlu 变瘦了，原来的衣服穿在身上都显得太宽松。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu għolob minn meta rajnieh l-aħħar? Lara: Iva, ftit. Qalli li l-qalziet sar wiesa' għalih.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has Pawlu lost weight since we last saw him? Lara: Yes, a little. He told me his trousers have become loose.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 比我们上次见到他时瘦了吗？Lara：是的，瘦了一点。他跟我说裤子穿起来变松了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu għolob minn meta rajnieh l-aħħar?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu għolob minn meta rajnieh l-aħħar?
messages.zh: Pawlu 比我们上次见到他时瘦了吗？
messages.en: Has Pawlu lost weight since we last saw him?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ftit. Qalli li l-qalziet sar wiesa' għalih.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ftit. Qalli li l-qalziet sar wiesa' għalih.
messages.zh: 是的，瘦了一点。他跟我说裤子穿起来变松了。
messages.en: Yes, a little. He told me his trousers have become loose.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“同一条裤子后来变松”的画面记 għolob：外形变瘦、体重下降，程度较大时就是明显消瘦；词本身不说明原因。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having considerable strength or physical power.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有较大力量的；形容人强壮或身体部位有力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħafna saħħa jew qawwa fiżika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强壮的；有力的。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ħaddiem huwa deskritt bħala raġel għoqdi li jġorr tagħbijiet tqal.
formal.en: In the story, the worker is described as a strong man who carries heavy loads.
formal.zh: 故事将这名工人描写成一个搬运重物的强壮男人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min jista' jgħinna nġorru din il-mejda? Mark: Pawlu hu għoqdi; nistaqsuh jekk jistax jgħinna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who can help us carry this table? Mark: Pawlu is strong; let's ask him whether he can help.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁能帮我们搬这张桌子？Mark：Pawlu很强壮；我们问问他能不能帮忙。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min jista' jgħinna nġorru din il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Min jista' jgħinna nġorru din il-mejda?
messages.zh: 谁能帮我们搬这张桌子？
messages.en: Who can help us carry this table?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu hu għoqdi; nistaqsuh jekk jistax jgħinna.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu hu għoqdi; nistaqsuh jekk jistax jgħinna.
messages.zh: Pawlu很强壮；我们问问他能不能帮忙。
messages.en: Pawlu is strong; let's ask him whether he can help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把għoqdi和搬重桌子的强壮人物联系起来，借助出力的画面记住“强壮、有力”。

gloss_zh: 块状物；悲伤或忧虑引起的喉头哽塞感

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lump, especially the feeling of a lump in the throat caused by grief or worry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 块状物，尤指因悲伤或忧虑而感到喉咙里仿佛堵着一块东西的哽塞感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Boċċa jew massa żgħira, speċjalment is-sensazzjoni ta' xi ħaġa mwaħħla fil-gerżuma minħabba niket jew inkwiet.

sense_translations.en_definition: a lump (esp. a lump in one's throat, as a result of grieving or worry)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 块状物；尤指因悲伤或忧虑而产生的喉头哽塞感。

collocations.en: to feel a lump in his throat

formal.mt: Meta semgħet l-aħbar tat-telfa, ħasset għoqla fil-gerżuma u għal mument ma setgħetx titkellem.
formal.en: When she heard the news of the loss, she felt a lump in her throat and could not speak for a moment.
formal.zh: 听到噩耗时，她感到喉头哽住，一时说不出话来。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex waqaft titkellem? Nina: Ġietni għoqla fil-gerżuma meta ftakart fin-nanna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you stop talking? Nina: I got a lump in my throat when I remembered Grandma.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你怎么停下来不说了？Nina：我想起奶奶时，喉头一下子哽住了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么停下来不说了？
messages.en: Why did you stop talking?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġietni għoqla fil-gerżuma meta ftakart fin-nanna.
messages.mt_standard: Ġietni għoqla fil-gerżuma meta ftakart fin-nanna.
messages.zh: 我想起奶奶时，喉头一下子哽住了。
messages.en: I got a lump in my throat when I remembered Grandma.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象悲伤时喉咙像堵着一小块东西，用这个画面记住għoqla的“块”和“哽塞感”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel grief, or to worry and fret about something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到悲伤，或因某事忧虑、烦恼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tħoss niket jew tinkwieta u titħasseb dwar xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到悲痛；因失去或不幸而哀伤。
忧虑；烦恼；因挂心某事而不安。

collocations.en: he grieved because of the loss

formal.mt: Wara l-mewt ta' ħabibu, ir-raġel għoqol ħafna u sab faraġ fil-kumpanija tal-familja.
formal.en: After his friend's death, the man grieved deeply and found comfort in his family's company.
formal.zh: 朋友去世后，这名男子深感悲痛，并从家人的陪伴中得到安慰。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għoqol daqshekk Pawlu lbieraħ? Mark: Ibnu kien għadu ma wasalx id-dar, u kien inkwetat ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu fret so much yesterday? Mark: His son had not arrived home yet, and he was very worried.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu昨天为什么那么忧心？Mark：他儿子当时还没到家，他非常担心。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu昨天为什么那么忧心？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu fret so much yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ibnu kien għadu ma wasalx id-dar, u kien inkwetat ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Ibnu kien għadu ma wasalx id-dar, u kien inkwetat ħafna.
messages.zh: 他儿子当时还没到家，他非常担心。
messages.en: His son had not arrived home yet, and he was very worried.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给għoqol配两幅情绪画面：失去朋友时悲伤，等孩子回家时忧虑，分别记牢两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An ulcer: an open sore on the skin or on an internal surface of the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 溃疡，指皮肤或身体内部表面出现的开放性疮损。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ferita miftuħa fuq il-ġilda jew fuq wiċċ ġewwa l-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 溃疡。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-eżami ġiet deskritta għoqra żgħira fil-ħalq.
formal.en: A small mouth ulcer was described in the examination report.
formal.zh: 检查报告中记述了一处小的口腔溃疡。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tiekol bil-mod? Nina: Għandi għoqra f'ħalqi u tweġġagħni meta niekol.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you eating slowly? Nina: I have a mouth ulcer, and it hurts when I eat.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你怎么吃得这么慢？Nina：我嘴里有个溃疡，吃东西时会疼。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么吃得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are you eating slowly?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi għoqra f'ħalqi u tweġġagħni meta niekol.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi għoqra f'ħalqi u tweġġagħni meta niekol.
messages.zh: 我嘴里有个溃疡，吃东西时会疼。
messages.en: I have a mouth ulcer, and it hurts when I eat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把għoqra放进口腔溃疡的生活场景：嘴里一处小疮，吃东西会疼，帮助记住词义。

gloss_zh: 陌生或外来的事物的泛称

teaching_sense.en_definition: A general term for whatever is strange, unfamiliar, or foreign.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对陌生、不熟悉或外来事物的统称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Terminu ġenerali għal dak kollu li hu barrani jew mhux familjari.

sense_translations.en_definition: generic term for the strange or foreign
sense_translations.zh_definition: 陌生或外来事物的泛称。

collocations.en: fear of the unfamiliar or foreign
collocations.zh: 对陌生或外来事物的恐惧

collocations.en: attraction to the unfamiliar or foreign
collocations.zh: 对陌生或外来事物的向往

formal.mt: L-awtur jesplora l-biża' mill-għorba u l-kurżità lejn dak li mhuwiex familjari.
formal.en: The author explores fear of the strange or foreign and curiosity about what is unfamiliar.
formal.zh: 作者探讨了人们对陌生或外来事物的恐惧，以及对不熟悉事物的好奇。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'jifhem l-awtur bil-kelma 'għorba'? Paul: Jifhem dak li hu barrani jew mhux familjari għalina.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does the author mean by the word 'għorba'? Paul: He means whatever is foreign or unfamiliar to us.
colloquial.zh: Sara：作者用għorba这个词是什么意思？Paul：他指的是对我们而言外来或不熟悉的事物。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 作者用għorba这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the author mean by the word 'għorba'?

messages.speaker: Paul (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jifhem dak li hu barrani jew mhux familjari għalina.
messages.mt_standard: Jifhem dak li hu barrani jew mhux familjari għalina.
messages.zh: 他指的是对我们而言外来或不熟悉的事物。
messages.en: He means whatever is foreign or unfamiliar to us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个写着għorba的收纳盒，把陌生事物和外来事物都放进去，记住它是泛称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of scrubbing something clean, or of rubbing a surface or part of the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次刷洗或擦洗，也可指对物体表面或身体部位的擦揉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li togħrok xi ħaġa biex tnaddafha, jew li tgħaddi idek jew drapp fuq wiċċ jew parti tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次刷洗；一次用力擦洗。
一次擦拭或揉擦。

collocations.en: a thorough scrubbing of the floor
collocations.zh: 对地板的一次彻底刷洗

collocations.en: a gentle rub on the arm

formal.mt: Wara x-xogħol, il-mejda kellha bżonn għorka tajba biex jitneħħa l-ħmieġ.
formal.en: After the work, the table needed a thorough scrubbing to remove the dirt.
formal.zh: 工作结束后，桌子需要彻底擦洗一次，以清除污垢。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Din it-tebgħa għadha hawn. Maja: Agħtiha għorka oħra b'dan id-drapp.
colloquial.en: Mark: This stain is still here. Maja: Give it another rub with this cloth.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这块污渍还在。Maja：用这块布再擦一擦。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 这块污渍还在。
messages.en: This stain is still here.

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 用这块布再擦一擦。
messages.en: Give it another rub with this cloth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用手拿布来回擦的动作记għorka：清洁时是刷洗，轻轻接触时可以是擦揉。

gloss_zh: 洞穴；兽穴；存放物产的小棚屋

teaching_sense.en_definition: A grotto, cave, or den; also a small hut used for storing products.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 岩洞、洞穴或兽穴；也指用来存放物产的小棚屋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għar jew kenn ta' annimal; ukoll għarix żgħir fejn jinżammu prodotti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 岩洞；洞穴；兽穴。

sense_translations.en_definition: a small hut used to store products
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用来存放物产的小棚屋。

collocations.en: a small hut for storing products

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni tal-post issemmi għorna fil-blat fejn l-annimali setgħu jsibu kenn.
formal.en: The description of the site mentions a cave in the rock where animals could find shelter.
formal.zh: 对该地点的描述提到了一处岩洞，动物可以在里面栖身。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn poġġejt il-kaxxi tat-tadam? Pawlu: Fl-għorna ħdejn l-għalqa; hemm post għalihom.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did you put the boxes of tomatoes? Pawlu: In the small storage hut beside the field; there is room for them there.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你把那几箱番茄放哪儿了？Pawlu：放在田边的小储物棚里了；那里有地方放。

messages.speaker: Lara (农户)
messages.zh: 你把那几箱番茄放哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did you put the boxes of tomatoes?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场帮工)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-għorna ħdejn l-għalqa; hemm post għalihom.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-għorna ħdejn l-għalqa; hemm post għalihom.
messages.zh: 放在田边的小储物棚里了；那里有地方放。
messages.en: In the small storage hut beside the field; there is room for them there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给għorna画两张词义卡：一张是岩洞或兽穴，一张是放物产的小棚屋，结合语境选择。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Resembling saffron, for example in colour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与藏红花相似的，例如颜色呈现藏红花般的色调。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jixbah liż-żagħfran, pereżempju fil-kulur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 似藏红花的；具有藏红花般特征的。

formal.mt: Il-pittur għażel lewn għosfri biex jagħti sħana lill-parti ċentrali tal-kwadru.
formal.en: The painter chose a saffron-like hue to give warmth to the central part of the painting.
formal.zh: 画家选用藏红花般的色调，为画面中央增添暖意。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema drapp jogħġbok għall-purtieri? Mark: Dak għosfri; il-kulur tiegħu jagħti sħana lill-kamra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which fabric do you like for the curtains? Mark: The saffron-coloured one; its colour gives the room warmth.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你喜欢用哪块布做窗帘？Mark：那块藏红花色的；它的颜色让房间显得温暖。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 你喜欢用哪块布做窗帘？
messages.en: Which fabric do you like for the curtains?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak għosfri; il-kulur tiegħu jagħti sħana lill-kamra.
messages.mt_standard: Dak għosfri; il-kulur tiegħu jagħti sħana lill-kamra.
messages.zh: 那块藏红花色的；它的颜色让房间显得温暖。
messages.en: The saffron-coloured one; its colour gives the room warmth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把għosfri写在一张藏红花色的色卡上，用颜色联想记住“像藏红花的”这个形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or effect of causing serious impairment of movement or physical ability.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或动物的行动能力或身体功能严重受损的行为或结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni jew ir-riżultat li persuna jew annimal jitħalla b'ħsara serja fil-ħila li jiċċaqlaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次致残；造成严重行动障碍或身体功能损伤。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-għotba li kkawża l-inċident u l-effett tagħha fuq il-moviment tal-pazjent.
formal.en: The report describes the crippling caused by the accident and its effect on the patient's movement.
formal.zh: 报告描述了事故造成的致残情况及其对患者行动的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kienet l-agħar konsegwenza tal-inċident? Mark: L-għotba li ħallietu ma jistax jimxi mingħajr għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was the worst consequence of the accident? Mark: The crippling that left him unable to walk without help.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那次事故最严重的后果是什么？马克：造成了残疾，让他没有帮助就无法行走。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那次事故最严重的后果是什么？
messages.en: What was the worst consequence of the accident?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-għotba li ħallietu ma jistax jimxi mingħajr għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: L-għotba li ħallietu ma jistax jimxi mingħajr għajnuna.
messages.zh: 造成了残疾，让他没有帮助就无法行走。
messages.en: The crippling that left him unable to walk without help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għotba 联系到“受伤后行动能力严重受损”的画面，重点记住它表示致残这一行为或结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of placing something over a surface or object to cover it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把材料放在某个表面或物体上，使其被覆盖或遮盖的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni jew il-proċess li wiċċ jew oġġett jitgħatta b'xi materjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 覆盖；用材料遮盖某个表面或物体的行为或过程。

collocations.en: covering a surface with a protective layer
covering the table with a cloth

formal.mt: L-għoti tal-wiċċ b'saff protettiv għandu jitlesta qabel jibda x-xogħol.
formal.en: The covering of the surface with a protective layer must be completed before work begins.
formal.zh: 开始工作之前，必须先完成用保护层覆盖表面的工序。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'għad fadal qabel nibdew inpinġu? Pawlu: L-għoti tal-mejda b'drapp, biex ma titħammiġx.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is left to do before we start painting? Pawlu: Covering the table with a cloth so it doesn't get dirty.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：开始画画之前还要做什么？保罗：用布把桌子盖上，免得弄脏。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 开始画画之前还要做什么？
messages.en: What is left to do before we start painting?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: L-għoti tal-mejda b'drapp, biex ma titħammiġx.
messages.mt_standard: L-għoti tal-mejda b'drapp, biex ma titħammiġx.
messages.zh: 用布把桌子盖上，免得弄脏。
messages.en: Covering the table with a cloth so it doesn't get dirty.

cognitive_memory_aid: 本词条按“覆盖”义记忆：想象给桌面铺上一块布，把 għoti 和“盖上一层”的动作相连。

gloss_zh: 所赠之物；捐赠；礼物；给予

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something given to another person or organization, such as a gift or donation; also the act of giving.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给予他人或机构的东西，例如礼物或捐赠物；也可表示给予这一行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tingħata lil persuna jew organizzazzjoni, bħal rigal jew donazzjoni; ukoll l-azzjoni li tagħti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给予出去的东西；所赠之物。
捐赠；为支持某人、机构或事业而给予的钱款或物品。
礼物；为表达心意而赠送的东西。
给予或赠送这一行为。

collocations.zh: 一份慷慨的赠礼或捐赠

formal.mt: L-iskola rċeviet għotja ta' kotba biex tkabbar il-librerija tagħha.
formal.en: The school received a donation of books to expand its library.
formal.zh: 学校收到了一批捐赠图书，用于扩充图书馆馆藏。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ta dawn il-kotba lill-iskola? Mark: Il-ġirien tagħna. Kienet għotja tassew ġeneruża.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who gave these books to the school? Mark: Our neighbors. It was a really generous donation.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些书是谁送给学校的？马克：我们的邻居。这真是一份慷慨的捐赠。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这些书是谁送给学校的？
messages.en: Who gave these books to the school?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġirien tagħna. Kienet għotja tassew ġeneruża.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġirien tagħna. Kienet għotja tassew ġeneruża.
messages.zh: 我们的邻居。这真是一份慷慨的捐赠。
messages.en: Our neighbors. It was a really generous donation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手递出一本书：书可以是礼物，也可以是捐赠；għotja 还能指递出、给予这一行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Grass: low-growing plants with narrow green leaves that cover the ground.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 草，通常指长着狭长绿叶、成片覆盖地面的低矮植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanti baxxi b'weraq aħdar u dejjaq li jikbru fuq l-art u jistgħu jiffurmaw kisja ħadra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 草；成片生长在地面上的青草。

formal.mt: Wara x-xita, l-għoxb fil-ġnien beda jikber malajr.
formal.en: After the rain, the grass in the garden began to grow quickly.
formal.zh: 下雨之后，花园里的草开始迅速生长。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn noqogħdu għall-piknik? Toni: Hemm, fuq l-għoxb ħdejn is-siġra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where shall we sit for the picnic? Toni: There, on the grass beside the tree.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们坐在哪里野餐？托尼：那边，树旁的草地上。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们坐在哪里野餐？
messages.en: Where shall we sit for the picnic?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 那边，树旁的草地上。
messages.en: There, on the grass beside the tree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 għoxb 就想象树下一片绿草，配合“绿草”和“割草”两个场景一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A seal, a marine mammal that swims and also rests on land.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 海豹，一种在海中游泳、也会上岸休息的哺乳动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mammiferu tal-baħar li jgħum u jitla' wkoll fuq l-art biex jistrieħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海豹，一种海洋哺乳动物。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt jidher għoġol il-baħar jistrieħ fuq il-blat ħdejn l-ilma.
formal.en: The photograph shows a seal resting on the rocks beside the water.
formal.zh: 照片中，一只海豹正在水边的岩石上休息。

colloquial.mt: Ben: X'inhu dak fuq il-blat? Nina: Dak għoġol il-baħar. Ara, issa qed jinżel fl-ilma!
colloquial.en: Ben: What's that on the rocks? Nina: That's a seal. Look, it's going into the water now!
colloquial.zh: Ben：岩石上那个是什么？Nina：那是海豹。看，它现在正往水里去！

messages.speaker: Ben (游客)
messages.zh: 岩石上那个是什么？
messages.en: What's that on the rocks?

messages.speaker: Nina (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak għoġol il-baħar. Ara, issa qed jinżel fl-ilma!
messages.mt_standard: Dak għoġol il-baħar. Ara, issa qed jinżel fl-ilma!
messages.zh: 那是海豹。看，它现在正往水里去！
messages.en: That's a seal. Look, it's going into the water now!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għoġol il-baħar 整体贴在海豹图片下，联想“岩石上休息、水里游泳”的连续画面，避免拆开后误认动物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An imaginary frightening creature, such as an ogre or ghoul, found in stories.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 故事中虚构的可怕怪物，可指食人怪或食尸鬼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlejqa tal-biża' immaġinarja li tidher fl-istejjer, bħal mostru li jiekol in-nies jew il-mejtin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 食人怪；食尸鬼；故事中可怕的虚构怪物。

collocations.zh: 可怕的食人怪或食尸鬼

collocations.en: a story about an ogre or ghoul
collocations.zh: 一个关于食人怪或食尸鬼的故事

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, għul jgħix f'għar mudlam u jbeżża' lil kull min jgħaddi minn hemm.
formal.en: In the story, an ogre lives in a dark cave and frightens everyone who passes by.
formal.zh: 故事里，一个食人怪住在黑暗的洞穴中，吓唬每一个经过那里的人。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'hemm moħbi fl-għar f'din l-istorja? Adam: Għul! Imma tibżax, l-eroj se jwaqqfu.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is hiding in the cave in this story? Adam: An ogre! But don't be afraid; the hero will stop him.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个故事里的洞穴中藏着什么？亚当：一个食人怪！不过别怕，英雄会阻止它。

messages.speaker: Nina (妹妹)
messages.zh: 这个故事里的洞穴中藏着什么？
messages.en: What is hiding in the cave in this story?

messages.speaker: Adam (哥哥)
messages.mt_spoken: Għul! Imma tibżax, l-eroj se jwaqqfu.
messages.mt_standard: Għul! Imma tibżax, l-eroj se jwaqqfu.
messages.zh: 一个食人怪！不过别怕，英雄会阻止它。
messages.en: An ogre! But don't be afraid; the hero will stop him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għul 放进童话洞穴的画面中：洞里藏着可怕怪物，用这个场景同时记住食人怪和食尸鬼两种译法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called hassium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素𬭶的名称，英语为 hassium。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element kimiku li bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ hassium.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 𬭶；一种化学元素，英语名称为 hassium。

collocations.en: a study of the element hassium

formal.mt: F'din il-lista ta' elementi kimiċi, hassju huwa l-isem bil-Malti tal-element magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala hassium.
formal.en: In this list of chemical elements, hassju is the Maltese name of the element known in English as hassium.
formal.zh: 在这份化学元素列表中，hassju 是英语 hassium 所指元素𬭶的马耳他语名称。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif ngħidu hassium bil-Malti? Mark: Hassju. Ikteb l-isem ħdejn dak bl-Ingliż.
colloquial.en: Sara: How do we say hassium in Maltese? Mark: Hassju. Write the name beside the English one.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：hassium 用马耳他语怎么说？马克：Hassju。把这个名称写在英语名称旁边。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: hassium 用马耳他语怎么说？
messages.en: How do we say hassium in Maltese?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hassju. Ikteb l-isem ħdejn dak bl-Ingliż.
messages.mt_standard: Hassju. Ikteb l-isem ħdejn dak bl-Ingliż.
messages.zh: Hassju。把这个名称写在英语名称旁边。
messages.en: Hassju. Write the name beside the English one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 hassju、英语 hassium 和中文“𬭶”写在同一张元素词卡上，利用两种外文共有的 hass 字母串辅助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To consume or use something up; also to waste or destroy it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 消耗或用尽某物，也可表示浪费某物或将其毁坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juża jew jikkonsma xi ħaġa sakemm tispiċċa; jista' wkoll ifisser jaħliha jew jeqridha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消耗；使用或耗尽某物。
浪费；没有取得相应价值或成果地耗用某物。
毁坏；摧毁；使某物遭到严重破坏或不复存在。

formal.mt: L-awditu sab li l-proġett heddeb il-fondi disponibbli mingħajr ma kiseb riżultati utli.
formal.en: The audit found that the project had wasted the available funds without achieving useful results.
formal.zh: 审计发现，该项目浪费了可用资金，却未取得有用的成果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma baqax injam? Pawlu: In-nar heddeb l-injam kollu li kellna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is there no wood left? Pawlu: The fire consumed all the wood we had.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么没有木头剩下了？保罗：火把我们所有的木头都烧光了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 为什么没有木头剩下了？
messages.en: Why is there no wood left?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nar heddeb l-injam kollu li kellna.
messages.mt_standard: In-nar heddeb l-injam kollu li kellna.
messages.zh: 火把我们所有的木头都烧光了。
messages.en: The fire consumed all the wood we had.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“东西越来越少，最后没了”的画面串联 heddeb：正常耗用是消耗，白白耗用是浪费，彻底破坏是毁坏。

gloss_zh: 有安抚作用的；令人平静的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an effect that helps someone become calmer or more relaxed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能使人情绪平静或放松的；具有安抚作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jgħin lil xi ħadd jikkalma jew jirrilassa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有安抚作用的；能让人平静下来的。

formal.mt: Il-qari b'leħen heddej għen lill-istudenti jirrilassaw qabel l-eżami.
formal.en: Reading in a soothing voice helped the students relax before the exam.
formal.zh: 用令人平静的声音朗读，帮助学生在考试前放松下来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-ħoss qed jgħinni nikkalma. Toni: Iva, għandu effett heddej. Ħallih għaddej ftit ieħor.
colloquial.en: Lara: This sound is helping me calm down. Toni: Yes, it has a calming effect. Leave it on a little longer.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个声音让我慢慢平静下来了。托尼：是啊，它有安抚作用。再放一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个声音让我慢慢平静下来了。
messages.en: This sound is helping me calm down.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandu effett heddej. Ħallih għaddej ftit ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandu effett heddej. Ħallih għaddej ftit ieħor.
messages.zh: 是啊，它有安抚作用。再放一会儿吧。
messages.en: Yes, it has a calming effect. Leave it on a little longer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 heddej 和轻柔声音带来的放松感联系起来，记住它强调“让人平静”的作用，可搭配声音或效果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cook food slowly over a fire.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把食物放在火上缓慢烹煮，使其逐渐熟透。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ssajjar l-ikel bil-mod fuq in-nar.

sense_translations.en_definition: to cook slowly over a fire
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在火上缓慢烹煮食物。

collocations.en: slow-cooked the soup over a fire
slow-cooked the meat over a fire

formal.mt: Il-kok heddem il-laħam fuq nar baxx sakemm sar artab.
formal.en: The cook slowly cooked the meat over a low fire until it became tender.
formal.zh: 厨师用小火慢炖肉，直到肉变软。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-laħam hu daqshekk artab? Pawlu: Missieri heddem il-laħam fuq nar baxx għal sagħtejn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the meat so tender? Pawlu: My father slowly cooked it over a low fire for two hours.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这肉怎么这么软？保罗：我爸爸用小火慢炖了两个小时。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这肉怎么这么软？
messages.en: Why is the meat so tender?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Missieri heddem il-laħam fuq nar baxx għal sagħtejn.
messages.mt_standard: Missieri heddem il-laħam fuq nar baxx għal sagħtejn.
messages.zh: 我爸爸用小火慢炖了两个小时。
messages.en: My father slowly cooked the meat over a low fire for two hours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 heddem 和“小火慢炖一锅肉”的画面绑定，重点记住缓慢烹煮这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who threatens someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对别人发出威胁或进行恐吓的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li thedded lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 威胁或恐吓他人的人。

collocations.en: a violent person who makes threats
an anonymous person who makes threats

formal.mt: Il-pulizija identifikaw il-heddied li bagħat il-messaġġi lill-familja.
formal.en: The police identified the person who sent threatening messages to the family.
formal.zh: 警方查明了向这家人发送威胁信息的恐吓者身份。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taf min hu dak il-heddied? Mark: Le, imma żammejt il-messaġġi kollha tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you know who that person making threats is? Mark: No, but I kept all his messages.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你知道那个恐吓者是谁吗？马克：不知道，不过我保存了他发来的所有信息。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你知道那个恐吓者是谁吗？
messages.en: Do you know who that person making threats is?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, imma żammejt il-messaġġi kollha tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, imma żammejt il-messaġġi kollha tiegħu.
messages.zh: 不知道，不过我保存了他发来的所有信息。
messages.en: No, but I kept all his messages.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手机另一端不断发来威胁信息的人；heddied 指实施恐吓的人。

gloss_zh: 带威胁意味的；令人感到威胁的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Expressing a threat or making someone feel that harm may occur.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示威胁，或使人感到可能受到伤害的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jesprimi theddida jew iqajjem biża' li tista' ssir ħsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 带有威胁意味的；表现出威胁态度的。
令人感到危险、恐惧或威胁逼近的。

formal.mt: Ix-xhud qal li r-raġel tkellem b'ton heddiedi waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The witness said that the man spoke in a threatening tone during the meeting.
formal.zh: 证人表示，那名男子在会议期间用带有威胁意味的语气说话。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-messaġġ jidher heddiedi ħafna. David: Iva, il-kliem tiegħu qed ibeżżagħni.
colloquial.en: Nina: This message seems very threatening. David: Yes, the wording is frightening me.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这条信息看起来很有威胁性。大卫：是啊，里面的话让我害怕。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这条信息看起来很有威胁性。
messages.en: This message seems very threatening.

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，里面的话让我害怕。
messages.en: Yes, the wording is frightening me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 heddiedi 放在“语气、信息”旁边记，想象读完后心里一紧的威胁感。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who cooks food slowly over a fire.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把食物放在火上缓慢烹煮的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ssajjar l-ikel bil-mod fuq in-nar.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who cooks slowly over a fire
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在火上慢慢烹煮食物的人。

collocations.en: a person who slowly cooks soup over a fire
a person who slowly cooks meat over a fire

formal.mt: Il-heddiem żamm in-nar baxx u ħalla s-soppa ssajjar bil-mod.
formal.en: The person tending the slow cooking kept the fire low and let the soup cook slowly.
formal.zh: 负责慢煮的人保持小火，让汤慢慢熬煮。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu l-heddiem illum? Toni: Jien; se noqgħod ħdejn il-borma u nżomm in-nar baxx.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is doing the slow cooking today? Toni: I am; I'll stay beside the pot and keep the fire low.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：今天谁负责慢煮？托尼：我来；我会守在锅旁，保持小火。

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.zh: 今天谁负责慢煮？
messages.en: Who is doing the slow cooking today?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien; se noqgħod ħdejn il-borma u nżomm in-nar baxx.
messages.mt_standard: Jien; se noqgħod ħdejn il-borma u nżomm in-nar baxx.
messages.zh: 我来；我会守在锅旁，保持小火。
messages.en: I am; I'll stay beside the pot and keep the fire low.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人耐心守着火上的汤锅；heddiem 指这位慢煮食物的人。

gloss_zh: 使食物在火上缓慢煮熟的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing food to cook slowly over a fire.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使食物在火上逐渐、缓慢煮熟的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel l-ikel jissajjar bil-mod fuq in-nar.

sense_translations.en_definition: causing slow cooking over a fire
sense_translations.zh_definition: 能使食物在火上缓慢烹煮的。

collocations.en: a fire that causes food to cook slowly
heating that causes slow cooking over a fire
collocations.zh: 使食物在火上缓慢煮熟的加热

formal.mt: Il-kok uża nar heddiemi biex il-laħam jissajjar bil-mod fil-borma.
formal.en: The cook used a fire that produced slow cooking so that the meat would cook gradually in the pot.
formal.zh: 厨师用能使食物慢煮的火，让锅里的肉逐渐煮熟。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan hu nar heddiemi? Ġanni: Iva, l-ikel se jissajjar bil-mod fuqu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is this a fire for slow cooking? Ġanni: Yes, the food will cook slowly over it.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这火能让食物慢慢煮熟吗？詹尼：能，食物会在这火上慢慢煮熟。

messages.speaker: Marija (烹饪学员)
messages.zh: 这火能让食物慢慢煮熟吗？
messages.en: Is this a fire for slow cooking?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (厨师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, l-ikel se jissajjar bil-mod fuqu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, l-ikel se jissajjar bil-mod fuqu.
messages.zh: 能，食物会在这火上慢慢煮熟。
messages.en: Yes, the food will cook slowly over it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 heddiemi 联想到锅底持续的小火，记住它描述使食物慢煮的作用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who praises God.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向上帝表达赞美的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tfaħħar lil Alla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赞美上帝的人。

collocations.en: a person who praises God in prayer
collocations.zh: 在祈祷中赞美上帝的人

formal.mt: Il-helliel ta' Alla esprima t-tifħir tiegħu permezz tat-talb u tal-kant.
formal.en: The person praising God expressed his praise through prayer and song.
formal.zh: 这位赞美上帝的人通过祈祷和歌唱表达赞美。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Xi jfisser helliel? Pietru: Persuna li tfaħħar lil Alla, pereżempju bit-talb jew bil-kant.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does helliel mean? Pietru: A person who praises God, for example through prayer or song.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：helliel 是什么意思？彼得：赞美上帝的人，比如通过祈祷或歌唱来赞美。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: helliel 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does helliel mean?

messages.speaker: Pietru (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Persuna li tfaħħar lil Alla, pereżempju bit-talb jew bil-kant.
messages.mt_standard: Persuna li tfaħħar lil Alla, pereżempju bit-talb jew bil-kant.
messages.zh: 赞美上帝的人，比如通过祈祷或歌唱来赞美。
messages.en: A person who praises God, for example through prayer or song.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个正在祈祷并赞美上帝的人，用这个人物画面记住 helliel。

gloss_zh: 赞美的；颂扬的；赞颂性的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Expressing praise or strong admiration for someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达赞美、称颂或高度赞赏的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jesprimi tifħir jew ammirazzjoni kbira għal xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表达赞美的；称赞的。
颂扬的；给予高度赞赏的。
赞颂性的；以言辞高度称颂的。

formal.mt: Id-direttur għamel diskors hellieli dwar il-ħidma tal-għalliema.
formal.en: The director gave a laudatory speech about the teachers' work.
formal.zh: 主任发表讲话，高度赞扬了教师们的工作。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Qrajt il-kumment tal-għalliem? Samwel: Iva, kien hellieli ħafna; faħħar l-ideat u l-kitba tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did you read the teacher's comment? Samwel: Yes, it was full of praise; he praised your ideas and writing.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你看了老师的评语吗？萨姆韦尔：看了，满是赞美；他称赞了你的想法和文笔。

messages.speaker: Rita (同学)
messages.zh: 你看了老师的评语吗？
messages.en: Did you read the teacher's comment?

messages.speaker: Samwel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien hellieli ħafna; faħħar l-ideat u l-kitba tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien hellieli ħafna; faħħar l-ideat u l-kitba tiegħek.
messages.zh: 看了，满是赞美；他称赞了你的想法和文笔。
messages.en: Yes, it was full of praise; he praised your ideas and writing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 hellieli 和一篇满是赞美的讲话联在一起，三个义项都围绕称颂展开。

gloss_zh: 使焦虑；使遭遇不幸或感到悲伤

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause anxiety, misfortune, or sadness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人产生焦虑，或给人带来不幸、悲伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġib ansjetà, sfortuna jew niket lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人焦虑、担忧或心神不安。
给人带来不幸或悲伤。

collocations.en: caused the family anxiety or sadness

formal.mt: Ir-rapport dwar il-ħsara hemmem lir-residenti, li bdew jinkwetaw dwar djarhom.
formal.en: The report about the damage caused the residents anxiety, and they began to worry about their homes.
formal.zh: 有关损坏情况的报告使居民焦虑，他们开始担心自己的房屋。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex kulħadd jinsab inkwetat? Ruben: Dak il-messaġġ hemmem lil kulħadd; għadna ma nafux x'ġara.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why is everyone worried? Ruben: That message made everyone anxious; we still don't know what happened.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：大家怎么都这么担心？鲁本：那条信息让所有人都焦虑起来；我们还不知道发生了什么。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 大家怎么都这么担心？
messages.en: Why is everyone worried?

messages.speaker: Ruben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-messaġġ hemmem lil kulħadd; għadna ma nafux x'ġara.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-messaġġ hemmem lil kulħadd; għadna ma nafux x'ġara.
messages.zh: 那条信息让所有人都焦虑起来；我们还不知道发生了什么。
messages.en: That message made everyone anxious; we still don't know what happened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一条坏消息使大家皱起眉头；hemmem 要连着造成焦虑、不幸或悲伤的结果记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To join or repair fabric with somewhat rough stitches.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用较粗略、不太精细的针脚把布料缝合或缝补起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaqqad jew isewwi d-drapp b'punti tal-ħjata mhux daqshekk fini.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用较粗糙的针脚缝合；粗略地缝补。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem hemmeż it-tiċrita fil-borża tad-drapp b'punti kbar u mhux indaqs.
formal.en: The worker roughly stitched up the tear in the cloth bag with large, uneven stitches.
formal.zh: 工人用粗大而不均匀的针脚，把布袋上的破口粗粗缝了起来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hemmeż din il-but? Il-punti huma kbar ħafna. Toni: Jien. Ridt nagħlaq it-tiċrita malajr.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who stitched this pocket so roughly? The stitches are very large. Toni: I did. I wanted to close the tear quickly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁把这个口袋缝得这么粗？针脚好大。托尼：我缝的。我想赶快把破口缝上。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hemmeż din il-but? Il-punti huma kbar ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Min hemmeż din il-but? Il-punti huma kbar ħafna.
messages.zh: 谁把这个口袋缝得这么粗？针脚好大。
messages.en: Who stitched this pocket so roughly? The stitches are very large.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 我缝的。我想赶快把破口缝上。
messages.en: I did. I wanted to close the tear quickly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象布袋破了，先用大针脚粗粗缝住；把 hemmeż 与这个粗略缝补的动作一起记。

gloss_zh: 惹麻烦的人或事物；麻烦制造者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or thing that causes trouble or difficulties.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给别人带来麻烦、困难或烦扰的人或事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew ħaġa li ġġib l-inkwiet jew toħloq id-diffikultajiet.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. or sth. that causes trouble
sense_translations.zh_definition: 引起麻烦或烦扰的人或事物。

collocations.en: a source of trouble for the neighbours
collocations.zh: 给邻居惹麻烦的人或事物

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi lil dan ir-raġel bħala hemmiem li spiss joħloq tilwim bejn il-ġirien.
formal.en: The report describes this man as a troublemaker who frequently causes disputes between neighbours.
formal.zh: 报告把这名男子描述为经常引起邻里纠纷的麻烦制造者。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-kelb huwa hemmiem! Reġa' ħareġ iż-żibel mill-borża. Pawlu: Ejja nagħlqu l-bieb tal-kċina.
colloquial.en: Lara: This dog is a troublemaker! He has pulled the rubbish out of the bag again. Pawlu: Let's close the kitchen door.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这只狗真会惹麻烦！它又把垃圾从袋子里拖出来了。保罗：我们把厨房门关上吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-kelb huwa hemmiem! Reġa' ħareġ iż-żibel mill-borża.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-kelb huwa hemmiem! Reġa' ħareġ iż-żibel mill-borża.
messages.zh: 这只狗真会惹麻烦！它又把垃圾从袋子里拖出来了。
messages.en: This dog is a troublemaker! He has pulled the rubbish out of the bag again.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 我们把厨房门关上吧。
messages.en: Let's close the kitchen door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 hemmiem 想成故事里不断惹出麻烦的角色，记住它是指人或事物的名词。

gloss_zh: 令人忧虑的；带来麻烦的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing worry, anxiety, or trouble.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人担心、焦虑，或带来麻烦的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġib it-tħassib jew l-inkwiet, jew joħloq il-problemi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引起焦虑、忧虑或麻烦的。

formal.mt: Id-dewmien hemmiemi fit-twassil tal-materjal jista' jfixkel it-tlestija tal-proġett.
formal.en: The worrying delay in delivering the material may hinder the completion of the project.
formal.zh: 材料交付出现令人担忧的延误，可能妨碍项目完工。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan id-dewmien hemmiemi; għadna ma smajna xejn. Mark: Se nċempel biex nara x'ġara.
colloquial.en: Nina: This delay is worrying; we still haven't heard anything. Mark: I'll call to find out what happened.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这样拖着真让人担心，我们还是一点消息都没有。马克：我打个电话问问出了什么事。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan id-dewmien hemmiemi; għadna ma smajna xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Dan id-dewmien hemmiemi; għadna ma smajna xejn.
messages.zh: 这样拖着真让人担心，我们还是一点消息都没有。
messages.en: This delay is worrying; we still haven't heard anything.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 我打个电话问问出了什么事。
messages.en: I'll call to find out what happened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 hemmiemi，就想象等消息时越来越担心的心情；它用来形容令人忧虑或添麻烦的情况。

gloss_zh: 负责固定或系牢东西的人
