teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who fastens or secures things in place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西系牢、扣紧或固定在适当位置的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li torbot jew twaħħal l-affarijiet biex iżżommhom f'posthom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把东西系牢、扣紧或固定起来的人。

collocations.en: a person who secures the load

formal.mt: Il-hemmież tat-tagħbija ċċekkja kull ħabel qabel ma telaq it-trakk.
formal.en: The person securing the load checked every rope before the truck departed.
formal.zh: 负责固定货物的人在卡车出发前检查了每一根绳子。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min se jkun il-hemmież tal-pakketti llum? Toni: Jien. Agħtini l-ispag u nibda.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who will fasten the parcels today? Toni: I will. Give me the string and I'll start.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：今天谁负责把包裹系牢？托尼：我来。把绳子给我，我就开始。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jkun il-hemmież tal-pakketti llum?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jkun il-hemmież tal-pakketti llum?
messages.zh: 今天谁负责把包裹系牢？
messages.en: Who will fasten the parcels today?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.zh: 我来。把绳子给我，我就开始。
messages.en: I will. Give me the string and I'll start.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个拿着绳子逐件系牢包裹的人，把 hemmież 记成执行固定动作的那个人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Serving to fasten something securely or attach it to something else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 起系牢、固定或把一物连接到另一物上作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jservi biex jorbot xi ħaġa sew jew iwaħħalha ma' xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于系牢、固定或连接的。

formal.mt: L-apparat hemmieżi jżomm il-pannell imwaħħal mal-qafas waqt l-użu.
formal.en: The fastening device keeps the panel attached to the frame during use.
formal.zh: 使用过程中，固定装置使面板保持连接在框架上。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għal xiex jintuża dan l-apparat hemmieżi? Lara: Bih inwaħħlu l-kaxxa mal-ħajt.
colloquial.en: Mark: What is this fastening device used for? Lara: We use it to attach the box to the wall.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这个固定装置是做什么用的？拉拉：我们用它把箱子固定在墙上。

messages.speaker: Mark (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal xiex jintuża dan l-apparat hemmieżi?
messages.mt_standard: Għal xiex jintuża dan l-apparat hemmieżi?
messages.zh: 这个固定装置是做什么用的？
messages.en: What is this fastening device used for?

messages.speaker: Lara (师傅)
messages.zh: 我们用它把箱子固定在墙上。
messages.en: We use it to attach the box to the wall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 hemmieżi 贴在固定装置旁边来记：这个形容词说明东西具有系牢或连接的用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who brings happiness or makes other people happy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给别人带来幸福、快乐或愉悦的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ġġib il-ferħ u tagħmel lil ħaddieħor kuntent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使别人快乐、给人带来幸福的人。

collocations.en: someone who brings joy to children
collocations.zh: 给孩子们带来快乐的人

collocations.en: someone who brings happiness to the family

formal.mt: L-awtur jippreżenta lin-nannu bħala l-hennej tal-familja, li jferraħ lil kulħadd bl-istejjer tiegħu.
formal.en: The author presents the grandfather as the person who brings happiness to the family, delighting everyone with his stories.
formal.zh: 作者把祖父描写成给家庭带来快乐的人，他讲的故事让大家都很开心。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħuk tassew hennej tat-tfal; ara kemm qed jidħku! Nina: Iva, dejjem isib xi logħba għalihom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Your brother really brings joy to the children; look how much they're laughing! Nina: Yes, he always finds a game for them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你哥哥真会给孩子们带来快乐，瞧他们笑得多开心！妮娜：是啊，他总能给他们找个游戏玩。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħuk tassew hennej tat-tfal; ara kemm qed jidħku!
messages.mt_standard: Ħuk tassew hennej tat-tfal; ara kemm qed jidħku!
messages.zh: 你哥哥真会给孩子们带来快乐，瞧他们笑得多开心！
messages.en: Your brother really brings joy to the children; look how much they're laughing!

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dejjem isib xi logħba għalihom.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dejjem isib xi logħba għalihom.
messages.zh: 是啊，他总能给他们找个游戏玩。
messages.en: Yes, he always finds a game for them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个走进房间就让大家笑起来的人，把 hennej 与带来快乐的那个人联系起来。

gloss_zh: 令人耗竭或备受煎熬的事物

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that wears a person out or subjects them to severe distress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人精力耗尽，或让人承受强烈痛苦、备受煎熬的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tgħejji ħafna lil persuna jew iġġegħelha tbati ħafna.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the effect of wearing out
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有使人耗竭、疲惫不堪作用的事物。
令人极其痛苦、备受煎熬的事物或经历。

collocations.en: something that wears out the body
something that wears a person down mentally

formal.mt: Fil-kitba tiegħu, l-awtur isejjaħ l-istennija bla tmiem herrej għall-moħħ, għax kull jum iġib aktar biża' u tbatija.
formal.en: In his writing, the author calls the endless wait a source of mental exhaustion, because every day brings more fear and suffering.
formal.zh: 作者在文中把无休止的等待称为令人精神耗竭的折磨，因为每一天都带来更多恐惧和痛苦。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Dan ir-ritmu sar herrej għalija; nispiċċa l-ġurnata bla saħħa. Sara: Ejja nieħdu pawża u naraw kif innaqqsu x-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: This pace has become a source of exhaustion for me; I finish the day with no energy. Sara: Let's take a break and see how we can reduce the workload.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：这样的节奏已经把我耗垮了，每天结束时我都一点力气也没有。萨拉：我们休息一下，看看怎样减少工作量。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ir-ritmu sar herrej għalija; nispiċċa l-ġurnata bla saħħa.
messages.mt_standard: Dan ir-ritmu sar herrej għalija; nispiċċa l-ġurnata bla saħħa.
messages.zh: 这样的节奏已经把我耗垮了，每天结束时我都一点力气也没有。
messages.en: This pace has become a source of exhaustion for me; I finish the day with no energy.

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nieħdu pawża u naraw kif innaqqsu x-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nieħdu pawża u naraw kif innaqqsu x-xogħol.
messages.zh: 我们休息一下，看看怎样减少工作量。
messages.en: Let's take a break and see how we can reduce the workload.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象精力像电池一样被不断耗尽，把 herrej 记为令人耗竭的事物，再联系令人备受煎熬的经历。

gloss_zh: 持续用力敲打；反复猛敲

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pound repeatedly and persistently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 持续而反复地用力敲打。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħabbat bis-saħħa għal darba wara l-oħra u jibqa' sejjer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 持续反复地猛敲或用力捶打。

formal.mt: Ir-raġel herreż fuq il-bieb għal diversi minuti, sakemm xi ħadd fl-aħħar fetaħlu.
formal.en: The man pounded persistently on the door for several minutes until someone finally opened it for him.
formal.zh: 那名男子持续猛敲了好几分钟的门，直到终于有人给他开门。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min herreż fuq il-bieb dalgħodu? Qajjimni mill-irqad. Mark: Il-ġar. Kien hemm l-ilma ħiereġ minn taħt il-bieb tagħna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who was pounding on the door this morning? It woke me up. Mark: The neighbour. Water was coming out from under our door.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：今天早上谁一直猛敲门？把我吵醒了。马克：邻居。当时有水从我们门底下流出去。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min herreż fuq il-bieb dalgħodu? Qajjimni mill-irqad.
messages.mt_standard: Min herreż fuq il-bieb dalgħodu? Qajjimni mill-irqad.
messages.zh: 今天早上谁一直猛敲门？把我吵醒了。
messages.en: Who was pounding on the door this morning? It woke me up.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġar. Kien hemm l-ilma ħiereġ minn taħt il-bieb tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġar. Kien hemm l-ilma ħiereġ minn taħt il-bieb tagħna.
messages.zh: 邻居。当时有水从我们门底下流出去。
messages.en: The neighbour. Water was coming out from under our door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用连续不断的咚咚敲门声来记 herreż，重点是反复用力、一直敲下去的动作。

gloss_zh: 捣碎者；用反复敲击来加工材料的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who pounds material with repeated blows, for example to crush it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过反复敲击或捣压来加工、捣碎材料的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tisħaq materjal billi tagħtih daqqiet ripetuti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进行捣压、捣碎或反复敲击的人。

formal.mt: Il-herrież tal-ħwawar juża lida biex jisħaq iż-żrieragħ b'daqqiet regolari.
formal.en: The person pounding the spices uses a pestle to crush the seeds with steady blows.
formal.zh: 捣香料的人用杵有节奏地敲击，将种子捣碎。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu l-herrież illum? Pawlu: Jien; int ġib il-ħwawar u jien nisħaqhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is doing the pounding today? Pawlu: I am; you bring the spices and I'll pound them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天谁负责捣料？保罗：我来；你把香料拿来，我来捣。

messages.speaker: Maja (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 今天谁负责捣料？
messages.en: Who is doing the pounding today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien; int ġib il-ħwawar u jien nisħaqhom.
messages.mt_standard: Jien; int ġib il-ħwawar u jien nisħaqhom.
messages.zh: 我来；你把香料拿来，我来捣。
messages.en: I am; you bring the spices and I'll pound them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象厨房里有人举杵连续捣香料，把 herrież 记成画面中负责捣碎的那个人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to pound material with repeated blows.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具备用反复敲击来捣压或捣碎材料的能力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħila jisħaq materjal b'daqqiet ripetuti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有捣压、捣碎或反复敲击能力的。

collocations.zh: 能够进行捣压工作的工人
有能力进行捣压的男子

formal.mt: Għal dan ix-xogħol hemm bżonn ħaddiem herrieżi li jista' jisħaq il-materjal bl-għodda xierqa.
formal.en: This task requires a worker capable of pounding the material with the appropriate tools.
formal.zh: 这项工作需要一名有捣压能力、能使用合适工具捣碎材料的工人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'herrieżi'? Toni: Li għandu l-ħila jisħaq xi ħaġa b'daqqiet, bħal min jisħaq il-ħwawar.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'herrieżi' mean? Toni: Able to pound something with repeated blows, like someone pounding spices.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：herrieżi 是什么意思？托尼：就是有能力反复敲击、捣碎东西的，比如能捣香料的人。

messages.speaker: Lara (学习马耳他语的朋友)
messages.zh: herrieżi 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'herrieżi' mean?

messages.speaker: Toni (帮助学习的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Li għandu l-ħila jisħaq xi ħaġa b'daqqiet, bħal min jisħaq il-ħwawar.
messages.mt_standard: Li għandu l-ħila jisħaq xi ħaġa b'daqqiet, bħal min jisħaq il-ħwawar.
messages.zh: 就是有能力反复敲击、捣碎东西的，比如能捣香料的人。
messages.en: Able to pound something with repeated blows, like someone pounding spices.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 herrieżi 放在工人旁边，想象一张写着“具备捣压能力”的标签，记住它描述能力。

gloss_zh: 神经质的人；容易过度紧张或焦虑的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person characterized by excessive nervousness, anxiety, or worry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现得神经质，容易过度紧张、焦虑或担忧的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tkun nervuża ħafna u tinkwieta żżejjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 神经质的人；容易过度紧张、焦虑或担忧的人。

collocations.en: a character described as a neurotic person
collocations.zh: 被描述为神经质者的角色

collocations.en: to be called a neurotic person

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, il-karattru deskritt bħala herwiela jinkwieta dwar kull bidla żgħira fil-pjan.
formal.en: In the story, the character described as a neurotic person worries about every small change to the plan.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个被描述为神经质者的角色，对计划中的每一点小变化都忧心不已。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex fil-ktieb isejħulu 'herwiela'? Mark: Għax jinkwieta żżejjed, anki meta ma jkun hemm ebda problema.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do they call him a 'herwiela' in the book? Mark: Because he worries excessively, even when there is no problem.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：书里为什么称他为 herwiela？马克：因为他总是过度担忧，就算没什么问题也一样。

messages.speaker: Sara (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 书里为什么称他为 herwiela？
messages.en: Why do they call him a 'herwiela' in the book?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jinkwieta żżejjed, anki meta ma jkun hemm ebda problema.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jinkwieta żżejjed, anki meta ma jkun hemm ebda problema.
messages.zh: 因为他总是过度担忧，就算没什么问题也一样。
messages.en: Because he worries excessively, even when there is no problem.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小说人物为每个微小变化反复担心，用这个人物画面记住 herwiela 指神经质的人。

gloss_zh: 十分担忧的；非常挂心的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling very concerned or worried about someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人或某事十分担忧、非常挂心的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun imħasseb ħafna dwar xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 十分担忧的；对某人或某事非常挂心的。

formal.mt: Il-missier kien hewdien dwar ibnu u talab lill-iskola tagħtih aktar tagħrif.
formal.en: The father was very concerned about his son and asked the school to give him more information.
formal.zh: 父亲十分担心儿子，请求学校提供更多情况。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex int daqshekk hewdien? David: Ħija għadu ma wasalx, u ma weġibx it-telefon.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why are you so concerned? David: My brother still hasn't arrived, and he didn't answer the phone.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你为什么这么担心？戴维：我兄弟还没到，而且没接电话。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么这么担心？
messages.en: Why are you so concerned?

messages.speaker: David (担心兄弟的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija għadu ma wasalx, u ma weġibx it-telefon.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija għadu ma wasalx, u ma weġibx it-telefon.
messages.zh: 我兄弟还没到，而且没接电话。
messages.en: My brother still hasn't arrived, and he didn't answer the phone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 hewdien 连到“等亲人消息、一直看手机”的画面，记住这是非常挂心的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Raving speech, or, in a separate sense, the act of turning a matter over repeatedly in one's mind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指狂乱、失去条理的言语；另一个独立义项指在心中反复思考某件事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Diskors bla rabta jew bla sens; f'tifsira oħra, ħsieb ripetut u fit-tul dwar xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狂言乱语；狂乱而缺乏条理的言语。
反复思量；在心中一再考虑某件事。

formal.mt: Wara ħafna hewdin dwar iż-żewġ proposti, il-kumitat għażel dik li kienet tiswa inqas.
formal.en: After much mulling over the two proposals, the committee chose the one that cost less.
formal.zh: 委员会反复考虑了两项提案后，选择了成本较低的那一项。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek ma ddeċidejtx? Pawlu: Le, wara dan il-hewdin kollu għadni ma nafx liema kors nagħżel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you still not decided? Pawlu: No, after all this mulling over, I still don't know which course to choose.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还没决定吗？保罗：没有，反复想了这么久，我还是不知道该选哪门课。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你还没决定吗？
messages.en: Have you still not decided?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (正在选课的同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, wara dan il-hewdin kollu għadni ma nafx liema kors nagħżel.
messages.mt_standard: Le, wara dan il-hewdin kollu għadni ma nafx liema kors nagħżel.
messages.zh: 没有，反复想了这么久，我还是不知道该选哪门课。
messages.en: No, after all this mulling over, I still don't know which course to choose.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 hewdin 画两格：一格是嘴里乱说，一格是心里反复想；两个名词义分别记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Love or affection; in separate senses, air, or an abyss or pit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可表示爱或爱意；其他独立义项分别表示空气，以及深渊或坑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imħabba jew għożża; f'tifsiriet separati, arja, jew abbiss jew ħofra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱；爱意；对某人或某物的深厚感情。
空气。
深渊；坑；地面上的深陷处。

formal.mt: F'din il-poeżija, il-kelma 'hewwa' tesprimi l-imħabba tal-poeta lejn il-persuna li jindirizza.
formal.en: In this poem, the word 'hewwa' expresses the poet's love for the person being addressed.
formal.zh: 在这首诗中，hewwa 一词表达诗人对倾诉对象的爱。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'tfisser 'hewwa' f'din il-poeżija? Toni: Hawn tfisser imħabba; f'kuntest ieħor tista' tfisser arja jew abbiss.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'hewwa' mean in this poem? Toni: Here it means love; in another context it can mean air or an abyss.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这首诗里的 hewwa 是什么意思？托尼：这里表示爱；在其他语境里也可以表示空气或深渊。

messages.speaker: Lara (读诗的学生)
messages.zh: 这首诗里的 hewwa 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'hewwa' mean in this poem?

messages.speaker: Toni (一起读诗的同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser imħabba; f'kuntest ieħor tista' tfisser arja jew abbiss.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser imħabba; f'kuntest ieħor tista' tfisser arja jew abbiss.
messages.zh: 这里表示爱；在其他语境里也可以表示空气或深渊。
messages.en: Here it means love; in another context it can mean air or an abyss.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 hewwa 分别画爱心、空气和深坑三张卡片；用上下文选卡，不把三个义项混成一个。

gloss_zh: 快速干活；因辛苦工作而产生的疲劳

teaching_sense.en_definition: To work quickly or carry out a task at a fast pace.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 快速干活；以较快的速度进行工作或完成任务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaħdem malajr jew iwettaq biċċa xogħol b'ritmu mgħaġġel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 快速干活；以较快的速度工作。
因辛苦工作或繁重劳动而产生的疲劳。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem heżża biex ilesti t-tiswijiet qabel ma jinfetaħ il-ħanut.
formal.en: The worker worked quickly to finish the repairs before the shop opened.
formal.zh: 工人加快干活，争取在商店开门前完成维修。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif lestejt daqshekk malajr? Mark: Heżża sieħbi, u jien għentu nġorr il-kaxxi.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did you finish so quickly? Mark: My friend worked fast, and I helped him carry the boxes.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你怎么这么快就干完了？马克：我朋友干活很快，我帮他搬箱子。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么这么快就干完了？
messages.en: How did you finish so quickly?

messages.speaker: Mark (刚完成搬运的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Heżża sieħbi, u jien għentu nġorr il-kaxxi.
messages.mt_standard: Heżża sieħbi, u jien għentu nġorr il-kaxxi.
messages.zh: 我朋友干活很快，我帮他搬箱子。
messages.en: My friend worked fast, and I helped him carry the boxes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张学习卡记 heżża：动词卡画快速干活，名词卡画劳动后的疲劳，分别标明词性。

gloss_zh: 摇动者；引起震颤的事物

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who shakes something, or, in a separate sense, something that causes quaking or trembling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 摇动某物的人；另一个独立义项指引起震动或颤动的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħawwad jew tħeżżeż xi ħaġa; f'tifsira oħra, xi ħaġa li ġġiegħel l-art jew oġġett jitriegħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摇动者；摇晃或抖动某物的人。
引起震动或颤动的事物。

collocations.en: something that makes the ground quake

formal.mt: Il-heżżież tal-friegħi ħadem bil-galbu, filwaqt li ħaddiem ieħor ġabar il-frott li waqa'.
formal.en: The person shaking the branches worked carefully, while another worker collected the fallen fruit.
formal.zh: 摇动树枝的人小心地操作，另一名工人则收集掉落的果实。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min se jkun il-heżżież tal-friegħi? David: Jien; int żomm il-qoffa taħt is-siġra.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who is going to shake the branches? David: I am; you hold the basket under the tree.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：谁来负责摇树枝？戴维：我来；你在树下拿着篮子。

messages.speaker: Anna (一起采果的朋友)
messages.zh: 谁来负责摇树枝？
messages.en: Who is going to shake the branches?

messages.speaker: David (一起采果的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien; int żomm il-qoffa taħt is-siġra.
messages.mt_standard: Jien; int żomm il-qoffa taħt is-siġra.
messages.zh: 我来；你在树下拿着篮子。
messages.en: I am; you hold the basket under the tree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象摇树枝的人，再想象使地面发颤的物体；heżżież 的两个义项分别对应人和致震物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing something to shake or quake.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使物体发生摇晃、震动或颤动的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lil xi ħaġa titħawwad jew titriegħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引起摇晃或震动的。

collocations.en: a sound that makes things shake

formal.mt: Il-makkinarju kellu effett heżżieżi fuq l-art tal-kamra.
formal.en: The machinery had a shaking effect on the floor of the room.
formal.zh: 机械使房间的地板产生了震动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ħoss heżżieżi qed iċaqlaq il-ħġieġ! Pawlu: Iva, il-magna qiegħda eżatt taħtna.
colloquial.en: Maja: This sound is making the glass shake! Pawlu: Yes, the machine is directly below us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这声音震得玻璃都在动！保罗：是啊，机器就在我们正下方。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ħoss heżżieżi qed iċaqlaq il-ħġieġ!
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ħoss heżżieżi qed iċaqlaq il-ħġieġ!
messages.zh: 这声音震得玻璃都在动！
messages.en: This sound is making the glass shake!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 是啊，机器就在我们正下方。
messages.en: Yes, the machine is directly below us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它和机器震得玻璃摇晃的画面相连，记住重点是“使别的东西震动”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A family name, written Hili.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 姓氏 Hili，可音译为“希利”；作为姓名使用时首字母大写。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jinkiteb Hili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个姓氏：Hili（希利）。

formal.mt: Is-Sur Hili se jattendi l-laqgħa bħala rappreżentant tal-familja.
formal.en: Mr Hili will attend the meeting as the family's representative.
formal.zh: 希利先生将作为家庭代表出席会议。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'inhu kunjomok? David: Hili. Tridni niktbu għalik?
colloquial.en: Anna: What's your surname? David: Hili. Would you like me to write it down for you?
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你姓什么？戴维：希利。要我写给你吗？

messages.speaker: Anna (接待员)
messages.zh: 你姓什么？
messages.en: What's your surname?

messages.speaker: David (访客)
messages.zh: 希利。要我写给你吗？
messages.en: Hili. Would you like me to write it down for you?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Hili 放在登记表的“姓氏”栏里记忆，并注意真实姓名中的大写 H。

teaching_sense.en_definition: There or over there, indicating a place away from the speaker.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 那里、那边，用来指离说话者有一定距离的地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'dak il-post jew f'dik id-direzzjoni, 'il bogħod minn min qed jitkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 那里；那边。

formal.mt: Il-gwida indikat is-siġra u qalet li d-daħla kienet tinsab hinn.
formal.en: The guide pointed to the tree and said that the entrance was over there.
formal.zh: 导游指着那棵树，说入口就在那边。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu l-kelb? Ben: Ħares hinn, ħdejn is-siġra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where's the dog? Ben: Look over there, beside the tree.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：狗在哪里？本：看那边，就在树旁。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 狗在哪里？
messages.en: Where's the dog?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 看那边，就在树旁。
messages.en: Look over there, beside the tree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 伸手指向远处的一棵树，同时说 hinn，把词义和“那边”的指向动作绑定。

gloss_zh: 别住；用针等固定的动作

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of fastening or attaching something, for example with a safety pin or drawing pin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物别住或固定到另一物上的动作，例如使用安全别针或图钉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li twaħħal xi ħaġa ma' oħra, pereżempju b'labra tas-sigurtà.

sense_translations.en_definition: fastening or attaching (e.g. with a safety or drawing pin)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 扣住、别住或附着固定的动作，例如用安全别针或图钉固定。

formal.mt: L-hmiż tad-drapp b'labra tas-sigurtà żammu f'postu waqt il-kejl.
formal.en: Fastening the fabric with a safety pin kept it in place during measurement.
formal.zh: 用安全别针别住布料，使它在测量时保持原位。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex hemm bżonn l-hmiż tad-drapp? Nina: Biex ma jiċċaqlaqx waqt li nkejlu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why does the fabric need pinning? Nina: So it doesn't move while we measure it.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：为什么要把布料别住？妮娜：这样我们量的时候它就不会移动。

messages.speaker: Rita (缝纫学员)
messages.zh: 为什么要把布料别住？
messages.en: Why does the fabric need pinning?

messages.speaker: Nina (缝纫老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex ma jiċċaqlaqx waqt li nkejlu.
messages.mt_standard: Biex ma jiċċaqlaqx waqt li nkejlu.
messages.zh: 这样我们量的时候它就不会移动。
messages.en: So it doesn't move while we measure it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用安全别针把两层布别在一起；这个名词指“固定的动作”，不是别针本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of pounding something with repeated forceful blows.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用连续而有力的击打来捣、砸某物的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tħabbat fuq xi ħaġa b'daqqiet qawwija u ripetuti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 捣打；连续而有力地敲击或砸打。

formal.mt: L-hriż tal-ħwawar fil-mehrież jgħin biex jitfarrku f'biċċiet iżgħar.
formal.en: Pounding the spices in a mortar helps break them into smaller pieces.
formal.zh: 在研钵中捣打香料，有助于把它们弄成更小的碎粒。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'inhu dak il-ħoss? Toni: Huwa l-hriż tal-ħwawar; qed inħejji t-taħlita.
colloquial.en: Lina: What's that sound? Toni: It's the pounding of the spices; I'm preparing the mixture.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：那是什么声音？托尼：是捣香料的声音，我正在准备混合料。

messages.speaker: Lina (家人)
messages.zh: 那是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that sound?

messages.speaker: Toni (做饭的家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa l-hriż tal-ħwawar; qed inħejji t-taħlita.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa l-hriż tal-ħwawar; qed inħejji t-taħlita.
messages.zh: 是捣香料的声音，我正在准备混合料。
messages.en: It's the pounding of the spices; I'm preparing the mixture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想研钵里“咚、咚、咚”的连续捣打声，把 hriż 记成反复用力击打的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression used like hux to ask whether something is so.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与 hux 同义的感叹表达，用来询问或确认“是这样吗？”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni bħal hux, użata biex tistaqsi jekk xi ħaġa hijiex tassew hekk.

sense_translations.en_definition: synonym of hux: is that so?
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与 hux 同义：是吗？是这样吗？

collocations.en: Is that so? Tell me more.

formal.mt: Wara li sema' l-aħbar, ir-rappreżentant staqsa: "Hwiex? Il-laqgħa se ssir għada?"
formal.en: After hearing the news, the representative asked, "Is that so? Will the meeting take place tomorrow?"
formal.zh: 听到消息后，代表问道：“是吗？会议明天举行？”

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ħanut se jiftaħ il-Ħadd ukoll. Karl: Hwiex? Mela nista' mmur il-Ħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: The shop will open on Sunday too. Karl: Is that so? Then I can go on Sunday.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那家店星期天也会开门。卡尔：是吗？那我可以星期天去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那家店星期天也会开门。
messages.en: The shop will open on Sunday too.

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.zh: 是吗？那我可以星期天去。
messages.en: Is that so? Then I can go on Sunday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象听到新消息后抬眉确认，说一句“是吗？”；把 hwiex 和这个回应动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Panting or breathing heavily, especially after physical effort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正在喘气或呼吸粗重的，尤指身体用力之后的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun qed jieħu n-nifs b'ħeffa jew b'saħħa, speċjalment wara sforz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正在喘气的；气喘吁吁的。
呼吸粗重的；大口呼吸的。

formal.mt: Wara t-tellieqa, l-atleta kien hġien u waqaf biex jistrieħ.
formal.en: After the race, the athlete was panting and stopped to rest.
formal.zh: 比赛结束后，那名运动员气喘吁吁，停下来休息。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex int hġien? Mark: Għadni kemm tlajt it-taraġ kollu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you panting? Mark: I've just climbed all those stairs.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你怎么喘成这样？马克：我刚爬完那些楼梯。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么喘成这样？
messages.en: Why are you panting?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我刚爬完那些楼梯。
messages.en: I've just climbed all those stairs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象爬完楼梯后胸口起伏、大口喘气，用这个身体画面记住形容词的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become hard or stiff, including becoming stiff in the joints.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得坚硬或僵直，也可指身体关节变得不灵活。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir iebes jew riġidu; jista' jingħad ukoll meta l-ġogi ma jibqgħux jiċċaqalqu faċilment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变硬；由较软的状态变得坚硬。
变僵；变得挺硬或不易弯曲。
关节变得僵硬；肢体活动变得不灵活。

formal.mt: Il-ġibs ibbies wara li tħalla jinxef għal diversi sigħat.
formal.en: The plaster hardened after it was left to dry for several hours.
formal.zh: 石膏放置晾干数小时后变硬了。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex qed timxi daqshekk bil-mod? Toni: Ġismi ibbies wara li qgħadt bilqiegħda għal tliet sigħat.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why are you walking so slowly? Toni: My body got stiff after I sat for three hours.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你怎么走得这么慢？托尼：我坐了三个小时，身体都僵了。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么走得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are you walking so slowly?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġismi ibbies wara li qgħadt bilqiegħda għal tliet sigħat.
messages.mt_standard: Ġismi ibbies wara li qgħadt bilqiegħda għal tliet sigħat.
messages.zh: 我坐了三个小时，身体都僵了。
messages.en: My body got stiff after I sat for three hours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把石膏晾干变硬与久坐后身体发僵放在一起记：共同点都是从柔软灵活变得硬而不灵活。

gloss_zh: 卖；出售（jbigħ 的辅音后形式及替代基本形式）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form of jbigħ, meaning 'he sells', used after a consonant and also as an alternative basic form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示“他卖、他出售”的动词形式；用于辅音之后，也是 jbigħ 的替代基本形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma ta' jbigħ, li tfisser li hu jagħti xi ħaġa bi ħlas; tintuża wara konsonanti u wkoll bħala forma bażika alternattiva.

sense_translations.en_definition: post-consonantal and alternative basic form of jbigħ
sense_translations.zh_definition: jbigħ 的辅音后形式及替代基本形式，表示“他卖；他出售”。

formal.mt: Mark ibigħ prodotti lokali fis-suq kull nhar ta' Sibt.
formal.en: Mark sells local products at the market every Saturday.
formal.zh: 马克每周六都在市场出售本地产品。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark ibigħ il-ħobż ukoll? Luqa: Iva, u tista' tixtrih frisk kull filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does Mark sell bread too? Luqa: Yes, and you can buy it fresh every morning.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克也卖面包吗？卢卡：是的，每天早上都能买到新鲜的。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 马克也卖面包吗？
messages.en: Does Mark sell bread too?

messages.speaker: Luqa (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u tista' tixtrih frisk kull filgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u tista' tixtrih frisk kull filgħodu.
messages.zh: 是的，每天早上都能买到新鲜的。
messages.en: Yes, and you can buy it fresh every morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用整句 Mark ibigħ il-ħobż 记住一个人卖面包；再把 ibigħ 与 jbigħ 配对识记。

gloss_zh: 卖；出售（jbigħu 的辅音后形式及替代基本形式）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form of jbigħu, meaning 'they sell', used after a consonant and also as an alternative basic form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示“他们卖、他们出售”的动词形式；用于辅音之后，也是 jbigħu 的替代基本形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma ta' jbigħu, li tfisser li huma jagħtu xi ħaġa bi ħlas; tintuża wara konsonanti u wkoll bħala forma bażika alternattiva.

sense_translations.en_definition: post-consonantal and alternative basic form of jbigħu
sense_translations.zh_definition: jbigħu 的辅音后形式及替代基本形式，表示“他们卖；他们出售”。

formal.mt: Dawn ibigħu l-frott direttament lill-konsumaturi.
formal.en: These sellers sell fruit directly to consumers.
formal.zh: 这些卖家直接向消费者出售水果。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dawn ibigħu l-larinġ ukoll? Ben: Iva, u llum għandhom larinġ frisk ħafna.
colloquial.en: Marija: Do these sellers sell oranges too? Ben: Yes, and today they have very fresh oranges.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：这些卖家也卖橙子吗？本：卖，而且他们今天的橙子非常新鲜。

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.zh: 这些卖家也卖橙子吗？
messages.en: Do these sellers sell oranges too?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u llum għandhom larinġ frisk ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u llum għandhom larinġ frisk ħafna.
messages.zh: 卖，而且他们今天的橙子非常新鲜。
messages.en: Yes, and today they have very fresh oranges.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象多个摊主一起卖水果，用 Dawn ibigħu l-frott 记整句，并与单数 ibigħ 对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The flowering plant Chinese hibiscus, scientifically named Hibiscus rosa-sinensis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种开花植物，中文称朱槿或扶桑，学名为 Hibiscus rosa-sinensis。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pjanta tal-fjuri magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Hibiscus rosa-sinensis.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 朱槿，又称扶桑，学名为 Hibiscus rosa-sinensis。

collocations.en: a Chinese hibiscus in a pot

formal.mt: Fil-ġnien tal-iskola hemm ibisku ħdejn id-daħla.
formal.en: There is a Chinese hibiscus near the entrance in the school garden.
formal.zh: 学校花园的入口附近有一株朱槿。

colloquial.mt: Elena: X'inhi din il-pjanta bil-fjura ħamra? Ġanni: Dan ibisku; poġġejtu hawn ilbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Elena: What is this plant with the red flower? Ġanni: It's a Chinese hibiscus; I put it here yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：这株开红花的植物是什么？詹尼：这是朱槿，我昨天把它放在这里的。

messages.speaker: Elena (邻居)
messages.zh: 这株开红花的植物是什么？
messages.en: What is this plant with the red flower?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (园艺爱好者)
messages.zh: 这是朱槿，我昨天把它放在这里的。
messages.en: It's a Chinese hibiscus; I put it here yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ibisku 写在朱槿图片旁，再配上盆栽和花朵两个画面，记住它指具体植物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Extremely foolish or stupid; an emphatic expression used to describe a person, idea, or action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 极其愚蠢的；用于强烈评价人、想法或行为的表达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iblah ħafna; espressjoni qawwija biex tiddeskrivi persuna, idea jew azzjoni bla għaqal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常愚蠢的；蠢透了的。

formal.mt: Fid-djalogu tar-rakkont, il-karattru jsejjaħ il-pjan ta' sieħbu 'iblah karnival'.
formal.en: In the story's dialogue, the character calls his companion's plan 'very stupid'.
formal.zh: 在故事的对话中，这个人物把同伴的计划称为“愚蠢透顶”。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kont se noħroġ u nħalli ċ-ċwievet ġewwa. Sam: Dak kien ikun żball iblah karnival! Ħudhom miegħek.
colloquial.en: Rita: I was about to go out and leave the keys inside. Sam: That would have been a very stupid mistake! Take them with you.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我刚才差点出门，把钥匙留在屋里。萨姆：那可真是个蠢透了的错误！把钥匙带上。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont se noħroġ u nħalli ċ-ċwievet ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Kont se noħroġ u nħalli ċ-ċwievet ġewwa.
messages.zh: 我刚才差点出门，把钥匙留在屋里。
messages.en: I was about to go out and leave the keys inside.

messages.speaker: Sam (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak kien ikun żball iblah karnival! Ħudhom miegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Dak kien ikun żball iblah karnival! Ħudhom miegħek.
messages.zh: 那可真是个蠢透了的错误！把钥匙带上。
messages.en: That would have been a very stupid mistake! Take them with you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语当作加重语气的评价来记，联想忘带钥匙后脱口而出的“真是蠢透了”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of combining different varieties or types to produce a hybrid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使不同品种或类型相结合，产生杂交个体或混合形式的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih jingħaqdu varjetajiet jew tipi differenti biex jinħoloq ibridu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 杂交；使不同品种或类型结合而产生杂交形式的过程。

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina l-ibridazzjoni bejn żewġ varjetajiet ta' pjanti.
formal.en: The study examines hybridization between two plant varieties.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察两个植物品种之间的杂交。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inħolqot din il-varjetà ġdida? Pawlu: Permezz tal-ibridazzjoni ta' żewġ varjetajiet differenti.
colloquial.en: Maja: How was this new variety created? Pawlu: Through the hybridization of two different varieties.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个新品种是怎么培育出来的？保罗：通过两个不同品种的杂交。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个新品种是怎么培育出来的？
messages.en: How was this new variety created?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园艺老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Permezz tal-ibridazzjoni ta' żewġ varjetajiet differenti.
messages.mt_standard: Permezz tal-ibridazzjoni ta' żewġ varjetajiet differenti.
messages.zh: 通过两个不同品种的杂交。
messages.en: Through the hybridization of two different varieties.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个品种画成两条汇合的线，用汇合的过程记住 ibridazzjoni 的“杂交过程”义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To combine different varieties or types so that they produce a hybrid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使不同品种或类型结合，以产生杂交个体或混合形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaqqad varjetajiet jew tipi differenti biex jipproduċi ibridu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使杂交；将不同品种或类型结合，产生杂交形式。

formal.mt: Il-botaniku ibridizza żewġ varjetajiet ta' pjanti u studja l-karatteristiċi tal-pjanti li nħolqu.
formal.en: The botanist hybridized two plant varieties and studied the characteristics of the resulting plants.
formal.zh: 这位植物学家使两个植物品种杂交，并研究了所得植株的特征。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'għamel il-botaniku b'dawn il-pjanti? Toni: Ibridizza żewġ varjetajiet biex joħloq waħda ġdida.
colloquial.en: Sara: What did the botanist do with these plants? Toni: He hybridized two varieties to create a new one.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：植物学家对这些植物做了什么？托尼：他让两个品种杂交，培育一个新品种。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 植物学家对这些植物做了什么？
messages.en: What did the botanist do with these plants?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ibridizza żewġ varjetajiet biex joħloq waħda ġdida.
messages.mt_standard: Ibridizza żewġ varjetajiet biex joħloq waħda ġdida.
messages.zh: 他让两个品种杂交，培育一个新品种。
messages.en: He hybridized two varieties to create a new one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“研究员动手让两个品种杂交”的动作画面记住 ibridizza；它表示做这件事，是动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The condition or quality of being hybrid, with features drawn from different types or sources.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 兼有不同类型或来源的特征，呈现杂交或混杂性质的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kundizzjoni jew il-karatteristika ta' xi ħaġa li tgħaqqad fiha elementi ta' tipi jew sorsi differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 杂交性；由不同类型或来源的成分混合而呈现的性质或状态。

formal.mt: L-analiżi tiddeskrivi l-ibridiżmu kulturali fix-xogħol tal-artist, li jgħaqqad elementi minn tradizzjonijiet differenti.
formal.en: The analysis describes the cultural hybridism in the artist's work, which combines elements from different traditions.
formal.zh: 这篇分析描述了艺术家作品中的文化混杂性，其作品融合了不同传统的元素。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex issejjaħlu ibridiżmu kulturali? Mark: Għax f'dan ix-xogħol hemm elementi minn diversi kulturi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do you call it cultural hybridism? Mark: Because this work contains elements from several cultures.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你为什么把它叫作文化混杂性？马克：因为这件作品包含多种文化的元素。

messages.speaker: Lara (参观者)
messages.zh: 你为什么把它叫作文化混杂性？
messages.en: Why do you call it cultural hybridism?

messages.speaker: Mark (展览讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax f'dan ix-xogħol hemm elementi minn diversi kulturi.
messages.mt_standard: Għax f'dan ix-xogħol hemm elementi minn diversi kulturi.
messages.zh: 因为这件作品包含多种文化的元素。
messages.en: Because this work contains elements from several cultures.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一幅同时带有多种风格的画，用作品呈现的“混杂性质”记住 ibridiżmu，并与杂交过程区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Combining features or elements of two or more different types.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 结合两种或多种不同类型的特征或成分的；杂交的或混合型的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jgħaqqad fih karatteristiċi jew elementi ta' żewġ tipi differenti jew aktar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 杂交的；兼有不同类型成分或特征的，混合型的。

formal.mt: Il-kors juża mudell ibridu li jgħaqqad tagħlim fil-klassi ma' lezzjonijiet online.
formal.en: The course uses a hybrid model that combines classroom teaching with online lessons.
formal.zh: 这门课程采用混合模式，将课堂教学与线上课程结合起来。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-kors kollu jsir online? David: Le, juża mudell ibridu: xi lezzjonijiet online u oħrajn fil-klassi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is the whole course online? David: No, it uses a hybrid model: some lessons online and others in the classroom.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：整门课都在线上进行吗？戴维：不是，它采用混合模式：有些课在线上，有些在教室里。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 整门课都在线上进行吗？
messages.en: Is the whole course online?

messages.speaker: David (课程顾问)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, juża mudell ibridu: xi lezzjonijiet online u oħrajn fil-klassi.
messages.mt_standard: Le, juża mudell ibridu: xi lezzjonijiet online u oħrajn fil-klassi.
messages.zh: 不是，它采用混合模式：有些课在线上，有些在教室里。
messages.en: No, it uses a hybrid model: some lessons online and others in the classroom.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把线上课堂与实体教室拼成一张图，给这个模式贴上 ibridu 标签，记住“混合型的”形容词义。

gloss_zh: 理想主义地；以理想主义的方式

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way guided by ideals or hopes about how things should be, sometimes with limited attention to practical difficulties.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以理想或对事物应有状态的期望来思考、说话或行动，有时较少考虑现实困难。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod immexxi minn ideali jew minn tama dwar kif għandhom ikunu l-affarijiet, xi drabi mingħajr biżżejjed attenzjoni għad-diffikultajiet prattiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 理想主义地；怀着理想、着眼于理想状态地。

collocations.zh: 以理想主义的方式思考
怀着理想主义的态度说话

formal.mt: Fl-esej tiegħu, l-istudent jaħseb idealistikament dwar soċjetà fejn kulħadd ikollu opportunitajiet indaqs.
formal.en: In his essay, the student thinks idealistically about a society where everyone has equal opportunities.
formal.zh: 这名学生在文章中以理想主义的眼光思考一个人人机会平等的社会。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Naħseb li kulħadd se jgħin mingħajr ma jitlob xejn lura. Pawlu: Qed taħseb idealistikament, imma xorta rridu nistaqsu min jista' jgħin.
colloquial.en: Lara: I think everyone will help without asking for anything in return. Pawlu: You're thinking idealistically, but we still need to ask who can help.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：我觉得每个人都会不求回报地帮忙。保罗：你想得很理想主义，不过我们还是得问问谁能帮忙。

messages.speaker: Lara (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li kulħadd se jgħin mingħajr ma jitlob xejn lura.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li kulħadd se jgħin mingħajr ma jitlob xejn lura.
messages.zh: 我觉得每个人都会不求回报地帮忙。
messages.en: I think everyone will help without asking for anything in return.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (志愿活动协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed taħseb idealistikament, imma xorta rridu nistaqsu min jista' jgħin.
messages.mt_standard: Qed taħseb idealistikament, imma xorta rridu nistaqsu min jista' jgħin.
messages.zh: 你想得很理想主义，不过我们还是得问问谁能帮忙。
messages.en: You're thinking idealistically, but we still need to ask who can help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住它回答“怎样想、怎样说”：idealistikament 是“理想主义地”，把注意力放在动作进行的方式上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Guided by strong ideals or hopes for how things should be, sometimes without fully considering practical limits.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受强烈理想或对美好状态的期望所引导的，有时未充分考虑现实限制的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Immexxi minn ideali qawwija jew minn tama għal kif għandhom ikunu l-affarijiet, xi drabi mingħajr ma jqis biżżejjed il-limiti prattiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 理想主义的；抱有崇高理想或倾向于按理想状态看待事物的。

collocations.zh: 一个怀有理想主义愿景的项目

formal.mt: Il-proġett huwa idealistiku fl-għan tiegħu li jagħmel l-edukazzjoni aċċessibbli għal kulħadd.
formal.en: The project is idealistic in its aim of making education accessible to everyone.
formal.zh: 这个项目以让人人都能获得教育为目标，体现了理想主义精神。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Irrid niftaħ ċentru fejn kull tifel u tifla jitgħallmu b'xejn. Toni: Huwa proġett idealistiku; ejja naraw x'riżorsi għandna biex nibdew.
colloquial.en: Sara: I want to open a centre where every child can learn for free. Toni: It's an idealistic project; let's see what resources we have to get started.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我想开一个让每个孩子都能免费学习的中心。托尼：这是个充满理想主义的项目；我们看看有哪些资源可以用来起步。

messages.speaker: Sara (社区志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrid niftaħ ċentru fejn kull tifel u tifla jitgħallmu b'xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Irrid niftaħ ċentru fejn kull tifel u tifla jitgħallmu b'xejn.
messages.zh: 我想开一个让每个孩子都能免费学习的中心。
messages.en: I want to open a centre where every child can learn for free.

messages.speaker: Toni (项目伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa proġett idealistiku; ejja naraw x'riżorsi għandna biex nibdew.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa proġett idealistiku; ejja naraw x'riżorsi għandna biex nibdew.
messages.zh: 这是个充满理想主义的项目；我们看看有哪些资源可以用来起步。
messages.en: It's an idealistic project; let's see what resources we have to get started.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给一个追求人人受教育的项目贴上 idealistiku 标签，用“项目是理想主义的”记住它修饰人或事物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To imagine or present someone or something as more perfect or better than they really are.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某人或某事想象或描绘得比实际更美好、更完美，忽略其缺点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimmaġina jew juri lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa bħala aħjar jew aktar perfetti milli huma fir-realtà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将……理想化；把人或事物想象、描绘得过于美好或完美。

collocations.en: to idealise life in the countryside

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz tiegħu, l-awtur idealizza l-ħajja fil-kampanja u ta ftit attenzjoni lid-diffikultajiet tagħha.
formal.en: In his novel, the author idealised life in the countryside and paid little attention to its difficulties.
formal.zh: 作者在小说中将乡村生活理想化，很少关注其中的困难。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ħajja fil-kampanja dejjem tidher perfetta f'dan il-ktieb. Mark: Iva, l-awtur idealizza dik il-ħajja u ma semmiex ħafna mill-problemi tagħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Life in the countryside always seems perfect in this book. Mark: Yes, the author idealised that life and left out many of its problems.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这本书里的乡村生活总是显得完美无缺。马克：是啊，作者把那种生活理想化了，许多问题都没有提到。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħajja fil-kampanja dejjem tidher perfetta f'dan il-ktieb.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħajja fil-kampanja dejjem tidher perfetta f'dan il-ktieb.
messages.zh: 这本书里的乡村生活总是显得完美无缺。
messages.en: Life in the countryside always seems perfect in this book.

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, l-awtur idealizza dik il-ħajja u ma semmiex ħafna mill-problemi tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, l-awtur idealizza dik il-ħajja u ma semmiex ħafna mill-problemi tagħha.
messages.zh: 是啊，作者把那种生活理想化了，许多问题都没有提到。
messages.en: Yes, the author idealised that life and left out many of its problems.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给现实照片加上一层完美滤镜，把缺点都遮住；用这个动作记住 idealizza 的“将……理想化”义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of presenting or imagining someone or something as more perfect than they really are.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某人或某事想象或描绘得比实际更完美的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih persuna jew ħaġa tiġi immaġinata jew ippreżentata bħala aktar perfetta milli hi fir-realtà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 理想化；把人或事物过度美化。

formal.mt: L-istudju janalizza l-idealizzazzjoni tal-passat fir-rumanzi tal-awtur.
formal.en: The study analyzes the idealization of the past in the author's novels.
formal.zh: 这项研究分析了该作家小说中对过去的理想化描写。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-film juri l-imħabba bħallikieku kollox dejjem imur tajjeb. — Lara: Iva, hemm wisq idealizzazzjoni; fil-ħajja hemm ukoll id-diffikultajiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: This film portrays love as if everything always goes well. — Lara: Yes, there is too much idealization; life also has difficulties.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这部电影把爱情拍得好像永远一帆风顺。——拉拉：是啊，太理想化了；生活中也有困难。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-film juri l-imħabba bħallikieku kollox dejjem imur tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-film juri l-imħabba bħallikieku kollox dejjem imur tajjeb.
messages.zh: 这部电影把爱情拍得好像永远一帆风顺。
messages.en: This film portrays love as if everything always goes well.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm wisq idealizzazzjoni; fil-ħajja hemm ukoll id-diffikultajiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm wisq idealizzazzjoni; fil-ħajja hemm ukoll id-diffikultajiet.
messages.zh: 是啊，太理想化了；生活中也有困难。
messages.en: Yes, there is too much idealization; life also has difficulties.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给现实加上完美滤镜：缺点被遮住，就是“理想化”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In the best or most desirable circumstances.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在最好或最符合期望的情况下。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fl-aħjar ċirkostanzi jew bil-mod l-aktar mixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 理想情况下；按照最理想的安排。

formal.mt: Idealment, il-parteċipanti għandhom jirċievu l-programm ġimgħa qabel il-laqgħa.
formal.en: Ideally, participants should receive the program one week before the meeting.
formal.zh: 理想情况下，参与者应在会议前一周收到议程。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'ħin nitilqu għada? — Sara: Idealment fit-tmienja, biex naslu qabel it-traffiku.
colloquial.en: Mark: What time shall we leave tomorrow? — Sara: Ideally at eight, so we arrive before the traffic builds up.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们明天几点出发？——萨拉：最好八点，这样能在交通拥堵前到达。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们明天几点出发？
messages.en: What time shall we leave tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Idealment fit-tmienja, biex naslu qabel it-traffiku.
messages.mt_standard: Idealment fit-tmienja, biex naslu qabel it-traffiku.
messages.zh: 最好八点，这样能在交通拥堵前到达。
messages.en: Ideally at eight, so we arrive before the traffic builds up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记成计划前的“最好能”：说的是理想安排，不是保证实现。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To recognize or establish who someone is or what something is.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 辨认或确定某人的身份，或确定某个事物是什么。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħraf jew jistabbilixxi min hi persuna jew x'inhi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 识别；辨认；确定身份或事物。

formal.mt: It-tekniku identifika l-kawża tal-ħsara wara spezzjoni bir-reqqa.
formal.en: The technician identified the cause of the fault after a thorough inspection.
formal.zh: 技术人员经过仔细检查，确定了故障原因。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Identifika lil ħuk f'dan ir-ritratt antik. — Mark: Hawn hu, fuq ix-xellug, bil-qmis blu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Identify your brother in this old photo. — Mark: Here he is, on the left, wearing the blue shirt.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：在这张老照片里认一认你哥哥。——马克：他在这里，左边穿蓝衬衫的那个。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Identifika lil ħuk f'dan ir-ritratt antik.
messages.mt_standard: Identifika lil ħuk f'dan ir-ritratt antik.
messages.zh: 在这张老照片里认一认你哥哥。
messages.en: Identify your brother in this old photo.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn hu, fuq ix-xellug, bil-qmis blu.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn hu, fuq ix-xellug, bil-qmis blu.
messages.zh: 他在这里，左边穿蓝衬衫的那个。
messages.en: Here he is, on the left, wearing the blue shirt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象从一排照片中指认一个人：完成“认出是谁”的动作就是识别。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to be recognized or distinguished as a particular person or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够被认出，或能够与其他人或事物区分开的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jingħaraf jew jiġi distint minn persuni jew affarijiet oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可识别的；能够辨认或确定身份的。

formal.mt: Il-bini huwa faċilment identifikabbli mit-torri għoli tiegħu.
formal.en: The building is easily identifiable by its tall tower.
formal.zh: 凭借高耸的塔楼，这座建筑很容易辨认。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif se nsib il-bagalja tiegħek? — Mark: Għandha żigarella ħamra, allura hi faċilment identifikabbli.
colloquial.en: Sara: How will I find your suitcase? — Mark: It has a red ribbon, so it is easily identifiable.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我怎么找到你的行李箱？——马克：上面有一条红丝带，所以很容易辨认。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我怎么找到你的行李箱？
messages.en: How will I find your suitcase?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandha żigarella ħamra, allura hi faċilment identifikabbli.
messages.mt_standard: Għandha żigarella ħamra, allura hi faċilment identifikabbli.
messages.zh: 上面有一条红丝带，所以很容易辨认。
messages.en: It has a red ribbon, so it is easily identifiable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给行李系上红丝带就“能够被认出”，用这个画面记住可识别的性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or act of recognizing or establishing who someone is or what something is.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 辨认或确定某人身份、某物性质的过程或行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew l-att li bih jingħaraf jew jiġi stabbilit min hi persuna jew x'inhi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 识别；辨认；身份或事物的确认。

formal.mt: L-identifikazzjoni tal-kampjuni saret fil-laboratorju bl-għajnuna ta' mikroskopju.
formal.en: The identification of the specimens was carried out in the laboratory with the aid of a microscope.
formal.zh: 样本的鉴定在实验室中借助显微镜完成。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'għandi nġib biex niġbor il-pakkett? — Rita: Ġib dokument ta' identifikazzjoni u n-numru tal-pakkett.
colloquial.en: Mark: What should I bring to collect the parcel? — Rita: Bring an identification document and the parcel number.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我来取包裹要带什么？——丽塔：带上身份证明文件和包裹编号。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 我来取包裹要带什么？
messages.en: What should I bring to collect the parcel?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġib dokument ta' identifikazzjoni u n-numru tal-pakkett.
messages.mt_standard: Ġib dokument ta' identifikazzjoni u n-numru tal-pakkett.
messages.zh: 带上身份证明文件和包裹编号。
messages.en: Bring an identification document and the parcel number.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把核对证件、确认身份的整个过程装进一个名词，就是“身份确认”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of being the same or exactly alike.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 两个或多个事物相同或完全一致的性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li żewġ affarijiet jew aktar ikunu l-istess jew eżattament bħal xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 相同性；完全相同或一致的状态。

collocations.en: the identicalness of the two copies

formal.mt: Il-paragun ikkonferma l-identiċità tal-kontenut taż-żewġ dokumenti.
formal.en: The comparison confirmed that the contents of the two documents were identical.
formal.zh: 比对确认了两份文件的内容完全一致。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed tqabbel iż-żewġ kopji kelma b'kelma? — Pawlu: Biex niċċekkja l-identiċità tagħhom; irrid inkun ċert li huma eżatt l-istess.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are you comparing the two copies word by word? — Pawlu: To check that they are identical; I want to be sure they are exactly the same.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么逐字比较这两份副本？——保罗：为了核查它们是否完全一致；我想确定它们一模一样。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tqabbel iż-żewġ kopji kelma b'kelma?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tqabbel iż-żewġ kopji kelma b'kelma?
messages.zh: 你为什么逐字比较这两份副本？

messages.mt_spoken: Biex niċċekkja l-identiċità tagħhom; irrid inkun ċert li huma eżatt l-istess.
messages.mt_standard: Biex niċċekkja l-identiċità tagħhom; irrid inkun ċert li huma eżatt l-istess.
messages.zh: 为了核查它们是否完全一致；我想确定它们一模一样。
messages.en: To check that they are identical; I want to be sure they are exactly the same.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两张透明图完全重合，用“一模一样的性质”记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To supply water or moisture to the body, skin, or another substance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为身体、皮肤或其他物质补充水分，或使其与水结合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iforni ilma jew umdità lill-ġisem, lill-ġilda jew lil sustanza oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使补充水分；使水合。

formal.mt: Din il-krema tgħin biex tidrata l-ġilda u żżommha ratba.
formal.en: This cream helps hydrate the skin and keep it soft.
formal.zh: 这款乳霜有助于为皮肤补水，并保持皮肤柔软。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Idejja niexfa ħafna llum. — Nina: Ipprova din il-krema; tidrata l-ġilda u tassorbi malajr.
colloquial.en: Lara: My hands are very dry today. — Nina: Try this cream; it hydrates the skin and absorbs quickly.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我的手今天特别干。——妮娜：试试这款乳霜；它能给皮肤补水，而且吸收很快。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我的手今天特别干。
messages.en: My hands are very dry today.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ipprova din il-krema; tidrata l-ġilda u tassorbi malajr.
messages.mt_standard: Ipprova din il-krema; tidrata l-ġilda u tassorbi malajr.
messages.zh: 试试这款乳霜；它能给皮肤补水，而且吸收很快。
messages.en: Try this cream; it hydrates the skin and absorbs quickly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象干燥皮肤得到水分后变柔软，用“把水补进去”的动作记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: All the water on, below, and above the Earth's surface, including liquid water, ice, and water vapor.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 地球表面、地下和大气中所有水的总称，包括液态水、冰和水蒸气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ilma kollu fuq il-wiċċ tad-Dinja, taħtu u fl-atmosfera, inkluż ilma likwidu, silġ u fwar tal-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 水圈；地球上各种形态的水所构成的整体。

formal.mt: L-idrosfera tinkludi l-oċeani, ix-xmajjar, l-ilma taħt l-art, is-silġ u l-fwar tal-ilma fl-atmosfera.
formal.en: The hydrosphere includes the oceans, rivers, groundwater, ice, and water vapor in the atmosphere.
formal.zh: 水圈包括海洋、河流、地下水、冰以及大气中的水蒸气。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-idrosfera tfisser biss il-baħar? — Pawlu: Le, tinkludi wkoll ix-xmajjar, is-silġ u anki l-fwar tal-ilma fl-arja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does the hydrosphere mean only the sea? — Pawlu: No, it also includes rivers, ice, and even water vapor in the air.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：水圈指的只是海洋吗？——保罗：不是，也包括河流、冰，甚至空气中的水蒸气。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 水圈指的只是海洋吗？
messages.en: Does the hydrosphere mean only the sea?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tinkludi wkoll ix-xmajjar, is-silġ u anki l-fwar tal-ilma fl-arja.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tinkludi wkoll ix-xmajjar, is-silġ u anki l-fwar tal-ilma fl-arja.
messages.zh: 不是，也包括河流、冰，甚至空气中的水蒸气。
messages.en: No, it also includes rivers, ice, and even water vapor in the air.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把海洋、河流、地下水、冰和水蒸气一起圈起来，合起来就是水圈。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very hard or stiff, so that something is difficult to bend, press, or chew.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容东西非常硬或僵硬，难以弯曲、按压或咀嚼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun iebes ħafna jew riġidu, u għalhekk diffiċli biex jitgħawweġ, jingħafas jew jintmagħad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常硬的；十分僵硬的

formal.mt: Il-ħobż li tħalla mikxuf għal diversi jiem sar iebes għuda u diffiċli biex jintmagħad.
formal.en: The bread left uncovered for several days became very hard and difficult to chew.
formal.zh: 面包敞开放了好几天，变得硬邦邦的，很难咀嚼。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-ħobż iebes għuda! Mark: Ħallih għas-soppa u ħu biċċa mill-ħobż frisk.
colloquial.en: Sara: This bread is rock hard! Mark: Save it for the soup and take a piece of the fresh bread.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这面包硬邦邦的！Mark：留着配汤吧，拿一块新鲜面包吃。

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.zh: 这面包硬邦邦的！
messages.en: This bread is rock hard!

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħallih għas-soppa u ħu biċċa mill-ħobż frisk.
messages.mt_standard: Ħallih għas-soppa u ħu biċċa mill-ħobż frisk.
messages.zh: 留着配汤吧，拿一块新鲜面包吃。
messages.en: Save it for the soup and take a piece of the fresh bread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一块硬得咬不动的面包，把整个短语 iebes għuda 与“硬邦邦”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pronoun meaning 'what', asking about a thing or a piece of information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 意为“什么”的代词，用来询问某个事物或某项信息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pronom li jfisser 'xiex' u jintuża biex tistaqsi dwar ħaġa jew informazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 什么

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti għandhom jagħrfu l-pronom 'iex' u jispjegaw li jfisser 'xiex'.
formal.en: In this exercise, students should identify the pronoun 'iex' and explain that it means 'what'.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，学生应识别代词 iex，并说明它表示“什么”。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'tfisser 'iex' f'dan it-test? Pawlu: Tfisser 'xiex'; bl-Ingliż ngħidu 'what'.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does 'iex' mean in this text? Pawlu: It means 'xiex'; in English we say 'what'.
colloquial.zh: Lina：这篇文章里的 iex 是什么意思？Pawlu：它表示 xiex，英语就是 what，也就是“什么”。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 iex 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'iex' mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 它表示 xiex，英语就是 what，也就是“什么”。
messages.en: It means 'xiex'; in English we say 'what'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张疑问代词卡：正面写 iex，背面写“什么／what”，用问号图案帮助联想。

gloss_zh: 治理；执政（ggverna 的辅音后形式及另一基本形式）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To govern or exercise political authority; an alternative basic form of ggverna, also used after a consonant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 治理国家或行使政治统治权；是 ggverna 的另一基本形式，也用于辅音之后。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mexxa pajjiż jew eżerċita l-awtorità politika; forma bażika alternattiva ta' ggverna, użata wkoll wara konsonanti.

sense_translations.en_definition: post-consonantal and alternative basic form of ggverna
sense_translations.zh_definition: ggverna 的辅音后形式及另一基本形式，意为治理、执政

collocations.en: the government governed for five years

formal.mt: Skont l-eżempju fil-lezzjoni, il-partit iggverna l-pajjiż għal ħames snin qabel l-elezzjoni li jmiss.
formal.en: According to the example in the lesson, the party governed the country for five years before the next election.
formal.zh: 按照课文中的例子，该党在下一次选举前治理这个国家达五年。

colloquial.mt: Eva: F'dan l-eżempju, kemm dam il-partit fil-gvern? Luqa: Il-partit iggverna għal ħames snin, imbagħad kien hemm elezzjoni.
colloquial.en: Eva: In this example, how long was the party in government? Luqa: The party governed for five years, and then there was an election.
colloquial.zh: Eva：这个例子里，该党执政了多久？Luqa：该党执政了五年，随后举行了选举。

messages.speaker: Eva (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dan l-eżempju, kemm dam il-partit fil-gvern?
messages.mt_standard: F'dan l-eżempju, kemm dam il-partit fil-gvern?
messages.zh: 这个例子里，该党执政了多久？
messages.en: In this example, how long was the party in government?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-partit iggverna għal ħames snin, imbagħad kien hemm elezzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Il-partit iggverna għal ħames snin, imbagħad kien hemm elezzjoni.
messages.zh: 该党执政了五年，随后举行了选举。
messages.en: The party governed for five years, and then there was an election.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 iggverna 和 ggverna 并排写在“执政”词卡上，再用 il-partit iggverna 记住辅音后出现的形式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instrument used to measure the humidity of the air.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于测量空气湿度的仪器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument li jintuża biex titkejjel l-umdità fl-arja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 湿度计；测量空气湿度的仪器。

formal.mt: L-igrometru fil-maħżen jintuża biex titkejjel l-umdità u jiġu protetti l-prodotti.
formal.en: The hygrometer in the storeroom is used to measure humidity and protect the products.
formal.zh: 库房里的湿度计用于测量湿度，以保护存放的产品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex xtrajt igrometru? Mark: Biex inkun naf kemm hemm umdità fil-kamra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you buy a hygrometer? Mark: To find out how humid the room is.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么买湿度计？马克：为了知道房间里的湿度有多高。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么买湿度计？
messages.en: Why did you buy a hygrometer?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex inkun naf kemm hemm umdità fil-kamra.
messages.mt_standard: Biex inkun naf kemm hemm umdità fil-kamra.
messages.zh: 为了知道房间里的湿度有多高。
messages.en: To find out how humid the room is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象房间墙上有一块显示湿度百分比的小仪表，把 igrometru 与“测空气湿度”这个画面一起记。

gloss_zh: 与某人互补；补足某人的长处

teaching_sense.en_definition: To work well with someone by supplying abilities or qualities that balance or complete theirs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以自身的能力或特点补足他人，使双方配合得更好。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaħdem tajjeb ma' xi ħadd billi jżid ħiliet jew kwalitajiet li flimkien ma' tiegħu jagħmlu ħaġa aktar sħiħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与某人形成互补；以自己的能力或特点补足某人。

collocations.en: he complemented a colleague in their work
collocations.zh: 他在工作中与一位同事形成了互补

formal.mt: Fit-tmexxija tal-proġett, Mark ikkomplementa lil Lara: hu ħa ħsieb il-baġit u hi organizzat il-ħidma tat-tim.
formal.en: In managing the project, Mark complemented Lara: he handled the budget and she organised the team's work.
formal.zh: 在管理项目时，马克与拉拉形成了互补：他负责预算，她组织团队的工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark u Lara ħadmu tajjeb flimkien? Nina: Iva, Mark ikkomplementa lil Lara; hu tajjeb bin-numri u hi tajba fl-organizzazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark and Lara work well together? Nina: Yes, Mark complemented Lara; he is good with numbers and she is good at organising.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克和拉拉合作得好吗？妮娜：好，马克与拉拉很互补；他擅长处理数字，她擅长组织。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark u Lara ħadmu tajjeb flimkien?
messages.mt_standard: Mark u Lara ħadmu tajjeb flimkien?
messages.zh: 马克和拉拉合作得好吗？
messages.en: Did Mark and Lara work well together?

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, Mark ikkomplementa lil Lara; hu tajjeb bin-numri u hi tajba fl-organizzazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, Mark ikkomplementa lil Lara; hu tajjeb bin-numri u hi tajba fl-organizzazzjoni.
messages.zh: 好，马克与拉拉很互补；他擅长处理数字，她擅长组织。
messages.en: Yes, Mark complemented Lara; he is good with numbers and she is good at organising.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两位各有所长的搭档想成两块拼图：ikkomplementa 表示彼此补足，不是口头称赞对方。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To finish a task or make something complete by doing all that is required.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做完一项任务，或完成全部必要部分，使某事完整。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jtemm xogħol jew jagħmel dak kollu meħtieġ biex xi ħaġa tkun sħiħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 做完；结束正在进行的工作或活动。
完成；补齐全部必要内容或步骤，使之完整。

formal.mt: L-istudent ikkompleta l-partijiet kollha tal-eżami fiż-żmien mogħti.
formal.en: The student completed all parts of the examination within the allotted time.
formal.zh: 这名学生在规定时间内完成了考试的所有部分。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Pawlu għadu jaħdem fuq il-proġett? Lara: Le, ikkompleta kollox ilbieraħ u llum għandu ġurnata libera.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is Pawlu still working on the project? Lara: No, he finished everything yesterday and has a free day today.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗还在忙那个项目吗？拉拉：没有，他昨天就全部做完了，今天有一天空闲。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗还在忙那个项目吗？
messages.en: Is Pawlu still working on the project?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ikkompleta kollox ilbieraħ u llum għandu ġurnata libera.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ikkompleta kollox ilbieraħ u llum għandu ġurnata libera.
messages.zh: 没有，他昨天就全部做完了，今天有一天空闲。
messages.en: No, he finished everything yesterday and has a free day today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象任务清单上的方框全部打勾：ikkompleta 就是做完、完成，可与英语 complete 一起联想记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a blue colour like that of a clear sky.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呈现晴朗天空般蓝色的；天蓝色的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu kulur blu bħal dak tas-sema ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天蓝色的；像晴朗天空那样蓝的。

formal.mt: Għall-purtieri tas-sala ntgħażel drapp ikħal nir biex il-kamra tidher aktar imdawla.
formal.en: Sky-blue fabric was chosen for the hall curtains to make the room look brighter.
formal.zh: 大厅的窗帘选用了天蓝色布料，让房间显得更加明亮。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema kulur trid għall-ħajt? Pawlu: Irrid kulur ikħal nir, bħal dak tas-sema.
colloquial.en: Lara: What colour do you want for the wall? Pawlu: I want a sky-blue colour, like the sky.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你想把墙刷成什么颜色？保罗：我想要天蓝色，就像天空的颜色。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你想把墙刷成什么颜色？
messages.en: What colour do you want for the wall?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrid kulur ikħal nir, bħal dak tas-sema.
messages.mt_standard: Irrid kulur ikħal nir, bħal dak tas-sema.
messages.zh: 我想要天蓝色，就像天空的颜色。
messages.en: I want a sky-blue colour, like the sky.

cognitive_memory_aid: 抬头想象晴朗天空，再把整组 ikħal nir 当作一个颜色标签记住：天蓝色。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An emotional exclamation expressing surprise, shock, frustration, or anger, like 'oh my God' or 'God damn'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达惊讶、震惊、懊恼或愤怒的感叹语，相当于“天哪”或“该死”，具体语气取决于情境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għajta li tesprimi sorpriża, xokk, dwejjaq jew rabja, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天哪！；该死！用于表达强烈的惊讶、震惊、懊恼或愤怒。

formal.mt: Fid-djalogu tar-rakkont, il-karattru jgħajjat: "Il-Alla! Il-bieb ingħalaq u ċ-ċwievet baqgħu ġewwa."
formal.en: In the story's dialogue, the character cries out: "Oh my God! The door has shut and the keys are still inside."
formal.zh: 在故事的对话中，人物喊道：“天哪！门关上了，钥匙还在里面。”

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-Alla! Erġajt insejt iċ-ċwievet id-dar. Maja: Tinkwetax, għandi ċavetta oħra.
colloquial.en: Mark: Damn! I left the keys at home again. Maja: Don't worry, I have another key.
colloquial.zh: 马克：该死！我又把钥匙忘在家里了。玛雅：别担心，我还有一把钥匙。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 该死！我又把钥匙忘在家里了。
messages.en: Damn! I left the keys at home again.

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 别担心，我还有一把钥匙。
messages.en: Don't worry, I have another key.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象发现钥匙被锁在屋里时脱口而出的惊呼；用语气区分“天哪”的惊讶与“该死”的懊恼。

gloss_zh: 伊尔马卢巴（马耳他南部地名）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a place in the south of Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他南部一处地方的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem ta' post fin-Nofsinhar ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: place in the south of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他南部的一处地方，名为伊尔马卢巴。

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-ħarġa jinkludi żjara fil-Maqluba, fin-Nofsinhar ta' Malta.
formal.en: The outing programme includes a visit to Il-Maqluba, in the south of Malta.
formal.zh: 这次出游的行程包括参观位于马耳他南部的伊尔马卢巴。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sejrin għada? Mark: Se mmorru l-Maqluba. Trid tiġi magħna?
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are we going tomorrow? Mark: We are going to Il-Maqluba. Would you like to come with us?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：明天我们去哪里？马克：我们去伊尔马卢巴。你想和我们一起去吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 明天我们去哪里？
messages.en: Where are we going tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmorru l-Maqluba. Trid tiġi magħna?
messages.mt_standard: Se mmorru l-Maqluba. Trid tiġi magħna?
messages.zh: 我们去伊尔马卢巴。你想和我们一起去吗？
messages.en: We are going to Il-Maqluba. Would you like to come with us?

cognitive_memory_aid: 在马耳他地图南部画一个写着 Il-Maqluba 的地点标记，把名称与南部位置一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A greeting used to wish someone a happy Christmas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在圣诞节期间祝愿他人节日快乐时使用的问候语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tislima li tintuża biex tawgura Milied hieni lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣诞快乐；用于表达圣诞祝福的问候语。

collocations.mt: Il-Milied it-Tajjeb lilek u lill-familja tiegħek!
collocations.en: Merry Christmas to you and your family!

formal.mt: Għeżież kollegi, nawguralkom il-Milied it-Tajjeb u nirringrazzjakom tal-ħidma tagħkom.
formal.en: Dear colleagues, I wish you a Merry Christmas and thank you for your work.
formal.zh: 亲爱的同事们，祝大家圣诞快乐，并感谢大家的工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-Milied it-Tajjeb, Mark! Mark: Grazzi, Maja! Il-Milied it-Tajjeb lilek ukoll!
colloquial.en: Maja: Merry Christmas, Mark! Mark: Thank you, Maja! Merry Christmas to you too!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克，圣诞快乐！马克：谢谢你，玛雅！也祝你圣诞快乐！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克，圣诞快乐！
messages.en: Merry Christmas, Mark!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi, Maja! Il-Milied it-Tajjeb lilek ukoll!
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi, Maja! Il-Milied it-Tajjeb lilek ukoll!
messages.zh: 谢谢你，玛雅！也祝你圣诞快乐！
messages.en: Thank you, Maja! Merry Christmas to you too!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 il-Milied it-Tajjeb 整句写在圣诞贺卡上，每次想说“圣诞快乐”就完整读一遍。

gloss_zh: 伊尔米斯特拉（圣保罗湾附近的海湾名）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of an inlet near St. Paul's Bay.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于圣保罗湾附近的一处海湾的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem ta' daħla tal-baħar qrib il-Bajja ta' San Pawl.

sense_translations.en_definition: (toponymy) The name of an inlet near St. Paul's Bay
sense_translations.zh_definition: （地名）圣保罗湾附近一处海湾的名称：伊尔米斯特拉。

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi l-Mistra, daħla tal-baħar qrib il-Bajja ta' San Pawl.
formal.en: The map shows Il-Mistra, an inlet near St. Paul's Bay.
formal.zh: 地图标出了伊尔米斯特拉，即圣保罗湾附近的一处海湾。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Immorru mixja fil-Mistra? Mark: Iva! Hija qrib il-Bajja ta' San Pawl, hux?
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we go for a walk in Il-Mistra? Mark: Yes! It is near St. Paul's Bay, isn't it?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们去伊尔米斯特拉散步好吗？马克：好啊！那里就在圣保罗湾附近，对吧？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们去伊尔米斯特拉散步好吗？
messages.en: Shall we go for a walk in Il-Mistra?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Hija qrib il-Bajja ta' San Pawl, hux?
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Hija qrib il-Bajja ta' San Pawl, hux?
messages.zh: 好啊！那里就在圣保罗湾附近，对吧？
messages.en: Yes! It is near St. Paul's Bay, isn't it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 在圣保罗湾旁画一个小海湾并标上 Il-Mistra，用“附近的海湾”这幅地图画面记住地名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a village in Gozo.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蒙沙尔，戈佐岛上的一个村庄名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' raħal f'Għawdex.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 戈佐岛上的村庄蒙沙尔。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Raħal f'Għawdex.

formal.mt: Il-programm taż-żjara jinkludi waqfa fil-Munxar, raħal f'Għawdex.
formal.en: The visit programme includes a stop in Il-Munxar, a village in Gozo.
formal.zh: 参观行程包括在戈佐岛的蒙沙尔村停留。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sejrin illum? Mark: Se mmorru l-Munxar, f'Għawdex.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are we going today? Mark: We're going to Il-Munxar, in Gozo.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们今天去哪里？马克：我们去戈佐岛的蒙沙尔。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们今天去哪里？
messages.en: Where are we going today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们去戈佐岛的蒙沙尔。
messages.en: We're going to Il-Munxar, in Gozo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把蒙沙尔放进“戈佐岛村庄”这张记忆卡；连读 żjara fil-Munxar，记住地名在短语中的样子。

gloss_zh: 愿平安与你们同在（弥撒中的问候语）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A greeting meaning 'peace be upon you', synonymous with is-sliem għalikom and used mainly by priests during Catholic Mass.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 意为“愿平安与你们同在”的问候语，与 is-sliem għalikom 同义，主要由神父在天主教弥撒中使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tislima li tfisser li wieħed jixtieq il-paċi lil dawk li qed ikellem; għandha l-istess tifsira bħal is-sliem għalikom u tintuża l-aktar mis-saċerdoti waqt il-quddiesa Kattolika.

sense_translations.en_definition: synonym of is-sliem għalikom: peace be upon you (mostly used during Catholic masses by priests to greet)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与 is-sliem għalikom 同义：愿平安与你们同在；主要是神父在天主教弥撒中使用的问候语。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tislima bl-istess tifsira bħal is-sliem għalikom, użata l-aktar mis-saċerdoti waqt il-quddiesa Kattolika.

collocations.zh: “愿平安与你们同在”这句问候语

formal.mt: Waqt il-quddiesa Kattolika, is-saċerdot isellem lill-kongregazzjoni bil-kliem 'Il-paċi magħkom'.
formal.en: During Catholic Mass, the priest greets the congregation with the words 'Peace be upon you'.
formal.zh: 在天主教弥撒中，神父用“愿平安与你们同在”这句话向会众致意。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qal is-saċerdot? Pawlu: Qal 'Il-paċi magħkom'. Hija tislima.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did the priest say? Pawlu: He said 'Peace be upon you'. It's a greeting.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：神父刚才说了什么？保罗：他说“愿平安与你们同在”。这是一句问候语。

messages.speaker: Lara (学习者)
messages.zh: 神父刚才说了什么？
messages.en: What did the priest say?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 他说“愿平安与你们同在”。这是一句问候语。
messages.en: He said 'Peace be upon you'. It's a greeting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象神父面向会众致意，把整句 il-paċi magħkom 与“愿平安与你们同在”的场景一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 奥拉（马耳他北部沿海地名）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a place on the coast towards the north of Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 奥拉，马耳他偏北部的一处沿海地点的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' post fuq il-kosta lejn it-tramuntana ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: place on the coast towards the north of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他偏北部沿海的地点奥拉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post fuq il-kosta lejn it-tramuntana ta' Malta.

formal.mt: Il-grupp se jżur il-Qawra, post fuq il-kosta lejn it-tramuntana ta' Malta.
formal.en: The group will visit Il-Qawra, a place on the coast towards the north of Malta.
formal.zh: 团队将参观奥拉，即马耳他偏北部的一处沿海地点。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn trid tmur timxi? Toni: Fil-Qawra. Nixtieq nimxi ħdejn il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where would you like to go for a walk? Toni: In Il-Qawra. I'd like to walk by the sea.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你想去哪里散步？托尼：去奥拉。我想在海边走走。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想去哪里散步？
messages.en: Where would you like to go for a walk?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 去奥拉。我想在海边走走。
messages.en: In Il-Qawra. I'd like to walk by the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“马耳他偏北、沿海散步”两个画面记住奥拉；再配读 fil-Qawra，把地点与常用短语一起记牢。

gloss_zh: 克巴亚尔（戈佐岛马尔萨尔福恩附近的海湾）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of an inlet near Marsalforn in Gozo.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 克巴亚尔，戈佐岛马尔萨尔福恩附近的一处小海湾名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' daħla tal-baħar qrib Marsalforn, f'Għawdex.

sense_translations.en_definition: name of an inlet in the neighbourhood of marsalforn, gozo
sense_translations.zh_definition: 戈佐岛马尔萨尔福恩附近一处小海湾的名称：克巴亚尔。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem ta' daħla tal-baħar fl-inħawi ta' Marsalforn, f'Għawdex.

collocations.zh: 在克巴亚尔的一次停留

formal.mt: L-itinerarju jinkludi waqfa fil-Qbajjar, daħla tal-baħar qrib Marsalforn, f'Għawdex.
formal.en: The itinerary includes a stop at Il-Qbajjar, an inlet near Marsalforn in Gozo.
formal.zh: 行程包括在克巴亚尔停留，这是戈佐岛马尔萨尔福恩附近的一处小海湾。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hu l-Qbajjar? Ġorġ: Qrib Marsalforn, f'Għawdex. Trid immorru narawh?
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is Il-Qbajjar? Ġorġ: Near Marsalforn, in Gozo. Shall we go and see it?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：克巴亚尔在哪里？乔治：在戈佐岛，靠近马尔萨尔福恩。我们去看看好吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (游客)
messages.zh: 克巴亚尔在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Il-Qbajjar?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qrib Marsalforn, f'Għawdex. Trid immorru narawh?
messages.mt_standard: Qrib Marsalforn, f'Għawdex. Trid immorru narawh?
messages.zh: 在戈佐岛，靠近马尔萨尔福恩。我们去看看好吗？
messages.en: Near Marsalforn, in Gozo. Shall we go and see it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“戈佐岛—马尔萨尔福恩附近—小海湾”三层定位来记克巴亚尔，把地名放进一幅海湾位置图。

gloss_zh: 瓦尔迪亚（马耳他及戈佐岛多处高地或地点的名称）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place name referring to an area 107 metres above sea level near St. Paul's Bay in Malta, a height west of Ta' Kerċem in Gozo, or a place within the limits of Dwejra known as Ras il-Wardija.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 瓦尔迪亚这一地名可指马耳他圣保罗湾附近海拔107米的高地区域、戈佐岛 Ta' Kerċem 以西的一处高地，或德韦伊拉范围内称为 Ras il-Wardija 的地点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' żona fuq għolja 107 metri 'l fuq mil-livell tal-baħar qrib San Pawl il-Baħar f'Malta; ta' għolja fil-punent ta' Ta' Kerċem f'Għawdex; jew ta' post fil-limiti tad-Dwejra magħruf bħala Ras il-Wardija.

sense_translations.en_definition: (toponymy) Il-Wardija, name of an area on a height 107 metres (350 feet) from sea level in the neighbourhood of St. Paul's Bay (Malta); name of a height west of Ta' Kerċem, Gozo; place in the limits of Dwejra actually known as Ras il-Wardija
sense_translations.zh_definition: （地名）瓦尔迪亚：马耳他圣保罗湾附近海拔107米（350英尺）高地上的区域名称；也指戈佐岛 Ta' Kerċem 以西的一处高地；还指德韦伊拉范围内实际称为 Ras il-Wardija 的地点。

collocations.zh: 圣保罗湾附近的瓦尔迪亚

collocations.mt: l-għolja tal-Wardija fil-punent ta' Ta' Kerċem
collocations.en: the height of Il-Wardija west of Ta' Kerċem
collocations.zh: Ta' Kerċem 以西的瓦尔迪亚高地

formal.mt: Il-Wardija qrib San Pawl il-Baħar tinsab fuq għolja 107 metri 'l fuq mil-livell tal-baħar.
formal.en: Il-Wardija near St. Paul's Bay lies on a height 107 metres above sea level.
formal.zh: 圣保罗湾附近的瓦尔迪亚位于海拔107米的高地上。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Meta tgħid il-Wardija, liema post qed issemmi? David: Il-Wardija qrib San Pawl il-Baħar, f'Malta.
colloquial.en: Anna: When you say Il-Wardija, which place do you mean? David: Il-Wardija near St. Paul's Bay, in Malta.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你说瓦尔迪亚时，指的是哪个地方？戴维：马耳他圣保罗湾附近的瓦尔迪亚。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tgħid il-Wardija, liema post qed issemmi?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tgħid il-Wardija, liema post qed issemmi?
messages.zh: 你说瓦尔迪亚时，指的是哪个地方？
messages.en: When you say Il-Wardija, which place do you mean?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-Wardija qrib San Pawl il-Baħar, f'Malta.
messages.mt_standard: Il-Wardija qrib San Pawl il-Baħar, f'Malta.
messages.zh: 马耳他圣保罗湾附近的瓦尔迪亚。
messages.en: Il-Wardija near St. Paul's Bay, in Malta.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给瓦尔迪亚制作三张地点卡：圣保罗湾附近107米高地、Ta' Kerċem 以西高地、德韦伊拉的 Ras il-Wardija，借附近地名区分所指。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of the international organisation known in English as the United Nations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 国际组织“联合国”的马耳他语名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem tal-organizzazzjoni internazzjonali magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala l-United Nations.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 联合国，国际组织名称。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tal-Ġnus Magħquda ġie diskuss waqt il-laqgħa dwar il-kooperazzjoni internazzjonali.
formal.en: The United Nations report was discussed at the meeting on international cooperation.
formal.zh: 与会者在关于国际合作的会议上讨论了联合国的报告。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fuq xiex se tagħmel il-preżentazzjoni? Mark: Fuq il-Ġnus Magħquda; sibt rapport interessanti biex nużah fil-klassi.
colloquial.en: Nina: What will your presentation be about? Mark: The United Nations; I found an interesting report to use in class.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你准备做什么主题的课堂报告？马克：联合国；我找到了一份有意思的报告，可以在课堂上使用。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你准备做什么主题的课堂报告？
messages.en: What will your presentation be about?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-Ġnus Magħquda; sibt rapport interessanti biex nużah fil-klassi.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-Ġnus Magħquda; sibt rapport interessanti biex nużah fil-klassi.
messages.zh: 联合国；我找到了一份有意思的报告，可以在课堂上使用。
messages.en: The United Nations; I found an interesting report to use in class.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Il-Ġnus Magħquda、United Nations 和“联合国”并排写在同一张词卡上，配上国际会议的画面，整组记忆。

gloss_zh: 衣服；衣着（lbies 的另一形式）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Clothing or attire; an alternative basic form of lbies, also used after a consonant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 衣服、衣着；是 lbies 的另一基本形式，也用于辅音之后。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dak li jintlibes; forma bażika alternattiva ta' lbies, li tintuża wkoll wara konsonanti.

sense_translations.en_definition: post-consonantal and alternative basic form of lbies
sense_translations.zh_definition: lbies 的辅音后形式及另一基本形式，表示衣服、衣着。

formal.mt: L-ilbies tax-xogħol għandu jinżamm nadif u adattat għall-kompiti ta' kuljum.
formal.en: Work clothing should be kept clean and suitable for everyday tasks.
formal.zh: 工作服应保持干净，并适合日常工作任务。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għandi nġib miegħi għall-vjaġġ? Sara: Ilbies komdu u ġakketta, għax filgħaxija jista' jagħmel il-bard.
colloquial.en: Lara: What should I bring for the trip? Sara: Comfortable clothes and a jacket, because it may get cold in the evening.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：旅行时我该带些什么？萨拉：舒适的衣服和一件夹克，因为晚上可能会冷。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 旅行时我该带些什么？
messages.en: What should I bring for the trip?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ilbies komdu u ġakketta, għax filgħaxija jista' jagħmel il-bard.
messages.mt_standard: Ilbies komdu u ġakketta, għax filgħaxija jista' jagħmel il-bard.
messages.zh: 舒适的衣服和一件夹克，因为晚上可能会冷。
messages.en: Comfortable clothes and a jacket, because it may get cold in the evening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ilbies 和 lbies 写在同一张衣柜词卡上：两种形式关联同一个衣着概念，开头多出的 i 不另算一个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to believe something false or to have misleading hopes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人相信不真实的事情，或使其抱有不切实际的希望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jemmen xi ħaġa falza jew ikollu tama qarrieqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蒙骗；使某人产生错误的信念或虚假的希望。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif il-bejjiegħ illuda lill-klijent bi wegħdiet li ma setax iżomm.
formal.en: The report explains how the seller deluded the customer with promises he could not keep.
formal.zh: 报告说明了卖方如何用无法兑现的承诺蒙骗顾客。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex emmintu? Lara: Illuda lili wkoll; qalli li kollox kien lest.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did you believe him? Lara: He deluded me too; he told me everything was ready.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你为什么相信他？拉拉：他也蒙骗了我，说一切都准备好了。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么相信他？
messages.en: Why did you believe him?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illuda lili wkoll; qalli li kollox kien lest.
messages.mt_standard: Illuda lili wkoll; qalli li kollox kien lest.
messages.zh: 他也蒙骗了我，说一切都准备好了。
