messages.en: He deluded me too; he told me everything was ready.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 illuda 配上“虚假承诺让人信以为真”的画面；重点记住这是使人受骗的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Holding a false belief or an unrealistic hope because one has been misled.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因受到误导而相信错误的事情，或抱有不切实际的希望的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jemmen xi ħaġa falza jew għandu tama qarrieqa għax ġie mqarraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受蒙骗的；因错误认识而抱有幻想的。

formal.mt: L-investitur baqa' illuż bil-wegħdiet tal-kumpanija, minkejja t-twissijiet.
formal.en: The investor remained deluded by the company's promises, despite the warnings.
formal.zh: 尽管已有警告，这名投资者仍被公司的承诺蒙骗。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għadek taħseb li se jħallas illum? Mark: Le, kont illuż. Issa naf li ma nistax noqgħod fuq il-wegħdiet tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you still think he will pay today? Mark: No, I was deluded. Now I know I cannot rely on his promises.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你还觉得他今天会付款吗？马克：不，我之前抱有错觉。现在我知道不能相信他的承诺。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek taħseb li se jħallas illum?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek taħseb li se jħallas illum?
messages.zh: 你还觉得他今天会付款吗？
messages.en: Do you still think he will pay today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kont illuż. Issa naf li ma nistax noqgħod fuq il-wegħdiet tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kont illuż. Issa naf li ma nistax noqgħod fuq il-wegħdiet tiegħu.
messages.zh: 不，我之前抱有错觉。现在我知道不能相信他的承诺。
messages.en: No, I was deluded. Now I know I cannot rely on his promises.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 illuż 记成受骗者头顶的状态标签：“我还以为是真的。”它描述人的错误信念。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Seeming real or achievable when it is actually false or misleading.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面上显得真实或能够实现，实际上却虚假或具有误导性的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jidher reali jew possibbli, iżda fil-fatt huwa falz jew qarrieqi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 虚幻的；仅在表象中存在、容易使人误信为真的。

formal.mt: Il-vantaġġ finanzjarju kien illużorju, għax l-ispejjeż żejda kienu ogħla mill-iffrankar.
formal.en: The financial advantage was illusory because the additional costs exceeded the savings.
formal.zh: 这项经济优势只是表象，因为额外费用超过了节省的金额。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan ir-roħs veru tajjeb? Mark: Il-vantaġġ hu illużorju; bit-twassil, tħallas l-istess.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this discount really good? Mark: The advantage is illusory; with delivery, you pay the same.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个折扣真的划算吗？马克：优惠只是表象；算上运费，付的钱还是一样。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个折扣真的划算吗？
messages.en: Is this discount really good?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-vantaġġ hu illużorju; bit-twassil, tħallas l-istess.
messages.mt_standard: Il-vantaġġ hu illużorju; bit-twassil, tħallas l-istess.
messages.zh: 优惠只是表象；算上运费，付的钱还是一样。
messages.en: The advantage is illusory; with delivery, you pay the same.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象标价降了、总价却没降的折扣：看起来有优势，实际没有，就是 illużorju。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Water found beneath the surface of the ground.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 存在于地表以下的水。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilma li jinsab taħt wiċċ l-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地下水，即存在于地表以下的水。

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina l-kwalità tal-ilma tal-pjan u l-bidliet fil-livell tiegħu.
formal.en: The study examines groundwater quality and changes in its level.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察地下水水质及其水位变化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn ġej dan l-ilma fil-bir? Pawlu: Huwa ilma tal-pjan, ilma li jinsab taħt l-art.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where does this water in the well come from? Pawlu: It is groundwater, water found beneath the ground.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：井里的这些水是从哪里来的？保罗：这是地下水，就是地面以下的水。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn ġej dan l-ilma fil-bir?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn ġej dan l-ilma fil-bir?
messages.zh: 井里的这些水是从哪里来的？
messages.en: Where does this water in the well come from?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa ilma tal-pjan, ilma li jinsab taħt l-art.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa ilma tal-pjan, ilma li jinsab taħt l-art.
messages.zh: 这是地下水，就是地面以下的水。
messages.en: It is groundwater, water found beneath the ground.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条地面线，把 ilma tal-pjan 写在线下的水层旁；整组词一起记作“地下水”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fragrant water made from orange blossoms, used to flavour food or drinks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用橙花制成的芳香水，可用于给食物或饮品增添香味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilma mfewwaħ magħmul mill-fjuri tal-larinġ, użat biex jagħti togħma lill-ikel jew lix-xorb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 橙花水；以橙花制成的芳香水。

collocations.en: a few drops of orange flower water
a bottle of orange flower water

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob li jiżdiedu ftit qtar ta' ilma żahar mat-taħlita.
formal.en: The recipe calls for a few drops of orange flower water to be added to the mixture.
formal.zh: 食谱要求在混合物中加入几滴橙花水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi din ir-riħa sabiħa fil-ħelu? Omm: Żidt ftit ilma żahar.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this lovely scent in the dessert? Mum: I added a little orange flower water.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：甜点里这股好闻的香味是什么？妈妈：我加了一点橙花水。

messages.speaker: Maja (女儿)
messages.zh: 甜点里这股好闻的香味是什么？
messages.en: What is this lovely scent in the dessert?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 我加了一点橙花水。
messages.en: I added a little orange flower water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象往甜点里滴入几滴带橙花香的水，把 ilma żahar 与小瓶、滴管和花香一起记住。

gloss_zh: lsien 的辅音后形式及另一基本形式

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form of the noun lsien used after a consonant, and also an alternative basic form of that noun.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 名词 lsien 在辅音后使用的形式，也可作为该名词的另一基本形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma tan-nom lsien li tintuża wara konsonanti u li tintuża wkoll bħala forma bażika alternattiva.

sense_translations.en_definition: post-consonantal and alternative basic form of lsien
sense_translations.zh_definition: lsien 在辅音后使用的形式，同时也是其另一基本形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Forma ta' lsien li tintuża wara konsonanti, kif ukoll forma bażika alternattiva.

formal.mt: Il-forma 'ilsien' tintuża wara konsonanti u hija wkoll forma bażika alternattiva ta' 'lsien'.
formal.en: The form 'ilsien' is used after a consonant and is also an alternative basic form of 'lsien'.
formal.zh: ilsien 这一形式用于辅音之后，同时也是 lsien 的另一基本形式。

colloquial.mt: Mei: Hawn miktub 'ilsien'. Għandu rabta ma' 'lsien'? Rita: Iva, hija forma ta' 'lsien' li tintuża wara konsonanti, u tintuża wkoll bħala forma bażika alternattiva.
colloquial.en: Mei: It says 'ilsien' here. Is it related to 'lsien'? Rita: Yes, it's a form of 'lsien' used after a consonant, and it's also used as an alternative basic form.
colloquial.zh: 梅：这里写的是 ilsien。它和 lsien 有关系吗？丽塔：有，它是 lsien 在辅音后使用的形式，也用作另一基本形式。

messages.speaker: Mei (学生)
messages.zh: 这里写的是 ilsien。它和 lsien 有关系吗？
messages.en: It says 'ilsien' here. Is it related to 'lsien'?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hija forma ta' 'lsien' li tintuża wara konsonanti, u tintuża wkoll bħala forma bażika alternattiva.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hija forma ta' 'lsien' li tintuża wara konsonanti, u tintuża wkoll bħala forma bażika alternattiva.
messages.zh: 有，它是 lsien 在辅音后使用的形式，也用作另一基本形式。
messages.en: Yes, it's a form of 'lsien' used after a consonant, and it's also used as an alternative basic form.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lsien 与 ilsien 并排写，圈出后者开头的 i，再标注“辅音后形式，也可作另一基本形式”。

gloss_zh: lħit 的辅音后形式及另一基本形式

teaching_sense.en_definition: An alternative basic form of the noun lħit, also used after a consonant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 名词 lħit 的另一基本形式，也用于辅音之后；本条说明两种词形之间的关系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma bażika alternattiva tan-nom lħit, li tintuża wkoll wara konsonanti.

sense_translations.en_definition: post-consonantal and alternative basic form of lħit
sense_translations.zh_definition: 名词 lħit 的辅音后形式及另一基本形式。

collocations.en: the use of "ilħit" after a consonant
collocations.zh: ilħit 在辅音之后的使用

formal.mt: F'din il-lezzjoni, "ilħit" jiġi ppreżentat bħala forma bażika alternattiva ta' "lħit" u bħala forma li tintuża wara konsonanti.
formal.en: In this lesson, "ilħit" is presented as an alternative basic form of "lħit" and as a form used after a consonant.
formal.zh: 本课将 ilħit 介绍为 lħit 的另一基本形式，以及用于辅音之后的形式。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' nuża "ilħit" bħala forma bażika? Rita: Iva, hija forma bażika alternattiva ta' "lħit" u tintuża wkoll wara konsonanti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I use "ilħit" as a basic form? Rita: Yes, it is an alternative basic form of "lħit" and is also used after a consonant.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我可以把 ilħit 用作基本形式吗？丽塔：可以，它是 lħit 的另一基本形式，也用于辅音之后。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 我可以把 ilħit 用作基本形式吗？
messages.en: Can I use "ilħit" as a basic form?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hija forma bażika alternattiva ta' "lħit" u tintuża wkoll wara konsonanti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hija forma bażika alternattiva ta' "lħit" u tintuża wkoll wara konsonanti.
messages.zh: 可以，它是 lħit 的另一基本形式，也用于辅音之后。
messages.en: Yes, it is an alternative basic form of "lħit" and is also used after a consonant.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 lħit 与 ilħit 并排抄写，圈出第二种形式开头的 i，并标注“辅音后形式，也可作另一基本形式”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An emirate: a territory or state ruled by an emir.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 酋长国或埃米尔国，即由埃米尔统治的领地或国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Territorju jew stat immexxi minn emir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 酋长国；埃米尔国，即由埃米尔统治的领地或国家。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Territorju jew stat immexxi minn emir.

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi l-imara bħala territorju mmexxi minn emir.
formal.en: The text describes the emirate as a territory ruled by an emir.
formal.zh: 这篇文字将酋长国描述为由埃米尔统治的领地。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi tfisser 'imara' f'dan it-test? Samwel: Territorju jew stat immexxi minn emir.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does 'imara' mean in this text? Samwel: A territory or state ruled by an emir.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这篇文字里的 imara 是什么意思？萨姆韦尔：由埃米尔统治的领地或国家。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文字里的 imara 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'imara' mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Samwel (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Territorju jew stat immexxi minn emir.
messages.mt_standard: Territorju jew stat immexxi minn emir.
messages.zh: 由埃米尔统治的领地或国家。
messages.en: A territory or state ruled by an emir.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一块领地并写上“埃米尔统治”，在地图下标注 imara，用“统治者与领地”的画面记住酋长国。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling fear; afraid of something or of what may happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到害怕或恐惧的，担心某事物或可能发生的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħoss il-biża' minn xi ħaġa jew minn dak li jista' jiġri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 害怕的；感到恐惧的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jħoss il-biża'.

formal.mt: It-tifel kien imbeżża' mill-ħoss qawwi u talab l-għajnuna tal-għalliem.
formal.en: The boy was afraid of the loud noise and asked the teacher for help.
formal.zh: 男孩害怕那巨大的声响，于是向老师求助。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Jien imbeżża' mill-ħoss. Tista' tibqa' hawn? Marija: Iva, se nibqa' hawn miegħek.
colloquial.en: Ben: I'm afraid of the noise. Can you stay here? Marija: Yes, I'll stay here with you.
colloquial.zh: 本：我害怕那声音。你能留在这里吗？玛丽亚：可以，我会留在这里陪你。

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien imbeżża' mill-ħoss. Tista' tibqa' hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Jien imbeżża' mill-ħoss. Tista' tibqa' hawn?
messages.zh: 我害怕那声音。你能留在这里吗？
messages.en: I'm afraid of the noise. Can you stay here?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 可以，我会留在这里陪你。
messages.en: Yes, I'll stay here with you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象男孩听到巨响后说 Jien imbeżża'，把表情与“我害怕”一起记；书写时保留词尾的撇号。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pile of things, or something filled beyond its capacity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 堆在一起的一堆东西，也可指装得过满的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Munzell ta' affarijiet, jew xi ħaġa mimlija żżejjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一堆；堆积在一起的东西。
装得过满的东西。

formal.mt: L-imburġatura ta' karti fuq l-iskrivanija trid titneħħa qabel il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The pile of papers on the desk must be removed before the meeting.
formal.zh: 开会前必须清走书桌上的那堆纸。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'inhi dik l-imburġatura fuq is-siġġu? Pawlu: Dawk huma l-ħwejjeġ tiegħi; se nqegħedhom fl-armarju.
colloquial.en: Rita: What's that pile on the chair? Pawlu: Those are my clothes; I'll put them in the wardrobe.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：椅子上那一堆是什么？保罗：那是我的衣服，我这就把它们放进衣柜。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 椅子上那一堆是什么？
messages.en: What's that pile on the chair?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawk huma l-ħwejjeġ tiegħi; se nqegħedhom fl-armarju.
messages.mt_standard: Dawk huma l-ħwejjeġ tiegħi; se nqegħedhom fl-armarju.
messages.zh: 那是我的衣服，我这就把它们放进衣柜。
messages.en: Those are my clothes; I'll put them in the wardrobe.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象椅子上的衣服越堆越高，再想象箱子被塞得过满，用这两个画面记住“一堆”和“过满之物”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of pushing someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用力推动某人或某物的一下动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li timbotta lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一下推；一次推动或推搡。

formal.mt: Il-bieb infetaħ wara imbuttata qawwija.
formal.en: The door opened after a strong push.
formal.zh: 用力推了一下后，门打开了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-bieb ma jridx jinfetaħ. Mark: Agħtih imbuttata żgħira.
colloquial.en: Maja: The door won't open. Mark: Give it a little push.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这门打不开。马克：轻轻推它一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这门打不开。
messages.en: The door won't open.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 轻轻推它一下。
messages.en: Give it a little push.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一次手掌向前推门的动作定格，记住 imbuttata 是名词“一下推”，可搭配“给一下推”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A push applied to a person or an object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对人或物施加的一次推动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spinta mogħtija lil persuna jew lil oġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次推动；一下推。

formal.mt: Il-karru beda jiċċaqlaq wara imbuttatura ħafifa.
formal.en: The cart began to move after a gentle push.
formal.zh: 轻轻推了一下后，小车开始移动。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tista' tagħti imbuttatura lill-karru? Toni: Iva, inti żomm il-manku.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you give the cart a push? Toni: Yes, you hold the handle.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你能推一下小车吗？托尼：可以，你扶住把手。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你能推一下小车吗？
messages.en: Can you give the cart a push?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.zh: 可以，你扶住把手。
messages.en: Yes, you hold the handle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象静止的小车被轻推一下就动起来，把 imbuttatura 和“一次推动”连在一起；本组中它与 imbuttata 都可表示推一下。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be broken or damaged; the post-consonantal and alternative basic form of mkisser.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于破碎或损坏的状态；是 mkisser 的辅音后形式及另一基本形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun miksur jew bil-ħsara; il-forma ta' mkisser wara konsonanti u forma bażika alternattiva tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: post-consonantal and alternative basic form of mkisser
sense_translations.zh_definition: mkisser（表示破碎、损坏状态）的辅音后形式及另一基本形式。

collocations.zh: 当时是坏的；当时已破损

formal.mt: It-tagħmir instab imkisser waqt l-ispezzjoni.
formal.en: The equipment was found broken during the inspection.
formal.zh: 检查时发现设备已经损坏。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex ma ċempiltlix? David: It-telefon kien imkisser.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why didn't you call me? David: The phone was broken.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你为什么没给我打电话？戴维：电话坏了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么没给我打电话？
messages.en: Why didn't you call me?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 电话坏了。
messages.en: The phone was broken.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一部摔坏的电话，整句记住 kien imkisser“当时坏了”，再把 imkisser 与 mkisser 配对识记。

gloss_zh: 年代久远而超出记忆的；远古的

teaching_sense.en_definition: So far in the past that its beginning is beyond living memory.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 年代久远到无人记得其开端的，常用于描述极久远的时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tant antik li ħadd ma jiftakar il-bidu tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 年代久远而超出人们记忆的；远古的。

collocations.zh: 久远得无人记得的年代

formal.mt: Din id-drawwa ilha teżisti minn żmien immemorabbli.
formal.en: This custom has existed since time immemorial.
formal.zh: 这一习俗自远古以来就已存在。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kemm ilha ssir din il-festa? Ġużeppi: Minn żmien immemorabbli, hekk jgħidu hawn.
colloquial.en: Marija: How long has this festival been held? Ġużeppi: Since time immemorial, or so people here say.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：这个节庆已经办了多久？朱塞佩：这里的人说，自远古以来就有了。

messages.speaker: Marija (游客)
messages.zh: 这个节庆已经办了多久？
messages.en: How long has this festival been held?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (当地居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn żmien immemorabbli, hekk jgħidu hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Minn żmien immemorabbli, hekk jgħidu hawn.
messages.zh: 这里的人说，自远古以来就有了。
messages.en: Since time immemorial, or so people here say.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象时间轴向过去延伸，直到任何人的记忆都够不到；把整组 minn żmien immemorabbli 记作“自远古以来”。

gloss_zh: 不可修改的；无法改动的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unable to be modified or changed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不能被修改或改动的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jistax jiġi modifikat jew mibdul.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不可修改的；无法改动的。

formal.mt: Il-fajl finali huwa immodifikabbli u jista' jinqara biss.
formal.en: The final file is unmodifiable and can only be read.
formal.zh: 最终文件不可修改，只能读取。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nista' nbiddel dan it-test? Elena: Le, dan it-test huwa immodifikabbli.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can I change this text? Elena: No, this text is unmodifiable.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我能改这段文字吗？埃莱娜：不能，这段文字不可修改。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 我能改这段文字吗？
messages.en: Can I change this text?

messages.speaker: Elena (同事)
messages.zh: 不能，这段文字不可修改。
messages.en: No, this text is unmodifiable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象文件旁有一把锁，能打开阅读却不能改字，把这个画面与 immodifikabbli“不可修改的”联系起来。

gloss_zh: 摸不着的；难以察觉或捉摸的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unable to be felt by touch, or too subtle to be clearly perceived or described.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 无法用触觉感知的；也指非常细微、难以明确察觉或描述的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jistax jinħass bil-mess, jew li hu tant sottili li diffiċli tinduna bih jew tiddeskrivih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摸不着的；细微得难以察觉或捉摸的。

collocations.zh: 一种难以捉摸的存在感
一种难以明确感知的感觉

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-memorja tad-dar tidher bħala preżenza impalpabbli li takkumpanja lill-karattru prinċipali.
formal.en: In the story, the memory of home appears as an impalpable presence accompanying the main character.
formal.zh: 在故事中，对家的记忆化作一种难以捉摸的存在感，始终伴随着主人公。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif tiddeskrivi l-atmosfera ta' dik id-dar? Luka: Hemm xi ħaġa impalpabbli fiha, sensazzjoni li ma nafx nispjega sew.
colloquial.en: Maja: How would you describe the atmosphere of that house? Luka: There is something impalpable about it, a feeling I cannot quite explain.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你会怎样描述那栋房子的氛围？Luka：里面有种难以捉摸的东西，一种我说不太清的感觉。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif tiddeskrivi l-atmosfera ta' dik id-dar?
messages.mt_standard: Kif tiddeskrivi l-atmosfera ta' dik id-dar?
messages.zh: 你会怎样描述那栋房子的氛围？
messages.en: How would you describe the atmosphere of that house?

messages.speaker: Luka (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm xi ħaġa impalpabbli fiha, sensazzjoni li ma nafx nispjega sew.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm xi ħaġa impalpabbli fiha, sensazzjoni li ma nafx nispjega sew.
messages.zh: 里面有种难以捉摸的东西，一种我说不太清的感觉。
messages.en: There is something impalpable about it, a feeling I cannot quite explain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象伸手去抓房间里的气氛：能感到，却摸不着、说不清。把这个画面与 impalpabbli 联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Treating all sides fairly without favouring one person or group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 公平对待各方，不偏袒任何个人或群体的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jittratta lin-naħat kollha b'mod ġust u ma jiffavorixxi lil ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公正的，不偏不倚的；不受偏见影响的。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ħatar ġudikant imparzjali biex jevalwa l-proposti kollha skont l-istess kriterji.
formal.en: The committee appointed an impartial judge to assess all proposals against the same criteria.
formal.zh: 委员会任命了一位公正的评判者，按照相同标准评估所有提案。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Int taf liż-żewġ timijiet. Tista' tkun ir-referee? Mark: Iva, imma se nkun imparzjali u napplika l-istess regoli għal kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Sara: You know both teams. Can you be the referee? Mark: Yes, but I will be impartial and apply the same rules to everyone.
colloquial.zh: Sara：两支队伍你都认识，你能当裁判吗？Mark：可以，不过我会不偏不倚，对所有人采用相同的规则。

messages.speaker: Sara (队员)
messages.mt_spoken: Int taf liż-żewġ timijiet. Tista' tkun ir-referee?
messages.mt_standard: Int taf liż-żewġ timijiet. Tista' tkun ir-referee?
messages.zh: 两支队伍你都认识，你能当裁判吗？
messages.en: You know both teams. Can you be the referee?

messages.speaker: Mark (裁判)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma se nkun imparzjali u napplika l-istess regoli għal kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma se nkun imparzjali u napplika l-istess regoli għal kulħadd.
messages.zh: 可以，不过我会不偏不倚，对所有人采用相同的规则。
messages.en: Yes, but I will be impartial and apply the same rules to everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imparzjali 配上一幅天平保持水平的画面：两边都公平对待，用来形容公正的人、评判或报告。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of treating all sides fairly without favouritism or bias.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 公平对待各方、不偏袒任何一方的品质或原则。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità li tittratta lin-naħat kollha b'mod ġust, mingħajr favoritiżmu jew preġudizzju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公正；不偏不倚；不偏袒任何一方的品质。

formal.mt: L-imparzjalità tal-kumitat hija essenzjali biex il-pubbliku jkollu fiduċja fil-proċess tal-għażla.
formal.en: The committee's impartiality is essential for public confidence in the selection process.
formal.zh: 委员会的公正性，是公众信任遴选程序的必要条件。

colloquial.mt: Luka: Għaliex għażilt lil Rita biex tiġġudika l-kompetizzjoni? Maja: Għax naf li taħdem b'imparzjalità u tagħti ċans indaqs lil kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Luka: Why did you choose Rita to judge the competition? Maja: Because I know she works with impartiality and gives everyone an equal chance.
colloquial.zh: Luka：你为什么选 Rita 来评判比赛？Maja：因为我知道她做事公正，会给每个人同等的机会。

messages.speaker: Luka (参赛者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għażilt lil Rita biex tiġġudika l-kompetizzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għażilt lil Rita biex tiġġudika l-kompetizzjoni?
messages.zh: 你为什么选 Rita 来评判比赛？
messages.en: Why did you choose Rita to judge the competition?

messages.speaker: Maja (组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax naf li taħdem b'imparzjalità u tagħti ċans indaqs lil kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Għax naf li taħdem b'imparzjalità u tagħti ċans indaqs lil kulħadd.
messages.zh: 因为我知道她做事公正，会给每个人同等的机会。
messages.en: Because I know she works with impartiality and gives everyone an equal chance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一组搭配记词性：imparzjali 是“公正的”，imparzjalità 是“公正”这种品质；想象把公正放进品质清单。

gloss_zh: 无法通行的；阻碍通行的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Impossible to pass through or across, or presenting an obstacle that prevents passage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 无法穿过或通过的；也指形成障碍、阻碍通行的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jistax jingħadda minnu jew li joħloq ostaklu li jwaqqaf il-mogħdija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无法通行的；无法穿过或越过的。
阻碍通行的；使人难以或不愿通过的。

formal.mt: Wara l-maltemp, il-passaġġ lejn ir-raħal sar impassabbli minħabba s-siġar li waqgħu.
formal.en: After the storm, the passage to the village became impassable because of fallen trees.
formal.zh: 暴风雨过后，倒下的树木使通往村庄的通道无法通行。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nistgħu ngħaddu minn hawn? Sara: Le, il-passaġġ impassabbli. Hemm ħajt ta' ġebel imwaqqa' fin-nofs.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can we get through here? Sara: No, the passage is impassable. There is a collapsed stone wall in the middle.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我们能从这里过去吗？Sara：不能，这条通道过不去。中间有一堵倒塌的石墙。

messages.speaker: Mark (徒步者)
messages.zh: 我们能从这里过去吗？
messages.en: Can we get through here?

messages.speaker: Sara (同行者)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-passaġġ impassabbli. Hemm ħajt ta' ġebel imwaqqa' fin-nofs.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-passaġġ impassabbli. Hemm ħajt ta' ġebel imwaqqa' fin-nofs.
messages.zh: 不能，这条通道过不去。中间有一堵倒塌的石墙。
messages.en: No, the passage is impassable. There is a collapsed stone wall in the middle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象通道中央横着一堵倒塌的石墙，脚步只能停下。用 impassabbli 给这个“过不去、阻碍通行”的画面贴标签。

gloss_zh: 不可通行性；无法通过的状态

teaching_sense.en_definition: The condition of a route or passage being impossible to pass through.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 道路或通道无法供人通过的性质或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kundizzjoni ta' triq jew passaġġ li ma jistax jingħadda minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不可通行性；道路、通道等无法通过的性质。

collocations.en: because of the impassability of the passage

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-impassibilità tat-triq wara l-għargħar u jirrakkomanda rotta alternattiva.
formal.en: The report describes the impassability of the road after the flooding and recommends an alternative route.
formal.zh: 报告描述了洪水过后道路无法通行的状况，并建议采用替代路线。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jiġifieri 'l-impassibilità tat-triq' f'dan l-avviż? Luka: Jiġifieri li ma nistgħux ngħaddu minn dik it-triq. Irridu nieħdu rotta oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'the impassability of the road' mean in this notice? Luka: It means we cannot use that road. We need to take another route.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这张告示里的“道路的不可通行状态”是什么意思？Luka：就是说我们不能从那条路走，得换一条路线。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 这张告示里的“道路的不可通行状态”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'the impassability of the road' mean in this notice?

messages.speaker: Luka (同行者)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri li ma nistgħux ngħaddu minn dik it-triq. Irridu nieħdu rotta oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri li ma nistgħux ngħaddu minn dik it-triq. Irridu nieħdu rotta oħra.
messages.zh: 就是说我们不能从那条路走，得换一条路线。
messages.en: It means we cannot use that road. We need to take another route.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“这条路过不去”写成报告里的一个状态项目，就是 impassibilità。记住它谈的是不可通行这一性质，而不是具体障碍物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bring goods or products into a country from another country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把货物或产品从外国运入本国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idaħħal merkanzija jew prodotti f'pajjiż minn pajjiż ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进口；把货物或产品从外国输入本国。

formal.mt: Is-sena li għaddiet, in-negozjant importa tagħmir mediku minn diversi pajjiżi Ewropej.
formal.en: Last year, the trader imported medical equipment from several European countries.
formal.zh: 去年，这位商人从多个欧洲国家进口了医疗设备。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Minn fejn ġie dan il-ġobon? Mark: In-negozjant importa dan il-ġobon mill-Italja l-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where did this cheese come from? Mark: The trader imported this cheese from Italy last week.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这奶酪是从哪里来的？Mark：商人上周从意大利进口了这批奶酪。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这奶酪是从哪里来的？
messages.en: Where did this cheese come from?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: In-negozjant importa dan il-ġobon mill-Italja l-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
messages.mt_standard: In-negozjant importa dan il-ġobon mill-Italja l-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
messages.zh: 商人上周从意大利进口了这批奶酪。
messages.en: The trader imported this cheese from Italy last week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一箱外国奶酪运进本国商店，把“从国外运进来”的箭头与 importa 联系起来；可借英语 import 辅助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The fact or condition of something being impossible to do or achieve.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某件事无法做到或实现的事实、性质或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt jew il-kundizzjoni li xi ħaġa ma tistax issir jew tintlaħaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不可能；无法做到或实现的状态（此处按所给名词词性理解）。

collocations.zh: 实际操作上不可能的事

collocations.en: the impossibility of completing the work on time
collocations.zh: 按时完成工作的不可能性

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega l-impossibilità li jitlesta l-proġett fi żmien ġimgħa bir-riżorsi disponibbli.
formal.en: The report explains the impossibility of completing the project within a week with the available resources.
formal.zh: 报告说明，凭现有资源不可能在一周内完成该项目。

colloquial.mt: Luka: Nistgħu nlestu dan kollu f'għaxar minuti? Maja: Mingħajr għajnuna, dik impossibilità. Għandna bżonn aktar ħin.
colloquial.en: Luka: Can we finish all this in ten minutes? Maja: Without help, that is an impossibility. We need more time.
colloquial.zh: Luka：我们能在十分钟内把这些全做完吗？Maja：没有人帮忙，那是不可能的事。我们需要更多时间。

messages.speaker: Luka (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nlestu dan kollu f'għaxar minuti?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nlestu dan kollu f'għaxar minuti?
messages.zh: 我们能在十分钟内把这些全做完吗？
messages.en: Can we finish all this in ten minutes?

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mingħajr għajnuna, dik impossibilità. Għandna bżonn aktar ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Mingħajr għajnuna, dik impossibilità. Għandna bżonn aktar ħin.
messages.zh: 没有人帮忙，那是不可能的事。我们需要更多时间。
messages.en: Without help, that is an impossibility. We need more time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象任务清单上写着“十分钟完成全部工作”，旁边盖上“不可能”的印章。impossibilità 是这种不可能性或不可能的事，按名词记。

gloss_zh: 达到不可能的程度；极其，难以置信地

teaching_sense.en_definition: To an impossible or seemingly impossible degree, often used to emphasize an extreme quality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 达到不可能或看似不可能的程度；常用于强调某种性质极其突出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sa grad impossibbli jew li jidher impossibbli, spiss biex jenfasizza kemm xi ħaġa hi estrema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 达到不可能的程度地；极其、难以置信地，常用来加强形容词的程度。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-muntanja tidher impossibilment għolja f'għajnejn it-tifel li jħares lejha mill-wied.
formal.en: In the story, the mountain appears impossibly high to the boy looking at it from the valley.
formal.zh: 在故事中，从山谷仰望的男孩觉得那座山高得简直难以企及。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif mar l-eżami? Mark: L-aħħar eżerċizzju kien impossibilment diffiċli. Lanqas kont naf minn fejn nibda.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did the exam go? Mark: The last exercise was impossibly difficult. I did not even know where to start.
colloquial.zh: Sara：考试考得怎么样？Mark：最后一道题难得简直没法做。我连从哪里开始都不知道。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 考试考得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the exam go?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: L-aħħar eżerċizzju kien impossibilment diffiċli. Lanqas kont naf minn fejn nibda.
messages.mt_standard: L-aħħar eżerċizzju kien impossibilment diffiċli. Lanqas kont naf minn fejn nibda.
messages.zh: 最后一道题难得简直没法做。我连从哪里开始都不知道。
messages.en: The last exercise was impossibly difficult. I did not even know where to start.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 impossibilment 想成形容词前的程度放大镜：放在 diffiċli 前，就是“难到几乎不可能完成”。用这个搭配记住它的副词作用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lack of power or ability to act effectively; also, an inability to function sexually.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缺乏采取有效行动的力量或能力；也可指性功能方面的无能。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' setgħa jew ħila biex wieħed jaġixxi b'mod effettiv; ukoll, nuqqas ta' ħila sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无力、无能为力；性无能，尤指男性勃起功能障碍。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi s-sens ta' impotenza li jħossu r-residenti meta l-ilmenti tagħhom jibqgħu mingħajr tweġiba.
formal.en: The report describes the feeling of powerlessness residents experience when their complaints remain unanswered.
formal.zh: 报告描述了居民的投诉一直得不到回应时所感到的无力感。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta ma nista' nagħmel xejn biex ngħin, inħoss sens ta' impotenza. Lara: Nifhmek. Forsi nistgħu nibdew b'xi ħaġa żgħira.
colloquial.en: Maja: When I can't do anything to help, I feel powerless. Lara: I understand. Maybe we can start with something small.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：当我什么也帮不上时，就觉得无能为力。拉拉：我明白。也许我们可以先做一件小事。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta ma nista' nagħmel xejn biex ngħin, inħoss sens ta' impotenza.
messages.mt_standard: Meta ma nista' nagħmel xejn biex ngħin, inħoss sens ta' impotenza.
messages.zh: 当我什么也帮不上时，就觉得无能为力。
messages.en: When I can't do anything to help, I feel powerless.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nifhmek. Forsi nistgħu nibdew b'xi ħaġa żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: Nifhmek. Forsi nistgħu nibdew b'xi ħaġa żgħira.
messages.zh: 我明白。也许我们可以先做一件小事。
messages.en: I understand. Maybe we can start with something small.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词联系到“想帮忙却使不上力”的画面，先记住无力感，再联系性功能语境中的性无能。

gloss_zh: 价值无法估量的；极其珍贵的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of such great value or importance that it cannot be measured or estimated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 价值或重要性极高，无法衡量或估计的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta' valur jew importanza tant kbira li ma tistax titkejjel jew tiġi stmata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 价值无法估量的；极其珍贵的。

formal.mt: Din il-kollezzjoni ta' ittri hija wirt imprezzabbli għall-komunità.
formal.en: This collection of letters is a priceless heritage for the community.
formal.zh: 这批书信是社区极其珍贵的遗产。

colloquial.mt: Nina: L-għajnuna tiegħek kienet imprezzabbli! Sara: Għamilt dak li stajt. Kuntenta li stajt ngħinek.
colloquial.en: Nina: Your help was invaluable! Sara: I did what I could. I'm glad I could help you.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你的帮助太宝贵了！萨拉：我尽了自己所能。很高兴能帮到你。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的帮助太宝贵了！
messages.en: Your help was invaluable!

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamilt dak li stajt. Kuntenta li stajt ngħinek.
messages.mt_standard: Għamilt dak li stajt. Kuntenta li stajt ngħinek.
messages.zh: 我尽了自己所能。很高兴能帮到你。
messages.en: I did what I could. I'm glad I could help you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一封珍藏的家书，多少钱也舍不得卖；用“珍贵到无法标价”的画面记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way that lacks exactness or sufficient accuracy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以不够精确或不够准确的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li ma jkunx eżatt jew preċiż biżżejjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不精确地；不准确地；含糊地。

formal.mt: Il-post tal-inċident ġie deskritt impreċiżament fir-rapport inizjali.
formal.en: The location of the accident was described imprecisely in the initial report.
formal.zh: 初步报告对事故地点的描述不够准确。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Spjegajt impreċiżament fejn se niltaqgħu? Nina: Iva, għedt biss ħdejn il-pjazza. Liema naħa?
colloquial.en: Mark: Did I explain imprecisely where we're meeting? Nina: Yes, you only said near the square. Which side?
colloquial.zh: 马克：我是不是没把见面地点说准确？妮娜：是啊，你只说在广场附近。哪一边？

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我是不是没把见面地点说准确？
messages.en: Did I explain imprecisely where we're meeting?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għedt biss ħdejn il-pjazza. Liema naħa?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għedt biss ħdejn il-pjazza. Liema naħa?
messages.zh: 是啊，你只说在广场附近。哪一边？
messages.en: Yes, you only said near the square. Which side?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友只说“广场附近”却不说哪一边；这个词说明动作做得怎样：说得不精确。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lack of exactness or sufficient precision in information, wording, or description.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 信息、措辞或描述缺乏精确性的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' eżattezza jew preċiżjoni fl-informazzjoni, fil-kliem jew fid-deskrizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不精确性；表述或信息不够准确的状态。

formal.mt: L-impreċiżazzjoni fid-deskrizzjoni tal-kompitu wasslet għal interpretazzjonijiet differenti.
formal.en: The impreciseness in the description of the task led to different interpretations.
formal.zh: 任务描述不够准确，导致了不同的理解。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hemm impreċiżazzjoni fid-deskrizzjoni: ma tgħidx kemm għandna nistennew. Pawlu: Veru. Se nżid il-ħin eżatt.
colloquial.en: Sara: The description lacks precision: it doesn't say how long we should wait. Pawlu: True. I'll add the exact time.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：描述不够精确，没说我们该等多久。保罗：确实。我会补上准确的时间。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm impreċiżazzjoni fid-deskrizzjoni: ma tgħidx kemm għandna nistennew.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm impreċiżazzjoni fid-deskrizzjoni: ma tgħidx kemm għandna nistennew.
messages.zh: 描述不够精确，没说我们该等多久。
messages.en: The description lacks precision: it doesn't say how long we should wait.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 确实。我会补上准确的时间。
messages.en: True. I'll add the exact time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记成说明书上缺少准确细节的状态：读完仍不知道等多久，就是“不够精确”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lack of precision, or a particular detail that is not stated or measured exactly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缺乏精确性；也指表述或测量中不够准确的具体之处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' preċiżjoni, jew dettall li ma jkunx espress jew imkejjel b'mod eżatt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不精确；不准确性；某个不够准确的细节。

formal.mt: L-impreċiżjoni fil-kejl tista' taffettwa l-kalkolu finali.
formal.en: Imprecision in measurement can affect the final calculation.
formal.zh: 测量不够精确可能会影响最终计算。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hemm impreċiżjoni f'dan il-kejl? Mark: Iva, il-mejda hi ftit itwal milli ktibt.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is there an imprecision in this measurement? Mark: Yes, the table is a little longer than I wrote.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个测量结果有不准确的地方吗？马克：有，桌子比我写的稍微长一点。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个测量结果有不准确的地方吗？
messages.en: Is there an imprecision in this measurement?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-mejda hi ftit itwal milli ktibt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-mejda hi ftit itwal milli ktibt.
messages.zh: 有，桌子比我写的稍微长一点。
messages.en: Yes, the table is a little longer than I wrote.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象尺子量出的长度差了一点点，用“测量不够精确”的画面记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put someone in prison or keep them confined there.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某人关进监狱，或使其继续受到监禁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daħħal lil xi ħadd il-ħabs jew żammu magħluq fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 监禁；把某人关进监狱。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, ir-re impriġjuna lill-avversarji politiċi tiegħu.
formal.en: In the novel, the king imprisoned his political opponents.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，国王监禁了自己的政治反对者。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Għaliex ir-re impriġjuna lil dak ir-raġel fl-istorja? Maja: Għax ir-raġel kien jaf is-sigriet tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Why did the king imprison that man in the story? Maja: Because the man knew his secret.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：故事里的国王为什么把那个男人关进监狱？玛雅：因为那个男人知道他的秘密。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (读书伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ir-re impriġjuna lil dak ir-raġel fl-istorja?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ir-re impriġjuna lil dak ir-raġel fl-istorja?
messages.zh: 故事里的国王为什么把那个男人关进监狱？
messages.en: Why did the king imprison that man in the story?

messages.speaker: Maja (读书伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ir-raġel kien jaf is-sigriet tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ir-raġel kien jaf is-sigriet tiegħu.
messages.zh: 因为那个男人知道他的秘密。
messages.en: Because the man knew his secret.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“国王把知道秘密的人关进牢房”的故事记忆，抓住把人关押起来这个动作。

gloss_zh: 死亡；死亡人数（mwiet 的变体）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Deaths, used as a form of mwiet after a consonant and also as an alternative basic form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示死亡事件或死亡人数，是 mwiet 在辅音后使用的形式，也可作为另一基本形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Każijiet ta' mewt; forma ta' mwiet li tintuża wara konsonanti u wkoll bħala forma bażika alternattiva.

sense_translations.en_definition: post-consonantal and alternative basic form of mwiet
sense_translations.zh_definition: mwiet 的辅音后形式及另一基本形式，表示死亡或死亡人数。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iqabbel l-imwiet fit-toroq matul dawn l-aħħar ħames snin.
formal.en: The report compares road deaths over the last five years.
formal.zh: 报告比较了过去五年的道路交通死亡人数。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan l-artiklu jitkellem dwar l-imwiet fit-toroq? Mark: Iva, u jispjega kif nistgħu nagħmlu t-toroq aktar siguri.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this article about road deaths? Mark: Yes, and it explains how we can make roads safer.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这篇文章讲的是道路交通死亡情况吗？马克：是的，还解释了怎样让道路更安全。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-artiklu jitkellem dwar l-imwiet fit-toroq?
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-artiklu jitkellem dwar l-imwiet fit-toroq?
messages.zh: 这篇文章讲的是道路交通死亡情况吗？
messages.en: Is this article about road deaths?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u jispjega kif nistgħu nagħmlu t-toroq aktar siguri.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u jispjega kif nistgħu nagħmlu t-toroq aktar siguri.
messages.zh: 是的，还解释了怎样让道路更安全。
messages.en: Yes, and it explains how we can make roads safer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imwiet 和 mwiet 放在同一张“死亡人数”词卡上，作为同义形式一起识别和记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Love or deep affection; the post-consonantal and alternative basic form of mħabba.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 爱、关爱或深厚的感情；是 mħabba 的辅音后形式及另一基本形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sentiment ta' għożża u rabta profonda; il-forma ta' mħabba wara konsonanti u forma bażika alternattiva tagħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: post-consonantal and alternative basic form of mħabba
sense_translations.zh_definition: mħabba（爱、关爱）的辅音后形式及另一基本形式。

formal.mt: L-imħabba għall-familja tidher fil-kura u fl-għajnuna ta' kuljum.
formal.en: Love for one's family is shown through everyday care and help.
formal.zh: 对家人的爱体现在日常的照顾和帮助中。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex tmur tara lin-nanna kuljum? Ben: Għax inħoss imħabba kbira lejha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do you visit your grandmother every day? Ben: Because I feel a great deal of love for her.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么每天都去看奶奶？本：因为我很爱她。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么每天都去看奶奶？
messages.en: Why do you visit your grandmother every day?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为我很爱她。
messages.en: Because I feel a great deal of love for her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“每天关心家人”的画面记住 imħabba 的爱意，并把 imħabba 与 mħabba 配成同义形式卡片一起复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The personal name Muhammad; the post-consonantal and alternative basic form of Mħammed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人名“穆罕默德”；Imħammed 是 Mħammed 的辅音后形式及另一基本形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem ta' persuna Imħammed; il-forma ta' Mħammed wara konsonanti u forma bażika alternattiva tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: post-consonantal and alternative basic form of Mħammed
sense_translations.zh_definition: Mħammed（人名“穆罕默德”）的辅音后形式及另一基本形式。

formal.mt: Is-Sur Imħammed se jippreżenta r-rapport fil-laqgħa ta' għada.
formal.en: Mr Muhammad will present the report at tomorrow's meeting.
formal.zh: 穆罕默德先生将在明天的会议上介绍这份报告。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Imħammed, ġej magħna? Imħammed: Iva, stennuni minuta.
colloquial.en: Nina: Muhammad, are you coming with us? Muhammad: Yes, wait a minute for me.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：穆罕默德，你跟我们一起去吗？穆罕默德：去，等我一分钟。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 穆罕默德，你跟我们一起去吗？
messages.en: Muhammad, are you coming with us?

messages.speaker: Imħammed (朋友)
messages.zh: 去，等我一分钟。
messages.en: Yes, wait a minute for me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Imħammed 写在人物名牌上，旁边标注“穆罕默德”；与 Mħammed 成对记忆，并留意人名的大写字母。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a town in Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他的一个城镇的名称，中文可译作“纳沙尔”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem ta' lokalità f'Malta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他的城镇：纳沙尔

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir fin-Naxxar nhar it-Tnejn.
formal.en: The meeting will take place in Naxxar on Monday.
formal.zh: 会议将于星期一在纳沙尔举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn toqgħod? Pawlu: Fin-Naxxar. U inti? Maja: Jiena noqgħod il-Mosta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where do you live? Pawlu: In Naxxar. And you? Maja: I live in Mosta.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你住在哪里？Pawlu：纳沙尔。你呢？Maja：我住在莫斯塔。

messages.speaker: Maja (新同学)
messages.zh: 你住在哪里？
messages.en: Where do you live?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 纳沙尔。你呢？
messages.en: In Naxxar. And you?

messages.speaker: Maja (新同学)
messages.zh: 我住在莫斯塔。
messages.en: I live in Mosta.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 In-Naxxar 当作地图上的完整地名记住，并连同 fin-Naxxar“在纳沙尔”一起练习，建立地点与表达的联系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A condition that limits a person's ability to perform certain activities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使一个人从事某些活动的能力受到限制的状况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li tillimita l-ħila ta' persuna li twettaq ċerti attivitajiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 失能；残障；从事某些活动的能力受到限制的状况。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mediku jiddeskrivi l-inabbilitazzjoni temporanja tal-pazjent u l-effett tagħha fuq l-attivitajiet ta' kuljum.
formal.en: The medical report describes the patient's temporary disability and its effect on daily activities.
formal.zh: 医疗报告描述了患者的暂时性失能及其对日常活动的影响。

colloquial.mt: Mark: It-tabib kiteb li għandi inabbilitazzjoni temporanja. Nina: Nista' ngħinek bix-xiri sakemm tkun tista' terġa' toħroġ?
colloquial.en: Mark: The doctor wrote that I have a temporary disability. Nina: Can I help you with the shopping until you can go out again?
colloquial.zh: 马克：医生写明我目前暂时失能。妮娜：在你能重新出门之前，我可以帮你买东西吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tabib kiteb li għandi inabbilitazzjoni temporanja.
messages.mt_standard: It-tabib kiteb li għandi inabbilitazzjoni temporanja.
messages.zh: 医生写明我目前暂时失能。
messages.en: The doctor wrote that I have a temporary disability.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' ngħinek bix-xiri sakemm tkun tista' terġa' toħroġ?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' ngħinek bix-xiri sakemm tkun tista' terġa' toħroġ?
messages.zh: 在你能重新出门之前，我可以帮你买东西吗？
messages.en: Can I help you with the shopping until you can go out again?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象受伤后暂时需要别人帮忙购物，用“某些活动能力受限”的场景记住失能这一含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The lack of ability to do something or perform a particular task.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缺乏做某事或完成某项任务所需的能力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-nuqqas ta' ħila jew kapaċità li wieħed jagħmel xi ħaġa jew iwettaq kompitu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无能力；缺乏做某事的能力

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-inabbiltà tal-istudent li jlesti l-kompitu mingħajr għajnuna.
formal.en: The report describes the student's inability to complete the task without help.
formal.zh: 报告描述了该学生无法独立完成任务的情况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma tlestejtx ix-xogħol? Pawlu: Il-problema hi l-inabbiltà tiegħi li nikkonċentra b'dan l-istorbju kollu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why didn't you finish the work? Pawlu: The problem is my inability to concentrate with all this noise.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么没完成工作？保罗：问题是这么吵，我没法集中注意力。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么没完成工作？
messages.en: Why didn't you finish the work?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-problema hi l-inabbiltà tiegħi li nikkonċentra b'dan l-istorbju kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-problema hi l-inabbiltà tiegħi li nikkonċentra b'dan l-istorbju kollu.
messages.zh: 问题是这么吵，我没法集中注意力。
messages.en: The problem is my inability to concentrate with all this noise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inabbiltà 和“想做却做不到”的画面联系起来，搭配 li 引出具体做不到的事，记住它表示能力上的缺乏。

gloss_zh: 不适宜居住的；无法居住的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not suitable or safe for people to live in.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因条件不适宜或不安全而无法供人居住的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li mhux adattat jew sigur biex jgħixu fih in-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不适宜居住的；无法供人居住的

formal.mt: Wara l-għargħar, il-perit iddikjara li d-dar kienet inabitabbli.
formal.en: After the flood, the architect declared that the house was uninhabitable.
formal.zh: 洪水过后，建筑师认定这所房屋已不适宜居住。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nistgħu noqogħdu fl-appartament illejla? Mark: Le, bħalissa hu inabitabbli; m'hemmx ilma u s-saqaf qed iqattar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can we stay in the apartment tonight? Mark: No, it's currently uninhabitable; there's no water and the ceiling is leaking.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们今晚能住在公寓里吗？马克：不能，现在没法住；既没水，天花板又漏水。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 我们今晚能住在公寓里吗？
messages.en: Can we stay in the apartment tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, bħalissa hu inabitabbli; m'hemmx ilma u s-saqaf qed iqattar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, bħalissa hu inabitabbli; m'hemmx ilma u s-saqaf qed iqattar.
messages.zh: 不能，现在没法住；既没水，天花板又漏水。
messages.en: No, it's currently uninhabitable; there's no water and the ceiling is leaking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一扇贴着“无法入住”的房门，把 inabitabbli 与漏雨、断水的房屋联系起来；重点记住它描述居住条件。

gloss_zh: 不可剥夺的；不可转让的

teaching_sense.en_definition: That cannot be taken away from its holder or transferred to someone else, especially a right.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不能从持有人那里剥夺或转让给他人的，尤用于权利。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jistax jittieħed minn min għandu jew jiġi trasferit lil ħaddieħor, speċjalment dritt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不可剥夺的；不可转让的

formal.mt: Id-dikjarazzjoni tiddeskrivi l-libertà bħala dritt inaljenabbli ta' kull persuna.
formal.en: The declaration describes freedom as an inalienable right of every person.
formal.zh: 该宣言将自由描述为每个人不可剥夺的权利。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser dritt inaljenabbli? David: Dritt li ma jistax jittieħed mingħandek jew jiġi trasferit lil xi ħadd ieħor.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does an inalienable right mean? David: A right that cannot be taken away from you or transferred to someone else.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：不可剥夺的权利是什么意思？戴维：就是不能从你这里夺走，也不能转让给别人的权利。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 不可剥夺的权利是什么意思？
messages.en: What does an inalienable right mean?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dritt li ma jistax jittieħed mingħandek jew jiġi trasferit lil xi ħadd ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Dritt li ma jistax jittieħed mingħandek jew jiġi trasferit lil xi ħadd ieħor.
messages.zh: 就是不能从你这里夺走，也不能转让给别人的权利。
messages.en: A right that cannot be taken away from you or transferred to someone else.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象写着“权利”的卡片始终属于本人，不能被夺走或转给别人；用这个画面记住 inaljenabbli 的权利含义。

gloss_zh: 不可上诉的；不可提出申诉的

teaching_sense.en_definition: That cannot be challenged through an appeal, especially a decision or judgment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不能通过上诉或申诉程序提出异议的，尤用于决定或判决。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jistax isir appell kontrih, speċjalment deċiżjoni jew ġudizzju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不可上诉的；不允许提出申诉的

formal.mt: Ir-regolament ta' din il-kompetizzjoni jgħid li d-deċiżjoni tal-ġurija hija inappellabbli.
formal.en: The rules of this competition state that the jury's decision cannot be appealed.
formal.zh: 本次比赛的规则规定，评审团的决定不可申诉。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nistgħu nappellaw kontra r-riżultat tal-kompetizzjoni? Ġanni: Le, skont ir-regoli, id-deċiżjoni tal-ġurija hi inappellabbli.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can we appeal against the competition result? Ġanni: No, under the rules, the jury's decision cannot be appealed.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们能对比赛结果提出申诉吗？詹尼：不能，按规则，评审团的决定不可申诉。

messages.speaker: Nina (参赛者)
messages.zh: 我们能对比赛结果提出申诉吗？
messages.en: Can we appeal against the competition result?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, skont ir-regoli, id-deċiżjoni tal-ġurija hi inappellabbli.
messages.mt_standard: Le, skont ir-regoli, id-deċiżjoni tal-ġurija hi inappellabbli.
messages.zh: 不能，按规则，评审团的决定不可申诉。
messages.en: No, under the rules, the jury's decision cannot be appealed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inappellabbli 放在“决定已作出，申诉通道关闭”的场景里记忆；它强调不能提出上诉或申诉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not relevant to or usable in a particular case or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不适合用于某个具体个案或情境的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma japplikax għal każ jew sitwazzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不适用的；不适合用于有关情况的

formal.mt: Din il-kundizzjoni hija inapplikabbli għal ordnijiet magħmula qabel l-ewwel ta' Mejju.
formal.en: This condition is inapplicable to orders placed before the first of May.
formal.zh: 这一条件不适用于五月一日之前提交的订单。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Din ir-regola tgħodd għalina wkoll? Sara: Le, hi inapplikabbli għal dan il-każ għax aħna bbukkjajna qabel.
colloquial.en: Mark: Does this rule apply to us too? Sara: No, it's inapplicable to this case because we booked earlier.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这条规则也适用于我们吗？萨拉：不适用，我们这个情况不在适用范围内，因为我们预订得更早。

messages.speaker: Mark (旅伴)
messages.zh: 这条规则也适用于我们吗？
messages.en: Does this rule apply to us too?

messages.speaker: Sara (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hi inapplikabbli għal dan il-każ għax aħna bbukkjajna qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hi inapplikabbli għal dan il-każ għax aħna bbukkjajna qabel.
messages.zh: 不适用，我们这个情况不在适用范围内，因为我们预订得更早。
messages.en: No, it's inapplicable to this case because we booked earlier.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一条规则套到某个案例上，却发现条件对不上；用“这条套不上”记住 inapplikabbli，常搭配 għal 指明对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The fact that a rule, condition, or method does not apply to a particular case.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某项规则、条件或方法不适用于具体个案这一性质或事实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li regola, kundizzjoni jew metodu ma japplikax għal każ partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不适用性；不适用于有关情况的事实

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega l-inapplikabilità tal-metodu għal kampjuni żgħar.
formal.en: The report explains the inapplicability of the method to small samples.
formal.zh: 报告解释了该方法对小样本的不适用性。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma użajtx dan il-metodu? Pawlu: Minħabba l-inapplikabilità tiegħu għal grupp daqshekk żgħir; għażilt metodu ieħor.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why didn't you use this method? Pawlu: Because of its inapplicability to such a small group; I chose another method.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你为什么没用这个方法？保罗：因为它不适用于这么小的群体，所以我选了另一个方法。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么没用这个方法？
messages.en: Why didn't you use this method?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba l-inapplikabilità tiegħu għal grupp daqshekk żgħir; għażilt metodu ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba l-inapplikabilità tiegħu għal grupp daqshekk żgħir; għażilt metodu ieħor.
messages.zh: 因为它不适用于这么小的群体，所以我选了另一个方法。
messages.en: Because of its inapplicability to such a small group; I chose another method.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inapplikabilità 记成报告中讨论的“不适用性”：不是直接形容某条规则，而是把“不能适用这件事”作为名词来谈。

gloss_zh: 不活跃的；未启用的；处于停用状态的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not active, operating, or currently in use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有活动、没有运作或当前未被使用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li mhux attiv, mhux qed jaħdem jew mhux qed jintuża bħalissa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不活跃的；未运作的；处于停用状态的

collocations.zh: 未启用或处于停用状态的账户

formal.mt: Il-kont jibqa' inattiv sakemm is-sid jikkonferma l-indirizz tal-email tiegħu.
formal.en: The account remains inactive until its owner confirms their email address.
formal.zh: 该账户在账户持有人确认电子邮箱地址之前保持未启用状态。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex ma nistax nuża l-kont tiegħi? Nina: Għadu inattiv; l-ewwel trid tikkonferma l-email tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why can't I use my account? Nina: It's still inactive; first you need to confirm your email address.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我为什么不能使用自己的账户？妮娜：账户还没启用；你得先确认电子邮箱地址。

messages.speaker: Mark (用户)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistax nuża l-kont tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistax nuża l-kont tiegħi?
messages.zh: 我为什么不能使用自己的账户？
messages.en: Why can't I use my account?

messages.speaker: Nina (客服人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu inattiv; l-ewwel trid tikkonferma l-email tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu inattiv; l-ewwel trid tikkonferma l-email tiegħek.
messages.zh: 账户还没启用；你得先确认电子邮箱地址。
messages.en: It's still inactive; first you need to confirm your email address.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象账户旁边的状态灯没有亮起，用这个“尚未活动或运作”的画面记住 inattiv；描述人或自然事物时也可表示不活跃。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not possible or practical to carry out under the available conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在现有条件下无法实施或实际行不通的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jistax jitwettaq fil-kundizzjonijiet jew bir-riżorsi disponibbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不可行的；无法付诸实施的

formal.mt: Il-kumitat qies il-proġett inattwabbli minħabba n-nuqqas ta' fondi u ta' ħaddiema.
formal.en: The committee considered the project unfeasible because of the lack of funds and workers.
formal.zh: 委员会认为，该项目因缺少资金和人员而不可行。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nistgħu nlestu kollox sa għada? David: B'żewġ persuni biss, il-pjan hu inattwabbli; għandna bżonn aktar ħin.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can we finish everything by tomorrow? David: With only two people, the plan is unfeasible; we need more time.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们能在明天之前把一切都完成吗？戴维：只有两个人，这个计划行不通；我们需要更多时间。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 我们能在明天之前把一切都完成吗？
messages.en: Can we finish everything by tomorrow?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: B'żewġ persuni biss, il-pjan hu inattwabbli; għandna bżonn aktar ħin.
messages.mt_standard: B'żewġ persuni biss, il-pjan hu inattwabbli; għandna bżonn aktar ħin.
messages.zh: 只有两个人，这个计划行不通；我们需要更多时间。
messages.en: With only two people, the plan is unfeasible; we need more time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象计划表上任务很多，却没有足够的人手、时间或资金；把 inattwabbli 与“条件不足，实施不了”的判断联系起来。

gloss_zh: 干净的（复数，辅音后形式）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Clean, describing plural things or people; the form of ndaf used after a consonant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示多个事物或人“干净的”；是 nadif 的复数 ndaf 在辅音之后使用的形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma ta' ndaf, il-plural ta' nadif, li tintuża wara konsonanti u tfisser li ma jkunx hemm ħmieġ.

sense_translations.en_definition: postconsonantal form of ndaf, the plural of nadif
sense_translations.zh_definition: nadif（干净的）的复数 ndaf 在辅音之后使用的形式，表示多个事物或人是干净的。

formal.mt: Il-lukanda toffri kmamar indaf u komdi għall-mistednin kollha.
formal.en: The hotel offers clean and comfortable rooms for all guests.
formal.zh: 这家酒店为所有住客提供干净舒适的房间。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Fejn poġġejt il-ħwejjeġ indaf? Rita: Fil-gwardarobba, fuq l-ixkaffa ta' fuq.
colloquial.en: Ben: Where did you put the clean clothes? Rita: In the wardrobe, on the top shelf.
colloquial.zh: 本：你把干净的衣服放在哪里了？丽塔：在衣柜里，最上面那层。

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.zh: 你把干净的衣服放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you put the clean clothes?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 在衣柜里，最上面那层。
messages.en: In the wardrobe, on the top shelf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 ħwejjeġ indaf 整组记忆：衣服是复数，前词以辅音结尾，此处“干净的”用 indaf。

gloss_zh: 大小相等的；同等重要的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Equal in size or in the importance given to the things being compared.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所比较的事物大小相等，或具有同等重要性的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandhom l-istess daqs jew l-istess importanza meta jitqabblu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大小相等的；尺寸相同的。
同等重要的；在重要性上相等的。

formal.mt: Il-pjan jagħti importanza indaqs lis-saħħa u lill-edukazzjoni.
formal.en: The plan gives equal importance to health and education.
formal.zh: 该计划给予健康和教育同等的重要性。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tista' taqsam il-kejk f'żewġ biċċiet indaqs? Mark: Iva, hekk ikollna biċċa tal-istess daqs kull wieħed.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you cut the cake into two equal pieces? Mark: Yes, then we'll each have a piece of the same size.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你能把蛋糕切成大小相等的两块吗？马克：可以，这样我们每人都有同样大的一块。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' taqsam il-kejk f'żewġ biċċiet indaqs?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' taqsam il-kejk f'żewġ biċċiet indaqs?
messages.zh: 你能把蛋糕切成大小相等的两块吗？
messages.en: Can you cut the cake into two equal pieces?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hekk ikollna biċċa tal-istess daqs kull wieħed.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hekk ikollna biċċa tal-istess daqs kull wieħed.
messages.zh: 可以，这样我们每人都有同样大的一块。
messages.en: Yes, then we'll each have a piece of the same size.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 indaqs 画成平衡的天平：两块蛋糕一样大，两项事务一样重要，用两个画面记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming weaker or losing strength.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 力量、体力或功能逐渐减弱的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih xi ħaġa ssir aktar dgħajfa jew titlef is-saħħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 减弱；衰弱；力量或功能的下降。

formal.mt: It-tabib innota indebboliment tal-muskoli wara l-marda.
formal.en: The doctor noted a weakening of the muscles after the illness.
formal.zh: 医生注意到，患者病后出现了肌肉力量减弱的情况。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Qed inħoss indebboliment f'saqajja. Pawlu: Għid lit-tabib kif qed tħossok.
colloquial.en: Marija: I'm feeling a loss of strength in my legs. Pawlu: Tell the doctor how you're feeling.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我觉得双腿的力气变弱了。Pawlu：把你的感受告诉医生吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 我觉得双腿的力气变弱了。
messages.en: I'm feeling a loss of strength in my legs.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 把你的感受告诉医生吧。
messages.en: Tell the doctor how you're feeling.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象体力仪表的指针逐渐下降，把 indebboliment 记成“变弱的过程”，注意它是名词。

gloss_zh: 不当地；无正当理由地；过分地

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way that is unjustified, improper, or excessive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以缺乏正当理由、不合适或超过合理程度的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod mhux ġustifikat, mhux xieraq jew eċċessiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不当地；无正当理由地；过分地。

collocations.zh: 支付本不该支付的款项

formal.mt: Il-klijent intalab iħallas indebitament miżata addizzjonali.
formal.en: The customer was unjustifiably asked to pay an additional fee.
formal.zh: 客户被无正当理由地要求支付一笔额外费用。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Naħseb li ċċarġjawni indebitament għal dan is-servizz. Rita: Ejja niċċekkjaw il-kont flimkien.
colloquial.en: Mark: I think they charged me improperly for this service. Rita: Let's check the bill together.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我觉得他们不该收我这项服务的费用。Rita：我们一起核对一下账单吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li ċċarġjawni indebitament għal dan is-servizz.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li ċċarġjawni indebitament għal dan is-servizz.
messages.zh: 我觉得他们不该收我这项服务的费用。
messages.en: I think they charged me improperly for this service.

messages.speaker: Rita (客服人员)
messages.zh: 我们一起核对一下账单吧。
messages.en: Let's check the bill together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象账单上多出一笔没有理由的收费，用 indebitament 描述“收得不当”，记住它修饰动作。

gloss_zh: 难以定义的；无法确切描述的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Impossible to define or describe precisely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 无法给出明确界定，或难以用语言准确描述的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jistax jiġi definit jew deskritt b'mod preċiż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无法定义的；难以确切描述或界定的。

collocations.zh: 一种难以确切描述的特质

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi sensazzjoni indefinibbli li tgħaqqad il-ferħ mal-biża'.
formal.en: The author describes an indefinable feeling that combines joy with fear.
formal.zh: 作者描述了一种交织着喜悦与恐惧、难以言明的感觉。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-post jagħtini sensazzjoni indefinibbli. Adam: Tħossok tajjeb hawn? Nina: Iva, imma ma nafx kif nispjegaha.
colloquial.en: Nina: This place gives me an indefinable feeling. Adam: Do you feel good here? Nina: Yes, but I don't know how to explain it.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个地方给我一种说不清的感觉。Adam：你在这里感觉好吗？Nina：好，可我不知道该怎么解释。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个地方给我一种说不清的感觉。
messages.en: This place gives me an indefinable feeling.

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在这里感觉好吗？
messages.en: Do you feel good here?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ma nafx kif nispjegaha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ma nafx kif nispjegaha.
messages.zh: 好，可我不知道该怎么解释。
messages.en: Yes, but I don't know how to explain it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一种明明感受得到、却怎么也说不准确的心情，用 indefinibbli 记住“难以定义”。

gloss_zh: 不明确的；未确定的；无固定期限的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not clearly specified or determined, especially without a fixed duration or end.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尚未明确说明或确定的，尤指没有固定时长或结束时间的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li mhuwiex speċifikat jew stabbilit b'mod ċar, speċjalment mingħajr tul jew tmiem fiss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不明确的；未确定的；没有固定期限的。

collocations.zh: 未确定期限的一段时期

formal.mt: Il-laqgħat ġew sospiżi għal żmien indefinit.
formal.en: The meetings were suspended for an indefinite period.
formal.zh: 这些会议被暂停，恢复时间未定。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għal kemm żmien se tagħlaq il-librerija? Toni: Għal żmien indefinit; għadhom ma tawx data.
colloquial.en: Elena: How long will the library be closed? Toni: For an indefinite period; they haven't given a date yet.
colloquial.zh: Elena：图书馆要关闭多久？Toni：期限未定，他们还没有给出日期。

messages.speaker: Elena (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal kemm żmien se tagħlaq il-librerija?
messages.mt_standard: Għal kemm żmien se tagħlaq il-librerija?
messages.zh: 图书馆要关闭多久？
messages.en: How long will the library be closed?

messages.speaker: Toni (图书馆工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal żmien indefinit; għadhom ma tawx data.
messages.mt_standard: Għal żmien indefinit; għadhom ma tawx data.
messages.zh: 期限未定，他们还没有给出日期。
messages.en: For an indefinite period; they haven't given a date yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历上只写开始日期，结束日期留白；indefinit 描述这种“尚未确定”的状态，不必理解为永远。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being unclear, unspecified, or not precisely determined.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表述、范围或安排缺乏明确界定，尚未准确确定的性质或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' xi ħaġa li mhijiex ċara, speċifikata jew determinata b'mod preċiż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不明确性；缺乏确切界定或确定内容的状态。

formal.mt: L-indefinitezza tat-termini użati fir-rapport tagħmel l-interpretazzjoni diffiċli.
formal.en: The indefiniteness of the terms used in the report makes interpretation difficult.
formal.zh: 报告所用术语的含义不明确，给理解带来了困难。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ma nħobbx din l-indefinitezza. Meta se nibdew? Ben: Naqbel; għandna bżonn data ċara.
colloquial.en: Lara: I don't like this lack of clarity. When are we starting? Ben: I agree; we need a clear date.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我不喜欢这样含糊不清。我们到底什么时候开始？Ben：我同意，我们需要一个明确的日期。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nħobbx din l-indefinitezza. Meta se nibdew?
messages.mt_standard: Ma nħobbx din l-indefinitezza. Meta se nibdew?
messages.zh: 我不喜欢这样含糊不清。我们到底什么时候开始？
messages.en: I don't like this lack of clarity. When are we starting?

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.zh: 我同意，我们需要一个明确的日期。
messages.en: I agree; we need a clear date.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 indefinitezza 想成计划表上的一片空白：日期、范围都没说清，整个“不明确的状态”就是这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a period of time whose end has not been fixed or specified.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 持续到尚未确定的时间；没有规定结束日期地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għal żmien li t-tmiem tiegħu għadu mhux stabbilit jew speċifikat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无限期地；未规定结束时间地。

formal.mt: Il-proġett ġie pospost indefinittivament minħabba nuqqas ta' fondi.
formal.en: The project was postponed indefinitely because of a lack of funds.
formal.zh: 由于资金不足，该项目被无限期推迟。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Il-ħanut se jibqa' magħluq indefinittivament? Ġanni: Hekk jgħidu; għadhom ma ħabbrux meta jerġa' jiftaħ.
colloquial.en: Marta: Will the shop remain closed indefinitely? Ġanni: That's what they say; they haven't announced when it will reopen.
colloquial.zh: Marta：这家店会无限期关闭吗？Ġanni：他们是这么说的，还没宣布什么时候重新营业。

messages.speaker: Marta (邻居)
messages.zh: 这家店会无限期关闭吗？
messages.en: Will the shop remain closed indefinitely?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Hekk jgħidu; għadhom ma ħabbrux meta jerġa' jiftaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Hekk jgħidu; għadhom ma ħabbrux meta jerġa' jiftaħ.
messages.zh: 他们是这么说的，还没宣布什么时候重新营业。
messages.en: That's what they say; they haven't announced when it will reopen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象店门公告写着“恢复营业日期另行通知”，用 indefinittivament 修饰“关闭、推迟”等动作或状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a form that does not change through grammatical declension.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在语法变格中保持同一词形、不发生相应词形变化的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jbiddilx il-forma tiegħu bid-deklinazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: （语法）不变格的；不随变格而改变词形的。

formal.mt: Fit-tabella, in-nom indeklinabbli jidher bl-istess forma f'kull każ grammatikali.
formal.en: In the table, the indeclinable noun appears in the same form in every grammatical case.
formal.zh: 在表格中，这个不变格名词在每个语法格中都使用相同的词形。

colloquial.mt: Eva: Għandi nbiddel il-forma ta' dan in-nom? Mark: Le, huwa indeklinabbli; ħallih kif inhu.
colloquial.en: Eva: Should I change the form of this noun? Mark: No, it is indeclinable; leave it as it is.
colloquial.zh: Eva：我需要改变这个名词的词形吗？Mark：不用，它是不变格的，保持原样就行。

messages.speaker: Eva (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi nbiddel il-forma ta' dan in-nom?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi nbiddel il-forma ta' dan in-nom?
messages.zh: 我需要改变这个名词的词形吗？
messages.en: Should I change the form of this noun?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa indeklinabbli; ħallih kif inhu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa indeklinabbli; ħallih kif inhu.
messages.zh: 不用，它是不变格的，保持原样就行。
messages.en: No, it is indeclinable; leave it as it is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象变格表里的每个格子都填着同一个词形，把 indeklinabbli 与“变格时词形保持原样”联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Without intending or deliberately choosing to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 并非出于有意识的意图或选择，而是无意地做某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bla ma wieħed ikollu l-ħsieb jew l-intenzjoni li jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无意地；并非故意地。

formal.mt: L-awtur żvela indeliberatament isem li kellu jibqa' kunfidenzjali.
formal.en: The author unintentionally revealed a name that should have remained confidential.
formal.zh: 作者无意中透露了一个本应保密的姓名。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għedtlu dwar ir-rigal? Mark: Għedtlu indeliberatament; ħsibt li kien diġà jaf.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you tell him about the present? Mark: I told him unintentionally; I thought he already knew.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么把礼物的事告诉他了？马克：我是无意中说出来的，我以为他已经知道了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把礼物的事告诉他了？
messages.en: Why did you tell him about the present?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għedtlu indeliberatament; ħsibt li kien diġà jaf.
messages.mt_standard: Għedtlu indeliberatament; ħsibt li kien diġà jaf.
messages.zh: 我是无意中说出来的，我以为他已经知道了。
messages.en: I told him unintentionally; I thought he already knew.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把礼物秘密说漏嘴后解释“我不是故意的”，把这个副词与“无意中做了某事”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way that does not follow democratic principles or allow fair participation in decisions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以不遵循民主原则、或不允许有关人员公平参与决策的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li ma jirrispettax il-prinċipji demokratiċi jew il-parteċipazzjoni ġusta fid-deċiżjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不民主地；以违背民主原则的方式。

collocations.zh: 以不民主的方式作决定

formal.mt: Il-kumitat aġixxa indemokratikament meta ħa d-deċiżjoni mingħajr ma ppermetta lill-membri jivvutaw.
formal.en: The committee acted undemocratically when it made the decision without allowing members to vote.
formal.zh: 委员会未允许成员投票便作出了决定，这种做法不民主。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tgħid li ċ-chairperson aġixxa indemokratikament? Pawlu: Għax għażel kollox waħdu u ma ħalliniex nivvutaw.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you saying the chairperson acted undemocratically? Pawlu: Because he chose everything himself and did not let us vote.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么说主席的做法不民主？保罗：因为所有事情都是他自己选定的，也不让我们投票。

messages.speaker: Sara (协会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tgħid li ċ-chairperson aġixxa indemokratikament?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tgħid li ċ-chairperson aġixxa indemokratikament?
messages.zh: 你为什么说主席的做法不民主？
messages.en: Why are you saying the chairperson acted undemocratically?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (协会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għażel kollox waħdu u ma ħalliniex nivvutaw.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għażel kollox waħdu u ma ħalliniex nivvutaw.
messages.zh: 因为所有事情都是他自己选定的，也不让我们投票。
messages.en: Because he chose everything himself and did not let us vote.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“大家还没投票，他就替所有人决定了”的场景，用这个副词描述作决定的方式不民主。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Without depending on another person or thing; with minn, regardless of a particular factor.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不依赖他人或其他事物而独立地行动；与 minn 连用时，也可表示不论某项因素如何。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bla ma wieħed jiddependi fuq ħaddieħor jew fuq xi ħaġa oħra; ma' minn, ukoll mingħajr ma fattur partikolari jagħmel differenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 独立地；自主地；不依赖其他人或事物地。

formal.mt: Kull applikazzjoni tiġi evalwata independentement mill-applikazzjonijiet l-oħra.
formal.en: Each application is assessed independently of the other applications.
formal.zh: 每份申请均独立于其他申请进行评估。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid naħdmu flimkien fuq dan l-eżerċizzju? Lara: L-ewwel nipprova naħdem independentement, imbagħad inqabblu t-tweġibiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want us to work together on this exercise? Lara: I will first try to work independently, then we can compare answers.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这道练习要一起做吗？拉拉：我先试着独立完成，然后我们再对答案。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid naħdmu flimkien fuq dan l-eżerċizzju?
messages.mt_standard: Trid naħdmu flimkien fuq dan l-eżerċizzju?
messages.zh: 这道练习要一起做吗？
messages.en: Do you want us to work together on this exercise?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel nipprova naħdem independentement, imbagħad inqabblu t-tweġibiet.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel nipprova naħdem independentement, imbagħad inqabblu t-tweġibiet.
messages.zh: 我先试着独立完成，然后我们再对答案。
messages.en: I will first try to work independently, then we can compare answers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“独立完成练习”作为核心画面；再整块记 independentement minn，理解为“不依赖于、无论”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of being free from another's control or able to act without depending on others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不受他人控制，或能够不依赖他人而自主行动的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat li fih persuna jew pajjiż ma jkunx taħt il-kontroll ta' ħaddieħor jew ikun jista' jaġixxi bla dipendenza fuq oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 独立；自主；不受外部控制或不依赖他人的状态。

formal.mt: Il-programm għandu l-għan li jsaħħaħ l-independenza finanzjarja tal-parteċipanti.
formal.en: The programme aims to strengthen the participants' financial independence.
formal.zh: 该计划旨在增强参与者的经济独立能力。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex trid tħallas il-kera int stess? Ben: Għax irrid aktar indipendenza u nixtieq nimmaniġġja l-flus tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why do you want to pay the rent yourself? Ben: Because I want more independence and would like to manage my own money.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你为什么想自己付房租？本：因为我想更独立，也想自己管理自己的钱。

messages.speaker: Anna (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex trid tħallas il-kera int stess?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex trid tħallas il-kera int stess?
messages.zh: 你为什么想自己付房租？
messages.en: Why do you want to pay the rent yourself?

messages.speaker: Ben (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax irrid aktar indipendenza u nixtieq nimmaniġġja l-flus tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Għax irrid aktar indipendenza u nixtieq nimmaniġġja l-flus tiegħi.
messages.zh: 因为我想更独立，也想自己管理自己的钱。
messages.en: Because I want more independence and would like to manage my own money.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“自己付房租、自己作决定”记住名词“独立”；它指一种状态，可搭配经济、政治等领域。

gloss_zh: 不可减损的；不得豁免的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a rule, duty, or right that cannot be set aside or made subject to an exception.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容规则、义务或权利不得被排除适用、豁免或减损。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jistax jiġi mwarrab jew ikun suġġett għal eċċezzjoni, bħal regola, obbligu jew dritt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不可减损的；不得通过例外安排排除或限制其适用的。

collocations.en: a rule that permits no exceptions

formal.mt: Id-dokument jiddeskrivi dan l-obbligu bħala inderogabbli u ma jipprevedi ebda eċċezzjoni.
formal.en: The document describes this obligation as non-derogable and provides for no exceptions.
formal.zh: 文件将该义务规定为不得豁免的义务，且未设任何例外。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nistgħu nagħmlu eċċezzjoni għal din ir-regola? Rita: Le, fid-dokument hemm miktub li hi inderogabbli.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can we make an exception to this rule? Rita: No, the document says it permits no exceptions.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这条规则能破例吗？丽塔：不能，文件上写明这条规则不得例外豁免。

messages.speaker: Mark (新员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nagħmlu eċċezzjoni għal din ir-regola?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nagħmlu eċċezzjoni għal din ir-regola?
messages.zh: 这条规则能破例吗？
messages.en: Can we make an exception to this rule?

messages.speaker: Rita (主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, fid-dokument hemm miktub li hi inderogabbli.
messages.mt_standard: Le, fid-dokument hemm miktub li hi inderogabbli.
messages.zh: 不能，文件上写明这条规则不得例外豁免。
messages.en: No, the document says it permits no exceptions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象规则旁盖着“不得破例”的章：这个词强调不能豁免或减损，学习时可与 regola 一起记。

gloss_zh: 无法确定的；无法判定的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Impossible to establish, calculate, or identify with certainty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 无法确切查明、计算或判定的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jistax jiġi stabbilit, ikkalkulat jew identifikat b'ċertezza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无法确定的；无法确切查明或判定的。

collocations.zh: 无法确定的数量或金额

formal.mt: Minħabba n-nuqqas ta' dokumenti, l-ammont eżatt tat-telf baqa' indeterminabbli.
formal.en: Because of the lack of documents, the exact amount of the loss remained indeterminable.
formal.zh: 由于缺少文件，损失的确切金额仍无法确定。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tista' tgħid kemm għandu żmien dan l-oġġett? Toni: Le, mingħajr aktar informazzjoni, l-età tiegħu hi indeterminabbli.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you tell how old this object is? Toni: No, without more information, its age is indeterminable.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你能看出这件东西有多少年了吗？托尼：不能，没有更多信息，就无法确定它的年代。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tgħid kemm għandu żmien dan l-oġġett?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tgħid kemm għandu żmien dan l-oġġett?
messages.zh: 你能看出这件东西有多少年了吗？
messages.en: Can you tell how old this object is?

messages.speaker: Toni (古董店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, mingħajr aktar informazzjoni, l-età tiegħu hi indeterminabbli.
messages.mt_standard: Le, mingħajr aktar informazzjoni, l-età tiegħu hi indeterminabbli.
messages.zh: 不能，没有更多信息，就无法确定它的年代。
messages.en: No, without more information, its age is indeterminable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一件没有标签、也没有记录的旧物：年代查不出来，就用这个形容词记“无法确定的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The view that not every event is necessarily determined by prior conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 认为并非每个事件都必然由先前条件决定的观点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fehma li mhux kull ġrajja hija neċessarjament determinata mill-kundizzjonijiet ta' qabilha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非决定论：认为并非所有事件都由先前条件必然决定的观点。

formal.mt: L-istudju jqabbel id-determiniżmu mal-indeterminiżmu u jeżamina jekk kull ġrajja hijiex neċessarjament determinata mill-kundizzjonijiet ta' qabilha.
formal.en: The study compares determinism with indeterminism and examines whether every event is necessarily determined by prior conditions.
formal.zh: 该研究比较决定论与非决定论，并考察每个事件是否都必然由先前条件决定。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu l-indeterminiżmu? Pawlu: Huwa l-fehma li mhux kull ġrajja tkun neċessarjament determinata minn dak li ġie qabilha.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is indeterminism? Pawlu: It is the view that not every event is necessarily determined by what came before it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：什么是非决定论？保罗：就是认为并非每个事件都必然由此前的情况决定的观点。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是非决定论？
messages.en: What is indeterminism?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (哲学教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa l-fehma li mhux kull ġrajja tkun neċessarjament determinata minn dak li ġie qabilha.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa l-fehma li mhux kull ġrajja tkun neċessarjament determinata minn dak li ġie qabilha.
messages.zh: 就是认为并非每个事件都必然由此前的情况决定的观点。
messages.en: It is the view that not every event is necessarily determined by what came before it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“未来是否全由过去必然决定”这个问题记忆；非决定论回答“不一定全部如此”，并非说一切都没有原因。

gloss_zh: 无法辨读的；无法破译的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Impossible to read or decode because the writing or code cannot be understood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因字迹无法辨认或编码无法解读而不能读懂的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jistax jinqara jew jinftiehem għax il-kitba jew il-kodiċi ma jistgħux jiġu deċifrati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无法辨读的；无法解码或破译的。

formal.mt: Il-kitba fuq id-dokument kienet indeċifrabbli minħabba l-ħsara lill-karta.
formal.en: The writing on the document was undecipherable because of damage to the paper.
formal.zh: 由于纸张受损，文件上的字迹已无法辨读。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tista' taqra din in-nota? Għalija hija indeċifrabbli. Luqa: Lanqas jien ma nista' naqraha. Ejja nistaqsu lil min kitebha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you read this note? I find it undecipherable. Luqa: I can't read it either. Let's ask whoever wrote it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你能读出这张便条吗？我完全辨认不出来。Luqa：我也读不出来。我们问问写便条的人吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' taqra din in-nota? Għalija hija indeċifrabbli.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' taqra din in-nota? Għalija hija indeċifrabbli.
messages.zh: 你能读出这张便条吗？我完全辨认不出来。
messages.en: Can you read this note? I find it undecipherable.

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Lanqas jien ma nista' naqraha. Ejja nistaqsu lil min kitebha.
messages.mt_standard: Lanqas jien ma nista' naqraha. Ejja nistaqsu lil min kitebha.
messages.zh: 我也读不出来。我们问问写便条的人吧。
messages.en: I can't read it either. Let's ask whoever wrote it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 indeċifrabbli 配上一张字迹糊成一团的便条：看得到符号，却辨读或破解不了。

gloss_zh: 无可争辩的；不容争议的

teaching_sense.en_definition: So clear or firmly established that it cannot reasonably be disputed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 十分明确或依据充分，以至于无法合理争辩的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tant ċar jew stabbilit sew li ma jistax jiġi kkontestat b'mod raġonevoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无可争辩的；不容争议的。

formal.mt: Ir-rekords juru li l-laqgħa saret nhar it-Tnejn; dan huwa fatt indibattibbli.
formal.en: The records show that the meeting took place on Monday; this is an undebatable fact.
formal.zh: 记录表明会议于星期一举行；这是一个无可争辩的事实。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Int ċert li wasalna tard? Ben: Iva, il-biljett jgħid it-tmienja u dħalna fit-tmienja u nofs; dan hu indibattibbli.
colloquial.en: Anna: Are you sure we arrived late? Ben: Yes, the ticket says eight o'clock and we went in at half past eight; that is undebatable.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你确定我们迟到了吗？本：确定，票上写的是八点，我们八点半才进去；这一点无可争辩。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你确定我们迟到了吗？
messages.en: Are you sure we arrived late?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
