messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-biljett jgħid it-tmienja u dħalna fit-tmienja u nofs; dan hu indibattibbli.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-biljett jgħid it-tmienja u dħalna fit-tmienja u nofs; dan hu indibattibbli.
messages.zh: 确定，票上写的是八点，我们八点半才进去；这一点无可争辩。
messages.en: Yes, the ticket says eight o'clock and we went in at half past eight; that is undebatable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象票面时间与入场记录都摆在眼前，事实清清楚楚；把 fatt indibattibbli 整块记作“无可争辩的事实”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way that shows little interest, concern, or preference.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以缺乏兴趣、关心或明显偏好的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li juri ftit interess jew tħassib, jew mingħajr preferenza ċara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冷淡地；漠不关心地；无所谓地。

formal.mt: Meta ġie mistoqsi dwar il-problema, ir-rappreżentant wieġeb indifferentement.
formal.en: When asked about the problem, the representative answered indifferently.
formal.zh: 被问及这个问题时，代表冷淡地作了回答。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex weġibtni indifferentement? Mark: Skużani, kont distratt. Għidli mill-ġdid.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you answer me so indifferently? Mark: Sorry, I was distracted. Tell me again.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么那么冷淡地回答我？Mark：抱歉，我刚才走神了。你再说一遍。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么那么冷淡地回答我？
messages.en: Why did you answer me so indifferently?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 抱歉，我刚才走神了。你再说一遍。
messages.en: Sorry, I was distracted. Tell me again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象对方听完消息只冷淡地耸肩：用 indifferentement 描述他回答时的态度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing little interest or concern, or having no particular preference.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现得缺乏兴趣或关心，或者没有特别偏好的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jurix interess jew tħassib, jew li ma jkollux preferenza partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 漠不关心的；冷淡的；对选择无所谓的。

collocations.zh: 对他人的痛苦漠不关心

formal.mt: Ħadd m'għandu jibqa' indifferenti għat-tbatija ta' persuni vulnerabbli.
formal.en: No one should remain indifferent to the suffering of vulnerable people.
formal.zh: 任何人都不应对弱势群体的痛苦无动于衷。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex tidher daqshekk indifferenti dwar il-festa? Pawlu: M'iniex indifferenti; għadni għajjien mix-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do you seem so indifferent about the party? Pawlu: I'm not indifferent; I'm still tired from work.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你怎么看起来对聚会这么不上心？Pawlu：我并不是不上心，只是工作后还很累。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tidher daqshekk indifferenti dwar il-festa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tidher daqshekk indifferenti dwar il-festa?
messages.zh: 你怎么看起来对聚会这么不上心？
messages.en: Why do you seem so indifferent about the party?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我并不是不上心，只是工作后还很累。
messages.en: I'm not indifferent; I'm still tired from work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 indifferenti 配上一个毫无反应的表情，记住它描述人或态度的冷淡、无所谓。

gloss_zh: 无差别论；宗教冷漠主义

teaching_sense.en_definition: The view or attitude that differences between religious beliefs are unimportant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 认为不同宗教信仰之间的差异并不重要的观点或态度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fehma jew l-attitudni li d-differenzi bejn twemmin reliġjuż differenti mhumiex importanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无差别论；尤指认为宗教信仰之间的差异无关紧要的观点或态度。

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddistingwi bejn ir-rispett lejn twemmin differenti u l-indifferentiżmu reliġjuż.
formal.en: The author distinguishes between respect for different beliefs and religious indifferentism.
formal.zh: 作者区分了尊重不同信仰与宗教无差别论。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser indifferentiżmu f'dan it-test? Ben: Hawn ifisser il-fehma li d-differenzi bejn ir-reliġjonijiet mhumiex importanti.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does indifferentism mean in this text? Ben: Here it means the view that differences between religions are unimportant.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这篇文章里的无差别论是什么意思？Ben：这里指认为各宗教之间的差异并不重要的观点。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的无差别论是什么意思？
messages.en: What does indifferentism mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ifisser il-fehma li d-differenzi bejn ir-reliġjonijiet mhumiex importanti.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ifisser il-fehma li d-differenzi bejn ir-reliġjonijiet mhumiex importanti.
messages.zh: 这里指认为各宗教之间的差异并不重要的观点。
messages.en: Here it means the view that differences between religions are unimportant.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进宗教观点讨论中记忆：关注的是如何看待信仰差异，而非某一次冷淡的回答。

gloss_zh: 汽车转向灯；方向指示灯

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flashing light on a vehicle used to show an intended turn or change of lane.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 车辆上通过闪烁表示即将转弯或变换车道的灯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dawl fuq vettura li jteptep biex juri li s-sewwieq se jdur jew jibdel il-karreġġjata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 车辆的转向灯；用于示意转弯或变换车道的闪光指示灯。

formal.mt: Is-sewwieq xegħel l-indikejter tal-lemin qabel ma dar fil-kantuniera.
formal.en: The driver switched on the right turn signal before turning the corner.
formal.zh: 司机在拐弯前打开了右转向灯。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ixgħel l-indikejter; se nduru lejn ix-xellug. Mark: Diġà mixgħul. Qed niċċekkja l-mera.
colloquial.en: Rita: Put on the turn signal; we're turning left. Mark: It's already on. I'm checking the mirror.
colloquial.zh: Rita：打开转向灯，我们要向左转。Mark：已经打开了。我正在看后视镜。

messages.speaker: Rita (驾驶教练)

messages.speaker: Mark (学车学员)

messages.en: It's already on. I'm checking the mirror.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 indikejter 和汽车转弯前滴答闪烁的灯联系起来，边想象拨动拨杆边记词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Through another person, thing, or step, or without expressing something directly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过其他人、事物或中间环节；也指不直接表达而以暗示等方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Permezz ta' persuna, ħaġa jew pass ieħor, jew mingħajr ma wieħed jesprimi xi ħaġa b'mod dirett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 间接地；通过中间环节地；以不直接明说的方式。

formal.mt: Iż-żieda fl-ispiża tat-trasport tista' taffettwa indirettament il-prezz tal-prodotti.
formal.en: An increase in transport costs can indirectly affect product prices.
formal.zh: 运输成本的增加可能间接影响产品价格。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qallek direttament li għandu bżonn l-għajnuna? Pawlu: Le, qallu indirettament billi semma kemm għandu xogħol.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did he tell you directly that he needs help? Pawlu: No, he said it indirectly by mentioning how much work he has.
colloquial.zh: Sara：他直接告诉你他需要帮忙了吗？Pawlu：没有，他提起自己有多少工作，间接表达了这个意思。

messages.zh: 没有，他提起自己有多少工作，间接表达了这个意思。
messages.en: No, he said it indirectly by mentioning how much work he has.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条经过中间点才到达终点的箭头，用 indirettament 记住间接传递、影响或表达。

gloss_zh: 难消化的；令人难以忍受的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Difficult to digest; also used of a person who is unpleasant or hard to tolerate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 食物难以消化的；也可形容一个人讨厌或令人难以忍受。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun diffiċli biex jiġi diġerit; jingħad ukoll għal persuna li tkun diffiċli biex tissaportiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 难消化的；不易被消化的。
形容人讨厌、难相处或令人难以忍受的。

formal.mt: L-ikel tqil u indiġest jista' jikkawża skumdità wara l-ikla.
formal.en: Heavy, indigestible food can cause discomfort after a meal.
formal.zh: 油腻而难消化的食物可能使人餐后感到不适。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif marret il-laqgħa ma' dak ir-raġel? Mark: Kien indiġest; qatta' l-ħin kollu jilmenta.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the meeting with that man go? Mark: He was unbearable; he spent the whole time complaining.
colloquial.zh: Maja：跟那个男人见面怎么样？Mark：他真让人受不了，全程都在抱怨。

messages.mt_spoken: Kif marret il-laqgħa ma' dak ir-raġel?

messages.en: He was unbearable; he spent the whole time complaining.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面并排记忆：食物让胃难受，人让相处难受；分别对应难消化与难以忍受。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Difficult or impossible for the digestive system to break down.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 消化系统难以或无法分解消化的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun diffiċli jew impossibbli għas-sistema diġestiva biex tkissru u tiddiġerih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 难消化的；不能被消化的。

formal.mt: Il-kampjun fih materjal indiġestibbli li ma jitkissirx waqt id-diġestjoni.
formal.en: The sample contains indigestible material that is not broken down during digestion.
formal.zh: 样本含有在消化过程中无法被分解的物质。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex neħħejt dik il-parti? Pawlu: Għax hi iebsa ħafna u għalija indiġestibbli.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you remove that part? Pawlu: Because it's very tough and I find it indigestible.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么把那一部分去掉了？Pawlu：因为它太硬，我消化不了。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being difficult or impossible to digest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 食物或物质难以或无法被消化的性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-karatteristika ta' ikel jew materjal li jkun diffiċli jew impossibbli biex jiġi diġerit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 难消化性；不可消化性，即某物不易或不能被消化的性质。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina l-indiġestibilità ta' ċerti komponenti tal-ikel.
formal.en: The report examines the indigestibility of certain food components.
formal.zh: 报告研究了某些食物成分的不可消化性。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser indiġestibilità? Ben: Tfisser kemm ikun diffiċli jew impossibbli li xi ħaġa tiġi diġerita.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does indigestibility mean? Ben: It means how difficult or impossible something is to digest.
colloquial.zh: Lara：难消化性是什么意思？Ben：就是说某种东西有多难消化，或者根本无法消化。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)

messages.en: What does indigestibility mean?

messages.en: It means how difficult or impossible something is to digest.

formal.mt: L-istudenti ħejjew preżentazzjoni dwar l-Indja għall-lezzjoni tal-ġeografija.
