messages.en: Yes, I have a book for you.

messages.speaker: Indri (同学)
messages.zh: 非常感谢！
messages.en: Thank you very much!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张双语姓名牌，一面写 Indri，另一面写 Andrew；再朗读 Jien Indri「我是因德里」，把它作为人名整体记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop industry in a country or region, or to make its economy more industrial.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使一个国家或地区发展工业，使其经济更多地转向工业生产。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiżviluppa l-industrija f'pajjiż jew reġjun, jew jagħmel l-ekonomija tiegħu aktar industrijali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使工业化；在国家或地区发展工业。

collocations.zh: 他使该国实现了工业化
他使该地区实现了工业化

formal.mt: Il-gvern industrijalizza r-reġjun billi investa f'fabbriki ġodda u fit-taħriġ tal-ħaddiema.
formal.en: The government industrialized the region by investing in new factories and worker training.
formal.zh: 政府通过投资新工厂和工人培训，使该地区实现了工业化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel il-gvern f'dan ir-reġjun? Pawlu: Industrijalizza r-reġjun u fetaħ fabbriki ġodda. Maja: Inħoloq xogħol ġdid? Pawlu: Iva, ħafna nies sabu xogħol hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did the government do in this region? Pawlu: It industrialized the region and opened new factories. Maja: Were new jobs created? Pawlu: Yes, many people found work there.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：政府在这个地区做了什么？保罗：政府使该地区实现了工业化，并开设了新工厂。玛雅：创造了新的就业机会吗？保罗：是的，很多人在那里找到了工作。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 政府在这个地区做了什么？
messages.en: What did the government do in this region?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Industrijalizza r-reġjun u fetaħ fabbriki ġodda.
messages.mt_standard: Industrijalizza r-reġjun u fetaħ fabbriki ġodda.
messages.zh: 政府使该地区实现了工业化，并开设了新工厂。
messages.en: It industrialized the region and opened new factories.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 创造了新的就业机会吗？
messages.en: Were new jobs created?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħafna nies sabu xogħol hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħafna nies sabu xogħol hemm.
messages.zh: 是的，很多人在那里找到了工作。
messages.en: Yes, many people found work there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一幅「地区增加工厂」的前后对照图记 industrijalizza，把注意力放在「使某地发生工业化」这个动作，并配记 r-reġjun「该地区」作为动作对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process by which a country or region develops industry and becomes more dependent on industrial production.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个国家或地区发展工业、使工业生产在经济中占据更大比重的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih pajjiż jew reġjun jiżviluppa l-industrija u jiddependi aktar fuq il-produzzjoni industrijali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 工业化，即发展工业并使经济更多地转向工业生产的过程。

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina kif l-industrijalizzazzjoni bidlet l-ekonomija tar-reġjun u żiedet il-ħtieġa għat-taħriġ tekniku.
formal.en: The study examines how industrialization changed the region's economy and increased the need for technical training.
formal.zh: 该研究考察工业化如何改变了该地区的经济，并增加了对技术培训的需求。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'tfisser industrijalizzazzjoni? Mark: Il-proċess li bih pajjiż jiżviluppa l-industrija. Sara: Bħal meta jinfetħu aktar fabbriki? Mark: Iva, dak jista' jkun parti mill-proċess.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does industrialization mean? Mark: The process by which a country develops industry. Sara: Like when more factories open? Mark: Yes, that can be part of the process.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：工业化是什么意思？马克：就是一个国家发展工业的过程。萨拉：比如开设更多工厂？马克：是的，那可以是这个过程的一部分。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 工业化是什么意思？
messages.en: What does industrialization mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-proċess li bih pajjiż jiżviluppa l-industrija.
messages.mt_standard: Il-proċess li bih pajjiż jiżviluppa l-industrija.
messages.zh: 就是一个国家发展工业的过程。
messages.en: The process by which a country develops industry.

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 比如开设更多工厂？
messages.en: Like when more factories open?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak jista' jkun parti mill-proċess.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak jista' jkun parti mill-proċess.
messages.zh: 是的，那可以是这个过程的一部分。
messages.en: Yes, that can be part of the process.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 industrijalizzazzjoni 放在一条逐步增加工厂的时间轴上，记住它是「工业化这个过程」；与表示实施动作的 industrijalizza 成对复习。

gloss_zh: 工业主义；以工业生产为核心的社会经济体系

teaching_sense.en_definition: A social and economic system in which industry and factory production have a central role.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 工业主义，指工业及工厂生产在社会和经济中占据核心地位的体系或组织方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema soċjali u ekonomika li fiha l-industrija u l-produzzjoni fil-fabbriki għandhom rwol ċentrali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 工业主义；以工业及工厂生产为核心的社会经济体系。

formal.mt: L-esej janalizza l-effetti tal-industrijaliżmu fuq ix-xogħol u l-ħajja fil-bliet.
formal.en: The essay analyses the effects of industrialism on work and urban life.
formal.zh: 这篇文章分析工业主义对工作和城市生活的影响。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dwar xiex qed tikteb? Mark: Dwar l-industrijaliżmu. Sara: Se titkellem fuq il-fabbriki biss? Mark: Le, anki fuq ix-xogħol u l-ħajja tan-nies.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are you writing about? Mark: Industrialism. Sara: Will you talk only about factories? Mark: No, also about people's work and lives.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你在写什么主题？马克：工业主义。萨拉：你只会谈工厂吗？马克：不会，也会谈人们的工作和生活。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你在写什么主题？
messages.en: What are you writing about?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 工业主义。
messages.en: Industrialism.

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你只会谈工厂吗？
messages.en: Will you talk only about factories?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, anki fuq ix-xogħol u l-ħajja tan-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Le, anki fuq ix-xogħol u l-ħajja tan-nies.
messages.zh: 不会，也会谈人们的工作和生活。
messages.en: No, also about people's work and lives.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 industrijaliżmu 配上一幅「工厂处于社会中心」的概念图，记它表示工业占核心地位的体系；再与表示变化过程的「工业化」分开记忆。

gloss_zh: 勤奋的；勤勉的；努力工作的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Working hard and showing steady effort and diligence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人工作或学习勤奋，持续投入努力，做事勤勉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaħdem jew jistudja b'ħafna ħeġġa, sforz u diliġenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 勤奋的，努力工作的，勤勉的。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, l-għalliem iddeskriva lil Mark bħala student industrijuż li jlesti x-xogħol tiegħu fil-ħin.
formal.en: In his report, the teacher described Mark as a diligent student who completes his work on time.
formal.zh: 老师在报告中把马克描述为一名勤奋、按时完成作业的学生。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sejjer Mark fl-iskola? Pawlu: Tajjeb ħafna. Huwa student industrijuż. Maja: Jistudja kuljum? Pawlu: Iva, u dejjem jipprepara għal-lezzjonijiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is Mark doing at school? Pawlu: Very well. He's a diligent student. Maja: Does he study every day? Pawlu: Yes, and he always prepares for lessons.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克在学校表现怎么样？保罗：很好。他是个勤奋的学生。玛雅：他每天都学习吗？保罗：是的，而且他总会为上课做好准备。

messages.speaker: Maja (家长朋友)
messages.zh: 马克在学校表现怎么样？
messages.en: How is Mark doing at school?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 很好。他是个勤奋的学生。
messages.en: Very well. He's a diligent student.

messages.speaker: Maja (家长朋友)
messages.zh: 他每天都学习吗？
messages.en: Does he study every day?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 是的，而且他总会为上课做好准备。
messages.en: Yes, and he always prepares for lessons.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一名每天认真预习、按时完成作业的学生，在旁边写 student industrijuż；用具体的勤奋行为记住这个形容人的词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Using time or resources poorly, or failing to produce the intended result.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 浪费时间或资源、办事效率低的；也可指不能产生预期效果的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaħli ħin jew riżorsi, jew li ma jagħtix ir-riżultat mixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 效率低的；消耗较多时间、精力或资源却完成较少工作的。
无效的；不能达到预期目的或产生预期效果的。

formal.mt: Il-proċess attwali huwa ineffiċjenti: l-istess informazzjoni tiddaħħal tliet darbiet, u kull talba tieħu wisq ħin.
formal.en: The current process is inefficient: the same information is entered three times, and each request takes too long.
formal.zh: 目前的流程效率很低：同样的信息要录入三次，每项申请都耗时过长。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għadek qed timla dawk il-formoli? Mark: Iva, dan il-proċess hu ineffiċjenti. Qed nikteb l-istess affarijiet għal darb'oħra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you still filling in those forms? Mark: Yes, this process is inefficient. I'm writing the same things all over again.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你还在填那些表格吗？马克：是啊，这个流程效率太低了。同样的内容我又得写一遍。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你还在填那些表格吗？
messages.en: Are you still filling in those forms?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dan il-proċess hu ineffiċjenti. Qed nikteb l-istess affarijiet għal darb'oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dan il-proċess hu ineffiċjenti. Qed nikteb l-istess affarijiet għal darb'oħra.
messages.zh: 是啊，这个流程效率太低了。同样的内容我又得写一遍。
messages.en: Yes, this process is inefficient. I'm writing the same things all over again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面区分义项：重复填表却进展缓慢是“效率低”，反复尝试仍达不到目的是“无效”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The poor use of time, effort, or resources when doing a task.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 完成任务时未能有效利用时间、精力或资源的状况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' effiċjenza fl-użu tal-ħin, tal-isforz jew tar-riżorsi biex isir xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 低效率；因时间、精力或资源利用不当而造成的效率低下。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika l-ineffiċjenza amministrattiva bħala kawża ewlenija tad-dewmien u jipproponi proċeduri aktar sempliċi.
formal.en: The report identifies administrative inefficiency as a major cause of delays and proposes simpler procedures.
formal.zh: 报告指出，行政效率低下是延误的主要原因之一，并提出简化程序。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex domna siegħa biex niġbru pakkett wieħed? Toni: Minħabba l-ineffiċjenza. Bagħtuna minn kju għal ieħor bla bżonn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did it take us an hour to collect one parcel? Toni: Because of inefficiency. They sent us from one queue to another for no reason.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：取一个包裹怎么花了我们一个小时？托尼：因为办事效率低。他们让我们毫无必要地换队排。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex domna siegħa biex niġbru pakkett wieħed?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex domna siegħa biex niġbru pakkett wieħed?
messages.zh: 取一个包裹怎么花了我们一个小时？
messages.en: Why did it take us an hour to collect one parcel?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba l-ineffiċjenza. Bagħtuna minn kju għal ieħor bla bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba l-ineffiċjenza. Bagħtuna minn kju għal ieħor bla bżonn.
messages.zh: 因为办事效率低。他们让我们毫无必要地换队排。
messages.en: Because of inefficiency. They sent us from one queue to another for no reason.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把排错队、重复办理、白白耗时合成一幅画面；这个名词指整体现象“效率低下”。

gloss_zh: 不具资格；不符合资格条件

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of not meeting the conditions required to apply, participate, or receive something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 未达到申请、参与或获得某物所需条件的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' min ma jissodisfax il-kundizzjonijiet meħtieġa biex japplika, jipparteċipa jew jirċievi xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不具资格；因未满足规定条件而没有申请、参与或领取资格的状态。

collocations.zh: 不具备获得该项补助的资格

formal.mt: L-ittra tispjega li l-ineleġibbilità tal-applikant għall-għotja hija dovuta għan-nuqqas tal-esperjenza meħtieġa.
formal.en: The letter explains that the applicant's ineligibility for the grant is due to a lack of the required experience.
formal.zh: 信中说明，申请人因缺少规定的经验而不具备获得该项补助的资格。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ma nistax nieħu sehem? Fl-ittra hemm miktub 'ineleġibbilità'. David: Jiġifieri ma tissodisfax il-kundizzjonijiet. Għal dan il-kors trid tkun għalaqt tmintax-il sena.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why can't I take part? The letter says 'ineligibility'. David: It means you don't meet the conditions. For this course, you need to be at least eighteen.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：为什么我不能参加？信里写着“不符合资格”。戴维：意思是你没有达到规定条件。这个课程要求年满十八岁。

messages.speaker: Nina (申请人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistax nieħu sehem? Fl-ittra hemm miktub 'ineleġibbilità'.
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistax nieħu sehem? Fl-ittra hemm miktub 'ineleġibbilità'.
messages.zh: 为什么我不能参加？信里写着“不符合资格”。
messages.en: Why can't I take part? The letter says 'ineligibility'.

messages.speaker: David (课程工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri ma tissodisfax il-kundizzjonijiet. Għal dan il-kors trid tkun għalaqt tmintax-il sena.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri ma tissodisfax il-kundizzjonijiet. Għal dan il-kors trid tkun għalaqt tmintax-il sena.
messages.zh: 意思是你没有达到规定条件。这个课程要求年满十八岁。
messages.en: It means you don't meet the conditions. For this course, you need to be at least eighteen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象报名表旁有一张资格清单，其中一项未达标；用“条件未满足”记住这个表示资格状态的名词。

gloss_zh: 无可非议的；挑不出毛病的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not open to reasonable objection or criticism.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有合理理由可以反对或批评的；无可非议的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jagħtix lok għal oġġezzjoni jew kritika ġustifikata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无可非议的；没有合理理由可以反对的。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat qies l-argument bħala ineċċepibbli, għax kull punt kien sostnut minn evidenza ċara.
formal.en: The committee considered the argument beyond reasonable objection because every point was supported by clear evidence.
formal.zh: 委员会认为这一论证无可非议，因为每一点都有明确证据支持。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taħseb li xi ħadd jista' jsib xi jgħid fuq dan l-argument? Pawlu: Ma naħsibx. Għalija hu ineċċepibbli; kull punt hu spjegat sew.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you think anyone could find fault with this argument? Pawlu: I don't think so. To me it's beyond reasonable objection; every point is well explained.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得有人能挑出这个论证的毛病吗？保罗：我觉得不能。在我看来，它无可非议；每一点都解释得很清楚。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li xi ħadd jista' jsib xi jgħid fuq dan l-argument?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li xi ħadd jista' jsib xi jgħid fuq dan l-argument?
messages.zh: 你觉得有人能挑出这个论证的毛病吗？
messages.en: Do you think anyone could find fault with this argument?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma naħsibx. Għalija hu ineċċepibbli; kull punt hu spjegat sew.
messages.mt_standard: Ma naħsibx. Għalija hu ineċċepibbli; kull punt hu spjegat sew.
messages.zh: 我觉得不能。在我看来，它无可非议；每一点都解释得很清楚。
messages.en: I don't think so. To me it's beyond reasonable objection; every point is well explained.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师逐点检查一份论证，最后找不到合理的反对意见，用这个画面记住“无可非议的”。

gloss_zh: 不确切的；不精确的；不准确的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not exact, precise, or correct in its details.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在数值、描述或其他细节上不够确切、精确或准确的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li mhuwiex eżatt, preċiż jew korrett fid-dettalji tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不确切的；不精确的；与实际情况或正确数值不符的。

formal.mt: Il-kejl irreġistrat fir-rapport kien ineżatt, għalhekk it-tim reġa' kejjel it-tul tal-kamra qabel ordna l-għamara.
formal.en: The measurement recorded in the report was inaccurate, so the team measured the room's length again before ordering the furniture.
formal.zh: 报告记录的测量结果不准确，因此团队在订购家具之前重新测量了房间的长度。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Skont il-kalkolu tiegħi, irridu għoxrin maduma. Luqa: Naħseb li l-kalkolu hu ineżatt. Ejja nkejlu l-art mill-ġdid.
colloquial.en: Emma: According to my calculation, we need twenty tiles. Luqa: I think the calculation is inaccurate. Let's measure the floor again.
colloquial.zh: 埃玛：按我的计算，我们需要二十块地砖。卢卡：我觉得这个计算不准确。我们再量一下地面吧。

messages.speaker: Emma (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Skont il-kalkolu tiegħi, irridu għoxrin maduma.
messages.mt_standard: Skont il-kalkolu tiegħi, irridu għoxrin maduma.
messages.zh: 按我的计算，我们需要二十块地砖。
messages.en: According to my calculation, we need twenty tiles.

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li l-kalkolu hu ineżatt. Ejja nkejlu l-art mill-ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li l-kalkolu hu ineżatt. Ejja nkejlu l-art mill-ġdid.
messages.zh: 我觉得这个计算不准确。我们再量一下地面吧。
messages.en: I think the calculation is inaccurate. Let's measure the floor again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象尺子没有对准起点，读出的数值偏了一点；用这个画面记住形容词“不准确的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lack of accuracy, or a detail that is incorrect or imprecise.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 内容或测量缺乏准确性的情况，也可指其中某个错误或不精确的细节。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' eżattezza, jew dettall li mhuwiex korrett jew preċiż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不准确；失实或不精确的情况，也可指一处不准确的内容。

collocations.zh: 报告中的一处不准确内容

formal.mt: L-editur sab ineżattezza fid-data tal-avveniment u kkoreġieha qabel il-pubblikazzjoni tal-artiklu.
formal.en: The editor found an inaccuracy in the date of the event and corrected it before the article was published.
formal.zh: 编辑发现活动日期有一处错误，并在文章发表之前进行了更正。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kollox sew fl-avviż? Ġanni: Hemm ineżattezza żgħira: il-laqgħa tibda fid-disgħa, mhux fl-għaxra.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is everything correct in the notice? Ġanni: There's a small inaccuracy: the meeting starts at nine, not ten.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：通知上的内容都对吗？詹尼：有一处小错误：会议九点开始，不是十点。

messages.speaker: Marija (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 通知上的内容都对吗？
messages.en: Is everything correct in the notice?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm ineżattezza żgħira: il-laqgħa tibda fid-disgħa, mhux fl-għaxra.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm ineżattezza żgħira: il-laqgħa tibda fid-disgħa, mhux fl-għaxra.
messages.zh: 有一处小错误：会议九点开始，不是十点。
messages.en: There's a small inaccuracy: the meeting starts at nine, not ten.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把通知里写错的时间圈出来：圈中的“一处不准确内容”就是这个名词，也可用它谈整体的不准确。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not existing or not present at all.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根本不存在或完全没有的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jeżistix jew li mhuwiex preżenti affattu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不存在的；完全没有的。

formal.mt: Il-pakkett intbagħat lura għax fuq it-tikketta kien hemm indirizz ineżistenti.
formal.en: The parcel was returned because the label bore a nonexistent address.
formal.zh: 包裹被退回，因为标签上写的是一个不存在的地址。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Sibt id-dar bin-numru mija u għoxrin? Samwel: Le, dak in-numru hu ineżistenti f'din it-triq. Id-djar jaslu biss sa mija.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did you find house number one hundred and twenty? Samwel: No, that number is nonexistent on this street. The house numbers only go up to one hundred.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你找到一百二十号那栋房子了吗？萨姆韦尔：没有，这条街根本没有这个门牌号。这里的门牌号只到一百号。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibt id-dar bin-numru mija u għoxrin?
messages.mt_standard: Sibt id-dar bin-numru mija u għoxrin?
messages.zh: 你找到一百二十号那栋房子了吗？
messages.en: Did you find house number one hundred and twenty?

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dak in-numru hu ineżistenti f'din it-triq. Id-djar jaslu biss sa mija.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dak in-numru hu ineżistenti f'din it-triq. Id-djar jaslu biss sa mija.
messages.zh: 没有，这条街根本没有这个门牌号。这里的门牌号只到一百号。
messages.en: No, that number is nonexistent on this street. The house numbers only go up to one hundred.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象沿街寻找一个根本没有设置的门牌号，用“查遍也不存在”记住这个词的含义。

gloss_zh: 不会出错的；绝对可靠的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Incapable of making a mistake or failing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不会犯错或失败的；在判断或效果上绝对可靠的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jistax jiżbalja jew ifalli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不会犯错的；不会失败的；绝对可靠的。

formal.mt: L-ebda metodu ta' verifika mhu infallibbli; għalhekk ir-riżultati għandhom jiġu kkontrollati minn persuna oħra.
formal.en: No verification method is infallible; therefore, the results should be checked by another person.
formal.zh: 没有任何核验方法能够保证绝不出错，因此结果应由另一人复核。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Int dejjem taf it-tweġiba t-tajba! Pietru: Mhux dejjem; m'iniex infallibbli. Ejja niċċekkjawha flimkien.
colloquial.en: Anna: You always know the right answer! Pietru: Not always; I'm not infallible. Let's check it together.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你总是知道正确答案！彼得：也不是每次都知道，我也会出错。我们一起核对一下吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 你总是知道正确答案！
messages.en: You always know the right answer!

messages.speaker: Pietru (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mhux dejjem; m'iniex infallibbli. Ejja niċċekkjawha flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Mhux dejjem; m'iniex infallibbli. Ejja niċċekkjawha flimkien.
messages.zh: 也不是每次都知道，我也会出错。我们一起核对一下吧。
messages.en: Not always; I'm not infallible. Let's check it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象答题记录上每一道都打勾，用“绝不出错”记住它；练习句“我也会出错”可帮助掌握否定语境。

gloss_zh: 绝无差错地；万无一失地

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way that cannot be wrong or fail.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以不会出错或不会失败的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li ma jistax ikun żbaljat jew ifalli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绝无差错地；不会失败地。

formal.mt: L-ebda mudell ma jista' jbassar infallibilment kull bidla fit-temp.
formal.en: No model can infallibly predict every change in the weather.
formal.zh: 没有任何模型能毫无差错地预测天气的每一次变化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-arloġġ jaħdem infallibilment? Pawlu: Le, xi drabi jieqaf.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this clock work without fail? Pawlu: No, it sometimes stops.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个钟运行起来绝不会出问题吗？保罗：不会，它有时会停。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个钟运行起来绝不会出问题吗？
messages.en: Does this clock work without fail?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 不会，它有时会停。
messages.en: No, it sometimes stops.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放在“预测、判断、运行”等动作后记忆：动作做得绝无差错，就是 infallibilment。

gloss_zh: 绝无谬误性；不会出错的特性

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being unable to make mistakes or be wrong.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不会犯错或作出错误判断的特性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità li wieħed ma jistax jiżbalja jew jagħti ġudizzju żbaljat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绝无谬误性；不可能犯错的特性。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ċaħad kull pretensjoni ta' infallibiltà u aċċetta li d-deċiżjonijiet tiegħu setgħu jkunu żbaljati.
formal.en: The committee rejected any claim to infallibility and accepted that its decisions could be wrong.
formal.zh: 委员会否认自己绝不会出错，并承认其决定可能有误。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'tfisser infallibiltà? Mark: Tfisser li wieħed ma jistax jiżbalja; mhijiex biss preċiżjoni kbira.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does infallibility mean? Mark: It means being unable to make mistakes; it is more than just great accuracy.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：绝无谬误性是什么意思？马克：意思是不可能犯错；它不仅仅是准确度很高。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 绝无谬误性是什么意思？
messages.en: What does infallibility mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li wieħed ma jistax jiżbalja; mhijiex biss preċiżjoni kbira.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li wieħed ma jistax jiżbalja; mhijiex biss preċiżjoni kbira.
messages.zh: 意思是不可能犯错；它不仅仅是准确度很高。
messages.en: It means being unable to make mistakes; it is more than just great accuracy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“绝不出错这一性质”记名词 infallibiltà，再与表示“绝无差错地”的副词配对区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who murders an infant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 杀害婴儿的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li toqtol tarbija apposta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 杀婴者；实施杀婴行为的人。

collocations.en: the trial of the infant killer

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, l-infantiċida jiġi arrestat wara investigazzjoni twila.
formal.en: In the novel, the infant killer is arrested after a lengthy investigation.
formal.zh: 在小说中，杀婴者经过长期调查后被捕。

colloquial.mt: Lara: F'din is-sentenza, infantiċida tfisser persuna? Toni: Iva, persuna li toqtol tarbija apposta.
colloquial.en: Lara: In this sentence, does infantiċida mean a person? Toni: Yes, a person who deliberately kills an infant.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：在这个句子里，infantiċida 指的是人吗？托尼：是的，指故意杀害婴儿的人。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 在这个句子里，infantiċida 指的是人吗？
messages.en: In this sentence, does infantiċida mean a person?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, persuna li toqtol tarbija apposta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, persuna li toqtol tarbija apposta.
messages.zh: 是的，指故意杀害婴儿的人。
messages.en: Yes, a person who deliberately kills an infant.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 infantiċida 放进“谁被捕了”的人物栏：它指杀婴者；与表示杀婴行为的 infantiċidju 成对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of murdering an infant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 故意杀害婴儿的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li persuna toqtol tarbija apposta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 杀婴；谋杀婴儿的行为。

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina l-prevenzjoni tal-infantiċidju u r-rwol tas-servizzi ta' appoġġ għall-familji.
formal.en: The study examines the prevention of infanticide and the role of family support services.
formal.zh: 该研究探讨杀婴行为的预防，以及家庭支持服务所发挥的作用。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Infantiċidju tfisser il-persuna jew l-att? David: L-att; il-persuna tissejjaħ infantiċida.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does infantiċidju mean the person or the act? David: The act; the person is called an infantiċida.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：infantiċidju 指人还是行为？戴维：指行为；实施这种行为的人叫 infantiċida。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: infantiċidju 指人还是行为？
messages.en: Does infantiċidju mean the person or the act?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.zh: 指行为；实施这种行为的人叫 infantiċida。
messages.en: The act; the person is called an infantiċida.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 infantiċidju 放进“发生了什么”的事件栏：它表示杀婴行为；人物栏则用 infantiċida。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lack of faithfulness to a partner, person, group, or commitment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对伴侣、他人、团体或承诺缺乏忠诚，可指感情上的不忠或一般的背信。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' fedeltà lejn sieħeb jew sieħba, persuna, grupp jew impenn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感情或婚姻中的不忠；背叛伴侣。
不忠诚；对他人、团体或所承担义务的背叛。

collocations.en: an act of disloyalty to the group

formal.mt: Ir-rumanz jesplora l-infedeltà fiż-żwieġ u l-effett tagħha fuq il-fiduċja bejn il-miżżewġin.
formal.en: The novel explores marital infidelity and its effect on trust between spouses.
formal.zh: 这部小说探讨婚姻中的不忠及其对夫妻之间信任的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex fil-ktieb isejħulu att ta' infedeltà lejn il-grupp? Pawlu: Għax żvela s-sigrieti tagħhom lil grupp rivali.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does the book call it an act of disloyalty to the group? Pawlu: Because he revealed their secrets to a rival group.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：书里为什么把这称为背叛团体的行为？保罗：因为他把他们的秘密泄露给了一个敌对团体。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex fil-ktieb isejħulu att ta' infedeltà lejn il-grupp?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex fil-ktieb isejħulu att ta' infedeltà lejn il-grupp?
messages.zh: 书里为什么把这称为背叛团体的行为？
messages.en: Why does the book call it an act of disloyalty to the group?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax żvela s-sigrieti tagħhom lil grupp rivali.
messages.mt_standard: Għax żvela s-sigrieti tagħhom lil grupp rivali.
messages.zh: 因为他把他们的秘密泄露给了一个敌对团体。
messages.en: Because he revealed their secrets to a rival group.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景记同一个核心：背叛伴侣是感情不忠，背叛团体是不忠诚，二者都可用 infedeltà。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who is unfaithful to a partner or disloyal to someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对伴侣不忠或对他人不忠诚的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ma tkunx fidila lejn is-sieħeb jew is-sieħba tagħha jew lejn xi ħadd ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不忠者；对伴侣或他人不忠诚的人。
不忠的；对伴侣或他人缺乏忠诚的。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, l-infidil jitlef il-fiduċja tas-sieħba tiegħu wara li tinkixef ir-relazzjoni sigrieta tiegħu.
formal.en: In the novel, the unfaithful man loses his partner's trust after his secret relationship is exposed.
formal.zh: 在小说中，这名不忠者的秘密恋情曝光后，他失去了伴侣的信任。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-karattru ta' Mark kien infidil lejn martu? Lara: Iva, kellu relazzjoni sigrieta ma' persuna oħra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Was the character Mark unfaithful to his wife? Lara: Yes, he had a secret relationship with someone else.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克这个角色对妻子不忠吗？拉拉：是的，他与另一个人有秘密恋情。

messages.speaker: Sara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-karattru ta' Mark kien infidil lejn martu?
messages.mt_standard: Il-karattru ta' Mark kien infidil lejn martu?
messages.zh: 马克这个角色对妻子不忠吗？
messages.en: Was the character Mark unfaithful to his wife?

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kellu relazzjoni sigrieta ma' persuna oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kellu relazzjoni sigrieta ma' persuna oħra.
messages.zh: 是的，他与另一个人有秘密恋情。
messages.en: Yes, he had a secret relationship with someone else.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用位置区分词性：l-infidil 可指“不忠者”，raġel infidil 中则用来形容丈夫“不忠”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To enter a place or organization secretly in order to gather information or influence it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为获取信息或施加影响而秘密进入某个地方或组织。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jidħol bil-moħbi f'post jew f'organizzazzjoni biex jiġbor informazzjoni jew jinfluwenzaha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 潜入；秘密进入或渗透到某个地方、团体或组织中。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, l-aġent infiltra l-organizzazzjoni biex jiġbor informazzjoni dwar l-attivitajiet tagħha.
formal.en: In the novel, the agent infiltrated the organization to gather information about its activities.
formal.zh: 在小说中，特工潜入该组织，收集有关其活动的信息。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Kif sar jaf il-pulizija x'kien qed jippjana l-grupp fil-film? Nina: Infiltra l-grupp u sema' l-pjan tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Toni: How did the police officer find out what the group was planning in the film? Nina: He infiltrated the group and heard their plan.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：电影里的警察是怎么知道那个团伙在策划什么的？妮娜：他潜入了那个团伙，听到了他们的计划。

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sar jaf il-pulizija x'kien qed jippjana l-grupp fil-film?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sar jaf il-pulizija x'kien qed jippjana l-grupp fil-film?
messages.zh: 电影里的警察是怎么知道那个团伙在策划什么的？
messages.en: How did the police officer find out what the group was planning in the film?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Infiltra l-grupp u sema' l-pjan tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Infiltra l-grupp u sema' l-pjan tagħhom.
messages.zh: 他潜入了那个团伙，听到了他们的计划。
messages.en: He infiltrated the group and heard their plan.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象电影人物悄悄进入团体内部获取消息，把“秘密进入”这个动作与 infiltra 联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The basic physical systems and facilities, such as roads, water supplies, and communication networks, that a society or organization needs to function.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 社会或组织正常运作所需的道路、供水系统、通信网络等基本设施与系统。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-sistemi u l-faċilitajiet bażiċi, bħat-toroq, il-provvista tal-ilma u n-networks tal-komunikazzjoni, li soċjetà jew organizzazzjoni teħtieġ biex taħdem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 基础设施；支撑社会或组织运作的基本设施和系统。

formal.mt: Il-pjan jipproponi investiment fl-infrastruttura tat-trasport biex jitjiebu t-toroq u s-servizzi tal-karozzi tal-linja.
formal.en: The plan proposes investment in transport infrastructure to improve roads and bus services.
formal.zh: 该计划提议投资交通基础设施，以改善道路和公共汽车服务。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Xi jfissru meta jgħidu li r-raħal għandu bżonn infrastruttura aħjar? Maja: Pereżempju, toroq aħjar, pajpijiet tal-ilma ġodda u konnessjoni tal-internet aktar affidabbli.
colloquial.en: Mark: What do they mean when they say the village needs better infrastructure? Maja: For example, better roads, new water pipes, and a more reliable internet connection.
colloquial.zh: 马克：他们说村里需要更好的基础设施，是什么意思？玛雅：比如更好的道路、新的水管，以及更可靠的网络连接。

messages.speaker: Mark (村民)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfissru meta jgħidu li r-raħal għandu bżonn infrastruttura aħjar?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfissru meta jgħidu li r-raħal għandu bżonn infrastruttura aħjar?
messages.zh: 他们说村里需要更好的基础设施，是什么意思？
messages.en: What do they mean when they say the village needs better infrastructure?

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Pereżempju, toroq aħjar, pajpijiet tal-ilma ġodda u konnessjoni tal-internet aktar affidabbli.
messages.mt_standard: Pereżempju, toroq aħjar, pajpijiet tal-ilma ġodda u konnessjoni tal-internet aktar affidabbli.
messages.zh: 比如更好的道路、新的水管，以及更可靠的网络连接。
messages.en: For example, better roads, new water pipes, and a more reliable internet connection.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把道路、水管和通信网络画在同一张城市底图上：支撑日常运作的这些设施合起来就是 infrastruttura。

gloss_zh: 基础设施的；与基础设施有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the basic facilities and systems, such as roads, water supplies and electricity networks, that support a community.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与支撑社会日常运作的道路、供水、电网等基础设施有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-faċilitajiet u s-sistemi bażiċi, bħat-toroq, il-provvista tal-ilma u n-networks tal-elettriku, li teħtieġ komunità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 基础设施的；与基础设施建设或系统有关的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika l-bżonnijiet infrastrutturali tar-raħal, fosthom it-tiswija tat-toroq u t-titjib tal-provvista tal-ilma.
formal.en: The report identifies the village's infrastructure needs, including road repairs and improvements to the water supply.
formal.zh: 报告指出了该村的基础设施需求，包括道路维修和供水改善。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'se jagħmlu f'din it-triq? Pawlu: Dan huwa proġett infrastrutturali; se jibdlu l-pajpijiet tal-ilma.
colloquial.en: Marta: What are they going to do on this street? Pawlu: This is an infrastructure project; they are going to replace the water pipes.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这条街准备做什么工程？保罗：这是基础设施项目，要更换水管。

messages.speaker: Marta (居民)
messages.zh: 这条街准备做什么工程？
messages.en: What are they going to do on this street?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan huwa proġett infrastrutturali; se jibdlu l-pajpijiet tal-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Dan huwa proġett infrastrutturali; se jibdlu l-pajpijiet tal-ilma.
messages.zh: 这是基础设施项目，要更换水管。
messages.en: This is an infrastructure project; they are going to replace the water pipes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把道路、水管和电网画成同一张城市底图，看到 infrastrutturali 就联想到这些基础设施及其相关工程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Happening only occasionally or with long intervals between occurrences.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 只偶尔发生的，或两次发生之间间隔较长的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġri biss kultant jew b'intervalli twal bejn darba u oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不频繁的；偶尔才发生的。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħat tal-kumitat kienu infrekwenti matul is-sena, u għalhekk xi deċiżjonijiet ittieħdu tard.
formal.en: The committee's meetings were infrequent during the year, so some decisions were made late.
formal.zh: 委员会这一年的会议次数较少，因此有些决定作出得较晚。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tmur spiss għand zijutek? Mark: Le, iż-żjarat tiegħi huma infrekwenti għax joqogħdu 'l bogħod.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you visit your aunt and uncle often? Mark: No, my visits are infrequent because they live far away.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你常去看姑姑和姑父吗？马克：不常去，他们住得远，所以我只是偶尔探望。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你常去看姑姑和姑父吗？
messages.en: Do you visit your aunt and uncle often?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, iż-żjarat tiegħi huma infrekwenti għax joqogħdu 'l bogħod.
messages.mt_standard: Le, iż-żjarat tiegħi huma infrekwenti għax joqogħdu 'l bogħod.
messages.zh: 不常去，他们住得远，所以我只是偶尔探望。
messages.en: No, my visits are infrequent because they live far away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历上隔很久才出现一个探访标记，用 infrekwenti 记住次数少、间隔长，注意它并不表示从不发生。

teaching_sense.en_definition: England, one of the constituent countries of the United Kingdom.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 英格兰，构成联合王国的国家之一。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wieħed mill-pajjiżi li jiffurmaw ir-Renju Unit.

sense_translations.en_definition: England (a constituent country of the United Kingdom)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 英格兰，联合王国的组成国之一。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iqabbel is-servizzi tat-trasport f'Malta ma' dawk fl-Ingilterra.
formal.en: The report compares transport services in Malta with those in England.
formal.zh: 报告比较了马耳他与英格兰的交通服务。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn tgħix oħtok? David: Fl-Ingilterra, f'belt qrib Londra.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where does your sister live? David: In England, in a town near London.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你姐姐住在哪里？戴维：在英格兰，伦敦附近的一个城镇。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你姐姐住在哪里？
messages.en: Where does your sister live?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 在英格兰，伦敦附近的一个城镇。
messages.en: In England, in a town near London.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在联合王国地图上单独圈出英格兰，把 Ingilterra 与这一块区域对应；作为地名，书写时首字母大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A covering worn on one hand for warmth, protection or a particular activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 戴在一只手上的覆盖物，用于保暖、防护或特定活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li jintlibes fuq id biex iżommha sħuna, jipproteġiha jew jgħin f'attività partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 手套；戴在手上用于保暖或防护的用品。

formal.mt: L-ingwanta protettiva għandha tkopri l-id kollha u tkun tad-daqs it-tajjeb.
formal.en: The protective glove should cover the whole hand and be the correct size.
formal.zh: 防护手套应覆盖整只手，并且尺寸合适。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Sibt ingwanta waħda biss. Toni: L-oħra tinsab fil-but tal-ġakketta tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Rita: I found only one glove. Toni: The other one is in your jacket pocket.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我只找到一只手套。托尼：另一只在你的夹克口袋里。

messages.speaker: Rita (姐姐)
messages.zh: 我只找到一只手套。
messages.en: I found only one glove.

messages.speaker: Toni (弟弟)
messages.zh: 另一只在你的夹克口袋里。
messages.en: The other one is in your jacket pocket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只手伸进一只手套，用 ingwanta waħda 这一短语帮助记忆：这里说的是一只手套，数手套时别自动当成一双。

gloss_zh: 抑制性的；起抑制作用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the effect of slowing, reducing or preventing an activity or process.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有减慢、减弱或阻止某种活动或过程的作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jnaqqas jew iwaqqaf attività jew proċess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抑制性的；能减弱、减慢或阻止某种活动或过程的。

formal.mt: L-istudju eżamina l-effett inibitorju tas-sustanza fuq it-tkabbir taċ-ċelloli.
formal.en: The study examined the substance's inhibitory effect on cell growth.
formal.zh: 该研究考察了这种物质对细胞生长的抑制作用。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Xi jfisser "effett inibitorju"? Karl: Ifisser li xi ħaġa tnaqqas jew twaqqaf proċess.
colloquial.en: Elena: What does "inhibitory effect" mean? Karl: It means that something slows down or stops a process.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：“抑制作用”是什么意思？卡尔：意思是某种东西使一个过程减慢或停止。

messages.speaker: Elena (学生)
messages.zh: “抑制作用”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does "inhibitory effect" mean?

messages.speaker: Karl (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li xi ħaġa tnaqqas jew twaqqaf proċess.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li xi ħaġa tnaqqas jew twaqqaf proċess.
messages.zh: 意思是某种东西使一个过程减慢或停止。
messages.en: It means that something slows down or stops a process.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给正在运行的过程踩下刹车，速度降低甚至停止；用这个画面记住 inibitorju 的“起抑制作用的”含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To restrain or slow down an activity, process, or response.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 抑制某种活动、过程或反应，使其减弱、减慢或难以发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rażżan jew naqqas attività, proċess jew reazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抑制；阻碍某种过程、活动或反应。

formal.mt: Fl-esperiment, il-kesħa inibixxiet it-tkabbir tal-pjanti.
formal.en: In the experiment, the cold inhibited the growth of the plants.
formal.zh: 在实验中，低温抑制了植物的生长。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex ma tkellimtx waqt il-laqgħa? Pawlu: Il-biża' li niżbalja inibixxieni.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why didn't you speak during the meeting? Pawlu: The fear of making a mistake inhibited me.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你为什么在会上没发言？保罗：我怕说错，这种恐惧让我不敢开口。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么在会上没发言？
messages.en: Why didn't you speak during the meeting?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 我怕说错，这种恐惧让我不敢开口。
messages.en: The fear of making a mistake inhibited me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“给过程踩刹车”的画面：生长、反应或发言受到压制，都可帮助记住“抑制”的意思。

gloss_zh: 无法辨认的；无法确定身份的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Impossible to identify or recognize as a particular person or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 无法辨认出具体是什么，或无法确定其身份的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jistax jiġi identifikat jew magħruf min jew x'inhu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无法辨认的；无法确定身份或类别的。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt deher oġġett inidentifikabbli minħabba l-kwalità baxxa tal-immaġni.
formal.en: An unidentifiable object appeared in the photograph because of the poor image quality.
formal.zh: 由于图像质量较差，照片中出现了一个无法辨认的物体。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak il-ħoss? Mark: Ma nafx; għalija hu inidentifikabbli.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's that sound? Mark: I don't know; I can't identify it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那是什么声音？马克：不知道，我听不出是什么。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 那是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that sound?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 不知道，我听不出是什么。
messages.en: I don't know; I can't identify it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张模糊照片，物体旁边只有问号；把整个词与“看见了却认不出来”一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 肮脏的；虫害侵扰的；淫秽的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dirty; also infested with pests, or obscene when describing language or content.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指物品肮脏、受到害虫侵扰，也可指言语或内容淫秽；具体含义由所描述的对象决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Maħmuġ; jista' jfisser ukoll infestat bil-parassiti, jew oxxen meta jiddeskrivi diskors jew kontenut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肮脏的；不干净的。
受到害虫或寄生虫侵扰的。
淫秽的；猥亵下流的，常用于描述言语或内容。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem neħħa t-tapit inkallat bil-briegħed u naddaf il-kamra.
formal.en: The worker removed the flea-infested carpet and cleaned the room.
formal.zh: 工人移走了有跳蚤侵扰的地毯，并清洁了房间。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Se tilbes dak il-flokk inkallat? Samwel: Le, se nbiddlu qabel noħroġ.
colloquial.en: Rita: Are you going to wear that dirty shirt? Samwel: No, I'll change it before I go out.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你要穿那件脏上衣吗？萨缪尔：不，我出门前会换掉。

messages.speaker: Rita (姐姐)
messages.zh: 你要穿那件脏上衣吗？
messages.en: Are you going to wear that dirty shirt?

messages.speaker: Samwel (弟弟)
messages.zh: 不，我出门前会换掉。
messages.en: No, I'll change it before I go out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张情境卡区分词义：脏衣服、跳蚤地毯、下流言语；看到搭配对象，再选择相应中文义。

gloss_zh: 使神职人员正式隶属教区或修会

teaching_sense.en_definition: To formally attach a member of the clergy to a diocese or religious institute.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使一名神职人员在教会组织中正式隶属于某个教区或修会。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daħħal uffiċjalment membru tal-kleru bħala wieħed li jappartjeni għal djoċesi jew istitut reliġjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使神职人员正式隶属于某教区或修会。

collocations.en: incardinated a priest into the diocese
collocations.zh: 使一名司铎正式隶属于该教区
为一名执事确立正式隶属关系

formal.mt: L-isqof inkardina lis-saċerdot fid-djoċesi wara li tlesta l-proċess meħtieġ.
formal.en: The bishop incardinated the priest into the diocese after the required process was completed.
formal.zh: 在必要程序完成后，主教使这名司铎正式隶属于该教区。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dak is-saċerdot issa jappartjeni għal din id-djoċesi? Ġużeppi: Iva, l-isqof inkardinah hawn.
colloquial.en: Marija: Does that priest now belong to this diocese? Ġużeppi: Yes, the bishop incardinated him here.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：那位司铎现在隶属于这个教区了吗？朱塞佩：是的，主教已经让他正式归属这里。

messages.speaker: Marija (教友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak is-saċerdot issa jappartjeni għal din id-djoċesi?
messages.mt_standard: Dak is-saċerdot issa jappartjeni għal din id-djoċesi?
messages.zh: 那位司铎现在隶属于这个教区了吗？
messages.en: Does that priest now belong to this diocese?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (堂区工作人员)
messages.zh: 是的，主教已经让他正式归属这里。
messages.en: Yes, the bishop incardinated him here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象主教把一位神职人员的姓名正式登记在教区名册中，用“确立归属的动作”记住这个动词。

gloss_zh: 神职人员正式隶属教区或修会的确立

teaching_sense.en_definition: The formal attachment of a member of the clergy to a diocese or religious institute.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 神职人员与某个教区或修会之间正式隶属关系的确立。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-rabta uffiċjali li biha membru tal-kleru jsir jappartjeni għal djoċesi jew istitut reliġjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 神职人员正式隶属于某教区或修会的归属确立。

collocations.zh: 一名司铎正式隶属关系的确立
神职人员正式隶属关系的文件

formal.mt: Id-dokument jikkonferma l-inkardinazzjoni tas-saċerdot fid-djoċesi.
formal.en: The document confirms the priest's incardination into the diocese.
formal.zh: 该文件确认这名司铎正式隶属于该教区。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex għandu bżonn dan id-dokument? David: Biex juri l-inkardinazzjoni tiegħu f'din id-djoċesi.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why does he need this document? David: To show his incardination into this diocese.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：他为什么需要这份文件？戴维：为了证明他正式隶属于这个教区。

messages.speaker: Anna (堂区志愿者)
messages.zh: 他为什么需要这份文件？
messages.en: Why does he need this document?

messages.speaker: David (堂区秘书)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex juri l-inkardinazzjoni tiegħu f'din id-djoċesi.
messages.mt_standard: Biex juri l-inkardinazzjoni tiegħu f'din id-djoċesi.
messages.zh: 为了证明他正式隶属于这个教区。
messages.en: To show his incardination into this diocese.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记成教区档案中“正式归属的确立”这一事项；与动词 inkardina 配对，分别记动作和事项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become angry or annoyed in response to something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某件事情而生气、恼火或发怒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Irrabja jew ħass rabja minħabba xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生气；发怒；变得恼火。

collocations.en: got angry because of the delay

formal.mt: Il-klijent inkazza meta sar jaf li l-kunsinna kienet se tittardja għal darb'oħra.
formal.en: The customer got angry when he learned that the delivery would be delayed again.
formal.zh: 顾客得知送货将再次延误时生气了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex inkazza Mark? Toni: Għax stenna siegħa u ħadd ma kellmu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Mark get angry? Toni: Because he waited an hour and nobody spoke to him.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克为什么生气了？托尼：因为他等了一个小时，却没人理他。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么生气了？
messages.en: Why did Mark get angry?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax stenna siegħa u ħadd ma kellmu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax stenna siegħa u ħadd ma kellmu.
messages.zh: 因为他等了一个小时，却没人理他。
messages.en: Because he waited an hour and nobody spoke to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人久等无人回应，脸色突然变了；用“从平静变生气”的情境记住这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A gesture of respect or acknowledgment made by bending forward at the waist.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过腰部向前弯曲来表示尊敬、致意或谢意的鞠躬动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġest ta' rispett jew ta' tislima li jsir billi wieħed jitgħawweġ 'il quddiem minn qaddu.

sense_translations.en_definition: bow (gesture made by bending forward at the waist)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 鞠躬；腰部向前弯曲以表示敬意或致意的动作。

formal.mt: Fi tmiem il-kunċert, il-pjanista għamel inkin quddiem l-udjenza.
formal.en: At the end of the concert, the pianist made a bow before the audience.
formal.zh: 音乐会结束时，钢琴家向观众鞠了一躬。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'għamilt meta spiċċajt tkanta? Luqa: Għamilt inkin u rringrazzjajt lill-udjenza.
colloquial.en: Nina: What did you do when you finished singing? Luqa: I made a bow and thanked the audience.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：唱完之后你做了什么？卢卡：我鞠了一躬，并感谢了观众。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 唱完之后你做了什么？
messages.en: What did you do when you finished singing?

messages.speaker: Luqa (歌手)
messages.zh: 我鞠了一躬，并感谢了观众。
messages.en: I made a bow and thanked the audience.

cognitive_memory_aid: 定格演员谢幕时弯腰的画面：inkin 是“一个鞠躬”这个名词，常与 għamel 搭配记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bend forward as a gesture of respect or deference.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向前弯身鞠躬，以表示尊敬或恭敬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħawweġ 'il quddiem bħala ġest ta' rispett jew qima.

sense_translations.en_definition: to bow (to bend oneself as a gesture of respect or deference)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 鞠躬；弯身以表示尊敬或恭敬。

formal.mt: Wara l-aħħar xena, l-attur inkina quddiem l-udjenza biex jirringrazzjaha.
formal.en: After the final scene, the actor bowed before the audience to thank them.
formal.zh: 最后一幕结束后，演员向观众鞠躬致谢。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex inkina dak iż-żeffien? Pietru: Biex jirringrazzja lin-nies li ċapċpulu.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why did that dancer bow? Pietru: To thank the people who applauded him.
colloquial.zh: 埃琳娜：那个舞者为什么鞠躬？彼得：为了感谢为他鼓掌的人。

messages.speaker: Elena (观众)
messages.zh: 那个舞者为什么鞠躬？
messages.en: Why did that dancer bow?

messages.speaker: Pietru (朋友)
messages.zh: 为了感谢为他鼓掌的人。
messages.en: To thank the people who applauded him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把谢幕画面播放起来：inkina 表示“鞠躬”这个动作；与名词 inkin 对照，分别记动作和一个礼节。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To apply ink to a surface or go over a drawing with ink.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把墨涂到表面上，或用墨描过已有的图画线条。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Japplika l-linka fuq wiċċ jew jgħaddi bil-linka fuq il-linji ta' tpinġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给……上墨；用墨描绘。

collocations.en: to go over the drawing with ink

formal.mt: L-artist inkja l-pjanċa b'attenzjoni qabel l-istampar.
formal.en: The artist carefully inked the plate before printing.
formal.zh: 艺术家在印刷前仔细地给印版上墨。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min inkja din it-tpinġija? Pawlu: Jien! L-ewwel għamiltha bil-lapes, imbagħad għaddejt fuqha bil-linka.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who inked this drawing? Pawlu: I did! First I drew it in pencil, then I went over it with ink.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这幅画是谁描的墨？保罗：我呀！我先用铅笔画，再用墨描了一遍。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这幅画是谁描的墨？
messages.en: Who inked this drawing?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (绘画爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien! L-ewwel għamiltha bil-lapes, imbagħad għaddejt fuqha bil-linka.
messages.mt_standard: Jien! L-ewwel għamiltha bil-lapes, imbagħad għaddejt fuqha bil-linka.
messages.zh: 我呀！我先用铅笔画，再用墨描了一遍。
messages.en: I did! First I drew it in pencil, then I went over it with ink.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inkja 配上“铅笔草图变成墨线”的画面来记：重点是上墨、描墨这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of applying ink to a surface, especially in drawing or printing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把墨施加到表面上的过程，尤用于绘画或印刷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih tiġi applikata l-linka fuq wiċċ, speċjalment fit-tpinġija jew fl-istampar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 上墨；描墨；施加墨水的过程。

formal.mt: Inkjatura uniformi tal-pjanċa hija essenzjali biex tinkiseb stampa ċara.
formal.en: Even inking of the plate is essential for obtaining a clear print.
formal.zh: 给印版均匀上墨是获得清晰印样的必要条件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sejra l-inkjatura? Pawlu: Kważi lesta, imma hemm rokna li għad għandha bżonn ftit linka.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is the inking going? Pawlu: Almost done, but one corner still needs a little ink.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：上墨进行得怎么样？保罗：快好了，不过有个角还需要加一点墨。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 上墨进行得怎么样？
messages.en: How is the inking going?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (版画课同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi lesta, imma hemm rokna li għad għandha bżonn ftit linka.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi lesta, imma hemm rokna li għad għandha bżonn ftit linka.
messages.zh: 快好了，不过有个角还需要加一点墨。
messages.en: Almost done, but one corner still needs a little ink.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师检查印版“上墨是否均匀”：inkjatura 指上墨这项过程，学习时可与表示动作的 inkja 对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A coloured liquid or substance used for writing, drawing, or printing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于书写、绘画或印刷的有色液体或物质，即墨或墨水。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Likwidu jew sustanza bil-kulur li tintuża għall-kitba, għat-tpinġija jew għall-istampar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 墨；用于书写、绘画或印刷的墨水。

formal.mt: Għall-kitba ta' dan id-dokument intuża inkjostru iswed.
formal.en: Black ink was used to write this document.
formal.zh: 这份文件是用黑墨水书写的。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek flixkun tal-inkjostru blu? Rita: Iva, qiegħed fuq l-ixkaffa ħdejn il-pinen.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have a bottle of blue ink? Rita: Yes, it is on the shelf next to the pens.
colloquial.zh: 马克：有蓝墨水卖吗？丽塔：有，就在钢笔旁边的架子上。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 有蓝墨水卖吗？
messages.en: Do you have a bottle of blue ink?

messages.speaker: Rita (文具店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed fuq l-ixkaffa ħdejn il-pinen.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed fuq l-ixkaffa ħdejn il-pinen.
messages.zh: 有，就在钢笔旁边的架子上。
messages.en: Yes, it is on the shelf next to the pens.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inkjostru 想成桌上的一瓶黑墨水：这是书写用的材料，可搭配 iswed“黑色的”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To attach one thing to another using glue or paste.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用胶水或浆糊把一个东西贴到另一个东西上，或把物件粘合起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iwaħħal ħaġa ma' oħra permezz tal-kolla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用胶粘合；用胶水或浆糊粘贴。

collocations.en: to paste the photograph into the album
to glue two pieces of wood together

formal.mt: L-istudent inkolla r-ritratti fuq il-kartun u kiteb deskrizzjoni taħt kull wieħed.
formal.en: The student pasted the photographs onto the cardboard and wrote a description beneath each one.
formal.zh: 学生把照片贴在硬纸板上，并在每张照片下面写了说明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min inkolla din it-tikketta fuq il-kaxxa? Mark: Jien, biex inkunu nafu x'hemm fiha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who glued this label onto the box? Mark: I did, so we would know what is inside.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：是谁把这张标签贴在盒子上的？马克：我贴的，这样我们就知道里面有什么了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min inkolla din it-tikketta fuq il-kaxxa?
messages.mt_standard: Min inkolla din it-tikketta fuq il-kaxxa?
messages.zh: 是谁把这张标签贴在盒子上的？
messages.en: Who glued this label onto the box?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, biex inkunu nafu x'hemm fiha.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, biex inkunu nafu x'hemm fiha.
messages.zh: 我贴的，这样我们就知道里面有什么了。
messages.en: I did, so we would know what is inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“涂胶、贴上、按住”三个动作，用 inkolla 串起来；再配一句“把照片贴进相册”帮助回忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of joining or attaching things with glue.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用胶把物件粘在一起或贴到某个表面上的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih jitwaħħlu affarijiet flimkien permezz tal-kolla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粘贴；用胶粘合；胶合过程。

formal.mt: Qabel l-inkollatura, l-uċuħ tal-injam għandhom ikunu nodfa u niexfa.
formal.en: Before gluing, the wooden surfaces should be clean and dry.
formal.zh: 胶合之前，木材表面应保持清洁干燥。

colloquial.mt: Mark: L-inkollatura tat-tikketti lesta? Rita: Għad fadal żewġ kaxxi, imbagħad inkunu lesti.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is the label sticking finished? Rita: There are still two boxes left, then we will be done.
colloquial.zh: 马克：标签都贴完了吗？丽塔：还剩两个盒子，贴完就好了。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 标签都贴完了吗？
messages.en: Is the label sticking finished?

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad fadal żewġ kaxxi, imbagħad inkunu lesti.
messages.mt_standard: Għad fadal żewġ kaxxi, imbagħad inkunu lesti.
messages.zh: 还剩两个盒子，贴完就好了。
messages.en: There are still two boxes left, then we will be done.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inkollatura 记成手工课里的“粘贴工序”：inkolla 表示动手粘，inkollatura 则把这项工作当作名词来谈。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lacking some required parts or not yet fully finished.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缺少应有部分，或尚未全部完成的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jonqsu xi partijiet meħtieġa jew li għadu mhux lest għalkollox.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不完整的；有缺漏的；尚未完成的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport għadu inkomplut għax jonqsu r-riżultati tal-aħħar test.
formal.en: The report is still incomplete because the results of the final test are missing.
formal.zh: 由于缺少最后一次测试的结果，报告仍不完整。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' naqra r-rapport tiegħek? Pawlu: Iva, imma għadu inkomplut; jonqosni nikteb il-konklużjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I read your report? Pawlu: Yes, but it is still incomplete; I still need to write the conclusion.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我可以读一下你的报告吗？保罗：可以，不过还没写完，我还得写结论。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 我可以读一下你的报告吗？
messages.en: Can I read your report?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għadu inkomplut; jonqosni nikteb il-konklużjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għadu inkomplut; jonqosni nikteb il-konklużjoni.
messages.zh: 可以，不过还没写完，我还得写结论。
messages.en: Yes, but it is still incomplete; I still need to write the conclusion.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一份缺少结论的报告，或少一块的拼图：inkomplut 都强调“还缺一部分，尚未完整”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not correct or accurate; containing an error.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不正确或不准确的；含有错误的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li mhuwiex korrett jew preċiż, jew li fih żball.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 错误的；不正确的；不准确的。

formal.mt: Il-kalkolu fir-rapport huwa inkorrett u għandu jiġi kkoreġut qabel il-pubblikazzjoni.
formal.en: The calculation in the report is incorrect and should be corrected before publication.
formal.zh: 报告中的计算有误，应在发表前更正。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex ma nistax nidħol fil-kont? Rita: In-numru li daħħalt huwa inkorrett. Erġa' ċċekkjah.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why can't I log into the account? Rita: The number you entered is incorrect. Check it again.
colloquial.zh: 马克：为什么我登录不了账户？丽塔：你输入的号码不对，再检查一下。

messages.speaker: Mark (用户)
messages.zh: 为什么我登录不了账户？
messages.en: Why can't I log into the account?

messages.speaker: Rita (客服人员)
messages.mt_spoken: In-numru li daħħalt huwa inkorrett. Erġa' ċċekkjah.
messages.mt_standard: In-numru li daħħalt huwa inkorrett. Erġa' ċċekkjah.
messages.zh: 你输入的号码不对，再检查一下。
messages.en: The number you entered is incorrect. Check it again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师在错误计算旁画一个叉：inkorrett 表示“有错、不正确”，本身并不表示这个错误无法改正。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way that is wrong or not correct.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以错误或不正确的方式，说明某个动作是怎样完成的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod ħażin jew mhux korrett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 错误地；不正确地

formal.mt: L-istudent wieġeb inkorrettament għal żewġ mistoqsijiet fl-eżami.
formal.en: The student answered two questions incorrectly in the exam.
formal.zh: 这名学生在考试中答错了两道题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-pakkett ma wasalx? Mark: Ktibt l-indirizz inkorrettament. Se nikkoreġih.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why hasn't the parcel arrived? Mark: I wrote the address incorrectly. I'll correct it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：包裹为什么还没到？Mark：我把地址写错了。我会改正。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 包裹为什么还没到？
messages.en: Why hasn't the parcel arrived?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我把地址写错了。我会改正。
messages.en: I wrote the address incorrectly. I'll correct it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放在“回答、填写、拼写”等动作后面记忆：它说明动作做得不正确，相当于“错误地”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality or state of being wrong or not correct.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 内容、说法或做法不正确的性质或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità jew l-istat ta' xi ħaġa li mhijiex korretta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不正确性；错误的性质或状态

formal.mt: L-għalliem spjega l-inkorrettezza tat-tweġiba permezz ta' eżempju ċar.
formal.en: The teacher explained the incorrectness of the answer using a clear example.
formal.zh: 老师用一个清楚的例子解释了这个答案为什么不正确。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma aċċettawx it-tweġiba tiegħi? Pawlu: L-inkorrettezza tagħha tidher meta tiċċekkja l-kalkolu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why didn't they accept my answer? Pawlu: Its incorrectness becomes apparent when you check the calculation.
colloquial.zh: Lara：他们为什么不接受我的答案？Pawlu：检查一下计算过程，就能看出答案不正确。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 他们为什么不接受我的答案？
messages.en: Why didn't they accept my answer?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: L-inkorrettezza tagħha tidher meta tiċċekkja l-kalkolu.
messages.mt_standard: L-inkorrettezza tagħha tidher meta tiċċekkja l-kalkolu.
messages.zh: 检查一下计算过程，就能看出答案不正确。
messages.en: Its incorrectness becomes apparent when you check the calculation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“答案不正确”这句话中的“不正确”当作一个概念来谈，就是这个名词；可记成“答案的错误性质”。

gloss_zh: 无法纠正的；屡教不改的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unable to be corrected or reformed; persistently keeping a habit or way of behaving.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 无法纠正或改正的；形容人时，也指某种习惯或行为屡次劝改仍不改变。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jistax jiġi kkoreġut jew li jibqa' jġib ruħu bl-istess mod minkejja t-twissijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无法纠正的；难以改正的；形容人时指屡教不改的。

collocations.zh: 怎么也改不了的乐观派

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-protagonist huwa ottimist inkorreġġibbli li jibqa' jittama minkejja kull diffikultà.
formal.en: In the novel, the protagonist is an incorrigible optimist who keeps hoping despite every difficulty.
formal.zh: 小说中的主人公是个怎么也改不了的乐观派，面对种种困难仍然心怀希望。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek taħseb li se naslu fil-ħin? Pawlu: Dażgur! Maja: Int ottimist inkorreġġibbli!
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you still think we will arrive on time? Pawlu: Of course! Maja: You are an incorrigible optimist!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还觉得我们能准时到吗？保罗：当然！玛雅：你真是个怎么也改不了的乐观派！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek taħseb li se naslu fil-ħin?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek taħseb li se naslu fil-ħin?
messages.zh: 你还觉得我们能准时到吗？
messages.en: Do you still think we will arrive on time?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 当然！
messages.en: Of course!

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你真是个怎么也改不了的乐观派！
messages.en: You are an incorrigible optimist!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inkorreġġibbli 放进“怎么劝也改不了”的场景来记；搭配“乐观派”时，也可以带朋友间打趣的语气。

gloss_zh: 孵化；在适宜条件下培养

teaching_sense.en_definition: To keep eggs or biological material under suitable conditions so that they can develop.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使蛋或生物材料处于适宜条件下，让其孵化或生长。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iżomm bajd jew materjal bijoloġiku f'kundizzjonijiet xierqa biex jiżviluppa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 孵化；将生物材料置于适宜条件下培养

collocations.en: to incubate samples in the laboratory

formal.mt: It-tekniku inkuba l-kampjuni f'temperatura kkontrollata.
formal.en: The technician incubated the samples at a controlled temperature.
formal.zh: 技术员在受控温度下培养了这些样本。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex poġġejt il-bajd f'din il-magna? Toni: Biex ninkuba l-bajd u nżommu sħun sakemm ifaqqas.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you put the eggs in this machine? Toni: To incubate the eggs and keep them warm until they hatch.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你为什么把蛋放进这台机器？Toni：为了孵蛋，让它们保持温暖，直到孵出小鸡。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把蛋放进这台机器？
messages.en: Why did you put the eggs in this machine?

messages.speaker: Toni (养鸡人)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex ninkuba l-bajd u nżommu sħun sakemm ifaqqas.
messages.mt_standard: Biex ninkuba l-bajd u nżommu sħun sakemm ifaqqas.
messages.zh: 为了孵蛋，让它们保持温暖，直到孵出小鸡。
messages.en: To incubate the eggs and keep them warm until they hatch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把鸡蛋放进恒温箱，耐心等待小鸡出来；把“适宜条件下等待发育”的画面与这个动词联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put a picture or photograph into a frame.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把图画或照片放入画框或相框中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed stampa jew ritratt f'qafas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给图画或照片装框

formal.mt: L-artist inkwadra l-istampa qabel il-wirja.
formal.en: The artist framed the picture before the exhibition.
formal.zh: 艺术家在展览前给这幅画装了框。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan ir-ritratt sabiħ ħafna. X'se tagħmel bih? Mark: Se ninkwadrah u ndendlu fis-salott.
colloquial.en: Sara: This photograph is lovely. What will you do with it? Mark: I'll frame it and hang it in the living room.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这张照片真好看。你打算怎么处理？Mark：我要给它装框，挂在客厅里。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ir-ritratt sabiħ ħafna. X'se tagħmel bih?
messages.mt_standard: Dan ir-ritratt sabiħ ħafna. X'se tagħmel bih?
messages.zh: 这张照片真好看。你打算怎么处理？
messages.en: This photograph is lovely. What will you do with it?

messages.speaker: Mark (照片主人)
messages.zh: 我要给它装框，挂在客厅里。
messages.en: I'll frame it and hang it in the living room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张散放的照片被放进四边相框，再挂到墙上；用“照片入框”的动作记住这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To show romantic interest in someone and try to win their affection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某人表达爱慕，并通过言语或行动争取对方的感情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juri interess romantiku f'xi ħadd u jipprova jirbaħ l-imħabba tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 追求某人；向某人求爱
通过示爱或殷勤争取某人的爱情
与某人做爱

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, iż-żagħżugħ beda jinnamra ma' mara li kien iltaqa' magħha fil-belt.
formal.en: In the novel, the young man began courting a woman he had met in the city.
formal.zh: 小说中，这位年轻男子开始追求一名他在城里认识的女子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Taħseb li Mark qed jinnamra ma' Sara? Nina: Naħseb li iva. Dejjem ifittex li jqatta' ħin magħha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you think Mark is courting Sara? Nina: I think so. He's always trying to spend time with her.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你觉得 Mark 在追求 Sara 吗？Nina：我觉得是。他总想找机会和她相处。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li Mark qed jinnamra ma' Sara?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li Mark qed jinnamra ma' Sara?
messages.zh: 你觉得 Mark 在追求 Sara 吗？
messages.en: Do you think Mark is courting Sara?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li iva. Dejjem ifittex li jqatta' ħin magħha.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li iva. Dejjem ifittex li jqatta' ħin magħha.
messages.zh: 我觉得是。他总想找机会和她相处。
messages.en: I think so. He's always trying to spend time with her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“送花、邀约、表达爱意”的场景记住求爱义；再单独记住性亲密义，阅读时依具体语境判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become annoyed, irritated, or easily angered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得恼怒或烦躁，或者进入容易发脾气的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibda jħossu irritat jew jirrabja malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到恼火；烦躁起来
变得易怒；变得容易发脾气

collocations.en: to get irritated because of the noise

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, Mark innervja minħabba l-interruzzjonijiet ripetuti.
formal.en: During the meeting, Mark became irritated because of the repeated interruptions.
formal.zh: 会议期间，Mark 因为发言反复被打断而恼火起来。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex innervjajt? Mark: Il-mużika kienet għolja wisq u ma stajtx nikkonċentra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you get irritated? Mark: The music was too loud and I couldn't concentrate.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么烦躁起来了？Mark：音乐太响，我没法集中注意力。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么烦躁起来了？
messages.en: Why did you get irritated?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-mużika kienet għolja wisq u ma stajtx nikkonċentra.
messages.mt_standard: Il-mużika kienet għolja wisq u ma stajtx nikkonċentra.
messages.zh: 音乐太响，我没法集中注意力。
messages.en: The music was too loud and I couldn't concentrate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象原本平静的人被噪声打扰后皱起眉头；记住这个词强调“烦躁起来”的变化，也可表示变得易怒。

gloss_zh: 无法观察到的；不可观测的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unable to be observed or detected under the relevant conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在相关条件下无法被观察或探测到的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jistax jiġi osservat jew jinstab fil-kundizzjonijiet partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不可观察的；无法观测到的

formal.mt: Il-fenomenu jibqa' inosservabbli bl-apparat disponibbli fil-laboratorju.
formal.en: The phenomenon remains unobservable with the equipment available in the laboratory.
formal.zh: 使用实验室现有的设备，仍然无法观测到这一现象。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ma nistgħux naraw l-effett? Pawlu: Għadu inosservabbli b'dan l-apparat. Għandna bżonn apparat aktar sensittiv.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why can't we see the effect? Pawlu: It's still unobservable with this equipment. We need more sensitive equipment.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我们为什么看不到这个效应？Pawlu：用这台设备仍然观测不到。我们需要更灵敏的设备。

messages.speaker: Nina (实验课学生)
messages.zh: 我们为什么看不到这个效应？
messages.en: Why can't we see the effect?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (实验课教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu inosservabbli b'dan l-apparat. Għandna bżonn apparat aktar sensittiv.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu inosservabbli b'dan l-apparat. Għandna bżonn apparat aktar sensittiv.
messages.zh: 用这台设备仍然观测不到。我们需要更灵敏的设备。
messages.en: It's still unobservable with this equipment. We need more sensitive equipment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象仪器屏幕始终没有可辨认的信号，用“在当前条件下观测不到”的画面记忆；观测不到本身不等于不存在。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Failure to follow a rule, law, instruction, or requirement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 未遵守规则、法律、指示或要求的行为或情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' ħarsien ta' regola, liġi, struzzjoni jew rekwiżit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不遵守；未遵行法律、规则或要求。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi każ ta' inosservanza tar-regoli tas-sigurtà.
formal.en: The report describes a case of nonobservance of the safety rules.
formal.zh: 该报告描述了一起未遵守安全规则的事件。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex kitbu rapport? Pawlu: Minħabba l-inosservanza tar-regoli: xi ħadd ħalla l-ħruġ imblukkat.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did they write a report? Pawlu: Because of nonobservance of the rules: someone left the exit blocked.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：他们为什么写了报告？保罗：因为有人没有遵守规则，把出口堵住了。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.zh: 他们为什么写了报告？
messages.en: Why did they write a report?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba l-inosservanza tar-regoli: xi ħadd ħalla l-ħruġ imblukkat.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba l-inosservanza tar-regoli: xi ħadd ħalla l-ħruġ imblukkat.
messages.zh: 因为有人没有遵守规则，把出口堵住了。
messages.en: Because of nonobservance of the rules: someone left the exit blocked.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与“规则写着，行动却没照做”的画面联系起来；搭配 tar-regoli 一起记，表示不遵守规则。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeding on insects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以昆虫为食的，用于描述动物等生物的取食特点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiekol l-insetti bħala ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 食虫的；以昆虫为食的。

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi għasfur insettivoru u jispjega kif jaqbad l-insetti.
formal.en: The text describes an insectivorous bird and explains how it catches insects.
formal.zh: 这篇课文描述了一种食虫鸟，并解释它如何捕捉昆虫。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'jiekol dan l-għasfur? David: Hu insettivoru; jiekol l-insetti.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does this bird eat? David: It is insectivorous; it eats insects.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这只鸟吃什么？戴维：它是食虫的，吃昆虫。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这只鸟吃什么？
messages.en: What does this bird eat?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.zh: 它是食虫的，吃昆虫。
messages.en: It is insectivorous; it eats insects.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“小鸟张嘴吃昆虫”的画面记住 insettivoru；这个词说明吃什么，搭配 għasfur 就是“食虫鸟”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A substance used to kill insects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于杀死昆虫的药剂或物质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza li tintuża biex toqtol l-insetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 杀虫剂；用于杀死昆虫的物质。

formal.mt: Qabel l-użu ta' dan l-insettiċida, aqra bir-reqqa l-istruzzjonijiet fuq it-tikketta.
formal.en: Before using this insecticide, read the instructions on the label carefully.
formal.zh: 使用这种杀虫剂之前，请仔细阅读标签上的说明。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan l-insettiċida hu għall-pjanti? Mark: Iva, imma aqra t-tikketta qabel tużah.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this insecticide for plants? Mark: Yes, but read the label before using it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这种杀虫剂是给植物用的吗？马克：是的，不过使用前要先看标签。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这种杀虫剂是给植物用的吗？
messages.en: Is this insecticide for plants?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma aqra t-tikketta qabel tużah.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma aqra t-tikketta qabel tużah.
messages.zh: 是的，不过使用前要先看标签。
messages.en: Yes, but read the label before using it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一瓶标有昆虫图案的喷雾，把 insettiċida 与“杀虫剂”直接配对；再用“使用前看标签”的场景巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The scientific study of insects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以昆虫为研究对象的科学学科。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istudju xjentifiku tal-insetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 昆虫学；研究昆虫的学科。

formal.mt: Il-kors fl-insettoloġija jinkludi l-istudju tal-imġiba tal-insetti.
formal.en: The course in insectology includes the study of insect behaviour.
formal.zh: 这门昆虫学课程包括对昆虫行为的研究。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'qed tistudja bħalissa? Luke: Qed nagħmel kors fl-insettoloġija; qed nitgħallem dwar l-insetti.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are you studying at the moment? Luke: I am taking a course in insectology; I am learning about insects.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你最近在学什么？卢克：我在上昆虫学课，学习有关昆虫的知识。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你最近在学什么？
messages.en: What are you studying at the moment?

messages.speaker: Luke (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nagħmel kors fl-insettoloġija; qed nitgħallem dwar l-insetti.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nagħmel kors fl-insettoloġija; qed nitgħallem dwar l-insetti.
messages.zh: 我在上昆虫学课，学习有关昆虫的知识。
messages.en: I am taking a course in insectology; I am learning about insects.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象课堂上用放大镜观察昆虫，把 insettoloġija 记作这门课的名称“昆虫学”；用 kors fl-insettoloġija 整组练习。

gloss_zh: 不可持续的；难以继续维持的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unable to be maintained over time because it uses more resources than are available or creates excessive costs or harm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因消耗过多资源、成本过高或造成过大损害而无法长期维持的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jistax jinżamm fit-tul għax juża wisq riżorsi, jiswa wisq jew jagħmel wisq ħsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不可持续的；无法长期维持或继续下去的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri li l-konsum attwali tal-ilma huwa insostenibbli fit-tul.
formal.en: The report shows that the current consumption of water is unsustainable in the long term.
formal.zh: 报告显示，目前的用水量从长期来看是不可持续的。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Qed taħdem kull lejl ukoll? Daniel: Iva, u dan ir-ritmu hu insostenibbli. Għandi bżonn aktar mistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Emma: Are you working every night as well? Daniel: Yes, and this pace is unsustainable. I need more rest.
colloquial.zh: 艾玛：你现在连每天晚上也在工作吗？丹尼尔：是的，这种节奏没法长期维持。我需要多休息。

messages.speaker: Emma (朋友)
messages.zh: 你现在连每天晚上也在工作吗？
messages.en: Are you working every night as well?

messages.speaker: Daniel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u dan ir-ritmu hu insostenibbli. Għandi bżonn aktar mistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u dan ir-ritmu hu insostenibbli. Għandi bżonn aktar mistrieħ.
messages.zh: 是的，这种节奏没法长期维持。我需要多休息。
messages.en: Yes, and this pace is unsustainable. I need more rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 insostenibbli 放进“每天熬夜，长期撑不住”的场景；记忆重点是“无法一直维持”，也可用于资源消耗。

gloss_zh: 无法解释的；难以解释的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Impossible or very difficult to explain or account for.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 无法或很难说明其原因、经过或道理的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jistax jiġi spjegat jew li diffiċli ħafna ssib spjegazzjoni għalih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无法解释的；令人费解的；难以说明原因的。

formal.mt: Minkejja l-investigazzjoni, id-dewmien baqa' inspjegabbli.
formal.en: Despite the investigation, the delay remained inexplicable.
formal.zh: 尽管进行了调查，这次延误仍然无法解释。

colloquial.mt: Julia: Kif spiċċa l-ktieb fil-friġġ? Ben: Ma nafx! Għalija dan hu inspjegabbli.
colloquial.en: Julia: How did the book end up in the fridge? Ben: I do not know! To me, this is inexplicable.
colloquial.zh: 朱莉娅：书怎么跑到冰箱里去了？本：我不知道！这事我实在解释不了。

messages.speaker: Julia (室友)
messages.zh: 书怎么跑到冰箱里去了？
messages.en: How did the book end up in the fridge?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx! Għalija dan hu inspjegabbli.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx! Għalija dan hu inspjegabbli.
messages.zh: 我不知道！这事我实在解释不了。
messages.en: I do not know! To me, this is inexplicable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开冰箱却发现一本书，大家都说不清原因；用这个令人费解的画面记住 inspjegabbli“无法解释的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lack of steadiness or stability in a physical object, condition, or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体、状态或局势缺乏稳固性或稳定性的情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' stabbiltà f'oġġett, kundizzjoni jew sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不稳定；不稳固；局势或状态的不稳定性。

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina l-effetti tal-instabbiltà ekonomika fuq l-impjiegi.
formal.en: The study examines the effects of economic instability on employment.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察经济不稳定对就业的影响。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex qed nistennew qabel niftħu l-ħanut? Mario: Minħabba l-instabbiltà ekonomika; l-ispejjeż qed jinbidlu ħafna.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why are we waiting before opening the shop? Mario: Because of economic instability; costs are changing a lot.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我们为什么还要等一等才开店？马里奥：因为经济不稳定，成本变化很大。

messages.speaker: Rita (生意合伙人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed nistennew qabel niftħu l-ħanut?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed nistennew qabel niftħu l-ħanut?
messages.zh: 我们为什么还要等一等才开店？
messages.en: Why are we waiting before opening the shop?

messages.speaker: Mario (生意合伙人)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba l-instabbiltà ekonomika; l-ispejjeż qed jinbidlu ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba l-instabbiltà ekonomika; l-ispejjeż qed jinbidlu ħafna.
messages.zh: 因为经济不稳定，成本变化很大。
messages.en: Because of economic instability; costs are changing a lot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 instabbiltà 当作给“不稳定这种状态”起的名字；联想经济曲线上下波动，并与形容事物的 instabbli 配对区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not steady, secure, or consistent, and liable to move or change.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不稳固或不稳定，容易晃动、改变或发生波动的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li mhuwiex stabbli jew sod u jista' jiċċaqlaq jew jinbidel faċilment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不稳定的；不稳固的；容易变化或晃动的。

formal.mt: L-ispezzjoni sabet li l-mejda kienet instabbli minħabba ħsara f'waħda mis-saqajn.
formal.en: The inspection found that the table was unstable because one of its legs was damaged.
formal.zh: 检查发现，这张桌子因一条桌腿受损而不稳固。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex qed titbandal il-mejda? Sam: Għandha sieq miksura u hi instabbli. Ejja nużaw oħra.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why is the table wobbling? Sam: It has a broken leg and is unstable. Let us use another one.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：桌子为什么晃来晃去？萨姆：它有一条腿断了，不稳。我们换一张吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 桌子为什么晃来晃去？
messages.en: Why is the table wobbling?

messages.speaker: Sam (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandha sieq miksura u hi instabbli. Ejja nużaw oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Għandha sieq miksura u hi instabbli. Ejja nużaw oħra.
messages.zh: 它有一条腿断了，不稳。我们换一张吧。
messages.en: It has a broken leg and is unstable. Let us use another one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张一碰就晃的桌子，说 mejda instabbli；这个词直接描述事物“不稳定的”，与表示状态的名词 instabbiltà 配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To impose a tax on a person, income, goods, or an activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对个人、收入、商品或某项活动征收税款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li timponi taxxa fuq persuna, dħul, oġġetti jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 征税；对……课税

formal.mt: Il-gvern intaxxa l-importazzjonijiet ta' ċerti prodotti biex iżid id-dħul pubbliku.
formal.en: The government taxed imports of certain products to increase public revenue.
formal.zh: 政府对某些产品的进口征税，以增加公共财政收入。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex għola dan il-prodott? Lara: Il-gvern intaxxa l-importazzjonijiet tiegħu, u għalhekk żdied il-prezz.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why has this product become more expensive? Lara: The government taxed imports of it, so the price went up.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这个产品为什么涨价了？拉拉：政府对它的进口征了税，所以价格上涨了。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个产品为什么涨价了？
messages.en: Why has this product become more expensive?

messages.speaker: Lara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-gvern intaxxa l-importazzjonijiet tiegħu, u għalhekk żdied il-prezz.
messages.mt_standard: Il-gvern intaxxa l-importazzjonijiet tiegħu, u għalhekk żdied il-prezz.
messages.zh: 政府对它的进口征了税，所以价格上涨了。
messages.en: The government taxed imports of it, so the price went up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 intaxxa 和商品账单上的税额联系起来：政府对商品征税，账单便多出一项税款。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To combine something with a larger whole or help someone become part of a group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某事物纳入一个整体，或帮助某人融入群体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tgħaqqad xi ħaġa ma' ħaġa sħiħa akbar jew tgħin lil xi ħadd isir parti minn grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 整合；把……纳入整体；使融入

collocations.en: integrated the new members into the team

formal.mt: Il-proġett integra d-data minn diversi sorsi f'sistema waħda.
formal.en: The project integrated data from several sources into a single system.
formal.zh: 该项目把多个来源的数据整合进了同一个系统。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sejrin il-membri l-ġodda? Pawlu: Tajjeb ħafna. Il-kowċ integra lil kulħadd fit-tim.
colloquial.en: Maja: How are the new members doing? Pawlu: Very well. The coach integrated everyone into the team.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：新成员们适应得怎么样？保罗：很好。教练让大家都融入了团队。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 新成员们适应得怎么样？
messages.en: How are the new members doing?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (队员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb ħafna. Il-kowċ integra lil kulħadd fit-tim.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb ħafna. Il-kowċ integra lil kulħadd fit-tim.

messages.en: Very well. The coach integrated everyone into the team.

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lack of moderation or self-control, especially in eating or drinking alcohol.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 行为缺乏节制或自我控制，尤指饮食无度或过度饮酒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' moderazzjoni jew ta' kontroll fuq l-imġiba, speċjalment fl-ikel jew fix-xorb alkoħoliku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不节制；放纵，尤指饮食无度或过度饮酒

formal.mt: L-intemperanza fl-ikel u x-xorb tista' tagħmel ħsara lis-saħħa.
formal.en: Intemperance in eating and drinking can harm health.
formal.zh: 饮食无度可能损害健康。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Qed ninkwieta dwar ħija. L-intemperanza fix-xorb qed tagħmillu l-ħsara. Mark: Nifhem. Forsi tista' tkellmu bil-kalma u toffrilu l-għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Rita: I'm worried about my brother. His excessive drinking is harming him. Mark: I understand. Perhaps you can talk to him calmly and offer him help.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我很担心我哥哥。他饮酒无度，正在伤害自己的身体。马克：我理解。也许你可以平静地和他谈谈，向他提供帮助。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very strong in degree, force, feeling, or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 程度、力量或感受很强烈的，也可形容活动紧张或强度很高。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qawwi ħafna fil-grad, fil-forza jew fis-sentiment, jew li jinvolvi attività kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强烈的；剧烈的；紧张而高强度的

formal.mt: Il-programm jinkludi taħriġ intens biex il-parteċipanti jtejbu l-ħiliet tagħhom.

formal.zh: 该计划包含高强度训练，以帮助参与者提升技能。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif kien it-taħriġ illum? Mark: Kien intens ħafna. Issa għandi bżonn nistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: How was training today? Mark: It was very intense. Now I need to rest.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：今天的训练怎么样？马克：强度很大。我现在需要休息。

messages.en: It was very intense. Now I need to rest.
