teaching_sense.en_definition: With great strength, effort, feeling, or concentration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以很强的力度、很大的努力、强烈的情感或高度集中的注意力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'qawwa kbira, bi sforz kbir, b'sentiment qawwi jew b'konċentrazzjoni kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强烈地；高强度地；全神贯注地

formal.mt: It-tim ħadem intensament għal diversi ġimgħat biex ilesti r-rapport fil-ħin.
formal.en: The team worked intensely for several weeks to complete the report on time.
formal.zh: 团队连续数周高强度工作，以按时完成报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex int daqshekk għajjien? Pawlu: Studjajt intensament il-ġurnata kollha. Għandi eżami għada.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you so tired? Pawlu: I studied intensely all day. I have an exam tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么这么累？保罗：我一整天都在专心刻苦地学习。我明天有考试。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)

messages.mt_standard: Studjajt intensament il-ġurnata kollha. Għandi eżami għada.
messages.zh: 我一整天都在专心刻苦地学习。我明天有考试。
messages.en: I studied intensely all day. I have an exam tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“动作怎样进行”这一问：intensament 回答“很用力、很投入地”，可跟工作或学习的动作搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something stronger, more concentrated, or greater in degree.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某事物更强、更集中，或使其程度进一步增加。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tagħmel xi ħaġa aktar qawwija, aktar ikkonċentrata jew akbar fil-grad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加强；使加剧；使程度或强度增加

formal.mt: It-tim intensifika l-isforzi tiegħu biex itemm il-proġett qabel l-iskadenza.
formal.en: The team intensified its efforts to finish the project before the deadline.
formal.zh: 团队加大了努力，以在截止日期前完成项目。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex qed titħarrġu aktar din il-ġimgħa? Mark: Il-kowċ intensifika t-taħriġ għax il-logħba importanti qed toqrob.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why are you training more this week? Mark: The coach intensified the training because the important match is approaching.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你们这周为什么训练得更多了？马克：因为那场重要比赛快到了，教练加强了训练。

messages.en: The coach intensified the training because the important match is approaching.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象教练把训练强度旋钮往上调，用 intensifika 记住“使原有的力量或程度进一步增强”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The degree of strength, force, concentration, or feeling that something has.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事物在力量、集中程度或情感方面的强烈程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-grad ta' qawwa, forza, konċentrazzjoni jew sentiment ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强度；强烈程度；集中程度

formal.mt: Matul l-esperiment, ir-riċerkaturi kejlu l-intensità tad-dawl f'diversi punti tal-kamra.
formal.en: During the experiment, the researchers measured the intensity of the light at several points in the room.
formal.zh: 实验期间，研究人员测量了房间内多个位置的光强度。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan id-dawl qawwi wisq għalija. Pawlu: Nista' nnaqqas l-intensità tiegħu. Hekk aħjar?
colloquial.en: Lara: This light is too bright for me. Pawlu: I can reduce its intensity. Is that better?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这灯对我来说太亮了。保罗：我可以把它的亮度调低。这样好些了吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fundamental physical interaction involved in processes such as beta decay.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物理学中的一种基本相互作用，参与贝塔衰变等过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Interazzjoni fiżika fundamentali involuta fi proċessi bħad-diżintegrazzjoni beta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弱相互作用，物理学中参与贝塔衰变等过程的一种基本相互作用

formal.mt: L-interazzjoni dgħajfa għandha rwol fid-diżintegrazzjoni beta ta' ċerti nuklei atomiċi.
formal.en: The weak interaction plays a role in the beta decay of certain atomic nuclei.
formal.zh: 弱相互作用在某些原子核的贝塔衰变中发挥作用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema interazzjoni hija involuta fid-diżintegrazzjoni beta? Pawlu: L-interazzjoni dgħajfa. Dan huwa wieħed mill-eżempji li studjajna fil-klassi.

teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与电荷及电磁效应有关的一种基本相互作用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Interazzjoni fundamentali li tinvolvi ċ-ċarġ elettriku u l-effetti elettromanjetiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电磁相互作用

collocations.zh: 对电磁相互作用的研究

formal.en: This chapter explains the role of electromagnetic interaction between electrically charged particles.
formal.zh: 本章解释电磁相互作用在带电粒子之间发挥的作用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi l-interazzjoni elettromanjetika? Toni: Hija interazzjoni li tinvolvi ċ-ċarġ elettriku; aħseb fl-elettriku u l-manjetiżmu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is electromagnetic interaction? Toni: It is an interaction involving electric charge; think of electricity and magnetism.

teaching_sense.en_definition: One of the basic interactions used in physics to describe how matter and particles affect one another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物理学中用于描述物质和粒子如何彼此作用的基本相互作用之一。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waħda mill-interazzjonijiet bażiċi li jintużaw fil-fiżika biex jiddeskrivu kif il-materja u l-partiċelli jaffettwaw lil xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 基本相互作用

collocations.zh: 基本相互作用的一个例子

formal.zh: 这篇课文将引力相互作用作为基本相互作用的一个例子。

colloquial.en: Lara: What does fundamental interaction mean? Mark: It is one of the basic interactions in physics; gravity is an example.

teaching_sense.en_definition: The fundamental interaction associated with gravity, through which bodies with mass attract one another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与引力有关的基本相互作用，有质量的物体通过这种作用彼此吸引。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-interazzjoni fundamentali marbuta mal-gravità, li permezz tagħha korpi b'massa jiġbdu lil xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引力相互作用

collocations.en: the gravitational interaction between two bodies
collocations.zh: 两个物体之间的引力相互作用

formal.mt: L-interazzjoni gravitazzjonali bejn id-Dinja u l-Qamar hija importanti biex nifhmu l-orbita tal-Qamar.
formal.en: The gravitational interaction between Earth and the Moon is important for understanding the Moon's orbit.
formal.zh: 地球与月球之间的引力相互作用对于理解月球轨道很重要。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex il-ballun jaqa' lejn l-art? Pawlu: Minħabba l-gravità; fil-fiżika nitkellmu dwar l-interazzjoni gravitazzjonali.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why does the ball fall towards the ground? Pawlu: Because of gravity; in physics we talk about gravitational interaction.

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fundamental interaction responsible for certain particle transformations, including those involved in beta decay.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 引起某些粒子转变的基本相互作用，包括参与贝塔衰变的转变。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Interazzjoni fundamentali responsabbli għal ċerti trasformazzjonijiet tal-partiċelli, inklużi dawk involuti fit-tħassir beta.

formal.zh: 这节课解释弱核相互作用在贝塔衰变中的作用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The strong fundamental interaction, associated with binding quarks and holding protons and neutrons together in atomic nuclei.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强的基本相互作用，与夸克的结合以及原子核内质子和中子的结合有关。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-interazzjoni fundamentali qawwija, marbuta ma' kif il-quarks jinżammu flimkien u ma' kif il-protoni u n-newtroni jinżammu flimkien fin-nuklei atomiċi.

messages.zh: 关于强核相互作用，我该记住什么？
messages.en: What should I remember about the strong nuclear interaction?

messages.speaker: Luqa (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħseb fil-protoni u n-newtroni li jinżammu flimkien fin-nukleu.
messages.mt_standard: Aħseb fil-protoni u n-newtroni li jinżammu flimkien fin-nukleu.
messages.zh: 可以想象质子和中子结合在原子核内。
messages.en: Think of protons and neutrons being held together in the nucleus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“核内粒子紧紧结合”的示意图联想强核相互作用；这只是学习图像，不把它理解成日常胶水。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The fundamental interaction that binds quarks together and underlies the binding of atomic nuclei.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使夸克结合在一起，并构成原子核结合机制基础的基本相互作用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-interazzjoni fundamentali li żżomm il-quarks flimkien u li hija l-bażi tar-rabta bejn il-partiċelli fin-nuklei atomiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强相互作用

collocations.zh: 夸克之间的强相互作用

collocations.en: the theory of the strong interaction

formal.mt: L-interazzjoni qawwija għandha rwol essenzjali biex il-quarks jinżammu flimkien fil-protoni u n-newtroni.
formal.en: The strong interaction plays an essential role in holding quarks together within protons and neutrons.
formal.zh: 强相互作用对于将夸克结合在质子和中子内部起着关键作用。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Hawnhekk, interazzjoni qawwija huwa terminu tal-fiżika? Rita: Iva, jirreferi għal interazzjoni fundamentali li żżomm il-quarks flimkien.
colloquial.en: Ben: Is strong interaction a physics term here? Rita: Yes, it refers to a fundamental interaction that holds quarks together.
colloquial.zh: 本：这里的“强相互作用”是物理术语吗？丽塔：是的，它指一种使夸克结合在一起的基本相互作用。

messages.speaker: Ben (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk, interazzjoni qawwija huwa terminu tal-fiżika?
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk, interazzjoni qawwija huwa terminu tal-fiżika?
messages.zh: 这里的“强相互作用”是物理术语吗？
messages.en: Is strong interaction a physics term here?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jirreferi għal interazzjoni fundamentali li żżomm il-quarks flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jirreferi għal interazzjoni fundamentali li żżomm il-quarks flimkien.
messages.zh: 是的，它指一种使夸克结合在一起的基本相互作用。
messages.en: Yes, it refers to a fundamental interaction that holds quarks together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个完整词组与“夸克结合”配对记忆；在本词条中要按物理术语“强相互作用”整体理解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An authoritative order prohibiting a particular action or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由有权机构发布、禁止某种行为或活动的命令。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ordni minn awtorità li tipprojbixxi azzjoni jew attività partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 禁令；由有权机构施加的禁止命令

formal.mt: Id-dokument jispjega li l-interdett jibqa' fis-seħħ sakemm titneħħa l-projbizzjoni.
formal.en: The document explains that the interdict remains in force until the prohibition is lifted.
formal.zh: 文件说明，在禁止措施被解除之前，该禁令持续有效。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Nistgħu nużaw is-sala llum? Ġorġ: Le, għad hemm interdett fuq l-użu tagħha.
colloquial.en: Marija: Can we use the hall today? Ġorġ: No, there is still an interdict on its use.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：我们今天可以用大厅吗？乔治：不行，禁止使用大厅的禁令还在生效。

messages.speaker: Marija (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 我们今天可以用大厅吗？
messages.en: Can we use the hall today?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (场地管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għad hemm interdett fuq l-użu tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għad hemm interdett fuq l-użu tagħha.
messages.zh: 不行，禁止使用大厅的禁令还在生效。
messages.en: No, there is still an interdict on its use.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 interdett 想成一张盖章的“禁止令”，先记它是命令这个名词，再与表示禁止动作的动词区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official prohibition that prevents a particular action or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由有关机构正式作出的禁止，限制某种行为或活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Projbizzjoni uffiċjali li twaqqaf azzjoni jew attività partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正式禁止；禁令。

formal.mt: L-avviż uffiċjali jħabbar interdizzjoni tad-dħul fiż-żona waqt ix-xogħlijiet.
formal.en: The official notice announces a prohibition on entering the area during the works.
formal.zh: 官方通知宣布，施工期间禁止进入该区域。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma nistgħux nidħlu? Mark: Hemm interdizzjoni tad-dħul sakemm jispiċċaw ix-xogħlijiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why can't we go in? Mark: Entry is prohibited until the works are finished.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们为什么不能进去？马克：施工结束之前禁止进入。

messages.speaker: Lara (访客)
messages.zh: 我们为什么不能进去？
messages.en: Why can't we go in?

messages.speaker: Mark (工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm interdizzjoni tad-dħul sakemm jispiċċaw ix-xogħlijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm interdizzjoni tad-dħul sakemm jispiċċaw ix-xogħlijiet.
messages.zh: 施工结束之前禁止进入。
messages.en: Entry is prohibited until the works are finished.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和门口的正式禁入告示一起记：看到禁令，就想到 interdizzjoni。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To prohibit an action or activity by an authoritative order.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过有权机构的命令禁止某种行为或活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ipprojbixxa azzjoni jew attività permezz ta' ordni minn awtorità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 下令禁止；以权威命令予以禁制

collocations.en: he interdicted the use of the hall
he interdicted entry into the building
collocations.zh: 他下令禁止进入该建筑

formal.mt: Il-kap interdiċa l-użu tas-sala sakemm jitlestew it-tiswijiet.
formal.en: The head interdicted the use of the hall until the repairs were completed.
formal.zh: 负责人下令禁止使用大厅，直至维修完成。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex ma nistgħux nidħlu fil-bini? Mark: Il-kap interdiċa d-dħul sakemm jitlestew it-tiswijiet.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why can't we enter the building? Mark: The head interdicted entry until the repairs are completed.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：为什么我们不能进入这栋建筑？马克：负责人下令禁止进入，直到维修完成。

messages.speaker: Anna (工作人员)
messages.zh: 为什么我们不能进入这栋建筑？
messages.en: Why can't we enter the building?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kap interdiċa d-dħul sakemm jitlestew it-tiswijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kap interdiċa d-dħul sakemm jitlestew it-tiswijiet.
messages.zh: 负责人下令禁止进入，直到维修完成。
messages.en: The head interdicted entry until the repairs are completed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“负责人下令禁止进入”的动作画面记 interdiċa；与名词 interdett 配对，一个表示下禁令，一个表示禁令本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A question asking a male addressee whether he is allergic to any medications.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 询问一名男性对方是否对某些药物过敏的问句；allerġiku 在这里使用阳性单数形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mistoqsija lil raġel biex wieħed ikun jaf jekk għandux allerġija għal xi mediċina.

sense_translations.en_definition: are you allergic to any medications?
sense_translations.zh_definition: 你对任何药物过敏吗？这里的 allerġiku 用于男性单数对象。

collocations.en: Are you allergic to any other medications?

collocations.mt: Inti allerġiku għal mediċini bħal dawn?
collocations.en: Are you allergic to medications like these?

formal.mt: Qabel il-kura, it-tabib staqsa lill-pazjent: 'Inti allerġiku għal mediċini?'
formal.en: Before treatment, the doctor asked the patient, 'Are you allergic to any medications?'
formal.zh: 治疗前，医生问患者：“你对药物过敏吗？”

colloquial.mt: Rita: Inti allerġiku għal mediċini? Pawlu: Iva, jien allerġiku għall-peniċillina.
colloquial.en: Rita: Are you allergic to any medications? Pawlu: Yes, I'm allergic to penicillin.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你对药物过敏吗？保罗：是的，我对青霉素过敏。

messages.speaker: Rita (医生)
messages.zh: 你对药物过敏吗？
messages.en: Are you allergic to any medications?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (患者)
messages.zh: 是的，我对青霉素过敏。
messages.en: Yes, I'm allergic to penicillin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按四块记整句：inti 是你，allerġiku 是过敏的，għal 表示对，mediċini 是药物；想象医生在问诊。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be forgotten; this is a form of ntnesa, used after a consonant and also as an alternative basic form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示被忘记或被遗忘；这是 ntnesa 在辅音后使用的形式，也可作为另一种基本形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma ta' ntnesa li tindika li xi ħadd ma baqax jiftakar persuna jew ħaġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: post-consonantal and alternative basic form of ntnesa
sense_translations.zh_definition: ntnesa 的辅音后形式及另一基本形式，表示被忘记。

formal.mt: L-appuntament intnesa u għalhekk il-laqgħa ma saritx fil-ħin.
formal.en: The appointment was forgotten, so the meeting did not take place on time.
formal.zh: 约定被忘记了，因此会议没有按时举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ħadd ma ġie għal-laqgħa? Karl: L-appuntament intnesa. Ejja nagħżlu ħin ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did nobody come to the meeting? Karl: The appointment was forgotten. Let's choose another time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么没人来开会？卡尔：大家把约定忘了。我们另选个时间吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 为什么没人来开会？
messages.en: Why did nobody come to the meeting?

messages.speaker: Karl (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: L-appuntament intnesa. Ejja nagħżlu ħin ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: L-appuntament intnesa. Ejja nagħżlu ħin ieħor.
messages.zh: 大家把约定忘了。我们另选个时间吧。
messages.en: The appointment was forgotten. Let's choose another time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历上的约定无人记得，用“约定被忘了”记住 intnesa 的被遗忘含义，并与 ntnesa 成对认读。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The second-person plural subject pronoun, used when addressing two or more people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 第二人称复数主语代词，指正在交谈的两人或多人，相当于“你们”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pronom personali tat-tieni persuna fil-plural, użat bħala suġġett meta wieħed ikellem żewġ persuni jew aktar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 你们，第二人称复数主语代词。

formal.mt: Intom responsabbli biex tibagħtu r-rapport qabel il-Ġimgħa.
formal.en: You are responsible for sending the report before Friday.
formal.zh: 你们负责在星期五之前发送报告。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Intom ġejjin magħna? Ben: Iva, aħna t-tnejn ġejjin.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you coming with us? Ben: Yes, both of us are coming.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你们要跟我们一起去吗？本：要，我们两个都去。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们要跟我们一起去吗？
messages.en: Are you coming with us?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 要，我们两个都去。
messages.en: Yes, both of us are coming.

cognitive_memory_aid: 说 intom 时想象自己指向面前的一群人：面对两人或更多人，中文就是“你们”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To work a lathe, shaping material as it rotates.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 操作车床，利用材料旋转进行切削成形。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaħdem bit-torn biex jagħti forma lil materjal waqt li dan idur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 操作车床；用车床加工。

collocations.en: turned a piece of wood on a lathe
collocations.zh: 用车床加工了一块木料

collocations.en: turned a piece of metal on a lathe
collocations.zh: 用车床加工了一块金属

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem intornja biċċa metall skont il-qisien mogħtija fid-disinn.
formal.en: The worker turned a piece of metal on a lathe according to the dimensions given in the drawing.
formal.zh: 工人按照图纸给出的尺寸，用车床加工了一块金属。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min għamel dan il-manku tal-injam? Toni: Missieri. Intornja biċċa njam biex jagħmlu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who made this wooden handle? Toni: My father. He turned a piece of wood on a lathe to make it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个木把手是谁做的？托尼：我爸爸。他用车床加工木料做成的。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个木把手是谁做的？
messages.en: Who made this wooden handle?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Missieri. Intornja biċċa njam biex jagħmlu.
messages.mt_standard: Missieri. Intornja biċċa njam biex jagħmlu.
messages.zh: 我爸爸。他用车床加工木料做成的。
messages.en: My father. He turned a piece of wood on a lathe to make it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用动作画面记忆：木料在车床上旋转，刀具把它削成把手；整个加工动作对应 intornja。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not equal in amount, size, value, or treatment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数量、大小、价值或所受待遇不相等的；可指具体差异，也可指待遇不平等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li mhux indaqs fil-kwantità, fid-daqs, fil-valur jew fit-trattament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不相等的；不平等的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri li ħaddiema bl-istess responsabbiltajiet jirċievu pagi inugwali.
formal.en: The report shows that workers with the same responsibilities receive unequal wages.
formal.zh: 报告显示，承担相同职责的工人领取的工资并不相等。

colloquial.mt: Ella: Dawn iż-żewġ biċċiet tal-kejk huma inugwali. Sam: Għandek raġun. Naqsam il-biċċa l-kbira biex ikollna l-istess ammont.
colloquial.en: Ella: These two pieces of cake are unequal. Sam: You're right. I'll divide the larger piece so we have the same amount.
colloquial.zh: 埃拉：这两块蛋糕大小不一样。萨姆：你说得对。我把大块分一下，让我们拿到一样多。

messages.speaker: Ella (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn iż-żewġ biċċiet tal-kejk huma inugwali.
messages.mt_standard: Dawn iż-żewġ biċċiet tal-kejk huma inugwali.
messages.zh: 这两块蛋糕大小不一样。
messages.en: These two pieces of cake are unequal.

messages.speaker: Sam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun. Naqsam il-biċċa l-kbira biex ikollna l-istess ammont.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun. Naqsam il-biċċa l-kbira biex ikollna l-istess ammont.
messages.zh: 你说得对。我把大块分一下，让我们拿到一样多。
messages.en: You're right. I'll divide the larger piece so we have the same amount.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两块一大一小的蛋糕，用 inugwali 描述它们“不相等”；记住这是描述性质的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of being unequal, especially in resources, opportunities, or treatment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不相等或不平等的状态，尤其指资源、机会或待遇存在差异。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda fejn ir-riżorsi, l-opportunitajiet jew it-trattament mhumiex indaqs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不相等的状态；不平等。

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina kif l-inugwalità ekonomika taffettwa l-aċċess għall-edukazzjoni.
formal.en: The study examines how economic inequality affects access to education.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察经济不平等如何影响受教育的机会。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Xi tfisser inugwalità fl-opportunitajiet? David: Pereżempju, meta xi tfal jistgħu jattendu kors u oħrajn ma jistgħux għax jiswa wisq.
colloquial.en: Marta: What does inequality of opportunity mean? David: For example, when some children can attend a course and others cannot because it costs too much.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：机会不平等是什么意思？戴维：比如，有些孩子能参加课程，另一些孩子却因为费用太高而不能参加。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: 机会不平等是什么意思？
messages.en: What does inequality of opportunity mean?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Pereżempju, meta xi tfal jistgħu jattendu kors u oħrajn ma jistgħux għax jiswa wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Pereżempju, meta xi tfal jistgħu jattendu kors u oħrajn ma jistgħux għax jiswa wisq.
messages.zh: 比如，有些孩子能参加课程，另一些孩子却因为费用太高而不能参加。
messages.en: For example, when some children can attend a course and others cannot because it costs too much.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inugwalità 放进“机会不平等”这个完整概念中记忆：它是给不平等状态命名的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state or situation in which people or things are not equal in amount, opportunity, or treatment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或事物在数量、机会或待遇方面不相等的状态或情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qagħda fejn persuni jew affarijiet mhumiex indaqs fil-kwantità, fl-opportunitajiet jew fit-trattament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不相等的状态；不平等。

formal.mt: Il-politika l-ġdida għandha l-għan li tnaqqas l-inugwaljanza fl-aċċess għas-servizzi pubbliċi.
formal.en: The new policy aims to reduce inequality in access to public services.
formal.zh: 新政策旨在减少获取公共服务方面的不平等。

colloquial.mt: Lea: Għaliex qed joffru dawn il-lezzjonijiet b'xejn? Omar: Biex inaqqsu l-inugwaljanza. B'hekk, anki min ma jistax iħallas ikun jista' jitgħallem.
colloquial.en: Lea: Why are they offering these lessons for free? Omar: To reduce inequality. That way, even people who cannot pay can learn.
colloquial.zh: 莉娅：他们为什么免费提供这些课程？奥马尔：为了减少不平等。这样，付不起费用的人也能学习。

messages.speaker: Lea (社区居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed joffru dawn il-lezzjonijiet b'xejn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed joffru dawn il-lezzjonijiet b'xejn?
messages.zh: 他们为什么免费提供这些课程？
messages.en: Why are they offering these lessons for free?

messages.speaker: Omar (社区志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex inaqqsu l-inugwaljanza. B'hekk, anki min ma jistax iħallas ikun jista' jitgħallem.
messages.mt_standard: Biex inaqqsu l-inugwaljanza. B'hekk, anki min ma jistax iħallas ikun jista' jitgħallem.
messages.zh: 为了减少不平等。这样，付不起费用的人也能学习。
messages.en: To reduce inequality. That way, even people who cannot pay can learn.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象免费课程让更多人获得学习机会，用“减少不平等”记住 tnaqqas l-inugwaljanza，并单独认清词尾拼写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way that gives different amounts, shares, or treatment to different people or things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以数量、份额或待遇不相等的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li jagħti ammonti, ishma jew trattament differenti lil persuni jew affarijiet differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不均等地；不平等地。

collocations.zh: 薪酬待遇不平等的工人

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri li r-riżorsi tqassmu inugwalment bejn iż-żewġ skejjel.
formal.en: The report shows that resources were distributed unequally between the two schools.
formal.zh: 报告显示，两所学校之间的资源分配不均。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex int għandek tliet biċċiet u jien waħda biss? Mark: Għax qassamna l-kejk inugwalment. Ejja nerġgħu naqsmuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you have three pieces and I have only one? Mark: Because we divided the cake unequally. Let's divide it again.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么你有三块，我只有一块？马克：因为我们把蛋糕分得不均。我们重新分吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex int għandek tliet biċċiet u jien waħda biss?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex int għandek tliet biċċiet u jien waħda biss?
messages.zh: 为什么你有三块，我只有一块？
messages.en: Why do you have three pieces and I have only one?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax qassamna l-kejk inugwalment. Ejja nerġgħu naqsmuh.
messages.mt_standard: Għax qassamna l-kejk inugwalment. Ejja nerġgħu naqsmuh.
messages.zh: 因为我们把蛋糕分得不均。我们重新分吧。
messages.en: Because we divided the cake unequally. Let's divide it again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两只盘子一边三块蛋糕、一边一块，用这个分配不均的画面记住“不均等地”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cruel and lacking the compassion or respect that people should show to others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 残酷而缺乏应有的同情心或对他人的尊重的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Krudil u nieqes mill-ħniena jew mir-rispett li wieħed għandu juri lejn ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不人道的；冷酷残忍、缺乏人性的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-trattament inuman li sofrew il-priġunieri.
formal.en: The report describes the inhuman treatment that the prisoners suffered.
formal.zh: 报告描述了囚犯遭受的不人道待遇。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ma ħallewhomx jistrieħu għal sigħat sħaħ. Pawlu: Dak hu trattament inuman. Kulħadd għandu bżonn il-mistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: They weren't allowed to rest for hours on end. Pawlu: That's inhuman treatment. Everyone needs rest.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：他们连续好几个小时都不准休息。保罗：那是不人道的待遇。每个人都需要休息。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma ħallewhomx jistrieħu għal sigħat sħaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Ma ħallewhomx jistrieħu għal sigħat sħaħ.
messages.zh: 他们连续好几个小时都不准休息。
messages.en: They weren't allowed to rest for hours on end.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu trattament inuman. Kulħadd għandu bżonn il-mistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu trattament inuman. Kulħadd għandu bżonn il-mistrieħ.
messages.zh: 那是不人道的待遇。每个人都需要休息。
messages.en: That's inhuman treatment. Everyone needs rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个形容词贴在“残酷待遇”的画面旁，记住它描述行为或待遇缺乏人道。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a cruel way that shows no compassion or respect for other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以残酷、缺乏同情心或不尊重他人的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod krudil li ma jurix ħniena jew rispett lejn ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不人道地；以缺乏人性或同情心的方式。

formal.mt: Ix-xhieda qalu li l-gwardji ttrattaw lill-priġunieri inumanament.
formal.en: The witnesses said that the guards treated the prisoners inhumanely.
formal.zh: 证人说，看守不人道地对待囚犯。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif ittrattahom il-kap? Mark: Ittrattahom inumanament; lanqas ħalliehom jistrieħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the boss treat them? Mark: He treated them inhumanely; he didn't even let them rest.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：老板是怎么对待他们的？马克：他对他们很不人道，连休息都不让。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 老板是怎么对待他们的？
messages.en: How did the boss treat them?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 他对他们很不人道，连休息都不让。
messages.en: He treated them inhumanely; he didn't even let them rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“他怎样对待别人？”来提示副词功能，回答“不人道地”时就想到这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cruelty or a lack of compassion in the way people treat others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对待他人时表现出的残酷、冷漠或缺乏同情心。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-krudeltà jew in-nuqqas ta' ħniena fil-mod kif in-nies jittrattaw lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不人道；残忍；对他人缺乏人性和同情心。

formal.mt: L-awtur jikkundanna l-inumanità ta' dawk li ċaħħdu lill-familji mill-ikel.
formal.en: The author condemns the inhumanity of those who deprived the families of food.
formal.zh: 作者谴责那些剥夺各家食物的人所表现出的残忍。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kienu jafu li kellu l-ġuħ, iżda ma tawh xejn x'jiekol. Pawlu: X'inumanità! Setgħu għall-inqas offrewlu ftit ikel.
colloquial.en: Sara: They knew he was hungry, but they gave him nothing to eat. Pawlu: Such inhumanity! They could at least have offered him some food.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：他们知道他饿了，却什么吃的都不给他。保罗：太没有人性了！他们至少可以给他一点食物。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kienu jafu li kellu l-ġuħ, iżda ma tawh xejn x'jiekol.
messages.mt_standard: Kienu jafu li kellu l-ġuħ, iżda ma tawh xejn x'jiekol.
messages.zh: 他们知道他饿了，却什么吃的都不给他。
messages.en: They knew he was hungry, but they gave him nothing to eat.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inumanità! Setgħu għall-inqas offrewlu ftit ikel.
messages.mt_standard: X'inumanità! Setgħu għall-inqas offrewlu ftit ikel.
messages.zh: 太没有人性了！他们至少可以给他一点食物。
messages.en: Such inhumanity! They could at least have offered him some food.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“不人道”想成可以被谴责的一种性质；这个名词用来点出行为中的残忍。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something invalid or declare that it is no longer valid or acceptable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某事物失去效力，或宣布它不再有效或不能被接受。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa invalida jew jiddikjara li ma għadhiex valida jew aċċettabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使无效；使失去效力；宣告无效。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat invalida r-riżultat minħabba żball serju fl-għadd tal-voti.
formal.en: The committee invalidated the result because of a serious error in counting the votes.
formal.zh: 委员会因计票出现严重错误而宣布结果无效。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex irridu nerġgħu nivvutaw? Mark: Il-kumitat invalida r-riżultat għax kien hemm żball fl-għadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do we have to vote again? Mark: The committee invalidated the result because there was a counting error.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们为什么要重新投票？马克：委员会因为计票出错而宣布结果无效。

messages.speaker: Maja (社团成员)
messages.zh: 我们为什么要重新投票？
messages.en: Why do we have to vote again?

messages.speaker: Mark (社团成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kumitat invalida r-riżultat għax kien hemm żball fl-għadd.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kumitat invalida r-riżultat għax kien hemm żball fl-għadd.
messages.zh: 委员会因为计票出错而宣布结果无效。
messages.en: The committee invalidated the result because there was a counting error.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象委员会给结果盖上“无效”章，记住这里是“使其无效”的动作，是动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of lacking validity or having no recognized force or effect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缺乏有效性，或不具有被认可的效力的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat ta' xi ħaġa li mhijiex valida jew li m'għandhiex effett rikonoxxut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无效；缺乏有效性或效力的状态。

formal.mt: Il-qorti eżaminat il-kwistjoni tal-invalidità tal-kuntratt.
formal.en: The court examined the issue of the contract's invalidity.
formal.zh: 法院审查了合同无效的问题。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'qal l-avukat dwar il-kuntratt? Pawlu: Semma l-invalidità tiegħu, imma għad irid jispjegalna r-raġuni.
colloquial.en: Sara: What did the lawyer say about the contract? Pawlu: He mentioned its invalidity, but he still needs to explain the reason to us.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：律师对这份合同说了什么？保罗：他提到了合同无效的问题，但还需要向我们解释原因。

messages.speaker: Sara (客户)
messages.zh: 律师对这份合同说了什么？
messages.en: What did the lawyer say about the contract?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (客户)
messages.mt_spoken: Semma l-invalidità tiegħu, imma għad irid jispjegalna r-raġuni.
messages.mt_standard: Semma l-invalidità tiegħu, imma għad irid jispjegalna r-raġuni.
messages.zh: 他提到了合同无效的问题，但还需要向我们解释原因。
messages.en: He mentioned its invalidity, but he still needs to explain the reason to us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用中文“无效性”中的“性”提醒自己这是名词，谈的是无效这一状态或性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not valid, acceptable, or effective for its intended purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不具有效力、不能被接受，或不能用于预定用途的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li mhuwiex validu, aċċettabbli jew effettiv għall-iskop maħsub.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无效的；不被认可的；用于论证时指不成立的。

formal.mt: Id-dokument ġie ddikjarat invalidu minħabba li ma kellux il-firma meħtieġa.
formal.en: The document was declared invalid because it lacked the required signature.
formal.zh: 该文件因缺少所需签名而被宣布无效。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex ma nistax nidħol b'dan il-biljett? Rita: Dan il-biljett huwa invalidu għax id-data tiegħu kienet ilbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why can't I enter with this ticket? Rita: This ticket is invalid because it was dated for yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 马克：为什么我不能拿这张票进去？丽塔：这张票无效，因为票上的日期是昨天。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistax nidħol b'dan il-biljett?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistax nidħol b'dan il-biljett?
messages.zh: 为什么我不能拿这张票进去？
messages.en: Why can't I enter with this ticket?

messages.speaker: Rita (检票员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-biljett huwa invalidu għax id-data tiegħu kienet ilbieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-biljett huwa invalidu għax id-data tiegħu kienet ilbieraħ.
messages.zh: 这张票无效，因为票上的日期是昨天。
messages.en: This ticket is invalid because it was dated for yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象检票员指着一张日期已过的票说“无效的”，把这个形容词与票的状态连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Remaining the same without changing across time or circumstances.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 随时间推移或情况变化仍保持相同的；恒定不变的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jibqa' l-istess mingħajr ma jinbidel maż-żmien jew skont iċ-ċirkostanzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不变的；始终相同的；恒定的。

formal.mt: Matul l-esperiment, il-volum tal-likwidu nżamm invarjabbli.
formal.en: Throughout the experiment, the volume of the liquid was kept constant.
formal.zh: 在整个实验过程中，液体体积保持不变。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-prezz jinbidel skont il-ġurnata? Mark: Le, jibqa' invarjabbli matul il-ġimgħa kollha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does the price change depending on the day? Mark: No, it stays the same throughout the whole week.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：价格会随星期几而变化吗？马克：不会，整个星期都保持不变。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 价格会随星期几而变化吗？
messages.en: Does the price change depending on the day?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jibqa' invarjabbli matul il-ġimgħa kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jibqa' invarjabbli matul il-ġimgħa kollha.
messages.zh: 不会，整个星期都保持不变。
messages.en: No, it stays the same throughout the whole week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一周七张价签上的数字完全一样，用“天天相同”的画面记住“不变的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of remaining unchanged across time or under different conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某种性质、数值或状态在时间推移或条件变化时保持不变的特性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' xi ħaġa li tibqa' l-istess maż-żmien jew taħt kundizzjonijiet differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不变性；保持相同状态或数值的特性。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-invarjabilità tat-temperatura matul l-esperiment kollu.
formal.en: The report describes the invariability of the temperature throughout the experiment.
formal.zh: 报告描述了整个实验过程中温度保持恒定的情况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tfisser l-invarjabilità hawn? Pawlu: Tfisser li l-valur baqa' l-istess kull darba li kejjelnieh.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does invariability mean here? Pawlu: It means the value stayed the same every time we measured it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的“不变性”是什么意思？保罗：意思是我们每次测量时，数值都保持相同。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这里的“不变性”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does invariability mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li l-valur baqa' l-istess kull darba li kejjelnieh.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li l-valur baqa' l-istess kull darba li kejjelnieh.
messages.zh: 意思是我们每次测量时，数值都保持相同。
messages.en: It means the value stayed the same every time we measured it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象连续几次测量，仪表上的数字始终不动，用这个画面记住“不变性”。

gloss_zh: 创造力；善于构思新办法的能力

teaching_sense.en_definition: The ability to think of original ideas or devise new and useful solutions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够提出原创想法，或设计出新颖且实用的解决办法的能力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħila li wieħed joħroġ b'ideat oriġinali jew isib soluzzjonijiet ġodda u utli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 创造力；善于提出新点子或想出巧妙办法的能力。

formal.mt: Il-proġett juri inventivà fl-użu ta' materjali riċiklati biex jinħoloq għamara utli.
formal.en: The project shows inventiveness in using recycled materials to create useful furniture.
formal.zh: 这个项目在利用回收材料制作实用家具方面展现了创造力。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għamilt lampa minn vażett qadim. Mark: Kemm għandek inventivà! Kif ħriġt b'din l-idea?
colloquial.en: Lara: I made a lamp from an old jar. Mark: You're so inventive! How did you come up with that idea?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我用一个旧罐子做了一盏灯。马克：你真有创造力！你怎么想到这个点子的？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我用一个旧罐子做了一盏灯。
messages.en: I made a lamp from an old jar.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm għandek inventivà! Kif ħriġt b'din l-idea?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm għandek inventivà! Kif ħriġt b'din l-idea?
messages.zh: 你真有创造力！你怎么想到这个点子的？
messages.en: You're so inventive! How did you come up with that idea?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把旧罐子变成新台灯：记住这个巧妙改造的画面，就能联想到“创造力”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who creates a new device, process, or other practical invention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 创造出新装置、新工艺或其他实用发明的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li toħloq apparat, proċess jew invenzjoni prattika ġdida.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发明家；设计或创造出某项新发明的人。

formal.mt: L-inventur ippreżenta apparat ġdid li jnaqqas il-ħela tal-ilma.
formal.en: The inventor presented a new device that reduces water waste.
formal.zh: 这位发明家展示了一种能够减少水资源浪费的新装置。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min ħoloq dan l-apparat? David: Ħija! Hu l-inventur, u għadu qed itejbu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who created this device? David: My brother! He's the inventor, and he's still improving it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个装置是谁做出来的？戴维：我哥哥！他就是发明者，而且还在改进它。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个装置是谁做出来的？
messages.en: Who created this device?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija! Hu l-inventur, u għadu qed itejbu.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija! Hu l-inventur, u għadu qed itejbu.
messages.zh: 我哥哥！他就是发明者，而且还在改进它。
messages.en: My brother! He's the inventor, and he's still improving it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人在工作台前造出新机器；这个“造出发明的人”就是发明者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A formal ceremony in which someone is officially given an office, rank, or honour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正式授予某人职位、等级或荣誉称号的仪式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċerimonja formali li fiha persuna tingħata uffiċjalment kariga, grad jew unur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 授职或授衔；正式赋予职位、等级或荣誉的仪式。

formal.mt: Il-programm jinkludi ċ-ċerimonja tal-investitura tal-kavallieri l-ġodda.
formal.en: The programme includes the investiture ceremony for the new knights.
formal.zh: 活动安排包括新晋骑士的授衔仪式。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex kulħadd liebes hekk eleganti? Toni: Illum hemm l-investitura; se jagħtu l-unuri lill-mistiedna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is everyone dressed so smartly? Toni: The investiture is today; they're going to present honours to the guests.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么大家都穿得这么正式？托尼：今天有授衔仪式，要向来宾颁授荣誉。

messages.speaker: Maja (来宾)
messages.zh: 为什么大家都穿得这么正式？
messages.en: Why is everyone dressed so smartly?

messages.speaker: Toni (活动工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum hemm l-investitura; se jagħtu l-unuri lill-mistiedna.
messages.mt_standard: Illum hemm l-investitura; se jagħtu l-unuri lill-mistiedna.
messages.zh: 今天有授衔仪式，要向来宾颁授荣誉。
messages.en: The investiture is today; they're going to present honours to the guests.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象典礼上郑重授予勋章或职位的场面，用“正式授予的仪式”来记这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Impossible to defeat or overcome.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 无法被击败或克服的；也可用于形容仿佛无人能战胜的强大状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jistax jiġi megħlub.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不可战胜的；无法被击败的。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-kavallier jidher invinċibbli sakemm jiltaqa' ma' avversarju aktar b'saħħtu.
formal.en: In the novel, the knight appears invincible until he meets a stronger opponent.
formal.zh: 小说中的骑士起初似乎不可战胜，直到他遇见更强大的对手。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Irbaħna kull logħba s'issa! Lara: Qisna tim invinċibbli, imma xorta rridu nitħarrġu.
colloquial.en: Mark: We've won every match so far! Lara: We seem like an invincible team, but we still need to train.
colloquial.zh: 马克：到目前为止，每场比赛我们都赢了！拉拉：我们简直像一支无敌的队伍，不过还是得训练。

messages.speaker: Mark (队友)
messages.zh: 到目前为止，每场比赛我们都赢了！
messages.en: We've won every match so far!

messages.speaker: Lara (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qisna tim invinċibbli, imma xorta rridu nitħarrġu.
messages.mt_standard: Qisna tim invinċibbli, imma xorta rridu nitħarrġu.
messages.zh: 我们简直像一支无敌的队伍，不过还是得训练。
messages.en: We seem like an invincible team, but we still need to train.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象游戏角色头顶写着“无敌”，对手怎样进攻都无法击败他，记住“不可战胜的”。

gloss_zh: 不可侵犯的；不可违背的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Required to be respected and protected, and not to be violated or infringed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 必须受到尊重和保护、不得被侵犯或违背的，常用于权利、尊严或原则。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu jiġi rispettat u mħares u ma għandux jinkiser jew jiġi miksur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不可侵犯的；必须受到尊重、不得遭到破坏或违背的。

formal.mt: Fid-diskors tagħha, l-awtriċi tiddeskrivi d-dinjità tal-bniedem bħala invjolabbli.
formal.en: In her speech, the author describes human dignity as inviolable.
formal.zh: 这位作家在演讲中将人的尊严描述为不可侵犯的。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nista' naqra d-djarju tiegħek? Maja: Le, għalija l-privatezza hija invjolabbli.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can I read your diary? Maja: No, to me privacy is inviolable.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我可以看你的日记吗？玛雅：不行，对我来说，隐私是不可侵犯的。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我可以看你的日记吗？
messages.en: Can I read your diary?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 不行，对我来说，隐私是不可侵犯的。
messages.en: No, to me privacy is inviolable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日记外有一道写着“必须尊重”的边界，用它记住“不可侵犯的”。

gloss_zh: 不可侵犯性；不可违背性

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality or status of being protected from violation or infringement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某种权利、尊严、领域或原则必须受到尊重、不得被侵犯或违背的性质或地位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità jew il-qagħda ta' xi ħaġa li għandha tiġi rispettata u mħarsa minn kull ksur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不可侵犯性；受到保护而不得被侵犯或违背的性质。

collocations.zh: 人的尊严的不可侵犯性

formal.mt: L-esej jiddiskuti l-invjolabilità tad-dinjità tal-bniedem u r-responsabbiltà li nirrispettaw lil xulxin.
formal.en: The essay discusses the inviolability of human dignity and the responsibility to respect one another.
formal.zh: 这篇文章讨论了人的尊严的不可侵犯性，以及相互尊重的责任。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Xi tfisser l-invjolabilità f'din is-sentenza? Sara: Tfisser li ħadd ma għandu jikser jew jhedded dak li qed jiġi protett.
colloquial.en: Toni: What does inviolability mean in this sentence? Sara: It means that no one should violate or threaten what is being protected.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：这句话里的“不可侵犯性”是什么意思？萨拉：意思是任何人都不应侵犯或威胁受到保护的事物。

messages.speaker: Toni (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的“不可侵犯性”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does inviolability mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Sara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li ħadd ma għandu jikser jew jhedded dak li qed jiġi protett.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li ħadd ma għandu jikser jew jhedded dak li qed jiġi protett.
messages.zh: 意思是任何人都不应侵犯或威胁受到保护的事物。
messages.en: It means that no one should violate or threaten what is being protected.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“不可侵犯”当作一项需要守护的性质：形容这种性质本身时，就想到“不可侵犯性”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Without intending to do something, or without conscious control over an action or reaction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 并非有意地做出某事，或在无法自主控制的情况下产生动作或反应。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mingħajr ma wieħed ikun ried jagħmel xi ħaġa, jew mingħajr kontroll konxju fuq azzjoni jew reazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无意地，并非故意地；不由自主地，非出于自主控制地。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipant għalaq għajnejh involontarjament meta deher dawl qawwi.
formal.en: The participant closed his eyes involuntarily when a bright light appeared.
formal.zh: 强光出现时，这名参与者不由自主地闭上了眼睛。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex ħassart ir-ritratt? Lara: Ħassartu involontarjament; għafast il-buttuna l-ħażina.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did you delete the photo? Lara: I deleted it unintentionally; I pressed the wrong button.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你为什么把照片删了？拉拉：我不是故意删的，我按错了按钮。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把照片删了？
messages.en: Why did you delete the photo?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我不是故意删的，我按错了按钮。
messages.en: I deleted it unintentionally; I pressed the wrong button.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面一起记：误按按钮是“无意地”，遇到强光闭眼是“不由自主地”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Happening without conscious control or without an intention to cause it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不受意识控制而发生的，或并非有意造成的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġri mingħajr kontroll konxju jew mingħajr intenzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不由自主的；非出于本人意愿的；无意的；非蓄意的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi moviment involontarju tal-id waqt l-eżami.
formal.en: The report describes an involuntary movement of the hand during the examination.
formal.zh: 报告描述了检查期间手部出现的一次不由自主的动作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ċaqlaqt idek? Mark: Kien moviment involontarju; ma għamiltux apposta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you move your hand? Mark: It was an involuntary movement; I didn't do it on purpose.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么动了一下手？马克：那是不由自主的动作，我不是故意的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么动了一下手？
messages.en: Why did you move your hand?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien moviment involontarju; ma għamiltux apposta.
messages.mt_standard: Kien moviment involontarju; ma għamiltux apposta.
messages.zh: 那是不由自主的动作，我不是故意的。
messages.en: It was an involuntary movement; I didn't do it on purpose.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手突然自己抖了一下，把 involontarju 与“身体自己动、本人没打算”联系起来；也可用来描述无意造成的错误。

gloss_zh: 在不知情的情况下；无意中

teaching_sense.en_definition: Without knowing a relevant fact or realizing what one is doing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在不知道有关事实或没有意识到自己行为的情况下。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mingħajr ma wieħed ikun jaf b'fatt rilevanti jew jinduna b'dak li jkun qed jagħmel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不知情地；在没有察觉或意识到的情况下。

collocations.zh: 在不知情的情况下分享信息

collocations.en: to use an old address unknowingly

formal.mt: Anna inxjentement użat indirizz antik meta bagħtet l-ittra.
formal.en: Anna unknowingly used an old address when she sent the letter.
formal.zh: 安娜寄信时，在不知情的情况下使用了旧地址。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kont taf li dak kien l-indirizz l-antik? Maja: Le, użajtu inxjentement. Issa nibgħat l-ittra fl-indirizz it-tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Mark: Did you know that was the old address? Maja: No, I used it unknowingly. I'll send the letter to the correct address now.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你知道那是旧地址吗？玛雅：不知道，我是不知情才用了它。我现在把信寄到正确的地址。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont taf li dak kien l-indirizz l-antik?
messages.mt_standard: Kont taf li dak kien l-indirizz l-antik?
messages.zh: 你知道那是旧地址吗？
messages.en: Did you know that was the old address?

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, użajtu inxjentement. Issa nibgħat l-ittra fl-indirizz it-tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Le, użajtu inxjentement. Issa nibgħat l-ittra fl-indirizz it-tajjeb.
messages.zh: 不知道，我是不知情才用了它。我现在把信寄到正确的地址。
messages.en: No, I used it unknowingly. I'll send the letter to the correct address now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“做了以后才知道”的场景：不知道地址已经变更，却照旧寄信。inxjentement 修饰动作，强调做事时并不知情。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not aware of a fact, situation, or event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不知道某个事实、情况或事件的；没有察觉的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jkunx jaf b'fatt, b'sitwazzjoni jew b'ġrajja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 未察觉的；不知道的；不知情的。

formal.mt: L-impjegat kien inxjenti tal-bidla fil-ħin tal-laqgħa.
formal.en: The employee was unaware of the change in the meeting time.
formal.zh: 这名员工不知道会议时间已经更改。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ġejt fid-disgħa? Il-laqgħa tibda fl-għaxra. Mark: Kont inxjenti tal-bidla; ħadd ma qalli.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you come at nine? The meeting starts at ten. Mark: I was unaware of the change; nobody told me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么九点就来了？会议十点才开始。马克：我不知道时间改了，没人告诉我。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ġejt fid-disgħa? Il-laqgħa tibda fl-għaxra.
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ġejt fid-disgħa? Il-laqgħa tibda fl-għaxra.
messages.zh: 你为什么九点就来了？会议十点才开始。
messages.en: Why did you come at nine? The meeting starts at ten.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont inxjenti tal-bidla; ħadd ma qalli.
messages.mt_standard: Kont inxjenti tal-bidla; ħadd ma qalli.
messages.zh: 我不知道时间改了，没人告诉我。
messages.en: I was unaware of the change; nobody told me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inxjenti 想成一个没收到通知的人，头上画着问号：它描述“不知情的人或状态”，而 inxjentement 描述“不知情地做”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An aromatic substance burned to produce a pleasant smell, especially during religious ceremonies.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 燃烧时散发香气的物质，尤其指宗教仪式中使用的熏香或乳香。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza li tinħaraq biex tagħti riħa tfuħ, speċjalment waqt ċerimonji reliġjużi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 熏香；乳香，即可燃烧以散发香气的香料或芳香树脂。

formal.mt: Waqt iċ-ċerimonja, ir-riħa tal-inċens imliet il-knisja.
formal.en: During the ceremony, the smell of incense filled the church.
formal.zh: 仪式进行时，熏香的气味弥漫了教堂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi dik ir-riħa tfuħ? Mark: Dik ir-riħa tal-inċens li qed jinħaraq.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that lovely smell? Mark: That's the smell of the incense that's burning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那是什么香味？马克：那是正在燃烧的熏香的气味。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是什么香味？
messages.en: What's that lovely smell?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik ir-riħa tal-inċens li qed jinħaraq.
messages.mt_standard: Dik ir-riħa tal-inċens li qed jinħaraq.
messages.zh: 那是正在燃烧的熏香的气味。
messages.en: That's the smell of the incense that's burning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inċens 和英语 incense 对照记忆，再想象教堂里升起的香烟，记住它表示熏香或乳香。

gloss_zh: 无可指责的；无可非议的

teaching_sense.en_definition: So proper or morally sound that there is no reasonable basis for criticism or blame.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 行为或品行十分正当，没有合理理由加以指责的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jagħti ebda raġuni ġusta għal kritika jew ċanfir, għax ikun korrett jew xieraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无可指责的；无可非议的，常用于评价行为、品行或操守。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat iddeskriva l-kondotta tal-uffiċjal bħala inċensurabbli.
formal.en: The committee described the officer's conduct as irreproachable.
formal.zh: 委员会认为这名官员的操守无可指责。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fir-rapport ktibt li l-imġiba ta' Sara kienet inċensurabbli. X'tifhem biha? Pawlu: Li ġabet ruħha tajjeb ħafna u ma kien hemm xejn x'tikkritika.
colloquial.en: Lara: In the report, you wrote that Sara's behaviour was irreproachable. What do you mean by that? Pawlu: That she behaved very well and there was nothing to criticise.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你在报告里写萨拉的行为无可指责，这是什么意思？保罗：就是说她表现得很好，没有什么可批评的。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fir-rapport ktibt li l-imġiba ta' Sara kienet inċensurabbli. X'tifhem biha?
messages.mt_standard: Fir-rapport ktibt li l-imġiba ta' Sara kienet inċensurabbli. X'tifhem biha?
messages.zh: 你在报告里写萨拉的行为无可指责，这是什么意思？
messages.en: In the report, you wrote that Sara's behaviour was irreproachable. What do you mean by that?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Li ġabet ruħha tajjeb ħafna u ma kien hemm xejn x'tikkritika.
messages.mt_standard: Li ġabet ruħha tajjeb ħafna u ma kien hemm xejn x'tikkritika.
messages.zh: 就是说她表现得很好，没有什么可批评的。
messages.en: That she behaved very well and there was nothing to criticise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inċensurabbli 放进“表现挑不出毛病”的评语场景，与 imġiba 一起记成“无可指责的行为”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Occurring alongside something else without being its main part or purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 伴随主要事情出现，但并非其主要部分或目的的；附带的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jseħħ flimkien ma' xi ħaġa oħra mingħajr ma jkun il-parti jew l-għan ewlieni tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 附带的；伴随发生而非主要的；视语境也可指偶然发生的。

formal.mt: Il-baġit jinkludi somma żgħira biex tkopri spejjeż inċidentali matul il-vjaġġ.
formal.en: The budget includes a small amount to cover incidental expenses during the trip.
formal.zh: 预算中包含一小笔款项，用于支付旅途中的附带费用。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ħallejt ftit flus żejda fil-baġit? Mark: Għal spejjeż inċidentali, bħal xi telefonata jew biljett tal-karozza tal-linja.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you leave a little extra money in the budget? Mark: For incidental expenses, like a phone call or a bus ticket.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么在预算里多留了一点钱？马克：支付一些附带费用，比如打电话或买公交车票。

messages.speaker: Nina (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ħallejt ftit flus żejda fil-baġit?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ħallejt ftit flus żejda fil-baġit?
messages.zh: 你为什么在预算里多留了一点钱？
messages.en: Why did you leave a little extra money in the budget?

messages.speaker: Mark (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal spejjeż inċidentali, bħal xi telefonata jew biljett tal-karozza tal-linja.
messages.mt_standard: Għal spejjeż inċidentali, bħal xi telefonata jew biljett tal-karozza tal-linja.
messages.zh: 支付一些附带费用，比如打电话或买公交车票。
messages.en: For incidental expenses, like a phone call or a bus ticket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象旅行大预算旁边的一小栏杂费，用 spejjeż inċidentali 记住“伴随主要事情产生的附带费用”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to introduce an additional remark; also, in a way that happens by chance or as a secondary result.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于引出补充话语，表示“顺便说一句”；也可表示偶然地或附带地发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tiddaħħal rimarka oħra; tista' wkoll tfisser li xi ħaġa sseħħ b'kumbinazzjoni jew bħala riżultat sekondarju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 顺便说一句；附带地；偶然地，具体含义由上下文决定。

collocations.en: Incidentally, I forgot to tell you
collocations.zh: 顺便说一句，我忘了告诉你

formal.mt: Inċidentalment, il-mappa msemmija f'dan il-kapitlu tinsab fl-appendiċi.
formal.en: Incidentally, the map mentioned in this chapter is in the appendix.
formal.zh: 附带说明，本章提到的地图收录在附录中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Inċidentalment, għada se niġi ftit tard. Lara: Tajjeb, nibdew meta tasal.
colloquial.en: Maja: By the way, I'll be a little late tomorrow. Lara: All right, we'll start when you arrive.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：顺便说一句，我明天会晚到一点。拉拉：好的，等你到了我们再开始。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Inċidentalment, għada se niġi ftit tard.
messages.mt_standard: Inċidentalment, għada se niġi ftit tard.
messages.zh: 顺便说一句，我明天会晚到一点。
messages.en: By the way, I'll be a little late tomorrow.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 好的，等你到了我们再开始。
messages.en: All right, we'll start when you arrive.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Inċidentalment, 想成说话时临时加上的小便签：先记“顺便说一句”，再用寻找物品的场景记“偶然地”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The frequency with which an event or condition occurs in a population during a given period.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某一事件或状况在一定时期、特定群体中的发生频率；用于疾病时常指发病率。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-frekwenza li biha avveniment jew kundizzjoni jseħħu f'popolazzjoni matul perjodu partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发生率；发生频率；在疾病统计语境中指发病率。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iqabbel l-inċidenza tal-marda f'żewġ reġjuni matul l-istess sena.
formal.en: The report compares the incidence of the disease in two regions during the same year.
formal.zh: 报告比较了同一年两个地区的该病发病率。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser inċidenza f'din it-tabella? Pawlu: Hawn tfisser kemm jinqalgħu każijiet ġodda tal-marda fil-popolazzjoni matul sena.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does incidence mean in this table? Pawlu: Here it means how frequently new cases of the disease occur in the population over a year.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这张表里的“发病率”是什么意思？保罗：这里指一年中该群体出现这种疾病新病例的频率。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这张表里的“发病率”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does incidence mean in this table?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser kemm jinqalgħu każijiet ġodda tal-marda fil-popolazzjoni matul sena.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser kemm jinqalgħu każijiet ġodda tal-marda fil-popolazzjoni matul sena.
messages.zh: 这里指一年中该群体出现这种疾病新病例的频率。
messages.en: Here it means how frequently new cases of the disease occur in the population over a year.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 inċidenza 就想一张标着“群体、时间、新发生事件”的统计表，帮助记住发生率和发病率。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To destroy something by burning it, especially waste in a suitable facility.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过燃烧销毁某物，尤其指在适当设施内焚化废弃物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jeqred xi ħaġa billi jaħraqha, speċjalment skart f'faċilità apposta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 焚化；通过焚烧将物品销毁或烧成灰烬。

formal.mt: L-impjant inċinera l-iskart f'forn apposta taħt kundizzjonijiet ikkontrollati.
formal.en: The plant incinerated the waste in a dedicated furnace under controlled conditions.
formal.zh: 该处理厂在受控条件下，使用专用焚烧炉焚化了废弃物。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'ġara mill-materjal ikkontaminat? Nina: L-impjant inċinerah ilbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Mark: What happened to the contaminated material? Nina: The plant incinerated it yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 马克：那些受污染的材料怎么处理了？妮娜：处理厂昨天把它们焚化了。

messages.speaker: Mark (工作人员)
messages.zh: 那些受污染的材料怎么处理了？
messages.en: What happened to the contaminated material?

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 处理厂昨天把它们焚化了。
messages.en: The plant incinerated it yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inċinera 与英语 incinerate 对照，再想象废弃物进入专用炉后化为灰烬，记住“焚化销毁”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Christian message about Jesus Christ, or a text recounting his life and teachings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基督教中关于耶稣基督的福音信息，或记述其生平与教导的福音书。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-messaġġ Nisrani dwar Ġesù Kristu, jew test li jirrakkonta ħajtu u t-tagħlim tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 福音；基督教中关于耶稣基督的信息，亦指记述其生平和教导的福音书。

formal.mt: Fl-istudju tiegħu, l-awtur janalizza l-messaġġ tal-inġil u l-importanza tal-maħfra.
formal.en: In his study, the author analyses the message of the gospel and the importance of forgiveness.
formal.zh: 作者在研究中分析了福音的信息以及宽恕的重要性。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'qed taqra? Ġużeppi: Silta mill-inġil; wara nistgħu nitkellmu dwarha.
colloquial.en: Marija: What are you reading? Ġużeppi: A passage from the gospel; we can talk about it afterwards.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你在读什么？朱塞佩：福音书中的一段，等会儿我们可以讨论一下。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.zh: 你在读什么？
messages.en: What are you reading?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Silta mill-inġil; wara nistgħu nitkellmu dwarha.
messages.mt_standard: Silta mill-inġil; wara nistgħu nitkellmu dwarha.
messages.zh: 福音书中的一段，等会儿我们可以讨论一下。
messages.en: A passage from the gospel; we can talk about it afterwards.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inġil 与一本正在诵读的福音书联系起来，再联想到书中传达的福音信息，同时记住文本与信息这两种理解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In or towards the surrounding area, or in various directions nearby.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在周围一带，或朝四周不同方向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fil-madwar jew lejn diversi direzzjonijiet fil-qrib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在周围；向四周；在附近一带。

formal.mt: Qabel ma daħlu fil-bini, il-viżitaturi ħarsu inġir biex isibu d-daħla prinċipali.
formal.en: Before entering the building, the visitors looked around to find the main entrance.
formal.zh: 进入大楼之前，访客们环顾四周，寻找正门。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu l-kelb? Ninu: Ħares inġir; kien hawn ftit ilu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the dog? Ninu: Look around; it was here a little while ago.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：狗在哪里？尼努：看看四周，它刚才还在这里。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 狗在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the dog?

messages.speaker: Ninu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħares inġir; kien hawn ftit ilu.
messages.mt_standard: Ħares inġir; kien hawn ftit ilu.
messages.zh: 看看四周，它刚才还在这里。
messages.en: Look around; it was here a little while ago.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己站在原地，目光向前后左右扫一圈；把 inġir 记成动作朝向四周的提示词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression used to tell someone that you love them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 直接向对方表达爱意的话，意思是“我爱你”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tuża biex tgħid lil persuna li tħobbha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我爱你。

formal.mt: Fl-aħħar tal-ittra, kitbet: "Inħobbok ħafna u nittama li narak dalwaqt."
formal.en: At the end of the letter, she wrote: "I love you very much and hope to see you soon."
formal.zh: 她在信的结尾写道：“我非常爱你，希望很快见到你。”

colloquial.mt: Maja: Inħobbok ħafna. Luqa: Jien ukoll inħobbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: I love you very much. Luqa: I love you too.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我非常爱你。卢卡：我也爱你。

messages.speaker: Maja (伴侣)
messages.zh: 我非常爱你。
messages.en: I love you very much.

messages.speaker: Luqa (伴侣)
messages.zh: 我也爱你。
messages.en: I love you too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inħobbok 当成完整的一句“我爱你”来记，再配对练习回答 jien ukoll inħobbok，让表达与回应一起进入记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To form an idea, image, or scene in one's mind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在脑海中形成某个想法、形象或场景。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jifforma idea, xbieha jew xena f'moħħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在心中构想；在脑海中设想。

collocations.en: he conceived an idea in his mind
collocations.zh: 他在脑海中构想了一个想法

collocations.en: he envisioned a scene in his mind
collocations.zh: 他在脑海中设想了一个场景

formal.mt: Qabel beda jikteb, l-awtur ippinzilla f'moħħu x-xena tal-ewwel kapitlu.
formal.en: Before he began writing, the author envisioned the scene of the first chapter in his mind.
formal.zh: 动笔之前，作者先在脑海中构想了第一章的场景。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif beda l-awtur jikteb din l-istorja? Mark: L-ewwel ippinzilla xena f'moħħu, imbagħad kiteb dwarha.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the author start writing this story? Mark: First he envisioned a scene in his mind, then he wrote about it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：作者最初是怎么写起这个故事的？马克：他先在脑海中构想了一个场景，然后把它写了下来。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif beda l-awtur jikteb din l-istorja?
messages.mt_standard: Kif beda l-awtur jikteb din l-istorja?
messages.zh: 作者最初是怎么写起这个故事的？
messages.en: How did the author start writing this story?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel ippinzilla xena f'moħħu, imbagħad kiteb dwarha.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel ippinzilla xena f'moħħu, imbagħad kiteb dwarha.
messages.zh: 他先在脑海中构想了一个场景，然后把它写了下来。
messages.en: First he envisioned a scene in his mind, then he wrote about it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“脑内先放一段电影，再动笔写”的画面记 ippinzilla：重点是在心中形成构想。这只是记忆场景，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Iran, a country in West Asia whose official name is the Islamic Republic of Iran.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 伊朗，西亚国家，正式名称为伊朗伊斯兰共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Asja tal-Punent li l-isem uffiċjali tiegħu huwa Repubblika Iżlamika tal-Iran.

sense_translations.en_definition: Iran (a country in West Asia; official name: Repubblika Iżlamika tal-Iran)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 伊朗，位于西亚的国家；正式名称为伊朗伊斯兰共和国。

formal.mt: L-istudenti identifikaw l-Iran fuq mappa tal-Asja tal-Punent.
formal.en: The students identified Iran on a map of West Asia.
formal.zh: 学生们在西亚地图上找出了伊朗。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-Iran fuq din il-mappa? Mark: Hawn, fl-Asja tal-Punent.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Iran on this map? Mark: Here, in West Asia.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：伊朗在这张地图的什么位置？马克：在这里，西亚。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-Iran fuq din il-mappa?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-Iran fuq din il-mappa?
messages.zh: 伊朗在这张地图的什么位置？
messages.en: Where is Iran on this map?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 在这里，西亚。
messages.en: Here, in West Asia.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Iran 与中文“伊朗”做成地图词卡，特别圈出末尾的 n；再与 Iraq 的末尾 q 对照，避免混淆两个国名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Iraq, a country in West Asia in the Middle East whose official name is the Republic of Iraq.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 伊拉克，位于西亚、中东地区的国家，正式名称为伊拉克共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Asja tal-Punent, fil-Lvant Nofsani, li l-isem uffiċjali tiegħu huwa Repubblika tal-Iraq.

sense_translations.en_definition: Iraq (a country in West Asia in the Middle East; official name: Repubblika tal-Iraq)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 伊拉克，位于西亚、中东地区的国家；正式名称为伊拉克共和国。

formal.mt: Fit-test tal-ġeografija, l-istudenti kitbu li l-isem uffiċjali tal-Iraq huwa Repubblika tal-Iraq.
formal.en: In the geography test, the students wrote that Iraq's official name is the Republic of Iraq.
formal.zh: 在地理测验中，学生们写道，伊拉克的正式名称是伊拉克共和国。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-mappa turi l-Iraq? Mark: Iva, u l-isem tiegħu jispiċċa b'q.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this map show Iraq? Mark: Yes, and its name ends in q.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张地图画的是伊拉克吗？马克：是的，它的名字以字母 q 结尾。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这张地图画的是伊拉克吗？
messages.en: Does this map show Iraq?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u l-isem tiegħu jispiċċa b'q.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u l-isem tiegħu jispiċċa b'q.
messages.zh: 是的，它的名字以字母 q 结尾。
messages.en: Yes, and its name ends in q.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 Iraq 写在“伊拉克”的词卡上，给最后的 q 加圈；和 Iran 并排练习，记住 q 对应伊拉克、n 对应伊朗。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called iridium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种化学元素的名称，中文称为铱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element kimiku li jissejjaħ iridju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铱，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tal-laboratorju jindika li l-kampjun fih l-iridju.
formal.en: The laboratory report indicates that the sample contains iridium.
formal.zh: 实验室报告表明，该样品含有铱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu l-iridju? Mark: Huwa element kimiku; illum qed nitgħallmu dwaru.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is iridium? Mark: It is a chemical element; we are learning about it today.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：铱是什么？马克：它是一种化学元素；我们今天正在学习它。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 铱是什么？
messages.en: What is iridium?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa element kimiku; illum qed nitgħallmu dwaru.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa element kimiku; illum qed nitgħallmu dwaru.
messages.zh: 它是一种化学元素；我们今天正在学习它。
messages.en: It is a chemical element; we are learning about it today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张元素名称卡片，正面写 iridju，背面写铱，把它放进化学元素这一类记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Winds: movements of air outdoors, referred to in the plural.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 风的复数形式，指自然环境中的气流。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-plural ta' riħ: arja li tiċċaqlaq fl-ambjent ta' barra.

sense_translations.en_definition: post-consonantal and alternative basic form of rjieħ
sense_translations.zh_definition: rjieħ 在辅音后使用的形式，也是其另一种基本形式，意为风，属复数形式。

formal.mt: It-tbassir tat-temp jindika irjieħ qawwija matul il-lejl.
formal.en: The weather forecast indicates strong winds during the night.
formal.zh: 天气预报显示，夜间将有强风。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għalaqt it-tieqa? Mark: Għax hemm irjieħ qawwija u qed jidħol ħafna trab.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you close the window? Mark: Because there are strong winds and a lot of dust is coming in.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么把窗户关上了？马克：因为外面风很大，有很多灰尘吹进来。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把窗户关上了？
messages.en: Why did you close the window?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hemm irjieħ qawwija u qed jidħol ħafna trab.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hemm irjieħ qawwija u qed jidħol ħafna trab.
messages.zh: 因为外面风很大，有很多灰尘吹进来。
messages.en: Because there are strong winds and a lot of dust is coming in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象窗外多股风一起吹动树枝，用 irjieħ 记住复数的风，再搭配 qawwija 表示强风。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The two knees: the joints where the legs bend.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 两个膝盖，即双腿弯曲处的关节。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iż-żewġ ġogi fejn jintwew is-saqajn.

sense_translations.en_definition: post-consonantal and alternative basic form of rkupptejn
sense_translations.zh_definition: rkupptejn 在辅音后使用的形式，也是其另一种基本形式，意为双膝或两个膝盖。

formal.mt: Matul l-eżerċizzju, l-irkupptejn għandhom jibqgħu ftit milwijin.
formal.en: During the exercise, the knees should remain slightly bent.
formal.zh: 做这个练习时，双膝应保持微微弯曲。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi uġigħ fl-irkupptejn wara l-mixja. Mark: Trid toqgħod bilqiegħda hawn għal ftit?
colloquial.en: Maja: My knees hurt after the walk. Mark: Would you like to sit here for a while?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：走完路后，我的膝盖疼。马克：你想在这里坐一会儿吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 走完路后，我的膝盖疼。
messages.en: My knees hurt after the walk.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid toqgħod bilqiegħda hawn għal ftit?
messages.mt_standard: Trid toqgħod bilqiegħda hawn għal ftit?
messages.zh: 你想在这里坐一会儿吗？
messages.en: Would you like to sit here for a while?

cognitive_memory_aid: 双手分别轻触左右膝盖，同时说 irkupptejn，用成对的身体动作记住双膝这个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ireland, a country in northwestern Europe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 爱尔兰，位于欧洲西北部的国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fil-majjistral tal-Ewropa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱尔兰，欧洲西北部的一个国家。

formal.mt: Il-programm jinkludi żjara fl-Irlanda biex l-istudenti jitgħallmu dwar il-pajjiż.
formal.en: The programme includes a visit to Ireland so that students can learn about the country.
formal.zh: 该项目包括一次爱尔兰之行，让学生了解这个国家。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sejjer għall-vaganzi? Mark: Sejjer l-Irlanda ma' oħti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you going on holiday? Mark: I am going to Ireland with my sister.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你要去哪里度假？马克：我要和姐姐去爱尔兰。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要和姐姐去爱尔兰。
messages.en: I am going to Ireland with my sister.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Irlanda、Ireland、爱尔兰写在同一张地图卡片上，三种语言共同指向这个国家。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Northern Ireland, a constituent country and province of the United Kingdom in the northeastern part of the island of Ireland.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 北爱尔兰，位于爱尔兰岛东北部，是英国的组成国及一个省区。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż kostitwenti u provinċja tar-Renju Unit fil-grigal tal-gżira tal-Irlanda.

sense_translations.en_definition: Northern Ireland (a constituent country and province of the United Kingdom, situated in the northeastern part of the island of Ireland)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 北爱尔兰，英国的组成国及一个省区，位于爱尔兰岛东北部。

formal.mt: L-iskola se tilqa' grupp ta' studenti mill-Irlanda ta' Fuq.
formal.en: The school will welcome a group of students from Northern Ireland.
formal.zh: 学校将接待一组来自北爱尔兰的学生。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se tmur il-ġimgħa d-dieħla? Mark: Se mmur l-Irlanda ta' Fuq biex inżur ħabib.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you going next week? Mark: I am going to Northern Ireland to visit a friend.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你下周要去哪里？马克：我要去北爱尔兰看望一位朋友。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你下周要去哪里？
messages.en: Where are you going next week?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmur l-Irlanda ta' Fuq biex inżur ħabib.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmur l-Irlanda ta' Fuq biex inżur ħabib.
messages.zh: 我要去北爱尔兰看望一位朋友。
messages.en: I am going to Northern Ireland to visit a friend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在地图学习卡上圈出爱尔兰岛东北部，把完整名称 Irlanda ta' Fuq 与北爱尔兰一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An ashtray: a small container for cigarette ash and cigarette ends.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 烟灰缸，用来盛放烟灰和烟头的小容器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent żgħir fejn jitqiegħdu l-irmied u l-fdalijiet tas-sigaretti.

sense_translations.en_definition: post-consonantal and alternative basic form of rmidiera
sense_translations.zh_definition: rmidiera 在辅音后使用的形式，也是其另一种基本形式，意为烟灰缸。

formal.mt: Il-persunal għandu jbattal l-irmidiera u jnaddaf il-mejda.
formal.en: The staff should empty the ashtray and clean the table.
formal.zh: 工作人员应倒空烟灰缸并清洁桌子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn inpoġġi din l-irmidiera? Mark: Poġġiha fuq il-mejda ta' barra, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where should I put this ashtray? Mark: Put it on the table outside, please.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个烟灰缸放在哪里？马克：请把它放在外面的桌子上。

messages.speaker: Maja (咖啡馆服务员)
messages.zh: 这个烟灰缸放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put this ashtray?

messages.speaker: Mark (咖啡馆店长)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġiha fuq il-mejda ta' barra, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġiha fuq il-mejda ta' barra, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请把它放在外面的桌子上。
messages.en: Put it on the table outside, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌上一个装着烟灰的小容器，在图旁写 irmidiera，再用倒空烟灰缸的动作帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Slim or slender in shape, with little thickness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形状纤细、厚度或围度较小的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandhom għamla rqiqa u ftit ħxuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纤细的；细长的。

formal.mt: Fl-istampa tidher mara b'dirgħajn irqajjaq u b'swaba' twal.
formal.en: The picture shows a woman with slim arms and long fingers.
formal.zh: 画面中是一位双臂纤细、手指修长的女子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dawn l-ingwanti tajbin għas-swaba' irqajjaq tiegħi? Mark: Naħseb li iva. Ipprovahom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are these gloves suitable for my slender fingers? Mark: I think so. Try them on.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些手套适合我纤细的手指吗？马克：我觉得适合。试戴一下吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn l-ingwanti tajbin għas-swaba' irqajjaq tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn l-ingwanti tajbin għas-swaba' irqajjaq tiegħi?
messages.zh: 这些手套适合我纤细的手指吗？
messages.en: Are these gloves suitable for my slender fingers?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.zh: 我觉得适合。试戴一下吧。
messages.en: I think so. Try them on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画出纤细的手指和双臂，在旁边写 irqajjaq，用细长的轮廓记住纤细这个形容意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Thin or fine; an alternative basic form of rqiq, also used after a consonant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示薄或细，是 rqiq 的另一基本形式，也用于辅音之后。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ftit ħxuna; forma bażika alternattiva ta' rqiq, użata wkoll wara konsonanti.

sense_translations.en_definition: post-consonantal and alternative basic form of rqiq
sense_translations.zh_definition: rqiq 在辅音之后使用的形式，也是其另一基本形式，表示薄或细。

formal.mt: Għall-inforra ntgħażel drapp irqiq biex il-ġakketta ma tkunx tqila.
formal.en: Thin fabric was chosen for the lining so that the jacket would not be heavy.
formal.zh: 里衬选用了薄布料，以免夹克过于厚重。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan id-drapp irqiq wisq għal purtiera? Rita: Iva, id-dawl jgħaddi minnu faċilment.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this fabric too thin for a curtain? Rita: Yes, light passes through it easily.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这块布做窗帘是不是太薄了？丽塔：是的，光很容易透过来。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan id-drapp irqiq wisq għal purtiera?
messages.mt_standard: Dan id-drapp irqiq wisq għal purtiera?
messages.zh: 这块布做窗帘是不是太薄了？
messages.en: Is this fabric too thin for a curtain?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: 是的，光很容易透过来。
messages.en: Yes, light passes through it easily.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 irqiq 配上透光的薄布和细细的线来记：布看厚薄，线看粗细；同时把它与 rqiq 成对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To arrange things or plans, fix something that is broken, or adjust something to make it suitable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 安排事物或计划，修好损坏的东西，或进行调整使其合适。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed affarijiet f'ordni, isewwi xi ħaġa miksura, jew jagħmel tibdil biex xi ħaġa tkun kif meħtieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安排；把事物整理妥当或组织好活动。
修理；使损坏或有问题的东西恢复正常。
调整；改变位置、设置或状态，使之合适。

collocations.en: adjust the height of the chair

formal.mt: Il-koordinatur irranġa laqgħa bejn l-għalliema u l-ġenituri biex jiddiskutu l-progress tal-istudenti.
formal.en: The coordinator arranged a meeting between the teachers and the parents to discuss the students' progress.
formal.zh: 协调员安排了教师与家长的会议，讨论学生的学习进展。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min irranġa l-vit tal-kċina? Mark: Pawlu. Issa ma jqattarx aktar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who fixed the kitchen tap? Mark: Pawlu. It no longer drips.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁修好了厨房的水龙头？马克：保罗。现在不再滴水了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 谁修好了厨房的水龙头？
messages.en: Who fixed the kitchen tap?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 保罗。现在不再滴水了。
messages.en: Pawlu. It no longer drips.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个画面记 irranġa：把会议安排好，把水龙头修好，把椅子高度调好；共同点是把事情弄妥。

gloss_zh: 未受监管的；缺乏规管的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not governed by rules or subject to regulatory control.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有受到规则约束或监管控制的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li mhuwiex soġġett għal regoli jew għal kontroll regolatorju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 未受监管的；没有受到规章制度或监管措施约束的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi settur irregolabbli u jenfasizza l-ħtieġa ta' regoli ċari għall-ħarsien tal-konsumaturi.
formal.en: The report describes an unregulated sector and stresses the need for clear rules to protect consumers.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一个未受监管的行业，并强调需要明确规则来保护消费者。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'jiġifieri suq irregolabbli? Rita: Suq li mhuwiex soġġett għal regoli jew kontroll regolatorju.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does an unregulated market mean? Rita: A market that is not subject to rules or regulatory control.
colloquial.zh: 马克：未受监管的市场是什么意思？丽塔：就是没有受到规则或监管控制的市场。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 未受监管的市场是什么意思？
messages.en: What does an unregulated market mean?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Suq li mhuwiex soġġett għal regoli jew kontroll regolatorju.
messages.mt_standard: Suq li mhuwiex soġġett għal regoli jew kontroll regolatorju.
messages.zh: 就是没有受到规则或监管控制的市场。
messages.en: A market that is not subject to rules or regulatory control.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本词条给定词义，把 irregolabbli 与一张写着“缺乏监管”的市场示意图相连，重点记住规则约束缺席。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A departure from a regular pattern, expected condition, or established rule.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 偏离正常规律、预期状态或既定规则的现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Devjazzjoni minn mudell regolari, minn dak li hu mistenni, jew minn regola stabbilita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不规则或异常现象；也可指不符合既定规则的情况。

formal.mt: L-awditur sab irregolarità fil-kontijiet u talab dokumenti addizzjonali biex jiċċara d-differenza.
formal.en: The auditor found an irregularity in the accounts and requested additional documents to clarify the discrepancy.
formal.zh: 审计员发现账目中有一处异常，要求提供补充文件以查明差异。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Sibt irregolarità fil-lista tal-ħlasijiet. Mark: Ejja niċċekkjawha flimkien; forsi ddaħħal l-istess ħlas darbtejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: I found an irregularity in the payment list. Mark: Let's check it together; perhaps the same payment was entered twice.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我发现付款清单有一处异常。马克：我们一起核对一下，也许同一笔付款录入了两次。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 我发现付款清单有一处异常。
messages.en: I found an irregularity in the payment list.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja niċċekkjawha flimkien; forsi ddaħħal l-istess ħlas darbtejn.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja niċċekkjawha flimkien; forsi ddaħħal l-istess ħlas darbtejn.
messages.zh: 我们一起核对一下，也许同一笔付款录入了两次。
messages.en: Let's check it together; perhaps the same payment was entered twice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象整齐的一列账目中突然多出一笔重复付款：这个偏离正常排列或规则的地方，就是 irregolarità。

gloss_zh: 不信奉宗教的；不敬宗教的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not religious, or showing a lack of respect for religion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不信奉宗教的，或表现出对宗教缺乏敬意的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jħaddanx reliġjon, jew li juri nuqqas ta' rispett lejn ir-reliġjon.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不信奉宗教的；也可形容对宗教缺乏敬意的态度或行为。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-karattru prinċipali huwa bniedem irreliġjuż li jibqa' jirrispetta t-twemmin ta' ħaddieħor.
formal.en: In the novel, the main character is an irreligious person who nevertheless respects other people's beliefs.
formal.zh: 小说中的主人公不信奉宗教，但仍然尊重他人的信仰。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-karattru f'dan il-ktieb hu irreliġjuż? Mark: Iva, ma jħaddan l-ebda reliġjon, iżda jirrispetta lil min jemmen.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the character in this book irreligious? Mark: Yes, he follows no religion, but he respects believers.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这本书里的人物不信奉宗教吗？马克：对，他不信奉任何宗教，但尊重有信仰的人。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 这本书里的人物不信奉宗教吗？
messages.en: Is the character in this book irreligious?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ma jħaddan l-ebda reliġjon, iżda jirrispetta lil min jemmen.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ma jħaddan l-ebda reliġjon, iżda jirrispetta lil min jemmen.
messages.zh: 对，他不信奉任何宗教，但尊重有信仰的人。
messages.en: Yes, he follows no religion, but he respects believers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两个搭配画面：形容人时想到“不信教”，形容态度时想到“不敬宗教”；根据语境选择中文表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To yield a return or result, or to render something in a particular form or language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产生收益或结果，或用某种形式或语言表达、转述内容。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti qligħ jew riżultat, jew jesprimi xi ħaġa f'forma jew b'lingwa partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 产生；带来收益、产出或结果。
表达；以某种形式呈现，或用另一种语言译出。

formal.mt: It-traduttur irrenda t-test bil-Malti b'mod ċar u żamm it-ton formali tal-oriġinal.
formal.en: The translator rendered the text clearly in Maltese and preserved the formal tone of the original.
formal.zh: 译者用清晰的马耳他语译出了文本，并保留了原文的正式语气。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak l-investiment irrenda xi qligħ? Mark: Iva, iżda inqas milli stennejt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did that investment yield any profit? Mark: Yes, but less than I expected.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那笔投资产生利润了吗？马克：有，但比我预期的少。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那笔投资产生利润了吗？
messages.en: Did that investment yield any profit?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，但比我预期的少。
messages.en: Yes, but less than I expected.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 irrenda 配两张学习卡：投资“带来收益”，译者“译出文字”；用搭配区分产出结果与语言表达两种用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unable to be revised or changed through revision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不能再进行修订或通过修订加以更改的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jistax jiġi rivedut jew emendat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不可修订的；无法再对其内容进行修改的。

formal.mt: Għall-finijiet ta' dan l-eżerċizzju, it-test approvat jitqies irrevidibbli u ma jistgħux isiru emendi fih.
formal.en: For the purposes of this exercise, the approved text is considered irrevisable and no amendments may be made to it.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，已批准的文本视为不可修订，不得对其作出修改。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan id-dokument hu mmarkat bħala irrevidibbli? Rita: Għax f'dan l-eżerċizzju ma nistgħux nibdlu t-test.
