colloquial.en: Maja: Why is this document marked as irrevisable? Rita: Because in this exercise we cannot change the text.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么这份文件标着“不可修订”？丽塔：因为在这个练习中，我们不能修改文本。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan id-dokument hu mmarkat bħala irrevidibbli?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan id-dokument hu mmarkat bħala irrevidibbli?
messages.zh: 为什么这份文件标着“不可修订”？
messages.en: Why is this document marked as irrevisable?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax f'dan l-eżerċizzju ma nistgħux nibdlu t-test.
messages.mt_standard: Għax f'dan l-eżerċizzju ma nistgħux nibdlu t-test.
messages.zh: 因为在这个练习中，我们不能修改文本。
messages.en: Because in this exercise we cannot change the text.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象文件旁有一支被划掉的修改笔：可以阅读，却不能修订；用这个画面把 irrevidibbli 与“不可修订”连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not connected with, or not pertinent to, the matter being considered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与正在讨论或考虑的事情没有关联，或不切合主题的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma għandux x'jaqsam mas-suġġett jew mal-kwistjoni li qed tiġi kkunsidrata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无关的；与当前主题、问题或判断没有关联的。

formal.mt: Il-kulur tal-qoxra huwa dettall irrilevanti għall-analiżi tal-argumenti ppreżentati fir-rapport.
formal.en: The colour of the cover is an irrelevant detail for the analysis of the arguments presented in the report.
formal.zh: 对于分析报告中的论点而言，封面的颜色是一个无关的细节。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi nsemmi l-kulur tal-bieb fir-risposta? Mark: Le, dak id-dettall irrilevanti; il-mistoqsija hi dwar il-prezz.
colloquial.en: Maja: Should I mention the colour of the door in the answer? Mark: No, that detail is irrelevant; the question is about the price.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我应该在回答中提到门的颜色吗？马克：不用，那个细节不相关；问题问的是价格。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 我应该在回答中提到门的颜色吗？
messages.en: Should I mention the colour of the door in the answer?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dak id-dettall irrilevanti; il-mistoqsija hi dwar il-prezz.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dak id-dettall irrilevanti; il-mistoqsija hi dwar il-prezz.
messages.zh: 不用，那个细节不相关；问题问的是价格。
messages.en: No, that detail is irrelevant; the question is about the price.

cognitive_memory_aid: 题目问价格，回答却谈颜色：把这种答非所问的画面与 irrilevanti 相连，记住“与当前问题无关”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of having no relevant connection to the subject or question being considered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与正在讨论的主题或问题没有相关联系的性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-nuqqas ta' rabta rilevanti mas-suġġett jew mal-kwistjoni li tkun qed tiġi diskussa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无关性；与所讨论事项不相干。

formal.mt: L-irrilevanza ta' dawn id-dettalji għas-suġġett tagħmilha diffiċli li jiġi ġġustifikat l-użu tagħhom fir-rapport.
formal.en: The irrelevance of these details to the subject makes it difficult to justify their inclusion in the report.
formal.zh: 这些细节与主题无关，因此很难说明将其纳入报告的理由。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ħallejt dak il-kumment barra? Mark: Minħabba l-irrilevanza tiegħu; konna qed nitkellmu dwar ħaġa oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you leave that comment out? Mark: Because of its irrelevance; we were talking about something else.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么删去了那条评论？马克：因为它不相干；我们当时谈的是另一件事。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么删去了那条评论？
messages.en: Why did you leave that comment out?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba l-irrilevanza tiegħu; konna qed nitkellmu dwar ħaġa oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba l-irrilevanza tiegħu; konna qed nitkellmu dwar ħaġa oħra.
messages.zh: 因为它不相干；我们当时谈的是另一件事。
messages.en: Because of its irrelevance; we were talking about something else.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象讨论旅行时突然有人谈修水管，把这种“与主题无关的性质”贴上 irrilevanza 标签。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unaffected by a specified condition or difference; used with minn to express 'regardless of'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不因某项条件或差异而改变的；与 minn 搭配表达“不论、不管”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jiddependix minn kundizzjoni jew differenza partikolari; ma' minn jesprimi li dik il-kundizzjoni ma tbiddilx ir-riżultat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不受某因素影响的；不论某条件如何的。

formal.mt: Is-servizz huwa disponibbli għal kulħadd, irrispettiv mill-età jew mill-post ta' residenza.
formal.en: The service is available to everyone, irrespective of age or place of residence.
formal.zh: 这项服务向所有人开放，不论年龄或居住地点。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Se nibqgħu ħbieb anki jekk ma nirbaħx? Ben: Dażgur, irrispettiv mir-riżultat!
colloquial.en: Lara: Will we still be friends even if I don't win? Ben: Of course, irrespective of the result!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：即使我没赢，我们也还是朋友吗？本：当然，不论结果如何！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nibqgħu ħbieb anki jekk ma nirbaħx?
messages.mt_standard: Se nibqgħu ħbieb anki jekk ma nirbaħx?
messages.zh: 即使我没赢，我们也还是朋友吗？
messages.en: Will we still be friends even if I don't win?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 当然，不论结果如何！
messages.en: Of course, irrespective of the result!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 irrispettiv minn 连成一个记忆块：条件可以变化，决定照样成立，就是“不论……”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move or make something move by rolling, to roll something up, or to pass a roller over a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使物体滚动或将其卷起，也可指用滚筒在表面上滚过、滚压。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċaqlaq jew iqiegħed xi ħaġa f'romblu, jew jgħaddi romblu fuq wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 滚动；使滚动；卷起。

sense_translations.en_definition: to pass over with a roller
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用滚筒在表面上滚过或滚压。

collocations.en: rolled the road surface with a roller

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem irrombla l-wiċċ tat-triq biex ikun aktar lixx.
formal.en: The worker passed a roller over the road surface to make it smoother.
formal.zh: 工人用滚筒碾压了路面，使其更加平整。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar it-tapit? Mark: Paul irrombla t-tapit u poġġieh ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did the carpet go? Mark: Paul rolled it up and put it next to the door.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：地毯去哪儿了？马克：保罗把地毯卷起来，放在门旁边了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 地毯去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did the carpet go?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Paul irrombla t-tapit u poġġieh ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Paul irrombla t-tapit u poġġieh ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 保罗把地毯卷起来，放在门旁边了。
messages.en: Paul rolled up the carpet and put it next to the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用同一个圆筒画面记两个义项：地毯卷成圆筒，滚筒压过路面，都可联系 irrombla。

gloss_zh: rtal 的辅音后形式及另一基本形式

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form of rtal used after a consonant, and also an alternative basic form of that noun.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 名词 rtal 在辅音后使用的形式，同时也是该名词的另一基本形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma tan-nom rtal li tintuża wara konsonanti, u wkoll bħala forma bażika alternattiva.

sense_translations.en_definition: post-consonantal and alternative basic form of rtal
sense_translations.zh_definition: rtal 的辅音后形式，同时也是其另一基本形式。

collocations.zh: 辅音后的 irtal 形式

formal.mt: In-nota tispjega li irtal tintuża wara konsonanti u hija wkoll forma bażika alternattiva ta' rtal.
formal.en: The note explains that irtal is used after a consonant and is also an alternative basic form of rtal.
formal.zh: 这条注释说明，irtal 用于辅音后，同时也是 rtal 的另一基本形式。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex hawn miktub irtal u mhux rtal? Rita: Irtal hija forma li tintuża wara konsonanti, u hija wkoll forma bażika alternattiva.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why does it say irtal here instead of rtal? Rita: Irtal is a form used after a consonant, and it is also an alternative basic form.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这里为什么写 irtal，而不是 rtal？丽塔：irtal 是辅音后使用的形式，同时也是另一基本形式。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hawn miktub irtal u mhux rtal?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hawn miktub irtal u mhux rtal?
messages.zh: 这里为什么写 irtal，而不是 rtal？
messages.en: Why does it say irtal here instead of rtal?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Irtal hija forma li tintuża wara konsonanti, u hija wkoll forma bażika alternattiva.
messages.mt_standard: Irtal hija forma li tintuża wara konsonanti, u hija wkoll forma bażika alternattiva.
messages.zh: irtal 是辅音后使用的形式，同时也是另一基本形式。
messages.en: Irtal is a form used after a consonant, and it is also an alternative basic form.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rtal 和 irtal 并排抄写，圈出开头的 i，记住后者兼有辅音后形式与另一基本形式两种说明。

gloss_zh: rwieħ 的辅音后形式及另一基本形式

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form of rwieħ used after a consonant, and also an alternative basic form of that noun.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 名词 rwieħ 在辅音后使用的形式，同时也是该名词的另一基本形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma tan-nom rwieħ li tintuża wara konsonanti, u wkoll bħala forma bażika alternattiva.

sense_translations.en_definition: post-consonantal and alternative basic form of rwieħ
sense_translations.zh_definition: rwieħ 的辅音后形式，同时也是其另一基本形式。

collocations.zh: 辅音后的 irwieħ 形式

formal.mt: Il-lista tinkludi irwieħ bħala forma ta' rwieħ li tintuża wara konsonanti u bħala forma bażika alternattiva.
formal.en: The list includes irwieħ as a form of rwieħ used after a consonant and as an alternative basic form.
formal.zh: 这份词表将 irwieħ 列为 rwieħ 的辅音后形式及另一基本形式。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Sibt irwieħ fil-lista. Hija marbuta ma' rwieħ? Ben: Iva, hija l-forma ta' wara konsonanti u wkoll forma bażika alternattiva.
colloquial.en: Lara: I found irwieħ in the list. Is it related to rwieħ? Ben: Yes, it is the post-consonantal form and also an alternative basic form.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我在词表里看到了 irwieħ。它与 rwieħ 有关系吗？本：有，它是辅音后形式，同时也是另一基本形式。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibt irwieħ fil-lista. Hija marbuta ma' rwieħ?
messages.mt_standard: Sibt irwieħ fil-lista. Hija marbuta ma' rwieħ?
messages.zh: 我在词表里看到了 irwieħ。它与 rwieħ 有关系吗？
messages.en: I found irwieħ in the list. Is it related to rwieħ?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hija l-forma ta' wara konsonanti u wkoll forma bażika alternattiva.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hija l-forma ta' wara konsonanti u wkoll forma bażika alternattiva.
messages.zh: 有，它是辅音后形式，同时也是另一基本形式。
messages.en: Yes, it is the post-consonantal form and also an alternative basic form.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做一张 rwieħ／irwieħ 对照卡，突出开头的 i，并在 irwieħ 下写“辅音后；另一基本形式”。

gloss_zh: 女王们；王后们（rġejjen 的另一形式）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Queens; an alternative form of rġejjen, including the form used after a consonant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 女王或王后的复数形式；是 rġejjen 的另一形式，也用于前接辅音的环境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma alternattiva ta' rġejjen, il-plural ta' reġina, li tintuża wkoll wara konsonanti.

sense_translations.en_definition: post-consonantal and alternative basic form of rġejjen
sense_translations.zh_definition: rġejjen（女王们；王后们）在辅音之后使用的形式，也是其另一基本形式。

formal.mt: Il-ktieb jippreżenta bijografiji ta' diversi slaten u jiddiskuti wkoll irġejjen tal-istess perjodu.
formal.en: The book presents biographies of various kings and also discusses queens of the same period.
formal.zh: 这本书介绍了多位国王的生平，也讨论了同一时期的女王。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed taqra? Mark: Ktieb dwar irġejjen. Fih stejjer dwar ħajjithom.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you reading? Mark: A book about queens. It has stories about their lives.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在读什么？马克：一本关于女王的书，里面讲了她们的生平故事。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在读什么？
messages.en: What are you reading?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ktieb dwar irġejjen. Fih stejjer dwar ħajjithom.
messages.mt_standard: Ktieb dwar irġejjen. Fih stejjer dwar ħajjithom.
messages.zh: 一本关于女王的书，里面讲了她们的生平故事。
messages.en: A book about queens. It has stories about their lives.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象历史书里一排戴王冠的女性，把 irġejjen 记成复数“女王们／王后们”；同时把它与 rġejjen 放在同一张词卡上。

gloss_zh: 男人们；成年男性（rġiel 的另一形式）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Men; an alternative form of rġiel, including the form used after a consonant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 男人、成年男性的复数形式；是 rġiel 的另一形式，也用于前接辅音的环境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma alternattiva ta' rġiel, il-plural ta' raġel, li tintuża wkoll wara konsonanti.

sense_translations.en_definition: post-consonantal and alternative basic form of rġiel
sense_translations.zh_definition: rġiel（男人们；成年男性）在辅音之后使用的形式，也是其另一基本形式。

formal.mt: L-istħarriġ jinkludi irġiel u nisa minn gruppi differenti ta' età.
formal.en: The survey includes men and women from different age groups.
formal.zh: 这项调查涵盖了不同年龄组的男性和女性。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn huma l-ħwejjeġ għall-irġiel? Mark: Fl-ewwel sular, ħdejn iż-żraben.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are the clothes for men? Mark: On the first floor, next to the shoes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：男装在哪里？马克：在楼上一层，鞋区旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 男装在哪里？
messages.en: Where are the clothes for men?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.zh: 在楼上一层，鞋区旁边。
messages.en: On the first floor, next to the shoes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用商店里的“男装”标牌记 għall-irġiel，再把 irġiel 与 rġiel 并列抄写；两种形式都指复数的男人，不要误记成一个人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Low in price, or costing less than something else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 价格低的，或与其他东西相比花费更少的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu prezz baxx jew jiswa inqas minn xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.en_definition: post-consonantal and alternative basic form of rħas
sense_translations.zh_definition: rħas 在辅音后使用的形式，也是其另一种基本形式，表示便宜或价格较低。

formal.mt: L-istudenti jistgħu jixtru dawn il-kotba bi prezz irħas.
formal.en: Students can buy these books at a lower price.
formal.zh: 学生可以用更低的价格购买这些书。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-biljett irħas mill-ieħor? Mark: Iva, jiswa ħames ewro inqas.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this ticket cheaper than the other one? Mark: Yes, it costs five euros less.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张票比另一张便宜吗？马克：是的，便宜五欧元。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这张票比另一张便宜吗？
messages.en: Is this ticket cheaper than the other one?

messages.speaker: Mark (售票员)
messages.zh: 是的，便宜五欧元。
messages.en: Yes, it costs five euros less.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象并排的两张价签，指着数字较小的一张说 irħas，把它与少花钱联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A greeting used to wish someone a happy New Year.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 新年时向他人表达祝福的用语，相当于“新年快乐”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tislima biex tawgura lil xi ħadd sena ġdida tajba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 新年快乐；用于新年祝福。

collocations.en: I wish you a happy New Year

formal.mt: F'isem l-iskola, nawguraw is-Sena t-Tajba lill-istudenti kollha u lill-familji tagħhom.
formal.en: On behalf of the school, we wish all students and their families a happy New Year.
formal.zh: 我们代表学校，祝全体学生及其家人新年快乐。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Is-Sena t-Tajba, Mark! Mark: Grazzi, Anna! Is-Sena t-Tajba lilek ukoll!
colloquial.en: Anna: Happy New Year, Mark! Mark: Thank you, Anna! Happy New Year to you too!
colloquial.zh: 安娜：马克，新年快乐！马克：谢谢你，安娜！也祝你新年快乐！

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克，新年快乐！
messages.en: Happy New Year, Mark!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi, Anna! Is-Sena t-Tajba lilek ukoll!
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi, Anna! Is-Sena t-Tajba lilek ukoll!
messages.zh: 谢谢你，安娜！也祝你新年快乐！
messages.en: Thank you, Anna! Happy New Year to you too!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把跨年互道祝福的场景和整句 Is-Sena t-Tajba 绑定，再接 lilek ukoll 练习“也祝你”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A greeting wishing peace upon those addressed, used especially by priests during Catholic Mass.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向在场的人祝愿平安的问候语，尤其用于天主教弥撒中神父向会众致意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tislima li tawgura l-paċi lil dawk preżenti, użata l-aktar mis-saċerdot waqt il-quddiesa Kattolika.

sense_translations.en_definition: peace be upon you (mostly used during Catholic masses by priests to greet)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 愿你们平安；主要用于天主教弥撒中，由神父向会众问候。

formal.mt: Waqt il-quddiesa, is-saċerdot isellem lill-ġemgħa bil-kliem 'Is-sliem għalikom'.
formal.en: During Mass, the priest greets the congregation with the words 'Peace be upon you'.
formal.zh: 弥撒中，神父用“愿你们平安”向会众致意。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qal is-saċerdot lill-ġemgħa? Pawlu: Qal 'Is-sliem għalikom'; hija tislima ta' paċi.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did the priest say to the congregation? Pawlu: He said 'Peace be upon you'; it is a greeting of peace.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：神父对会众说了什么？保罗：他说“愿你们平安”，这是一句祝愿平安的问候语。

messages.speaker: Lara (参礼者)
messages.zh: 神父对会众说了什么？
messages.en: What did the priest say to the congregation?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qal 'Is-sliem għalikom'; hija tislima ta' paċi.
messages.mt_standard: Qal 'Is-sliem għalikom'; hija tislima ta' paċi.
messages.zh: 他说“愿你们平安”，这是一句祝愿平安的问候语。
messages.en: He said 'Peace be upon you'; it is a greeting of peace.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象神父面向会众祝福，把整句 is-sliem għalikom 记成“愿你们平安”，同时记住面向多人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a town in Malta near San Ġiljan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他的一座城镇的名称，位于圣朱利安附近。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' lokalità f'Malta qrib San Ġiljan.

sense_translations.en_definition: town in Malta near San Ġiljan
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他圣朱利安附近的城镇斯维伊。

formal.mt: Is-Swieqi hija lokalità f'Malta qrib San Ġiljan.
formal.en: Swieqi is a locality in Malta near San Ġiljan.
formal.zh: 斯维伊是马耳他的一个城镇，位于圣朱利安附近。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn toqgħod? Anna: Noqgħod fis-Swieqi, qrib San Ġiljan.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where do you live? Anna: I live in Swieqi, near San Ġiljan.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你住在哪里？安娜：我住在斯维伊，靠近圣朱利安。

messages.speaker: Mark (新同学)
messages.zh: 你住在哪里？
messages.en: Where do you live?

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 我住在斯维伊，靠近圣朱利安。
messages.en: I live in Swieqi, near San Ġiljan.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在学习地图上把 Is-Swieqi 放在 San Ġiljan 附近，再用 Noqgħod fis-Swieqi 练习介绍住处。

gloss_zh: 令人陶醉的；使人着迷的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a quality that tends to enchant, captivate, or hold someone's attention completely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有容易使人陶醉、着迷或深深吸引注意力的特质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu kwalità li tiġbed ħafna l-attenzjoni u tħalli lil dak li jkun affaxxinat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易使人陶醉或着迷的；引人入胜的。

formal.mt: Il-kantant għandu leħen isaħħar li jiġbed l-attenzjoni tas-semmiegħa mill-ewwel nota.
formal.en: The singer has an enchanting voice that captures the listeners' attention from the first note.
formal.zh: 这位歌手的嗓音令人陶醉，从第一个音符起便吸引了听众的注意。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kien il-kantant ilbieraħ? Mark: Għandu leħen isaħħar; ridt nibqa' nisimgħu!
colloquial.en: Maja: How was the singer yesterday? Mark: He has an enchanting voice; I wanted to keep listening!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：昨天那位歌手唱得怎么样？马克：他的嗓音令人陶醉，我真想一直听下去！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天那位歌手唱得怎么样？
messages.en: How was the singer yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu leħen isaħħar; ridt nibqa' nisimgħu!
messages.mt_standard: Għandu leħen isaħħar; ridt nibqa' nisimgħu!
messages.zh: 他的嗓音令人陶醉，我真想一直听下去！
messages.en: He has an enchanting voice; I wanted to keep listening!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一段歌声让你忘记看时间，用 isaħħar 给这种“被吸引得入迷”的感受贴标签。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having greater density or a more closely packed structure than something else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与另一事物相比密度更高、结构更紧密的，表达“更稠密”的比较意义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu densità akbar jew struttura aktar magħquda minn ta' xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 更稠密的；密度更高的；更密实的。

formal.mt: Għal din il-purtiera ntgħażel drapp isfaq sabiex jgħaddi inqas dawl minnu.
formal.en: A denser fabric was chosen for this curtain so that less light would pass through it.
formal.zh: 这幅窗帘选用了更密实的布料，以减少透光。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema drapp nagħżlu għall-purtieri? Ben: Dan isfaq mill-ieħor, u jgħaddi inqas dawl minnu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which fabric shall we choose for the curtains? Ben: This one is denser than the other, and less light passes through it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们选哪种布料做窗帘？本：这种比另一种更密实，透过的光也更少。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 我们选哪种布料做窗帘？
messages.en: Which fabric shall we choose for the curtains?

messages.speaker: Ben (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan isfaq mill-ieħor, u jgħaddi inqas dawl minnu.
messages.mt_standard: Dan isfaq mill-ieħor, u jgħaddi inqas dawl minnu.
messages.zh: 这种比另一种更密实，透过的光也更少。
messages.en: This one is denser than the other, and less light passes through it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两块布迎光比较，透光更少、织得更密的那块就是 isfaq，记住其中含有“更”的比较义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of a vivid yellow colour, expressed by the comparison 'yellow as guinea'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容颜色鲜明、明亮的黄色，用作具体的颜色描述。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta' lewn isfar qawwi u jgħajjat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鲜黄色的；亮黄色的。

formal.mt: Għall-pannell intgħażel kulur isfar lellux biex jidher b'mod ċar fuq l-isfond skur.
formal.en: A vivid yellow colour was chosen for the panel so that it would stand out clearly against the dark background.
formal.zh: 这块面板选用了鲜黄色，使其在深色背景上清晰醒目。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Liema drapp trid għall-kuxxin? Rita: Dak isfar lellux; il-kulur tiegħu jferraħ il-kamra!
colloquial.en: Nina: Which fabric do you want for the cushion? Rita: That vivid yellow one; its colour brightens up the room!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你想用哪种布料做靠垫？丽塔：那种鲜黄色的；它的颜色能让房间活泼起来！

messages.speaker: Nina (店员)
messages.zh: 你想用哪种布料做靠垫？
messages.en: Which fabric do you want for the cushion?

messages.speaker: Rita (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak isfar lellux; il-kulur tiegħu jferraħ il-kamra!
messages.mt_standard: Dak isfar lellux; il-kulur tiegħu jferraħ il-kamra!
messages.zh: 那种鲜黄色的；它的颜色能让房间活泼起来！
messages.en: That vivid yellow one; its colour brightens up the room!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 isfar lellux 整体写在一张醒目的鲜黄色色卡上，用颜色记住整个短语，避免只记住其中一个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a person, community, or institution adopt Islam or Islamic practices.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使个人、群体或机构接受伊斯兰教，或采用伊斯兰教的习俗与规范。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iwassal lil persuna, komunità jew istituzzjoni biex tħaddan l-Iżlam jew tadotta prattiki Iżlamiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使伊斯兰化；使接受伊斯兰教或采用伊斯兰教规范。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-ħakkiem jipprova jislamizza l-istituzzjonijiet tar-renju.
formal.en: In the novel, the ruler tries to Islamize the kingdom's institutions.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，统治者试图使王国的各机构伊斯兰化。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'jipprova jagħmel il-ħakkiem f'dan ir-rumanz? Mark: Jipprova jislamizza l-istituzzjonijiet tar-renju.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does the ruler try to do in this novel? Mark: He tries to Islamize the kingdom's institutions.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这部小说里的统治者试图做什么？马克：他试图使王国的各机构伊斯兰化。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这部小说里的统治者试图做什么？
messages.en: What does the ruler try to do in this novel?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 他试图使王国的各机构伊斯兰化。
messages.en: He tries to Islamize the kingdom's institutions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“使某个群体或机构伊斯兰化”的动作画面记 islamizza；学习时把施动者、动作和对象连成一句。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of applying soap to something, usually as part of washing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 清洗时给某物涂上肥皂或打肥皂的动作、过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li jitqiegħed jew jingħorok is-sapun fuq xi ħaġa waqt il-ħasil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涂肥皂、打肥皂的动作或过程。

formal.mt: Wara l-issapnar tal-idejn, laħlaħhom sew bl-ilma biex tneħħi s-sapun kollu.
formal.en: After soaping your hands, rinse them thoroughly with water to remove all the soap.
formal.zh: 双手打过肥皂后，要用水充分冲洗，洗净所有肥皂。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Lestejt taħsel il-flokk? Nina: Għadni fl-issapnar; issa se nlaħalħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you finished washing the shirt? Nina: I am still at the soaping stage; I am going to rinse it now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你洗完那件上衣了吗？妮娜：我还在打肥皂，现在就准备冲洗。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你洗完那件上衣了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished washing the shirt?

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 我还在打肥皂，现在就准备冲洗。
messages.en: I am still at the soaping stage; I am going to rinse it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按洗衣顺序想象“弄湿、打肥皂、冲洗”，把中间打肥皂的整个过程记作名词 issapnar。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be temporarily stitched, to be repaired by darning, or to be delayed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指布料被临时疏缝、衣物被织补，也可指事情被延迟或耽搁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinħiet b'punti temporanji, jissewwa bit-traqqigħ, jew jittardja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被用临时针脚疏缝或固定。
被织补；破洞或磨损处被用线补好。
被延迟；被耽搁。

formal.mt: Id-drapp issarsar biex il-biċċiet jibqgħu f'posthom qabel il-ħjata finali.
formal.en: The fabric was tacked to keep the pieces in place before the final stitching.
formal.zh: 布料先被疏缝，以便各块布在正式缝合前保持位置。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex għadna hawn? Pawlu: It-tluq issarsar minħabba x-xita; nitilqu aktar tard.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why are we still here? Pawlu: The departure was delayed because of the rain; we will leave later.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：我们怎么还在这里？保罗：下雨把出发耽搁了，我们晚些再走。

messages.speaker: Marija (旅伴)
messages.zh: 我们怎么还在这里？
messages.en: Why are we still here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tluq issarsar minħabba x-xita; nitilqu aktar tard.
messages.mt_standard: It-tluq issarsar minħabba x-xita; nitilqu aktar tard.
messages.zh: 下雨把出发耽搁了，我们晚些再走。
messages.en: The departure was delayed because of the rain; we will leave later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 issarsar 配三张学习卡：布料被疏缝、袜子被织补、出发被耽搁；靠搭配区分三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who establishes an institution, or a person who teaches or instructs others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 创办某个机构的人；也可指负责教学或指导他人的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li twaqqaf istituzzjoni, jew persuna li tgħallem jew tagħti struzzjoni lil oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 创立者；创办机构或组织的人。
指导者；教师；负责教授知识或技能的人。

formal.mt: Il-ktieb jiddeskrivi lill-istitutur tal-iskola u jispjega għaliex waqqafha.
formal.en: The book describes the school's founder and explains why he established it.
formal.zh: 这本书介绍了学校的创办者，并解释了他创办学校的原因。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min se jgħallimna l-mużika? Mark: Pawlu, l-istitutur il-ġdid tagħna; l-ewwel lezzjoni hi għada.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who will teach us music? Mark: Pawlu, our new instructor; the first lesson is tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁来教我们音乐？马克：保罗，我们的新老师；第一节课在明天。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 谁来教我们音乐？
messages.en: Who will teach us music?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu, l-istitutur il-ġdid tagħna; l-ewwel lezzjoni hi għada.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu, l-istitutur il-ġdid tagħna; l-ewwel lezzjoni hi għada.
messages.zh: 保罗，我们的新老师；第一节课在明天。
messages.en: Pawlu, our new instructor; the first lesson is tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 istitutur 画两张人物卡：一人创办学校，一人站在课堂教学；分别记住“创立者”和“指导教师”。

gloss_zh: 机构的；与机构运作有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to an institution, its organization, or its activities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与某个机构、其组织方式或其活动有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' istituzzjoni, mal-organizzazzjoni tagħha jew mal-ħidma tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 机构的；与机构及其运作有关的

formal.mt: Il-proġett jeħtieġ appoġġ istituzzjonali biex ikompli joffri servizzi lill-komunità.
formal.en: The project needs institutional support to continue providing services to the community.
formal.zh: 该项目需要机构支持，才能继续为社区提供服务。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandkom appoġġ istituzzjonali għall-proġett? Mark: Iva, l-università qed tgħinna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have institutional support for the project? Mark: Yes, the university is helping us.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你们的项目有机构支持吗？Mark：有，大学正在帮助我们。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们的项目有机构支持吗？
messages.en: Do you have institutional support for the project?

messages.speaker: Mark (项目成员)
messages.zh: 有，大学正在帮助我们。
messages.en: Yes, the university is helping us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个形容词贴在“机构支持”和“机构改革”两张卡片上，记住它描述的是与机构有关的性质。

gloss_zh: 使制度化；使成为机构的固定做法

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a practice an established part of an institution's rules or regular activities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某种做法成为机构规则或日常活动中正式、固定的一部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel prattika parti stabbilita mir-regoli jew mill-ħidma regolari ta' istituzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使制度化；使某种做法正式成为机构的固定安排

formal.mt: Il-kunsill istituzzjonalizza l-konsultazzjoni mar-residenti billi daħħal laqgħat regolari fir-regolamenti tiegħu.
formal.en: The council institutionalized consultation with residents by incorporating regular meetings into its regulations.
formal.zh: 议会将定期会议写入其规章，使与居民协商的做法制度化。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dawn il-laqgħat issa se jsiru kull xahar? Pawlu: Iva, il-kunsill istituzzjonalizza din il-prattika.
colloquial.en: Sara: Will these meetings now take place every month? Pawlu: Yes, the council has institutionalized this practice.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这些会议现在每个月都会举行吗？Pawlu：会，议会已经把这种做法制度化了。

messages.speaker: Sara (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn il-laqgħat issa se jsiru kull xahar?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn il-laqgħat issa se jsiru kull xahar?
messages.zh: 这些会议现在每个月都会举行吗？
messages.en: Will these meetings now take place every month?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (议会工作人员)
messages.zh: 会，议会已经把这种做法制度化了。
messages.en: Yes, the council has institutionalized this practice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一次临时会议写进规章、变成每月固定会议：用这个动作记住“使制度化”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To formally establish an organization, system, rule, or practice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正式设立组织，或建立某项制度、规则或做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jistabbilixxi formalment organizzazzjoni, sistema, regola jew prattika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 设立；创立；正式建立或实行

formal.mt: Il-kunsill istitwixxa kumitat biex jeżamina l-proposti tar-residenti.
formal.en: The council established a committee to examine residents' proposals.
formal.zh: 议会设立了一个委员会，负责审议居民的建议。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min istitwixxa dan il-kumitat? David: Il-kunsill, biex ir-residenti jkunu jistgħu jressqu l-ideat tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who established this committee? David: The council, so that residents could put forward their ideas.
colloquial.zh: Lara：谁设立了这个委员会？David：议会，为了让居民能够提出自己的想法。

messages.speaker: Lara (居民)
messages.zh: 谁设立了这个委员会？
messages.en: Who established this committee?

messages.speaker: David (社区工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kunsill, biex ir-residenti jkunu jistgħu jressqu l-ideat tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kunsill, biex ir-residenti jkunu jistgħu jressqu l-ideat tagħhom.
messages.zh: 议会，为了让居民能够提出自己的想法。
messages.en: The council, so that residents could put forward their ideas.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“正式设立一个委员会”的画面记忆：宣布成立的那一刻，对应这个动词的核心意思。

gloss_zh: 漆黑的；黑得像煤炭一样的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Extremely black; as black as coal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容颜色非常黑，黑得像煤炭一样。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iswed ħafna; espressjoni li tenfasizza kemm xi ħaġa tkun sewda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黑得像煤炭一样；漆黑的

collocations.en: a wall as black as coal
a face as black as coal
collocations.zh: 一张黑得像煤炭一样的脸

formal.mt: Wara n-nar, il-ħajt tal-kċina kien iswed borma minħabba n-nugrufun.
formal.en: After the fire, the kitchen wall was as black as coal because of the soot.
formal.zh: 火灾过后，厨房的墙壁因烟灰而变得漆黑。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex wiċċek iswed borma? Ben: Kont qed innaddaf iċ-ċumnija!
colloquial.en: Anna: Why is your face as black as coal? Ben: I was cleaning the chimney!
colloquial.zh: Anna：你的脸怎么黑得像煤炭一样？Ben：我刚才在清理烟囱！

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的脸怎么黑得像煤炭一样？
messages.en: Why is your face as black as coal?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 我刚才在清理烟囱！
messages.en: I was cleaning the chimney!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语当作“漆黑”的夸张标签，联想清理烟囱后沾满烟灰的脸，整块记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Stronger or more robust than another person or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 比另一个人或事物更有力量、更坚固或更有力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu aktar saħħa minn persuna jew ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 比较级：更强的；更有力的；更结实的。

formal.mt: Għal din il-kamra hemm bżonn mejda b'qafas isħaħ minn dak tal-mejda l-qadima.
formal.en: This room needs a table with a stronger frame than that of the old table.
formal.zh: 这个房间需要一张框架比旧桌子更结实的桌子。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan is-siġġu jidher dgħajjef. Pawlu: Ħu dak ħdejn it-tieqa; huwa isħaħ.
colloquial.en: Marija: This chair looks weak. Pawlu: Take the one by the window; it is sturdier.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这把椅子看着不结实。保罗：拿窗边那把吧，那把更结实。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 这把椅子看着不结实。
messages.en: This chair looks weak.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu dak ħdejn it-tieqa; huwa isħaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu dak ħdejn it-tieqa; huwa isħaħ.
messages.zh: 拿窗边那把吧，那把更结实。
messages.en: Take the one by the window; it is sturdier.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两把椅子并排比较，把更结实的那把标成 isħaħ，记住它自带“更”的比较含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The one occupying position three in an ordered sequence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示在有顺序的一组事物中排在第三位的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġi wara t-tieni u qabel ir-raba' f'ordni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 第三的；按顺序排在第三位的

formal.mt: It-tielet kapitlu tar-rapport jispjega r-riżultati tal-istudju.
formal.en: The third chapter of the report explains the results of the study.
formal.zh: 报告的第三章阐述了这项研究的结果。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema ktieb trid? Toni: It-tielet wieħed mix-xellug, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which book do you want? Toni: The third one from the left, please.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你想要哪本书？Toni：请给我从左边数第三本。

messages.speaker: Lara (图书管理员)
messages.zh: 你想要哪本书？
messages.en: Which book do you want?

messages.speaker: Toni (读者)
messages.zh: 请给我从左边数第三本。
messages.en: The third one from the left, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画出一排书并圈住第三本，指着它读 it-tielet；把“第三位”的顺序感与词形一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Italy, a country in Southern Europe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 意大利，位于欧洲南部的国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fin-Nofsinhar tal-Ewropa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 意大利，欧洲南部的一个国家

collocations.zh: 一次前往意大利的旅行

formal.mt: L-iskola organizzat vjaġġ lejn l-Italja bħala parti mill-programm edukattiv tagħha.
formal.en: The school organized a trip to Italy as part of its educational programme.
formal.zh: 学校组织了一次意大利之行，作为其教育计划的一部分。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se tqatta' l-btala? Mark: Fl-Italja, ma' ħabib tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where will you spend your holiday? Mark: In Italy, with a friend of mine.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你打算去哪里度假？Mark：去意大利，和我的一个朋友一起。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你打算去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where will you spend your holiday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 去意大利，和我的一个朋友一起。
messages.en: In Italy, with a friend of mine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Italja 与地图上的“意大利”配对，再连读“去意大利旅行”和“在意大利度假”两个短语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called ytterbium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 名为“镱”的化学元素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element kimiku li jissejjaħ itterbju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 镱，一种化学元素

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-kampjun tal-itterbju u r-riżultati tal-analiżi tiegħu.
formal.en: The report describes the ytterbium sample and the results of its analysis.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这份镱样品及其分析结果。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif ngħid 'ytterbium' bil-Malti? Paul: Itterbju. Ikteb l-isem ħdejn it-traduzzjoni.
colloquial.en: Nina: How do I say 'ytterbium' in Maltese? Paul: Itterbju. Write the name next to the translation.
colloquial.zh: Nina：ytterbium 用马耳他语怎么说？Paul：Itterbju。把这个名称写在译名旁边。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: ytterbium 用马耳他语怎么说？
messages.en: How do I say 'ytterbium' in Maltese?

messages.speaker: Paul (老师)
messages.zh: Itterbju。把这个名称写在译名旁边。
messages.en: Itterbju. Write the name next to the translation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作“itterbju—ytterbium—镱”三语卡片，特别圈出字母组合 erb，帮助与 ittriju 区分；这只是拼写记忆提示。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called yttrium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 名为“钇”的化学元素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element kimiku li jissejjaħ ittriju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钇，一种化学元素

formal.mt: Il-folja tal-laboratorju tinkludi deskrizzjoni tal-kampjun tal-ittriju u n-numru ta' referenza tiegħu.
formal.en: The laboratory sheet includes a description of the yttrium sample and its reference number.
formal.zh: 实验室记录表包含这份钇样品的描述及其参考编号。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fuq din it-tikketta hemm miktub 'ittriju'. Dan ifisser 'yttrium'? Mark: Iva, huwa l-isem Malti tal-element.
colloquial.en: Sara: This label says 'ittriju'. Does that mean 'yttrium'? Mark: Yes, it is the Maltese name of the element.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这个标签上写着 ittriju。它是指 yttrium 吗？Mark：对，这是该元素的马耳他语名称。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq din it-tikketta hemm miktub 'ittriju'. Dan ifisser 'yttrium'?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq din it-tikketta hemm miktub 'ittriju'. Dan ifisser 'yttrium'?
messages.zh: 这个标签上写着 ittriju。它是指 yttrium 吗？
messages.en: This label says 'ittriju'. Does that mean 'yttrium'?

messages.speaker: Mark (实验课老师)
messages.zh: 对，这是该元素的马耳他语名称。
messages.en: Yes, it is the Maltese name of the element.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“ittriju—yttrium—钇”写成一行，圈出 tr，再与 itterbju 的 erb 对照；用拼写差别避免混淆两个元素名。

gloss_zh: 承诺；答应（jwiegħed 的另一基本形式）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An alternative basic form of jwiegħed, used after a consonant, meaning to promise or give one's word.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示承诺或答应，是 jwiegħed 的另一基本形式，用于辅音之后。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma bażika alternattiva ta' jwiegħed, użata wara konsonanti, li tfisser li wieħed jagħti kelmtu li se jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: post-consonantal and alternative basic form of jwiegħed
sense_translations.zh_definition: jwiegħed 的辅音后形式及另一基本形式，表示承诺、答应。

formal.mt: Mark iwiegħed li jibgħat ir-rapport qabel il-laqgħa.
formal.en: Mark promises to send the report before the meeting.
formal.zh: 马克承诺在会议前发送报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark iwiegħed li jgħinna għada. Rita: Tajjeb, allura nistennewh fid-disgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark promises to help us tomorrow. Rita: Good, then we'll expect him at nine.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克答应明天帮我们。丽塔：好，那我们就等他九点来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克答应明天帮我们。
messages.en: Mark promises to help us tomorrow.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，那我们就等他九点来。
messages.en: Good, then we'll expect him at nine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“马克答应帮忙”的场景与 Mark iwiegħed li jgħin 一起记；iwiegħed 和 jwiegħed 都联系“承诺”，同时留意所给的辅音后形式说明。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An exclamation used to ask for silence or to scare an animal away.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感叹词，用来要求安静，或用来吓走、驱赶动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintuża biex titlob is-skiet jew biex tkeċċi annimal.

sense_translations.en_definition: Used to ask for silence: hush!
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于要求安静：嘘！

sense_translations.en_definition: Used to scare away animals: shoo!
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于吓走或驱赶动物：去！走开！

formal.mt: Meta l-qattus resaq lejn l-ikel, it-tifel qal: 'Ixx!' biex ikeċċih.
formal.en: When the cat approached the food, the boy said 'Shoo!' to drive it away.
formal.zh: 猫靠近食物时，男孩喊了一声“去！”，想把它赶走。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ixx! It-tarbija rieqda. Mark: Sewwa, nitkellem bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Rita: Hush! The baby is asleep. Mark: All right, I'll speak quietly.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：嘘！宝宝睡着了。马克：好，我小声说话。

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 嘘！宝宝睡着了。
messages.en: Hush! The baby is asleep.

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.zh: 好，我小声说话。
messages.en: All right, I'll speak quietly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个动作记住 ixx：手指放唇边是“嘘”，挥手赶小动物是“去”；结合对象判断具体意思。

gloss_zh: 被疏缝；被用临时针脚固定

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be held temporarily with loose stitches, as a garment or piece of fabric before final sewing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指衣物或布料被用疏松的临时针脚固定，以便之后正式缝合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal ilbies jew drapp li jinżamm temporanjament b'punti laxki qabel il-ħjata finali.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be tacked (used of garments and fabric)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被疏缝、被用临时针脚固定，用于衣物和布料。

formal.mt: Id-drapp ixxellel b'punti laxki qabel il-ħjata finali.
formal.en: The fabric was tacked with loose stitches before the final sewing.
formal.zh: 布料在正式缝合前，先用疏松的针脚临时固定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kmiem ixxellel diġà? Rita: Iva, issa tista' tipprova l-ġakketta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the sleeve been tacked yet? Rita: Yes, you can try on the jacket now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：袖子已经疏缝好了吗？丽塔：是的，现在可以试穿外套了。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 袖子已经疏缝好了吗？
messages.en: Has the sleeve been tacked yet?

messages.speaker: Rita (裁缝)
messages.zh: 是的，现在可以试穿外套了。
messages.en: Yes, you can try on the jacket now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象裁缝先用几针松线固定袖子，再让顾客试穿；把 ixxellel 记成布料“被临时疏缝”的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something clear through explanation, or to become clear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过解释使事情清楚明白，或指事情本身变得清楚、得到澄清。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa ċara billi jispjegaha, jew isir ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 澄清；使含糊或不明确的事情变得清楚。
得到澄清；原先不清楚的事情变得明确。
解释；说明意思、原因或做法，使人理解。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, id-direttur iċċara r-raġunijiet għad-deċiżjoni.
formal.en: In his report, the director clarified the reasons for the decision.
formal.zh: 主任在报告中解释清楚了作出这一决定的原因。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tiċċara dan il-punt? Mark: Iva. Trid tibgħat il-formola sal-Ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you clarify this point? Mark: Yes. You need to send the form by Friday.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能把这一点解释清楚吗？马克：可以。你需要最迟在星期五提交表格。

messages.speaker: Maja (申请人)
messages.zh: 你能把这一点解释清楚吗？
messages.en: Can you clarify this point?

messages.speaker: Mark (办事员)
messages.zh: 可以。你需要最迟在星期五提交表格。
messages.en: Yes. You need to send the form by Friday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象模糊的说明经过解释变清晰：有人澄清、事情得到澄清、向人解释，都围绕“清楚”来记。

gloss_zh: 以卫生的方式；合乎卫生地

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a clean and hygienic manner that helps prevent contamination.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以清洁、合乎卫生的方式进行，有助于避免污染。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod nadif u iġjeniku li jgħin biex jiġi evitat it-tniġġis.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 合乎卫生地；以卫生的方式

collocations.zh: 以卫生的方式准备食物
以卫生的方式储存食物

formal.mt: L-ikel għandu jitħejja iġjenikament, bl-użu ta' għodod nodfa u fuq uċuħ nodfa.
formal.en: Food should be prepared hygienically, using clean utensils and clean surfaces.
formal.zh: 准备食物时应讲究卫生，使用洁净的用具和操作台面。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif nista' nipprepara dawn is-sandwiches iġjenikament? David: Aħsel idejk u uża sikkina u bord nodfa.
colloquial.en: Marta: How can I prepare these sandwiches hygienically? David: Wash your hands and use a clean knife and board.
colloquial.zh: Marta：怎样才能卫生地做好这些三明治？David：洗净双手，再用干净的刀和砧板。

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nista' nipprepara dawn is-sandwiches iġjenikament?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nista' nipprepara dawn is-sandwiches iġjenikament?
messages.zh: 怎样才能卫生地做好这些三明治？
messages.en: How can I prepare these sandwiches hygienically?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħsel idejk u uża sikkina u bord nodfa.
messages.mt_standard: Aħsel idejk u uża sikkina u bord nodfa.
messages.zh: 洗净双手，再用干净的刀和砧板。
messages.en: Wash your hands and use a clean knife and board.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 iġjenikament，就在动作旁补上“卫生地”：卫生地准备、卫生地存放，记住它说明做事方式。

gloss_zh: 卫生的；合乎卫生要求的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Clean and suitable for maintaining hygiene and preventing contamination.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 清洁且符合卫生要求的，有助于保持卫生、避免污染。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nadif u adattat biex tinżamm l-iġjene u jiġi evitat it-tniġġis.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卫生的；合乎卫生要求的

formal.mt: Il-kċina għandha tipprovdi ambjent iġjeniku għall-preparazzjoni u l-ħażna tal-ikel.
formal.en: The kitchen should provide a hygienic environment for preparing and storing food.
formal.zh: 厨房应为食物的准备和储存提供卫生的环境。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan il-post jidher iġjeniku? Ben: Iva, il-bankijiet huma nodfa u l-ikel kollu mgħotti.
colloquial.en: Anna: Does this place look hygienic? Ben: Yes, the counters are clean and all the food is covered.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这地方看起来卫生吗？Ben：卫生，柜台很干净，食物也都盖好了。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 这地方看起来卫生吗？
messages.en: Does this place look hygienic?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-bankijiet huma nodfa u l-ikel kollu mgħotti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-bankijiet huma nodfa u l-ikel kollu mgħotti.
messages.zh: 卫生，柜台很干净，食物也都盖好了。
messages.en: Yes, the counters are clean and all the food is covered.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 iġjeniku 想成贴在干净厨房门上的“卫生合格”标签，记住它描述环境或物品的性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A trained professional who helps maintain hygiene, for example by providing dental hygiene care.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接受过专业训练、协助维护卫生的人员，例如提供牙齿卫生护理的专业人员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna mħarrġa li tgħin biex tinżamm l-iġjene, pereżempju billi tipprovdi kura tal-iġjene tas-snien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卫生师；卫生专业人员

formal.mt: L-iġjenista dentali spjegat lill-pazjent kif għandu jnaddaf snienu u jieħu ħsieb il-ħanek.
formal.en: The dental hygienist explained to the patient how to clean his teeth and care for his gums.
formal.zh: 牙齿卫生师向患者讲解了如何清洁牙齿和护理牙龈。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandek appuntament mad-dentist illum? Karl: Le, mal-iġjenista, biex innaddaf snieni.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you have a dentist appointment today? Karl: No, it's with the hygienist, to have my teeth cleaned.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你今天约了牙医吗？Karl：不是，约的是牙齿卫生师，去洁牙。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天约了牙医吗？
messages.en: Do you have a dentist appointment today?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.zh: 不是，约的是牙齿卫生师，去洁牙。
messages.en: No, it's with the hygienist, to have my teeth cleaned.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象预约表上写着 iġjenista，旁边画着洁牙工具；把这个词与“提供卫生护理的人”相连。

gloss_zh: 使清洁卫生；进行卫生处理

teaching_sense.en_definition: To clean or treat something so that it becomes hygienic.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过清洁或适当处理，使某物达到卫生要求。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Naddaf jew ittratta xi ħaġa biex issir iġjenika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使合乎卫生要求；对某物进行清洁卫生处理

collocations.zh: 对物体表面进行卫生处理

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem iġjenizza l-mejda tax-xogħol qabel ma beda jipprepara l-ikel.
formal.en: The worker made the worktable hygienic before starting to prepare the food.
formal.zh: 工作人员在开始准备食物前，对操作台进行了清洁卫生处理。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' nuża din il-mejda issa? Toni: Iva, il-kollega tiegħi għadu kemm iġjenizza l-wiċċ kollu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can I use this table now? Toni: Yes, my colleague has just made the whole surface hygienic.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我现在可以用这张桌子了吗？Toni：可以，我同事刚把整个桌面清洁处理好了。

messages.speaker: Lara (厨房工作人员)
messages.zh: 我现在可以用这张桌子了吗？
messages.en: Can I use this table now?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-kollega tiegħi għadu kemm iġjenizza l-wiċċ kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-kollega tiegħi għadu kemm iġjenizza l-wiċċ kollu.
messages.zh: 可以，我同事刚把整个桌面清洁处理好了。
messages.en: Yes, my colleague has just made the whole surface hygienic.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“清洁前→卫生处理→可以使用”的连续画面记 iġjenizza，重点记住它表示让东西变卫生的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For certain animals, to bring swallowed food back into the mouth and chew it again.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某些动物将已经吞下的食物返回口中，再次咀嚼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal ċerti annimali meta jtellgħu lura f'ħalqhom ikel li jkunu belgħu u jerġgħu jomogħduh.

sense_translations.en_definition: to ruminate (used of certain species of animals)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 反刍，指某些动物将吞下的食物返回口中再次咀嚼

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, il-gendus iġtar għal xi ħin wara li kiel il-ħaxix.
formal.en: During the observation, the bull ruminated for a while after eating grass.
formal.zh: 观察期间，这头公牛吃草后反刍了一段时间。

colloquial.mt: Mia: Għaliex għadu jomgħod il-gendus? Ġanni: Għadu kemm iġtar; reġa' tomgħod l-ikel li kien bela'.
colloquial.en: Mia: Why is the bull still chewing? Ġanni: It has just been ruminating; it chewed again the food it had swallowed.
colloquial.zh: Mia：这头公牛怎么还在嚼？Ġanni：它刚才在反刍，把已经吞下的食物又嚼了一遍。

messages.speaker: Mia (参观者)
messages.zh: 这头公牛怎么还在嚼？
messages.en: Why is the bull still chewing?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (农场主)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu kemm iġtar; reġa' tomgħod l-ikel li kien bela'.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu kemm iġtar; reġa' tomgħod l-ikel li kien bela'.
messages.zh: 它刚才在反刍，把已经吞下的食物又嚼了一遍。
messages.en: It has just been ruminating; it chewed again the food it had swallowed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象牛吃完草后又慢慢咀嚼，把 iġtar 与“吞下后再嚼”的反刍画面配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a village in Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他一座村庄的专名，写作 Iż-Żebbiegħ。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem ta' raħal f'Malta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他的一座村庄，名为 Iż-Żebbiegħ。

collocations.zh: 到 Iż-Żebbiegħ 村的一次游览

formal.mt: Iż-Żebbiegħ huwa raħal f'Malta; it-test jiddeskrivi żjara f'dan ir-raħal.
formal.en: Iż-Żebbiegħ is a village in Malta; the text describes a visit to this village.
formal.zh: Iż-Żebbiegħ 是马耳他的一座村庄；这篇文章描述了到该村游览的经历。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se niltaqgħu għada? Mark: Fiż-Żebbiegħ, ħdejn id-dar ta' Rita.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we meet tomorrow? Mark: In Iż-Żebbiegħ, near Rita's house.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们明天在哪里碰面？马克：在 Iż-Żebbiegħ 村，丽塔家附近。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们明天在哪里碰面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 在 Iż-Żebbiegħ 村，丽塔家附近。
messages.en: In Iż-Żebbiegħ, near Rita's house.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做一张写有“Iż-Żebbiegħ—马耳他村庄”的地点卡，特别圈出词尾 ie għ 的连续字母，避免与戈佐岛的 Iż-Żebbuġ 混记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a village in Gozo.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 戈佐岛一座村庄的专名，写作 Iż-Żebbuġ。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem ta' raħal f'Għawdex.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 戈佐岛的一座村庄，名为 Iż-Żebbuġ。

collocations.zh: 到 Iż-Żebbuġ 村的一次游览

formal.mt: Iż-Żebbuġ huwa raħal f'Għawdex; it-test jiddeskrivi żjara f'dan ir-raħal.
formal.en: Iż-Żebbuġ is a village in Gozo; the text describes a visit to this village.
formal.zh: Iż-Żebbuġ 是戈佐岛的一座村庄；这篇文章描述了到该村游览的经历。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn tgħix Rita? Mark: Fiż-Żebbuġ, f'Għawdex. Se nżuruha għada.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where does Rita live? Mark: In Iż-Żebbuġ, in Gozo. We're going to visit her tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：丽塔住在哪里？马克：在戈佐岛的 Iż-Żebbuġ 村。我们明天去看她。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 丽塔住在哪里？
messages.en: Where does Rita live?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 在戈佐岛的 Iż-Żebbuġ 村。我们明天去看她。
messages.en: In Iż-Żebbuġ, in Gozo. We're going to visit her tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Iż-Żebbuġ 与“戈佐岛”写在同一张地点卡上，圈出词尾 uġ；与 Iż-Żebbiegħ 对照拼写，分别记牢各自所在的岛。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A proverb meaning that the truth will eventually become known, expressed through the image of oil rising to the surface of water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以油总会浮到水面上的形象，比喻真相最终会显露出来的谚语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qawl li jfisser li l-verità fl-aħħar toħroġ, bħaż-żejt li jitla' f'wiċċ l-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 真相终究会显露；事实最终总会浮出水面。

collocations.mt: kif jgħid il-qawl, iż-żejt dejjem jitla' f'wiċċ l-ilma
collocations.en: as the proverb says, the truth will always surface
collocations.zh: 正如谚语所说，真相终会浮出水面

collocations.mt: ftakar li ż-żejt dejjem jitla' f'wiċċ l-ilma
collocations.en: remember that the truth will always surface
collocations.zh: 记住，真相终会浮出水面

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, l-awtur ifakkar lill-qarrejja fil-qawl: iż-żejt dejjem jitla' f'wiċċ l-ilma.
formal.en: In his report, the author reminds readers of the proverb: the truth will always surface.
formal.zh: 作者在报告中提醒读者这句谚语：真相终会浮出水面。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taħseb li xi darba nsiru nafu x'ġara? Mark: Iva, iż-żejt dejjem jitla' f'wiċċ l-ilma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you think we'll ever find out what happened? Mark: Yes, the truth will always surface.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你觉得我们终有一天会知道发生了什么吗？Mark：会的，真相终会浮出水面。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li xi darba nsiru nafu x'ġara?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li xi darba nsiru nafu x'ġara?
messages.zh: 你觉得我们终有一天会知道发生了什么吗？
messages.en: Do you think we'll ever find out what happened?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iż-żejt dejjem jitla' f'wiċċ l-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iż-żejt dejjem jitla' f'wiċċ l-ilma.
messages.zh: 会的，真相终会浮出水面。
messages.en: Yes, the truth will always surface.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整句记成一幅画：油浮到水面，隐藏的真相也终于显露；用画面串起谚语含义。

gloss_zh: 泽伊屯（马耳他南部城镇名）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The proper name of a town in the south of Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他南部一座城镇的专名，中文可音译为泽伊屯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem proprju ta' belt fin-Nofsinhar ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: name of a town in the south of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他南部城镇的名称：泽伊屯。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir fiż-Żejtun, belt fin-Nofsinhar ta' Malta.
formal.en: The meeting will take place in Żejtun, a town in the south of Malta.
formal.zh: 会议将在马耳他南部的城镇泽伊屯举行。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn se niltaqgħu għada? Paul: Fiż-Żejtun, quddiem il-knisja.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where shall we meet tomorrow? Paul: In Żejtun, in front of the church.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我们明天在哪里见面？Paul：在泽伊屯，教堂前面。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们明天在哪里见面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Paul (朋友)
messages.zh: 在泽伊屯，教堂前面。
messages.en: In Żejtun, in front of the church.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Iż-Żejtun 当作地图上的整块地名来记，并配一句 fiż-Żejtun，练习说“在泽伊屯”。

gloss_zh: 祖里克（马耳他南部村庄名）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The proper name of a village in the south of Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他南部一个村庄的专名，中文可音译为祖里克。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem proprju ta' raħal fin-Nofsinhar ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: a village in the south of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他南部的一个村庄：祖里克。

formal.mt: Il-grupp se jżur iż-Żurrieq, raħal fin-Nofsinhar ta' Malta.
formal.en: The group will visit Żurrieq, a village in the south of Malta.
formal.zh: 这个团体将参观马耳他南部的村庄祖里克。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn toqgħod? David: Fiż-Żurrieq. Trid tiġi żżurna nhar il-Ħadd?
colloquial.en: Sara: Where do you live? David: In Żurrieq. Would you like to visit us on Sunday?
colloquial.zh: Sara：你住在哪里？David：在祖里克。你星期天想来我们家做客吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你住在哪里？
messages.en: Where do you live?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fiż-Żurrieq. Trid tiġi żżurna nhar il-Ħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Fiż-Żurrieq. Trid tiġi żżurna nhar il-Ħadd?
messages.zh: 在祖里克。你星期天想来我们家做客吗？
messages.en: In Żurrieq. Would you like to visit us on Sunday?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用问答卡片记地名：正面写“你住哪里”，背面写 fiż-Żurrieq，并标注马耳他南部村庄。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The personal name Isaac.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人名“以撒”，对应英语 Isaac。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' persuna li bl-Ingliż jinkiteb Isaac.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以撒，英语人名 Isaac 的对应形式。

formal.mt: Iżakk ippreżenta x-xogħol tiegħu lill-klassi.
formal.en: Isaac presented his work to the class.
formal.zh: 以撒向全班展示了自己的作品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ġej magħna llum? Mark: Iżakk ġej magħna; niltaqgħu miegħu ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is coming with us today? Mark: Isaac is coming with us; we'll meet him by the door.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天谁和我们一起去？马克：以撒和我们一起去；我们在门边和他碰面。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天谁和我们一起去？
messages.en: Who is coming with us today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iżakk ġej magħna; niltaqgħu miegħu ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Iżakk ġej magħna; niltaqgħu miegħu ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 以撒和我们一起去；我们在门边和他碰面。
messages.en: Isaac is coming with us; we'll meet him by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给想象中的同学做一张三语名牌：Iżakk—Isaac—以撒；用“他叫以撒”反复练习，并记住人名首字母大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: More; to a greater degree or in a greater amount.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示程度更高或数量更多，相当于“更、更加、更多”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li juri grad ogħla jew kwantità akbar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 更、更加；更多。

formal.mt: Dan l-eżempju jispjega l-idea iżjed ċar.
formal.en: This example explains the idea more clearly.
formal.zh: 这个例子把这一概念解释得更清楚。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' titkellem iżjed bil-mod? Mark: Żgur, nerġa' ngħidha bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you speak more slowly? Mark: Of course, I'll say it again slowly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能说得再慢一点吗？马克：当然，我慢慢再说一遍。

messages.speaker: Maja (语言学习者)
messages.zh: 你能说得再慢一点吗？
messages.en: Can you speak more slowly?

messages.speaker: Mark (语伴)
messages.zh: 当然，我慢慢再说一遍。
messages.en: Of course, I'll say it again slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 iżjed 想成程度调节器上的“再加一点”：加在“快”前是更快，加在“重要”前是更重要。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to Iceland, its people, or its language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与冰岛、冰岛人或冰岛语有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Iżlanda, man-nies tagħha jew mal-lingwa tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冰岛的；冰岛人的；冰岛语的。
冰岛人。
冰岛语。

collocations.en: an Icelander who lives in Malta
collocations.zh: 一位住在马耳他的冰岛人

formal.mt: L-istudent għażel film Iżlandiż għall-preżentazzjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: The student chose an Icelandic film for his presentation.
formal.zh: 这名学生为自己的展示选了一部冰岛电影。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan film Iżlandiż? Mark: Iva, u qed nitgħallem l-Iżlandiż biex nifhmu aħjar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this an Icelandic film? Mark: Yes, and I'm learning Icelandic so I can understand it better.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是一部冰岛电影吗？马克：是的，而且我正在学冰岛语，好更好地看懂它。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是一部冰岛电影吗？
messages.en: Is this an Icelandic film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u qed nitgħallem l-Iżlandiż biex nifhmu aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u qed nitgħallem l-Iżlandiż biex nifhmu aħjar.
messages.zh: 是的，而且我正在学冰岛语，好更好地看懂它。
messages.en: Yes, and I'm learning Icelandic so I can understand it better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“冰岛电影、冰岛朋友、学习冰岛语”三张场景卡记同一词形：修饰电影时是形容词，指人或语言时是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: More than is needed, wanted, or appropriate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数量或程度超过需要、期望或合适限度的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Aktar milli hemm bżonn jew milli hu xieraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 太多的；数量或程度超过合适限度的。
超出所需的；多余的。

formal.mt: Biex nevitaw il-ħela, m'għandniex nippreparaw ikel iżżejjed għall-laqgħa.
formal.en: To avoid waste, we should not prepare too much food for the meeting.
formal.zh: 为了避免浪费，我们不应为会议准备过多食物。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandna ikel iżżejjed għall-ikla? Ben: Iva, ejja nistiednu lil Sara wkoll.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do we have too much food for the meal? Ben: Yes, let's invite Sara too.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这顿饭的食物是不是准备太多了？Ben：是啊，我们也邀请 Sara 来吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这顿饭的食物是不是准备太多了？
messages.en: Do we have too much food for the meal?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nistiednu lil Sara wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nistiednu lil Sara wkoll.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们也邀请 Sara 来吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's invite Sara too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象盘子装满后还继续加菜：超过需要的那一份，就是 iżżejjed。

gloss_zh: 啊；呀（呼唤或称呼对方的助词）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A particle placed before a name or form of address when calling or directly addressing someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 放在人名或称呼前，用来呼唤某人或直接向对方说话的助词，可按语境译为“啊、呀”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Partikella li titqiegħed qabel isem jew kelma ta' indirizz biex issejjaħ jew tkellem lil xi ħadd direttament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呼格助词，用于呼唤或称呼对方；啊！喂！你呀！

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu kiteb: 'Grazzi, ja ħabib, tal-għajnuna tiegħek.'
formal.en: In his letter he wrote: 'Thank you, my friend, for your help.'
formal.zh: 他在信中写道：“朋友啊，谢谢你的帮助。”

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ja tfal, lesti biex nitilqu? Leo: Iva, kollox lest!
colloquial.en: Rita: Children, are you ready to leave? Leo: Yes, everything is ready!
colloquial.zh: Rita：孩子们，准备好出发了吗？Leo：好了，都准备好了！

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 孩子们，准备好出发了吗？
messages.en: Children, are you ready to leave?

messages.speaker: Leo (儿子)
messages.zh: 好了，都准备好了！
messages.en: Yes, everything is ready!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象开口叫人之前先发出一声“呀”：ja 放在称呼前，把听者的注意力叫过来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To know a fact or have the skill to do something; jaf is used with a third-person masculine singular subject.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示知道事实，或掌握做某事的技能；jaf 用于第三人称阳性单数主语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu tagħrif dwar xi ħaġa jew il-ħila li jagħmel xi ħaġa; jaf tintuża ma' suġġett fit-tielet persuna maskili singular.

sense_translations.en_definition: to know; to be able to do sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 知道；懂得；具备做某事的技能，会做某事。

formal.mt: L-applikant jaf juża l-kompjuter u jaf ir-regoli tas-sigurtà.
formal.en: The applicant knows how to use a computer and knows the safety rules.
formal.zh: 这名申请人会使用电脑，也了解安全规则。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Ħuk jaf isuq? Toni: Iva, u jaf ukoll kif jasal sa hemm.
colloquial.en: Emma: Does your brother know how to drive? Toni: Yes, and he also knows how to get there.
colloquial.zh: Emma：你兄弟会开车吗？Toni：会，而且他也知道怎么去那里。

messages.speaker: Emma (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟会开车吗？
messages.en: Does your brother know how to drive?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u jaf ukoll kif jasal sa hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u jaf ukoll kif jasal sa hemm.
messages.zh: 会，而且他也知道怎么去那里。
messages.en: Yes, and he also knows how to get there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 jaf 配两张图：脑中有答案是“知道”，双手会操作是“会做”；同一个词连接知识与技能。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A particle followed by an imperfect verb to express a wish, hope, or request, often translated as 'may' or 'I hope'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 后接未完成式动词，用于表达愿望、期盼或请求的助词，常译为“但愿、愿、希望”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Partikella li tiġi qabel verb fl-imperfett biex tesprimi xewqa, tama jew talba.

sense_translations.en_definition: Followed by an imperfect verb, it expresses the optative, i.e. a wish or request.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 后接未完成式动词，表达祈愿意义，即愿望或请求。

collocations.en: may you have a lovely day

formal.mt: Jalla din il-kollaborazzjoni ġġib riżultati tajbin għal kulħadd.
formal.en: May this collaboration bring good results for everyone.
formal.zh: 愿这次合作为所有人带来良好的成果。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandi eżami għada. Paul: Jalla tmur tajjeb! Studjajt ħafna.
colloquial.en: Nina: I have an exam tomorrow. Paul: I hope you do well! You've studied a lot.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我明天有考试。Paul：祝你考得顺利！你已经学了很多了。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 我明天有考试。
messages.en: I have an exam tomorrow.

messages.speaker: Paul (同学)
messages.zh: 祝你考得顺利！你已经学了很多了。
messages.en: I hope you do well! You've studied a lot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jalla 想成愿望句的开门词：先说“但愿”，再接希望发生的动作，如 jalla tmur tajjeb。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To need something or use it for a particular purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 需要某物，或为了某个特定目的使用某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu bżonn xi ħaġa jew jużaha għal skop partikolari.

sense_translations.en_definition: to need, to use for some purpose
sense_translations.zh_definition: 需要；为某种目的使用。

collocations.en: to need a lot of time

formal.mt: Dan ix-xogħol jambi ħafna ħin u għodda speċjali, għalhekk għandu jiġi ppjanat minn qabel.
formal.en: This work needs a lot of time and special tools, so it should be planned in advance.
formal.zh: 这项工作需要很多时间和专用工具，因此应当提前规划。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan ix-xogħol jambi ħafna ħin? Rita: Iva, aħjar nibdew kmieni.
colloquial.en: Mark: Does this work need a lot of time? Rita: Yes, we'd better start early.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这项工作需要很多时间吗？丽塔：是的，我们最好早点开始。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 这项工作需要很多时间吗？
messages.en: Does this work need a lot of time?

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 是的，我们最好早点开始。
messages.en: Yes, we'd better start early.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jambi 放进“工作需要时间”的情景记忆，再联想到“为某种用途使用”，将需要与用途两个意思一起记住。

gloss_zh: 奴役人的；使人受奴役的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Enslaving people or placing them under a form of control that deprives them of freedom.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人受到奴役，或通过控制剥夺人的自由的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jpoġġi lil xi ħadd f'jasar jew iċaħħdu mil-libertà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奴役人的；使人陷入受奴役状态的。

formal.mt: L-awtur jikkundanna kull kontroll jassari li jċaħħad lill-bniedem mil-libertà u mid-dinjità.
formal.en: The author condemns every form of enslaving control that deprives a person of freedom and dignity.
formal.zh: 作者谴责一切剥夺人的自由与尊严、使人受到奴役的控制。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex issejjaħlu xogħol jassari? Pawlu: Għax il-ħaddiema ma jistgħux jitilqu u ħadd ma jisma' x'għandhom xi jgħidu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do you call it enslaving work? Pawlu: Because the workers cannot leave and nobody listens to what they have to say.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么把它叫作奴役人的劳动？保罗：因为工人不能离开，也没有人听取他们的意见。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把它叫作奴役人的劳动？
messages.en: Why do you call it enslaving work?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-ħaddiema ma jistgħux jitilqu u ħadd ma jisma' x'għandhom xi jgħidu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-ħaddiema ma jistgħux jitilqu u ħadd ma jisma' x'għandhom xi jgħidu.
messages.zh: 因为工人不能离开，也没有人听取他们的意见。
messages.en: Because the workers cannot leave and nobody listens to what they have to say.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人被控制、无法自由离开的画面，把 jassari 记成描述“使人受奴役”的性质词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An angry curse expressing rejection or frustration, similar to 'to hell with it' or 'damn it'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达愤怒、厌烦或强烈拒斥的咒骂语，意思近于“见鬼去吧”或“该死”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni ta' saħta li turi rabja, dwejjaq jew ċaħda qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 让……见鬼去吧；该死；用于愤怒地咒骂或表示不想再理会。

formal.mt: Fid-djalogu tar-rakkont, il-karattru jgħid 'jaħraqdin' biex jesprimi r-rabja tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story's dialogue, the character says 'damn it' to express his anger.
formal.zh: 在故事的对话中，角色用一句“该死”表达自己的愤怒。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Jaħraqdin! Il-kompjuter reġa' waqaf jaħdem. Lara: Ikkalma, nippruvaw nerġgħu nixegħluh.
colloquial.en: Mark: Damn it! The computer has stopped working again. Lara: Calm down, let's try turning it on again.
colloquial.zh: Mark：该死！电脑又不工作了。Lara：冷静点，我们试着重新开机。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 该死！电脑又不工作了。
messages.en: Damn it! The computer has stopped working again.

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 冷静点，我们试着重新开机。
messages.en: Calm down, let's try turning it on again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jaħraqdin 记在“愤怒感叹”卡片上，配电脑突然故障的画面，整句对应“该死”，不要自行拆词猜义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression meaning 'God willing', used when speaking hopefully about a future action or event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 意为“若上帝愿意”，用于带着希望谈论将来的行动或事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li turi t-tama li xi ħaġa sseħħ fil-futur, jekk tkun ir-rieda ta' Alla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 若上帝愿意；承蒙上帝意愿。

collocations.en: we will meet again, God willing
collocations.zh: 若上帝愿意，我们会再见

formal.mt: Jekk Alla jrid, il-proġett jitlesta sal-aħħar tax-xahar u r-riżultati jiġu ppreżentati lill-parteċipanti.
formal.en: God willing, the project will be completed by the end of the month and the results will be presented to the participants.
formal.zh: 若上帝愿意，项目将在月底前完成，成果也将向参与者展示。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Tiġi tarana nhar il-Ħadd? Ġużeppi: Iva, jekk Alla jrid. Inġib xi ħaġa ħelwa wkoll.
colloquial.en: Marta: Will you come and see us on Sunday? Ġużeppi: Yes, God willing. I'll bring something sweet too.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你星期天会来看我们吗？朱塞佩：会的，若上帝愿意。我还会带点甜食。

messages.speaker: Marta (亲友)
messages.zh: 你星期天会来看我们吗？
messages.en: Will you come and see us on Sunday?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (亲友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk Alla jrid. Inġib xi ħaġa ħelwa wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk Alla jrid. Inġib xi ħaġa ħelwa wkoll.
messages.zh: 会的，若上帝愿意。我还会带点甜食。
messages.en: Yes, God willing. I'll bring something sweet too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整句话当作未来计划旁的一句祝愿：“若上帝愿意，就能成行”，连同希望的语气一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 会哭的孩子有奶吃；想得到就要争取

teaching_sense.en_definition: A proverb saying that you must express your needs and persist if you want to obtain something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 劝人主动表达需求并坚持争取的谚语，相当于“会哭的孩子有奶吃”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qawl li jfisser li trid turi x'għandek bżonn u tinsisti biex tikseb dak li trid.

sense_translations.en_definition: You have to insist to get what you want.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 要得到自己想要的东西，就必须坚持争取。

collocations.mt: kif jgħid il-qawl, jekk ma tibkix ma terdax
collocations.en: as the proverb says, you have to insist to get what you want
collocations.zh: 正如谚语所说，会哭的孩子有奶吃

collocations.mt: ftakar: jekk ma tibkix ma terdax
collocations.en: remember: you have to insist to get what you want
collocations.zh: 记住：想得到就要坚持争取

formal.mt: Il-qawl 'jekk ma tibkix ma terdax' ifakkarna li għandna nesprimu l-ħtiġijiet tagħna b'mod ċar u ninsistu b'rispett.
formal.en: The proverb 'you have to insist to get what you want' reminds us to express our needs clearly and persist respectfully.
formal.zh: “会哭的孩子有奶吃”这句谚语提醒我们，要清楚表达自己的需求，并以尊重他人的方式坚持争取。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għadni ma staqsejtx jekk nistax nibdel il-ħin tal-appuntament. Marija: Staqsi! Jekk ma tibkix ma terdax.
colloquial.en: Nina: I still haven't asked whether I can change my appointment time. Marija: Ask! You have to insist to get what you want.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我还没问能不能更改预约时间。玛丽亚：问问呀！会哭的孩子有奶吃。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma staqsejtx jekk nistax nibdel il-ħin tal-appuntament.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma staqsejtx jekk nistax nibdel il-ħin tal-appuntament.
messages.zh: 我还没问能不能更改预约时间。
messages.en: I still haven't asked whether I can change my appointment time.

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Staqsi! Jekk ma tibkix ma terdax.
messages.mt_standard: Staqsi! Jekk ma tibkix ma terdax.
messages.zh: 问问呀！会哭的孩子有奶吃。
messages.en: Ask! You have to insist to get what you want.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用中文“会哭的孩子有奶吃”对应整句，记住它鼓励主动开口、坚持争取的实际用意。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Introduces an indirect question about whether something is true or will happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 引出间接疑问，表示某件事是否属实或是否会发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintroduċi mistoqsija indiretta dwar jekk xi ħaġa hijiex vera jew hix se sseħħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 是否；用来引出需要确认的情况。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat talab li jiġi kkonfermat jekkx id-dokumenti kollha waslu fil-ħin.
formal.en: The committee requested confirmation of whether all the documents had arrived on time.
formal.zh: 委员会要求确认所有文件是否都已按时送达。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Taf jekkx il-ħanut għadu miftuħ? David: Ma nafx; nista' nċempel u nistaqsi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you know whether the shop is still open? David: I don't know; I can call and ask.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你知道商店是否还开着吗？大卫：我不知道，可以打电话问问。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你知道商店是否还开着吗？
messages.en: Do you know whether the shop is still open?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx; nista' nċempel u nistaqsi.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx; nista' nċempel u nistaqsi.
messages.zh: 我不知道，可以打电话问问。
messages.en: I don't know; I can call and ask.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jekkx 放在“询问、知道、核实”后面，脑中接上中文“是否”，记成引出待确认情况的连接词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Yemen, a country in West Asia in the Middle East, officially called the Republic of Yemen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 也门，位于西亚、中东地区的国家，正式名称为也门共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Asja tal-Punent, fil-Lvant Nofsani, bl-isem uffiċjali Repubblika tal-Jemen.

sense_translations.en_definition: Yemen (a country in West Asia in the Middle East; official name: Repubblika tal-Jemen)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 也门，西亚中东地区的一个国家；正式名称为也门共和国，马耳他语为 Repubblika tal-Jemen。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika l-Jemen bħala pajjiż fl-Asja tal-Punent u juża l-isem uffiċjali Repubblika tal-Jemen.
formal.en: The report identifies Yemen as a country in West Asia and uses its official name, the Republic of Yemen.
formal.zh: 报告将也门列为西亚国家，并使用其正式名称“也门共和国”。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Fejn hu l-Jemen fuq din il-mappa? Mark: Hawn, fl-Asja tal-Punent. Ara l-isem ħdejn subgħajja.
colloquial.en: Elena: Where is Yemen on this map? Mark: Here, in West Asia. Look at the name next to my finger.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：这张地图上的也门在哪里？马克：这里，在西亚。看我手指旁边的名字。

messages.speaker: Elena (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-Jemen fuq din il-mappa?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-Jemen fuq din il-mappa?
messages.zh: 这张地图上的也门在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Yemen on this map?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn, fl-Asja tal-Punent. Ara l-isem ħdejn subgħajja.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn, fl-Asja tal-Punent. Ara l-isem ħdejn subgħajja.
messages.zh: 这里，在西亚。看我手指旁边的名字。
messages.en: Here, in West Asia. Look at the name next to my finger.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Jemen、Yemen、也门并排写在同一张地图标签上，再用“西亚国家”这一位置线索帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hyena; the general animal name without specifying a particular species.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鬣狗这一动物的通称；单用此词时不特指某一种鬣狗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ġenerali għall-annimal jena, mingħajr ma jispeċifika speċi partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鬣狗。

formal.mt: Il-paġna turi ritratt ta' jena, iżda t-test ma jispeċifikax l-ispeċi tal-annimal.
formal.en: The page shows a photograph of a hyena, but the text does not specify the animal's species.
formal.zh: 这一页展示了一张鬣狗的照片，但文字没有说明该动物的具体物种。

colloquial.mt: Luca: X'annimal hu dan fir-ritratt? Anna: Din jena. Ejja naqraw x'hemm miktub taħt ir-ritratt.
colloquial.en: Luca: What animal is this in the photograph? Anna: It's a hyena. Let's read what is written below the photograph.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：照片里这是什么动物？安娜：这是一只鬣狗。我们读读照片下面写的内容吧。

messages.speaker: Luca (同学)
messages.zh: 照片里这是什么动物？
messages.en: What animal is this in the photograph?

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Din jena. Ejja naqraw x'hemm miktub taħt ir-ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Din jena. Ejja naqraw x'hemm miktub taħt ir-ritratt.
messages.zh: 这是一只鬣狗。我们读读照片下面写的内容吧。
messages.en: It's a hyena. Let's read what is written below the photograph.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张鬣狗图片卡，正面写 jena，背面写“鬣狗／hyena”，先牢牢记住动物通称，再学习具体种名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The striped hyena, the species of hyena scientifically named Hyaena hyaena.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 条纹鬣狗，鬣狗中的一个具体物种，学名为 Hyaena hyaena。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' jena bl-istrixxi, magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Hyaena hyaena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 条纹鬣狗，学名 Hyaena hyaena。

collocations.en: a photograph of a striped hyena
the scientific name of the striped hyena

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jidentifika l-annimal bħala jena bl-istrixxi u jagħti l-isem xjentifiku Hyaena hyaena.
formal.en: The catalogue identifies the animal as a striped hyena and gives its scientific name as Hyaena hyaena.
formal.zh: 图录将该动物鉴定为条纹鬣狗，并列出其学名 Hyaena hyaena。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din ukoll jena? Ben: Iva, din jena bl-istrixxi. Ara l-istrixxi fir-ritratt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this a hyena too? Ben: Yes, it's a striped hyena. Look at the stripes in the photograph.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这也是鬣狗吗？本：是的，这是条纹鬣狗。看看照片里的条纹。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这也是鬣狗吗？
messages.en: Is this a hyena too?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, din jena bl-istrixxi. Ara l-istrixxi fir-ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, din jena bl-istrixxi. Ara l-istrixxi fir-ritratt.
messages.zh: 是的，这是条纹鬣狗。看看照片里的条纹。
messages.en: Yes, it's a striped hyena. Look at the stripes in the photograph.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 jena 是“鬣狗”，再把 bl-istrixxi 与图片上的条纹一起记忆，用完整短语锁定“条纹鬣狗”这一物种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression of praise used to congratulate someone on doing something well.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来赞扬某人表现出色或成功完成某事的感叹语，相当于“干得好！”或“真棒！”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni ta' tifħir lil xi ħadd li jkun għamel xi ħaġa tajba jew irnexxa f'xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 好样的！；干得好！；真棒！

formal.mt: Fl-aħħar tal-ittra, l-għalliem kiteb: "Jessu għalik ta' dan ix-xogħol eċċellenti!"
formal.en: At the end of the letter, the teacher wrote: "Well done on this excellent work!"
formal.zh: 老师在信的末尾写道：“这项工作完成得非常出色，真棒！”

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fl-aħħar għaddejt mill-eżami! Mark: Jessu għalik! Kont naf li se jirnexxielek.
colloquial.en: Lara: I finally passed the exam! Mark: Well done! I knew you would succeed.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我终于通过考试了！Mark：真棒！我就知道你会成功。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我终于通过考试了！
messages.en: I finally passed the exam!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jessu għalik! Kont naf li se jirnexxielek.
messages.mt_standard: Jessu għalik! Kont naf li se jirnexxielek.
messages.zh: 真棒！我就知道你会成功。
messages.en: Well done! I knew you would succeed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这整句配上鼓掌动作来记：朋友成功时，立即说“干得好！”

gloss_zh: 希望；常用于放弃希望的表达

teaching_sense.en_definition: Hope, chiefly used in expressions about giving up hope, especially with the verb qata'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 希望，主要出现在表示放弃希望或不再抱有期待的表达中，尤其与动词 qata' 搭配。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tama, l-aktar f'espressjonijiet dwar it-telf tat-tama, speċjalment mal-verb qata'.

sense_translations.en_definition: hope; but chiefly in a negative context, especially with qata’ (“to give up”)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 希望；但主要用于消极语境，尤其与表示“放弃”的 qata' 搭配。

collocations.en: she did not give up hope

formal.mt: Minkejja d-diffikultajiet, il-familja ma qatgħetx jiesha li ssib dar adattata.
formal.en: Despite the difficulties, the family did not give up hope of finding a suitable home.
formal.zh: 尽管困难重重，这家人仍未放弃找到合适住房的希望。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għadek tfittex ix-xogħol? Pawlu: Iva, ma qtajtx jiesi. Għada għandi intervista oħra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you still looking for work? Pawlu: Yes, I haven't given up hope. I have another interview tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你还在找工作吗？Pawlu：是的，我还没有放弃希望。明天我还有一场面试。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还在找工作吗？
messages.en: Are you still looking for work?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (求职者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ma qtajtx jiesi. Għada għandi intervista oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ma qtajtx jiesi. Għada għandi intervista oħra.
messages.zh: 是的，我还没有放弃希望。明天我还有一场面试。
messages.en: Yes, I haven't given up hope. I have another interview tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 jies 放进整句来记：qata' jiesu 是放弃希望，加上否定则是仍不放弃。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to say that something is possible but not certain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某事有可能发生或属实，但说话者并不确定，相当于“也许”或“可能”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li turi li xi ħaġa tista' tiġri jew tkun vera, iżda mhix ċerta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 也许；可能；或许。

formal.mt: Jimken ikun meħtieġ aktar żmien biex jitlesta r-rapport.
formal.en: Perhaps more time will be needed to complete the report.
formal.zh: 完成这份报告也许需要更多时间。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Se tiġi magħna għada? David: Jimken niġi, jekk nispiċċa x-xogħol kmieni.
colloquial.en: Nina: Are you coming with us tomorrow? David: Maybe I'll come, if I finish work early.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你明天跟我们一起去吗？David：如果我早点完成工作，也许会去。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你明天跟我们一起去吗？
messages.en: Are you coming with us tomorrow?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jimken niġi, jekk nispiċċa x-xogħol kmieni.
messages.mt_standard: Jimken niġi, jekk nispiċċa x-xogħol kmieni.
messages.zh: 如果我早点完成工作，也许会去。
messages.en: Maybe I'll come, if I finish work early.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历上画着问号的明天：jimken 表示可能发生，还没有确定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to introduce what will happen if the preceding action is not taken or condition is not met.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 引出前述行动未采取或条件未满足时会出现的另一种结果，相当于“否则”或“不然”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tintroduċi x'jiġri jekk ma ssirx l-azzjoni jew ma tintlaħaqx il-kundizzjoni msemmija qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 否则；不然；在另一种情况下。

collocations.en: otherwise it will be too late
otherwise we will have to wait

formal.mt: Il-formola għandha tasal sal-Ġimgħa, jonkella l-applikazzjoni ma tiġix aċċettata.
formal.en: The form must arrive by Friday; otherwise, the application will not be accepted.
formal.zh: 表格必须在星期五之前送达，否则申请将不获受理。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Ejja nitilqu issa, jonkella nitilfu l-karozza tal-linja. Ben: Tajjeb, lest. Ejja mmorru!
colloquial.en: Marta: Let's leave now, otherwise we'll miss the bus. Ben: All right, I'm ready. Let's go!
colloquial.zh: Marta：我们现在走吧，不然会错过公交车。Ben：好，我准备好了。走吧！

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nitilqu issa, jonkella nitilfu l-karozza tal-linja.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nitilqu issa, jonkella nitilfu l-karozza tal-linja.
messages.zh: 我们现在走吧，不然会错过公交车。
messages.en: Let's leave now, otherwise we'll miss the bus.

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我准备好了。走吧！
messages.en: All right, I'm ready. Let's go!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用赶公交的情景记忆：现在出发，jonkella 后面接“不然会怎样”的结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: On one unspecified day, often used to introduce an event in a story.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在没有具体说明日期的某一天，常用于引出叙事中的事件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'ġurnata mhux speċifikata, spiss biex tintroduċi ġrajja f'rakkont.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有一天；某一天，具体时间未说明。

collocations.mt: jum fost l-oħrajn iltqajt ma' ħabib
collocations.en: one day I met a friend
collocations.zh: 有一天我遇见了一位朋友

collocations.mt: jum fost l-oħrajn ġara xi ħaġa

formal.mt: Jum fost l-oħrajn, ir-riċerkatriċi sabet ittra antika fl-arkivju tal-belt.
formal.en: One day, the researcher found an old letter in the city's archive.
formal.zh: 有一天，这位研究员在城市档案馆里发现了一封旧信。
