colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif sirt taf lil Luqa? Marija: Jum fost l-oħrajn iltqajt miegħu fil-ħanut u bdejna nitkellmu.
colloquial.en: Anna: How did you get to know Luqa? Marija: One day I met him at the shop and we started talking.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你是怎么认识 Luqa 的？Marija：有一天我在店里遇见他，我们就聊了起来。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你是怎么认识 Luqa 的？
messages.en: How did you get to know Luqa?

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jum fost l-oħrajn iltqajt miegħu fil-ħanut u bdejna nitkellmu.
messages.mt_standard: Jum fost l-oħrajn iltqajt miegħu fil-ħanut u bdejna nitkellmu.
messages.zh: 有一天我在店里遇见他，我们就聊了起来。
messages.en: One day I met him at the shop and we started talking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象从许多日历页中随手抽出一页：不说具体日期，只说故事里的“有一天”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The day of final divine judgement in a religious context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宗教语境中，神对人作最终审判的日子，即审判日或末日审判之日。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-jum li fih, skont it-twemmin reliġjuż, Alla jagħmel il-ġudizzju finali fuq il-bnedmin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 审判日；末日审判之日。

formal.mt: Fit-test reliġjuż, jum il-ħaqq huwa deskritt bħala l-jum tal-ġudizzju finali.
formal.en: In the religious text, judgement day is described as the day of final judgement.
formal.zh: 这篇宗教文本将审判日描述为最终审判的日子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu jum il-ħaqq f'dan ir-rakkont? Pawlu: Huwa l-jum meta Alla jagħmel il-ġudizzju finali.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is judgement day in this story? Pawlu: It is the day when God makes the final judgement.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这个故事里的审判日是什么意思？Pawlu：就是神作最终审判的日子。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这个故事里的审判日是什么意思？
messages.en: What is judgement day in this story?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa l-jum meta Alla jagħmel il-ġudizzju finali.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa l-jum meta Alla jagħmel il-ġudizzju finali.
messages.zh: 就是神作最终审判的日子。
messages.en: It is the day when God makes the final judgement.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一张标有“最终审判”的日历页记住整组词，联想到宗教语境中的审判日。

gloss_zh: 掉头；车辆作一百八十度转向

teaching_sense.en_definition: A turn made by a vehicle to travel back in the opposite direction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 车辆转向并改为朝原来相反方向行驶的动作，即掉头。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dawra li tagħmel vettura biex terġa' timxi fid-direzzjoni opposta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 车辆掉头；使行驶方向变为相反方向的转弯。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, is-sewwieq għamel jutern u beda jsuq fid-direzzjoni opposta.
formal.en: According to the report, the driver made a U-turn and began driving in the opposite direction.
formal.zh: 据报告记载，司机掉头后开始朝相反方向行驶。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qbiżna d-daħla tal-parkeġġ. Mark: Iva, se nagħmel jutern fejn ikun permess u sigur.
colloquial.en: Maja: We went past the car park entrance. Mark: Yes, I'll make a U-turn where it is allowed and safe.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们开过停车场入口了。Mark：是的，我会在允许且安全的地方掉头。

messages.speaker: Maja (乘客)
messages.zh: 我们开过停车场入口了。
messages.en: We went past the car park entrance.

messages.speaker: Mark (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se nagħmel jutern fejn ikun permess u sigur.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se nagħmel jutern fejn ikun permess u sigur.
messages.zh: 是的，我会在允许且安全的地方掉头。
messages.en: Yes, I'll make a U-turn where it is allowed and safe.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象汽车沿字母 U 的形状转弯，车头转向来路，就能记住 jutern 是掉头。

gloss_zh: 种植培育；放大；增加；扩展；变得骄傲；增添者

teaching_sense.en_definition: To grow plants or produce, or to make something larger, greater in amount, or more extensive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 种植培育植物或农产品；也指使事物的尺寸、数量、程度或范围变大，包括放大、增加和扩展。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tkabbar pjanti jew prodotti tar-raba', jew tagħmel xi ħaġa akbar fid-daqs, fil-kwantità jew fil-firxa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to grow sth. (especially vegetables, fruit, etc)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 种植、培育某物，尤其指蔬菜、水果等。
放大；扩大尺寸。
增添；扩充，使原有事物更多或更大。
增加；提高数量、数值或程度。
变得骄傲；变得自大。
扩展自己的业务；扩大经营规模。
使更高；提高或增强程度。
使某物增加或扩充的人；增添者。

formal.mt: Matul is-sena li għaddiet, il-bidwi kabbar il-ħaxix għall-bejgħ u kabbar ukoll in-negozju tiegħu.
formal.en: Over the past year, the farmer grew vegetables for sale and also expanded his business.
formal.zh: 过去一年里，这位农民种植蔬菜出售，同时也扩大了自己的经营规模。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan ir-ritratt żgħir wisq. Tista' tkabbru? Luqa: Iva, nagħmlu akbar biex tara d-dettalji aħjar.
colloquial.en: Sara: This photograph is too small. Can you enlarge it? Luqa: Yes, I'll make it bigger so you can see the details better.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这张照片太小了。你能把它放大吗？Luqa：可以，我把它放大，让你看得更清楚。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ir-ritratt żgħir wisq. Tista' tkabbru?
messages.mt_standard: Dan ir-ritratt żgħir wisq. Tista' tkabbru?
messages.zh: 这张照片太小了。你能把它放大吗？
messages.en: This photograph is too small. Can you enlarge it?

messages.speaker: Luqa (照相馆店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nagħmlu akbar biex tara d-dettalji aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nagħmlu akbar biex tara d-dettalji aħjar.
messages.zh: 可以，我把它放大，让你看得更清楚。
messages.en: Yes, I'll make it bigger so you can see the details better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 串起三个画面：菜苗长大、照片放大、业务扩大；再单独记住“变骄傲”和名词“增添者”。

gloss_zh: 有放大作用的；爱夸饰的；倾向于长得高大魁梧的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the effect of making something appear larger, as a magnifying lens does.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有放大作用、能使所观察的东西显得更大的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel xi ħaġa tidher akbar, bħal lenti li tkabbar.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to magnify (e.g. a magnifying glass)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有放大作用的，例如用于描述放大镜。
倾向于添油加醋、夸饰或夸大的。

sense_translations.en_definition: tending towards a big physical stature
sense_translations.zh_definition: 体格倾向于长得高大或魁梧的。

formal.mt: L-istudent uża lenti kabbari biex jara d-dettalji żgħar fuq il-werqa.
formal.en: The student used a magnifying lens to see the small details on the leaf.
formal.zh: 学生用放大镜观察叶片上的细小细节。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ma nistax naqra dawn l-ittri żgħar. Pawlu: Ħu din il-lenti kabbari; biha tarahom aħjar.
colloquial.en: Lara: I can't read these tiny letters. Pawlu: Take this magnifying lens; you'll see them better with it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这些小字我看不清。保罗：拿这个放大镜，用它就能看得更清楚。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nistax naqra dawn l-ittri żgħar.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nistax naqra dawn l-ittri żgħar.
messages.zh: 这些小字我看不清。
messages.en: I can't read these tiny letters.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu din il-lenti kabbari; biha tarahom aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu din il-lenti kabbari; biha tarahom aħjar.
messages.zh: 拿这个放大镜，用它就能看得更清楚。
messages.en: Take this magnifying lens; you'll see them better with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个义项分别配成三幅图：镜片放大文字、讲故事添油加醋、人物体格高大；用画面区分具体语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cover or dress someone in a cloak.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把斗篷披在某人身上，使其得到遮盖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għatta jew libbes lil xi ħadd b'kabozza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给某人披上斗篷；用斗篷裹住某人。

formal.mt: Qabel ma ħarġu fil-kesħa, il-missier kabbaz lit-tifel b'kabozza sħuna.
formal.en: Before they went out into the cold, the father cloaked the boy in a warm cloak.
formal.zh: 出门迎向寒冷之前，父亲给男孩披上了一件暖和的斗篷。

colloquial.mt: Mira: It-tifel kellu l-bard? Toni: Iva, u missieru kabbaz lit-tifel qabel ħarġu.
colloquial.en: Mira: Was the boy cold? Toni: Yes, and his father cloaked him before they went out.
colloquial.zh: 米拉：那男孩觉得冷吗？托尼：觉得冷，他爸爸出门前给他披上了斗篷。

messages.speaker: Mira (朋友)
messages.zh: 那男孩觉得冷吗？
messages.en: Was the boy cold?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u missieru kabbaz lit-tifel qabel ħarġu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u missieru kabbaz lit-tifel qabel ħarġu.
messages.zh: 觉得冷，他爸爸出门前给他披上了斗篷。
messages.en: Yes, and his father cloaked him before they went out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象父亲把斗篷披到孩子肩上，记住这是给人披衣的动作；连同“给谁披上”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cloak or similar covering worn over or wrapped around the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 披在身体外面或裹在身上的斗篷、披风一类遮盖物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilbies jew għata li jintlibes fuq il-ġisem jew jitgeżwer madwaru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 斗篷，披在外衣外面的宽松衣物。
兜帽，罩在头上的帽状遮盖物。
披风，覆盖肩部及身体的外披衣物。
披裹物，披在或裹在身上的衣物。

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, il-vjaġġatur libes kabozza tas-suf qabel beda l-mixja tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the traveller put on a woollen cloak before beginning his walk.
formal.zh: 故事中，旅人在开始步行前穿上了一件羊毛斗篷。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn poġġejt il-kabozza tiegħi? Rita: Fuq is-siġġu ħdejn il-bieb; ħudha għax barra hemm il-bard.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where did you put my cloak? Rita: On the chair by the door; take it because it's cold outside.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你把我的斗篷放哪儿了？丽塔：门边的椅子上；外面冷，带上吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (姐妹)
messages.zh: 你把我的斗篷放哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did you put my cloak?

messages.speaker: Rita (姐妹)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq is-siġġu ħdejn il-bieb; ħudha għax barra hemm il-bard.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq is-siġġu ħdejn il-bieb; ħudha għax barra hemm il-bard.
messages.zh: 门边的椅子上；外面冷，带上吧。
messages.en: On the chair by the door; take it because it's cold outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用穿戴画面记义项：罩头时想兜帽，披肩裹身时想斗篷或披裹物；具体译法跟着上下文走。

gloss_zh: 使某物滚动；使某物沿斜面滚下

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make an object roll, including down a slope.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使物体滚动，也可指使其沿斜面向下滚动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġiegħel oġġett jirrombla, ukoll 'l isfel minn wiċċ imżerżaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物滚动。

sense_translations.en_definition: to roll sth. down an inclined plane
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物沿斜面向下滚动。

formal.mt: Waqt id-dimostrazzjoni, l-għalliem kabras il-ballun 'l isfel minn fuq rampa.
formal.en: During the demonstration, the teacher rolled the ball down a ramp.
formal.zh: 演示时，老师让球沿着斜坡滚了下去。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif wasal il-ballun ħdejn il-bieb? Mark: Leo kabras il-ballun minn hawn sa hemm.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did the ball get over by the door? Mark: Leo rolled it from here to there.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：球怎么到门边去了？马克：莱奥把球从这里滚到那边去了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 球怎么到门边去了？
messages.en: How did the ball get over by the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Leo kabras il-ballun minn hawn sa hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Leo kabras il-ballun minn hawn sa hemm.
messages.zh: 莱奥把球从这里滚到那边去了。
messages.en: Leo rolled it from here to there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手推动圆球，球一圈圈滚走；再把地面换成斜坡，就能记住沿斜面滚下的第二义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called cadmium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素镉的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku msejjaħ kadmju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 镉，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tal-laboratorju jsemmi l-preżenza tal-kadmju fil-kampjun analizzat.
formal.en: The laboratory report mentions the presence of cadmium in the analysed sample.
formal.zh: 实验室报告提到，在所分析的样本中存在镉。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Xi jfisser kadmju f'dan ir-rapport? David: Huwa l-isem ta' element kimiku; bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ cadmium.
colloquial.en: Elena: What does kadmju mean in this report? David: It's the name of a chemical element; in English it's called cadmium.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：这份报告里的 kadmju 是什么意思？戴维：它是一种化学元素的名称，英语叫 cadmium，也就是镉。

messages.speaker: Elena (学生)
messages.zh: 这份报告里的 kadmju 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does kadmju mean in this report?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa l-isem ta' element kimiku; bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ cadmium.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa l-isem ta' element kimiku; bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ cadmium.
messages.zh: 它是一种化学元素的名称，英语叫 cadmium，也就是镉。
messages.en: It's the name of a chemical element; in English it's called cadmium.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kadmju、cadmium 和“镉”写在同一张元素词卡上，利用两种外文拼写的相似处建立三语对应。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The substance called caffeine, referred to when describing whether a drink contains it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 咖啡因这种物质的名称，可用于说明饮品是否含有咖啡因。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-sustanza msejħa kafeina, li tissemma meta jingħad jekk xarba fihiex din is-sustanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 咖啡因。

formal.mt: It-tikketta tindika jekk ix-xarba fihiex kafeina.
formal.en: The label indicates whether the drink contains caffeine.
formal.zh: 标签注明了该饮品是否含有咖啡因。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Din ix-xarba fiha l-kafeina? Nina: Iva. Jekk trid waħda mingħajr kafeina, għandna din.
colloquial.en: Mark: Does this drink contain caffeine? Nina: Yes. If you'd like one without caffeine, we have this one.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这款饮品含咖啡因吗？妮娜：含。如果你想要不含咖啡因的，我们有这一款。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这款饮品含咖啡因吗？
messages.en: Does this drink contain caffeine?

messages.speaker: Nina (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. Jekk trid waħda mingħajr kafeina, għandna din.
messages.mt_standard: Iva. Jekk trid waħda mingħajr kafeina, għandna din.
messages.zh: 含。如果你想要不含咖啡因的，我们有这一款。
messages.en: Yes. If you'd like one without caffeine, we have this one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kafeina 与“咖啡因”配成饮品标签词卡，再并排记住 bil-kafeina 和 mingħajr kafeina，分别对应含与不含。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Light brown in colour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 颜色为浅棕色的，用于描述衣服、家具等物品的颜色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta' lewn kannella ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 浅棕色的。

formal.mt: Għall-kamra tal-laqgħat, intgħażlu purtieri kafelatte biex jaqblu mal-għamara.
formal.en: Light brown curtains were chosen for the meeting room to match the furniture.
formal.zh: 会议室选用了浅棕色窗帘，以搭配家具。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema ġakketta tippreferi? Lara: Dik kafelatte; taqbel maż-żraben tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which jacket do you prefer? Lara: The light brown one; it matches my shoes.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你更喜欢哪件夹克？Lara：那件浅棕色的，和我的鞋子很配。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你更喜欢哪件夹克？
messages.en: Which jacket do you prefer?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那件浅棕色的，和我的鞋子很配。
messages.en: The light brown one; it matches my shoes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把浅棕色夹克和浅棕色窗帘放在同一幅画面里，用 kafelatte 给两件物品标注颜色。

gloss_zh: 大量咒骂；亵渎神明的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To curse a great deal or repeatedly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大量或反复地咒骂、说骂人的话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħid ħafna kliem ta' saħta jew dagħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大量咒骂，反复说咒骂的话。
说亵渎神明之语的人。

collocations.en: he cursed a lot in anger
he cursed for a long time

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jgħid li r-raġel kaffar għal ħin twil wara l-inċident.
formal.en: The report states that the man cursed for a long time after the incident.
formal.zh: 报告指出，那名男子在事件发生后咒骂了很长时间。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex tlaqt mill-kamra? Mark: Għax Pawlu kaffar għal ħin twil u ma ridtx nibqa' nisma'.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you leave the room? Mark: Because Pawlu cursed for a long time, and I didn't want to keep listening.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么离开房间？Mark：因为 Pawlu 骂了很久，我不想继续听了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么离开房间？
messages.en: Why did you leave the room?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax Pawlu kaffar għal ħin twil u ma ridtx nibqa' nisma'.
messages.mt_standard: Għax Pawlu kaffar għal ħin twil u ma ridtx nibqa' nisma'.
messages.zh: 因为 Pawlu 骂了很久，我不想继续听了。
messages.en: Because Pawlu cursed for a long time, and I didn't want to keep listening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住一段持续很久的咒骂：动词 kaffar 强调骂得多；另做一张名词卡，单独记住“亵渎神明的人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing disrespect towards God or things regarded as sacred.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对神明或被视为神圣的事物表示冒犯、不敬的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri nuqqas ta' rispett lejn Alla jew lejn affarijiet meqjusa qaddisa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 亵渎神明或神圣事物的。

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tat-test, l-awtriċi tispjega għaliex il-kumment tqies kaffari.
formal.en: In her analysis of the text, the author explains why the comment was considered blasphemous.
formal.zh: 作者在文本分析中解释了为什么这句评论被认为亵渎神明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma qrajtx dik is-sentenza b'leħen għoli? Lara: Għax fiha kliem kaffari.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why didn't you read that sentence aloud? Lara: Because it contains blasphemous words.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么没有把那句话读出来？Lara：因为里面有亵渎神明的话。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma qrajtx dik is-sentenza b'leħen għoli?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma qrajtx dik is-sentenza b'leħen għoli?
messages.zh: 你为什么没有把那句话读出来？
messages.en: Why didn't you read that sentence aloud?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 因为里面有亵渎神明的话。
messages.en: Because it contains blasphemous words.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“这话是什么性质？”来提示形容词：kliem kaffari 就是具有亵渎性质的话，重点记住它在描述话语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Blasphemous speech or an utterance of cursing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 亵渎神明的言语，或一句咒骂的话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma jew espressjoni ta' dagħa jew saħta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 亵渎神明的言语；咒骂、诅咒的话。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru qal kafra meta nduna li kien tilef il-flus.
formal.en: In the story, the character uttered a curse when he realised that he had lost the money.
formal.zh: 故事中，人物发现自己把钱弄丢时，咒骂了一句。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qal Mark meta waqagħlu t-telefon? Maja: Qal kafra, imbagħad ġabar it-telefon mill-art.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did Mark say when he dropped his phone? Maja: He uttered a curse, then picked the phone up from the floor.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark 把手机掉在地上时说了什么？Maja：他骂了一句，然后把手机从地上捡了起来。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 把手机掉在地上时说了什么？
messages.en: What did Mark say when he dropped his phone?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qal kafra, imbagħad ġabar it-telefon mill-art.
messages.mt_standard: Qal kafra, imbagħad ġabar it-telefon mill-art.
messages.zh: 他骂了一句，然后把手机从地上捡了起来。
messages.en: He uttered a curse, then picked the phone up from the floor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kafra 放进一个小小的对话气泡，表示“骂出来的一句话”；再用 kafra wara oħra 记住一句接一句的画面。

gloss_zh: 传统环形甜糕点；亦指 ftira 式面饼

teaching_sense.en_definition: A traditional sweet pastry, usually made in the shape of a ring.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种传统甜糕点，通常做成环形。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' ħelu tradizzjonali magħmul mill-għaġina, ġeneralment f'għamla ta' ċirku.

sense_translations.en_definition: a traditional kind of sweet pastry, usually ring-shaped
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种传统甜糕点，通常呈环形。
与 ftira 同义，指一种面饼。

formal.mt: Għat-tmiem tal-ikla, ġie servut kagħak ħelu mat-te.
formal.en: At the end of the meal, sweet ring-shaped pastries were served with tea.
formal.zh: 用餐结束时，端上了配茶的甜味环形糕点。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandkom kagħak ħelu llum? Rita: Iva, għadu kemm ħareġ mill-forn.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have sweet ring-shaped pastries today? Rita: Yes, they have just come out of the oven.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你们今天有甜味环形糕点吗？Rita：有，刚刚出炉。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 你们今天有甜味环形糕点吗？
messages.en: Do you have sweet ring-shaped pastries today?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: 有，刚刚出炉。
messages.en: Yes, they have just come out of the oven.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先画一个甜糕点圆环来记 kagħak 的主要义；另加一张写有 ftira 的面饼卡片，提醒自己它还有另一义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A room in a home used for receiving visitors and sitting with them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 住宅内用来接待访客、与客人一起坐谈的房间，即会客室。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kamra f'dar fejn jintlaqgħu l-mistednin u wieħed joqgħod jitkellem magħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 会客室，住宅中接待访客的房间。
老妇人，年老的女人。

collocations.en: the drawing room of the house

formal.mt: Il-kagħba tad-dar għandha twieqi kbar li jagħtu fuq il-ġnien.
formal.en: The drawing room of the house has large windows overlooking the garden.
formal.zh: 这所房子的会客室有几扇面向花园的大窗户。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se noqogħdu mal-mistednin? Rita: Fil-kagħba; hemm biżżejjed siġġijiet għal kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we sit with the guests? Rita: In the drawing room; there are enough chairs for everyone.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们和客人坐在哪里？Rita：在会客室，那里有足够的椅子让大家坐。

messages.speaker: Maja (女儿)
messages.zh: 我们和客人坐在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we sit with the guests?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-kagħba; hemm biżżejjed siġġijiet għal kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-kagħba; hemm biżżejjed siġġijiet għal kulħadd.
messages.zh: 在会客室，那里有足够的椅子让大家坐。
messages.en: In the drawing room; there are enough chairs for everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张分开的图片记同形词：一张画接待客人的房间，一张画老妇人；两张都写 kagħba，但不要把两个意思混成一个。

gloss_zh: 虐待；滥用；因使用不当或过度而损坏

teaching_sense.en_definition: To treat someone badly, use something improperly, or damage something by improper or excessive use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 恶劣地对待某人；不当地使用某物；或因使用不当、使用过度而使某物损坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittratta lil xi ħadd ħażin, juża xi ħaġa b'mod mhux xieraq, jew jagħmlilha ħsara b'użu ħażin jew żejjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 虐待，恶劣地对待。
滥用，使用不当。

sense_translations.en_definition: to damage through misuse or overuse
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因使用不当或过度使用而使之损坏。

collocations.zh: 他不当地使用了那些工具

collocations.en: he damaged the chair through misuse
collocations.zh: 他因使用不当弄坏了椅子

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega li l-ħaddiem kagħbar l-apparat billi użah għal xogħol li ma kienx adattat għalih.
formal.en: The report explains that the worker misused the equipment by using it for work it was not suited to.
formal.zh: 报告解释说，该工人将设备用于不适合的工作，构成了使用不当。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex dan is-siġġu ma għadux tajjeb? Mark: Pawlu kagħbar is-siġġu; kien dejjem jitbandal fuqu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is this chair no longer usable? Mark: Pawlu damaged it through misuse; he was always rocking on it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这把椅子为什么不能用了？Mark：Pawlu 用坏了这把椅子，他总是坐在上面摇来摇去。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan is-siġġu ma għadux tajjeb?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan is-siġġu ma għadux tajjeb?
messages.zh: 这把椅子为什么不能用了？
messages.en: Why is this chair no longer usable?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu kagħbar is-siġġu; kien dejjem jitbandal fuqu.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu kagħbar is-siġġu; kien dejjem jitbandal fuqu.
messages.zh: Pawlu 用坏了这把椅子，他总是坐在上面摇来摇去。
messages.en: Pawlu damaged it through misuse; he was always rocking on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按对象和结果记三格画面：对生命是虐待，对工具是滥用，椅子被摇坏则强调损坏结果；三格都配 kagħbar。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Solid animal waste, especially from farm animals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 动物排出的固体粪便，尤指牲畜的粪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħmieġ solidu tal-annimali, speċjalment tal-bhejjem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 动物的粪便，尤指牲畜粪。

formal.mt: Waqt it-tindif tal-istalla, il-kagħbur inġabar f'post apposta.
formal.en: During the cleaning of the stable, the dung was collected in a designated place.
formal.zh: 清理马厩时，粪便被集中收集到指定地点。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'hemm ħdejn il-bieb tal-istalla? Pawlu: Munzell kagħbur; oqgħod attent fejn tirfes.
colloquial.en: Mark: What's beside the stable door? Pawlu: A heap of dung; watch where you step.
colloquial.zh: Mark：马厩门旁边是什么？Pawlu：一堆粪便，注意脚下。

messages.speaker: Mark (农场访客)
messages.zh: 马厩门旁边是什么？
messages.en: What's beside the stable door?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Munzell kagħbur; oqgħod attent fejn tirfes.
messages.mt_standard: Munzell kagħbur; oqgħod attent fejn tirfes.
messages.zh: 一堆粪便，注意脚下。
messages.en: A heap of dung; watch where you step.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象马厩门边的一堆牲畜粪，把 munzell kagħbur 与“注意脚下”的提醒一起记，建立具体场景联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A piece or lump of animal dung.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 动物排出的一块或一团粪便。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa jew għoqda ta' ħmieġ ta' annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一块粪便；一团动物粪。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa ħmieġ ta' annimal.

collocations.en: a piece of dung in the road

formal.mt: Waqt it-tindif tal-bitħa, il-ħaddiem neħħa kagħbura minn ħdejn il-bieb.
formal.en: While cleaning the yard, the worker removed a piece of dung from beside the door.
formal.zh: 清扫院子时，工人清除了门边的一块粪便。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Attent fejn tirfes! Hemm kagħbura quddiemek. Pawlu: Rajtha, grazzi. Se ngħaddi minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Marija: Watch your step! There's a piece of dung in front of you. Pawlu: I've seen it, thanks. I'll go this way.
colloquial.zh: Marija：小心脚下！你前面有一块粪便。Pawlu：看到了，谢谢。我从这边走。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Attent fejn tirfes! Hemm kagħbura quddiemek.
messages.mt_standard: Attent fejn tirfes! Hemm kagħbura quddiemek.
messages.zh: 小心脚下！你前面有一块粪便。
messages.en: Watch your step! There's a piece of dung in front of you.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtha, grazzi. Se ngħaddi minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtha, grazzi. Se ngħaddi minn hawn.
messages.zh: 看到了，谢谢。我从这边走。
messages.en: I've seen it, thanks. I'll go this way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kagħbura 配上“路上有一块，要绕开”的画面，记住它指一块粪便，而不是泛指脏东西。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sweet pastry shaped like a ring.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做成圆环形状的甜糕点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaġina ħelwa magħmula f'għamla ta' ċirku.

sense_translations.en_definition: a sweet pastry in the shape of a ring
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种做成圆环形状的甜糕点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għaġina ħelwa li għandha għamla ta' ċirku.

formal.mt: Il-ħanut joffri kagħka ħelwa ma' kull kikkra kafè.
formal.en: The shop offers a sweet ring-shaped pastry with every cup of coffee.
formal.zh: 这家店每卖一杯咖啡，都配一个环形甜糕点。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid kagħka mal-kafè? Mark: Iva, grazzi. Waħda biss, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like a ring-shaped pastry with your coffee? Mark: Yes, thanks. Just one, please.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你要不要来个环形甜糕点配咖啡？Mark：好，谢谢。一个就行。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要不要来个环形甜糕点配咖啡？
messages.en: Would you like a ring-shaped pastry with your coffee?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi. Waħda biss, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi. Waħda biss, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 好，谢谢。一个就行。
messages.en: Yes, thanks. Just one, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 kagħka 时画一个中间空心的甜糕点，再在旁边画杯咖啡，把“甜”和“圆环形”一起记住。

gloss_zh: 使扭动；使痛得或笑得扭曲身体

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone writhe or twist their body, for example because of pain or laughter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人扭动或扭曲身体，例如使其痛得蜷扭或笑得直不起身。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitgħawweġ b'ġismu, pereżempju bl-uġigħ jew bid-daħk.

sense_translations.en_definition: to cause to writhe (e.g. in pain or laughter)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人扭动或扭曲身体，例如因疼痛或大笑而蜷扭。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitgħawweġ, bħal meta jkollu uġigħ jew jidħak ħafna.

collocations.en: to make someone writhe in pain
to make someone double up with laughter

formal.mt: L-uġigħ qawwi kagħweġ lill-pazjent waqt l-eżami.
formal.en: The severe pain made the patient writhe during the examination.
formal.zh: 检查过程中，剧烈的疼痛使患者扭动身体。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dak ir-rakkont kagħweġ lil Pawlu bid-daħk! Ben: Veru! Lanqas seta' jitkellem.
colloquial.en: Anna: That story made Pawlu double up with laughter! Ben: It really did! He couldn't even speak.
colloquial.zh: Anna：那个故事让 Pawlu 笑得直不起身！Ben：真的！他连话都说不出来了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ir-rakkont kagħweġ lil Pawlu bid-daħk!
messages.mt_standard: Dak ir-rakkont kagħweġ lil Pawlu bid-daħk!
messages.zh: 那个故事让 Pawlu 笑得直不起身！
messages.en: That story made Pawlu double up with laughter!

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 真的！他连话都说不出来了。
messages.en: It really did! He couldn't even speak.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 kagħweġ 画一支“原因指向人”的箭头：疼痛或笑料让人扭起来，重点记住“使别人扭动”的动作关系。

gloss_zh: 扭动身体的人；柔术演员

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who writhes or twists their body; also a performer who contorts their body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 扭动或扭曲身体的人；也指以身体弯曲、扭转动作进行表演的柔术演员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li titgħawweġ b'ġisimha; ukoll artist li jgħawweġ ġismu waqt wirja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身体扭动、蜷扭的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħadd li jitgħawweġ b'ġismu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 柔术演员；表演身体弯曲、扭转动作的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Artist li jgħawweġ ġismu f'pożizzjonijiet mhux tas-soltu waqt wirja.

formal.mt: Il-programm jinkludi wirja ta' kagħwiex li jgħawweġ ġismu f'diversi pożizzjonijiet.
formal.en: The programme includes a performance by a contortionist who bends his body into various positions.
formal.zh: 节目安排中包括一位柔术演员的表演，他会将身体弯成各种姿势。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dak ir-raġel fuq il-palk hu kagħwiex? Mark: Iva, ara kif jgħawweġ ġismu!
colloquial.en: Sara: Is that man on stage a contortionist? Mark: Yes, look at how he bends his body!
colloquial.zh: Sara：台上那个男人是柔术演员吗？Mark：是啊，你看他把身体弯成什么样了！

messages.speaker: Sara (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ir-raġel fuq il-palk hu kagħwiex?
messages.mt_standard: Dak ir-raġel fuq il-palk hu kagħwiex?
messages.zh: 台上那个男人是柔术演员吗？
messages.en: Is that man on stage a contortionist?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，你看他把身体弯成什么样了！
messages.en: Yes, look at how he bends his body!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kagħwiex 的词卡画成人形：一个人在蜷扭，另一个在台上做柔术；两个义项都指“人”。

gloss_zh: 使人扭动身体的；令人痛得蜷扭或笑弯腰的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing someone to writhe or twist their body through pain, laughter, or a similar reaction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容使人因疼痛、大笑等反应而扭动或扭曲身体的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitgħawweġ b'ġismu minħabba uġigħ, daħk jew reazzjoni simili.

sense_translations.en_definition: causing writhing (due to pain, laughter etc.)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人因疼痛、大笑等而扭动身体的；令人蜷扭或笑弯腰的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitgħawweġ bl-uġigħ, bid-daħk jew b'reazzjoni simili.

collocations.en: humour that makes someone double up with laughter

formal.mt: Il-pazjent iddeskriva l-uġigħ bħala kagħwiexi, tant li ma setax iżomm ġismu wieqaf.
formal.en: The patient described the pain as making him writhe, to the point that he could not keep his body upright.
formal.zh: 患者形容这种疼痛让他身体蜷扭，甚至无法保持直立。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dak l-umoriżmu kien kagħwiexi; għadni qed nidħak! Ben: Jien ukoll! Kważi waqajt minn fuq is-siġġu bid-daħk.
colloquial.en: Lara: That humour had me doubled up; I'm still laughing! Ben: Me too! I nearly fell off my chair laughing.
colloquial.zh: Lara：那些笑料让我笑弯了腰，我现在还在笑！Ben：我也是！我差点笑得从椅子上掉下来。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak l-umoriżmu kien kagħwiexi; għadni qed nidħak!
messages.mt_standard: Dak l-umoriżmu kien kagħwiexi; għadni qed nidħak!
messages.zh: 那些笑料让我笑弯了腰，我现在还在笑！
messages.en: That humour had me doubled up; I'm still laughing!

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien ukoll! Kważi waqajt minn fuq is-siġġu bid-daħk.
messages.mt_standard: Jien ukoll! Kważi waqajt minn fuq is-siġġu bid-daħk.
messages.zh: 我也是！我差点笑得从椅子上掉下来。
messages.en: Me too! I nearly fell off my chair laughing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kagħwiexi 贴在疼痛和笑料旁边，记作“令人扭起来的”；它描述引发反应的性质，可用于痛或笑的语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cairo, the capital city of Egypt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 开罗，埃及的首都；城市专名。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-belt kapitali tal-Eġittu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开罗，埃及的首都。

formal.mt: Il-Kajr huwa l-belt kapitali tal-Eġittu.
formal.en: Cairo is the capital city of Egypt.
formal.zh: 开罗是埃及的首都。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sejjer għall-vaganza? Mark: Se mmur il-Kajr.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you going on holiday? Mark: I'm going to Cairo.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你要去哪里度假？马克：我要去开罗。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要去开罗。
messages.en: I'm going to Cairo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Kajr 写在开罗的地图标记旁，再用“前往开罗”这个旅行短语反复练习；注意城市专名首字母大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pass faeces; to have a bowel movement, often expressed in familiar or child-directed language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 排出粪便，拉粑粑；常用于日常口语或对儿童说话的场合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ l-ippurgar mill-ġisem; kelma familjari li tintuża wkoll mat-tfal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 排便；大便。
排出粪便。
屎；粑粑，口语中对粪便的称呼。
粪便；排泄物。
排便这一行为。
脏污；污物。

collocations.en: had a bowel movement in the nappy
had a bowel movement in the potty
collocations.zh: 在儿童便盆里拉了粑粑

formal.mt: It-tifel kakka fil-potty, u missieru għenu jitnaddaf.
formal.en: The boy had a bowel movement in the potty, and his father helped him clean himself.
formal.zh: 男孩在儿童便盆里排了便，父亲帮他清洁。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-tarbija kakka? Pawlu: Iva, se nbiddlilha l-ħarqa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has the baby done a poo? Pawlu: Yes, I'm going to change her nappy.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：宝宝拉粑粑了吗？保罗：拉了，我这就给她换尿布。

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.zh: 宝宝拉粑粑了吗？
messages.en: Has the baby done a poo?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 拉了，我这就给她换尿布。
messages.en: Yes, I'm going to change her nappy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用宝宝和便盆的画面记 kakka：作动词是“拉粑粑”，作名词可指“粑粑、排便或脏污”，读句子时先辨认词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who shows off; also used to describe someone who defecates.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人爱炫耀、爱显摆；另可形容排便的人，须根据语境区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiddeskrivi persuna li tħobb tiftaħar; jista' wkoll jiddeskrivi persuna li tagħmel il-kakka.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容爱炫耀、爱显摆的人。
形容排便、拉粑粑的人。

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, ir-raġel kakkaj jitkellem kontinwament dwar il-ġid tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the ostentatious man constantly talks about his wealth.
formal.zh: 故事里，那个爱炫耀的男人不停地谈论自己的财富。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm hu kakkaj! Mark: Iva, dejjem jiftaħar b'dak li għandu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What a show-off he is! Mark: Yes, he's always boasting about what he owns.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他可真爱显摆！马克：是啊，他总是吹嘘自己拥有什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他可真爱显摆！
messages.en: What a show-off he is!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dejjem jiftaħar b'dak li għandu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dejjem jiftaħar b'dak li għandu.
messages.zh: 是啊，他总是吹嘘自己拥有什么。
messages.en: Yes, he's always boasting about what he owns.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 kakkaj 配两张语境卡：一张是不断炫耀的人，另一张是排便的人。两义分开记，实际阅读时用上下文判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cast or let down a fishing net into the water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把渔网撒入或放入水中；通常用于捕鱼的语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitfa' jew iniżżel xibka tas-sajd fl-ilma.

sense_translations.en_definition: to cast (typically used of fishing nets)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 撒下、投放，通常指撒渔网。

collocations.en: cast the nets into the sea

formal.mt: Is-sajjied kala x-xibka fil-baħar u stenna bil-paċenzja.
formal.en: The fisherman cast the net into the sea and waited patiently.
formal.zh: 渔夫把渔网撒入海中，耐心地等待。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ġużeppi diġà kala x-xibka? Pawlu: Iva, issa qed jistenna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has Ġużeppi cast the net already? Pawlu: Yes, he's waiting now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：朱塞佩已经撒网了吗？保罗：是的，他现在正在等。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 朱塞佩已经撒网了吗？
messages.en: Has Ġużeppi cast the net already?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，他现在正在等。
messages.en: Yes, he's waiting now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象渔夫把网撒进海里的动作，把 kala 和 x-xibka 连起来记；这里的“投放”要优先联想到渔网。

gloss_zh: 带坠钩的细钓线；捕鸟细绳

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thin fishing cord fitted with a weight and a hook; also a thin cord used for trapping birds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 装有坠子和鱼钩的细钓线；也指用于捕鸟的细绳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħabel irqiq b'toqol u sunnara għas-sajd; ukoll ħabel irqiq li jintuża għall-insib tal-għasafar.

sense_translations.en_definition: thin weighted cord with a hook used for fishing
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于捕鱼、装有坠子和鱼钩的细钓线。

sense_translations.en_definition: thin cord used for bird trapping
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于捕鸟的细绳。

collocations.en: a fishing cord with a weight and hook
a thin cord for bird trapping

formal.mt: Is-sajjied eżamina l-kalament biex jiżgura li s-sunnara kienet imwaħħla sew.
formal.en: The fisherman examined the fishing cord to make sure the hook was securely attached.
formal.zh: 渔夫检查了细钓线，确认鱼钩已经牢固地系好。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn poġġejt il-kalament tas-sajd? Ġużeppi: Fil-kaxxa, ħdejn ix-xibka.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where did you put the fishing cord? Ġużeppi: In the box, next to the net.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你把那根细钓线放哪儿了？朱塞佩：在箱子里，渔网旁边。

messages.speaker: Mark (钓鱼同伴)
messages.zh: 你把那根细钓线放哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did you put the fishing cord?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (钓鱼同伴)
messages.zh: 在箱子里，渔网旁边。
messages.en: In the box, next to the net.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kalament 画成一根细线：捕鱼义在线上加坠子和鱼钩，捕鸟义则记用途。共同记忆线索是“细绳状的工具”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of casting fishing nets into the water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把渔网撒入水中的动作或一次撒网。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jitfa' jew iniżżel ix-xbieki tas-sajd fl-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 撒网；投放渔网的动作。

collocations.en: the first casting of the nets

formal.mt: Wara l-ewwel kalata tax-xbieki, is-sajjieda stennew fis-skiet.
formal.en: After the first casting of the nets, the fishermen waited in silence.
formal.zh: 第一次撒网后，渔夫们安静地等待。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif marret l-ewwel kalata? Ġużeppi: Tajjeb, qbadna ftit ħut.
colloquial.en: Mark: How did the first cast go? Ġużeppi: Well, we caught a few fish.
colloquial.zh: 马克：第一网撒得怎么样？朱塞佩：不错，我们捞到了几条鱼。

messages.speaker: Mark (捕鱼同伴)
messages.zh: 第一网撒得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the first cast go?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (渔夫)
messages.zh: 不错，我们捞到了几条鱼。
messages.en: Well, we caught a few fish.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kalata 当作能数出来的“一次撒网”来记：第一次、第二次撒网。与 kala 对照练习，一个表示动作，一个是动作的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A weight used with scales, or extra weight, including weight introduced by tampering with scales.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与秤配合使用的重物或附加重量；也可指篡改秤具所造成的额外重量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Toqol użat ma' miżien, jew toqol żejjed, inkluż dak li jirriżulta minn tbagħbis fil-miżien.

sense_translations.en_definition: weight (e.g. used in connection with weighing scales, also to indicate extra weight occurring as a result of tampering with the scales)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 重量或重物，例如与秤配合使用的重物；也指因篡改秤具而产生的额外重量。

collocations.en: a weight associated with the scales

formal.mt: L-ispettur sab kalatura żejda fuq il-miżien li kienet qed tbiddel ir-riżultat tal-użin.
formal.en: The inspector found extra weight on the scales that was altering the weighing result.
formal.zh: 检查员发现秤上有额外重物，影响了称重结果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-miżien qed juri aktar? Mark: Hemm kalatura żejda fuqu; neħħiha u erġa' iżen.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are the scales showing more? Mark: There's extra weight on them; remove it and weigh again.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么秤显示的重量偏大？马克：上面有额外重物；拿掉后再称一次。

messages.speaker: Maja (店员)
messages.zh: 为什么秤显示的重量偏大？
messages.en: Why are the scales showing more?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm kalatura żejda fuqu; neħħiha u erġa' iżen.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm kalatura żejda fuqu; neħħiha u erġa' iżen.
messages.zh: 上面有额外重物；拿掉后再称一次。
messages.en: There's extra weight on them; remove it and weigh again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象秤上多放了一块重物，读数随之改变，用这个画面记 kalatura 的重量义；再用 żejda 提醒自己“额外”的语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The calendar called the Gregorian calendar, used to organize dates into days, months and years.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 称为格里高利历的历法，中文通常称为公历，用于按日、月、年记录日期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kalendarju magħruf bħala l-kalendarju Gregorjan, li jintuża biex jiġu organizzati d-dati fi ġranet, xhur u snin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公历；格里高利历。

collocations.en: a date in the Gregorian calendar

formal.mt: Id-dati kollha f'dan id-dokument huma mogħtija skont il-kalendarju Gregorjan.
formal.en: All dates in this document are given according to the Gregorian calendar.
formal.zh: 本文件中的所有日期均按公历标注。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din id-data hi skont il-kalendarju Gregorjan? Mark: Iva, id-dati kollha fuq din il-lista huma skont dak il-kalendarju.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this date according to the Gregorian calendar? Mark: Yes, all the dates on this list use that calendar.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个日期是按公历写的吗？Mark：是的，这张清单上的所有日期都用这个历法。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Din id-data hi skont il-kalendarju Gregorjan?
messages.mt_standard: Din id-data hi skont il-kalendarju Gregorjan?
messages.zh: 这个日期是按公历写的吗？
messages.en: Is this date according to the Gregorian calendar?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, id-dati kollha fuq din il-lista huma skont dak il-kalendarju.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, id-dati kollha fuq din il-lista huma skont dak il-kalendarju.
messages.zh: 是的，这张清单上的所有日期都用这个历法。
messages.en: Yes, all the dates on this list use that calendar.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语记成一种历法的名称：kalendarju 提示“日历、历法”，Gregorjan 帮你锁定“格里高利历”，中文常说“公历”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The first day of a month, referred to by the term calends.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指一个月的第一天，即月朔；该词对应英语中的 calends。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ewwel jum tax-xahar, imsejjaħ b'dan it-terminu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 月朔，即每月的第一天。

formal.mt: F'dan it-test, l-espressjoni 'il-kalendi ta' Marzu' tirreferi għall-ewwel jum ta' Marzu.
formal.en: In this text, the expression 'the calends of March' refers to the first day of March.
formal.zh: 在本文中，“三月月朔”这一表达指三月的第一天。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'kalendi' f'din is-sentenza? Pawlu: Tfisser l-ewwel jum tax-xahar; hawn qed jitkellmu fuq l-ewwel ta' Marzu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'calends' mean in this sentence? Pawlu: It means the first day of the month; here they are talking about the first of March.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这句话里的 kalendi 是什么意思？Pawlu：指每月的第一天；这里说的是三月一日。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 kalendi 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'calends' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser l-ewwel jum tax-xahar; hawn qed jitkellmu fuq l-ewwel ta' Marzu.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser l-ewwel jum tax-xahar; hawn qed jitkellmu fuq l-ewwel ta' Marzu.
messages.zh: 指每月的第一天；这里说的是三月一日。
messages.en: It means the first day of the month; here they are talking about the first of March.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象月历上只有数字“一”被圈起来：看到 kalendi，就回想“月朔、每月第一天”，不要把它记成整个月。

gloss_zh: 哈里发国；哈里发统治体制

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state or system of rule headed by a caliph.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由哈里发领导的国家或统治体制。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat jew sistema ta' tmexxija mmexxija minn kalif.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 哈里发国；由哈里发领导的统治体制。

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina t-tmexxija tal-kalifat u l-organizzazzjoni tat-territorju tiegħu.
formal.en: The study examines the governance of the caliphate and the organization of its territory.
formal.zh: 该研究考察哈里发国的治理及其领土的组织方式。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kalifat hu l-persuna li tmexxi? Sami: Le, il-persuna hi l-kalif; il-kalifat hu l-istat jew is-sistema li jmexxi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the caliphate the person who rules? Sami: No, the person is the caliph; the caliphate is the state or system he heads.
colloquial.zh: Maja：kalifat 指统治者本人吗？Sami：不是，那个人叫 kalif；kalifat 指他领导的国家或体制。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: kalifat 指统治者本人吗？
messages.en: Is the caliphate the person who rules?

messages.speaker: Sami (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-persuna hi l-kalif; il-kalifat hu l-istat jew is-sistema li jmexxi.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-persuna hi l-kalif; il-kalifat hu l-istat jew is-sistema li jmexxi.
messages.zh: 不是，那个人叫 kalif；kalifat 指他领导的国家或体制。
messages.en: No, the person is the caliph; the caliphate is the state or system he heads.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个统治者和他所领导的国家，给整个国家标上 kalifat；用画面区分“哈里发本人”与“哈里发国或统治体制”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called californium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素锎，英语名称为 californium。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku magħruf bl-isem kalifornju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锎，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juża l-isem kalifornju biex jidentifika l-element kimiku msemmi fit-tabella.
formal.en: The report uses the name californium to identify the chemical element mentioned in the table.
formal.zh: 该报告使用“锎”这一名称来标明表格中提到的化学元素。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu l-kalifornju? Mark: Hu element kimiku. Nina: Mela nniżżlu mal-ismijiet tal-elementi fin-noti tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is californium? Mark: It is a chemical element. Nina: Then I will put it with the element names in my notes.
colloquial.zh: Nina：kalifornju 是什么？Mark：是一种化学元素。Nina：那我把它记在笔记里的元素名称一栏。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: kalifornju 是什么？
messages.en: What is californium?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 是一种化学元素。
messages.en: It is a chemical element.

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nniżżlu mal-ismijiet tal-elementi fin-noti tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nniżżlu mal-ismijiet tal-elementi fin-noti tiegħi.
messages.zh: 那我把它记在笔记里的元素名称一栏。
messages.en: Then I will put it with the element names in my notes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张双语元素卡，一面写 kalifornju，另一面写“锎”；每次翻卡都补说“化学元素”，把词形与类别一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool placed behind the heel to help the foot slide into a shoe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿鞋时放在脚后跟后方、帮助脚滑入鞋内的工具，即鞋拔子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li titqiegħed wara l-għarqub biex tgħin lis-sieq tidħol fiż-żarbun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鞋拔子，辅助脚跟滑入鞋内的穿鞋工具。

collocations.en: a shoehorn with a long handle

formal.mt: Biex tilbes iż-żarbun, poġġi l-kalzatur wara l-għarqub u daħħal sieqek bil-mod.
formal.en: To put on the shoe, place the shoehorn behind your heel and slide your foot in gently.
formal.zh: 穿鞋时，将鞋拔子放在脚后跟后方，再让脚轻轻滑入鞋内。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek kalzatur? Qed insibha bi tqila biex nilbes dan iż-żarbun. Rita: Iva, ħu dan; għandu manku twil.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have a shoehorn? I am finding it hard to put on this shoe. Rita: Yes, take this one; it has a long handle.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你有鞋拔子吗？这只鞋我有点穿不进去。Rita：有，用这个吧；它是长柄的。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek kalzatur? Qed insibha bi tqila biex nilbes dan iż-żarbun.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek kalzatur? Qed insibha bi tqila biex nilbes dan iż-żarbun.
messages.zh: 你有鞋拔子吗？这只鞋我有点穿不进去。
messages.en: Do you have a shoehorn? I am finding it hard to put on this shoe.

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu dan; għandu manku twil.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu dan; għandu manku twil.
messages.zh: 有，用这个吧；它是长柄的。
messages.en: Yes, take this one; it has a long handle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kalzatur 配上“脚跟沿着鞋拔滑进鞋里”的动作画面；记忆重点是辅助穿鞋的小工具，而不是鞋子本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes or sells socks, stockings and similar garments.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制作或销售短袜、长袜等袜类用品的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel jew tbigħ kalzetti u oġġetti simili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 袜商；制作或销售袜类用品的人。

formal.mt: Il-kalzettar għen lill-klijent jagħżel kalzetti tad-daqs it-tajjeb.
formal.en: The hosier helped the customer choose socks of the right size.
formal.zh: 袜商帮助顾客挑选了尺码合适的袜子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Minn fejn xtrajt dawn il-kalzetti? Pawlu: Mingħand il-kalzettar ħdejn il-pjazza. Għandu ħafna daqsijiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did you buy these socks? Pawlu: From the hosier near the square. He has lots of sizes.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这些袜子你在哪里买的？Pawlu：在广场附近的袜商那里。他有很多尺码。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些袜子你在哪里买的？
messages.en: Where did you buy these socks?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mingħand il-kalzettar ħdejn il-pjazza. Għandu ħafna daqsijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Mingħand il-kalzettar ħdejn il-pjazza. Għandu ħafna daqsijiet.
messages.zh: 在广场附近的袜商那里。他有很多尺码。
messages.en: From the hosier near the square. He has lots of sizes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象柜台后有一位帮你挑袜子的人，把 kalzettar 贴在这个人身上；与表示店铺的 kalzetterija 配对，记住“人”和“店”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shop that sells socks, stockings and similar garments.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出售短袜、长袜等袜类用品的店铺。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħanut li jbigħ kalzetti u oġġetti simili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 袜店；经营袜类用品的商店。

formal.mt: Il-kalzetterija turi kalzetti ta' diversi kuluri u daqsijiet fil-vetrina tagħha.
formal.en: The hosiery shop displays socks in various colours and sizes in its window.
formal.zh: 这家袜店在橱窗里陈列着不同颜色和尺码的袜子。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandi bżonn kalzetti ġodda. Fejn nista' nixtri? Maja: Hemm kalzetterija f'din it-triq. Ejja nidħlu naraw x'għandhom.
colloquial.en: Nina: I need new socks. Where can I buy some? Maja: There is a hosiery shop on this street. Let's go in and see what they have.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我需要买新袜子。哪里可以买到？Maja：这条街上有一家袜店。我们进去看看有什么吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi bżonn kalzetti ġodda. Fejn nista' nixtri?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi bżonn kalzetti ġodda. Fejn nista' nixtri?
messages.zh: 我需要买新袜子。哪里可以买到？
messages.en: I need new socks. Where can I buy some?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm kalzetterija f'din it-triq. Ejja nidħlu naraw x'għandhom.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm kalzetterija f'din it-triq. Ejja nidħlu naraw x'għandhom.
messages.zh: 这条街上有一家袜店。我们进去看看有什么吧。
messages.en: There is a hosiery shop on this street. Let's go in and see what they have.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kalzetterija 写在一间摆满袜子的店铺招牌上，再把 kalzettar 写在店员旁边；用同一幅图分清“袜店”和“袜商”。

gloss_zh: 脚覆平滑羽毛的鸽子；脚覆羽毛的燕子

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pigeon whose feet are covered with smooth feathers, or a swallow whose feet are covered with feathers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指脚部覆有平滑羽毛的鸽子，也可指脚部覆有羽毛的燕子；理解时需根据上下文区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħamiema li għandha saqajha miksija b'rix lixx, jew ħuttafa li għandha saqajha miksija bir-rix.

sense_translations.en_definition: pigeon with feet covered with smooth feathers
sense_translations.zh_definition: 脚部覆有平滑羽毛的鸽子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħamiema li għandha saqajha miksija b'rix lixx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脚部覆有羽毛的燕子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħuttafa li għandha saqajha miksija bir-rix.

collocations.en: a pigeon with smooth feathers covering its feet
collocations.zh: 脚部覆有平滑羽毛的鸽子

collocations.en: to describe a feather-footed pigeon or swallow
collocations.zh: 描述脚部覆羽的鸽子或燕子

formal.mt: Fl-ewwel deskrizzjoni, il-kelma kalzettiera tirreferi għal ħamiema b'rix lixx fuq saqajha; fit-tieni waħda tirreferi għal ħuttafa b'saqajha miksija bir-rix.
formal.en: In the first description, kalzettiera refers to a pigeon with smooth feathers on its feet; in the second, it refers to a swallow with feather-covered feet.
formal.zh: 在第一段描述中，kalzettiera 指脚部覆有平滑羽毛的鸽子；在第二段中，它指脚部覆有羽毛的燕子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-kelma 'kalzettiera' dejjem tfisser ħamiema? Pawlu: Le, tista' tfisser ukoll ħuttafa b'saqajha miksija bir-rix. Lara: Mela rrid inħares lejn il-kuntest biex nagħżel it-tifsira.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does the word 'kalzettiera' always mean a pigeon? Pawlu: No, it can also mean a swallow with feather-covered feet. Lara: Then I need to look at the context to choose the meaning.
colloquial.zh: Lara：kalzettiera 这个词总是指鸽子吗？Pawlu：不是，它也可以指脚部覆有羽毛的燕子。Lara：那我得看上下文来判断词义。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: kalzettiera 这个词总是指鸽子吗？
messages.en: Does the word 'kalzettiera' always mean a pigeon?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tista' tfisser ukoll ħuttafa b'saqajha miksija bir-rix.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tista' tfisser ukoll ħuttafa b'saqajha miksija bir-rix.
messages.zh: 不是，它也可以指脚部覆有羽毛的燕子。
messages.en: No, it can also mean a swallow with feather-covered feet.

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela rrid inħares lejn il-kuntest biex nagħżel it-tifsira.
messages.mt_standard: Mela rrid inħares lejn il-kuntest biex nagħżel it-tifsira.
messages.zh: 那我得看上下文来判断词义。
messages.en: Then I need to look at the context to choose the meaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排画一只鸽子和一只燕子，都圈出脚部羽毛；鸽子旁再写“平滑”。把两幅图共同标为 kalzettiera，提醒自己按上下文区分两义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Calcium, a chemical element.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 钙，一种化学元素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element kimiku msejjaħ kalċju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钙，化学元素。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tal-laboratorju jindika l-kontenut ta' kalċju fil-kampjun.
formal.en: The laboratory report indicates the calcium content of the sample.
formal.zh: 实验室报告列明了样品中的钙含量。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ifisser kalċju? Mark: Huwa element kimiku; biċ-Ċiniż jgħidulu gài.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does kalċju mean? Mark: It's a chemical element; in Chinese it's called gài.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：kalċju 是什么意思？马克：它是一种化学元素，中文叫“钙”。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: kalċju 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does kalċju mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa element kimiku; biċ-Ċiniż jgħidulu gài.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa element kimiku; biċ-Ċiniż jgħidulu gài.
messages.zh: 它是一种化学元素，中文叫“钙”。
messages.en: It's a chemical element; in Chinese it's called gài.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kalċju、calcium 和“钙”并排写成一张三语卡，再用“钙含量”短语复习；记住 ċ 上的小点也是拼写的一部分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A reptile that can change its skin colour and has eyes that can move independently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种能改变皮肤颜色、两只眼睛可以独立转动的爬行动物，即变色龙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rettili li jista' jibdel il-kulur tal-ġilda u jċaqlaq għajn waħda indipendentement mill-oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变色龙。

formal.mt: Il-kamaleont jista' jibdel il-kulur tal-ġilda tiegħu.
formal.en: The chameleon can change the colour of its skin.
formal.zh: 变色龙能够改变自身皮肤的颜色。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tara l-kamaleont fuq il-fergħa? Leo: Iva, imma bilkemm jidher bejn il-weraq!
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you see the chameleon on the branch? Leo: Yes, but you can barely see it among the leaves!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看见树枝上的变色龙了吗？利奥：看见了，不过它藏在叶子之间，几乎看不出来！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看见树枝上的变色龙了吗？
messages.en: Can you see the chameleon on the branch?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma bilkemm jidher bejn il-weraq!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma bilkemm jidher bejn il-weraq!
messages.zh: 看见了，不过它藏在叶子之间，几乎看不出来！
messages.en: Yes, but you can barely see it among the leaves!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kamaleont 配上树枝间变色龙的画面，边指动物边读词，用视觉场景记住词义。

gloss_zh: 同宿舍的学生群体；合住住宅楼

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group of students who share a dormitory; also, a tenement building containing homes for several households.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指共住同一宿舍的一群学生；也可指供多户人家居住的合住住宅楼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' studenti li jaqsmu l-istess dormitorju; ukoll, bini maqsum f'abitazzjonijiet għal diversi familji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 共住同一宿舍的学生，作为一个群体而言。
供多户人家居住的合住住宅楼。

collocations.en: the college's group of students sharing a dormitory
collocations.zh: 学院里共住同一宿舍的学生群体

collocations.en: to live in a tenement building

formal.mt: Il-kamerata kienet magħmula minn sitt studenti li kienu jaqsmu l-istess dormitorju.
formal.en: The dormitory group consisted of six students who shared the same dormitory.
formal.zh: 这个同宿舍学生群体由共住同一宿舍的六名学生组成。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn tgħix Sara? Nina: F'kamerata ħdejn il-pjazza; hemm diversi familji fl-istess bini.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where does Sara live? Nina: In a tenement building near the square; several families live in the same building.
colloquial.zh: 马克：萨拉住在哪里？妮娜：住在广场附近的一栋合住住宅楼里；同一栋楼里住着好几户人家。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 萨拉住在哪里？
messages.en: Where does Sara live?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: F'kamerata ħdejn il-pjazza; hemm diversi familji fl-istess bini.
messages.mt_standard: F'kamerata ħdejn il-pjazza; hemm diversi familji fl-istess bini.
messages.zh: 住在广场附近的一栋合住住宅楼里；同一栋楼里住着好几户人家。
messages.en: In a tenement building near the square; several families live in the same building.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张学习卡区分 kamerata：一张画同宿舍的学生，一张画多户合住的楼，分别记住群体义和建筑义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cameroon, a country in Central Africa whose official name is the Republic of Cameroon.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 喀麦隆，位于中非的国家，正式名称为喀麦隆共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Afrika Ċentrali bl-isem uffiċjali Repubblika tal-Kamerun.

sense_translations.en_definition: Cameroon (a country in Central Africa; official name: Repubblika tal-Kamerun)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 喀麦隆，中非国家；正式名称为喀麦隆共和国。

formal.mt: Ir-Repubblika tal-Kamerun tinsab fl-Afrika Ċentrali.
formal.en: The Republic of Cameroon is situated in Central Africa.
formal.zh: 喀麦隆共和国位于中非。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema pajjiż għażilt għall-proġett? Leo: Il-Kamerun. Se nfittxu fuq il-mappa flimkien?
colloquial.en: Maja: Which country did you choose for the project? Leo: Cameroon. Shall we look for it on the map together?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为这个课题选了哪个国家？利奥：喀麦隆。我们一起在地图上找找它，好吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你为这个课题选了哪个国家？
messages.en: Which country did you choose for the project?

messages.speaker: Leo (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-Kamerun. Se nfittxu fuq il-mappa flimkien?
messages.mt_standard: Il-Kamerun. Se nfittxu fuq il-mappa flimkien?
messages.zh: 喀麦隆。我们一起在地图上找找它，好吗？
messages.en: Cameroon. Shall we look for it on the map together?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Kamerun、Cameroon 和中文喀麦隆并排写在中非地图旁，注意马耳他语国名首字母大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A screw used to fasten things, or a screw thread; in another sense, the course or process of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指用于固定物件的螺钉，也可指螺纹；另有事情的发展过程、进程之义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vit li jintuża biex iwaħħal affarijiet, jew il-ħajt spirali ta' vit; f'sens ieħor, il-mixja jew il-proċess ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 事情的发展过程、进程。
螺钉；用于拧入并固定物件的紧固件。
螺纹；供旋合连接的螺旋状纹路。

formal.mt: Qabel tuża s-siġġu, iċċekkja li l-kamin huwa ssikkat sew.
formal.en: Before using the chair, check that the screw is properly tightened.
formal.zh: 使用椅子之前，请检查螺钉是否已拧紧。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex qed jiċċaqlaq dan is-siġġu? Nina: Hemm kamin maħlul. Għaddili t-tornavit, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why is this chair wobbling? Nina: There's a loose screw. Pass me the screwdriver, please.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这把椅子为什么晃来晃去？妮娜：有颗螺钉松了。请把螺丝刀递给我。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 这把椅子为什么晃来晃去？
messages.en: Why is this chair wobbling?

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm kamin maħlul. Għaddili t-tornavit, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm kamin maħlul. Għaddili t-tornavit, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 有颗螺钉松了。请把螺丝刀递给我。
messages.en: There's a loose screw. Pass me the screwdriver, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用拧紧螺钉的动作记住 kamin，再分别标出整颗螺钉和表面螺纹；抽象的进程义另做一张卡。

gloss_zh: 勉强应付；维持生计；渡过难关

teaching_sense.en_definition: To manage with limited resources, get by, or get through a difficult situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在资源有限时勉强应付、维持生活，或设法渡过困难处境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirnexxilu jlaħħaq b'riżorsi limitati, jgħix b'dak li għandu, jew jgħaddi minn sitwazzjoni diffiċli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 勉强应付得来；刚好能够撑住。
靠有限的资源过活；维持生计。

sense_translations.en_definition: to get through a difficult situation
sense_translations.zh_definition: 设法渡过困难处境；熬过难关。

collocations.zh: 靠家人的帮助撑了过来

formal.mt: Matul ix-xhur mingħajr xogħol, Pawlu kampa bit-tfaddil tiegħu u bl-għajnuna tal-familja.
formal.en: During the months without work, Pawlu got by on his savings and with his family's help.
formal.zh: 失业的那几个月里，保罗靠积蓄和家人的帮助维持生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kampa Pawlu sakemm sab xogħol? Leo: Oħtu għenitu, u nefaq biss fuq l-affarijiet meħtieġa.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Pawlu get by until he found work? Leo: His sister helped him, and he spent money only on necessities.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗找到工作之前是怎么撑过来的？利奥：他姐姐帮了他，而且他只花钱买必需品。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kampa Pawlu sakemm sab xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kampa Pawlu sakemm sab xogħol?
messages.zh: 保罗找到工作之前是怎么撑过来的？
messages.en: How did Pawlu get by until he found work?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Oħtu għenitu, u nefaq biss fuq l-affarijiet meħtieġa.
messages.mt_standard: Oħtu għenitu, u nefaq biss fuq l-affarijiet meħtieġa.
messages.zh: 他姐姐帮了他，而且他只花钱买必需品。
messages.en: His sister helped him, and he spent money only on necessities.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象月底预算很紧但仍撑到发薪日，用这个场景记 kampa：能应付、能过活、能渡过难关。

gloss_zh: 与人同住；与人合住一间房

teaching_sense.en_definition: To share a room with someone or live together with another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与另一个人合住一间房，或与某人共同居住。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqsam kamra ma' persuna oħra jew jgħix magħha fl-istess dar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有室友；与另一个人合住一间房。
与某人一起居住。

collocations.en: shared a room or home with a friend

formal.mt: Matul l-ewwel sena tal-istudji tiegħu, Mark kamrad ma' student ieħor biex jaqsmu l-ispejjeż tal-kera.
formal.en: During his first year of study, Mark lived with another student so that they could share the rent.
formal.zh: 在求学的第一年，马克与另一名学生合住，以便分摊房租。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ma' min kamrad Mark meta kien student? Sara: Ma' Pawlu. Kellhom kamra waħda u qasmu l-kera.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who did Mark room with when he was a student? Sara: Pawlu. They had one room and split the rent.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：马克当学生时和谁合住？萨拉：和保罗。他们住同一间房，平摊房租。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma' min kamrad Mark meta kien student?
messages.mt_standard: Ma' min kamrad Mark meta kien student?
messages.zh: 马克当学生时和谁合住？
messages.en: Who did Mark room with when he was a student?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma' Pawlu. Kellhom kamra waħda u qasmu l-kera.
messages.mt_standard: Ma' Pawlu. Kellhom kamra waħda u qasmu l-kera.
messages.zh: 和保罗。他们住同一间房，平摊房租。
messages.en: Pawlu. They had one room and split the rent.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kamrad ma' 和具体人名一起记，想象两人合住房间、平摊房租；这个词表达同住的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A male waiter who takes orders and serves food and drinks to customers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为顾客点餐、端送食物和饮料的男服务员或餐厅侍者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raġel li jieħu l-ordnijiet u jservi ikel u xorb lill-klijenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 男服务员；为顾客提供餐饮服务的侍者。

formal.mt: Il-kamrier ħa l-ordni tal-klijenti u ġabilhom l-ilma qabel l-ikel.
formal.en: The waiter took the customers' order and brought them water before the meal.
formal.zh: 服务员为顾客点了餐，并在上菜前为他们送来了水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nistgħu nitolbu l-kont? Leo: Iva, se nsejjaħ lill-kamrier.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can we ask for the bill? Leo: Yes, I'll call the waiter.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们可以请人拿账单来了吗？利奥：可以，我来叫服务员。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 我们可以请人拿账单来了吗？
messages.en: Can we ask for the bill?

messages.speaker: Leo (同桌顾客)
messages.zh: 可以，我来叫服务员。
messages.en: Yes, I'll call the waiter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象餐厅里拿菜单、送水和递账单的男服务员，把这一组服务动作都贴上 kamrier 标签。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A female hotel worker who cleans guest rooms, makes beds, and replaces bed linen and towels.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责打扫旅馆客房、整理床铺以及更换床单和毛巾的女客房服务员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mara li tnaddaf il-kmamar tal-klijenti f'lukanda, tirranġa s-sodod u tbiddel il-lożor u x-xugamani.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 女客房服务员；负责清洁和整理旅馆客房的女性工作人员。

collocations.en: the chambermaid changes the bed linen
collocations.zh: 女客房服务员更换床单

formal.mt: Il-kamriera naddfet il-kamra u bidlet il-lożor qabel il-wasla tal-klijenti.
formal.en: The chambermaid cleaned the room and changed the bed linen before the guests arrived.
formal.zh: 女客房服务员在客人到达前打扫了房间，并更换了床单。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-kamriera ġabet xugamani nodfa? Mark: Iva, ħalliethom fuq is-sodda dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did the chambermaid bring clean towels? Mark: Yes, she left them on the bed this morning.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：女客房服务员送来干净毛巾了吗？马克：送来了，她今天早上把毛巾放在床上了。

messages.speaker: Sara (住客)
messages.zh: 女客房服务员送来干净毛巾了吗？
messages.en: Did the chambermaid bring clean towels?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行住客)
messages.zh: 送来了，她今天早上把毛巾放在床上了。
messages.en: Yes, she left them on the bed this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用旅馆房间里的床单和毛巾记 kamriera；再与餐厅场景中的 kamrier 对照，分别记牢本组给定的职业义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small room or chamber, especially a room where performers change clothes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小房间，也可指演员等换装使用的更衣室。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kamra żgħira, jew kamra fejn l-atturi jbiddlu ħwejjiġhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小室；面积较小的房间。
更衣室；供演员等换衣服、换装的房间。

formal.mt: Qabel il-wirja, l-atturi biddlu ħwejjiġhom fil-kamrin.
formal.en: Before the performance, the actors changed their clothes in the dressing room.
formal.zh: 演出前，演员们在更衣室里换了衣服。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn nista' nbiddel ħwejġi? Pawlu: Hemm kamrin wara l-palk.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where can I change my clothes? Pawlu: There is a dressing room behind the stage.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我可以在哪里换衣服？Pawlu：舞台后面有一间更衣室。

messages.speaker: Marija (演员)
messages.zh: 我可以在哪里换衣服？
messages.en: Where can I change my clothes?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (舞台工作人员)
messages.zh: 舞台后面有一间更衣室。
messages.en: There is a dressing room behind the stage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kamrin 放进“舞台后的小房间”画面中：先记小室，再联系演员换装的更衣室。

gloss_zh: 船上杂役少年；护圈；垫圈

teaching_sense.en_definition: A boy employed to do small jobs on a ship; also a grommet protecting a hole or a washer used with a screw or bolt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指船上做杂务的少年；也可指保护孔口的护圈，或配合螺钉、螺栓使用的垫圈。具体意义由语境确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tifel li jagħmel xogħlijiet żgħar fuq vapur; ukoll ċirku li jipproteġi toqba jew jitqiegħed ma' vit jew bolt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 船上杂役少年；在船上承担杂务的男孩。
护圈；装在孔口处，用于加固孔口或保护穿过物的环状零件。
垫圈；配合螺钉、螺栓等使用的环状垫片。

collocations.en: a rubber grommet for the hole

formal.mt: L-istruzzjonijiet jgħidu li għandu jitqiegħed kamrot taħt l-iskorfina qabel ma tissikka.
formal.en: The instructions state that a washer should be placed under the nut before it is tightened.
formal.zh: 说明书指出，拧紧螺母之前应在其下面放置一个垫圈。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-kejbil qed jogħrok mat-tarf tat-toqba. Mark: Poġġi kamrot tal-gomma fit-toqba biex tipproteġi l-kejbil.
colloquial.en: Lara: The cable is rubbing against the edge of the hole. Mark: Put a rubber grommet in the hole to protect the cable.
colloquial.zh: Lara：电缆正在摩擦孔口边缘。Mark：在孔口装一个橡胶护圈来保护电缆。

messages.speaker: Lara (维修学徒)
messages.zh: 电缆正在摩擦孔口边缘。
messages.en: The cable is rubbing against the edge of the hole.

messages.speaker: Mark (维修师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġi kamrot tal-gomma fit-toqba biex tipproteġi l-kejbil.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġi kamrot tal-gomma fit-toqba biex tipproteġi l-kejbil.
messages.zh: 在孔口装一个橡胶护圈来保护电缆。
messages.en: Put a rubber grommet in the hole to protect the cable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个场景分开记 kamrot：船上是杂役少年，孔口是护圈，螺母下面是垫圈；不要把三个义项混成一个。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of Canada, a country in North America.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 加拿大的国名，指位于北美洲的国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem ta' pajjiż fl-Amerka ta' Fuq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加拿大，北美洲的一个国家。

formal.mt: Il-Kanada hija pajjiż fl-Amerka ta' Fuq.
formal.en: Canada is a country in North America.
formal.zh: 加拿大是北美洲的一个国家。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn jgħix ħuk? David: Jgħix fil-Kanada, imma ġej iżurna dalwaqt.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where does your brother live? David: He lives in Canada, but he is coming to visit us soon.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你兄弟住在哪里？David：他住在加拿大，不过很快就会来看我们。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟住在哪里？
messages.en: Where does your brother live?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jgħix fil-Kanada, imma ġej iżurna dalwaqt.
messages.mt_standard: Jgħix fil-Kanada, imma ġej iżurna dalwaqt.
messages.zh: 他住在加拿大，不过很快就会来看我们。
messages.en: He lives in Canada, but he is coming to visit us soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: Kanada 与英语 Canada 拼写相近；把首字母 K 和国名大写一起记，再整块记住 fil-Kanada 表示“在加拿大”。

gloss_zh: 挖松树周围的土；挖开树周围的地面

teaching_sense.en_definition: To dig out the soil in the area around a tree.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 挖开或挖松树周围的土壤，动作针对树周围的地面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaffer il-ħamrija ta' madwar siġra.

sense_translations.en_definition: to dig out the area around a tree
sense_translations.zh_definition: 挖开树周围的地面；挖松树周围的土壤。

collocations.en: dug out the area around the tree
dug out the area around the olive tree
collocations.zh: 挖开了橄榄树周围的地面

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar kannak madwar is-siġra u mbagħad saqqa l-ħamrija.
formal.en: The gardener dug out the area around the tree and then watered the soil.
formal.zh: 园丁挖松了树周围的土，然后给土壤浇了水。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'għamel il-ġardinar dalgħodu? Pawlu: Kannak madwar iż-żebbuġa; ara kemm hi maħlula l-ħamrija issa.
colloquial.en: Lina: What did the gardener do this morning? Pawlu: He dug out the area around the olive tree; look how loose the soil is now.
colloquial.zh: Lina：园丁今天早上做了什么？Pawlu：他挖松了橄榄树周围的土；看，现在土多松。

messages.speaker: Lina (屋主)
messages.zh: 园丁今天早上做了什么？
messages.en: What did the gardener do this morning?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Kannak madwar iż-żebbuġa; ara kemm hi maħlula l-ħamrija issa.
messages.mt_standard: Kannak madwar iż-żebbuġa; ara kemm hi maħlula l-ħamrija issa.
messages.zh: 他挖松了橄榄树周围的土；看，现在土多松。
messages.en: He dug out the area around the olive tree; look how loose the soil is now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象园丁绕着树干挖松一圈土，把这个动作标成 kannak；记忆焦点是“树周围的土”，不是把树挖走。

gloss_zh: 可歌唱的；如歌的；如歌的演唱或演奏风格

teaching_sense.en_definition: Suitable for singing; also describing music performed in a flowing, songlike manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 适合歌唱的；也指音乐以流畅、如歌的方式演唱或演奏的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jitkanta; ukoll, li jindaqq jew jitkanta b'mod mexxej bħal għanja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可以唱出来的；适合歌唱的。
如歌的；指具有歌唱般流畅表达的音乐风格。
如歌的演唱或演奏风格。

formal.mt: Il-kompożitur għażel melodija kantabbli biex l-istudenti jkunu jistgħu jkantawha flimkien.
formal.en: The composer chose a singable melody so that the students could sing it together.
formal.zh: 作曲家选用了一段适合歌唱的旋律，让学生们能够一起演唱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-melodija kantabbli? Mark: Iva, ipprova kantaha miegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this melody singable? Mark: Yes, try singing it with me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这段旋律适合唱吗？马克：适合，试着跟我一起唱。

messages.speaker: Maja (音乐学生)
messages.zh: 这段旋律适合唱吗？
messages.en: Is this melody singable?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 适合，试着跟我一起唱。
messages.en: Yes, try singing it with me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上一条流畅的旋律线：能用嘴唱出来是“可歌唱的”，乐器像人声一样流畅表达是“如歌的”；名词义则指这种风格。

gloss_zh: 反复念叨；单调吟唱般的腔调

teaching_sense.en_definition: Repetition of the same words or ideas, or a singsong way of speaking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 同样话语或想法的反复重复，也可指说话时单调、像吟唱一样的腔调。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ripetizzjoni tal-istess kliem jew ideat, jew mod ta' taħdit b'ton li jitla' u jinżel bħal kant.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 重复；同样内容的反复念叨。
单调而有节奏起伏的吟唱声或说话腔调。

formal.mt: Ir-ripetizzjoni tal-istess frażi saret kantaliena li fixklet l-attenzjoni tas-semmiegħa.
formal.en: The repetition of the same phrase became a repetitive refrain that distracted the listeners.
formal.zh: 同一句话不断重复，成了使听众分心的反复念叨。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Reġa' beda bl-istess kantaliena dwar it-temp? Pawlu: Iva, ilu jirrepeti l-istess ħaġa minn filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has he started the same old refrain about the weather again? Pawlu: Yes, he has been repeating the same thing since this morning.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：他又开始反复念叨天气那一套了吗？保罗：是啊，从早上起就一直在重复同一件事。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Reġa' beda bl-istess kantaliena dwar it-temp?
messages.mt_standard: Reġa' beda bl-istess kantaliena dwar it-temp?
messages.zh: 他又开始反复念叨天气那一套了吗？
messages.en: Has he started the same old refrain about the weather again?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ilu jirrepeti l-istess ħaġa minn filgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ilu jirrepeti l-istess ħaġa minn filgħodu.
messages.zh: 是啊，从早上起就一直在重复同一件事。
messages.en: Yes, he has been repeating the same thing since this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一段话被设成循环播放，内容不断重复，声音又像单调的小曲；用这个画面同时记住“反复念叨”和“吟唱腔”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a person who sings, especially as a performer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容从事歌唱或以歌手身份表演的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkanta, speċjalment bħala artist quddiem udjenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 歌唱的；担任歌手的，用来描述演唱者。

formal.mt: L-artist kantant ippreżenta tliet kanzunetti waqt il-kunċert tal-iskola.
formal.en: The singing artist performed three songs during the school concert.
formal.zh: 这位歌唱艺人在学校音乐会上演唱了三首歌曲。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan hu l-attur kantant li rajna lbieraħ? Samwel: Iva, fil-film ikanta wkoll.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this the singing actor we saw yesterday? Samwel: Yes, he sings in the film too.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这就是我们昨天看到的那位兼事歌唱的演员吗？萨姆韦尔：是啊，他在电影里也唱歌。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu l-attur kantant li rajna lbieraħ?
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu l-attur kantant li rajna lbieraħ?
messages.zh: 这就是我们昨天看到的那位兼事歌唱的演员吗？
messages.en: Is this the singing actor we saw yesterday?

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，他在电影里也唱歌。
messages.en: Yes, he sings in the film too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放在 artist kantant 这个短语里记：先看到一位艺人，再给他加上麦克风，表示这位艺人从事歌唱；本条按形容词学习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity or sound of singing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 歌唱这一活动，或演唱时发出的歌声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività tal-kant jew il-ħoss li jsir meta xi ħadd ikanta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 歌唱；演唱活动或歌声。

formal.mt: Il-kantar tal-kor fetaħ iċ-ċerimonja u ġibed l-attenzjoni tal-pubbliku.
formal.en: The choir's singing opened the ceremony and drew the audience's attention.
formal.zh: 合唱团的演唱拉开了典礼的序幕，吸引了观众的注意。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Tisma' dak il-kantar? Ġanni: Iva, il-kor qed jipprova fis-sala.
colloquial.en: Marija: Can you hear that singing? Ġanni: Yes, the choir is rehearsing in the hall.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你听到那阵歌声了吗？詹尼：听到了，合唱团正在大厅里排练。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.zh: 你听到那阵歌声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that singing?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同学)
messages.zh: 听到了，合唱团正在大厅里排练。
messages.en: Yes, the choir is rehearsing in the hall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象站在排练厅门外，只听见歌声：这里指的是“歌唱这件事”或“唱出的声音”，把整个活动当作一个名词来记。

gloss_zh: 叙事歌手；以歌曲讲故事的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A singer who tells stories through the songs they sing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过演唱叙事歌曲来讲述故事的歌手。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tkanta għanjiet li jirrakkontaw stejjer.

sense_translations.en_definition: a singer who sings songs that recount narratives
sense_translations.zh_definition: 演唱叙事歌曲、通过歌曲讲述故事的歌手。

formal.mt: Il-kantastorja rrakkonta l-vjaġġ ta' familja permezz ta' sensiela ta' għanjiet.
formal.en: The narrative singer recounted a family's journey through a series of songs.
formal.zh: 这位叙事歌手通过一系列歌曲讲述了一个家庭的旅程。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'jagħmel kantastorja? Toni: Jirrakkonta stejjer bil-kant; ejja nisimgħu din l-għanja.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does a narrative singer do? Toni: Tells stories through singing; let's listen to this song.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：叙事歌手是做什么的？托尼：用歌唱来讲故事；我们来听听这首歌。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 叙事歌手是做什么的？
messages.en: What does a narrative singer do?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jirrakkonta stejjer bil-kant; ejja nisimgħu din l-għanja.
messages.mt_standard: Jirrakkonta stejjer bil-kant; ejja nisimgħu din l-għanja.
messages.zh: 用歌唱来讲故事；我们来听听这首歌。
messages.en: Tells stories through singing; let's listen to this song.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一位拿着麦克风、身旁展开故事画卷的人：他唱出的每一段都推进故事情节，用“唱着讲故事的人”记住这个职业名词。

gloss_zh: 唱出的；供演唱的乐曲，康塔塔

teaching_sense.en_definition: A musical composition intended to be sung, such as a classical work for a religious service.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人声演唱的音乐作品，例如用于宗教礼仪的古典声乐作品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kompożizzjoni mużikali maħsuba biex titkanta, bħal xogħol klassiku għal funzjoni reliġjuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 唱出的；被演唱的。

sense_translations.en_definition: a composition which is sung (e.g. a classical composition for mass)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 供演唱的音乐作品，例如弥撒中演唱的古典乐曲；康塔塔。

collocations.zh: 供合唱团演唱的康塔塔

formal.mt: Il-programm jinkludi kantata reliġjuża li se titkanta mill-kor tal-knisja.
formal.en: The programme includes a religious cantata that will be sung by the church choir.
formal.zh: 节目包括一部宗教康塔塔，将由教堂合唱团演唱。

colloquial.mt: Elena: X'se tkantaw il-Ħadd? David: Kantata ġdida; qed nippruvawha mal-kor.
colloquial.en: Elena: What will you sing on Sunday? David: A new cantata; we are rehearsing it with the choir.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你们星期日要唱什么？戴维：一部新的康塔塔；我们正在和合唱团一起排练。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们星期日要唱什么？
messages.en: What will you sing on Sunday?

messages.speaker: David (合唱团员)
messages.zh: 一部新的康塔塔；我们正在和合唱团一起排练。
messages.en: A new cantata; we are rehearsing it with the choir.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用中文音译“康塔塔”辅助记音，再想象合唱团翻开一部声乐作品的乐谱；把重点落在“一部供演唱的作品”上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who writes songs and performs them as a singer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 自己创作歌曲并亲自演唱的音乐人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tikteb il-kanzunetti tagħha stess u tkantahom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 创作歌手；既写歌又演唱自己作品的唱作人。

formal.mt: Il-kantawtur ippreżenta album b'kanzunetti li kiteb u kanta hu stess.
formal.en: The singer-songwriter presented an album of songs that he had written and sung himself.
formal.zh: 这位创作歌手推出了一张专辑，其中的歌曲由他本人创作并演唱。

colloquial.mt: Julia: Min kiteb din il-kanzunetta? Ben: L-istess persuna li qed tkantaha; huwa kantawtur.
colloquial.en: Julia: Who wrote this song? Ben: The same person who is singing it; he is a singer-songwriter.
colloquial.zh: 尤莉娅：这首歌是谁写的？本：就是正在唱这首歌的人；他是一位创作歌手。

messages.speaker: Julia (听众)
messages.zh: 这首歌是谁写的？
messages.en: Who wrote this song?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-istess persuna li qed tkantaha; huwa kantawtur.
messages.mt_standard: L-istess persuna li qed tkantaha; huwa kantawtur.
messages.zh: 就是正在唱这首歌的人；他是一位创作歌手。
messages.en: The same person who is singing it; he is a singer-songwriter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一个人一手拿笔写歌、一手拿麦克风演唱；两件事由同一人完成，就记为“创作歌手”，避免只记住演唱这一半。

gloss_zh: 分歌长诗；分为若干诗章的诗作

teaching_sense.en_definition: A poem divided into sections called cantos.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 分成若干“歌”或诗章的诗作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Poeżija maqsuma f'kanti, jiġifieri taqsimiet li flimkien jiffurmaw ix-xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分成若干“歌”（cantos，即诗章）的诗作。

collocations.en: a long poem divided into cantos
the first part of the poem divided into cantos
collocations.zh: 这部分歌诗作的第一部分

formal.mt: L-istudenti analizzaw kif it-taqsimiet tal-kantika jingħaqdu biex jiżviluppaw it-tema ewlenija.
formal.en: The students analysed how the sections of the poem divided into cantos work together to develop its main theme.
formal.zh: 学生们分析了这部分歌诗作的各个诗章如何相互配合，展开其核心主题。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Qrajt il-kantika kollha? Luqa: Għadni le; qrajt l-ewwel parti biss.
colloquial.en: Rita: Have you read the whole poem divided into cantos? Luqa: Not yet; I have only read the first part.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你读完整部按诗章划分的诗作了吗？卢卡：还没有；我只读了第一部分。

messages.speaker: Rita (同学)
messages.zh: 你读完整部按诗章划分的诗作了吗？
messages.en: Have you read the whole poem divided into cantos?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni le; qrajt l-ewwel parti biss.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni le; qrajt l-ewwel parti biss.
messages.zh: 还没有；我只读了第一部分。
messages.en: Not yet; I have only read the first part.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一本诗集中的一部完整诗作，内部插着标有“第一歌、第二歌”的书签；用“整部诗作分成若干歌”这个结构记住词义。

gloss_zh: 颜色渐变；逐渐过渡成另一种颜色

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a colour to shade gradually into another colour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指一种颜色逐渐过渡成另一种颜色，形成渐变。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta kulur jgħaddi gradwalment għal kulur ieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: to shade (used of colours which shade into other colours)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 渐变；指颜色逐渐过渡、融入另一种颜色。

collocations.en: the colour changed gradually into another shade
collocations.zh: 颜色逐渐过渡成了另一色调

formal.mt: Fil-parti ta' fuq tal-pittura, il-blu kanġa gradwalment fil-vjola.
formal.en: In the upper part of the painting, the blue gradually shaded into purple.
formal.zh: 在画作的上部，蓝色逐渐过渡成了紫色。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara kif il-blu kanġa fil-vjola hawn! Toni: Iva, ma tarax linja ċara bejn iż-żewġ kuluri.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look how the blue shaded into purple here! Toni: Yes, you cannot see a clear line between the two colours.
colloquial.zh: Nina：看，这里的蓝色渐变成紫色了！Toni：是啊，两种颜色之间看不到清楚的分界线。

messages.speaker: Nina (绘画学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kif il-blu kanġa fil-vjola hawn!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kif il-blu kanġa fil-vjola hawn!
messages.zh: 看，这里的蓝色渐变成紫色了！
messages.en: Look how the blue shaded into purple here!

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ma tarax linja ċara bejn iż-żewġ kuluri.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ma tarax linja ċara bejn iż-żewġ kuluri.
messages.zh: 是啊，两种颜色之间看不到清楚的分界线。
messages.en: Yes, you cannot see a clear line between the two colours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象画笔把蓝色慢慢推入紫色：kanġa 记的是颜色“渐渐过渡”的动作，可配一条渐变色带帮助记忆。

gloss_zh: 颜色渐变的；色彩逐渐过渡的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having colour that shades gradually into another colour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容颜色逐渐过渡成另一种颜色、呈现渐变效果的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu kulur li jgħaddi gradwalment għal kulur ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 颜色渐变的；一种颜色逐渐过渡成另一种颜色的。
