collocations.en: fabric with colours shading into one another
silk with colours shading into one another

formal.mt: Id-disinjatur għażel drapp kanġakulur li fih il-blu jgħaddi gradwalment għall-aħdar.
formal.en: The designer selected fabric with a colour gradient in which blue gradually shades into green.
formal.zh: 设计师选择了一种渐变布料，其蓝色逐渐过渡为绿色。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Liema drapp tixtieq għall-libsa? Elena: Dak id-drapp kanġakulur; jogħġobni kif il-blu jgħaddi għall-aħdar.
colloquial.en: Marta: Which fabric would you like for the dress? Elena: That fabric with the colour gradient; I like how the blue shades into green.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你想用哪种布料做裙子？Elena：那种渐变布料；我喜欢它从蓝色过渡到绿色的效果。

messages.speaker: Marta (裁缝)
messages.zh: 你想用哪种布料做裙子？
messages.en: Which fabric would you like for the dress?

messages.speaker: Elena (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak id-drapp kanġakulur; jogħġobni kif il-blu jgħaddi għall-aħdar.
messages.mt_standard: Dak id-drapp kanġakulur; jogħġobni kif il-blu jgħaddi għall-aħdar.
messages.zh: 那种渐变布料；我喜欢它从蓝色过渡到绿色的效果。
messages.en: That fabric with the colour gradient; I like how the blue shades into green.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kanġakulur 写在渐变布料图片旁，整组记 drapp kanġakulur；它描述布料“呈渐变色”的性质，是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The storm petrel, the seabird species Hydrobates pelagicus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 欧洲海燕，学名 Hydrobates pelagicus，是一种海鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-baħar tal-ispeċi Hydrobates pelagicus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欧洲海燕，一种海鸟，学名为 Hydrobates pelagicus。

collocations.en: a photograph of a storm petrel

formal.mt: Il-gwida tidentifika l-kanġu ta' Filfla bl-isem xjentifiku Hydrobates pelagicus.
formal.en: The guide identifies the storm petrel by the scientific name Hydrobates pelagicus.
formal.zh: 这本指南用学名 Hydrobates pelagicus 标识欧洲海燕。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan fir-ritratt huwa kanġu ta' Filfla? Ġużeppi: Iva, u l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu huwa Hydrobates pelagicus.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is this bird in the photograph a storm petrel? Ġużeppi: Yes, and its scientific name is Hydrobates pelagicus.
colloquial.zh: Anna：照片里的这只鸟是欧洲海燕吗？Ġużeppi：是的，它的学名是 Hydrobates pelagicus。

messages.speaker: Anna (观鸟初学者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan fir-ritratt huwa kanġu ta' Filfla?
messages.mt_standard: Dan fir-ritratt huwa kanġu ta' Filfla?
messages.zh: 照片里的这只鸟是欧洲海燕吗？
messages.en: Is this bird in the photograph a storm petrel?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (观鸟向导)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu huwa Hydrobates pelagicus.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu huwa Hydrobates pelagicus.
messages.zh: 是的，它的学名是 Hydrobates pelagicus。
messages.en: Yes, and its scientific name is Hydrobates pelagicus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作三栏识鸟卡：kanġu ta' Filfla、欧洲海燕、Hydrobates pelagicus；把整个马耳他语名称作为一个词组记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Leach's Storm Petrel, the seabird species given here as Oceanodroma leucorhoa.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 白腰叉尾海燕，英语称 Leach's Storm Petrel，此处所列学名为 Oceanodroma leucorhoa。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-baħar magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala Leach's Storm Petrel, bl-isem xjentifiku mogħti hawn Oceanodroma leucorhoa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 白腰叉尾海燕，英语称 Leach's Storm Petrel，所列学名为 Oceanodroma leucorhoa。

collocations.en: a photograph of a Leach's Storm Petrel
collocations.zh: 一张白腰叉尾海燕的照片

collocations.en: a sighting of a Leach's Storm Petrel
collocations.zh: 一次白腰叉尾海燕的目击记录

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, il-kanġu tal-Atlantiku jidher taħt l-isem xjentifiku Oceanodroma leucorhoa.
formal.en: In the report, Leach's Storm Petrel appears under the scientific name Oceanodroma leucorhoa.
formal.zh: 在这份报告中，白腰叉尾海燕以学名 Oceanodroma leucorhoa 列出。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kif jissejjaħ il-kanġu tal-Atlantiku bl-Ingliż? Simon: Leach's Storm Petrel; hekk miktub fil-gwida.
colloquial.en: Rita: What is kanġu tal-Atlantiku called in English? Simon: Leach's Storm Petrel; that is what the guide says.
colloquial.zh: Rita：kanġu tal-Atlantiku 用英语怎么说？Simon：Leach's Storm Petrel；指南上就是这样写的。

messages.speaker: Rita (观鸟爱好者)
messages.zh: kanġu tal-Atlantiku 用英语怎么说？
messages.en: What is kanġu tal-Atlantiku called in English?

messages.speaker: Simon (观鸟同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Leach's Storm Petrel; hekk miktub fil-gwida.
messages.mt_standard: Leach's Storm Petrel; hekk miktub fil-gwida.
messages.zh: Leach's Storm Petrel；指南上就是这样写的。
messages.en: Leach's Storm Petrel; that is what the guide says.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kanġu tal-Atlantiku 与 Leach's Storm Petrel、白腰叉尾海燕写在同一张卡上；重点记完整名称，避免与 kanġu ta' Filfla 混淆。

gloss_zh: Picridium vulgare，一种常拌沙拉或煮食的植物

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plant of the species Picridium vulgare, often eaten in salads or boiled.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物种 Picridium vulgare 的植物，常用于沙拉或煮后食用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-ispeċi Picridium vulgare, li spiss tittiekel fl-insalata jew mgħollija.

sense_translations.en_definition: member of the species Picridium vulgare, often eaten in salads or boiled
sense_translations.zh_definition: Picridium vulgare 这一物种的植物，常用于沙拉或煮后食用。

collocations.zh: 加入 Picridium vulgare 的沙拉

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi l-kaċċalepri bħala pjanta tal-ispeċi Picridium vulgare, li spiss tittiekel fl-insalata jew mgħollija.
formal.en: The text describes kaċċalepri as a plant of the species Picridium vulgare, often eaten in salads or boiled.
formal.zh: 文中将 kaċċalepri 描述为 Picridium vulgare 这一物种的植物，常用于沙拉或煮后食用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'hemm f'din l-insalata? Lino: Hemm il-kaċċalepri. Maja: U jista' jittiekel mgħolli wkoll? Lino: Iva, jittiekel mgħolli wkoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's in this salad? Lino: It has Picridium vulgare in it. Maja: Can it be eaten boiled too? Lino: Yes, it can also be eaten boiled.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这份沙拉里有什么？利诺：有 Picridium vulgare。玛雅：它也能煮着吃吗？利诺：对，也能煮着吃。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这份沙拉里有什么？
messages.en: What's in this salad?

messages.speaker: Lino (朋友)
messages.zh: 有 Picridium vulgare。
messages.en: It has Picridium vulgare in it.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 它也能煮着吃吗？
messages.en: Can it be eaten boiled too?

messages.speaker: Lino (朋友)
messages.zh: 对，也能煮着吃。
messages.en: Yes, it can also be eaten boiled.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词卡分成两个餐盘画面：一盘沙拉，一盘煮菜；两盘都标上 Picridium vulgare，帮助记住植物名称及食用语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To search for and pursue animals in order to catch or kill them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为捕获或猎杀动物而寻找并追逐它们。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fittex u segwa annimali biex jaqbadhom jew joqtolhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狩猎；为捕获或猎杀动物而进行追寻。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel kaċċaċ fil-bosk għal sigħat u mbagħad mar lura d-dar.
formal.en: In the account, the man hunted in the woods for hours and then returned home.
formal.zh: 记述中，男子在树林里打了几个小时的猎，然后回了家。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'għamel il-karattru f'dan il-kapitlu? Ben: Kaċċaċ fil-bosk, imbagħad mar lura lejn ir-raħal.
colloquial.en: Sara: What did the character do in this chapter? Ben: He hunted in the woods, then went back towards the village.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这一章里那个人物做了什么？本：他在树林里打猎，然后往村子走回去。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 这一章里那个人物做了什么？
messages.en: What did the character do in this chapter?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kaċċaċ fil-bosk, imbagħad mar lura lejn ir-raħal.
messages.mt_standard: Kaċċaċ fil-bosk, imbagħad mar lura lejn ir-raħal.
messages.zh: 他在树林里打猎，然后往村子走回去。
messages.en: He hunted in the woods, then went back towards the village.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个动词配上寻找并追踪猎物的动作画面，再用“在树林里打猎”这一整块表达帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sand with a greenish colour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 颜色略带绿色的沙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ramel li għandu lewn ħadrani.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 带绿色的沙；颜色略微发绿的沙。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ramel ta' lewn ħadrani.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 杜鹃；布谷鸟。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għasfur magħruf ukoll bħala l-kukku.

collocations.en: the colour of the greenish sand

formal.mt: Fil-katalgu, il-kampjun huwa deskritt bħala kaħla, jiġifieri ramel ta' lewn ħadrani.
formal.en: In the catalogue, the sample is described as kaħla, meaning greenish sand.
formal.zh: 目录将这份样本描述为 kaħla，即颜色略带绿色的沙。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'inhi dik il-kaħla fl-istampa? Ben: Hawnhekk tfisser l-għasfur, il-kukku. Anna: Mela hawn mhux qed nitkellmu fuq ir-ramel.
colloquial.en: Anna: What's that kaħla in the picture? Ben: Here it means the bird, the cuckoo. Anna: So here we're not talking about sand.
colloquial.zh: Anna：图片里的 kaħla 是什么？Ben：这里指的是鸟，也就是杜鹃。Anna：这么说，这里讲的不是沙。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 图片里的 kaħla 是什么？
messages.en: What's that kaħla in the picture?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 这里指的是鸟，也就是杜鹃。
messages.en: Here it means the bird, the cuckoo.

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela hawn mhux qed nitkellmu fuq ir-ramel.
messages.mt_standard: Mela hawn mhux qed nitkellmu fuq ir-ramel.
messages.zh: 这么说，这里讲的不是沙。
messages.en: So here we're not talking about sand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 kaħla 做两张同字词卡：一张画绿沙，一张画杜鹃；看到采样语境想到沙，看到鸟鸣语境想到鸟。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A species of fish known in English as the saddled seabream.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种鱼，英语称为 saddled seabream，属于鲷鱼类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' ħuta magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala saddled seabream.

sense_translations.en_definition: obrade or saddled seabream (a species of fish)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种鲷鱼，英语称为 obrade 或 saddled seabream。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Speċi ta' ħuta msejħa obrade jew saddled seabream bl-Ingliż.

formal.mt: Fil-lista tal-ħut għall-bejgħ, il-kaħlija hija offruta friska u tinbiegħ bil-piż.
formal.en: On the list of fish for sale, saddled seabream is offered fresh and sold by weight.
formal.zh: 售鱼清单列有新鲜的这种鲷鱼，按重量出售。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dik kaħlija? Rita: Iva, friska. Trid waħda? Mark: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Se nsajjarha llejla.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is that a saddled seabream? Rita: Yes, a fresh one. Would you like one? Mark: Yes, please. I'll cook it tonight.
colloquial.zh: Mark：那是 kaħlija 这种鲷鱼吗？Rita：是的，很新鲜。你要一条吗？Mark：要，谢谢。我今晚做来吃。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 那是 kaħlija 这种鲷鱼吗？
messages.en: Is that a saddled seabream?

messages.speaker: Rita (鱼贩)
messages.zh: 是的，很新鲜。你要一条吗？
messages.en: Yes, a fresh one. Would you like one?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Se nsajjarha llejla.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Se nsajjarha llejla.
messages.zh: 要，谢谢。我今晚做来吃。
messages.en: Yes, please. I'll cook it tonight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kaħlija 放进“鱼摊买鱼”的记忆场景，连着记 kaħlija friska，再配上“一条新鲜鲷鱼”的画面。

gloss_zh: 倾向于抹灰的；爱给墙面抹灰的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to plaster or to apply plaster to surfaces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有给墙面等表面抹灰的倾向的；爱进行抹灰工作的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jkaħħal il-ħitan jew uċuħ oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于抹灰的；爱给墙面等表面抹灰的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jkaħħal.

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem hu kaħħali u jippreferi jkaħħal il-ħitan li għadhom mikxufin.
formal.en: The worker is inclined to plaster and prefers to plaster walls that are still bare.
formal.zh: 这名工人喜欢做抹灰工作，偏爱给尚未覆盖的墙面抹灰。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Pawlu tassew kaħħali; dejjem ikun irid jkaħħal xi ħajt. Ġużeppi: Iva, malli jara ħajt mikxuf, jibda jippjana kif se jkaħħlu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Pawlu really likes plastering; he's always wanting to plaster a wall. Ġużeppi: Yes, as soon as he sees a bare wall, he starts planning how to plaster it.
colloquial.zh: Marija：Pawlu 真爱抹灰，总想着找面墙来抹。Ġużeppi：是啊，他一看见裸露的墙面，就开始盘算怎么给它抹灰。

messages.speaker: Marija (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu tassew kaħħali; dejjem ikun irid jkaħħal xi ħajt.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu tassew kaħħali; dejjem ikun irid jkaħħal xi ħajt.
messages.zh: Pawlu 真爱抹灰，总想着找面墙来抹。
messages.en: Pawlu really likes plastering; he's always wanting to plaster a wall.

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, malli jara ħajt mikxuf, jibda jippjana kif se jkaħħlu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, malli jara ħajt mikxuf, jibda jippjana kif se jkaħħlu.
messages.zh: 是啊，他一看见裸露的墙面，就开始盘算怎么给它抹灰。
messages.en: Yes, as soon as he sees a bare wall, he starts planning how to plaster it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人见到裸墙就想拿抹刀：kaħħali 描述“倾向于抹灰”的特点，不必把它记成职业名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To breathe or take a breath.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进行呼吸，或吸入一口气；ħa nifs 这一形式可表示已经吸了一口气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħa l-arja fil-pulmuni; għamel att ta' teħid tan-nifs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呼吸；吸气。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Daħħal l-arja fil-pulmuni u ħariġha.

formal.mt: Qabel beda d-diskors tiegħu, l-istudent ħa nifs fil-fond u ħares lejn l-udjenza.
formal.en: Before beginning his speech, the student took a deep breath and looked at the audience.
formal.zh: 开始演讲前，学生深吸了一口气，然后望向听众。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ħadt nifs daqshekk fil-fond? Toni: Kont nervuż qabel ma bdejt nitkellem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you take such a deep breath? Toni: I was nervous before I started speaking.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么吸了那么深的一口气？Toni：我开口说话前有点紧张。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么吸了那么深的一口气？
messages.en: Why did you take such a deep breath?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont nervuż qabel ma bdejt nitkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Kont nervuż qabel ma bdejt nitkellem.
messages.zh: 我开口说话前有点紧张。
messages.en: I was nervous before I started speaking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħa nifs 整体连到“上台前吸一口气”的画面，再搭配 fil-fond 记住“深吸一口气”。

gloss_zh: 坐着挪动；用臀部蹭着前移

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move along while sitting, shuffling on one's bottom.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 保持坐姿，用臀部在地面等表面上蹭着挪动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimxi minn post għal ieħor waqt li jibqa' bilqiegħda u jiżżerżaq fuq il-warrani.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坐着用臀部蹭动、挪行。

collocations.en: shuffled on his bottom towards the toy

formal.mt: It-tifel baqa' bilqiegħda u ħaba fuq il-warrani lejn il-ġugarell.
formal.en: The boy remained seated and shuffled on his bottom towards the toy.
formal.zh: 男孩保持坐姿，用臀部蹭着向玩具挪去。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif wasal ħdejn il-ballun? Marija: Ħaba fuq il-warrani sa hemm u qabdu.
colloquial.en: Anna: How did he get to the ball? Marija: He shuffled there on his bottom and picked it up.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：他怎么到球旁边去的？玛丽亚：他坐着蹭到了那里，然后把球拿起来了。

messages.speaker: Anna (姨妈)
messages.zh: 他怎么到球旁边去的？
messages.en: How did he get to the ball?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħaba fuq il-warrani sa hemm u qabdu.
messages.mt_standard: Ħaba fuq il-warrani sa hemm u qabdu.
messages.zh: 他坐着蹭到了那里，然后把球拿起来了。
messages.en: He shuffled there on his bottom and picked it up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象孩子坐在地上，屁股一挪一挪地靠近玩具，用这段动作画面记住 ħaba。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The opening in the centre of the eye through which light enters.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 眼睛中央让光线进入的开口，即瞳孔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fetħa fiċ-ċentru tal-għajn li minnha jidħol id-dawl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 瞳孔，眼睛中央让光线进入的开口。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fetħa fiċ-ċentru tal-għajn li minnha jgħaddi d-dawl.

formal.mt: Il-ħabba tal-għajn titwessa' meta jkun hemm ftit dawl u tidjieq meta d-dawl ikun qawwi.
formal.en: The pupil dilates when there is little light and constricts when the light is bright.
formal.zh: 光线较暗时瞳孔扩大，光线强烈时瞳孔缩小。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-ħabba tal-għajn tidher ikbar fid-dlam? Luka: Għax titwessa' biex jidħol aktar dawl.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why does the pupil look bigger in the dark? Luka: Because it dilates to let in more light.
colloquial.zh: Sara：为什么瞳孔在黑暗中看起来更大？Luka：因为它会扩大，让更多光线进入。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-ħabba tal-għajn tidher ikbar fid-dlam?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-ħabba tal-għajn tidher ikbar fid-dlam?
messages.zh: 为什么瞳孔在黑暗中看起来更大？
messages.en: Why does the pupil look bigger in the dark?

messages.speaker: Luka (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax titwessa' biex jidħol aktar dawl.
messages.mt_standard: Għax titwessa' biex jidħol aktar dawl.
messages.zh: 因为它会扩大，让更多光线进入。
messages.en: Because it dilates to let in more light.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看着镜子里眼睛中央的小黑圆，把整个词组与“瞳孔”绑定；再用暗处变大、亮处变小的画面帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the duty or task of making an announcement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负有发布通知或宣布某件事情的职责或任务的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu d-dmir jew il-kompitu li jħabbar xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 须作出宣布的；负有发布通知任务的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu jagħmel avviż jew iħabbar xi ħaġa.

collocations.en: an official tasked with making an announcement
a spokesperson who has an announcement to make
collocations.zh: 负有宣布任务的发言人

formal.mt: L-uffiċjal ħabbari għandu jħabbar id-deċiżjoni qabel tibda l-laqgħa.
formal.en: The official tasked with making the announcement must announce the decision before the meeting begins.
formal.zh: 负责宣布消息的官员须在会议开始前宣布决定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int ħabbari llum? Mark: Iva, irrid inħabbar il-ħin tal-laqgħa lill-grupp.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you the one who has to make the announcement today? Mark: Yes, I have to announce the meeting time to the group.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今天由你负责宣布消息吗？Mark：是的，我得向大家宣布开会时间。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 今天由你负责宣布消息吗？
messages.en: Are you the one who has to make the announcement today?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irrid inħabbar il-ħin tal-laqgħa lill-grupp.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irrid inħabbar il-ħin tal-laqgħa lill-grupp.
messages.zh: 是的，我得向大家宣布开会时间。
messages.en: Yes, I have to announce the meeting time to the group.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个拿着通知单、轮到他向全体宣布消息的人；把这个词记作描述“负有宣布任务”的形容词。

gloss_zh: 爱恋者；热爱者；藏东西的人；爱藏东西的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who loves someone or has a strong love for something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 爱恋某个人，或热爱某种事物的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħobb lil xi ħadd jew li għandha mħabba kbira għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱恋者；情人；热爱某种事物的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tħobb lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把东西藏起来的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li taħbi l-affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱藏东西的；用来形容把东西藏起来的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jaħbi l-affarijiet.

formal.mt: Bħala ħabbej tal-poeżija, Pawlu jattendi regolarment għal-laqgħat tal-qari.
formal.en: As a lover of poetry, Pawlu regularly attends reading meetings.
formal.zh: 作为诗歌爱好者，Pawlu 经常参加读诗聚会。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn poġġejt iċ-ċwievet? Int tassew ħabbej! Ben: Ħbejthom fil-kexxun biex ma jintilfux.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you put the keys? You really are someone who hides things! Ben: I hid them in the drawer so they wouldn't get lost.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你把钥匙放哪儿了？你真是个爱藏东西的人！Ben：我把它们藏在抽屉里，免得弄丢。

messages.speaker: Maja (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn poġġejt iċ-ċwievet? Int tassew ħabbej!
messages.mt_standard: Fejn poġġejt iċ-ċwievet? Int tassew ħabbej!
messages.zh: 你把钥匙放哪儿了？你真是个爱藏东西的人！
messages.en: Where did you put the keys? You really are someone who hides things!

messages.speaker: Ben (弟弟)
messages.zh: 我把它们藏在抽屉里，免得弄丢。
messages.en: I hid them in the drawer so they wouldn't get lost.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两张独立词义卡：一张是捧着诗集的热爱者，一张是把钥匙藏进抽屉的人；后一个意思还可作形容词，不能把两义混成一个解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put someone in prison or keep someone imprisoned.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某人关进监狱，或使其处于被监禁的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daħħal lil xi ħadd il-ħabs jew żammu hemm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 监禁；把某人关进监狱。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Daħħal jew żamm lil xi ħadd il-ħabs.

formal.mt: Skont ir-rakkont, il-ħakem ħabbes lir-raġel għal sena.
formal.en: According to the account, the ruler imprisoned the man for a year.
formal.zh: 据这段记述，统治者将那名男子监禁了一年。

colloquial.mt: Luka: Għaliex il-ħakem ħabbes lir-raġel fl-istorja? Sara: Għax ir-raġel kien għenu lill-għadu jaħrab.
colloquial.en: Luka: Why did the ruler imprison the man in the story? Sara: Because the man had helped the enemy escape.
colloquial.zh: Luka：故事里的统治者为什么把那个男子关进监狱？Sara：因为那个男子曾帮助敌人逃走。

messages.speaker: Luka (同学)
messages.zh: 故事里的统治者为什么把那个男子关进监狱？
messages.en: Why did the ruler imprison the man in the story?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ir-raġel kien għenu lill-għadu jaħrab.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ir-raġel kien għenu lill-għadu jaħrab.
messages.zh: 因为那个男子曾帮助敌人逃走。
messages.en: Because the man had helped the enemy escape.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象故事中的人物被押进牢房、铁门随后关上；用这个动作画面记住它是表示“监禁”的动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who helps other people become friends or develop friendship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过自己的行动，帮助他人建立或增进友谊的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taħdem biex tnissel il-ħbiberija bejn nies oħra.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who acts to instil friendship among others
sense_translations.zh_definition: 采取行动促使他人建立友谊的人；促进他人友好相处的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li taġixxi biex toħloq il-ħbiberija bejn ħaddieħor.

collocations.en: a person who fosters friendship among neighbours
a person who fosters friendship in the community
collocations.zh: 在社区中促成友谊的人

formal.mt: Pawlu huwa ħabbieb fil-komunità: ilaqqa' lill-ġirien u jgħinhom isiru jafu lil xulxin.
formal.en: Pawlu fosters friendship in the community: he brings neighbours together and helps them get to know one another.
formal.zh: Pawlu 是社区中促成友谊的人：他召集邻居相聚，帮助他们彼此认识。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark dejjem jistedinna niltaqgħu ma' nies ġodda. Sara: Veru ħabbieb! Bis-saħħa tiegħu sirna ħbieb ilkoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark always invites us to meet new people. Sara: He really brings people together as friends! Thanks to him, we've all become friends.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 总是邀请我们去认识新朋友。Sara：他真会帮大家建立友谊！多亏他，我们都成了朋友。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark dejjem jistedinna niltaqgħu ma' nies ġodda.
messages.mt_standard: Mark dejjem jistedinna niltaqgħu ma' nies ġodda.
messages.zh: Mark 总是邀请我们去认识新朋友。
messages.en: Mark always invites us to meet new people.

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru ħabbieb! Bis-saħħa tiegħu sirna ħbieb ilkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Veru ħabbieb! Bis-saħħa tiegħu sirna ħbieb ilkoll.
messages.zh: 他真会帮大家建立友谊！多亏他，我们都成了朋友。
messages.en: He really brings people together as friends! Thanks to him, we've all become friends.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位邻居把原本不认识的人请到同一张餐桌旁，让大家成为朋友；记忆重点是“帮助别人建立友谊的人”。

gloss_zh: 制绳者；制造混乱者；使人怀孕者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes ropes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以制作绳索为工作或从事制绳活动的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel il-ħbula.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 制绳者；制作绳索的工匠。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel il-ħbula.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 制造混乱的人；把事情搅乱的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li toħloq il-kaos jew il-konfużjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使他人怀孕的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd joħroġ tqila.

collocations.mt: ħabbiel li ġiegħel mara toħroġ tqila
collocations.en: a person who made a woman pregnant

formal.mt: Il-ħabbiel tas-sengħa wera lill-istudenti kif jagħmel ħabel b'saħħtu.
formal.en: The skilled rope-maker showed the students how he makes a strong rope.
formal.zh: 技艺娴熟的制绳工匠向学生展示了他如何制作结实的绳索。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kulħadd kien jaf x'għandu jagħmel sakemm wasal Ben. Maja: Dak ħabbiel! Biddel il-pjan u ħoloq konfużjoni sħiħa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Everyone knew what to do until Ben arrived. Maja: He's a troublemaker! He changed the plan and caused complete confusion.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Ben 来之前，大家都知道该做什么。Maja：他就是个制造混乱的人！他改了计划，把事情全搅乱了。

messages.speaker: Sara (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kulħadd kien jaf x'għandu jagħmel sakemm wasal Ben.
messages.mt_standard: Kulħadd kien jaf x'għandu jagħmel sakemm wasal Ben.
messages.zh: Ben 来之前，大家都知道该做什么。
messages.en: Everyone knew what to do until Ben arrived.

messages.speaker: Maja (活动志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ħabbiel! Biddel il-pjan u ħoloq konfużjoni sħiħa.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ħabbiel! Biddel il-pjan u ħoloq konfużjoni sħiħa.
messages.zh: 他就是个制造混乱的人！他改了计划，把事情全搅乱了。
messages.en: He's a troublemaker! He changed the plan and caused complete confusion.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个名词义分成三格：工匠制作绳索、有人搅乱计划、有人使他人怀孕；每次先看语境，再选择对应的一格，不用一个画面硬推全部词义。

gloss_zh: 令人困惑的；有使对方怀孕倾向的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Difficult to understand or likely to cause confusion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 难以理解、容易使人弄不清楚的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li diffiċli tifhmu jew li joħloq konfużjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人困惑的；使人混淆的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li joħloq konfużjoni jew jagħmilha diffiċli li wieħed jifhem.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the tendency to cause impregnation
sense_translations.zh_definition: 有使对方怀孕倾向的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd joħroġ tqila.

collocations.zh: 让人摸不着头脑的练习

collocations.en: a man with a tendency to make a partner pregnant
collocations.zh: 有使伴侣怀孕倾向的男子

formal.mt: Dan it-test huwa ħabbieli għax juża l-istess kelma għal żewġ ideat differenti mingħajr ma jispjega d-differenza.
formal.en: This text is confusing because it uses the same word for two different ideas without explaining the difference.
formal.zh: 这篇文本令人困惑，因为它用同一个词表达两个不同的概念，却没有解释两者的区别。

colloquial.mt: Luka: Dan l-eżerċizzju ħabbieli wisq għalija. Sara: Ejja naqraw l-ewwel mistoqsija flimkien.
colloquial.en: Luka: This exercise is too confusing for me. Sara: Let's read the first question together.
colloquial.zh: Luka：这道练习太让人摸不着头脑了。Sara：我们一起读第一道题吧。

messages.speaker: Luka (同学)
messages.zh: 这道练习太让人摸不着头脑了。
messages.en: This exercise is too confusing for me.

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 我们一起读第一道题吧。
messages.en: Let's read the first question together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“读完题目满头问号”的画面记住常用教学义“令人困惑的”；另设一张生育语境卡记录第二义，避免把两个形容词义混用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose work is to guard prisoners in a prison.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在监狱中负责看守囚犯的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li tgħasses lill-priġunieri fil-ħabs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狱卒；负责看守囚犯的监狱看守。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tgħasses lill-priġunieri fil-ħabs.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ħabbies fetaħ iċ-ċella u għadd il-priġunieri qabel ma ħarġu fil-bitħa.
formal.en: In the account, the jailer opened the cell and counted the prisoners before they went out into the yard.
formal.zh: 在这段记述中，狱卒打开牢房，在囚犯走到院子里之前清点了人数。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak bir-ringiela ċwievet fil-film? Mark: Dak il-ħabbies; xogħlu hu li jgħasses lill-priġunieri.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who's the person with the bunch of keys in the film? Mark: That's the jailer; his job is to guard the prisoners.
colloquial.zh: Maja：电影里那个拿着一串钥匙的人是谁？Mark：那是狱卒，他的工作是看守囚犯。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak bir-ringiela ċwievet fil-film?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak bir-ringiela ċwievet fil-film?
messages.zh: 电影里那个拿着一串钥匙的人是谁？
messages.en: Who's the person with the bunch of keys in the film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-ħabbies; xogħlu hu li jgħasses lill-priġunieri.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-ħabbies; xogħlu hu li jgħasses lill-priġunieri.
messages.zh: 那是狱卒，他的工作是看守囚犯。
messages.en: That's the jailer; his job is to guard the prisoners.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象电影中拿着一串牢房钥匙、站在铁门旁看守囚犯的人；把这个人物与“狱卒”对应，记住这里是人的名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to bake or to engage in baking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于烘焙、喜欢进行烘焙的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandhom tendenza jaħmu jew iħobbu jagħmlu xogħol tal-ħami.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于烘焙的；爱烘焙的。
使人退缩或退出的。

formal.mt: Il-kors huwa maħsub għal nies ħabbieżi li jixtiequ jitgħallmu jagħmlu tipi differenti ta' ħobż.
formal.en: The course is intended for people inclined to bake who want to learn to make different kinds of bread.
formal.zh: 本课程面向爱烘焙、希望学习制作不同种类面包的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Sħabek huma ħabbieżi? Mark: Iva, kull tmiem il-ġimgħa jagħmlu xi ħobż jew kejk.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do your friends like baking? Mark: Yes, every weekend they make some bread or a cake.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的朋友们喜欢烘焙吗？马克：喜欢，他们每个周末都会做些面包或蛋糕。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的朋友们喜欢烘焙吗？
messages.en: Do your friends like baking?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kull tmiem il-ġimgħa jagħmlu xi ħobż jew kejk.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kull tmiem il-ġimgħa jagħmlu xi ħobż jew kejk.
messages.zh: 喜欢，他们每个周末都会做些面包或蛋糕。
messages.en: Yes, every weekend they make some bread or a cake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把这个词与周末主动做面包的人联系起来，记住“爱烘焙的”；另一个“引起退缩的”义项分开记忆，靠上下文辨别。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of hiding oneself or keeping something from being seen or known.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把自己或某物藏起来，或使某件事不被看见、知晓的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jinħeba jew iżomm xi ħaġa milli tidher jew tkun magħrufa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 躲藏；把自己或某物藏起来的行为。
隐瞒；使某物或某事不被发现、看见或知晓。

formal.mt: Il-ħabi tal-verità għamel l-investigazzjoni aktar diffiċli.
formal.en: The concealment of the truth made the investigation more difficult.
formal.zh: 对真相的隐瞒使调查更加困难。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan post tajjeb għall-ħabi? Mark: Iva, minn wara dak il-ħajt ħadd ma jarak.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this a good place to hide? Mark: Yes, behind that wall nobody can see you.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里适合躲藏吗？马克：适合，躲在那堵墙后面就没人看见你了。

messages.speaker: Maja (玩伴)
messages.zh: 这里适合躲藏吗？
messages.en: Is this a good place to hide?

messages.speaker: Mark (玩伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, minn wara dak il-ħajt ħadd ma jarak.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, minn wara dak il-ħajt ħadd ma jarak.
messages.zh: 适合，躲在那堵墙后面就没人看见你了。
messages.en: Yes, behind that wall nobody can see you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面一起记：人躲到墙后是“躲藏”，真相被遮住是“隐瞒”；共同点都是让人看不见或不知道。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A particular act or episode of hiding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某一次具体的躲藏或藏匿行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att wieħed jew episodju partikolari ta' ħabi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次躲藏或藏匿。

collocations.en: an episode of hiding behind the door
an episode of hiding during play

formal.mt: Il-ħabja tat-tifel wara l-bieb damet biss ftit sekondi.
formal.en: The boy's hiding behind the door lasted only a few seconds.
formal.zh: 男孩在门后的这次躲藏只持续了几秒钟。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif marret il-ħabja wara l-bieb? Mark: Ma tantx marret tajjeb; sabuni mill-ewwel!
colloquial.en: Maja: How did hiding behind the door go? Mark: Not very well; they found me straight away!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：刚才躲在门后怎么样？马克：不太成功，他们一下子就找到我了！

messages.speaker: Maja (玩伴)
messages.zh: 刚才躲在门后怎么样？
messages.en: How did hiding behind the door go?

messages.speaker: Mark (玩伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma tantx marret tajjeb; sabuni mill-ewwel!
messages.mt_standard: Ma tantx marret tajjeb; sabuni mill-ewwel!
messages.zh: 不太成功，他们一下子就找到我了！
messages.en: Not very well; they found me straight away!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上一张“刚才躲在门后”的照片，重点记住它指一次具体的躲藏经历，而不是只背抽象的隐藏概念。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Working carefully and persistently with diligence and effort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做事认真、持续投入努力，表现出勤奋勤勉的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaħdem b'ħeġġa, b'attenzjoni u bi sforz kontinwu.

sense_translations.en_definition: diligent; working with diligence and effort
sense_translations.zh_definition: 勤奋的；做事勤勉并付出努力的。

formal.mt: L-istudent ħabriek ħejja r-riċerka tiegħu b'attenzjoni u temmha fil-ħin.
formal.en: The diligent student prepared his research carefully and completed it on time.
formal.zh: 这名勤奋的学生认真准备了自己的研究，并按时完成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħuk tassew ħabriek! Mark: Iva, jistudja kuljum u dejjem jagħmel ix-xogħol tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Your brother is really diligent! Mark: Yes, he studies every day and always does his work.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你兄弟真勤奋！马克：是啊，他每天都学习，而且总会完成自己的功课。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟真勤奋！
messages.en: Your brother is really diligent!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jistudja kuljum u dejjem jagħmel ix-xogħol tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jistudja kuljum u dejjem jagħmel ix-xogħol tiegħu.
messages.zh: 是啊，他每天都学习，而且总会完成自己的功课。
messages.en: Yes, he studies every day and always does his work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一名每天认真完成作业的学生，用“这个人很勤奋”来记住形容词 ħabriek，重点放在人的做事态度上。

gloss_zh: 勤勉的工作；高效的工作

teaching_sense.en_definition: Work carried out with diligence and effort, or work performed efficiently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以勤勉和努力完成的工作，或高效开展的工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xogħol magħmul b'ħeġġa u bi sforz, jew xogħol imwettaq b'mod effiċjenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 勤勉的工作；付出认真努力的劳动。
高效的工作；有效率地开展的劳动。

formal.mt: Il-ħabrik kontinwu tat-tim wassal għat-tlestija tal-proġett fil-ħin.
formal.en: The team's continuous diligent work led to the project being completed on time.
formal.zh: 团队持续的勤勉工作使项目得以按时完成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm sar sabiħ il-ġnien! Mark: Iva, dan kollu frott il-ħabrik ta' missieri.
colloquial.en: Maja: The garden has become so beautiful! Mark: Yes, all this is the result of my father's diligent work.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：花园变得真漂亮！马克：是啊，这全是我父亲辛勤劳作的成果。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 花园变得真漂亮！
messages.en: The garden has become so beautiful!

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dan kollu frott il-ħabrik ta' missieri.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dan kollu frott il-ħabrik ta' missieri.
messages.zh: 是啊，这全是我父亲辛勤劳作的成果。
messages.en: Yes, all this is the result of my father's diligent work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħabrik 记成花园背后那一份辛勤劳动：ħabriek 描写人勤奋，ħabrik 则用名词说这份勤勉或高效的工作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be present at a wedding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 到场参加婚礼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun preżenti għal tieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出席婚礼；到场参加婚礼。

formal.mt: Ir-rappreżentant tal-familja ħadar għat-tieġ u feraħ lill-koppja.
formal.en: The family representative attended the wedding and congratulated the couple.
formal.zh: 这位家庭代表出席了婚礼，并向新人表示祝贺。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark ħadar għat-tieġ ta' oħtok? Lara: Iva, ġie mal-familja tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark attend your sister's wedding? Lara: Yes, he came with his family.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克参加你姐妹的婚礼了吗？拉拉：参加了，他和家人一起来的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克参加你姐妹的婚礼了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark attend your sister's wedding?

messages.speaker: Lara (新人的姐妹)
messages.zh: 参加了，他和家人一起来的。
messages.en: Yes, he came with his family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħadar 与婚礼宾客签到的画面绑定，整组记住 ħadar għat-tieġ“他出席了婚礼”，突出婚礼这一具体场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Expressing or involving an embrace.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现出拥抱动作或包含拥抱的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jesprimi jew jinvolvi tgħanniqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拥抱的；作出拥抱动作的。

formal.mt: B'ġest ħaddani, l-omm fetħet dirgħajha biex tilqa' lil binha.
formal.en: With an embracing gesture, the mother opened her arms to welcome her son.
formal.zh: 母亲作出拥抱的姿态，张开双臂迎接儿子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt il-ġest ħaddani tiegħu? Mark: Iva, fetaħ dirgħajh u ta tgħanniqa lil ħuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see his embracing gesture? Mark: Yes, he opened his arms and gave his brother a hug.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到他那个拥抱的姿态了吗？马克：看到了，他张开双臂，抱了抱自己的兄弟。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到他那个拥抱的姿态了吗？
messages.en: Did you see his embracing gesture?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fetaħ dirgħajh u ta tgħanniqa lil ħuh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fetaħ dirgħajh u ta tgħanniqa lil ħuh.
messages.zh: 看到了，他张开双臂，抱了抱自己的兄弟。
messages.en: Yes, he opened his arms and gave his brother a hug.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 ħaddani，就想象双臂张开准备拥抱的姿态；搭配 ġest“姿态”一起记，明确这里用形容词描写拥抱动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Green and rich in vegetation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 草木繁茂、呈现青翠绿色的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Aħdar u mimli ħdura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 青翠的；草木繁茂的。

sense_translations.en_definition: having the propensity to make things go green
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有使事物变绿的倾向或作用的。

formal.mt: Wara x-xita, il-wied ħaddari offra dehra sabiħa lill-viżitaturi.
formal.en: After the rain, the verdant valley offered visitors a beautiful view.
formal.zh: 雨后，青翠的山谷为游客呈现了美丽的景色。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm hu ħaddari dan il-wied! Mark: Iva, wara x-xita l-ħaxix kiber kullimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: This valley is so green! Mark: Yes, after the rain the grass grew everywhere.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个山谷真青翠！马克：是啊，下雨之后，到处都长出了青草。

messages.speaker: Maja (同行的朋友)
messages.zh: 这个山谷真青翠！
messages.en: This valley is so green!

messages.speaker: Mark (同行的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, wara x-xita l-ħaxix kiber kullimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, wara x-xita l-ħaxix kiber kullimkien.
messages.zh: 是啊，下雨之后，到处都长出了青草。
messages.en: Yes, after the rain the grass grew everywhere.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用雨后满山青草记住“青翠的”；再画一个让物体变绿的箭头，单独提示另一义项“具有使事物变绿的作用”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To get someone to speak or express themselves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人开口说话，或引导对方表达自己的想法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitkellem jew jesprimi ruħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人说话；促使某人开口。

formal.mt: L-għalliem ħaddet lit-tifel b'mistoqsija sempliċi dwar il-logħba favorita tiegħu.
formal.en: The teacher got the boy to speak by asking a simple question about his favourite game.
formal.zh: 老师问了一个关于男孩最喜欢的游戏的简单问题，使他开口说话。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ħaddet lil Mark? Kien kwiet ħafna. Lara: Jien. Staqsejtu dwar il-kelb tiegħu, u beda jitkellem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who got Mark talking? He was very quiet. Lara: I did. I asked him about his dog, and he started talking.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁让马克开口了？他刚才一直很安静。拉拉：是我。我问起他的狗，他就开始说话了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min ħaddet lil Mark? Kien kwiet ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Min ħaddet lil Mark? Kien kwiet ħafna.
messages.zh: 谁让马克开口了？他刚才一直很安静。
messages.en: Who got Mark talking? He was very quiet.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Staqsejtu dwar il-kelb tiegħu, u beda jitkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Staqsejtu dwar il-kelb tiegħu, u beda jitkellem.
messages.zh: 是我。我问起他的狗，他就开始说话了。
messages.en: I did. I asked him about his dog, and he started talking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师抛出一个简单问题，让沉默的孩子开口；把 ħaddet 记成“让别人说起来”的动作。

gloss_zh: 致麻痹或使不能活动之物

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that causes paralysis or makes movement impossible.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 引起麻痹、瘫痪或使人无法活动的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tikkawża paraliżi jew iżżomm lil xi ħadd milli jiċċaqlaq.

sense_translations.en_definition: sth. that causes paralysis or immobility
sense_translations.zh_definition: 引起麻痹、瘫痪或无法活动的东西。

collocations.en: a powerful agent that causes paralysis
the effect of something that causes paralysis

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, il-velenu jaġixxi bħala ħaddiel u jħalli lill-karattru bla ħila jiċċaqlaq.
formal.en: In the story, the poison acts as a paralysing agent and leaves the character unable to move.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这种毒物起到致麻痹物的作用，使人物无法动弹。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu l-ħaddiel f'din il-ġrajja? Mark: Huwa l-velenu li jżomm lill-karattru milli jiċċaqlaq.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is the paralysing agent in this story? Mark: It is the poison that stops the character from moving.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个故事里的致麻痹物是什么？马克：就是让人物无法动弹的那种毒物。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 这个故事里的致麻痹物是什么？
messages.en: What is the paralysing agent in this story?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa l-velenu li jżomm lill-karattru milli jiċċaqlaq.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa l-velenu li jżomm lill-karattru milli jiċċaqlaq.
messages.zh: 就是让人物无法动弹的那种毒物。
messages.en: It is the poison that stops the character from moving.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用故事画面记忆：人物受到某物影响后动弹不得；ħaddiel 指造成这种状态的东西。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An electric ray, also called a torpedo ray or cramp fish.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 电鳐，一种鱼；本词也对应英语名称 torpedo ray 和 cramp fish。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħuta magħrufa bħala raja elettrika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电鳐。
电鳐；英语也称 torpedo ray。
电鳐；英语别称 cramp fish。

collocations.en: a picture of an electric ray
an electric ray in the sea

formal.mt: L-istudent għażel stampa ta' ħaddiela għall-preżentazzjoni tiegħu dwar il-ħut.
formal.en: The student chose a picture of an electric ray for his presentation about fish.
formal.zh: 这名学生为自己的鱼类主题报告选了一张电鳐的图片。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jisimha din il-ħuta fl-istampa? Mark: Dik ħaddiela. Bl-Ingliż tissejjaħ electric ray.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this fish in the picture called? Mark: That is a ħaddiela. In English, it is called an electric ray.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：图片里的这条鱼叫什么？马克：那是 ħaddiela，也就是电鳐，英语叫 electric ray。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 图片里的这条鱼叫什么？
messages.en: What is this fish in the picture called?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik ħaddiela. Bl-Ingliż tissejjaħ electric ray.
messages.mt_standard: Dik ħaddiela. Bl-Ingliż tissejjaħ electric ray.
messages.zh: 那是 ħaddiela，也就是电鳐，英语叫 electric ray。
messages.en: That is a ħaddiela. In English, it is called an electric ray.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张电鳐图片卡，正面写 ħaddiela，背面列出三个英语名称，记住它们都指这类鱼。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Making someone feel sleepy or drowsy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人产生困意、感到昏昏欲睡的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħoss in-ngħas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人困倦的；引起睡意的。

collocations.en: a sound that makes one drowsy

formal.mt: Il-ħoss ripetut kellu effett ħaddieli fuq is-semmiegħ.
formal.en: The repetitive sound had a drowsiness-inducing effect on the listener.
formal.zh: 重复的声音使听者产生了困意。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-ħoss ħaddieli; qed inħoss in-ngħas. Maja: Trid nitfi r-radju? Nistgħu nitkellmu ftit.
colloquial.en: Lara: This sound makes me drowsy; I am getting sleepy. Maja: Shall I turn off the radio? We can talk for a bit.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这声音让人昏昏欲睡，我开始困了。玛雅：要我关掉收音机吗？我们可以聊一会儿。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ħoss ħaddieli; qed inħoss in-ngħas.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ħoss ħaddieli; qed inħoss in-ngħas.
messages.zh: 这声音让人昏昏欲睡，我开始困了。
messages.en: This sound makes me drowsy; I am getting sleepy.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid nitfi r-radju? Nistgħu nitkellmu ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Trid nitfi r-radju? Nistgħu nitkellmu ftit.
messages.zh: 要我关掉收音机吗？我们可以聊一会儿。
messages.en: Shall I turn off the radio? We can talk for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象单调声音让眼皮越来越沉；ħaddieli 描述引起困意的声音或效果，重点是“使人困”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A party or celebration held for a wedding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为庆祝婚礼而举行的聚会或宴会。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Festa jew laqgħa biex jiġi ċċelebrat tieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 婚礼庆祝聚会；婚宴。

collocations.en: the guests at the wedding party

formal.mt: Il-ħadra saret wara ċ-ċerimonja, u l-mistednin inġabru biex jiċċelebraw mal-koppja.
formal.en: The wedding party took place after the ceremony, and the guests gathered to celebrate with the couple.
formal.zh: 婚礼仪式结束后举行了庆祝聚会，宾客们齐聚一堂，与新人共同庆祝。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Se tmur għall-ħadra wara t-tieġ? Lara: Iva, se mmur mal-familja tiegħi. Niltaqgħu hemm.
colloquial.en: Mark: Are you going to the wedding party after the wedding? Lara: Yes, I am going with my family. See you there.
colloquial.zh: 马克：婚礼后你会去参加庆祝聚会吗？拉拉：会，我和家人一起去。到时那里见。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 婚礼后你会去参加庆祝聚会吗？
messages.en: Are you going to the wedding party after the wedding?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se mmur mal-familja tiegħi. Niltaqgħu hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se mmur mal-familja tiegħi. Niltaqgħu hemm.
messages.zh: 会，我和家人一起去。到时那里见。
messages.en: Yes, I am going with my family. See you there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħadra 放进“新人、宾客、婚礼庆祝”的画面中记忆，看到这个名词就想到婚礼后的热闹聚会。

gloss_zh: 小香蒲；海面下的礁石；空的；中空的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plant called lesser reed-mace or small bulrush; in a separate noun sense, a rock below the surface of the sea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种称为小香蒲或小型蒲草的植物；另一个独立名词义指海面以下的礁石。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala lesser reed-mace jew small bulrush; f'tifsira oħra bħala nom, blata taħt wiċċ il-baħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小香蒲，一种植物。
小型蒲草。

sense_translations.en_definition: a rock below the surface of the sea
sense_translations.zh_definition: 位于海面以下的礁石；暗礁。
空的；里面没有东西的。
中空的；内部有空腔的。

collocations.en: a rock below the surface of the sea

formal.mt: L-istudent pinġa l-pjanta tal-ħafa u kiteb isimha taħt l-istampa.
formal.en: The student drew the lesser reed-mace plant and wrote its name below the picture.
formal.zh: 这名学生画了小香蒲，并在图画下方写上了它的名称。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Attent, hemm ħafa taħt l-ilma quddiem id-dgħajsa. Mark: Rajtha. Se ngħaddu min-naħa l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Careful, there is a submerged rock in front of the boat. Mark: I have seen it. We will go around the other side.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：小心，船前面的水下有块礁石。马克：我看到了。我们从另一侧绕过去。

messages.speaker: Maja (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Attent, hemm ħafa taħt l-ilma quddiem id-dgħajsa.
messages.mt_standard: Attent, hemm ħafa taħt l-ilma quddiem id-dgħajsa.
messages.zh: 小心，船前面的水下有块礁石。
messages.en: Careful, there is a submerged rock in front of the boat.

messages.speaker: Mark (船夫)
messages.zh: 我看到了。我们从另一侧绕过去。
messages.en: I have seen it. We will go around the other side.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ħafa 做三格记忆卡：植物、海下礁石、空或中空的物体；先看词性和语境，再选择对应义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take hold of something, grasp it, or seize it firmly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用手抓住、握住或一把攫住某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqbad jew iżomm xi ħaġa sew b'idu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抓住；用手握住。
握紧；抓牢。
一把抓住；攫住。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ħafen il-ħabel biż-żewġ idejn biex iżommu sod.
formal.en: The worker grasped the rope with both hands to hold it firmly.
formal.zh: 工人用双手抓住绳子，将它牢牢握住。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajtu kif ħafen il-ħabel? Mark: Iva, qabdu biż-żewġ idejn u żammu sew.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see how he grasped the rope? Mark: Yes, he took hold of it with both hands and held it firmly.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看到他怎么抓住绳子了吗？马克：看到了，他用双手抓住，握得很牢。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到他怎么抓住绳子了吗？
messages.en: Did you see how he grasped the rope?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qabdu biż-żewġ idejn u żammu sew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qabdu biż-żewġ idejn u żammu sew.
messages.zh: 看到了，他用双手抓住，握得很牢。
messages.en: Yes, he took hold of it with both hands and held it firmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读到 ħafen 时做一个伸手抓牢绳子的动作，把“抓住、握紧、一把攫住”连成同一个动作画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something lighter by reducing its weight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 减少某物的重量，使它变轻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inaqqas il-piż ta' xi ħaġa biex jagħmilha eħfef.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 减轻重量；使变轻。

collocations.en: reduced the weight of the bag

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ħaff it-tagħbija billi neħħa żewġ kaxxi qabel it-trasport.
formal.en: The worker lightened the load by removing two boxes before transport.
formal.zh: 工人在运输前取下两个箱子，减轻了载荷。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ħaff din il-borża? Issa faċli nġorrha. Mark: Jien. Neħħejt il-kotba li m'għandniex bżonn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who lightened this bag? It is easy to carry now. Mark: I did. I took out the books we do not need.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁把这个袋子弄轻了？现在拿起来很轻松。马克：是我。我把我们不需要的书拿出来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Min ħaff din il-borża? Issa faċli nġorrha.
messages.mt_standard: Min ħaff din il-borża? Issa faċli nġorrha.
messages.zh: 谁把这个袋子弄轻了？现在拿起来很轻松。
messages.en: Who lightened this bag? It is easy to carry now.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Neħħejt il-kotba li m'għandniex bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Neħħejt il-kotba li m'għandniex bżonn.
messages.zh: 是我。我把我们不需要的书拿出来了。
messages.en: I did. I took out the books we do not need.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象从沉重的袋子里拿出几本书，提起来立刻轻松；用这个前后对比记住 ħaff 的“减轻重量”。

gloss_zh: 减轻；加快；赶快；加速办理；使更容易

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something lighter, faster, or easier, or to hurry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 减轻某物的重量，加快动作或事情的进展，使事情更容易，或赶快行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inaqqas il-piż ta' xi ħaġa, iżid il-ħeffa, jagħmel xi ħaġa aktar faċli, jew jagħmel għaġla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 减轻重量；使某物变轻。
加快；使动作或进程变得更快。
赶快；抓紧行动。
加速办理事情；推动事务尽快完成。
使某事更容易；减轻完成某事的难度。

formal.mt: L-uffiċċju ħaffef il-proċess biex l-applikazzjonijiet jiġu approvati qabel.
formal.en: The office expedited the process so that the applications could be approved sooner.
formal.zh: 办事处加快了流程，以便更早批准申请。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħaffef, inkella nitilfu l-karozza tal-linja! Mark: Ġej, għandi biss nieħu l-basket.
colloquial.en: Maja: Hurry up, or we'll miss the bus! Mark: I'm coming; I just need to get the bag.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：快点，不然我们要赶不上公交车了！马克：来了，我只要拿一下包。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 快点，不然我们要赶不上公交车了！
messages.en: Hurry up, or we'll miss the bus!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 来了，我只要拿一下包。
messages.en: I'm coming; I just need to get the bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象先把背包减轻，再加快脚步赶车，用同一幅画面串起减轻、加快和赶快三个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes something lighter by reducing its weight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过减少重量而使某物变轻的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tnaqqas il-piż ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 减轻重量的人；使某物变轻的人。

collocations.en: a person who lightens the load
a person who reduces the weight of luggage

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, il-ħaffief tat-tagħbija neħħa l-materjal żejjed biex inaqqas il-piż totali.
formal.en: In this example, the person lightening the load removed excess material to reduce the total weight.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，负责减轻负载的人移除了多余材料，以降低总重量。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jiġifieri ħaffief? Pawlu: Xi ħadd li jnaqqas il-piż, bħal meta tneħħi affarijiet żejda minn bagalja.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does ħaffief mean? Pawlu: Someone who reduces weight, as when you remove unnecessary things from a suitcase.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：ħaffief 是什么意思？保罗：就是减轻重量的人，比如从行李箱里拿掉多余东西的人。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: ħaffief 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does ħaffief mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd li jnaqqas il-piż, bħal meta tneħħi affarijiet żejda minn bagalja.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd li jnaqqas il-piż, bħal meta tneħħi affarijiet żejda minn bagalja.
messages.zh: 就是减轻重量的人，比如从行李箱里拿掉多余东西的人。
messages.en: Someone who reduces weight, as when you remove unnecessary things from a suitcase.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面定格在行李秤旁：有人不断拿出多余物品，让重量下降，这个人就是本词所指。

gloss_zh: 有促进作用的；有助于事情进行的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Helping an action or process happen more easily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够帮助某个动作或过程更容易进行的；具有便利或促进作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jgħin biex azzjoni jew proċess isir aktar faċli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有促进或便利作用的；能使事情更容易进行的。

collocations.zh: 起便利或促进作用的角色

formal.mt: L-użu ta' eżempji ċari għandu effett ħaffiefi fuq il-fehim ta' kunċetti ġodda.
formal.en: Using clear examples has a facilitatory effect on understanding new concepts.
formal.zh: 使用清晰的例子有助于理解新概念。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'ifisser effett ħaffiefi? David: Ifisser li jgħinek tagħmel xi ħaġa aktar faċilment, bħal stampa li tgħinek tifhem spjegazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does a facilitatory effect mean? David: It means that it helps you do something more easily, like a picture that helps you understand an explanation.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：促进作用是什么意思？戴维：就是帮助你更容易完成某件事，比如一幅帮助你理解讲解的图片。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 促进作用是什么意思？
messages.en: What does a facilitatory effect mean?

messages.speaker: David (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li jgħinek tagħmel xi ħaġa aktar faċilment, bħal stampa li tgħinek tifhem spjegazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li jgħinek tagħmel xi ħaġa aktar faċilment, bħal stampa li tgħinek tifhem spjegazzjoni.
messages.zh: 就是帮助你更容易完成某件事，比如一幅帮助你理解讲解的图片。
messages.en: It means that it helps you do something more easily, like a picture that helps you understand an explanation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一道难题旁边添上清楚的示意图，理解立刻容易了；用这个辅助画面记住促进作用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who digs, for example to make a hole or trench.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从事挖掘的人，例如挖坑或挖沟的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħaffer, pereżempju biex tagħmel ħofra jew trinka.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挖掘的人；进行挖土等挖掘活动的人。
挖掘者；挖土工。

formal.mt: Il-ħaffier ħaffer trinka tul il-ġnien biex jitqiegħed pajp ġdid tal-ilma.
formal.en: The digger dug a trench along the garden so that a new water pipe could be laid.
formal.zh: 挖土工沿着花园挖了一条沟，以便铺设新的水管。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min se jħaffer il-ħofra għas-siġra? Toni: Ġej ħaffier għada filgħodu; għandu l-għodda kollha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who will dig the hole for the tree? Toni: A digger is coming tomorrow morning; he has all the tools.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁来挖种树的坑？托尼：明天早上会来一位挖土工，他带齐了工具。

messages.speaker: Sara (园主)
messages.zh: 谁来挖种树的坑？
messages.en: Who will dig the hole for the tree?

messages.speaker: Toni (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġej ħaffier għada filgħodu; għandu l-għodda kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Ġej ħaffier għada filgħodu; għandu l-għodda kollha.
messages.zh: 明天早上会来一位挖土工，他带齐了工具。
messages.en: A digger is coming tomorrow morning; he has all the tools.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个拿铁锹的人站在刚挖好的沟旁，把人物与挖掘动作连在一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 有挖掘倾向的；爱挖洞的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to dig, as an animal that often digs holes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有挖掘倾向的，例如经常挖洞的动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jħaffer, bħal annimal li spiss jagħmel ħofor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有挖掘倾向的；习惯或喜欢挖洞的。

collocations.en: a dog with a tendency to dig
an animal with a tendency to dig

formal.mt: Dan il-kelb huwa ħaffieri u spiss jagħmel ħofor fil-ħamrija tal-ġnien.
formal.en: This dog has a tendency to dig and often makes holes in the garden soil.
formal.zh: 这只狗有挖掘的习性，经常在花园的泥土里挖洞。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm daqshekk ħofor fil-ġnien? Luqa: Il-kelb tagħna ħaffieri; kull darba li joħroġ jibda jħaffer.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are there so many holes in the garden? Luqa: Our dog loves digging; every time he goes outside, he starts to dig.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：花园里怎么有这么多洞？卢卡：我们家的狗爱挖洞，每次一出去就开始挖。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 花园里怎么有这么多洞？
messages.en: Why are there so many holes in the garden?

messages.speaker: Luqa (狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kelb tagħna ħaffieri; kull darba li joħroġ jibda jħaffer.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kelb tagħna ħaffieri; kull darba li joħroġ jibda jħaffer.
messages.zh: 我们家的狗爱挖洞，每次一出去就开始挖。
messages.en: Our dog loves digging; every time he goes outside, he starts to dig.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小狗每天把花园挖出新洞，用反复发生的习惯记住这是描述挖掘倾向的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very light in weight, like a feather.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 重量非常轻的；轻得像羽毛一样的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħafif ħafna fil-piż, bħal rixa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常轻的；轻如羽毛的。

formal.mt: Il-pakkett kien ħafif rix u seta' jinġarr faċilment b'id waħda.
formal.en: The parcel was feather-light and could easily be carried with one hand.
formal.zh: 这个包裹轻如羽毛，用一只手就能轻松提起。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tridni ngħinek iġġorr il-basket? Lara: Le, grazzi, ħafif rix; fih biss xalpa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Would you like me to help you carry the bag? Lara: No, thanks, it's feather-light; there's only a scarf in it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：要我帮你提包吗？拉拉：不用，谢谢，它轻得很，里面只有一条围巾。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 要我帮你提包吗？
messages.en: Would you like me to help you carry the bag?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, grazzi, ħafif rix; fih biss xalpa.
messages.mt_standard: Le, grazzi, ħafif rix; fih biss xalpa.
messages.zh: 不用，谢谢，它轻得很，里面只有一条围巾。
messages.en: No, thanks, it's feather-light; there's only a scarf in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手中的包裹像羽毛一样几乎没有重量，把整个短语与轻如羽毛的画面一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: On many occasions, or frequently as a habit or recurring event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在许多次场合发生；也表示某事经常、频繁地发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'ħafna okkażjonijiet, jew ta' spiss bħala drawwa jew ġrajja li tirrepeti ruħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 许多次；在多个不同场合。
经常；频繁地。

formal.mt: L-istudenti jużaw il-librerija ħafna drabi biex jistudjaw u jissellfu l-kotba.
formal.en: The students often use the library to study and borrow books.
formal.zh: 学生们经常使用图书馆学习和借书。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ġieli mort f'dan il-kafetterija? Pawlu: Iva, mort ħafna drabi; ħafna drabi nieħu kafè hemm qabel ix-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you ever been to this café? Pawlu: Yes, I've been many times; I often have coffee there before work.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你去过这家咖啡馆吗？保罗：去过很多次，我经常上班前在那里喝咖啡。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你去过这家咖啡馆吗？
messages.en: Have you ever been to this café?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, mort ħafna drabi; ħafna drabi nieħu kafè hemm qabel ix-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, mort ħafna drabi; ħafna drabi nieħu kafè hemm qabel ix-xogħol.
messages.zh: 去过很多次，我经常上班前在那里喝咖啡。
messages.en: Yes, I've been many times; I often have coffee there before work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历上许多日期都画着同一家咖啡馆：数起来是许多次，看习惯就是经常。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Forgiveness for a wrong or mistake, involving a willingness to stop blaming the person responsible.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对他人过错或错误的原谅与宽恕，包含愿意不再责怪对方的态度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Maħfra għal żball jew għemil ħażin, bir-rieda li wieħed ma jibqax iwaħħal fil-persuna li għamlitu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原谅；宽恕；对他人过错的谅解。

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, talab ħafrien għall-iżball li għamel u wiegħed li ma jirrepetihx.
formal.en: In his letter, he asked for forgiveness for the mistake he had made and promised not to repeat it.
formal.zh: 他在信中为自己犯下的错误请求原谅，并承诺不再重犯。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Qed nitolbok ħafrien talli ksirt it-tazza tiegħek. Maja: Naħfirlek; naf li kien aċċident.
colloquial.en: Nina: I'm asking for your forgiveness for breaking your cup. Maja: I forgive you; I know it was an accident.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我打碎了你的杯子，请你原谅。玛雅：我原谅你，我知道那是意外。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nitolbok ħafrien talli ksirt it-tazza tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nitolbok ħafrien talli ksirt it-tazza tiegħek.
messages.zh: 我打碎了你的杯子，请你原谅。
messages.en: I'm asking for your forgiveness for breaking your cup.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我原谅你，我知道那是意外。
messages.en: I forgive you; I know it was an accident.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友打碎杯子后诚恳道歉，主人放下责怪并接受道歉，用这幅场景记住原谅与宽恕。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The oat species Avena sterilis, referred to here by its Maltese plant name ħafur kbir.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指学名为 Avena sterilis 的燕麦属植物；ħafur kbir 是这里使用的马耳他语植物名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-ġeneru Avena bl-isem xjentifiku Avena sterilis.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种燕麦属植物，学名为 Avena sterilis。

collocations.zh: 一份 Avena sterilis 植物标本

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, il-kampjun ġie identifikat bħala ħafur kbir, bl-isem xjentifiku Avena sterilis.
formal.en: In the report, the specimen was identified as ħafur kbir, with the scientific name Avena sterilis.
formal.zh: 报告将这份标本鉴定为 ħafur kbir，学名为 Avena sterilis。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jisimha din il-pjanta? Pawlu: Jisimha ħafur kbir; fuq it-tikketta hemm Avena sterilis.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's this plant called? Pawlu: It's called ħafur kbir; the label says Avena sterilis.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这种植物叫什么？保罗：叫 ħafur kbir，标签上写着 Avena sterilis。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这种植物叫什么？
messages.en: What's this plant called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jisimha ħafur kbir; fuq it-tikketta hemm Avena sterilis.
messages.mt_standard: Jisimha ħafur kbir; fuq it-tikketta hemm Avena sterilis.
messages.zh: 叫 ħafur kbir，标签上写着 Avena sterilis。
messages.en: It's called ħafur kbir; the label says Avena sterilis.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħafur 联想为“燕麦”，用 kbir 的“大”义制作“大字燕麦标签”记忆卡，再将整张卡与 Avena sterilis 配对；这是记名称，不据此判断植株大小。

gloss_zh: 燕麦属植物 Avena sterilis 的 altherantha 亚种

teaching_sense.en_definition: The oat subspecies Avena sterilis subsp. altherantha, referred to in Maltese as ħafur kbir rari.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指 Avena sterilis 的 altherantha 亚种，马耳他语名称为 ħafur kbir rari。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sottospeċi ta' Avena sterilis bl-isem xjentifiku Avena sterilis subsp. altherantha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种燕麦属植物，具体指 Avena sterilis 的 altherantha 亚种。

collocations.en: a specimen of Avena sterilis subsp. altherantha
collocations.zh: 一份 Avena sterilis 的 altherantha 亚种标本

collocations.en: identification of Avena sterilis subsp. altherantha
collocations.zh: 对 Avena sterilis 的 altherantha 亚种的鉴定

formal.mt: Fil-lista tal-pjanti, ħafur kbir rari huwa mniżżel bl-isem xjentifiku Avena sterilis subsp. altherantha.
formal.en: In the plant list, ħafur kbir rari is listed under the scientific name Avena sterilis subsp. altherantha.
formal.zh: 植物名录中的 ħafur kbir rari 列于学名 Avena sterilis subsp. altherantha 之下。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hawn miktub ħafur kbir rari. X'isem xjentifiku għandu? Mark: Avena sterilis subsp. altherantha; iktbu ħdejn l-isem bil-Malti.
colloquial.en: Lara: It says ħafur kbir rari here. What's its scientific name? Mark: Avena sterilis subsp. altherantha; write it next to the Maltese name.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里写着 ħafur kbir rari。它的学名是什么？马克：Avena sterilis subsp. altherantha，把它写在马耳他语名称旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn miktub ħafur kbir rari. X'isem xjentifiku għandu?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn miktub ħafur kbir rari. X'isem xjentifiku għandu?
messages.zh: 这里写着 ħafur kbir rari。它的学名是什么？
messages.en: It says ħafur kbir rari here. What's its scientific name?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Avena sterilis subsp. altherantha; iktbu ħdejn l-isem bil-Malti.
messages.mt_standard: Avena sterilis subsp. altherantha; iktbu ħdejn l-isem bil-Malti.
messages.zh: Avena sterilis subsp. altherantha，把它写在马耳他语名称旁边。
messages.en: Avena sterilis subsp. altherantha; write it next to the Maltese name.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 ħafur kbir，再把末尾的 rari 用醒目颜色圈出，与 altherantha 亚种标签相连。rari 可借“稀少”义帮助记词，但这里不据此推断该植物的实际稀有程度。

gloss_zh: 冬生野燕麦，Avena sterilis 的 ludoviciana 亚种

teaching_sense.en_definition: Winter wild-oat, the subspecies Avena sterilis subsp. ludoviciana, called ħafur kbir ta' Ludovik in Maltese.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指称为冬生野燕麦的植物，即 Avena sterilis 的 ludoviciana 亚种，马耳他语名称为 ħafur kbir ta' Ludovik。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sottospeċi ta' Avena sterilis bl-isem xjentifiku Avena sterilis subsp. ludoviciana, magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala winter wild-oat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冬生野燕麦，具体指 Avena sterilis 的 ludoviciana 亚种。

collocations.mt: kampjun ta' ħafur kbir ta' Ludovik
ritratt ta' ħafur kbir ta' Ludovik
collocations.zh: 一张冬生野燕麦的照片

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jagħti l-isem ħafur kbir ta' Ludovik għall-pjanta Avena sterilis subsp. ludoviciana.
formal.en: The catalogue gives the name ħafur kbir ta' Ludovik for the plant Avena sterilis subsp. ludoviciana.
formal.zh: 目录将 Avena sterilis subsp. ludoviciana 这一植物的马耳他语名称列为 ħafur kbir ta' Ludovik。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif insejħulu winter wild-oat bil-Malti? Pawlu: Ħafur kbir ta' Ludovik. Żid ukoll l-isem xjentifiku fin-noti.
colloquial.en: Nina: What do we call winter wild-oat in Maltese? Pawlu: Ħafur kbir ta' Ludovik. Add the scientific name to your notes too.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：冬生野燕麦用马耳他语怎么说？保罗：Ħafur kbir ta' Ludovik。也把学名加进你的笔记里。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 冬生野燕麦用马耳他语怎么说？
messages.en: What do we call winter wild-oat in Maltese?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħafur kbir ta' Ludovik. Żid ukoll l-isem xjentifiku fin-noti.
messages.mt_standard: Ħafur kbir ta' Ludovik. Żid ukoll l-isem xjentifiku fin-noti.
messages.zh: Ħafur kbir ta' Ludovik。也把学名加进你的笔记里。
messages.en: Ħafur kbir ta' Ludovik. Add the scientific name to your notes too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ludovik 与学名中的 ludoviciana 并排写，用两者共有的字母串 ludovi 帮助配对，再在卡片上画一个冬日符号提示英文义；这只是拼写助记，不解释名称来源。

gloss_zh: 普通燕麦，栽培燕麦（Avena sativa）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Common oat, the plant species Avena sativa, called ħafur tal-għelieqi in Maltese.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指普通燕麦或栽培燕麦，即学名为 Avena sativa 的植物，马耳他语名称为 ħafur tal-għelieqi。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-ġeneru Avena bl-isem xjentifiku Avena sativa, magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala common oat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 普通燕麦，又称栽培燕麦，学名为 Avena sativa。

formal.mt: Il-pjan tal-kultivazzjoni jinkludi ħafur tal-għelieqi, magħruf xjentifikament bħala Avena sativa.
formal.en: The cultivation plan includes common oat, known scientifically as Avena sativa.
formal.zh: 栽培计划包含普通燕麦，其学名为 Avena sativa。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'se niżirgħu f'din l-għalqa? Sara: Ħafur tal-għelieqi; iż-żrieragħ qegħdin f'dik il-borża.
colloquial.en: Mark: What are we going to sow in this field? Sara: Common oat; the seeds are in that bag.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们要在这块田里播种什么？萨拉：普通燕麦，种子就在那个袋子里。

messages.speaker: Mark (农场帮工)
messages.zh: 我们要在这块田里播种什么？
messages.en: What are we going to sow in this field?

messages.speaker: Sara (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħafur tal-għelieqi; iż-żrieragħ qegħdin f'dik il-borża.
messages.mt_standard: Ħafur tal-għelieqi; iż-żrieragħ qegħdin f'dik il-borża.
messages.zh: 普通燕麦，种子就在那个袋子里。
messages.en: Common oat; the seeds are in that bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 ħafur“燕麦”和 tal-għelieqi“田地的”拼出一幅田间燕麦图，再把整幅图与普通燕麦 Avena sativa 配对。记住完整名称，避免只凭出现地点判断植物种类。

gloss_zh: 细长野燕麦，Avena barbata 的 barbata 亚种

teaching_sense.en_definition: Slender wild oat, the plant identified as Avena barbata subsp. barbata, called ħafur żgħir in Maltese.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指英文称为细长野燕麦的植物，即 Avena barbata 的 barbata 亚种，马耳他语名称为 ħafur żgħir。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-ġeneru Avena bl-isem xjentifiku Avena barbata subsp. barbata, magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala slender wild oat.

sense_translations.en_definition: slender wild oat (Avena barbata subsp. barbata)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 细长野燕麦，具体指 Avena barbata 的 barbata 亚种。

collocations.en: a specimen of slender wild oat
a photograph of slender wild oat
collocations.zh: 一张细长野燕麦的照片

formal.mt: It-tikketta tal-kampjun tagħti l-isem ħafur żgħir u l-isem xjentifiku Avena barbata subsp. barbata.
formal.en: The specimen label gives the name ħafur żgħir and the scientific name Avena barbata subsp. barbata.
formal.zh: 标本标签列出了名称 ħafur żgħir，以及学名 Avena barbata subsp. barbata。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan ir-ritratt ta' ħafur żgħir? Pawlu: Iva, hekk tgħid it-tikketta: Avena barbata subsp. barbata.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this a photograph of slender wild oat? Pawlu: Yes, that's what the label says: Avena barbata subsp. barbata.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这张照片拍的是细长野燕麦吗？保罗：是的，标签上就是这么写的：Avena barbata subsp. barbata。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这张照片拍的是细长野燕麦吗？
messages.en: Is this a photograph of slender wild oat?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hekk tgħid it-tikketta: Avena barbata subsp. barbata.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hekk tgħid it-tikketta: Avena barbata subsp. barbata.
messages.zh: 是的，标签上就是这么写的：Avena barbata subsp. barbata。
messages.en: Yes, that's what the label says: Avena barbata subsp. barbata.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żgħir 的“小”义画成一张小号燕麦词卡，与 ħafur kbir 的大号词卡形成对照，再在小卡背面写 Avena barbata subsp. barbata；卡片大小只是记忆提示，不是鉴定标准。

gloss_zh: 流浪汉；戏称的不明作怪者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who travels from place to place without a settled home.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有固定住所、四处漂泊的人；流浪汉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna bla dar fissa li tiġġerra minn post għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 没有固定住所、四处漂泊的流浪汉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna bla dar fissa li tiġġerra minn post għal ieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: An indexical word used to blame an unknown phenomenon, usually for comical or sarcastic purpose.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 原因或责任者不明时，用来指称并归咎于某个不明作怪者的词，通常带有搞笑或讽刺意味。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża biex it-tort jintefa' fuq xi ħaġa jew xi ħadd mhux magħruf, ġeneralment b'ċajta jew b'sarkażmu.

collocations.en: a hobo without a settled home
collocations.zh: 一名没有固定住所的流浪汉

collocations.en: the fault of a mysterious culprit, said jokingly
collocations.zh: 戏称是那个不明作怪者的错

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ħajbu jivvjaġġa minn raħal għal ieħor u jfittex post fejn jorqod.
formal.en: In the story, the hobo travels from village to village and looks for somewhere to sleep.
formal.zh: 故事中，这名流浪汉辗转于各个村庄，寻找过夜的地方。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ċaqlaq iċ-ċwievet? Ħadd ma jaf! | Mark: Mela żgur il-ħajbu! Dejjem hu t-tort tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who moved the keys? Nobody knows! | Mark: Then it must have been the mysterious culprit! It's always his fault.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁把钥匙挪走了？谁都不知道！ | 马克：那肯定又是那个神秘家伙！什么都怪他就对了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min ċaqlaq iċ-ċwievet? Ħadd ma jaf!
messages.mt_standard: Min ċaqlaq iċ-ċwievet? Ħadd ma jaf!
messages.zh: 谁把钥匙挪走了？谁都不知道！
messages.en: Who moved the keys? Nobody knows!

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela żgur il-ħajbu! Dejjem hu t-tort tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Mela żgur il-ħajbu! Dejjem hu t-tort tiegħu.
messages.zh: 那肯定又是那个神秘家伙！什么都怪他就对了。
messages.en: Then it must have been the mysterious culprit! It's always his fault.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分两幅画记忆：故事里四处漂泊的人，以及钥匙不见时被大家开玩笑归咎的“神秘家伙”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression describing someone as being completely alone, a variation of 'waħdu waħdu'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某人完全独自一人的表达，是 'waħdu waħdu' 的变体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tfisser li xi ħadd qiegħed waħdu għalkollox; varjazzjoni ta' 'waħdu waħdu'.

sense_translations.en_definition: this expression is a variation on 'waħdu waħdu', referring to sb. being all alone
sense_translations.zh_definition: 这一表达是 'waħdu waħdu' 的变体，指某人独自一人、身边没有别人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Varjazzjoni ta' 'waħdu waħdu' li tirreferi għal xi ħadd li jkun waħdu għalkollox.

formal.mt: Wara li telqu l-mistednin kollha, Mark baqa' ħajdu ħajdu fis-sala.
formal.en: After all the guests had left, Mark remained all alone in the hall.
formal.zh: 所有客人离开后，马克独自留在大厅里。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hu Mark? | Nina: Qiegħed bilqiegħda ħajdu ħajdu fil-bitħa. Ejja mmorru noqogħdu miegħu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where's Mark? | Nina: He's sitting all alone in the courtyard. Let's go and sit with him.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克在哪儿？ | 妮娜：他一个人坐在院子里。咱们过去陪他坐坐吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 马克在哪儿？
messages.en: Where's Mark?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħed bilqiegħda ħajdu ħajdu fil-bitħa. Ejja mmorru noqogħdu miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħed bilqiegħda ħajdu ħajdu fil-bitħa. Ejja mmorru noqogħdu miegħu.
messages.zh: 他一个人坐在院子里。咱们过去陪他坐坐吧。
messages.en: He's sitting all alone in the courtyard. Let's go and sit with him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把重复的两个词当作加强孤单感的记忆提示：大大的院子里，只有一个人坐着。整组表达一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Attractive or appealing in a way that draws attention or makes someone want something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有吸引力、能引人注意或使人产生欲望的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġbed l-attenzjoni jew iqanqal ix-xewqa għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有吸引力的；惹人喜爱的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jiġbed l-attenzjoni u jogħġob.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诱人的；让人很想得到或尝试的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jħajjar lil xi ħadd jew iqanqal ix-xewqa.

collocations.en: the appearance of an attractive man
collocations.zh: 一位有魅力男子的外貌

formal.mt: Il-ħanut offra l-prodott bi prezz ħajjari, u dan ġibed ħafna klijenti.
formal.en: The shop offered the product at a tempting price, which attracted many customers.
formal.zh: 商店以诱人的价格出售这款产品，吸引了许多顾客。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-prezz ħajjari ħafna! | Lara: Veru, imma għandna bżonnha din il-borża?
colloquial.en: Maja: This price is really tempting! | Lara: True, but do we need this bag?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个价格太诱人了！ | 拉拉：确实，不过我们需要这个包吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个价格太诱人了！
messages.en: This price is really tempting!

messages.speaker: Lara (购物同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, imma għandna bżonnha din il-borża?
messages.mt_standard: Veru, imma għandna bżonnha din il-borża?
messages.zh: 确实，不过我们需要这个包吗？
messages.en: True, but do we need this bag?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象看到漂亮人物或优惠价签时目光被吸引：前者帮助记“有吸引力”，后者帮助记“诱人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stroke someone affectionately, or to indulge them by giving them whatever they want, sometimes spoiling them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 温柔地爱抚，或通过满足对方的各种要求来宠爱、迁就，甚至把对方宠坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iżiegħel b'xi ħadd jew jagħtih kull ma jixtieq, xi drabi sal-punt li jfissdu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱抚；温柔地抚摸。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Imiss jew imelles lil xi ħadd bil-ħlewwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 满足某人的每一个任性要求；百般迁就。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jissodisfa kull xewqa ta' xi ħadd, anki jekk tkun kapriċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 过分宠爱；把人宠坏。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ifissed lil xi ħadd b'ħafna indulġenza.

collocations.mt: ħajjem lit-tifel billi tah kull ma ried
collocations.en: indulged the boy by giving him everything he wanted
collocations.zh: 给男孩想要的一切，百般迁就他

collocations.en: spoiled the boy by indulging him too much
collocations.zh: 过分溺爱，把男孩宠坏了

formal.mt: In-nannu ħajjem lit-tifel billi ssodisfa kull xewqa tiegħu, u maż-żmien it-tifel beda jistenna li dejjem isir kif irid hu.
formal.en: The grandfather indulged the boy by satisfying his every wish, and over time the boy began to expect always to get his own way.
formal.zh: 祖父满足男孩的每一个要求，百般迁就他；时间一久，男孩便开始觉得事事都该顺着自己。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara l-qattus kemm hu kwiet! | Mark: Iva, Pawlu ħajjem il-qattus bil-ħlewwa u issa raqad.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look how quiet the cat is! | Mark: Yes, Paul gently caressed the cat, and now it's fallen asleep.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看，猫多安静！ | 马克：是啊，保罗温柔地抚摸了它，现在它睡着了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看，猫多安静！
messages.en: Look how quiet the cat is!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, Pawlu ħajjem il-qattus bil-ħlewwa u issa raqad.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, Pawlu ħajjem il-qattus bil-ħlewwa u issa raqad.
messages.zh: 是啊，保罗温柔地抚摸了它，现在它睡着了。
messages.en: Yes, Paul gently caressed the cat, and now it's fallen asleep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个小场景分别记义项：轻轻摸猫是爱抚，孩子要什么都给是迁就，最终事事任性便是宠坏。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To surround a piece of land or another space with a wall or fence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用墙或围栏将一块土地或某个空间围起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dawwar biċċa art jew spazju ieħor b'ħajt jew b'ċint.

sense_translations.en_definition: to enclose with a wall or fence
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用墙或围栏围住；将某处围起来。

collocations.en: enclosed the field with a wall or fence
collocations.zh: 用墙或围栏围起了田地

collocations.en: enclosed the garden with a fence

formal.mt: Is-sid ħajjet l-għalqa biex jipproteġi l-uċuħ tar-raba' mill-annimali.
formal.en: The owner enclosed the field with a wall or fence to protect the crops from animals.
formal.zh: 主人用墙或围栏围起田地，以保护庄稼不受动物侵害。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex Pawlu ħajjet il-ġnien? Luqa: Biex il-kelb ma joħroġx fit-triq.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did Pawlu fence off the garden? Luqa: To keep the dog from going out into the street.
colloquial.zh: Marija：Pawlu为什么把花园围起来？Luqa：为了不让狗跑到街上去。

messages.speaker: Marija (邻居)
messages.zh: Pawlu为什么把花园围起来？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu fence off the garden?

messages.speaker: Luqa (邻居)
messages.zh: 为了不让狗跑到街上去。
messages.en: To keep the dog from going out into the street.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给花园四周画上一圈围栏，把 ħajjet 与“围起来保护里面”的动作一起记。

gloss_zh: 过度放纵；矫揉造作；娇纵态度

teaching_sense.en_definition: Excessive indulgence, affected behaviour, or a spoilt attitude that expects special treatment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 过分放纵、刻意装出来的姿态，或期待别人处处迁就的娇纵态度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imġiba ta' indulġenza żejda, affettazzjoni, jew persuna mfissda li tistenna li kulħadd jagħmel kif trid hi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 过度放纵；过分满足欲望或要求。
矫揉造作；为了给人某种印象而刻意表现出的姿态。
被宠坏后表现出的娇纵态度；认为别人理应迁就自己的心态。

collocations.en: without affectation or a spoilt attitude
collocations.zh: 不矫揉造作；不摆娇纵姿态

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ħajm tal-karattru jidher meta jistenna li kulħadd jaqdih minnufih.
formal.en: In the story, the character's spoilt attitude becomes apparent when he expects everyone to attend to him immediately.
formal.zh: 故事中，这个人物期待所有人立刻为他效劳，显露出他的娇纵态度。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ma jridx joqgħod magħna għax is-siġġu mhux artab biżżejjed. Mark: Dan ħajm żejjed; jista' jġib kuxxin.
colloquial.en: Sara: He won't sit with us because the chair isn't soft enough. Mark: That's far too fussy; he can get a cushion.
colloquial.zh: Sara：他嫌椅子不够软，不肯和我们坐在一起。Mark：这也太娇气了；他可以拿个坐垫。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma jridx joqgħod magħna għax is-siġġu mhux artab biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Ma jridx joqgħod magħna għax is-siġġu mhux artab biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 他嫌椅子不够软，不肯和我们坐在一起。
messages.en: He won't sit with us because the chair isn't soft enough.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ħajm żejjed; jista' jġib kuxxin.
messages.mt_standard: Dan ħajm żejjed; jista' jġib kuxxin.
messages.zh: 这也太娇气了；他可以拿个坐垫。
messages.en: That's far too fussy; he can get a cushion.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个小画面记 ħajm：欲望被过分满足、姿态刻意做作、要求人人迁就；按语境区分三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dishonest deception, especially a scheme used to obtain someone's money or property.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以不诚实手段欺骗他人的行为，尤指骗取钱财的骗局。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qerq jew skema qarrieqa, speċjalment biex jittieħdu l-flus jew il-proprjetà ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欺诈；通过欺骗手段谋取利益的行为。
骗局；以欺骗方式骗取他人钱财的勾当。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi każ ta' ħajna li fih inġabru flus għal servizz li qatt ma ngħata.
formal.en: The report describes a case of fraud in which money was collected for a service that was never provided.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一起欺诈案件：有人收取了服务费用，却从未提供相应服务。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ħallast għall-biljetti, imma l-bejjiegħ sparixxa. Pawlu: Din tidher ħajna; żomm il-messaġġi kollha.
colloquial.en: Nina: I paid for the tickets, but the seller disappeared. Pawlu: This looks like a swindle; keep all the messages.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我付了票钱，卖家却消失了。Pawlu：这看起来是个骗局；把所有消息都留着。

messages.speaker: Nina (购票者)
messages.zh: 我付了票钱，卖家却消失了。
messages.en: I paid for the tickets, but the seller disappeared.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din tidher ħajna; żomm il-messaġġi kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Din tidher ħajna; żomm il-messaġġi kollha.
messages.zh: 这看起来是个骗局；把所有消息都留着。
messages.en: This looks like a swindle; keep all the messages.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħajna 放进“付了钱，承诺却是假的”这个情景；它指欺诈行为或骗局本身，是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dishonest and misleading, or unfaithful to a person, group, or commitment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不诚实、会欺骗他人的；或对某人、团体或承诺不忠的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jqarraq b'ħaddieħor jew li ma jibqax leali lejn persuna, grupp jew wegħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欺诈的；惯于隐瞒事实或误导他人的。
不忠的；背弃他人信任、所属团体或既有承诺的。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, is-sieħeb ħajni jikxef is-sigriet tal-grupp biex jikseb vantaġġ personali.
formal.en: In the novel, the disloyal partner reveals the group's secret to gain a personal advantage.
formal.zh: 小说中，那个不忠的伙伴泄露了团体的秘密，以谋取个人利益。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Il-bejjiegħ qal li l-arloġġ kien ġdid, imma kien diġà użat. David: Kemm hu ħajni! Kellha tgħidlek il-verità dik il-persuna.
colloquial.en: Anna: The seller said the watch was new, but it had already been used. David: How deceitful he is! That person should have told you the truth.
colloquial.zh: Anna：卖家说手表是新的，其实已经用过了。David：他真会骗人！那个人本该告诉你实情。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bejjiegħ qal li l-arloġġ kien ġdid, imma kien diġà użat.
messages.mt_standard: Il-bejjiegħ qal li l-arloġġ kien ġdid, imma kien diġà użat.
messages.zh: 卖家说手表是新的，其实已经用过了。
messages.en: The seller said the watch was new, but it had already been used.

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu ħajni! Kellha tgħidlek il-verità dik il-persuna.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu ħajni! Kellha tgħidlek il-verità dik il-persuna.
messages.zh: 他真会骗人！那个人本该告诉你实情。
messages.en: How deceitful he is! That person should have told you the truth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“这个人怎样？”来记 ħajni：他会骗人，或背弃信任。它是描述性质的形容词，不是骗局本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Thanks or a feeling of gratitude; also an attraction that draws someone towards something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达的感谢或内心的谢意；也指使人对某事物产生兴趣的吸引力。
