teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grazzi jew sens ta' gratitudni; ukoll ġibda jew interess lejn xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感谢；谢意；对他人帮助或善意的感激之情。
诱惑力；吸引力；使人产生兴趣或向往的力量。

formal.mt: Fl-aħħar tad-diskors, il-kap tal-iskola ta ħajr lill-għalliema għall-ħidma tagħhom.
formal.en: At the end of the speech, the head of the school thanked the teachers for their work.
formal.zh: 演讲结束时，校长向教师们的辛勤工作表示感谢。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Ħija ħa ħajr għall-qari minn meta tajtu dak il-ktieb. Ben: Mela għamiltlu rigal sabiħ!
colloquial.en: Marta: My brother has developed a liking for reading since I gave him that book. Ben: Then you gave him a lovely present!
colloquial.zh: Marta：自从我送给弟弟那本书，他就开始喜欢阅读了。Ben：那你真是送了他一份好礼物！

messages.speaker: Marta (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija ħa ħajr għall-qari minn meta tajtu dak il-ktieb.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija ħa ħajr għall-qari minn meta tajtu dak il-ktieb.
messages.zh: 自从我送给弟弟那本书，他就开始喜欢阅读了。
messages.en: My brother has developed a liking for reading since I gave him that book.

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 那你真是送了他一份好礼物！
messages.en: Then you gave him a lovely present!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħajr 分成两个场景记：向帮助者表达谢意，以及被书本吸引而喜欢阅读；结合搭配判断词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To scratch something repeatedly, or to reduce food such as cheese to small shreds by rubbing it against a grater.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反复抓挠某处；或用擦丝器将奶酪等食物擦成细丝或碎屑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħakk xi ħaġa diversi drabi, jew għamel ikel bħall-ġobon fi frak żgħir billi għaddieh fuq ħakkiek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复抓挠；一再用指甲等刮擦某处。
把奶酪等食物擦成细丝或碎屑。

collocations.zh: 反复抓挠了自己的手臂

formal.mt: Waqt li kien jaqra, it-tifel ħakkek driegħu diversi drabi minħabba l-ħakk.
formal.en: While reading, the boy scratched his arm several times because it was itchy.
formal.zh: 男孩读书时，因为手臂发痒而抓挠了好几次。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min ħakkek il-ġobon għall-għaġin? Toni: Jien; qiegħed fl-iskutella ħdejn il-platti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who grated the cheese for the pasta? Toni: I did; it's in the bowl next to the plates.
colloquial.zh: Lara：意面用的奶酪是谁擦碎的？Toni：我擦的；就在盘子旁边的碗里。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 意面用的奶酪是谁擦碎的？
messages.en: Who grated the cheese for the pasta?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.zh: 我擦的；就在盘子旁边的碗里。
messages.en: I did; it's in the bowl next to the plates.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象来回重复的摩擦动作：手指在皮肤上是反复抓挠，奶酪在擦丝器上是擦碎，用动作串联两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To exercise rule over people or territory, to colonise a territory, or to bring others under control.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对人民或领土实行统治；对某地进行殖民统治；或使他人处于控制之下。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Eżerċita setgħa fuq nies jew territorju, ikkolonizza territorju, jew ġab lil oħrajn taħt il-kontroll tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 统治；对人民或某片领土行使统治权。
殖民；将某地置于殖民统治之下。
使臣服；使某人或群体受到支配或控制。

collocations.zh: 对一片领土实行了统治

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-re ħakkem fuq territorju vast u żamm il-poplu taħt il-kontroll tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the king ruled over a vast territory and kept the people under his control.
formal.zh: 故事中，国王统治着辽阔的领土，并将人民置于自己的控制之下。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min ħakkem fuq il-gżira f'din l-istorja? Ġużeppi: Re barrani, sakemm in-nies irvellaw kontrih.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who ruled over the island in this story? Ġużeppi: A foreign king, until the people rebelled against him.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这个故事里是谁统治那座岛？Ġużeppi：一个外国国王，后来人们起来反抗他。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Min ħakkem fuq il-gżira f'din l-istorja?
messages.mt_standard: Min ħakkem fuq il-gżira f'din l-istorja?
messages.zh: 这个故事里是谁统治那座岛？
messages.en: Who ruled over the island in this story?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Re barrani, sakemm in-nies irvellaw kontrih.
messages.mt_standard: Re barrani, sakemm in-nies irvellaw kontrih.
messages.zh: 一个外国国王，后来人们起来反抗他。
messages.en: A foreign king, until the people rebelled against him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用故事地图记 ħakkem：王冠表示统治，外来势力控制土地表示殖民，人被置于权力之下表示臣服。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A kitchen utensil with a rough or perforated surface used to shred food such as cheese or vegetables.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面有凸起刃口或孔洞，用来把奶酪、蔬菜等擦成细丝或碎屑的厨房工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda tal-kċina b'wiċċ aħrax jew bit-toqob, li tintuża biex tagħmel il-ġobon jew il-ħaxix fi frak jew strixxi rqaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 擦丝器；通过摩擦将奶酪、蔬菜等刨成细丝或碎屑的厨房用具。

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, uża ħakkiek fin biex tipprepara l-qoxra tal-lumija.
formal.en: For this recipe, use a fine grater to prepare the lemon zest.
formal.zh: 制作这道食谱时，用细孔擦丝器刨取柠檬皮屑。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Fejn hu l-ħakkiek tal-ġobon? Mario: Fil-kexxun ħdejn il-forn; għaddihuli meta tlesti.
colloquial.en: Elena: Where's the cheese grater? Mario: In the drawer next to the oven; pass it to me when you're done.
colloquial.zh: Elena：奶酪擦丝器在哪里？Mario：在烤箱旁边的抽屉里；你用完后递给我。

messages.speaker: Elena (家人)
messages.zh: 奶酪擦丝器在哪里？
messages.en: Where's the cheese grater?

messages.speaker: Mario (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-kexxun ħdejn il-forn; għaddihuli meta tlesti.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-kexxun ħdejn il-forn; għaddihuli meta tlesti.
messages.zh: 在烤箱旁边的抽屉里；你用完后递给我。
messages.en: In the drawer next to the oven; pass it to me when you're done.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中给厨房工具贴标签：ħakkiek 是手里拿着的擦丝器；想象奶酪擦过孔面后落下一堆细屑。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A kitchen tool with a rough or perforated surface used to shred foods such as cheese or vegetables.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用粗糙表面或带孔刨面把奶酪、蔬菜等食物擦成细丝或碎屑的厨房工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda tal-kċina b'wiċċ aħrax jew imtaqqab li tintuża biex tnaqqas ġobon jew ħaxix f'biċċiet żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 擦丝器；用于把食物刨成细丝或碎屑的器具。

formal.mt: Uża ħakkieka nadifa biex tħokk il-ġobon qabel iżżidu mal-għaġin.
formal.en: Use a clean grater to grate the cheese before adding it to the pasta.
formal.zh: 先用干净的刨碎器把奶酪刨碎，再加入意面中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hi l-ħakkieka? Għandi bżonn inħokk il-ġobon. Lara: Fil-kexxun ħdejn il-kuċċarini.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where's the grater? I need to grate the cheese. Lara: In the drawer next to the teaspoons.
colloquial.zh: Maja：擦丝器在哪里？我要刨奶酪。Lara：在茶匙旁边的抽屉里。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi l-ħakkieka? Għandi bżonn inħokk il-ġobon.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi l-ħakkieka? Għandi bżonn inħokk il-ġobon.
messages.zh: 擦丝器在哪里？我要刨奶酪。
messages.en: Where's the grater? I need to grate the cheese.

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 在茶匙旁边的抽屉里。
messages.en: In the drawer next to the teaspoons.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħakkieka 和厨房擦奶酪的画面绑定：手里拿的是工具，盘里落下的是碎屑。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Suitable for being grated; also describing someone who is eager and ready to work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容食物适合刨碎；也可形容人热心干活、积极投入工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jinħakk, bħal ġobon; jew li għandu ħeġġa biex jaħdem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可刨碎的；适合用擦丝器刨成碎屑或细丝的。
热心干活的；积极主动、愿意投入工作的。

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, agħżel ġobon ħakkieki u ħokku qabel isservi.
formal.en: For this recipe, choose cheese suitable for grating and grate it before serving.
formal.zh: 做这道菜时，选择适合刨碎的奶酪，并在上菜前将其刨碎。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif sejjer il-ħaddiem il-ġdid? Mark: Tajjeb ħafna! Hu ħakkieki u dejjem jistaqsi kif jista' jgħin.
colloquial.en: Lara: How is the new worker getting on? Mark: Very well! He's eager to work and always asks how he can help.
colloquial.zh: Lara：新来的工人干得怎么样？Mark：很好！他干活很积极，总是问能帮什么忙。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 新来的工人干得怎么样？
messages.en: How is the new worker getting on?

messages.speaker: Mark (领班)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb ħafna! Hu ħakkieki u dejjem jistaqsi kif jista' jgħin.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb ħafna! Hu ħakkieki u dejjem jistaqsi kif jista' jgħin.
messages.zh: 很好！他干活很积极，总是问能帮什么忙。
messages.en: Very well! He's eager to work and always asks how he can help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记两个搭配来分义：ġobon ħakkieki 是奶酪可刨，ħaddiem ħakkieki 是工人肯干；看被修饰的对象判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Trying to control other people and make them obey, often without considering their wishes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人或其态度专横，喜欢控制别人、要求别人服从，常不顾他人的意愿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jrid jikkontrolla lill-oħrajn u jġegħelhom jobdu, spiss mingħajr ma jqis ix-xewqat tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 专横的；喜欢支配他人、强迫他人服从的。

formal.mt: Atteġġjament ħakkiemi min-naħa tal-kap jista' jnaqqas il-fiduċja u l-kooperazzjoni fit-tim.
formal.en: A domineering attitude on the part of the boss can reduce trust and cooperation within the team.
formal.zh: 上司的专横态度可能削弱团队内部的信任与合作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma tridx taħdem miegħu? Lara: Għax hu ħakkiemi wisq; irid jiddeċiedi kollox hu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why don't you want to work with him? Lara: Because he's too domineering; he wants to decide everything himself.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么不想和他共事？Lara：因为他太专横了，什么都要由他自己决定。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么不想和他共事？
messages.en: Why don't you want to work with him?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu ħakkiemi wisq; irid jiddeċiedi kollox hu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu ħakkiemi wisq; irid jiddeċiedi kollox hu.
messages.zh: 因为他太专横了，什么都要由他自己决定。
messages.en: Because he's too domineering; he wants to decide everything himself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人把所有决定都抓在手里，反复说“都听我的”，用这幅画面记住 ħakkiemi 的专横语气。

gloss_zh: 巴尔灿，马耳他北部大区的村庄及地方议会辖区

teaching_sense.en_definition: The proper name of Balzan, a village and local council area in Malta's Northern Region.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 地名，指马耳他北部大区的巴尔灿村及其地方议会辖区。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem ta' raħal u lokalità b'kunsill lokali fir-Reġjun tat-Tramuntana ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: Balzan (a village and local council of the Northern Region, Malta)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 巴尔灿，马耳他北部大区的一个村庄及地方议会辖区。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi l-opinjonijiet ta' grupp ta' residenti ta' Ħal Balzan dwar is-servizzi lokali.
formal.en: The report includes the views of a group of Balzan residents on local services.
formal.zh: 报告收录了一组巴尔灿居民对当地服务的意见。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se niltaqgħu għada? Mark: F'Ħal Balzan, ħdejn il-knisja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we meet tomorrow? Mark: In Balzan, near the church.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们明天在哪里见？Mark：在巴尔灿，教堂附近。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们明天在哪里见？
messages.en: Where shall we meet tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 在巴尔灿，教堂附近。
messages.en: In Balzan, near the church.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ħal Balzan 整体当作地图上的地名标签记住，再配一句 f'Ħal Balzan，练习表达“在巴尔灿”。

gloss_zh: 萨菲村（马耳他南部村庄）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a village in the south of Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他南部一个村庄的名称，可译作萨菲村。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem ta' raħal fin-Nofsinhar ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: a village in the south of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他南部的一个村庄，名为萨菲村。

formal.mt: Ħal Safi huwa raħal fin-Nofsinhar ta' Malta.
formal.en: Ħal Safi is a village in the south of Malta.
formal.zh: 萨菲村是马耳他南部的一个村庄。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn toqgħod? Pawlu: Noqgħod f'Ħal Safi. Sara: Jien ukoll noqgħod hemm!
colloquial.en: Sara: Where do you live? Pawlu: I live in Ħal Safi. Sara: I live there too!
colloquial.zh: Sara：你住在哪里？Pawlu：我住在萨菲村。Sara：我也住在那里！

messages.speaker: Sara (新同学)
messages.zh: 你住在哪里？
messages.en: Where do you live?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 我住在萨菲村。
messages.en: I live in Ħal Safi.

messages.speaker: Sara (新同学)
messages.zh: 我也住在那里！
messages.en: I live there too!

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一张马耳他地图，把“Ħal Safi／萨菲村”的标签贴在南部；整组当作地名记忆，不逐字猜意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To combine two or more substances or ingredients so that they form a mixture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把两种或更多物质、配料放到一起，使其混合，常通过搅拌完成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaqqad żewġ sustanzi jew ingredjenti jew aktar biex jagħmel taħlita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 混合；把不同物质或配料掺在一起。

collocations.en: he mixed the flour with the water

formal.mt: Il-kok ħalat id-dqiq mal-ilma sakemm kiseb għaġina lixxa.
formal.en: The cook mixed the flour with the water until he obtained a smooth dough.
formal.zh: 厨师把面粉和水混合，直到形成光滑的面团。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min ħalat iż-żewġ kuluri? Mark: Jien. Ridt nara x'kulur joħroġ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who mixed the two colours? Mark: I did. I wanted to see what colour would come out.
colloquial.zh: Lara：谁把这两种颜色混在一起了？Mark：是我。我想看看会调出什么颜色。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁把这两种颜色混在一起了？
messages.en: Who mixed the two colours?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是我。我想看看会调出什么颜色。
messages.en: I did. I wanted to see what colour would come out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħalat 配上“两杯不同颜色倒进同一碗”的动作；例句中的 ħalat 可连同“他混合了”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: One occasion of milking an animal; also a heavy shower of rain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指一次给动物挤奶的过程；也指一阵雨势较大的降雨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Darba li fiha jinħareġ il-ħalib minn annimal; ukoll xita qawwija li tinżel għal xi ħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次挤奶；给产奶动物挤奶的一次过程。
大雨；一阵强降雨。

formal.mt: Wara l-ħalba ta' filgħodu, il-ħalib tqiegħed f'kontenituri nodfa.
formal.en: After the morning milking, the milk was placed in clean containers.
formal.zh: 早晨挤奶结束后，奶被装进了干净的容器。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex int imxarrab hekk? Mark: Qabditni ħalba xita fi triqti lejn id-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you so wet? Mark: I got caught in a heavy shower on my way home.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么湿成这样？Mark：我回家的路上赶上了一阵大雨。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你怎么湿成这样？
messages.en: Why are you so wet?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qabditni ħalba xita fi triqti lejn id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Qabditni ħalba xita fi triqti lejn id-dar.
messages.zh: 我回家的路上赶上了一阵大雨。
messages.en: I got caught in a heavy shower on my way home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景分别记：农场里是“一次挤奶”，街上遇到 ħalba xita 是“一阵大雨”；靠场景辨义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Resembling milk in appearance, colour, or consistency.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在外观、颜色或质地上类似牛奶的，如呈乳白色或具有乳状质地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jixbah il-ħalib fid-dehra, fil-kulur jew fil-konsistenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 似乳的；在颜色、外观或质地上与奶相似的。

formal.mt: Wara t-taħlit, il-likwidu ħa kulur ħalbi.
formal.en: After mixing, the liquid took on a milky colour.
formal.zh: 混合后，液体呈现出乳白色。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema vażun tippreferi? Maja: Dak b'kulur ħalbi. Jaqbel mal-mejda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which vase do you prefer? Maja: The milky-coloured one. It goes with the table.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你更喜欢哪个花瓶？Maja：那个乳白色的，和桌子很搭。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你更喜欢哪个花瓶？
messages.en: Which vase do you prefer?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个乳白色的，和桌子很搭。
messages.en: The milky-coloured one. It goes with the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见 ħalbi 就想象一杯奶的颜色和质地；它描述“像奶”，单凭这个词不能判断是否含奶。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Extravagant or wasteful, especially in spending money or using resources.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容花钱奢侈、挥霍无度，或使用资源时造成浪费。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jonfoq iżżejjed jew jaħli flus u riżorsi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奢侈的；花费超过实际需要的。
挥霍的；大手大脚耗费钱财的。
浪费的；不节约钱财或资源的。
挥霍无度的；毫无节制地耗费钱财或资源的。

formal.mt: Il-maniġer kien ħali bil-flus tal-kumpanija u nefaq somom kbar fuq affarijiet bla bżonn.
formal.en: The manager was extravagant with the company's money and spent large sums on unnecessary things.
formal.zh: 这位经理挥霍公司的资金，在不必要的东西上花费了大笔钱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xtrajt tliet flokkijiet oħra? Mark: Iva, imma naf li kont ħali; wieħed kien biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you buy three more shirts? Mark: Yes, but I know I was extravagant; one was enough.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你又买了三件上衣？马克：对，但我知道自己花钱太大手大脚了；一件就够了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你又买了三件上衣？
messages.en: Did you buy three more shirts?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma naf li kont ħali; wieħed kien biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma naf li kont ħali; wieħed kien biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 对，但我知道自己花钱太大手大脚了；一件就够了。
messages.en: Yes, but I know I was extravagant; one was enough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħali 放进“本来只需一件，却买了三件”的购物画面，记住它形容奢侈和浪费。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Condensed milk: milk made thicker by removing some of its water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 炼乳，即去除部分水分后制成的浓缩乳制品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħalib li jsir eħxen billi jitneħħa parti mill-ilma tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 炼乳；经去除部分水分而浓缩的乳制品。

collocations.en: a dessert made with condensed milk

formal.mt: Għal din id-deżerta, żid żewġ imgħaref ħalib magħqud mat-taħlita u ħawwad sew.
formal.en: For this dessert, add two tablespoons of condensed milk to the mixture and stir well.
formal.zh: 制作这款甜点时，向混合物中加入两汤匙炼乳，并充分搅拌。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandna ħalib magħqud għad-deżerta? Mark: Iva, hemm landa fl-armarju.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do we have condensed milk for the dessert? Mark: Yes, there is a tin in the cupboard.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们有做甜点用的炼乳吗？马克：有，橱柜里有一罐。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 我们有做甜点用的炼乳吗？
messages.en: Do we have condensed milk for the dessert?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 有，橱柜里有一罐。
messages.en: Yes, there is a tin in the cupboard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħalib magħqud 整组贴在“炼乳罐”的想象标签上，再配上“加入两汤匙”的动作记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Evaporated milk: milk concentrated by evaporating some of its water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蒸发乳，通常称为淡奶，是通过蒸发去除部分水分制成的浓缩乳制品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħalib ikkonċentrat billi parti mill-ilma tiegħu titneħħa bl-evaporazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蒸发乳；淡奶，即经蒸发去除部分水分的浓缩乳制品。

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob mitt millilitru ħalib maħlul, li għandu jiżdied gradwalment waqt li tħawwad.
formal.en: The recipe calls for one hundred millilitres of evaporated milk, which should be added gradually while stirring.
formal.zh: 食谱需要一百毫升淡奶，应在搅拌的同时逐渐加入。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid ftit ħalib maħlul fil-kafè? Mark: Iva, ftit biss, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like some evaporated milk in your coffee? Mark: Yes, just a little, please.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的咖啡要加点淡奶吗？马克：要，请加一点点。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的咖啡要加点淡奶吗？
messages.en: Would you like some evaporated milk in your coffee?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 要，请加一点点。
messages.en: Yes, just a little, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħalib maħlul 与“咖啡里加淡奶”绑定记忆，并与 ħalib magħqud 的炼乳标签分开练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fig fruit, or a fig tree.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指无花果这种果实，也可指结无花果的树。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frotta tat-tin, jew is-siġra li tagħti t-tin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无花果，指果实。
无花果树，指结无花果的树木。

collocations.en: a fig tree in the garden
collocations.zh: 花园里的一棵无花果树

formal.mt: Fil-ġnien hemm ħaliba kbira, u minnha nġabret ħaliba misjura.
formal.en: There is a large fig tree in the garden, and a ripe fig was picked from it.
formal.zh: 花园里有一棵大无花果树，人们从树上摘下了一颗成熟的无花果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid ħaliba misjura? Mark: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Ġbartha mill-ħaliba fil-ġnien?
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like a ripe fig? Mark: Yes, please. Did you pick it from the fig tree in the garden?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想吃一颗成熟的无花果吗？马克：想，谢谢。你是从花园里的无花果树上摘的吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想吃一颗成熟的无花果吗？
messages.en: Would you like a ripe fig?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Ġbartha mill-ħaliba fil-ġnien?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Ġbartha mill-ħaliba fil-ġnien?
messages.zh: 想，谢谢。你是从花园里的无花果树上摘的吗？
messages.en: Yes, please. Did you pick it from the fig tree in the garden?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一颗果实、一棵果树”两幅图记 ħaliba；看到“成熟”想果实，看到“花园里生长”想树。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The unnecessary loss or waste of something useful, such as food, water, or materials.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 食物、水或材料等有用物品不必要的浪费或损耗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-telf bla bżonn ta' ikel, ilma, materjal jew riżorsi oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 浪费；资源或物品在使用、处理过程中产生的不必要损耗。

formal.mt: Il-kċina għandha tippjana l-porzjonijiet bir-reqqa sabiex tnaqqas il-ħalja tal-ikel.
formal.en: The kitchen should plan portions carefully to reduce food wastage.
formal.zh: 厨房应仔细规划每份食物的分量，以减少食物浪费。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tagħlaq il-vit? Mark: Biex innaqqas il-ħalja tal-ilma waqt li naħsel snieni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you turning off the tap? Mark: To reduce water wastage while I brush my teeth.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么关上水龙头？马克：为了在刷牙时减少水的浪费。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 你为什么关上水龙头？
messages.en: Why are you turning off the tap?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex innaqqas il-ħalja tal-ilma waqt li naħsel snieni.
messages.mt_standard: Biex innaqqas il-ħalja tal-ilma waqt li naħsel snieni.
messages.zh: 为了在刷牙时减少水的浪费。
messages.en: To reduce water wastage while I brush my teeth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象水龙头白白流走的水，把 ħalja 记作“浪费这一现象”；它在这里是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dark, aromatic vinegar with a sweet and sour taste, used in dressings and other dishes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种颜色较深、香气浓郁、味道酸甜的醋，常用于调制沙拉酱汁或其他菜肴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' ħall skur u aromatiku b'togħma ħelwa u qarsa, użat fl-insalati u fi platti oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 意式香醋，又称巴萨米克醋，是一种味道酸甜、香气浓郁的醋。

formal.mt: Għall-insalata, ħallat żewġ mgħaref żejt taż-żebbuġa ma' mgħarfa ħall balsamiku.
formal.en: For the salad, mix two tablespoons of olive oil with one tablespoon of balsamic vinegar.
formal.zh: 制作这份沙拉时，将两汤匙橄榄油与一汤匙意式香醋混合。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Trid ftit ħall balsamiku fuq l-insalata? Lara: Iva, imma ftit biss, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Mark: Would you like a little balsamic vinegar on the salad? Lara: Yes, but just a little, please.
colloquial.zh: Mark：沙拉上要加一点意式香醋吗？Lara：要，不过请只加一点。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid ftit ħall balsamiku fuq l-insalata?
messages.mt_standard: Trid ftit ħall balsamiku fuq l-insalata?
messages.zh: 沙拉上要加一点意式香醋吗？
messages.en: Would you like a little balsamic vinegar on the salad?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ftit biss, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ftit biss, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 要，不过请只加一点。
messages.en: Yes, but just a little, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象沙拉旁并排摆着橄榄油和深色香醋，把整个短语当成瓶身上的调味品名称来记。

gloss_zh: 付款爽快的人；惯常及时付款者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who habitually pays promptly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常会及时付款、不拖延支付的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li s-soltu tħallas fil-pront.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who tends to pay promptly
sense_translations.zh_definition: 惯常及时付款的人；付款爽快、不拖欠的人。

collocations.zh: 一位付款及时可靠的人

collocations.en: known as someone who pays promptly
collocations.zh: 以付款及时而为人所知

formal.mt: Is-Sur Borg huwa magħruf bħala ħallasi, għax iħallas kull fattura fil-pront.
formal.en: Mr Borg is known as a prompt payer because he pays every invoice promptly.
formal.zh: 博尔格先生以付款及时而为人所知，因为他每张账单都及时支付。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu għadu ma ħallasx? Mark: Ħallas dalgħodu. Hu ħallasi tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has Pawlu still not paid? Mark: He paid this morning. He is a reliable prompt payer.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗还没付款吗？马克：他今天早上已经付了。他一向付款很及时。

messages.speaker: Maja (店员)
messages.zh: 保罗还没付款吗？
messages.en: Has Pawlu still not paid?

messages.speaker: Mark (店主)
messages.zh: 他今天早上已经付了。他一向付款很及时。
messages.en: He paid this morning. He is a reliable prompt payer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位收到单据就马上付款的顾客，把 ħallasi 记成“付款及时的人”，而不是付款动作。

gloss_zh: 混乱的混合物；杂乱状态（常用于 ħallata ballata）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A confusing mixture, used almost exclusively in the expression 'ħallata ballata' for chaos or things mixed together indiscriminately.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 令人混淆的混合物或杂乱状态，几乎总用于 ħallata ballata，表示混乱或各种东西不加区分地混在一起。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħlita mħawda; tintuża kważi dejjem fl-espressjoni 'ħallata ballata' għal kaos jew affarijiet imħallta bla ordni.

sense_translations.en_definition: confusing mixture (used almost exclusively in the expression 'ħallata ballata', meaing 'chaos' or 'indiscriminate mixture')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人混淆的混合物；几乎仅用于 ħallata ballata 这一表达，意为混乱，或各种东西不加区分地混在一起。

formal.mt: Il-fajls għandhom jiġu kklassifikati skont is-suġġett, sabiex l-arkivju ma jsirx ħallata ballata.
formal.en: The files should be classified by subject so that the archive does not become a jumble.
formal.zh: 文件应按主题分类，以免档案变得杂乱无章。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn poġġejt l-irċevuta? Mark: F'dan il-kexxun, imma kollox ħallata ballata. Ejja nfittxuha flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you put the receipt? Mark: In this drawer, but everything is in a jumble. Let's look for it together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你把收据放哪儿了？马克：在这个抽屉里，可里面乱成一团。我们一起找吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 你把收据放哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did you put the receipt?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dan il-kexxun, imma kollox ħallata ballata. Ejja nfittxuha flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: F'dan il-kexxun, imma kollox ħallata ballata. Ejja nfittxuha flimkien.
messages.zh: 在这个抽屉里，可里面乱成一团。我们一起找吧。
messages.en: In this drawer, but everything is in a jumble. Let's look for it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħallata ballata 当作完整词组反复念，配上抽屉里纸张乱成一团的画面，记住“杂乱混合”。

gloss_zh: 促成混合的；容易使人混淆的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to mix things together or to make ideas difficult to distinguish or understand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于使事物混合在一起，或使概念难以区分和理解的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jħallat affarijiet flimkien jew iħawwad l-ideat u l-fehim.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于使不同事物混合在一起的。
容易造成混淆、使人理解不清的。

formal.mt: Il-mekkaniżmu ħallati jgħin biex iż-żewġ likwidi jitħalltu sew.
formal.en: The mixing mechanism helps the two liquids mix thoroughly.
formal.zh: 这个促成混合的机制有助于让两种液体充分混合。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan id-diskors ħallati; ma fhimt xejn. Pawlu: Ejja nieħdu punt wieħed kull darba.
colloquial.en: Maja: This speech is confusing; I didn't understand anything. Pawlu: Let's take one point at a time.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这番话让人混淆，我一点也没听懂。Pawlu：我们一次看一个要点吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan id-diskors ħallati; ma fhimt xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Dan id-diskors ħallati; ma fhimt xejn.
messages.zh: 这番话让人混淆，我一点也没听懂。
messages.en: This speech is confusing; I didn't understand anything.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nieħdu punt wieħed kull darba.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nieħdu punt wieħed kull darba.
messages.zh: 我们一次看一个要点吧。
messages.en: Let's take one point at a time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两杯液体混在一起，再把两条解释混在一起：前者记“促成混合”，后者记“造成混淆”。

gloss_zh: 使人做梦；激发想象或幻想

teaching_sense.en_definition: To inspire someone to dream or imagine ideas, including ideas that may be far-fetched or impossible to realise.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人产生梦境、想象或念头，也可指激发不切实际或难以实现的幻想。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqanqal ħolm jew ideat f'xi ħadd, anki ideat li jistgħu jkunu 'l bogħod mir-realtà jew impossibbli li jitwettqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人产生梦境或梦想，唤起做梦般的想象。

sense_translations.en_definition: to inspire ideas (often far-fetched or unrealisable)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 激发想法或幻想，所产生的念头往往不切实际或无法实现。

collocations.zh: 激发了孩子们的梦想或想象
使听众产生了梦想或幻想

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont ħallem lit-tfal, li bdew jimmaġinaw vjaġġ lejn il-qamar.
formal.en: The story inspired the children to dream, and they began imagining a journey to the moon.
formal.zh: 这个故事激发了孩子们的想象，他们开始幻想一趟月球之旅。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-film ħallem lil ħija. Mark: Iva, issa qed jimmaġina li jista' jtir!
colloquial.en: Lara: This film set my brother dreaming. Mark: Yes, now he's imagining that he can fly!
colloquial.zh: Lara：这部电影让我的兄弟浮想联翩。Mark：是啊，他现在正幻想自己能飞呢！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这部电影让我的兄弟浮想联翩。
messages.en: This film set my brother dreaming.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa qed jimmaġina li jista' jtir!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa qed jimmaġina li jista' jtir!
messages.zh: 是啊，他现在正幻想自己能飞呢！
messages.en: Yes, now he's imagining that he can fly!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“故事让孩子脑中冒出月球旅行”来记：重点是某事激发别人做梦或幻想这一动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who obtains milk by milking animals such as cows or goats.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从奶牛、山羊等动物身上挤取乳汁的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taħleb annimali, bħal baqar jew mogħoż, biex tiġbor il-ħalib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从动物身上挤奶的人；挤奶工。

formal.mt: Il-ħallieb jaħsel idejh u jħejji reċipjent nadif qabel jibda jaħleb.
formal.en: The milker washes his hands and prepares a clean container before starting to milk.
formal.zh: 挤奶人开始挤奶前，会洗手并准备一个干净的容器。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-ħallieb? Pawlu: Qiegħed mal-baqar; qed jiġbor il-ħalib.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the milker? Pawlu: He's with the cows, collecting the milk.
colloquial.zh: Maja：挤奶人在哪里？Pawlu：他在奶牛那边，正在收集牛奶。

messages.speaker: Maja (农场访客)
messages.zh: 挤奶人在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the milker?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场工作人员)
messages.zh: 他在奶牛那边，正在收集牛奶。
messages.en: He's with the cows, collecting the milk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词贴在“提着奶桶给牛挤奶的人”身上，记住它指人，画面中心是挤奶者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Producing or yielding milk, as an animal does.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 描述动物能够产生或提供乳汁的性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jipproduċi jew jagħti l-ħalib, bħalma jagħmel annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 产奶的；能够提供乳汁的。

formal.mt: Annimal ħalliebi jeħtieġ ilma nadif u għalf adattat biex jibqa' f'saħħtu.
formal.en: A milk-producing animal needs clean water and suitable feed to stay healthy.
formal.zh: 产奶动物需要干净的饮水和适当的饲料，以保持健康。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser annimal ħalliebi? Mark: Annimal li jagħti l-ħalib, bħal din il-baqra.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does a milk-producing animal mean? Mark: An animal that gives milk, like this cow.
colloquial.zh: Lara：“产奶动物”是什么意思？Mark：就是能提供奶的动物，像这头奶牛。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: “产奶动物”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does a milk-producing animal mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Annimal li jagħti l-ħalib, bħal din il-baqra.
messages.mt_standard: Annimal li jagħti l-ħalib, bħal din il-baqra.
messages.zh: 就是能提供奶的动物，像这头奶牛。
messages.en: An animal that gives milk, like this cow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给奶牛画一张写着“产奶的”的标签：这里记的是动物的性质，可与指挤奶人的 ħallieb 对照学习。

gloss_zh: 主持他人宣誓者；施行割礼者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who administers an oath to another person; in a separate sense, a person who performs circumcision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主持他人宣誓、使他人立誓的人；另一个独立义项指施行割礼的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tamministra ġurament lil ħaddieħor; f'tifsira separata, persuna li twettaq ċirkonċiżjoni.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who puts others under oath
sense_translations.zh_definition: 主持他人宣誓、使他人在誓言约束下作出陈述的人。
施行割礼的人。

collocations.en: the person administering the oath and the witness
the circumciser who performs the circumcision

formal.mt: Il-ħallief talab lix-xhud jaħlef li kien se jgħid il-verità.
formal.en: The person administering the oath asked the witness to swear that he would tell the truth.
formal.zh: 主持宣誓者要求证人宣誓，保证自己将如实陈述。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu l-ħallief f'din ix-xena? Pawlu: Dak li qed jitlob lix-xhud jaħlef li se jgħid il-verità.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is the person administering the oath in this scene? Pawlu: The one asking the witness to swear that he will tell the truth.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个场景里谁是主持宣誓者？Pawlu：就是那个要求证人宣誓会如实陈述的人。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这个场景里谁是主持宣誓者？
messages.en: Who is the person administering the oath in this scene?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak li qed jitlob lix-xhud jaħlef li se jgħid il-verità.
messages.mt_standard: Dak li qed jitlob lix-xhud jaħlef li se jgħid il-verità.
messages.zh: 就是那个要求证人宣誓会如实陈述的人。
messages.en: The one asking the witness to swear that he will tell the truth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为两个义项各画一张独立卡片：“主持宣誓的人”和“施行割礼的人”，根据上下文选择，勿把两种职责合并。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the authority to administer an oath to another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有主持他人宣誓、使他人立誓的权限的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu s-setgħa jamministra ġurament lil persuna oħra.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the right to administer an oath
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有主持他人宣誓的权利或权限的。

collocations.en: an official authorised to administer oaths
a role carrying authority to administer oaths
collocations.zh: 具有主持宣誓权限的职务

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, l-uffiċjal ħalliefi għandu s-setgħa jamministra l-ġurament lix-xhud.
formal.en: In this example, the official authorised to administer oaths has the authority to administer the oath to the witness.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，这位有权主持宣誓的官员具有主持证人宣誓的权限。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Xi jfisser uffiċjal ħalliefi? Lara: Uffiċjal li għandu s-setgħa jamministra ġurament.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does an official authorised to administer oaths mean? Lara: An official who has the authority to administer an oath.
colloquial.zh: Mark：“有权主持宣誓的官员”是什么意思？Lara：就是具有主持宣誓权限的官员。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: “有权主持宣誓的官员”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does an official authorised to administer oaths mean?

messages.speaker: Lara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Uffiċjal li għandu s-setgħa jamministra ġurament.
messages.mt_standard: Uffiċjal li għandu s-setgħa jamministra ġurament.
messages.zh: 就是具有主持宣誓权限的官员。
messages.en: An official who has the authority to administer an oath.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象官员胸前有一张“可主持宣誓”的权限卡：这个形容词强调获有权限，而不是本人正在宣誓。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who dreams or imagines things they hope for; sometimes someone whose ideas are unrealistic.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做梦或怀有梦想的人；也可指想法脱离现实、不切实际的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li toħlom jew timmaġina dak li tixtieq; kultant persuna li l-ideat tagħha ma jqisux ir-realtà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 做梦的人；怀有梦想、喜欢想象的人。
想法不切实际、没有充分考虑现实条件的人。

collocations.en: a dreamer with no practical sense
collocations.zh: 缺乏实际判断力的梦想家

formal.mt: L-awtur jippreżenta lill-karattru prinċipali bħala ħalliem li jixtieq jibdel id-dinja.
formal.en: The author presents the main character as a dreamer who wishes to change the world.
formal.zh: 作者把主人公塑造成一位希望改变世界的梦想家。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu jrid jibni dar ħdejn il-baħar, iżda għadu ma ffranka xejn. Mark: Hu ħalliem, imma jista' jibda bi pjan żgħir.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu wants to build a house by the sea, but he hasn't saved anything yet. Mark: He's a dreamer, but he can start with a small plan.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu想在海边盖房子，可他还一点钱都没存。Mark：他是个梦想家，不过可以先从一个小计划开始。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu jrid jibni dar ħdejn il-baħar, iżda għadu ma ffranka xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu jrid jibni dar ħdejn il-baħar, iżda għadu ma ffranka xejn.
messages.zh: Pawlu想在海边盖房子，可他还一点钱都没存。
messages.en: Pawlu wants to build a house by the sea, but he hasn't saved anything yet.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu ħalliem, imma jista' jibda bi pjan żgħir.
messages.mt_standard: Hu ħalliem, imma jista' jibda bi pjan żgħir.
messages.zh: 他是个梦想家，不过可以先从一个小计划开始。
messages.en: He's a dreamer, but he can start with a small plan.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人画着未来蓝图：有行动时是“梦想家”，只顾幻想时可能是“不切实际的人”。用同一幅画记住两种语气。

gloss_zh: 爱幻想的；梦幻般的；引人入梦的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dreamy in mood or manner, resembling a dream, or encouraging dreams.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容神情或心境爱幻想、事物如梦一般，或能够引发梦境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri ħsieb mitluf fil-ħolm, li jixbah ħolma, jew li jqanqal il-ħolm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱幻想的；神情出神、沉浸在遐想中的。
如梦一般的；具有梦幻感的。
引发梦境的；使人进入梦境的。

formal.mt: Id-dawl artab jagħti lill-pajsaġġ dehra ta' ħolma u joħloq effett ħalliemi.
formal.en: The soft light gives the landscape the appearance of a dream and creates a dreamlike effect.
formal.zh: 柔和的光线使景色宛如梦境，营造出梦幻般的效果。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-ġnien jidher ħalliemi bid-dwal mixgħula. Nina: Iva, qisu post minn ħolma.
colloquial.en: Lara: This garden looks dreamlike with the lights on. Nina: Yes, it's like a place from a dream.
colloquial.zh: Lara：灯一亮，这个花园看起来好梦幻。Nina：是啊，简直像梦里的地方。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ġnien jidher ħalliemi bid-dwal mixgħula.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ġnien jidher ħalliemi bid-dwal mixgħula.
messages.zh: 灯一亮，这个花园看起来好梦幻。
messages.en: This garden looks dreamlike with the lights on.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，简直像梦里的地方。
messages.en: Yes, it's like a place from a dream.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个形容词配上三张图：出神的目光、梦幻的风景、引人入梦的场景；分别记住“爱幻想、如梦、引梦”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A worker who dresses or prepares cotton for further processing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 整理棉花、使其适合后续加工的工人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaddiem li jnaddaf u jħejji l-qoton għal aktar ipproċessar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 棉花整理工，即对棉花进行整理、为后续加工做准备的人。

formal.mt: Il-ħallieġ iħejji l-qoton sabiex ikun lest għall-istadju li jmiss tal-ipproċessar.
formal.en: The cotton-dresser prepares the cotton so that it is ready for the next stage of processing.
formal.zh: 棉花整理工整理棉花，使其能够进入下一道加工工序。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jagħmel il-ħallieġ? Pawlu: Iħejji l-qoton biex ikun jista' jiġi pproċessat aktar.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does a cotton-dresser do? Pawlu: He prepares cotton so that it can be processed further.
colloquial.zh: Maja：棉花整理工做什么？Pawlu：他整理棉花，让棉花能够接受后续加工。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 棉花整理工做什么？
messages.en: What does a cotton-dresser do?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iħejji l-qoton biex ikun jista' jiġi pproċessat aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Iħejji l-qoton biex ikun jista' jiġi pproċessat aktar.
messages.zh: 他整理棉花，让棉花能够接受后续加工。
messages.en: He prepares cotton so that it can be processed further.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象工人面前是一堆等待整理的棉花，把“人、棉花、加工前准备”三个画面连起来记住这个职业名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action or process of combining different things so that they become mixed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把不同事物放到一起，使其相互混合的动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni jew il-proċess li tgħaqqad affarijiet differenti sabiex jitħalltu flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 混合；将不同成分搅拌或掺合在一起的过程。

formal.mt: Il-ħalt tal-ingredjenti għandu jsir bil-mod sakemm it-taħlita tkun lixxa.
formal.en: The mixing of the ingredients should be done slowly until the mixture is smooth.
formal.zh: 应慢慢混合各项配料，直至混合物变得顺滑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ħalt ta' dawn iż-żewġ kuluri jagħtina l-aħdar? Mark: Iva, ħallat il-blu mal-isfar u ara.
colloquial.en: Maja: Will mixing these two colours give us green? Mark: Yes, mix the blue with the yellow and see.
colloquial.zh: Maja：把这两种颜色混在一起会变成绿色吗？Mark：会，把蓝色和黄色混起来看看。

messages.speaker: Maja (美术课同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħalt ta' dawn iż-żewġ kuluri jagħtina l-aħdar?
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħalt ta' dawn iż-żewġ kuluri jagħtina l-aħdar?
messages.zh: 把这两种颜色混在一起会变成绿色吗？
messages.en: Will mixing these two colours give us green?

messages.speaker: Mark (美术课同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħallat il-blu mal-isfar u ara.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħallat il-blu mal-isfar u ara.
messages.zh: 会，把蓝色和黄色混起来看看。
messages.en: Yes, mix the blue with the yellow and see.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象画笔把蓝色和黄色搅在一起：ħalt指的是“混合”这个过程。用正在搅动的画面帮助记忆这个名词。

gloss_zh: 梳理纤维；梳棉、梳毛工序

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of separating and arranging textile fibres to prepare them for spinning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将纺织纤维分开、梳松并整理，以便后续纺纱的加工过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih il-fibri jinfirdu u jiġu rranġati biex jitħejjew għall-għażil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 梳理纤维的工序；把纤维梳松、分开并整理，为纺纱作准备。

formal.mt: Il-ħalġ tas-suf jifred il-fibri u jħejjihom għall-għażil.
formal.en: Wool carding separates the fibres and prepares them for spinning.
formal.zh: 羊毛梳理使纤维分开，为纺纱作准备。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nistgħu nibdew nagħżlu s-suf issa? Rita: Għadna rridu nagħmlu l-ħalġ biex nifirdu l-fibri.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can we start spinning the wool now? Rita: We still need to do the carding to separate the fibres.
colloquial.zh: Maja：现在可以开始纺羊毛了吗？Rita：还要先梳理，把纤维分开。

messages.speaker: Maja (手工课学员)
messages.zh: 现在可以开始纺羊毛了吗？
messages.en: Can we start spinning the wool now?

messages.speaker: Rita (手工课教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadna rridu nagħmlu l-ħalġ biex nifirdu l-fibri.
messages.mt_standard: Għadna rridu nagħmlu l-ħalġ biex nifirdu l-fibri.
messages.zh: 还要先梳理，把纤维分开。
messages.en: We still need to do the carding to separate the fibres.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħalġ 想成“纤维上纺车前先梳开”的步骤：先梳松、再纺线，用工序顺序帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something less dense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某种物质或混合物的密度降低。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel xi ħaġa inqas densa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 降低密度；使变得不那么稠密。

collocations.en: make less dense with a little water

formal.mt: Jekk it-taħlita tkun densa wisq, ħalħalha billi żżid ftit ilma u tħawwad sew.
formal.en: If the mixture is too dense, make it less dense by adding a little water and stirring well.
formal.zh: 如果混合物过于稠密，可加入少量水并充分搅拌，使其变稀。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din it-taħlita densa wisq. Mark: Ħalħalha bi ftit ilma u erġa' ħawwadha.
colloquial.en: Maja: This mixture is too dense. Mark: Make it less dense with a little water and stir it again.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这份混合物太稠了。马克：加一点水调稀，再搅拌一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这份混合物太稠了。
messages.en: This mixture is too dense.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħalħalha bi ftit ilma u erġa' ħawwadha.
messages.mt_standard: Ħalħalha bi ftit ilma u erġa' ħawwadha.
messages.zh: 加一点水调稀，再搅拌一下。
messages.en: Make it less dense with a little water and stir it again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一碗过稠的混合物，边加水边念 ħalħal，把动作记成“使密度降低”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Vulgar or crass behaviour or expression that shows a lack of manners, respect, or taste.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 言行中表现出的粗俗、粗鄙或无礼，带有对教养、尊重或品味不足的负面评价。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mġiba jew espressjoni baxxa u bla edukazzjoni li turi nuqqas ta' rispett jew ta' togħma tajba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粗俗；言语或行为中低俗、不雅的性质或表现。
粗鄙无礼；欠缺体谅、教养或品味的表现。

formal.mt: Il-kritika tista' tkun qawwija mingħajr ħamallaġni jew insulti personali.
formal.en: Criticism can be forceful without vulgarity or personal insults.
formal.zh: 批评可以有力度，同时避免粗俗言辞或人身侮辱。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Smajt kif beda jgħajjat u jinsulta lil kulħadd? Nina: Iva, dik kienet ħamallaġni. Seta' tkellem bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you hear how he started shouting and insulting everyone? Nina: Yes, that was crass behaviour. He could have spoken calmly.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你听见他怎么开始大喊大叫、辱骂所有人了吗？Nina：听见了，那样太粗鄙无礼了。他本可以平静地说话。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt kif beda jgħajjat u jinsulta lil kulħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Smajt kif beda jgħajjat u jinsulta lil kulħadd?
messages.zh: 你听见他怎么开始大喊大叫、辱骂所有人了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear how he started shouting and insulting everyone?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dik kienet ħamallaġni. Seta' tkellem bil-kalma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dik kienet ħamallaġni. Seta' tkellem bil-kalma.
messages.zh: 听见了，那样太粗鄙无礼了。他本可以平静地说话。
messages.en: Yes, that was crass behaviour. He could have spoken calmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“别这样粗俗无礼”的提醒场景：记住评价的是言行的粗鄙程度，并留意这个词带有明显的负面语气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Loud or vociferous, especially when describing someone who speaks or shouts noisily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人大声说话、喊叫或喧嚷，声音响亮而引人注意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitkellem jew jgħajjat b'leħen għoli u jagħmel ħafna storbju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大声喧嚷的；高声而强烈地表达意见的。
声音很大的；响亮或吵闹的。

collocations.zh: 高声表达诉求的抗议者

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, parteċipant ħambieqi għamilha diffiċli biex jinstemgħu l-opinjonijiet tal-oħrajn.
formal.en: During the meeting, a vociferous participant made it difficult for the others' opinions to be heard.
formal.zh: 会议期间，一名大声喧嚷的与会者使其他人的意见难以被听见。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed jitkellem daqshekk għoli Mark? Pawlu: Meta jara l-futbol isir ħambieqi ħafna!
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is Mark speaking so loudly? Pawlu: He gets very loud when he watches football!
colloquial.zh: Sara：Mark怎么说话这么大声？Pawlu：他一看足球就变得特别吵！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed jitkellem daqshekk għoli Mark?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed jitkellem daqshekk għoli Mark?
messages.zh: Mark怎么说话这么大声？
messages.en: Why is Mark speaking so loudly?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta jara l-futbol isir ħambieqi ħafna!
messages.mt_standard: Meta jara l-futbol isir ħambieqi ħafna!
messages.zh: 他一看足球就变得特别吵！
messages.en: He gets very loud when he watches football!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象看球时不断高声喊叫的朋友，把ħambieqi贴在这个人物旁；重点记“嗓门大、爱喧嚷”的声音特征。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 500, equal to five groups of one hundred.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数词五百，即五个一百，写作500。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 500, jiġifieri ħames gruppi ta' mitt wieħed.

formal.mt: L-ispiża totali tal-proġett hija ta' ħames mija ewro.
formal.en: The total cost of the project is five hundred euros.
formal.zh: 该项目的总费用为五百欧元。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm jiswa dan ir-rota? Sara: Ħames mija ewro. Mark: Se niffranka ftit aktar qabel nixtrih.
colloquial.en: Mark: How much does this bicycle cost? Sara: Five hundred euros. Mark: I'll save a little more before buying it.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这辆自行车多少钱？Sara：五百欧元。Mark：我再多存一点钱再买。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这辆自行车多少钱？
messages.en: How much does this bicycle cost?

messages.speaker: Sara (店员)
messages.zh: 五百欧元。
messages.en: Five hundred euros.

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Se niffranka ftit aktar qabel nixtrih.
messages.mt_standard: Se niffranka ftit aktar qabel nixtrih.
messages.zh: 我再多存一点钱再买。
messages.en: I'll save a little more before buying it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把五张各写着100的卡片排成一行，合起来读ħames mija；再添一张10，就练习ħames mija u għaxra。

gloss_zh: 五（ħamsa用于名词前的长定语形式）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The long attributive form of ħamsa, meaning five, used before certain nouns, as in ħamest ijiem, meaning five days.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数词ħamsa“五”用于某些名词前的长定语形式，例如ħamest ijiem表示“五天”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-forma attributtiva twila tan-numru ħamsa, użata quddiem ċerti nomi, bħal fil-frażi ħamest ijiem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: ħamsa（五）的长定语形式，用于修饰后面的某些名词。

formal.mt: Il-kors se jdum ħamest ijiem u se jinkludi eżerċizzji prattiċi.
formal.en: The course will last five days and will include practical exercises.
formal.zh: 课程将持续五天，并包含实践练习。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm se ddum hemm? Mark: Ħamest ijiem. Maja: Mela għandek ħin iżżur lil sħabek ukoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: How long will you stay there? Mark: Five days. Maja: Then you have time to visit your friends too.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你会在那里待多久？Mark：五天。Maja：那你也有时间去看看朋友了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你会在那里待多久？
messages.en: How long will you stay there?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 五天。
messages.en: Five days.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela għandek ħin iżżur lil sħabek ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Mela għandek ħin iżżur lil sħabek ukoll.
messages.zh: 那你也有时间去看看朋友了。
messages.en: Then you have time to visit your friends too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ħamest ijiem“五天”和ħamest itfal“五个孩子”整组朗读；用“数字五牵着后面的名词”记住它的定语用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 5,000, equal to five times one thousand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数词，表示五个一千，即五千。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 5,000, jiġifieri ħames darbiet elf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 五千。

formal.mt: Il-proġett irċieva għotja ta' ħamest elef ewro biex jinxtara tagħmir ġdid.
formal.en: The project received a grant of five thousand euros to buy new equipment.
formal.zh: 该项目获得了五千欧元的拨款，用于购买新设备。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm se jiswa x-xogħol? Mark: Ħamest elef ewro, kollox inkluż.
colloquial.en: Maja: How much will the work cost? Mark: Five thousand euros, with everything included.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这项工程要花多少钱？马克：五千欧元，所有费用都包括了。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这项工程要花多少钱？
messages.en: How much will the work cost?

messages.speaker: Mark (承包商)
messages.zh: 五千欧元，所有费用都包括了。
messages.en: Five thousand euros, with everything included.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把五叠各一千欧元的钞票想成一组，边数五叠边读 ħamest elef，记住整个短语表示五千。

gloss_zh: 向耕牛吆喝，使其贴近犁沟

teaching_sense.en_definition: To shout to a cow during ploughing so that it stays close to the furrow and keeps adjacent furrows close together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 犁地时向牛吆喝，使牛贴近犁沟行进，从而让相邻的犁沟保持紧密。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti għajta lill-baqra waqt il-ħrit biex tibqa' qrib ir-radda u r-raddi jibqgħu qrib xulxin.

sense_translations.en_definition: ploughman's shout to the cow to keep close to the furrow and thus keep the furrows close to one another
sense_translations.zh_definition: 耕作者向牛吆喝，叫它紧贴犁沟行进，从而使各条犁沟彼此靠近。

collocations.en: shouted to the cow to keep it close to the furrow
collocations.zh: 向牛吆喝，让它贴近犁沟

collocations.en: gave the furrow-guiding shout while ploughing
collocations.zh: 犁地时吆喝，引导牛贴着犁沟走

formal.mt: Il-bidwi ħameż lill-baqra biex tibqa' qrib ir-radda u r-raddi ma jitbegħdux minn xulxin.
formal.en: The farmer shouted to the cow to keep it close to the furrow so that the furrows would not become too widely spaced.
formal.zh: 农夫向牛吆喝，让它贴近犁沟行进，避免犁沟之间的间距过大。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ħameż il-bidwi? Pawlu: Biex il-baqra tibqa' qrib ir-radda u r-raddi jibqgħu qrib xulxin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the farmer give that shout? Pawlu: To keep the cow close to the furrow and the furrows close together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：农夫为什么那样吆喝？保罗：为了让牛贴近犁沟走，使犁沟之间保持紧密。

messages.speaker: Maja (学徒)
messages.zh: 农夫为什么那样吆喝？
messages.en: Why did the farmer give that shout?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex il-baqra tibqa' qrib ir-radda u r-raddi jibqgħu qrib xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Biex il-baqra tibqa' qrib ir-radda u r-raddi jibqgħu qrib xulxin.
messages.zh: 为了让牛贴近犁沟走，使犁沟之间保持紧密。
messages.en: To keep the cow close to the furrow and the furrows close together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住田间画面：农夫一声吆喝，牛贴着犁沟走。用这个完整动作记 ħameż，重点是吆喝所起的引导作用。

gloss_zh: 烘焙；激励或煽动；（土地）焦灼的；（食物）酸的

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity or process of cooking bread, cakes, or other food in an oven.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在烤箱中制作面包、蛋糕或其他食物的活动或过程，即烘焙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess ta' tisjir ta' ħobż, kejkijiet jew ikel ieħor fil-forn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烘焙；用烤箱烤制食物的活动或过程。
激励、促动或煽动；促使他人采取行动。
焦灼的；用于形容土地或土壤被灼热烤焦的状态。
酸的；用于形容食物带有明显酸味。

formal.mt: Waqt il-ħami tal-ħobż, żomm it-temperatura tal-forn kostanti u segwi l-ħin indikat fir-riċetta.
formal.en: While baking bread, keep the oven temperature constant and follow the time indicated in the recipe.
formal.zh: 烘焙面包时，保持烤箱温度恒定，并遵循食谱标明的时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm idum il-ħami ta' dan il-ħobż? Mark: Madwar nofs siegħa; ara r-riċetta għall-ħin eżatt.
colloquial.en: Maja: How long does this bread take to bake? Mark: About half an hour; check the recipe for the exact time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个面包要烤多久？马克：大约半小时，具体时间看看食谱。

messages.speaker: Maja (烘焙学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm idum il-ħami ta' dan il-ħobż?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm idum il-ħami ta' dan il-ħobż?
messages.zh: 这个面包要烤多久？
messages.en: How long does this bread take to bake?

messages.speaker: Mark (面包师)
messages.mt_spoken: Madwar nofs siegħa; ara r-riċetta għall-ħin eżatt.
messages.mt_standard: Madwar nofs siegħa; ara r-riċetta għall-ħin eżatt.
messages.zh: 大约半小时，具体时间看看食谱。
messages.en: About half an hour; check the recipe for the exact time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用烤箱里的面包记住 ħami 的烘焙义；再做四格卡分别画烤面包、促人行动、焦灼土地和酸味食物，并标清前两格是名词、后两格是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Thursday, the day of the week between Wednesday and Friday.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 星期四，即星期三之后、星期五之前的一天。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-jum tal-ġimgħa bejn l-Erbgħa u l-Ġimgħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 星期四。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa tal-kumitat se ssir nhar il-Ħamis fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: The committee meeting will take place on Thursday at nine in the morning.
formal.zh: 委员会会议将于星期四上午九点举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta se niltaqgħu? Mark: Nhar il-Ħamis wara x-xogħol. Maja: Tajjeb, narak il-Ħamis!
colloquial.en: Maja: When shall we meet? Mark: On Thursday after work. Maja: Great, see you on Thursday!
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们什么时候见面？Mark：星期四下班后。Maja：好，星期四见！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们什么时候见面？
messages.en: When shall we meet?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 星期四下班后。
messages.en: On Thursday after work.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，星期四见！
messages.en: Great, see you on Thursday!

cognitive_memory_aid: 在日历的星期四一格写上 Ħamis，再把自己的固定约会标进去，用具体日程记住这个星期名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Soil, sand, and other sediment carried by flowing water and deposited on land.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 流水搬运后沉积下来的泥土、沙粒等物质，即冲积物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal bħall-ħamrija u r-ramel li jinġarr mill-ilma ġieri u jitħalla fuq l-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冲积物；流水搬运并沉积下来的泥、沙等物质。

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi saff ta' ħamla magħmul minn ramel u ħama li ħalla x-xmara.
formal.en: The study describes a layer of alluvium made up of sand and silt deposited by the river.
formal.zh: 该研究描述了一层由河流沉积的沙和淤泥组成的冲积物。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dan is-saff ħdejn ix-xmara? Pawlu: Din hi ħamla, materjal li ġarr u ħalla l-ilma. Lara: Mela dan ir-ramel ġabu l-ilma.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this layer beside the river? Pawlu: This is alluvium, material carried and deposited by the water. Lara: So the water brought this sand here.
colloquial.zh: Lara：河边这一层是什么？Pawlu：这是冲积物，是水搬运并沉积下来的物质。Lara：原来这些沙是水带来的。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 河边这一层是什么？
messages.en: What is this layer beside the river?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Din hi ħamla, materjal li ġarr u ħalla l-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Din hi ħamla, materjal li ġarr u ħalla l-ilma.
messages.zh: 这是冲积物，是水搬运并沉积下来的物质。
messages.en: This is alluvium, material carried and deposited by the water.

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 原来这些沙是水带来的。
messages.en: So the water brought this sand here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象流水退去后留下一层泥沙，把这层沉积物标作 ħamla；记住它指留下的物质。

gloss_zh: 使发红的；具有致红作用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an effect that makes something become red or redder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够使某物变红或颜色更红的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu effett li jagħmel xi ħaġa ħamra jew iżjed ħamra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有使某物发红或变得更红的作用的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-effett ħammari tal-prodott fuq il-wiċċ tal-materjal.
formal.en: The report describes the product's reddening effect on the surface of the material.
formal.zh: 报告描述了该产品使材料表面变红的作用。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex dan il-kampjun sar iżjed aħmar? Toni: Il-prodott li żidna għandu effett ħammari. Nina: Iva, issa nara d-differenza fil-kulur.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why has this sample become redder? Toni: The product we added has a reddening effect. Nina: Yes, now I can see the difference in colour.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个样品为什么变得更红了？Toni：我们加的产品有致红作用。Nina：对，现在我看出颜色的差别了。

messages.speaker: Nina (实验课学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan il-kampjun sar iżjed aħmar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan il-kampjun sar iżjed aħmar?
messages.zh: 这个样品为什么变得更红了？
messages.en: Why has this sample become redder?

messages.speaker: Toni (实验课教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-prodott li żidna għandu effett ħammari.
messages.mt_standard: Il-prodott li żidna għandu effett ħammari.
messages.zh: 我们加的产品有致红作用。
messages.en: The product we added has a reddening effect.

messages.speaker: Nina (实验课学生)
messages.zh: 对，现在我看出颜色的差别了。
messages.en: Yes, now I can see the difference in colour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一支把样品颜色变红的滴管，在旁边写 ħammari，把注意力放在“使其发红”的作用上。

gloss_zh: 乘以五；使成为原来的五倍

teaching_sense.en_definition: To multiply a number or quantity by five, making it five times its original value.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将一个数或数量乘以五，使它成为原来的五倍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li timmultiplika numru jew kwantità b'ħamsa, biex isiru ħames darbiet daqs kemm kienu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乘以五；使数量成为原来的五倍。

formal.mt: Biex jikkalkula l-ispiża għal ħames gruppi ndaqs, l-organizzatur ħammes l-ammont meħtieġ għal grupp wieħed.
formal.en: To calculate the cost for five equal-sized groups, the organiser multiplied the amount needed for one group by five.
formal.zh: 为计算五个同等规模小组的费用，组织者把一个小组所需的金额乘以五。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif wasal għal ħamsin minn għaxra? Ben: Ħammes in-numru: għaxra għal ħamsa jagħmlu ħamsin. Sara: Issa fhimt il-kalkolu.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did he get fifty from ten? Ben: He multiplied the number by five: ten times five is fifty. Sara: Now I understand the calculation.
colloquial.zh: Sara：他怎么从十算出五十的？Ben：他把数字乘以五：十乘五等于五十。Sara：现在我明白这个计算了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif wasal għal ħamsin minn għaxra?
messages.mt_standard: Kif wasal għal ħamsin minn għaxra?
messages.zh: 他怎么从十算出五十的？
messages.en: How did he get fifty from ten?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħammes in-numru: għaxra għal ħamsa jagħmlu ħamsin.
messages.mt_standard: Ħammes in-numru: għaxra għal ħamsa jagħmlu ħamsin.
messages.zh: 他把数字乘以五：十乘五等于五十。
messages.en: He multiplied the number by five: ten times five is fifty.

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 现在我明白这个计算了。
messages.en: Now I understand the calculation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在 ħammes 旁边写“10 × 5 = 50”，每次看到词就做一次乘五运算，记住结果是原来的五倍。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who carries loads or goods, especially as a job.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 搬运重物或货物的人，尤指以搬运为职业的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ġġorr tagħbijiet jew merkanzija, speċjalment bħala xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 搬运者；负责搬运物品或货物的人。

formal.mt: Il-ħammiel ġarr il-kaxxi mill-maħżen sal-vettura u qegħedhom b'attenzjoni.
formal.en: The carrier took the boxes from the warehouse to the vehicle and put them down carefully.
formal.zh: 搬运工把箱子从仓库搬到车辆旁，并小心地放好。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Din il-bagalja tqila wisq għalija. Mark: Hemm ħammiel ħdejn id-daħla; jista' jgħinek. Elena: Tajjeb, se nitolbu l-għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Elena: This suitcase is too heavy for me. Mark: There's a porter near the entrance; he can help you. Elena: All right, I'll ask him for help.
colloquial.zh: Elena：这个行李箱对我来说太重了。Mark：入口附近有位搬运工，他可以帮你。Elena：好，我去请他帮忙。

messages.speaker: Elena (旅客)
messages.zh: 这个行李箱对我来说太重了。
messages.en: This suitcase is too heavy for me.

messages.speaker: Mark (同行旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm ħammiel ħdejn id-daħla; jista' jgħinek.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm ħammiel ħdejn id-daħla; jista' jgħinek.
messages.zh: 入口附近有位搬运工，他可以帮你。
messages.en: There's a porter near the entrance; he can help you.

messages.speaker: Elena (旅客)
messages.zh: 好，我去请他帮忙。
messages.en: All right, I'll ask him for help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象车站里替旅客搬行李的人，把 ħammiel 写在他的工作牌上，用搬运这个动作记住人物名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A prepared bed for sowing seeds and raising seedlings, or a nursery where young plants are grown.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供播种和培育幼苗使用的苗床，也可指培育幼小植物的育苗圃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Medda art imħejjija għaż-żrigħ u t-tkabbir tax-xtieli, jew post fejn jitrabbew pjanti żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 苗床；经过整理、供播种和培育幼苗使用的土床。
育苗圃；专门培育幼苗和幼小植物的场所。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi ħejja ħammiela għaż-żrigħ tal-ħass, filwaqt li l-ħammiela tas-siġar fir-raħal kabbar fiha siġar żgħar għat-tħawwil.
formal.en: The farmer prepared a seed-bed for sowing lettuce, while in the village tree nursery he grew young trees for planting.
formal.zh: 农民整理了一块用于播种生菜的苗床，同时在村里的树木育苗圃中培育供移栽的小树。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn se niżirgħu l-ħass? Ġużi: Fil-ħammiela ż-żgħira ħdejn il-ħajt. Anna: U s-siġar żgħar minn fejn se nġibuhom? Ġużi: Mill-ħammiela tas-siġar fir-raħal.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where shall we sow the lettuce? Ġużi: In the small seed-bed beside the wall. Anna: And where shall we get the young trees? Ġużi: From the tree nursery in the village.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我们把生菜种在哪里？Ġużi：种在墙边的小苗床里。Anna：那小树从哪里买来？Ġużi：从村里的树木育苗圃买。

messages.speaker: Anna (园艺学员)
messages.zh: 我们把生菜种在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we sow the lettuce?

messages.speaker: Ġużi (园丁)
messages.zh: 种在墙边的小苗床里。
messages.en: In the small seed-bed beside the wall.

messages.speaker: Anna (园艺学员)
messages.mt_spoken: U s-siġar żgħar minn fejn se nġibuhom?
messages.mt_standard: U s-siġar żgħar minn fejn se nġibuhom?
messages.zh: 那小树从哪里买来？
messages.en: And where shall we get the young trees?

messages.speaker: Ġużi (园丁)
messages.zh: 从村里的树木育苗圃买。
messages.en: From the tree nursery in the village.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一块播种的小苗床，再画一处培育小树的苗圃，两幅图都标 ħammiela，把两个义项一起记牢。

gloss_zh: 用于搬运的；具有承载功能的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Serving to carry or transport things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 描述具有承载或搬运物品功能的装置、工具等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jservi biex iġorr jew jittrasporta l-oġġetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有承载或搬运物品功能的。

formal.mt: L-apparat ħammieli jintuża biex iġorr il-kaxxi fil-maħżen.
formal.en: The carrying equipment is used to transport boxes in the warehouse.
formal.zh: 这套搬运设备用于在仓库内搬运箱子。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan l-apparat ħammieli jista' jġorr din il-kaxxa? Rita: Iva, poġġiha fuqu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can this carrying equipment carry this box? Rita: Yes, put it on there.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这台搬运设备能搬这个箱子吗？丽塔：能，把箱子放上去吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (仓库员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-apparat ħammieli jista' jġorr din il-kaxxa?
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-apparat ħammieli jista' jġorr din il-kaxxa?
messages.zh: 这台搬运设备能搬这个箱子吗？
messages.en: Can this carrying equipment carry this box?

messages.speaker: Rita (仓库同事)
messages.zh: 能，把箱子放上去吧。
messages.en: Yes, put it on there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个形容词贴在搬运设备的图上，看到它就想“能承载、能搬东西”，并连读 apparat ħammieli。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stove that provides heat for cooking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提供烹饪热源、可用于加热锅具和食物的炉子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jipprovdi s-sħana għat-tisjir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 炉子；供烹饪使用的炉灶。

formal.mt: Qabel tibda ssajjar, kun żgur li l-ħammiem huwa nadif.
formal.en: Before you start cooking, make sure the stove is clean.
formal.zh: 开始做饭前，请确保炉灶干净。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn inpoġġi l-borma? Pawlu: Poġġiha fuq il-ħammiem, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where should I put the pot? Pawlu: Put it on the stove, please.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：锅放在哪里？保罗：请把它放到炉子上。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 锅放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put the pot?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 请把它放到炉子上。
messages.en: Put it on the stove, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一口锅放在炉灶上，把 ħammiem 与“炉子上的锅”整幅画面一起记，练习 borma fuq il-ħammiem。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes things or places dirty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品或地方弄脏的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħammeġ l-affarijiet jew il-postijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弄脏物品或环境的人。

collocations.en: a thoughtless person who makes things dirty
collocations.zh: 不顾他人、把东西弄脏的人

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, il-ħammieġ tal-bitħa jitgħallem jiġbor l-iskart tiegħu u jżomm il-post nadif.
formal.en: In the story, the person who dirties the yard learns to pick up his rubbish and keep the place clean.
formal.zh: 故事中，把院子弄脏的人学会了收拾自己的垃圾，并保持环境清洁。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Min ħalla dan it-tajn kollu mal-art? Leo: Jien il-ħammieġ illum; dħalt biż-żraben mimlijin tajn. Marta: Mela ġib il-mopp u naddaf.
colloquial.en: Marta: Who left all this mud on the floor? Leo: I'm the one making a mess today; I came in with muddy shoes. Marta: Then get the mop and clean up.
colloquial.zh: Marta：谁把地板弄得到处是泥？Leo：今天弄脏这里的是我；我穿着沾满泥的鞋进来了。Marta：那就拿拖把来清理吧。

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min ħalla dan it-tajn kollu mal-art?
messages.mt_standard: Min ħalla dan it-tajn kollu mal-art?
messages.zh: 谁把地板弄得到处是泥？
messages.en: Who left all this mud on the floor?

messages.speaker: Leo (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien il-ħammieġ illum; dħalt biż-żraben mimlijin tajn.
messages.mt_standard: Jien il-ħammieġ illum; dħalt biż-żraben mimlijin tajn.
messages.zh: 今天弄脏这里的是我；我穿着沾满泥的鞋进来了。
messages.en: I'm the one making a mess today; I came in with muddy shoes.

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.zh: 那就拿拖把来清理吧。
messages.en: Then get the mop and clean up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个穿泥鞋留下脚印的人，在人物旁标上 ħammieġ，牢牢记住这个名词指弄脏东西的人。

gloss_zh: 会弄脏东西的；造成污秽的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing things or places to become dirty or filthy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 会使物品或地方变脏、产生污秽的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jikkawża ħmieġ jew iħammeġ l-affarijiet jew il-postijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 造成污垢或污秽的；会把东西弄脏的。

collocations.zh: 容易把东西弄脏的工作

formal.mt: It-tħin tal-materjal huwa proċess ħammieġi li jħalli trab fin fuq l-uċuħ tal-kamra.
formal.en: Grinding the material is a process that produces dirt, leaving fine dust on the surfaces in the room.
formal.zh: 研磨这种材料会产生污垢，并在房间内的各处表面留下细尘。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex qed tgħatti l-mejda? Sam: Dan xogħol ħammieġi; se jaqa' ħafna trab. Rita: Tajjeb, ngħatti s-siġġijiet ukoll.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why are you covering the table? Sam: This is messy work; a lot of dust will fall. Rita: All right, I'll cover the chairs too.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你为什么把桌子盖起来？Sam：这活儿会弄脏东西，会落下很多灰尘。Rita：好，我也把椅子盖起来。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把桌子盖起来？
messages.en: Why are you covering the table?

messages.speaker: Sam (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan xogħol ħammieġi; se jaqa' ħafna trab.
messages.mt_standard: Dan xogħol ħammieġi; se jaqa' ħafna trab.
messages.zh: 这活儿会弄脏东西，会落下很多灰尘。
messages.en: This is messy work; a lot of dust will fall.

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 好，我也把椅子盖起来。
messages.en: All right, I'll cover the chairs too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħammieġi 写在扬起灰尘的工作场景旁，练说 xogħol ħammieġi，记住它描述会造成脏污的性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of the planet Mars.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 行星火星的名称，本条作为专名学习。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem il-pjaneta li bl-Ingliż tissejjaħ Mars.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 火星，指这颗行星的专名。

formal.mt: L-istudenti kitbu rapport dwar il-wiċċ ta' Ħamra.
formal.en: The students wrote a report about the surface of Mars.
formal.zh: 学生们撰写了一份关于火星表面的报告。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema pjaneta qed tpinġi? Ben: Qed inpinġi Ħamra għall-proġett tal-iskola.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which planet are you drawing? Ben: I'm drawing Mars for the school project.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你在画哪颗行星？本：我在为学校的课题画火星。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你在画哪颗行星？
messages.en: Which planet are you drawing?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 我在为学校的课题画火星。
messages.en: I'm drawing Mars for the school project.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在行星图的火星旁写上大写 Ħamra，看到首字母大写就提醒自己：本条记的是行星专名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or connected with Hamrun.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自哈姆伦、属于哈姆伦或与哈姆伦有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Ħamrun jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Ħamrun.

sense_translations.en_definition: of, from or relating to Hamrun
sense_translations.zh_definition: 哈姆伦的；来自哈姆伦或与该地有关的。
哈姆伦人；出生于哈姆伦或居住在该地的人。

formal.mt: L-artiklu jiddeskrivi l-kontribut ta' artist Ħamruniż għall-ħajja kulturali tal-belt.
formal.en: The article describes the contribution of an artist from Hamrun to the town's cultural life.
formal.zh: 这篇文章介绍了一位哈姆伦艺术家对当地文化生活的贡献。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int Ħamruniż? Mark: Iva, noqgħod il-Ħamrun.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you from Hamrun? Mark: Yes, I live in Hamrun.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你是哈姆伦人吗？马克：是的，我住在哈姆伦。

messages.speaker: Maja (新朋友)
messages.zh: 你是哈姆伦人吗？
messages.en: Are you from Hamrun?

messages.speaker: Mark (哈姆伦居民)
messages.zh: 是的，我住在哈姆伦。
messages.en: Yes, I live in Hamrun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张卡片分别记“哈姆伦的艺术家”和“一个哈姆伦人”，让同一个词对应形容词与名词两种用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number 95, equal to ninety plus five.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数词九十五，表示九十加五的数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 95, jiġifieri disgħin u ħamsa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 九十五；数字95。

formal.mt: Il-ktieb fih ħamsa u disgħin paġna.
formal.en: The book contains ninety-five pages.
formal.zh: 这本书共有九十五页。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm tiswa din il-mejda? Rita: Tiswa ħamsa u disgħin ewro.
colloquial.en: Mark: How much does this table cost? Rita: It costs ninety-five euros.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这张桌子多少钱？丽塔：九十五欧元。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这张桌子多少钱？
messages.en: How much does this table cost?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: 九十五欧元。
messages.en: It costs ninety-five euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“五＋和＋九十”的顺序记 ħamsa u disgħin：先说个位五，再说九十，合起来就是95。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number 45, equal to forty plus five.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数词四十五，表示四十加五的数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 45, jiġifieri erbgħin u ħamsa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 四十五；数字45。

formal.mt: It-taħriġ idum ħamsa u erbgħin minuta.
formal.en: The training session lasts forty-five minutes.
formal.zh: 这次培训持续四十五分钟。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm idum il-vjaġġ? Pawlu: Madwar ħamsa u erbgħin minuta.
colloquial.en: Lara: How long does the journey take? Pawlu: About forty-five minutes.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：路上要花多长时间？保罗：大约四十五分钟。

messages.speaker: Lara (乘客)
messages.zh: 路上要花多长时间？
messages.en: How long does the journey take?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (司机)
messages.zh: 大约四十五分钟。
messages.en: About forty-five minutes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把45拆成“五＋和＋四十”，顺着念 ħamsa u erbgħin，再联想四十五分钟的一段行程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number 25, equal to twenty plus five.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数词二十五，表示二十加五的数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 25, jiġifieri għoxrin u ħamsa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 二十五；数字25。

formal.mt: Għal dan il-kors hemm ħamsa u għoxrin post.
formal.en: There are twenty-five places available on this course.
formal.zh: 这门课程设有二十五个名额。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm se jiġu nies għall-ikla? Ben: Se jiġu ħamsa u għoxrin persuna.
colloquial.en: Maja: How many people are coming to the meal? Ben: Twenty-five people are coming.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：有多少人会来吃饭？本：会来二十五个人。

messages.speaker: Maja (聚餐组织者)
messages.zh: 有多少人会来吃饭？
messages.en: How many people are coming to the meal?

messages.speaker: Ben (聚餐协办者)
messages.mt_spoken: Se jiġu ħamsa u għoxrin persuna.
messages.mt_standard: Se jiġu ħamsa u għoxrin persuna.
messages.zh: 会来二十五个人。
messages.en: Twenty-five people are coming.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在25旁边标注“五＋和＋二十”，用 ħamsa u għoxrin 数聚餐人数，记住个位先出现的顺序。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 75, used for counting or stating an amount.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数词七十五，用来计数或说明数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 75, użat biex jingħadd xi ħaġa jew biex tingħata kwantità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 七十五。

formal.mt: Il-miżata għall-kors hija ta' ħamsa u sebgħin ewro.
formal.en: The fee for the course is seventy-five euros.
formal.zh: 该课程的费用为七十五欧元。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kemm swiet il-mejda? Pawlu: Ħamsa u sebgħin ewro.
colloquial.en: Marija: How much did the table cost? Pawlu: Seventy-five euros.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这张桌子花了多少钱？保罗：七十五欧元。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 这张桌子花了多少钱？
messages.en: How much did the table cost?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 七十五欧元。
messages.en: Seventy-five euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按词序记成“五和七十”：ħamsa 是五，u 是和，sebgħin 是七十，合起来就是七十五。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 35, used for counting or stating an amount.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数词三十五，用来计数或说明数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 35, użat biex jingħadd xi ħaġa jew biex tingħata kwantità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 三十五。

formal.mt: Il-preżentazzjoni se ddum ħamsa u tletin minuta.
formal.en: The presentation will last thirty-five minutes.
formal.zh: 报告将持续三十五分钟。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kemm qrajt illum? Mark: Qrajt ħamsa u tletin paġna.
colloquial.en: Anna: How much did you read today? Mark: I read thirty-five pages.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你今天读了多少？马克：我读了三十五页。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 你今天读了多少？
messages.en: How much did you read today?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 我读了三十五页。
messages.en: I read thirty-five pages.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三十五倒着拆成“五和三十”：ħamsa 加 u，再接 tletin；先说个位五，再说十位三十。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 85, used for counting or stating an amount.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数词八十五，用来计数或说明数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 85, użat biex jingħadd xi ħaġa jew biex tingħata kwantità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 八十五。

formal.mt: Id-distanza bejn iż-żewġt ibliet hija ta' ħamsa u tmenin kilometru.
formal.en: The distance between the two cities is eighty-five kilometres.
formal.zh: 两座城市之间的距离为八十五公里。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm ġibt fl-eżami? David: Ġibt ħamsa u tmenin punt.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did you score in the exam? David: I scored eighty-five points.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你考试得了多少分？戴维：我得了八十五分。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你考试得了多少分？
messages.en: What did you score in the exam?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.zh: 我得了八十五分。
messages.en: I scored eighty-five points.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“五和八十”的顺序：ħamsa 是五，tmenin 是八十，中间用 u 连接，就得到八十五。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number 55, equal to fifty plus five.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数词五十五，表示五十加五的数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 55, jiġifieri ħamsin u ħamsa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 五十五；数字55。

formal.mt: Is-sala għandha ħamsa u ħamsin siġġu għall-parteċipanti.
formal.en: The hall has fifty-five chairs for the participants.
formal.zh: 大厅为参加者准备了五十五把椅子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm għandna siġġijiet għall-laqgħa? Mark: Għandna ħamsa u ħamsin siġġu.
colloquial.en: Lara: How many chairs do we have for the meeting? Mark: We have fifty-five chairs.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：我们为会议准备了多少把椅子？马克：我们有五十五把椅子。

messages.speaker: Lara (会议组织者)
messages.zh: 我们为会议准备了多少把椅子？
messages.en: How many chairs do we have for the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (会务同事)
messages.zh: 我们有五十五把椅子。
messages.en: We have fifty-five chairs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排写 ħamsa＝五、ħamsin＝五十，中间加 u，读成“五和五十”，就能把整个短语与55对应起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An individual piece or small lump of dirt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一块或一小团具体的污物、脏东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa jew ċappa żgħira ta' ħmieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一块污物；一点脏东西。

collocations.en: a piece of dirt on the table

formal.mt: Neħħi kull ħamġa minn fuq il-mejda qabel tibda tipprepara l-ikel.
formal.en: Remove every piece of dirt from the table before you begin preparing food.
formal.zh: 开始准备食物之前，清除桌上的每一块污物。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hemm ħamġa fuq il-mejda. Mark: Fejn? Sara: Ħdejn it-tazza; neħħiha b'ċarruta.
colloquial.en: Sara: There's a piece of dirt on the table. Mark: Where? Sara: Next to the cup; remove it with a cloth.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：桌上有块脏东西。马克：在哪儿？萨拉：杯子旁边，用抹布把它清掉。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 桌上有块脏东西。
messages.en: There's a piece of dirt on the table.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 在哪儿？
messages.en: Where?

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 杯子旁边，用抹布把它清掉。
messages.en: Next to the cup; remove it with a cloth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指指着桌上一小块脏东西说 ħamġa；把它记成看得见、能清走的一块污物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To speak with a nasal voice, sounding as though the speech comes through the nose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用带鼻音的声音说话，听起来像声音从鼻子里发出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitkellem b'leħen nażali, bħallikieku l-ħoss joħroġ mill-imnieħer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 带鼻音说话；说话时声音听起来像从鼻子里发出。

collocations.en: gave his reply in a nasal voice

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-qari, l-attur ħamħam biex jagħti lill-karattru leħen nażali.
formal.en: In the reading exercise, the actor spoke through his nose to give the character a nasal voice.
formal.zh: 在朗读练习中，演员带鼻音说话，以赋予角色一种鼻音声线。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ħamħam l-attur f'dik ix-xena? Mark: Għax il-karattru tiegħu jitkellem b'leħen nażali.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the actor speak through his nose in that scene? Mark: Because his character speaks with a nasal voice.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：演员在那场戏里为什么带鼻音说话？马克：因为他扮演的角色说话带鼻音。

messages.speaker: Maja (观众)
messages.zh: 演员在那场戏里为什么带鼻音说话？
messages.en: Why did the actor speak through his nose in that scene?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-karattru tiegħu jitkellem b'leħen nażali.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-karattru tiegħu jitkellem b'leħen nażali.
messages.zh: 因为他扮演的角色说话带鼻音。
messages.en: Because his character speaks with a nasal voice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 朗读 ħamħam 时，想象演员故意带鼻音说一句台词；把这个词和说话的动作绑定，记住它是动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a person who has a nasal speaking voice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人说话的声音带鼻音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu leħen nażali meta jitkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 说话带鼻音的；形容具有鼻音声线的人。

collocations.en: a man with a nasal voice
a speaker with a nasal voice

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru ewlieni huwa raġel ħamħiemi li jitkellem bil-mod u b'mod ċar.
formal.en: In the story, the main character is a man with a nasal voice who speaks slowly and clearly.
formal.zh: 故事中的主人公是一名说话带鼻音的男子，他说话缓慢而清楚。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif nagħraf lill-karattru fir-reġistrazzjoni? Pawlu: Huwa ħamħiemi; isma' l-leħen nażali tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Sara: How can I recognize the character in the recording? Pawlu: He has a nasal voice; listen for that nasal quality.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我怎么在录音里辨认出那个角色？保罗：他说话带鼻音，留意他的鼻音就行。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 我怎么在录音里辨认出那个角色？
messages.en: How can I recognize the character in the recording?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa ħamħiemi; isma' l-leħen nażali tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa ħamħiemi; isma' l-leħen nażali tiegħu.
messages.zh: 他说话带鼻音，留意他的鼻音就行。
messages.en: He has a nasal voice; listen for that nasal quality.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给故事人物贴一张写着“说话带鼻音的”的描述卡，再配上 ħamħiemi；用人物特征记住它的形容词用法。

gloss_zh: 带鼻音的说话；鼻音说话声

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or sound of speaking in a nasal voice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带鼻音说话这一行为，或由此产生的说话声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-taħdit b'leħen nażali, jew il-ħoss ta' dan it-taħdit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 带鼻音说话；以鼻音发出的说话声。

formal.mt: Fir-reġistrazzjoni, il-ħamħim tal-attur jagħti lill-karattru leħen li jintgħaraf faċilment.
formal.en: In the recording, the actor's nasal speech gives the character an easily recognizable voice.
formal.zh: 在录音中，演员带鼻音的说话方式赋予角色一种容易辨认的声音。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak il-ħoss fir-reġistrazzjoni? Mark: Dak il-ħamħim tal-attur; qed jagħmel leħen nażali għall-karattru.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that sound in the recording? Mark: That's the actor's nasal speech; he's giving the character a nasal voice.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：录音里那是什么声音？马克：那是演员带鼻音的说话声，他在为角色塑造鼻音声线。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 录音里那是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that sound in the recording?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-ħamħim tal-attur; qed jagħmel leħen nażali għall-karattru.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-ħamħim tal-attur; qed jagħmel leħen nażali għall-karattru.
messages.zh: 那是演员带鼻音的说话声，他在为角色塑造鼻音声线。
messages.en: That's the actor's nasal speech; he's giving the character a nasal voice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象录音机录下一段带鼻音的说话声，把这段声音标为 ħamħim；记忆焦点是说话现象或声音本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who speaks with a nasal voice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话时声音带鼻音的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li titkellem b'leħen nażali.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who speaks through his nose
sense_translations.zh_definition: 说话带鼻音的人；声音听起来像从鼻子里发出的人。

collocations.en: a person with a nasal voice speaking
collocations.zh: 一个带鼻音的人在说话

collocations.en: the voice of someone who speaks nasally

formal.mt: Fil-qari tar-rakkont, l-attur jagħti leħen nażali lill-karattru deskritt bħala ħamħum.
formal.en: When reading the story, the actor gives a nasal voice to the character described as a person who speaks through his nose.
formal.zh: 朗读故事时，演员用鼻音演绎那个被描述为说话带鼻音者的角色。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser ħamħum f'din is-sentenza? Pawlu: Persuna li titkellem b'leħen nażali.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does ħamħum mean in this sentence? Pawlu: A person who speaks with a nasal voice.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这句话里的 ħamħum 是什么意思？保罗：指说话带鼻音的人。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 ħamħum 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does ħamħum mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.zh: 指说话带鼻音的人。
messages.en: A person who speaks with a nasal voice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在记忆卡上画一个正在带鼻音说话的人，人物下方写 ħamħum；记住这个名词指人，ħamħim 则指说话现象。

gloss_zh: 阿拉伯字母符号 hamza；喉塞音符号

teaching_sense.en_definition: An Arabic writing sign that represents a glottal stop.
