teaching_sense.zh_definition: 阿拉伯文字中表示喉塞音的书写符号，称为 hamza。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sinjal fil-kitba Għarbija li jirrappreżenta waqfa glottali.

sense_translations.en_definition: hamza (Arabic sign representing a glottal stop)
sense_translations.zh_definition: hamza，阿拉伯文字中表示喉塞音的符号。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti għandhom jagħrfu l-ħamża fil-kliem Għarbi.
formal.en: In this exercise, students should identify the hamza in Arabic words.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，学生应辨认阿拉伯语单词中的 hamza 符号。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dan is-sinjal? Omar: Din il-ħamża; tirrappreżenta waqfa glottali.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is this sign? Omar: This is the hamza; it represents a glottal stop.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这是什么符号？奥马尔：这是 hamza，表示喉塞音。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这是什么符号？
messages.en: What is this sign?

messages.speaker: Omar (教师)
messages.zh: 这是 hamza，表示喉塞音。
messages.en: This is the hamza; it represents a glottal stop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħamża 与“喉头短暂关闭再放开”的发音动作配对记忆：它是表示喉塞音的书写符号。

gloss_zh: 使声音嘶哑；勒住脖子；扼制；使窒息

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a voice hoarse; also to strangle or suffocate someone, or severely restrict something's development.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使声音嘶哑；也可指勒住某人的脖子、使人窒息，或严重压制某事物的发展。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel il-leħen isir maħnuq; ukoll jagħfas għonq xi ħadd, iċaħħdu mill-arja, jew irażżan bil-qawwa l-iżvilupp ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使声音变得嘶哑。
勒住脖子，使无法正常呼吸；扼颈。

sense_translations.en_definition: to drastically limit sth. from flourishing
sense_translations.zh_definition: 严重限制某事物的成长或繁荣；扼制其发展。
使某人因缺乏空气而窒息。

formal.mt: In-nuqqas ta' fondi ħanaq l-iżvilupp tal-proġett.
formal.en: The lack of funds stifled the project's development.
formal.zh: 资金短缺严重阻碍了项目的发展。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex leħnek hekk? Pawlu: L-għajjat fil-logħba ħanaq leħni.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why does your voice sound like that? Pawlu: Shouting at the match made my voice hoarse.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你的声音怎么这样了？保罗：比赛时大喊把我的嗓子喊哑了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的声音怎么这样了？
messages.en: Why does your voice sound like that?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 比赛时大喊把我的嗓子喊哑了。
messages.en: Shouting at the match made my voice hoarse.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“声音、呼吸、发展都受阻”的画面串联各义：声音受阻会嘶哑，呼吸受阻会窒息，发展受阻则被扼制；这是学习联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a building to deteriorate and fall into ruin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指建筑物逐渐衰败、变得破败。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jispiċċa fi stat ta' ħerba; jingħad dwar bini.

sense_translations.en_definition: to fall into ruin (used of buildings)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 衰败而变得破败，用于建筑物。

collocations.en: fell into ruin through lack of maintenance

formal.mt: Il-bini ħandem wara snin twal mingħajr manutenzjoni.
formal.en: The building fell into ruin after many years without maintenance.
formal.zh: 这座建筑因多年缺乏维护而变得破败。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif spiċċa l-palazz il-qadim? Mark: Ħandem; għal snin sħaħ ħadd ma ħa ħsiebu.
colloquial.en: Anna: What became of the old palace? Mark: It fell into ruin; nobody looked after it for years.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：那座老宫殿后来怎么样了？马克：变得破败了，好多年都没人维护。

messages.speaker: Anna (居民)
messages.zh: 那座老宫殿后来怎么样了？
messages.en: What became of the old palace?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħandem; għal snin sħaħ ħadd ma ħa ħsiebu.
messages.mt_standard: Ħandem; għal snin sħaħ ħadd ma ħa ħsiebu.
messages.zh: 变得破败了，好多年都没人维护。
messages.en: It fell into ruin; nobody looked after it for years.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħandem 配上一张无人维护的旧楼照片，记住它说的是“建筑物变得破败”，重点在建筑的状态变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be pampered or looked after with excessive care and attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到娇养，被给予过多的照顾和关爱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirċievi kura u attenzjoni żejda u jkun imfissed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到娇养或过分细致的呵护。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel ħanes għax il-familja kienet tagħtih kura u attenzjoni żejda.
formal.en: In the story, the boy was cosseted because his family gave him excessive care and attention.
formal.zh: 故事中的男孩受到娇养，因为家人给了他过多的照顾和关爱。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif mar Pawlu għand in-nanna? David: Ħanes hemm; kienet tagħmillu dak kollu li jrid.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did Pawlu get on at his grandmother's? David: He was pampered there; she did everything he wanted for him.

messages.mt_standard: Ħanes hemm; kienet tagħmillu dak kollu li jrid.
messages.zh: 他在那里被宠着，想要什么祖母都满足他。
messages.en: He was pampered there; she did everything he wanted for him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人被家人照顾得事事不用自己动手，用这个画面记 ħanes 的“受到娇养”；句中主语是被呵护的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To annoy someone or make them feel irritated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人感到烦躁或恼火；惹恼某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idejjaq lil xi ħadd jew iġiegħlu jħossu irritat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使烦躁；惹恼。

formal.mt: Il-ħoss kontinwu ħanfes lill-istudenti waqt il-lezzjoni.
formal.en: The continuous noise irritated the students during the lesson.
formal.zh: 持续不断的噪声使上课的学生感到烦躁。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Mark kien imdejjaq? Omar: Il-ħoss tat-telefon ħanfes lil Mark waqt li kien jaqra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why was Mark annoyed? Omar: The sound of the phone irritated Mark while he was reading.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克为什么不高兴？奥马尔：他看书时，电话的声音让他很烦躁。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么不高兴？
messages.en: Why was Mark annoyed?

messages.speaker: Omar (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħoss tat-telefon ħanfes lil Mark waqt li kien jaqra.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħoss tat-telefon ħanfes lil Mark waqt li kien jaqra.
messages.zh: 他看书时，电话的声音让他很烦躁。
messages.en: The sound of the phone irritated Mark while he was reading.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象看书时电话反复响起，让人皱眉烦躁；把 ħanfes 和“某事惹恼某人”的完整情景一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The edge of a tile.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 瓷砖边沿的部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tarf jew ix-xifer ta' maduma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 瓷砖的边缘或边沿。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ix-xifer ta' maduma.

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, il-ħaddiem innota li l-ħanka tal-maduma kienet miksura.
formal.en: During the inspection, the worker noticed that the edge of the tile was broken.
formal.zh: 检查时，工人发现这块瓷砖的边缘已经破损。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-maduma tajba? Mark: Ħares lejn il-ħanka; hemm biċċa nieqsa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this tile all right? Mark: Look at the edge; a piece is missing.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这块瓷砖没问题吗？Mark：看看边缘，那里缺了一块。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这块瓷砖没问题吗？
messages.en: Is this tile all right?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħares lejn il-ħanka; hemm biċċa nieqsa.
messages.mt_standard: Ħares lejn il-ħanka; hemm biċċa nieqsa.
messages.zh: 看看边缘，那里缺了一块。
messages.en: Look at the edge; a piece is missing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象检查一块瓷砖，目光沿四周边沿移动：ħanka 指瓷砖的边缘，把它和 maduma 一起记。

gloss_zh: 扼住某人的喉咙；勒某人的脖子

teaching_sense.en_definition: To strangle someone by applying pressure to their neck and preventing them from breathing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 掐住或勒住某人的脖子，使其无法呼吸；词义本身不必然说明对方已经死亡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għafas għonq xi ħadd b'mod li ma jħallihx jieħu n-nifs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扼住某人的喉咙或勒住某人的脖子，使其窒息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għafas għonq persuna u żammilha n-nifs.

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-ħalliel ħannaq lill-gwardjan, iżda l-gwardjan baqa' ħaj.
formal.en: In the novel, the thief strangled the guard, but the guard survived.
formal.zh: 小说中，窃贼扼住了警卫的喉咙，但警卫活了下来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel il-ħalliel fil-film? Toni: Ħannaq lill-gwardjan, imma mbagħad waslet l-għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did the thief do in the film? Toni: He strangled the guard, but then help arrived.
colloquial.zh: Maja：电影里的窃贼做了什么？Toni：他扼住了警卫的喉咙，不过随后有人赶来救援。

messages.speaker: Maja (观影同伴)
messages.zh: 电影里的窃贼做了什么？
messages.en: What did the thief do in the film?

messages.speaker: Toni (观影同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħannaq lill-gwardjan, imma mbagħad waslet l-għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Ħannaq lill-gwardjan, imma mbagħad waslet l-għajnuna.
messages.zh: 他扼住了警卫的喉咙，不过随后有人赶来救援。
messages.en: He strangled the guard, but then help arrived.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħannaq 记成故事里的“扼喉”动作：脖子受压、呼吸受阻；不要自动把它翻成已经致死。

gloss_zh: 给容器雕刻边沿；讨好某人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To carve an edge around a vessel; also, to try to gain someone's favour by pleasing them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 沿容器周围雕刻出边沿；另一个义项是通过迎合某人来博取其好感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Naqqax xifer madwar reċipjent; f'sens ieħor, fittex li jogħġob lil xi ħadd biex jikseb il-favur tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to carve an edge around a vessel
sense_translations.zh_definition: 沿容器周围雕刻出一道边沿。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Naqqax xifer madwar reċipjent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 讨好某人；通过奉承或迎合来博取某人的好感。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fittex li jikseb il-favur ta' xi ħadd billi jogħġbu jew ifaħħru.

collocations.en: carved an edge around a vessel
collocations.zh: 给一个容器雕刻了边沿

formal.mt: L-artiġjan ħannek ir-reċipjent b'attenzjoni, u ħoloq xifer imnaqqax madwaru.
formal.en: The craftsperson carefully carved an edge around the vessel, creating a carved rim.
formal.zh: 工匠仔细地沿容器周围雕刻，做出了一圈雕刻边沿。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark faħħar lill-kap daqshekk? Toni: Ħannek miegħu għax ried favur.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark praise the boss so much? Toni: He was currying favour with him because he wanted a favour.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 为什么把上司夸得那么厉害？Toni：他想请上司帮忙，所以就讨好他。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: Mark 为什么把上司夸得那么厉害？
messages.en: Why did Mark praise the boss so much?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.zh: 他想请上司帮忙，所以就讨好他。
messages.en: He was currying favour with him because he wanted a favour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 ħannek 准备两张记忆卡：一张画容器的雕刻边沿，一张画讨好上司的人；按语境分别选义，不推断词源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To inspire mercy or compassion; also, to lull someone to sleep or caress them affectionately.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人产生怜悯或同情；也可表示哄某人入睡，或温柔地爱抚某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qanqal ħniena f'xi ħadd; jista' wkoll ifisser li raqqad lil xi ħadd bil-ħlewwa jew messu b'għożża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 唤起怜悯之情；使人心生同情。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qanqal sentiment ta' ħniena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻柔地哄某人入睡。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Raqqad lil xi ħadd bil-ħlewwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 温柔地抚摸；以亲昵的动作表达疼爱。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mess lil xi ħadd b'għożża u mħabba.

collocations.en: lulled the baby until it fell asleep
caressed the boy with a gentle touch

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont tat-tifel ħannen qalb is-semmiegħ, li ddeċieda li jgħinu.
formal.en: The boy's account moved the listener's heart to compassion, and he decided to help him.
formal.zh: 男孩的讲述使听者心生怜悯，听者决定帮助他。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tarbija għadha mqajma? Toni: Le, missierha ħannen lit-tarbija sakemm raqdet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the baby still awake? Toni: No, her father lulled her until she fell asleep.
colloquial.zh: Maja：宝宝还醒着吗？Toni：没有，她爸爸已经把她哄睡了。

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.zh: 宝宝还醒着吗？
messages.en: Is the baby still awake?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, missierha ħannen lit-tarbija sakemm raqdet.
messages.mt_standard: Le, missierha ħannen lit-tarbija sakemm raqdet.
messages.zh: 没有，她爸爸已经把她哄睡了。
messages.en: No, her father lulled her until she fell asleep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个温柔场景记 ħannen：听故事生怜悯、轻声哄宝宝睡、伸手爱抚孩子；三个义项分别记清。

gloss_zh: 植物名：Acanthus mollis（英语 bear's breech）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The plant called bear's breech, scientifically named Acanthus mollis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种植物的名称，指学名为 Acanthus mollis、英语称 bear's breech 的植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Acanthus mollis u bl-Ingliż bħala bear's breech.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 学名为 Acanthus mollis 的植物，英语名称为 bear's breech。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-pjanta Acanthus mollis.

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-botanika, l-istudenti qabblu ritratt tal-ħannewija ma' pjanta bit-tikketta Acanthus mollis.
formal.en: In the botany exercise, the students compared a photograph of bear's breech with a plant labelled Acanthus mollis.
formal.zh: 在植物学练习中，学生把 ħannewija 的照片与一株标有 Acanthus mollis 的植物进行了比较。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jisimha din il-pjanta? Lara: Din ħannewija; fuq it-tikketta hemm miktub Acanthus mollis.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's this plant called? Lara: It's bear's breech; the label says Acanthus mollis.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这种植物叫什么？Lara：马耳他语叫 ħannewija，标签上写着 Acanthus mollis。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 这种植物叫什么？
messages.en: What's this plant called?

messages.speaker: Lara (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Din ħannewija; fuq it-tikketta hemm miktub Acanthus mollis.
messages.mt_standard: Din ħannewija; fuq it-tikketta hemm miktub Acanthus mollis.
messages.zh: 马耳他语叫 ħannewija，标签上写着 Acanthus mollis。
messages.en: It's bear's breech; the label says Acanthus mollis.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给同一株植物挂两张标签：马耳他语 ħannewija，学名 Acanthus mollis；把两个名字配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The spiny bear's breech, a plant of the species Acanthus spinosus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指学名为 Acanthus spinosus 的带刺莨苕属植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-ispeċi Acanthus spinosus li għandha weraq bix-xewk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 带刺莨苕，学名为 Acanthus spinosus。

collocations.en: leaves of the spiny bear's breech
spiny bear's breech in the garden

formal.mt: It-tikketta fil-ġnien botaniku tidentifika din il-pjanta bħala ħannewija xewwekija, Acanthus spinosus.
formal.en: The label in the botanical garden identifies this plant as spiny bear's breech, Acanthus spinosus.
formal.zh: 植物园的标签将这株植物标为带刺莨苕，学名 Acanthus spinosus。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jisimha din il-pjanta? Mark: Din hi ħannewija xewwekija. Oqgħod attent għax għandha x-xewk.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's this plant called? Mark: This is spiny bear's breech. Be careful because it has spines.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这株植物叫什么？马克：这是带刺莨苕。小心，它有刺。

messages.speaker: Mark (园丁)

messages.mt_standard: Din hi ħannewija xewwekija. Oqgħod attent għax għandha x-xewk.

messages.en: This is spiny bear's breech. Be careful because it has spines.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组配上一张带刺叶片的植物图来记，看到它就回想植物标签上的 Acanthus spinosus。

gloss_zh: 生出蚯蚓；长长、伸长（尤指植物）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To produce earthworms, or to grow long, especially when said of plants.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指生出蚯蚓；也指长长或伸长，后一义尤其用于植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jipproduċi ħniex, jew jikber fit-tul, speċjalment meta jingħad għall-pjanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生出蚯蚓。

sense_translations.en_definition: to grow long (used especially of plants)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 长长、伸长，尤其用于描述植物。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport dwar it-tkabbir tal-pjanti, ġie nnutat li l-ħabaq ħannex matul l-aħħar ġimgħa.
formal.en: The report on plant growth noted that the basil had grown long over the past week.
formal.zh: 植物生长报告指出，罗勒在过去一周里长长了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-ħabaq ħannex ħafna! Pawlu: Veru, issa għandu bżonn aktar spazju.
colloquial.en: Sara: This basil has grown really long! Pawlu: It has; now it needs more space.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这罗勒长长了好多！保罗：是啊，现在它需要更多空间了。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 这罗勒长长了好多！
messages.en: This basil has grown really long!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, issa għandu bżonn aktar spazju.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, issa għandu bżonn aktar spazju.
messages.zh: 是啊，现在它需要更多空间了。
messages.en: It has; now it needs more space.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两格画面记两个动作：第一格堆肥里出现蚯蚓，第二格植物向外伸长；再按主语判断具体词义。

gloss_zh: 有磨刃作用的；能使刀刃锋利的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an effect that sharpens an edge or blade.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容能使刃口或刀刃变得锋利的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu effett li jsinn xifer jew xafra.

sense_translations.en_definition: having a sharpening effect on an edge or blade
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对刃口或刀刃具有磨利作用的。

collocations.en: a material with a sharpening effect

formal.mt: Il-materjal ħannieki ntuża biex ix-xifer tas-sikkina jerġa' jsir jaqta'.
formal.en: The material with a sharpening effect was used to make the knife's edge sharp again.
formal.zh: 这种有磨刃作用的材料被用来使刀口重新变得锋利。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Għaliex tuża dan il-materjal fuq is-sikkina? Rita: Għax hu ħannieki; jgħin biex ix-xifer isir jaqta'.
colloquial.en: Toni: Why are you using this material on the knife? Rita: Because it has a sharpening effect; it helps make the edge sharp.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：你为什么用这种材料磨刀？丽塔：因为它有磨刃作用，能帮助刀口变锋利。

messages.speaker: Toni (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tuża dan il-materjal fuq is-sikkina?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tuża dan il-materjal fuq is-sikkina?
messages.zh: 你为什么用这种材料磨刀？
messages.en: Why are you using this material on the knife?

messages.speaker: Rita (师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu ħannieki; jgħin biex ix-xifer isir jaqta'.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu ħannieki; jgħin biex ix-xifer isir jaqta'.
messages.zh: 因为它有磨刃作用，能帮助刀口变锋利。
messages.en: Because it has a sharpening effect; it helps make the edge sharp.

gloss_zh: 唱摇篮曲哄婴儿入睡的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who lulls an infant to sleep by singing a lullaby.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过唱摇篮曲安抚婴儿、使其入睡的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tkanta għanja biex traqqad tarbija.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who lulls an infant to sleep (by singing a lullaby)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 以唱摇篮曲的方式哄婴儿入睡的人。

collocations.en: a person who sings infants to sleep
a person with a sweet voice who sings infants to sleep
collocations.zh: 嗓音悦耳、唱歌哄婴儿入睡的人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ħannien kanta għanja bil-mod sakemm it-tarbija raqdet.
formal.en: In the story, the person lulling the infant sang a song slowly until the baby fell asleep.
formal.zh: 故事里，哄睡的人缓缓唱着歌，直到婴儿睡着。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min se jkanta lit-tarbija llejla? Ġanni: Jien se nkun il-ħannien tagħha; diġà għażilt għanja.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who's going to sing to the baby tonight? Ġanni: I'll be the one singing her to sleep; I've already chosen a song.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：今晚谁给宝宝唱歌？詹尼：我来唱歌哄她睡觉，我已经选好一首歌了。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 今晚谁给宝宝唱歌？
messages.en: Who's going to sing to the baby tonight?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien se nkun il-ħannien tagħha; diġà għażilt għanja.
messages.mt_standard: Jien se nkun il-ħannien tagħha; diġà għażilt għanja.
messages.zh: 我来唱歌哄她睡觉，我已经选好一首歌了。
messages.en: I'll be the one singing her to sleep; I've already chosen a song.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象婴儿床旁唱摇篮曲的人，把这个名词指向唱歌者；与 ħannieni 对照时，先记住这里回答的是谁。

gloss_zh: 有安抚催眠作用的；能哄人入睡的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a soothing effect that helps someone fall asleep.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容具有安抚、催人入睡作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu effett li jikkalma u jgħin lil xi ħadd jorqod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有安抚催眠、使人渐渐入睡的作用的。

formal.mt: Il-leħen ħannieni tal-qarrej għen lit-tfal jikkalmaw qabel l-irqad.
formal.en: The reader's lulling voice helped the children settle down before sleep.
formal.zh: 朗读者那令人安静欲睡的声音，帮助孩子们在睡前平静下来。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Qed jagħlaqlek għajnejk? Luqa: Iva, dan il-leħen ħannieni qed iraqqadni.
colloquial.en: Nina: Are your eyes closing? Luqa: Yes, this lulling voice is sending me to sleep.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你的眼睛都快闭上了？卢卡：是啊，这催人入睡的声音让我快睡着了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的眼睛都快闭上了？
messages.en: Are your eyes closing?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dan il-leħen ħannieni qed iraqqadni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dan il-leħen ħannieni qed iraqqadni.
messages.zh: 是啊，这催人入睡的声音让我快睡着了。
messages.en: Yes, this lulling voice is sending me to sleep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħannieni 写在轻柔声音和缓慢节奏旁，记成催人入睡的效果；对照 ħannien，区分形容效果与指称人物。

gloss_zh: 扼颈者；使嗓音嘶哑的东西

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who strangles, or something that causes hoarseness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指扼住他人颈部使其窒息的人；也指使嗓音变得嘶哑的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tifga lil xi ħadd billi tagħfaslu għonqu, jew xi ħaġa li ġġiegħel il-leħen isir maħnuq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扼住他人颈部使其窒息的人；扼颈者。
使嗓音嘶哑的东西。

collocations.en: smoke as something that causes hoarseness
collocations.zh: 作为致嗓音嘶哑之物的烟雾

formal.mt: Ix-xhud identifika lill-ħannieq u ddeskriva l-ħwejjeġ li kien liebes.
formal.en: The witness identified the strangler and described the clothes he was wearing.
formal.zh: 证人认出了扼颈者，并描述了他当时穿的衣服。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex sejjaħt lid-duħħan ħannieq? David: Għax jagħmilli leħni maħnuq.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did you call the smoke a cause of hoarseness? David: Because it makes my voice hoarse.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你为什么把烟雾称为使嗓音嘶哑的东西？戴维：因为它会让我嗓音沙哑。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么把烟雾称为使嗓音嘶哑的东西？
messages.en: Why did you call the smoke a cause of hoarseness?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.zh: 因为它会让我嗓音沙哑。
messages.en: Because it makes my voice hoarse.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张名词卡分开记：一张画扼颈的人，一张画使声音沙哑的烟雾；遇词先判断它指人还是指物。

gloss_zh: 扼颈致窒息的；使嗓音嘶哑的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a strangling effect, or causing the voice to become hoarse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容具有扼颈致窒息作用的，或会使嗓音嘶哑的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jifga billi jagħfas l-għonq, jew li jġiegħel il-leħen isir maħnuq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扼颈致窒息的；具有扼喉作用的。
使嗓音嘶哑的。

collocations.en: smoke that makes the voice hoarse

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iddeskriva l-għasir fuq l-għonq bħala ħannieqi.
formal.en: The report described the pressure on the neck as strangling.
formal.zh: 报告将颈部所受的挤压描述为具有扼颈致窒息作用。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Dan id-duħħan ħannieqi; leħni diġà nbidel. Samwel: Ejja noħorġu minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Elena: This smoke makes you hoarse; my voice has already changed. Samwel: Let's get out of here.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：这烟雾会让嗓音嘶哑，我的声音已经变了。萨姆韦尔：我们出去吧。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan id-duħħan ħannieqi; leħni diġà nbidel.
messages.mt_standard: Dan id-duħħan ħannieqi; leħni diġà nbidel.
messages.zh: 这烟雾会让嗓音嘶哑，我的声音已经变了。
messages.en: This smoke makes you hoarse; my voice has already changed.

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们出去吧。
messages.en: Let's get out of here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 ħannieqi 放在挤压或烟雾后面记搭配：它描述造成的作用；与名词 ħannieq 对照，留意末尾多出的 i。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A producer of worms; something that produces worms.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指产生虫的事物，即产虫者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dak li jipproduċi d-dud.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 产虫者；产生虫的东西。

collocations.en: compost as a producer of worms

formal.mt: Fin-noti tal-osservazzjoni, il-kompost ġie deskritt bħala ħanniex minħabba d-dud li deher fih.
formal.en: In the observation notes, the compost was described as a producer of worms because of the worms that appeared in it.
formal.zh: 观察笔记因堆肥中出现了虫，将这堆肥描述为产虫之物。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex sejjaħt lil dan il-kompost ħanniex? Pietru: Għax qed nuża l-kelma għal xi ħaġa li tipproduċi d-dud.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did you call this compost a producer of worms? Pietru: Because I'm using the word for something that produces worms.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你为什么把这堆肥称为产虫之物？彼得：因为我用这个词指产生虫的东西。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex sejjaħt lil dan il-kompost ħanniex?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex sejjaħt lil dan il-kompost ħanniex?
messages.zh: 你为什么把这堆肥称为产虫之物？
messages.en: Why did you call this compost a producer of worms?

messages.speaker: Pietru (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax qed nuża l-kelma għal xi ħaġa li tipproduċi d-dud.
messages.mt_standard: Għax qed nuża l-kelma għal xi ħaġa li tipproduċi d-dud.
messages.zh: 因为我用这个词指产生虫的东西。
messages.en: Because I'm using the word for something that produces worms.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħanniex 写在产虫者的名词卡上，与动词 ħannex 并排比较；用指事物和说动作两种句子区分，留意 ie 的拼写。

gloss_zh: 虫子大量滋生的；生满虫的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Full of worms, with worms growing or multiplying in it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某物里面有许多虫子，虫子正在其中滋生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun mimli dud li qed jikber jew jitkattar fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 虫子大量滋生的；生满虫的

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni nstab li l-frott fil-kaxxa kien ħanniexi.
formal.en: During the inspection, the fruit in the box was found to be infested with worms.
formal.zh: 检查时发现，箱子里的水果已经生满了虫。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex warrabt dak il-frott? Mark: Għax huwa ħanniexi; ara kemm fih dud.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you set that fruit aside? Mark: Because it is infested with worms; look how many there are inside.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么把那些水果放到一边？Mark：因为生满虫了；你看里面有多少虫。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把那些水果放到一边？
messages.en: Why did you set that fruit aside?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax huwa ħanniexi; ara kemm fih dud.
messages.mt_standard: Għax huwa ħanniexi; ara kemm fih dud.
messages.zh: 因为生满虫了；你看里面有多少虫。
messages.en: Because it is infested with worms; look how many there are inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它和切开水果后发现许多虫子的画面相连，记住它描述的是物品生虫的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A male pig, especially an adult one.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 雄性的猪，通常指成年公猪；在野生动物语境中可指雄性野猪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħanżir raġel, speċjalment wieħed adult.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公猪；雄性野猪

formal.mt: Ir-rapport isemmi ħannuf selvaġġ li deher ħdejn il-bosk.
formal.en: The report mentions a wild boar that was seen near the woods.
formal.zh: 报告提到，有人在树林附近看见了一头雄性野猪。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'annimal hemm f'dak ir-ritratt? Pawlu: Dak ħannuf selvaġġ; ħadt ir-ritratt mill-bogħod.
colloquial.en: Lara: What animal is in that photograph? Pawlu: That is a wild boar; I took the photograph from far away.
colloquial.zh: Lara：那张照片里是什么动物？Pawlu：那是一头雄性野猪；我是从远处拍的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那张照片里是什么动物？
messages.en: What animal is in that photograph?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (摄影爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ħannuf selvaġġ; ħadt ir-ritratt mill-bogħod.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ħannuf selvaġġ; ħadt ir-ritratt mill-bogħod.
messages.zh: 那是一头雄性野猪；我是从远处拍的。
messages.en: That is a wild boar; I took the photograph from far away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用动物识别卡记忆：先画一头猪，再标上雄性符号，把词义固定为公猪。

gloss_zh: 假笑作态的人；乏味的、无趣的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who smiles in an affected way or behaves insincerely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 笑容做作或行为虚假的人，强调其表现不自然、不真诚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li titbissem b'mod affettwat jew iġġib ruħha mingħajr sinċerità.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who simpers or exhibits fake behaviour
sense_translations.zh_definition: 假笑作态或表现虚假的人
乏味的、索然无趣的，用来形容人

collocations.en: to act in an affected or insincere way
collocations.zh: 表现得假惺惺、装模作样

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ħannux ifaħħar lil kulħadd, iżda kliemu ma jidhirx sinċier.
formal.en: In the story, the affected man praises everyone, but his words do not seem sincere.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个装模作样的人夸赞所有人，但他的话显得并不真诚。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex sejjaħtlu ħannux? David: Għax jitbissem u jfaħħrek, imma ma jidhirx sinċier.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you call him a phoney? David: Because he smiles and praises you, but he does not seem sincere.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你为什么说他是个假惺惺的人？David：因为他笑着夸你，却显得并不真诚。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么说他是个假惺惺的人？
messages.en: Why did you call him a phoney?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jitbissem u jfaħħrek, imma ma jidhirx sinċier.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jitbissem u jfaħħrek, imma ma jidhirx sinċier.
messages.zh: 因为他笑着夸你，却显得并不真诚。
messages.en: Because he smiles and praises you, but he does not seem sincere.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分成两张人物卡记忆：名词卡是假笑作态的人，形容词卡是让人觉得乏味的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Artificial or affected in manner, especially through an exaggerated or insincere smile.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容举止、语气或笑容不自然，带有刻意做作或假笑作态的意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri manjieri mhux naturali jew tbissim affettwat u mhux sinċier.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 做作的；矫揉造作的
假笑作态的；笑容忸怩做作的

formal.mt: L-attur uża ton ħannuxi biex juri li l-karattru ma kienx sinċier.
formal.en: The actor used an affected tone to show that the character was insincere.
formal.zh: 演员用做作的语气表现这个角色的不真诚。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif deherlek it-ton tiegħu? Ben: Kien ħannuxi wisq; ma deherx naturali.
colloquial.en: Sara: What did you think of his tone? Ben: It was far too affected; it did not seem natural.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你觉得他的语气怎么样？Ben：太做作了；听着不自然。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你觉得他的语气怎么样？
messages.en: What did you think of his tone?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien ħannuxi wisq; ma deherx naturali.
messages.mt_standard: Kien ħannuxi wisq; ma deherx naturali.
messages.zh: 太做作了；听着不自然。
messages.en: It was far too affected; it did not seem natural.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象演员故意摆出的笑容和拿腔拿调的声音，用这两个画面记住做作与假笑。

gloss_zh: 惯于劈砍的；动辄挥砍的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to cut or strike with slashing movements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容有劈砍、挥砍倾向的，强调惯常的动作方式或行为倾向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jaqta' jew jolqot b'daqqiet ta' xafra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有劈砍或挥砍倾向的；惯于挥砍的

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tar-rumanz, il-ġellied huwa deskritt bħala ħanxari minħabba t-tendenza tiegħu li jiġġieled b'daqqiet ta' xabla.
formal.en: In the analysis of the novel, the fighter is described as prone to slashing because of his tendency to fight with sweeping sword blows.
formal.zh: 在这篇小说分析中，该战士被描述为惯于挥砍，因为他打斗时倾向于挥剑劈砍。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex issejjaħ lil dan il-karattru ħanxari? Leo: Għax f'kull ġlieda jibda jxejjer ix-xabla u jagħti d-daqqiet.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why do you describe this character as prone to slashing? Leo: Because in every fight he starts swinging his sword and striking.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你为什么说这个角色惯于挥砍？Leo：因为每次打斗，他都会开始挥剑砍击。

messages.speaker: Marta (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex issejjaħ lil dan il-karattru ħanxari?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex issejjaħ lil dan il-karattru ħanxari?
messages.zh: 你为什么说这个角色惯于挥砍？
messages.en: Why do you describe this character as prone to slashing?

messages.speaker: Leo (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax f'kull ġlieda jibda jxejjer ix-xabla u jagħti d-daqqiet.
messages.mt_standard: Għax f'kull ġlieda jibda jxejjer ix-xabla u jagħti d-daqqiet.
messages.zh: 因为每次打斗，他都会开始挥剑砍击。
messages.en: Because in every fight he starts swinging his sword and striking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小说人物每次打斗都挥剑劈砍，抓住反复出现的倾向来记这个形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take root by developing small roots.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指植物长出小根并开始扎根。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li joħroġ għeruq żgħar u jibda jaqbad fil-ħamrija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扎根；开始生根
长出小根；生出细小的根

collocations.en: developed small roots in the pot

formal.mt: Wara ġimgħa, ix-xitel ħanxel fil-ħamrija niedja u dehru l-ewwel għeruq żgħar.
formal.en: After a week, the young plant took root in the moist soil, and the first small roots appeared.
formal.zh: 一周后，幼苗在湿润的土壤中生了根，最初的小根已经出现。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ix-xitel ħanxel diġà? Toni: Iva, ara l-għeruq żgħar ħdejn il-qiegħ tal-borma.
colloquial.en: Rita: Has the young plant taken root already? Toni: Yes, look at the little roots near the bottom of the pot.
colloquial.zh: Rita：幼苗已经生根了吗？Toni：是的，你看花盆底部附近的那些小根。

messages.speaker: Rita (园艺爱好者)
messages.zh: 幼苗已经生根了吗？
messages.en: Has the young plant taken root already?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara l-għeruq żgħar ħdejn il-qiegħ tal-borma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara l-għeruq żgħar ħdejn il-qiegħ tal-borma.
messages.zh: 是的，你看花盆底部附近的那些小根。
messages.en: Yes, look at the little roots near the bottom of the pot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象透明花盆里冒出第一批细小根须，把长小根到扎根的过程连起来记忆。

gloss_zh: 形容微笑忸怩做作的；小鳗鱼；婴儿安抚布

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a smile that is affected, coy, or insincere.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于形容微笑显得忸怩、做作或不真诚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiddeskrivi tbissim affettwat jew mhux sinċier.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容微笑忸怩做作的；带着假笑的
一条小鳗鱼

sense_translations.en_definition: a cloth used by infants as a comforter
sense_translations.zh_definition: 婴儿用来获得安慰、安定情绪的布；婴儿安抚布

collocations.en: a small eel in the water

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tbissim ħanxu tal-karattru jissuġġerixxi li l-kliem ġentili tiegħu mhuwiex sinċier.
formal.en: In the story, the character's simpering smile suggests that his kind words are insincere.
formal.zh: 故事中，这个角色忸怩做作的微笑暗示，他那些友善的话并不真诚。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn hu l-ħanxu tat-tarbija? Mark: Qiegħed fil-basket; ħa nġibu biex torqod bih.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where is the baby's comfort cloth? Mark: It is in the basket; I'll get it so she can sleep with it.
colloquial.zh: Anna：宝宝的安抚布在哪里？Mark：在篮子里；我去拿来，让她抱着睡。

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.zh: 宝宝的安抚布在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the baby's comfort cloth?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħed fil-basket; ħa nġibu biex torqod bih.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħed fil-basket; ħa nġibu biex torqod bih.
messages.zh: 在篮子里；我去拿来，让她抱着睡。
messages.en: It is in the basket; I'll get it so she can sleep with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画三格独立小图：做作的笑容、小鳗鱼、宝宝抱的安抚布；分别记词性和语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small root of a plant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物的一条小根或细小的根。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għerq żgħir ta' pjanta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一条小根；细小的根

collocations.en: a small root in the soil

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-pjanta, l-istudent innota ħanxul irqiq ħdejn il-bażi taz-zokk.
formal.en: While observing the plant, the student noticed a thin little root near the base of the stem.
formal.zh: 观察植物时，学生注意到茎的基部附近有一条细细的小根。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'inhu dak l-abjad fil-ħamrija? Sam: Dak ħanxul irqiq tal-pjanta; ħallih hemm.
colloquial.en: Lina: What is that white thing in the soil? Sam: That is a thin little root of the plant; leave it there.
colloquial.zh: Lina：土里那个白色的东西是什么？Sam：那是植物的一条细小根；让它留在那里吧。

messages.speaker: Lina (园艺初学者)
messages.zh: 土里那个白色的东西是什么？
messages.en: What is that white thing in the soil?

messages.speaker: Sam (园艺伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ħanxul irqiq tal-pjanta; ħallih hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ħanxul irqiq tal-pjanta; ħallih hemm.
messages.zh: 那是植物的一条细小根；让它留在那里吧。
messages.en: That is a thin little root of the plant; leave it there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把视线放到植物根部的一条细小根须上，记住这个名词指小根这一具体事物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The throat or larynx, especially in connection with the voice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 喉咙或喉头，尤其用于谈论发声及喉部的感觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-gerżuma jew il-parti tagħha marbuta mal-produzzjoni tal-vuċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喉咙；喉头，即与发声有关的喉部。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-gerżuma jew il-larinġi.

formal.mt: Wara l-kunċert, il-kantant ħass nixfa fil-ħanġra u xorob ftit ilma.
formal.en: After the concert, the singer felt dryness in his throat and drank some water.
formal.zh: 音乐会结束后，歌手感到喉咙干燥，喝了一点水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex m'intix tkanta magħna? Toni: Għandi uġigħ fil-ħanġra; illum se nisma' biss.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why aren't you singing with us? Toni: My throat hurts; today I'll just listen.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么不和我们一起唱？Toni：我喉咙疼，今天就听你们唱吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么不和我们一起唱？
messages.en: Why aren't you singing with us?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi uġigħ fil-ħanġra; illum se nisma' biss.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi uġigħ fil-ħanġra; illum se nisma' biss.
messages.zh: 我喉咙疼，今天就听你们唱吧。
messages.en: My throat hurts; today I'll just listen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħanġra 放进唱歌后喝水的画面：声音从喉部发出，唱久了喉咙会干。用场景记住词义。

gloss_zh: 用鼻音说话；说话带鼻音的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To speak with a nasal voice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话时带有明显鼻音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tkellem b'vuċi nażali, bħallikieku l-ħoss joħroġ mill-imnieħer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用鼻音说话；说话带鼻音。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tkellem b'vuċi nażali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 说话带鼻音的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li titkellem b'vuċi nażali.

collocations.en: used a nasal voice when he spoke

formal.mt: Matul il-qari fil-klassi, it-tifel ħanħan, u l-għalliema nnutat il-vuċi nażali tiegħu.
formal.en: During the classroom reading, the boy spoke nasally, and the teacher noticed his nasal voice.
formal.zh: 在课堂朗读时，男孩说话带着鼻音，老师注意到了他的鼻音。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Toni ħanħan waqt il-qari llum? Lara: Iva, innutajt il-vuċi nażali tiegħu wkoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Toni speak nasally during the reading today? Lara: Yes, I noticed his nasal voice too.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Toni 今天朗读时是不是带着鼻音？Lara：是啊，我也注意到了他的鼻音。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: Toni 今天朗读时是不是带着鼻音？
messages.en: Did Toni speak nasally during the reading today?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, innutajt il-vuċi nażali tiegħu wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, innutajt il-vuċi nażali tiegħu wkoll.
messages.zh: 是啊，我也注意到了他的鼻音。
messages.en: Yes, I noticed his nasal voice too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同学带着鼻音朗读：ħanħan 作动词记动作“用鼻音说”，作名词记人物“说话带鼻音的人”。

gloss_zh: 弄脏；玷污名誉；粗糙地做

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something dirty, damage someone's reputation, or do a task very roughly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西弄脏；损害某人的名誉；也可指做事十分粗糙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħammeġ xi ħaġa, itebba' r-reputazzjoni ta' xi ħadd, jew jagħmel xogħol b'mod goff ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弄脏，使沾上污物
玷污，损害某人的名声或信誉

sense_translations.en_definition: to carry out sth. very roughly
sense_translations.zh_definition: 十分粗糙地处理或完成某事

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ħanżer l-art biż-żebgħa waqt it-tiswija.
formal.en: The worker dirtied the floor with paint during the repair.
formal.zh: 工人在维修时用油漆弄脏了地板。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ħanżer l-art biż-żebgħa? Mark: Jien, skużani. Se nnaddafha issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who dirtied the floor with paint? Mark: I did, sorry. I'll clean it now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁用油漆弄脏了地板？马克：是我，对不起。我现在就清理。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 谁用油漆弄脏了地板？
messages.en: Who dirtied the floor with paint?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 是我，对不起。我现在就清理。
messages.en: I did, sorry. I'll clean it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个画面连起来记：地板被弄脏、名誉被抹黑、工作被做糙；共同抓住“把事情弄坏”的感觉。

gloss_zh: 潮虫；土豚；贪吃的陆生动物，尤指宠物

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woodlouse; also an aardvark, or a land animal, especially a pet, described as gluttonous.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指潮虫或土豚，也可用来形容贪吃的陆生动物，尤其是宠物；具体所指需结合语境判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal żgħir li jgħix f'postijiet niedja, bħal taħt il-ġebel; jista' jfisser ukoll aardvark jew annimal tal-art, speċjalment wieħed domestiku, li jiekol bla rażan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 潮虫，常见于石块下等潮湿处的小型陆生甲壳动物
土豚，一种主要以蚂蚁和白蚁为食的非洲哺乳动物

sense_translations.en_definition: a land animal, especially a pet, that acts gluttonous
sense_translations.zh_definition: 表现得贪吃的陆生动物，尤其指宠物

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni fil-ġnien, l-istudenta sabet ħanżir l-art taħt ġebla niedja.
formal.en: During an observation in the garden, the student found a woodlouse under a damp stone.
formal.zh: 在花园进行观察时，这名学生在一块潮湿的石头下发现了一只潮虫。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara, ħanżir l-art taħt il-ġebla! Pawlu: Rajtu. Erġa' poġġi l-ġebla bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look, a woodlouse under the stone! Pawlu: I see it. Put the stone back gently.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看，石头下面有一只潮虫！保罗：我看见了。轻轻把石头放回去。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，石头下面有一只潮虫！
messages.en: Look, a woodlouse under the stone!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我看见了。轻轻把石头放回去。
messages.en: I see it. Put the stone back gently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画三张语境卡来区分：石头下的潮虫、非洲的土豚、贪吃的宠物；同一词组靠场景辨义，不把三种动物混为一谈。

gloss_zh: 辱骂圣母玛利亚的粗俗亵渎咒语

teaching_sense.en_definition: To curse the Virgin Mary using an explicitly vulgar and blasphemous expression.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用直接辱骂圣母玛利亚的粗俗亵渎表达进行咒骂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jidgħi kontra l-Madonna bi kliem vulgari u offensiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: “操圣母玛利亚”，直接辱骂圣母的粗俗亵渎咒语

collocations.en: said "Fuck the Virgin Mary" in anger
collocations.zh: 愤怒地骂了一句“操圣母玛利亚”

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tad-djalogu, l-espressjoni "Ħaqq għal-Madonna" hija identifikata bħala dagħwa vulgari kontra l-Madonna.
formal.en: In the analysis of the dialogue, the expression "Fuck the Virgin Mary" is identified as vulgar blasphemy against the Virgin Mary.
formal.zh: 在对话分析中，“操圣母玛利亚”被归为针对圣母玛利亚的粗俗亵渎咒语。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser "Ħaqq għal-Madonna" f'dan il-film? Pawlu: Hija dagħwa kontra l-Madonna, vulgari ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does "Fuck the Virgin Mary" mean in this film? Pawlu: It's blasphemy against the Virgin Mary, and it's very vulgar.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这部电影里的“操圣母玛利亚”是什么意思？保罗：这是辱骂圣母的亵渎咒语，非常粗俗。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这部电影里的“操圣母玛利亚”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does "Fuck the Virgin Mary" mean in this film?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija dagħwa kontra l-Madonna, vulgari ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Hija dagħwa kontra l-Madonna, vulgari ħafna.
messages.zh: 这是辱骂圣母的亵渎咒语，非常粗俗。
messages.en: It's blasphemy against the Virgin Mary, and it's very vulgar.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整句放进“愤怒时的粗俗亵渎咒语”记忆格，连同冒犯程度一起记；看到 Madonna 时联系此处被辱骂的圣母。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To treat someone harshly and unfairly, especially by abusing power over them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以严酷而不公正的方式对待某人，尤其指滥用权力进行压迫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittratta lil xi ħadd b'mod aħrax u inġust, speċjalment billi jabbuża mill-poter tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 压迫，以权力或强势地位严酷、不公正地对待他人
压迫者，严酷而不公正地支配或对待他人的人

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif il-mexxej ħaqqar lill-poplu u ċaħħdu mid-drittijiet tiegħu.
formal.en: The report describes how the leader oppressed the people and deprived them of their rights.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这名领导者如何压迫人民，并剥夺他们的权利。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex telqu l-ħaddiema? Toni: Is-sid ħaqqarhom għal snin sħaħ. Fl-aħħar telqu lkoll.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did the workers leave? Toni: The owner oppressed them for years. Eventually they all left.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：工人们为什么离开了？托尼：老板压迫了他们好多年。最后他们全都走了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 工人们为什么离开了？
messages.en: Why did the workers leave?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sid ħaqqarhom għal snin sħaħ. Fl-aħħar telqu lkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Is-sid ħaqqarhom għal snin sħaħ. Fl-aħħar telqu lkoll.
messages.zh: 老板压迫了他们好多年。最后他们全都走了。
messages.en: The owner oppressed them for years. Eventually they all left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“谁压迫了谁”记动词，用“谁是压迫者”记名词；同形词分成动作卡和人物卡，词性就不会混。

gloss_zh: 压迫性的；严酷压制人的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Harsh and unjust in a way that restricts people's freedom or rights.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 严酷而不公正、压制他人自由或权利的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaħqar lin-nies u jillimita l-libertà jew id-drittijiet tagħhom b'mod aħrax u inġust.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 压迫性的，以严酷而不公正的方式限制他人自由或权利的

formal.mt: Il-ktieb janalizza l-effetti ta' reġim ħaqqari fuq il-libertà tal-espressjoni.
formal.en: The book analyses the effects of an oppressive regime on freedom of expression.
formal.zh: 这本书分析了压迫性政权对言论自由的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kien il-mexxej fl-istorja? Mark: Kien ħaqqari. Ħadd ma seta' jikkritikah.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was the leader in the story like? Mark: He was oppressive. Nobody could criticise him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：故事里的领导者是怎样的人？马克：他很专横，压迫别人。谁都不能批评他。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 故事里的领导者是怎样的人？
messages.en: What was the leader in the story like?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien ħaqqari. Ħadd ma seta' jikkritikah.
messages.mt_standard: Kien ħaqqari. Ħadd ma seta' jikkritikah.
messages.zh: 他很专横，压迫别人。谁都不能批评他。
messages.en: He was oppressive. Nobody could criticise him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个不准别人发言的领导者，把“压迫性的”贴在人物或政权旁边，记住这是描述性质的形容词。

gloss_zh: 坚定争辩的人；据理力争者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who argues firmly and persistently for a position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在争论中坚定而持续地维护某一立场的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li targumenta b'mod sod u tibqa' tinsisti fuq il-pożizzjoni tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坚定争辩、坚持自己论点的人

collocations.en: a firm arguer in the debate
a firm arguer who defends his position
collocations.zh: 坚定捍卫自己立场的争辩者

formal.mt: Fid-dibattitu, Pawlu deher bħala ħaqqieq li ddefenda l-pożizzjoni tiegħu b'argumenti ċari.
formal.en: In the debate, Pawlu came across as a firm arguer who defended his position with clear arguments.
formal.zh: 在辩论中，保罗表现为一个坚定的争辩者，用清晰的论据捍卫自己的立场。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Pawlu baqa' jiddefendi l-idea tiegħu sal-aħħar? Toni: Iva, hu ħaqqieq. Dejjem jitlob raġuni ċara.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Pawlu keep defending his idea right to the end? Toni: Yes, he's a firm arguer. He always asks for a clear reason.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗一直到最后都在捍卫自己的想法吗？托尼：是的，他是个坚定争辩的人。他总要听到明确的理由。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu baqa' jiddefendi l-idea tiegħu sal-aħħar?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu baqa' jiddefendi l-idea tiegħu sal-aħħar?
messages.zh: 保罗一直到最后都在捍卫自己的想法吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu keep defending his idea right to the end?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu ħaqqieq. Dejjem jitlob raġuni ċara.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu ħaqqieq. Dejjem jitlob raġuni ċara.
messages.zh: 是的，他是个坚定争辩的人。他总要听到明确的理由。
messages.en: Yes, he's a firm arguer. He always asks for a clear reason.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象辩论桌旁一直举证、坚持立场的那个人，把 ħaqqieq 贴在人物头像上，记住它指人。

gloss_zh: 在争论中坚持己见的；争辩时不肯让步的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Firmly persistent about an argument or the position being defended.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在争论中坚持自己的论点或所捍卫的立场、不轻易让步的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jibqa' jinsisti fuq argument jew fuq il-pożizzjoni li jkun qed jiddefendi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在争论或论点上坚持不让步的

collocations.en: an insistent tone in an argument
collocations.zh: 争论中坚持不让步的语气

collocations.en: a speaker who is insistent in argument
collocations.zh: 争辩时坚持己见的发言者

formal.mt: Il-kelliem kien ħaqqieqi waqt id-diskussjoni u baqa' jiddefendi l-istess argument.
formal.en: The speaker was insistent during the discussion and kept defending the same argument.
formal.zh: 这名发言者在讨论中坚持己见，始终捍卫同一个论点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark kien ħaqqieqi llum, hux? Lara: Iva, baqa' jinsisti fuq l-istess punt anki wara t-tweġiba.
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark was insistent in the argument today, wasn't he? Lara: Yes, he kept insisting on the same point even after the answer.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克今天争论时一直不肯让步，对吧？拉拉：是啊，即使得到答复后，他还坚持同一个观点。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 马克今天争论时一直不肯让步，对吧？
messages.en: Mark was insistent in the argument today, wasn't he?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, baqa' jinsisti fuq l-istess punt anki wara t-tweġiba.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, baqa' jinsisti fuq l-istess punt anki wara t-tweġiba.
messages.zh: 是啊，即使得到答复后，他还坚持同一个观点。
messages.en: Yes, he kept insisting on the same point even after the answer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħaqqieq 记作“争辩的人”，把 ħaqqieqi 记作“争辩时坚持的”；用人物与性质两张卡对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put energy and determination into trying to do or achieve something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为做成某事或达到某个目标而投入精力、作出努力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel sforz u juża l-ħila tiegħu biex jagħmel xi ħaġa jew jilħaq għan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作出努力，尽力去做某事

collocations.en: made as much effort as he could

formal.mt: L-istudent ħar biex itemm ix-xogħol fil-ħin, minkejja d-diffikultajiet.
formal.en: The student made an effort to finish the work on time, despite the difficulties.
formal.zh: 尽管遇到了困难，这名学生仍努力按时完成工作。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Pawlu ħar biex jgħinna? Toni: Iva, għamel ħiltu kollha, imma ma kellux biżżejjed ħin.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Pawlu make an effort to help us? Toni: Yes, he did his very best, but he didn't have enough time.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗有没有尽力帮我们？托尼：有，他已经尽了全力，只是时间不够。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗有没有尽力帮我们？
messages.en: Did Pawlu make an effort to help us?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għamel ħiltu kollha, imma ma kellux biżżejjed ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għamel ħiltu kollha, imma ma kellux biżżejjed ħin.
messages.zh: 有，他已经尽了全力，只是时间不够。
messages.en: Yes, he did his very best, but he didn't have enough time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象学生为了按时交作业而认真用力，把这个短词贴在“付出努力”的动作上；记住努力本身不保证成功。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To save or preserve something so that it remains available or protected from loss or damage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 保存或保全某物，使其能够留存，避免遗失或损坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iżomm xi ħaġa biex tibqa' disponibbli jew biex ma tintilifx jew issirilha ħsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 保存；保留下来。
保存；保全，使其维持原有状态。

formal.mt: L-arkivista ħarar id-dokument oriġinali f'kaxxa apposta biex jipproteġih mill-ħsara.
formal.en: The archivist preserved the original document in a special box to protect it from damage.
formal.zh: 档案管理员将原始文件保存在专用盒子里，以防损坏。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu ħarar kopja tar-ritratt? Mark: Iva, il-kopja tinsab fil-kaxxa blu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu save a copy of the photograph? Mark: Yes, the copy is in the blue box.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗保存了一份照片的副本吗？马克：保存了，副本在蓝色盒子里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗保存了一份照片的副本吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu save a copy of the photograph?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 保存了，副本在蓝色盒子里。
messages.en: Yes, the copy is in the blue box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把珍贵照片放进保护盒：留下来是“保存”，防止受损是“保全”，用同一画面连接两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A payment made to an authority or ruler as tribute or tax.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向当局或统治者缴纳的贡赋或税款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlas lil awtorità jew ħakkiem bħala taxxa jew tribut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贡赋；税款。

formal.mt: F'dan ir-rakkont, kull raħal kellu jħallas ħaraġ lill-ħakkiem.
formal.en: In this story, every village had to pay tribute to the ruler.
formal.zh: 在这个故事中，每个村庄都必须向统治者缴纳贡赋。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex in-nies fir-rakkont qed jiġbru l-flus? Mark: Biex iħallsu l-ħaraġ lill-ħakkiem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are the people in the story collecting money? Mark: To pay tribute to the ruler.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：故事里的人们为什么在筹钱？马克：为了向统治者缴纳贡赋。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex in-nies fir-rakkont qed jiġbru l-flus?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex in-nies fir-rakkont qed jiġbru l-flus?
messages.zh: 故事里的人们为什么在筹钱？
messages.en: Why are the people in the story collecting money?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 为了向统治者缴纳贡赋。
messages.en: To pay tribute to the ruler.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“村民交钱给统治者”的画面中，连着“缴纳贡赋、征收税款”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Armed conflict between countries or organized groups.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 国家或有组织的群体之间进行的武装冲突，即战争。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġlied armat bejn pajjiżi jew gruppi organizzati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 战争；武装冲突。

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi kif il-ħarb bejn iż-żewġ pajjiżi biddel il-ħajja tan-nies.
formal.en: The text describes how the war between the two countries changed people's lives.
formal.zh: 这篇文章描述了两国之间的战争如何改变人们的生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dwar xiex jitkellem dan il-ktieb? Mark: Dwar familja fi żmien il-ħarb.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this book about? Mark: A family in wartime.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这本书讲什么？马克：讲一个家庭在战争时期的生活。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这本书讲什么？
messages.en: What is this book about?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 讲一个家庭在战争时期的生活。
messages.en: A family in wartime.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词夹在“战争时期”和“战争结束”两张时间卡片之间，记住它指战争这一事件。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An escape from confinement or danger, or a short trip away from everyday surroundings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从拘禁或危险中逃脱，也可指暂时离开日常环境的短途出游。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħruġ minn magħluq jew minn periklu, jew vjaġġ qasir 'il bogħod mill-ħajja ta' kuljum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逃脱；逃离拘禁或危险。
短暂出游；暂时离开日常环境的休闲旅行。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-ħarba tal-priġunier mill-ħabs isseħħ matul il-lejl.
formal.en: In the novel, the prisoner's escape from prison takes place during the night.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，囚犯是在夜间越狱的。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek aptit ħarba sal-baħar nhar il-Ħadd? Mark: Iva, għandna bżonn ftit mistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Fancy a getaway to the seaside on Sunday? Mark: Yes, we need a little rest.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：星期天想去海边散散心吗？马克：想啊，我们需要休息一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek aptit ħarba sal-baħar nhar il-Ħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek aptit ħarba sal-baħar nhar il-Ħadd?
messages.zh: 星期天想去海边散散心吗？
messages.en: Fancy a getaway to the seaside on Sunday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 想啊，我们需要休息一下。
messages.en: Yes, we need a little rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个离开的画面记忆：离开监狱是“逃脱”，周末离开日常环境是“短暂出游”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing damage or destruction, or tending to damage things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 造成损坏或毁坏的，或有破坏东西倾向的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħmel ħsara jew jeqred l-affarijiet, jew li għandu tendenza jagħmel hekk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 破坏性的；具有破坏倾向的。

formal.mt: Il-karattru ħarbati fir-rakkont ikisser l-għamara kull meta jirrabja.
formal.en: The destructive character in the story breaks furniture whenever he gets angry.
formal.zh: 故事中那个爱搞破坏的角色每次生气都会砸坏家具。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed taħbi ż-żraben? Mark: Għax il-ġeru ħarbati u jigdimhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you hiding the shoes? Mark: Because the puppy is destructive and chews them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么把鞋子藏起来？马克：因为小狗爱搞破坏，会咬鞋子。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把鞋子藏起来？
messages.en: Why are you hiding the shoes?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 因为小狗爱搞破坏，会咬鞋子。
messages.en: Because the puppy is destructive and chews them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象鞋子被小狗咬坏，再给行为贴上“破坏性的”标签；这个词是形容词，用来描述性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who scribbles or makes untidy written marks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 随意涂写或写下潦草笔迹的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tikteb jew tagħmel marki bil-kitba bla ordni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乱写乱画的人；写字潦草的人。

collocations.en: someone who scribbles in the margins

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ħarbiex jimla l-marġini tal-ktieb b'linji u kliem bla ordni.
formal.en: In the story, the scribbler fills the book's margins with untidy lines and words.
formal.zh: 在故事中，那个乱写乱画的人把书的页边涂满了杂乱的线条和文字。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu l-ħarbiex li mela l-paġna b'dawn il-linji? Mark: Jien! Kont qed nipprova l-pinna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is the scribbler who filled the page with these lines? Mark: Me! I was trying out the pen.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：是哪个涂鸦的人把这一页画满了线条？马克：是我！我刚才在试笔。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu l-ħarbiex li mela l-paġna b'dawn il-linji?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu l-ħarbiex li mela l-paġna b'dawn il-linji?
messages.zh: 是哪个涂鸦的人把这一页画满了线条？
messages.en: Who is the scribbler who filled the page with these lines?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 是我！我刚才在试笔。
messages.en: Me! I was trying out the pen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象页边满是试笔线条，再把镜头移到拿笔的人：这个名词指涂写的人，而不是涂写动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who wrecks, damages, or destroys things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 砸坏、损毁或破坏东西的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tkisser l-affarijiet, tagħmlilhom ħsara jew teqridhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 破坏者；砸坏或毁坏东西的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ħarbut jidħol fid-dar vojta u jkisser l-għamara.
formal.en: In the story, a destructive person enters the empty house and smashes the furniture.
formal.zh: 在故事中，一个破坏者走进空屋，把家具砸坏了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min kisser it-trakk tal-ġugarell? Mark: Ħija ż-żgħir. Illum kien ħarbut!
colloquial.en: Maja: Who broke the toy truck? Mark: My little brother. He was a real wrecker today!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁把玩具卡车弄坏了？马克：我弟弟。他今天简直是个破坏大王！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁把玩具卡车弄坏了？
messages.en: Who broke the toy truck?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我弟弟。他今天简直是个破坏大王！
messages.en: My little brother. He was a real wrecker today!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把散落的玩具零件与旁边的破坏者连成画面；记住这个名词回答“谁毁坏了东西”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To conduct war against another country or organized group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对另一国家或有组织的群体进行战争。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel gwerra kontra pajjiż ieħor jew grupp organizzat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进行战争；对敌方作战。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, ir-re ħareb kontra r-renju ġar għal snin sħaħ.
formal.en: In the novel, the king waged war against the neighbouring kingdom for years.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，国王与邻国进行了多年的战争。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel ir-re f'dan il-kapitlu? Mark: Ħareb kontra l-għadu, iżda fl-aħħar talab il-paċi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did the king do in this chapter? Mark: He waged war against the enemy, but eventually asked for peace.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这一章里国王做了什么？马克：他对敌方作战，但最后提出了求和。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这一章里国王做了什么？
messages.en: What did the king do in this chapter?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħareb kontra l-għadu, iżda fl-aħħar talab il-paċi.
messages.mt_standard: Ħareb kontra l-għadu, iżda fl-aħħar talab il-paċi.
messages.zh: 他对敌方作战，但最后提出了求和。
messages.en: He waged war against the enemy, but eventually asked for peace.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个动词放进“国王对敌方作战”的句子里，并连着 kontra 一起练习，记住本词条的“进行战争”义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To scrape or scratch around, especially to claw at the ground.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 四处刮抓或刨动，尤指用爪子抓刨地面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jigref jew iħokk minn hawn u minn hemm, speċjalment fl-art bid-dwiefer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在周围四处刮抓、刨动。
用爪子抓刨泥土。

formal.mt: Il-kelb ħarfen fil-ħamrija ħdejn iċ-ċint u kixef għerq żgħir.
formal.en: The dog scraped around in the soil beside the fence and uncovered a small root.
formal.zh: 狗在围栏旁的泥土里刨抓，露出了一条小树根。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm il-ħamrija kollha barra mill-qasrija? Pawlu: Il-qattus ħarfen fiha dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is all this soil outside the flowerpot? Pawlu: The cat scratched around in it this morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：怎么这么多泥土都弄到花盆外面了？保罗：猫今天早上在里面刨来刨去。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm il-ħamrija kollha barra mill-qasrija?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm il-ħamrija kollha barra mill-qasrija?
messages.zh: 怎么这么多泥土都弄到花盆外面了？
messages.en: Why is all this soil outside the flowerpot?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 猫今天早上在里面刨来刨去。
messages.en: The cat scratched around in it this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小狗用爪子把泥土刨得到处都是，把这个词和反复刮抓地面的动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To do work carelessly and produce a poor-quality result.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做事粗糙马虎，做出来的成果质量差。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xogħol bl-addoċċ u mingħajr reqqa, b'riżultat ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马虎地干活；把工作做得粗糙低劣。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ħarfex fit-tiswija tal-bieb, u l-bieb baqa' ma jingħalaqx sew.
formal.en: The worker did a shoddy job repairing the door, and it still did not close properly.
formal.zh: 工人修门时干得很马虎，门修过后仍然关不好。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din l-ixkaffa għadha mgħawġa! Mark: Min waħħalha ħarfex fix-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Lara: This shelf is still crooked! Mark: Whoever put it up did a shoddy job.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个架子还是歪的！马克：安装的人干得太马虎了。

messages.speaker: Lara (住户)
messages.zh: 这个架子还是歪的！
messages.en: This shelf is still crooked!

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 安装的人干得太马虎了。
messages.en: Whoever put it up did a shoddy job.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把歪架子和松螺丝当作记忆画面：动作虽然做完，质量却很差，这就是马虎干活。

gloss_zh: 干活马虎的人；笨手笨脚的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who works carelessly or ineptly and produces poor results.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 干活粗糙马虎或做事笨拙、常把事情办坏的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taħdem mingħajr reqqa jew bla ħila u tagħmel xogħol ħażin.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who works in a shoddy manner
sense_translations.zh_definition: 干活粗糙马虎、不讲究质量的人。
笨手笨脚、常把事情办砸的人。

collocations.en: someone who is careless in their work

collocations.zh: 没有本事、做事笨拙的人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ħarfiex jagħmel l-istess żball darbtejn u jħalli x-xogħol f'kundizzjoni ħażina.
formal.en: In the story, the bungler makes the same mistake twice and leaves the work in a poor state.
formal.zh: 故事里，那个笨手笨脚的人把同一个错误犯了两次，还把工作做得一塌糊涂。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-kexxun reġa' weħel wara t-tiswija. Ġanni: Dak li sewwieh ħarfiex!
colloquial.en: Nina: The drawer got stuck again after the repair. Ġanni: The person who repaired it is a bungler!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：抽屉修过后又卡住了。詹尼：修抽屉的那个人真是个笨手笨脚的家伙！

messages.speaker: Nina (住户)
messages.zh: 抽屉修过后又卡住了。
messages.en: The drawer got stuck again after the repair.

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.zh: 修抽屉的那个人真是个笨手笨脚的家伙！
messages.en: The person who repaired it is a bungler!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用人物卡片记这个名词：一个总把活干坏的人。和表示马虎干活的动词对照，注意这里指人。

gloss_zh: 秋季的；具有秋日特征的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to autumn or having the qualities associated with autumn.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与秋季有关的，或具有秋日特征的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-ħarifa jew li għandu l-karatteristiċi tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 秋季的；带有秋日气息或特征的。

formal.mt: Il-pittura turi pajsaġġ ħarifi, b'weraq isfar u kannella mxerred mal-art.
formal.en: The painting depicts an autumnal landscape, with yellow and brown leaves scattered on the ground.
formal.zh: 这幅画描绘了秋日景色，黄色和棕色的落叶散布在地上。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Illum għandna temp ħarifi. Pietru: Iva, se nieħu ġakketta għall-mixja.
colloquial.en: Elena: We have autumnal weather today. Pietru: Yes, I'll take a jacket for the walk.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：今天的天气很有秋天的感觉。彼得：是啊，我散步时会带件外套。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天的天气很有秋天的感觉。
messages.en: We have autumnal weather today.

messages.speaker: Pietru (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，我散步时会带件外套。
messages.en: Yes, I'll take a jacket for the walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用落叶、凉风和薄外套组成秋日画面；把这个形容词放在天气、日子或景色后面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move a substance around, for example with a spoon, to mix it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 搅动某种物质，例如用勺子搅拌，使其混合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċaqlaq sustanza, pereżempju b'kuċċarina, biex iħallatha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 搅动；搅拌。

collocations.en: stirred the mixture with a spoon

formal.mt: Il-kok ħarken is-soppa b'kuċċarina tal-injam biex iħallat l-ingredjenti.
formal.en: The cook stirred the soup with a wooden spoon to mix the ingredients.
formal.zh: 厨师用木勺搅拌汤，使各种食材混合。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ħarken is-soppa? Mark: Jien, b'kuċċarina kbira.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who stirred the soup? Mark: I did, with a large spoon.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁搅拌了汤？马克：我，用了一把大勺子。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 谁搅拌了汤？
messages.en: Who stirred the soup?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 我，用了一把大勺子。
messages.en: I did, with a large spoon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħarken 和勺子在汤里画圈的动作一起记：看到这个词，就想起搅动、搅拌。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The grain-bearing ears of a cereal plant; also, something small.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 谷类植物上结有谷粒的穗；也可指很小的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-sbul ta' pjanta taċ-ċereali; ukoll xi ħaġa żgħira.

sense_translations.en_definition: ears (fruiting body of a grain plant)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 谷穗；谷类植物上结有谷粒的部分。
小东西；任何体积很小的事物。

collocations.en: a small thing on the table

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw il-ħarkus tal-qamħ biex jaraw kif il-ħbub kienu mqassma fuq is-sbul.
formal.en: The students observed the ears of wheat to see how the grains were arranged on them.
formal.zh: 学生们观察麦穗，了解谷粒在穗上如何排列。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak il-ħarkus fuq il-mejda? Mark: Biċċa karta żgħira; se nneħħiha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that little thing on the table? Mark: A small piece of paper; I'll remove it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：桌上那个小东西是什么？马克：一小片纸；我把它拿走。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 桌上那个小东西是什么？
messages.en: What's that little thing on the table?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 一小片纸；我把它拿走。
messages.en: A small piece of paper; I'll remove it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ħarkus 画两张记忆卡：一张画麦穗，一张画桌上的小东西，分别对应两个名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing an excessive interest in sexual matters, or feeling sexually excited.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对性话题表现出过度兴趣的；或处于性兴奋状态的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri interess żejjed fis-sess, jew li jkun eċċitat sesswalment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 好色的；对性内容抱有过度或不适当兴趣的。
性兴奋的；产生性欲的。

collocations.zh: 处于性兴奋状态的男子

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tad-djalogu, il-kumment ġie deskritt bħala ħarman minħabba l-interess żejjed tiegħu fis-sess.
formal.en: In the analysis of the dialogue, the comment was described as prurient because of its excessive interest in sex.
formal.zh: 在对这段对话的分析中，这条评论因过度关注性而被描述为带有好色意味。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak il-kumment kien ħarman. Mark: Iva, ma kienx xieraq waqt il-pranzu.
colloquial.en: Maja: That comment was prurient. Mark: Yes, it wasn't appropriate over lunch.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那句话带着好色的意味。马克：是啊，吃午饭时说那种话不合适。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那句话带着好色的意味。
messages.en: That comment was prurient.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ma kienx xieraq waqt il-pranzu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ma kienx xieraq waqt il-pranzu.
messages.zh: 是啊，吃午饭时说那种话不合适。
messages.en: Yes, it wasn't appropriate over lunch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ħarman 时分清两个角度：评价言论可指好色，描述身体状态可指性兴奋，靠上下文选择。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A narrow opening or split in a surface or solid material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面或固体材料上裂开的狭窄缝隙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xaqq dejjaq f'wiċċ jew f'materjal solidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 裂缝；裂隙。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi ħarq dejjaq fil-ħajt ta' barra tal-bini.
formal.en: The report describes a narrow crack in the building's outer wall.
formal.zh: 报告描述了建筑外墙上的一道狭窄裂缝。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt il-ħarq fil-ħajt? Mark: Iva, qiegħed ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see the crack in the wall? Mark: Yes, it's next to the window.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到墙上的裂缝了吗？马克：看到了，就在窗户旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (住户)
messages.zh: 你看到墙上的裂缝了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the crack in the wall?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 看到了，就在窗户旁边。
messages.en: Yes, it's next to the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħarq 写在一幅墙面裂缝图旁，再配上 fil-ħajt，利用具体位置记住裂缝这个名词义。

gloss_zh: 迫使排便；删净；揭穿其无价值；使受公愤；败坏名誉

teaching_sense.en_definition: To expurgate a text by removing material considered objectionable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 删去文本中被认为不宜保留的内容，使文本得到删净或净化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ineħħi minn test materjal meqjus oġġezzjonabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 迫使排便；促使肠道排出粪便。
删净；删除文本中被认为不宜保留的内容。

sense_translations.en_definition: to demonstrate the fakery or worthlessness of sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 揭穿某物的虚假，或证明其毫无价值。
使某人或某事受到公众的谴责与唾弃。
败坏某人的名誉；使某人声名扫地。

collocations.zh: 删净了文本中的不宜内容

formal.mt: Qabel il-pubblikazzjoni, l-editur ħarra t-test billi neħħa s-siltiet li qies oġġezzjonabbli.
formal.en: Before publication, the editor expurgated the text by removing the passages he considered objectionable.
formal.zh: 出版前，编辑删去了他认为不宜保留的段落，对文本进行了删净处理。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed jgħidu li dak l-artiklu ħarra lill-attur? Mark: Għax wara li ħareġ, ir-reputazzjoni tiegħu marret ħażin ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are people saying that article ruined the actor's reputation? Mark: Because after it came out, his reputation suffered badly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么大家说那篇文章败坏了那个演员的名誉？马克：因为文章发表后，他的名声受到了很大损害。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed jgħidu li dak l-artiklu ħarra lill-attur?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed jgħidu li dak l-artiklu ħarra lill-attur?
messages.zh: 为什么大家说那篇文章败坏了那个演员的名誉？
messages.en: Why are people saying that article ruined the actor's reputation?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax wara li ħareġ, ir-reputazzjoni tiegħu marret ħażin ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Għax wara li ħareġ, ir-reputazzjoni tiegħu marret ħażin ħafna.
messages.zh: 因为文章发表后，他的名声受到了很大损害。
messages.en: Because after it came out, his reputation suffered badly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 ħarra 做五格情境卡：排便、删文、揭假、公愤、毁誉。分别记例句，不把五义当成可以随意替换。

gloss_zh: 释放某人；让某人逃脱；解救他人的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To free someone or enable someone to escape from confinement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 释放某人，或使某人能够逃离拘禁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jeħles lil xi ħadd jew iħallih jaħrab minn fejn ikun miżmum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 释放某人；使某人获得自由。
让某人逃脱；使某人得以逃走。
释放或解救他人的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-gwardjan ħarrab lill-priġunier billi fetaħ il-bieb taċ-ċella.
formal.en: In the story, the guard freed the prisoner by opening the cell door.
formal.zh: 在故事中，守卫打开牢门，放走了囚犯。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ħarrab lill-priġunier fil-film? Mark: Il-gwardjan; fetaħlu l-bieb u ħallieh joħroġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who freed the prisoner in the film? Mark: The guard; he opened the door for him and let him out.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：电影里是谁放走了囚犯？马克：守卫；他给囚犯开了门，让他出去了。

messages.speaker: Maja (影迷)
messages.zh: 电影里是谁放走了囚犯？
messages.en: Who freed the prisoner in the film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-gwardjan; fetaħlu l-bieb u ħallieh joħroġ.
messages.mt_standard: Il-gwardjan; fetaħlu l-bieb u ħallieh joħroġ.
messages.zh: 守卫；他给囚犯开了门，让他出去了。
messages.en: The guard; he opened the door for him and let him out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用开门放人的画面记 ħarrab：动词强调释放或让人逃脱，名词则指实施解救的人，注意词性边界。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An alarm bell, historically rung on a ship to warn that hostile vessels were approaching.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出警报的钟；历史上指船上用来警告敌方船只接近的钟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qanpiena tal-allarm li fl-imgħoddi kienet tindaqq fuq vapur biex twissi li kienu qed joqorbu bastimenti tal-għadu.

sense_translations.en_definition: alarm bell (historically, one rung on a ship to warn of the approach of hostile vessels)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 警钟；历史上指船上用来警告敌方船只正在接近的钟。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-baħri daqq il-ħarraba biex iwissi lill-ekwipaġġ li kienu qed joqorbu bastimenti tal-għadu.
formal.en: In the story, the sailor rang the alarm bell to warn the crew that hostile vessels were approaching.
formal.zh: 在故事中，水手敲响警钟，提醒船员敌方船只正在接近。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-baħri daqq il-ħarraba f'din l-istorja? Mark: Biex iwissi lill-oħrajn li kienu qed joqorbu vapuri tal-għadu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the sailor ring the alarm bell in this story? Mark: To warn the others that enemy ships were approaching.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个故事里的水手为什么敲响警钟？马克：为了提醒其他人，敌船正在接近。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-baħri daqq il-ħarraba f'din l-istorja?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-baħri daqq il-ħarraba f'din l-istorja?
messages.zh: 这个故事里的水手为什么敲响警钟？
messages.en: Why did the sailor ring the alarm bell in this story?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex iwissi lill-oħrajn li kienu qed joqorbu vapuri tal-għadu.
messages.mt_standard: Biex iwissi lill-oħrajn li kienu qed joqorbu vapuri tal-għadu.
messages.zh: 为了提醒其他人，敌船正在接近。
messages.en: To warn the others that enemy ships were approaching.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħarraba 配成船上警钟的画面：远处敌船接近，水手敲钟示警，借完整场景记住名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a person who has escaped and is avoiding capture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容已经逃走、正在躲避抓捕的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun ħarab u jkun qed jevita li jinqabad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逃亡的；形容正在躲避抓捕的人。

collocations.en: an escaped prisoner on the run

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, raġel ħarrabi jsib kenn f'dar abbandunata waqt li jipprova jevita li jinqabad.
formal.en: In the novel, a fugitive man takes shelter in an abandoned house while trying to avoid capture.
formal.zh: 在小说中，一名逃亡男子躲进废弃房屋，试图逃避抓捕。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak ir-raġel ħarrabi fil-film? Mark: Huwa priġunier li ħarab; issa qed jinħeba.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that fugitive man in the film? Mark: He's a prisoner who escaped; now he's hiding.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：电影里那个逃亡男子是谁？马克：他是一个越狱的囚犯，现在正躲着。

messages.speaker: Maja (影迷)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak ir-raġel ħarrabi fil-film?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak ir-raġel ħarrabi fil-film?
messages.zh: 电影里那个逃亡男子是谁？
messages.en: Who is that fugitive man in the film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa priġunier li ħarab; issa qed jinħeba.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa priġunier li ħarab; issa qed jinħeba.
messages.zh: 他是一个越狱的囚犯，现在正躲着。
messages.en: He's a prisoner who escaped; now he's hiding.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħarrabi 放在 raġel 后面一起记：raġel ħarrabi 是逃亡中的男子，词条按形容词学习，抓住躲避抓捕的状态。

gloss_zh: 排便的人；骗子，耍诡计的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who defecates; also, a person who deceives others or plays tricks on them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指排便的人；也可指欺骗别人或耍诡计的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel il-ħmieġ; ukoll, persuna li tqarraq b'ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 排便的人。
骗子；惯于耍诡计的人。

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, il-ħarraj wiegħed teżor lill-vjaġġaturi biex jieħu flushom.
formal.en: In the story, the trickster promised the travellers treasure in order to take their money.
formal.zh: 故事中，骗子向旅人许诺能得到宝藏，以骗取他们的钱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak ir-raġel? Toni: Għax hu ħarraj; wiegħed li jġibli l-biljetti u sparixxa bil-flus.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why don't you trust that man? Toni: Because he's a trickster; he promised to get me the tickets and disappeared with the money.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么不信任那个男人？托尼：因为他是个骗子；他答应帮我弄到票，却拿着钱消失了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak ir-raġel?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak ir-raġel?
messages.zh: 你为什么不信任那个男人？
messages.en: Why don't you trust that man?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu ħarraj; wiegħed li jġibli l-biljetti u sparixxa bil-flus.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu ħarraj; wiegħed li jġibli l-biljetti u sparixxa bil-flus.
messages.zh: 因为他是个骗子；他答应帮我弄到票，却拿着钱消失了。
messages.en: Because he's a trickster; he promised to get me the tickets and disappeared with the money.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词记成两张人物卡：一张是正在排便的人，一张是耍诡计的骗子；读句子时靠情境选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pit or underground container in which sewage and human waste collect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于积存污水和人类排泄物的坑或地下容器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħofra jew ġiebja taħt l-art fejn jinġabru d-drenaġġ u l-ħmieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 积存污水、粪污的坑或池。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li l-ħarrajja hija mimlija u li hemm bżonn titbattal.
formal.en: The report indicates that the cesspool is full and needs to be emptied.
formal.zh: 报告指出，粪污池已经积满，需要清掏。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Minn fejn ġejja din ir-riħa? Rita: Mill-ħarrajja; hija mimlija u ċempilt biex jiġu jbattluha.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where is this smell coming from? Rita: From the cesspool; it's full, and I've called to have it emptied.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这股气味是从哪里来的？丽塔：从粪污池来的；池子满了，我已经打电话请人来清掏了。

messages.speaker: Mark (住户)
messages.zh: 这股气味是从哪里来的？
messages.en: Where is this smell coming from?

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Mill-ħarrajja; hija mimlija u ċempilt biex jiġu jbattluha.
messages.mt_standard: Mill-ħarrajja; hija mimlija u ċempilt biex jiġu jbattluha.
messages.zh: 从粪污池来的；池子满了，我已经打电话请人来清掏了。
messages.en: From the cesspool; it's full, and I've called to have it emptied.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“污水积满地下池，需要叫人来清掏”的完整画面记住 ħarrajja，注意它表示容纳污物的地方。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause something to burn.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物发生燃烧或被烧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel xi ħaġa tinħaraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引起燃烧；使某物燃烧或被烧。

formal.mt: Waqt l-esperiment, il-fjamma ħarrqet il-karta li kienet miżmuma fuqha.
formal.en: During the experiment, the flame caused the paper held above it to burn.
formal.zh: 实验中，火焰使拿在其上方的纸张燃烧起来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ħarraq din il-karta? Pawlu: Il-ġamar ħarraq il-karta meta waqgħet fuqu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What caused this paper to burn? Pawlu: The embers caused the paper to burn when it fell onto them.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：是什么把这张纸烧了？保罗：纸掉到余烬上，余烬把它烧了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 是什么把这张纸烧了？
messages.en: What caused this paper to burn?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġamar ħarraq il-karta meta waqgħet fuqu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġamar ħarraq il-karta meta waqgħet fuqu.
messages.zh: 纸掉到余烬上，余烬把它烧了。
messages.en: The embers caused the paper to burn when it fell onto them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象火焰碰到纸张，纸随即烧起来；用“某物导致另一物燃烧”的因果画面记住这个动词。

gloss_zh: 使干透；烤焦土地；刺激或使发炎；皮肤刺激或炎症的诱因

teaching_sense.en_definition: To dry something intensely, scorch the ground, or cause irritation or inflammation of the skin or similar tissue.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物极度干燥，烤焦土地，或使皮肤等组织受到刺激、发生炎症。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inixxef ħafna, jaħraq wiċċ l-art, jew jikkawża irritazzjoni jew infjammazzjoni fil-ġilda jew f'tessut simili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使干透；使极度干燥。
烤焦土地；使地表受到灼烤。

sense_translations.en_definition: to irritate or inflame (used of the skin etc)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 刺激皮肤等组织，或使其发炎。
引起皮肤刺激的事物或因素。
引起炎症的事物或因素。

collocations.zh: 刺激了皮肤或使皮肤发炎

formal.mt: Is-sħana kienet qawwija ħafna, u r-riħ sħun ħarrar l-art.
formal.en: The heat was very intense, and the hot wind parched the ground.
formal.zh: 天气酷热，热风使土地变得干透。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ma tridx terġa' tuża dak is-sapun? Sara: Għax ħarrar il-ġilda tiegħi meta użajtu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why don't you want to use that soap again? Sara: Because it irritated my skin when I used it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么不想再用那块肥皂了？萨拉：因为我用的时候，它刺激了我的皮肤。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tridx terġa' tuża dak is-sapun?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tridx terġa' tuża dak is-sapun?
messages.zh: 你为什么不想再用那块肥皂了？
messages.en: Why don't you want to use that soap again?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ħarrar il-ġilda tiegħi meta użajtu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ħarrar il-ġilda tiegħi meta użajtu.
messages.zh: 因为我用的时候，它刺激了我的皮肤。
messages.en: Because it irritated my skin when I used it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排记两幅画：土地被热风吹干，皮肤被某物刺激。动词记作用，名词义另记为造成刺激或炎症的因素。

gloss_zh: 续随子，千金子（大戟属植物）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A southern European spurge plant with the scientific name Euphorbia lathyris.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种南欧的大戟属植物，学名为 Euphorbia lathyris，中文称续随子或千金子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tan-Nofsinhar tal-Ewropa mill-ġeneru Euphorbia, bl-isem xjentifiku Euphorbia lathyris.

sense_translations.en_definition: Euphorbia lathyris; a type of southern European spurge (type of plant)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 续随子，又称千金子，学名 Euphorbia lathyris；一种南欧的大戟属植物。

formal.mt: It-tikketta tidentifika l-ħarrara bl-isem xjentifiku Euphorbia lathyris.
formal.en: The label identifies the plant called ħarrara by its scientific name, Euphorbia lathyris.
formal.zh: 标签用学名 Euphorbia lathyris 标明了这种马耳他语称作 ħarrara 的植物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jisimha din il-pjanta? Toni: Din ħarrara; fuq it-tikketta hemm miktub Euphorbia lathyris.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's this plant called? Toni: It's called ħarrara; the label says Euphorbia lathyris.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这种植物叫什么？托尼：叫 ħarrara，也就是续随子；标签上写着 Euphorbia lathyris。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 这种植物叫什么？
messages.en: What's this plant called?

messages.speaker: Toni (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Din ħarrara; fuq it-tikketta hemm miktub Euphorbia lathyris.
messages.mt_standard: Din ħarrara; fuq it-tikketta hemm miktub Euphorbia lathyris.
messages.zh: 叫 ħarrara，也就是续随子；标签上写着 Euphorbia lathyris。
messages.en: It's called ħarrara; the label says Euphorbia lathyris.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做一张植物标签卡，正面写 ħarrara，背面写“续随子／Euphorbia lathyris”，把它作为完整植物名称记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to turn over soil or plough land.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有翻动土壤或耕地能力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħila jew il-kapaċità li jaqleb il-ħamrija jew jaħrat l-art.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the ability to turn over or plough the land
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有翻土或耕地能力的。

collocations.en: an apparatus capable of turning over soil

formal.mt: L-istudenti qabblu żewġ tipi ta' tagħmir ħarrati biex jaraw kif kull wieħed jaqleb il-ħamrija.
formal.en: The students compared two types of equipment capable of ploughing to see how each turns over the soil.
formal.zh: 学生比较了两种能够耕地的设备，观察它们各自如何翻动土壤。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan l-apparat jaqleb il-ħamrija wkoll? Pawlu: Iva, huwa apparat ħarrati; nużawh biex inħejju l-art għaż-żrigħ.
colloquial.en: Mark: Does this apparatus turn over the soil too? Pawlu: Yes, it's capable of ploughing; we use it to prepare the land for sowing.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这个装置也能翻土吗？保罗：能，它具有耕地功能；我们用它来整理土地，准备播种。

messages.speaker: Mark (农业学员)
messages.zh: 这个装置也能翻土吗？
messages.en: Does this apparatus turn over the soil too?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
