messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa apparat ħarrati; nużawh biex inħejju l-art għaż-żrigħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa apparat ħarrati; nużawh biex inħejju l-art għaż-żrigħ.
messages.zh: 能，它具有耕地功能；我们用它来整理土地，准备播种。
messages.en: Yes, it's capable of ploughing; we use it to prepare the land for sowing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给能把泥土翻过来的设备贴上 ħarrati 标签；重点记“具备耕地能力的”这一形容词意义。

gloss_zh: 作战；抛弃；蹂躏，毁坏；毁掉

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wage war, abandon someone or something, devastate a place, or ruin something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进行战争，抛弃某人或某物，蹂躏某地，或毁掉某事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel gwerra, jabbanduna lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, iħalli post ħerba, jew jeqred xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进行战争；作战。
抛弃；离弃。
蹂躏某地；使某地遭到严重破坏。
毁坏；毁掉；使败坏或陷入毁败。

formal.mt: L-attakk ħarreb ir-raħal u ħalla ħafna familji mingħajr dar.
formal.en: The attack devastated the village and left many families without a home.
formal.zh: 袭击摧毁了村庄，使许多家庭无家可归。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ġara mill-kotba li ħallejt fil-garaxx? Mark: L-ilma daħal ġewwa u ħarreb kollox.
colloquial.en: Lara: What happened to the books I left in the garage? Mark: Water got in and ruined everything.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我放在车库里的那些书怎么样了？马克：水进来了，把所有东西都毁了。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 我放在车库里的那些书怎么样了？
messages.en: What happened to the books I left in the garage?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ilma daħal ġewwa u ħarreb kollox.
messages.mt_standard: L-ilma daħal ġewwa u ħarreb kollox.
messages.zh: 水进来了，把所有东西都毁了。
messages.en: Water got in and ruined everything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画四格学习卡，分别写“作战、离弃、蹂躏土地、毁掉事物”；四格共同帮助记义，不把它们当作词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bring someone or something out; also, to train someone through instruction and practice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某人或某物带出来；也指通过指导和练习训练某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa minn ġewwa; ukoll, jgħallem u jipprepara lil xi ħadd permezz tat-taħriġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 带出；把某人或某物弄出来。
训练某人；通过指导和练习培养某人的技能。

formal.mt: L-għalliem ħarreġ lill-ħaddiema l-ġodda fl-użu tat-tagħmir qabel bdew ix-xogħol.
formal.en: The instructor trained the new workers in using the equipment before they started work.
formal.zh: 新员工开始工作前，培训教师教他们练习了设备的使用方法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ħarreġ lit-tim għall-kompetizzjoni? Toni: Ħarreġ lit-tim Pawlu; għamilna ħafna eżerċizzji miegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who trained the team for the competition? Toni: Pawlu trained the team; we did lots of exercises with him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：是谁为比赛训练了这支队伍？托尼：保罗训练的；我们跟着他做了很多练习。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 是谁为比赛训练了这支队伍？
messages.en: Who trained the team for the competition?

messages.speaker: Toni (队员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħarreġ lit-tim Pawlu; għamilna ħafna eżerċizzji miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Ħarreġ lit-tim Pawlu; għamilna ħafna eżerċizzji miegħu.
messages.zh: 保罗训练的；我们跟着他做了很多练习。
messages.en: Pawlu trained the team; we did lots of exercises with him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅独立画面记忆：把人带到外面，以及教练带队练习。前者对应“带出”，后者对应“训练某人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or thing that causes destruction or ruin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 造成破坏、毁坏或毁灭的人或事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew ħaġa li ġġib qerda jew tikkawża ħsara kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 破坏者；毁灭者；造成毁坏的人或事物。

formal.mt: Il-kronaka ssejjaħ lill-invażur ħarrieb tal-bliet minħabba l-qerda li ħalla warajh.
formal.en: The chronicle calls the invader a destroyer of cities because of the devastation he left behind.
formal.zh: 编年史称这名入侵者为城市的毁灭者，因为他所到之处留下了严重破坏。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min qered il-ġnien fir-rumanz? Mark: Il-ħarrieb kien raġel li daħal billejl.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who destroyed the garden in the novel? Mark: The destroyer was a man who came in at night.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：小说里是谁毁掉了花园？马克：破坏者是一个夜里进来的男人。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书伙伴)
messages.zh: 小说里是谁毁掉了花园？
messages.en: Who destroyed the garden in the novel?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħarrieb kien raġel li daħal billejl.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħarrieb kien raġel li daħal billejl.
messages.zh: 破坏者是一个夜里进来的男人。
messages.en: The destroyer was a man who came in at night.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象花园被毁后寻找破坏者，把 ħarrieb 和“造成毁坏的人或事物”连在一起记。

gloss_zh: 造成严重破坏的；毁灭性的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing destruction or extensive damage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 造成毁坏或大范围严重损害的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġib qerda jew jikkawża ħsara kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 造成严重破坏的；带来毁灭的。

formal.mt: L-attakk ħarriebi qered ħafna bini u ħalla lill-familji bla dar.
formal.en: The devastating attack destroyed many buildings and left families homeless.
formal.zh: 这场毁灭性的袭击摧毁了许多建筑，使一些家庭无家可归。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif kien ir-riħ ilbieraħ? Toni: Kien riħ ħarriebi; waqqa' żewġ siġriet.
colloquial.en: Lara: What was the wind like yesterday? Toni: It was destructive; it knocked down two trees.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：昨天的风怎么样？托尼：破坏力很强，吹倒了两棵树。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 昨天的风怎么样？
messages.en: What was the wind like yesterday?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien riħ ħarriebi; waqqa' żewġ siġriet.
messages.mt_standard: Kien riħ ħarriebi; waqqa' żewġ siġriet.
messages.zh: 破坏力很强，吹倒了两棵树。
messages.en: It was destructive; it knocked down two trees.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“风吹倒树”的画面记 ħarriebi：它描述事物具有破坏性，与表示破坏者的名词区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to invent stories or to tell lies.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于编造故事，或经常说谎的；具体含义取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jivvinta stejjer jew jgħid il-gideb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱编造故事的；倾向于虚构情节的。
爱说谎的；有说假话倾向的。

collocations.en: a narrator inclined to make up stories
a person inclined to tell lies

formal.mt: L-awtur ipinġi lil dan ir-raġel bħala bniedem ħarriefi li jħallat il-fatti mal-gideb.
formal.en: The author portrays this man as a person inclined to lie who mixes facts with falsehoods.
formal.zh: 作者将这名男子描写成一个爱说谎的人，总把事实与谎言混在一起。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Temmen dak li jgħid Pawlu? Lara: Mhux dejjem; hu ħarriefi u spiss iżid affarijiet li ma ġrawx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you believe what Pawlu says? Lara: Not always; he tends to make things up and often adds things that never happened.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你相信保罗说的话吗？拉拉：不总相信，他爱编故事，经常添上没发生过的事。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你相信保罗说的话吗？
messages.en: Do you believe what Pawlu says?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mhux dejjem; hu ħarriefi u spiss iżid affarijiet li ma ġrawx.
messages.mt_standard: Mhux dejjem; hu ħarriefi u spiss iżid affarijiet li ma ġrawx.
messages.zh: 不总相信，他爱编故事，经常添上没发生过的事。
messages.en: Not always; he tends to make things up and often adds things that never happened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人给故事不断添情节：ħarriefi 可指爱编故事；若把假话当事实说，就是爱说谎。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who arouses lustful sexual desire in others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在他人心中激起强烈性欲或色欲的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqajjem xewqa sesswali qawwija f'ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 激起他人色欲的人；挑起淫欲的人。

collocations.en: a person who arouses lust in the novel
the role of someone who arouses lust
collocations.zh: 挑起他人色欲者的角色

formal.mt: L-awtriċi tippreżenta lir-raġel bħala ħarrieq li jqajjem xewqa sesswali qawwija fil-karattri l-oħra.
formal.en: The author presents the man as someone who arouses intense sexual desire in the other characters.
formal.zh: 女作家将这名男子描写成一个在其他人物心中激起强烈色欲的人。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex dan il-karattru jissejjaħ ħarrieq? Mark: Għax iqajjem xewqa sesswali qawwija fil-karattri l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why is this character called someone who arouses lust? Mark: Because he arouses intense sexual desire in the other characters.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：为什么称这个人物为挑起色欲的人？马克：因为他在其他人物心中激起强烈的性欲。

messages.speaker: Anna (文学课学生)
messages.zh: 为什么称这个人物为挑起色欲的人？
messages.en: Why is this character called someone who arouses lust?

messages.speaker: Mark (文学课同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax iqajjem xewqa sesswali qawwija fil-karattri l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Għax iqajjem xewqa sesswali qawwija fil-karattri l-oħra.
messages.zh: 因为他在其他人物心中激起强烈的性欲。
messages.en: Because he arouses intense sexual desire in the other characters.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用小说人物关系记 ħarrieq：重点是此人使别人产生色欲，记清欲望被激起的是他人。

gloss_zh: 引起炎症的；造成灼伤或烧焦的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing inflammation, scorching, or burning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 引起炎症的，或造成灼伤、烧灼、烧焦的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jikkawża infjammazzjoni, ħruq jew tiċrit bil-ħruq fil-wiċċ ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引起炎症的；致炎的。
造成灼伤、烧焦或燃烧的；具有烧灼作用的。

collocations.en: an inflammation-causing effect on the skin
collocations.zh: 对皮肤产生的致炎作用

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema evitaw il-kuntatt mal-likwidu ħarrieqi biex jipproteġu l-ġilda minn ħruq.
formal.en: The workers avoided contact with the burn-causing liquid to protect their skin from burns.
formal.zh: 工人们避免接触这种会造成灼伤的液体，以保护皮肤免受烧灼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'effett ħarrieqi' f'dan it-test? Toni: 'Ħarrieqi' hawn ifisser li jikkawża infjammazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'an inflammation-causing effect' mean in this text? Toni: Here, 'ħarrieqi' means that it causes inflammation.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这篇文章里的 effett ħarrieqi 是什么意思？托尼：这里的 ħarrieqi 表示会引起炎症。

messages.speaker: Maja (语言课学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 effett ħarrieqi 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'an inflammation-causing effect' mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Toni (语言教师)
messages.zh: 这里的 ħarrieqi 表示会引起炎症。
messages.en: Here, 'ħarrieqi' means that it causes inflammation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ħarrieqi 做两张记忆卡：一张写引起炎症，一张写造成灼伤或烧焦；根据语境选择义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who causes other people to leave a place or go outside.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使其他人离开某处或走到外面去的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ġġiegħel jew twassal lil nies oħra joħorġu minn post.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who causes others to exit
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使他人出去或离开某处的人。

collocations.en: a person who gets the visitors to leave
a person who gets the crowd to exit

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ħarrieġ talab lill-viżitaturi joħorġu mis-sala u wassalhom sal-bieb.
formal.en: In the story, the person getting others to exit asked the visitors to leave the hall and led them to the door.
formal.zh: 故事中，负责让别人出去的人请访客离开大厅，并将他们带到门口。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min qed jgħid lin-nies biex joħorġu? Mark: Dak huwa l-ħarrieġ; qed imexxihom lejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who is telling people to go out? Mark: That is the person getting them to exit; he is leading them towards the door.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：是谁在叫大家出去？马克：那就是使大家出去的人，他正领着他们往门口走。

messages.speaker: Anna (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Min qed jgħid lin-nies biex joħorġu?
messages.mt_standard: Min qed jgħid lin-nies biex joħorġu?
messages.zh: 是谁在叫大家出去？
messages.en: Who is telling people to go out?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak huwa l-ħarrieġ; qed imexxihom lejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Dak huwa l-ħarrieġ; qed imexxihom lejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 那就是使大家出去的人，他正领着他们往门口走。
messages.en: That is the person getting them to exit; he is leading them towards the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħarrieġ 放进“有人引导大家走出门”的画面，记住本词条指使别人出去的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stone projecting from a wall, or a stone spout through which water flows out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 突出于墙面的石块，或供水流出的石制出水嘴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġebla li toħroġ 'il barra minn ħajt, jew bokka tal-ġebel li minnha joħroġ l-ilma.

sense_translations.en_definition: a stone projecting from a wall
sense_translations.zh_definition: 从墙面向外突出的石块；墙面凸石。
石制出水嘴；供水流出的石质槽嘴。

collocations.en: a projecting stone in the wall

formal.mt: L-ilma tax-xita jgħaddi mill-ħarrieġa tal-ġebel u jaqa' 'l bogħod mill-ħajt.
formal.en: Rainwater passes through the stone spout and falls away from the wall.
formal.zh: 雨水经石制出水嘴流出，落在离墙面较远的位置。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex dik il-ġebla ħierġa mill-ħajt? Toni: Dik hija ħarrieġa; oqgħod attent biex ma taħbatx magħha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does that stone stick out from the wall? Toni: That is a projecting stone; be careful not to bump into it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那块石头为什么突出墙面？托尼：那是墙面凸石，小心别撞上。

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.zh: 那块石头为什么突出墙面？
messages.en: Why does that stone stick out from the wall?

messages.speaker: Toni (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik hija ħarrieġa; oqgħod attent biex ma taħbatx magħha.
messages.mt_standard: Dik hija ħarrieġa; oqgħod attent biex ma taħbatx magħha.
messages.zh: 那是墙面凸石，小心别撞上。
messages.en: That is a projecting stone; be careful not to bump into it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ħarrieġa 配两幅图：墙上凸出的一块石头，以及让水向外流出的石嘴，分别记住两个义项。

gloss_zh: 提供培训的；具有训练作用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Providing training in a particular skill, activity, or subject.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提供某种技能、活动或学科方面训练的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti taħriġ f'ħila, attività jew suġġett partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提供某方面培训或训练的。

formal.mt: Il-programm ħarrieġi jgħallem lill-parteċipanti kif jużaw l-għodda b'mod sigur.
formal.en: The training programme teaches participants how to use the tools safely.
formal.zh: 这个培训项目教参与者如何安全使用工具。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-kors huwa teoriku biss? Sara: Le, huwa kors ħarrieġi: titgħallem kif tuża l-magna.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this course only theoretical? Sara: No, it provides training: you learn how to use the machine.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这门课只讲理论吗？萨拉：不是，它提供操作训练，你会学到如何使用机器。

messages.speaker: Mark (学员)
messages.zh: 这门课只讲理论吗？
messages.en: Is this course only theoretical?

messages.speaker: Sara (培训教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa kors ħarrieġi: titgħallem kif tuża l-magna.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa kors ħarrieġi: titgħallem kif tuża l-magna.
messages.zh: 不是，它提供操作训练，你会学到如何使用机器。
messages.en: No, it provides training: you learn how to use the machine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħarrieġi 写在培训课程旁，想象学员练习操作机器；本词条是描述提供训练的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of looking or watching, or the gaze directed towards someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 看或观看的行为，也指投向某人或某物的目光。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iħares jew josserva, jew il-mod kif jitfa' għajnejh fuq xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 投向人或事物的目光；看的神情。
短暂的一瞥；匆匆投去的目光。
凝视；持续注视的目光。
观看；留意观察的行为。

formal.mt: Il-ħars attent tal-istudenti wera l-interess tagħhom fl-esperiment.
formal.en: The students' attentive watching showed their interest in the experiment.
formal.zh: 学生们专注观看，表现出他们对实验的兴趣。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dak il-ħars kollu lejn it-tieqa? | Mark: Qed nistenna lil ħija jasal.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why all that looking towards the window? | Mark: I'm waiting for my brother to arrive.
colloquial.zh: Maja：怎么一直往窗户那边看？ | Mark：我在等我兄弟来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dak il-ħars kollu lejn it-tieqa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dak il-ħars kollu lejn it-tieqa?
messages.zh: 怎么一直往窗户那边看？
messages.en: Why all that looking towards the window?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我在等我兄弟来。
messages.en: I'm waiting for my brother to arrive.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħars 联想成镜头持续记录目光：重点是“看、注视”这件事，也可以表示投来的目光。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A look or glance directed at someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 朝某人或某物看的一眼，也可指这一眼所流露的神情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daqqa t'għajn lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, li tista' wkoll turi sentiment jew ħsieb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一眼；一瞥；看向某人或某物的目光。

formal.mt: Qabel tiffirma d-dokument, agħti ħarsa lejn id-dettalji kollha.
formal.en: Before signing the document, take a look at all the details.
formal.zh: 签署文件之前，请查看所有细节。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tista' tagħti ħarsa lejn dan ir-ritratt? | Luqa: Iva, urini. Fejn ħadtu?
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you take a look at this photo? | Luqa: Yes, show me. Where did you take it?
colloquial.zh: Sara：你能看看这张照片吗？ | Luqa：可以，给我看看。你在哪里拍的？

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tagħti ħarsa lejn dan ir-ritratt?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tagħti ħarsa lejn dan ir-ritratt?
messages.zh: 你能看看这张照片吗？
messages.en: Can you take a look at this photo?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 可以，给我看看。你在哪里拍的？
messages.en: Yes, show me. Where did you take it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习时把 ħarsa 画成一次快门：朝目标看“一眼”，再把 agħti ħarsa 整块记成“看一看”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Protection from harm, or responsibility for keeping someone or something safe and in one's care.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或事物免受伤害的保护，也指承担安全照管或监护的责任。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Protezzjoni mill-ħsara jew responsabbiltà biex persuna jew ħaġa tinżamm sigura u taħt il-kura ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 监护；保管；对人或物承担照管责任的状态。
保护；防护；使人或事物免受伤害。

formal.mt: Il-programm jippromwovi l-ħarsien tal-ambjent permezz ta' edukazzjoni u azzjoni fil-komunità.
formal.en: The programme promotes environmental protection through education and community action.
formal.zh: 该计划通过教育和社区行动促进环境保护。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex hemm ċint madwar il-bejta? | Toni: Għall-ħarsien tal-għasafar, biex ħadd ma jersaq wisq qrib.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is there a fence around the nest? | Toni: For the birds' protection, so nobody gets too close.
colloquial.zh: Nina：为什么鸟巢周围有围栏？ | Toni：为了保护鸟儿，免得有人靠得太近。

messages.speaker: Nina (游客)
messages.zh: 为什么鸟巢周围有围栏？
messages.en: Why is there a fence around the nest?

messages.speaker: Toni (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għall-ħarsien tal-għasafar, biex ħadd ma jersaq wisq qrib.
messages.mt_standard: Għall-ħarsien tal-għasafar, biex ħadd ma jersaq wisq qrib.
messages.zh: 为了保护鸟儿，免得有人靠得太近。
messages.en: For the birds' protection, so nobody gets too close.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħarsien 想成围在孩子或鸟巢外的保护圈：圈内有人照管，圈外挡住伤害，连接“监护”和“保护”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The agricultural work of turning the soil with a plough to prepare land for planting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用犁翻动土壤、为播种做准备的农业作业。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol agrikolu li fih il-ħamrija tinqaleb bil-moħriet biex l-art titħejja għaż-żrigħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 犁地；用犁翻耕土壤的作业。

formal.mt: Il-ħart tal-għalqa tlesta qabel beda ż-żrigħ.
formal.en: The ploughing of the field was completed before sowing began.
formal.zh: 这块田在开始播种之前已经完成翻耕。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Lest il-ħart tal-għalqa? | Ġużeppi: Iva, lestejtu dalgħodu. Issa nistgħu nibdew niżirgħu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is the ploughing of the field finished? | Ġużeppi: Yes, I finished it this morning. Now we can start sowing.
colloquial.zh: Marija：田已经犁好了吗？ | Ġużeppi：是的，我今天早上犁好了。现在可以开始播种了。

messages.speaker: Marija (农民)
messages.zh: 田已经犁好了吗？
messages.en: Is the ploughing of the field finished?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, lestejtu dalgħodu. Issa nistgħu nibdew niżirgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, lestejtu dalgħodu. Issa nistgħu nibdew niżirgħu.
messages.zh: 是的，我今天早上犁好了。现在可以开始播种了。
messages.en: Yes, I finished it this morning. Now we can start sowing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ħart 配一幅犁头翻开泥土的图，按“先犁地、后播种”的顺序记住它表示农业作业。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A blow to someone's face with an open hand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用张开的手掌打在别人脸上的一下，即一记耳光。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daqqa fuq wiċċ xi ħadd bil-pala tal-id miftuħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打在脸上的一巴掌；一记耳光。

collocations.en: to give someone a slap in the face
to receive a slap in the face

formal.mt: Ix-xhud qal li ra raġel jagħti ħarta lil raġel ieħor.
formal.en: The witness said that he saw a man slap another man in the face.
formal.zh: 证人说，他看见一名男子打了另一名男子一记耳光。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tibki? | Anna: Tifel tani ħarta. | Lara: Ejja mmorru għand l-għalliema.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you crying? | Anna: A boy slapped me in the face. | Lara: Let's go to the teacher.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你怎么哭了？ | Anna：一个男孩打了我一记耳光。 | Lara：我们去找老师吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你怎么哭了？
messages.en: Why are you crying?

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 一个男孩打了我一记耳光。
messages.en: A boy slapped me in the face.

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 我们去找老师吧。
messages.en: Let's go to the teacher.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一只张开的手掌碰到脸”的画面记 ħarta；它是名词，重点数出“一记耳光”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To hit someone in the face with an open hand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用张开的手掌打某人的脸，即打某人耳光。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta daqqa lil xi ħadd fuq wiċċu bil-pala tal-id miftuħa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to slap sb. in the face
sense_translations.zh_definition: 打某人一记耳光；用手掌打某人的脸。

collocations.en: he slapped someone in the face
he slapped his companion in the face during a fight
collocations.zh: 他在打斗中打了同伴一记耳光

formal.mt: Skont ix-xhud, ir-raġel ħartam lil ġar tiegħu waqt argument.
formal.en: According to the witness, the man slapped his neighbour in the face during an argument.
formal.zh: 据证人所述，该男子在争吵中打了邻居一记耳光。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ġara fil-bitħa? | Ben: Pawlu ħartam lil Mark. | Sara: Immorru ngħidu lill-għalliem minnufih.
colloquial.en: Sara: What happened in the yard? | Ben: Pawlu slapped Mark in the face. | Sara: Let's tell the teacher straight away.
colloquial.zh: Sara：院子里发生什么事了？ | Ben：Pawlu 打了 Mark 一记耳光。 | Sara：我们马上去告诉老师吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 院子里发生什么事了？
messages.en: What happened in the yard?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: Pawlu 打了 Mark 一记耳光。
messages.en: Pawlu slapped Mark in the face.

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 我们马上去告诉老师吧。
messages.en: Let's tell the teacher straight away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħarta 的“一记耳光”画面变成动作短片来记 ħartam：谁打了谁，句中用 lil 引出被打的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A marine mammal with flippers that swims in the sea and also rests on land.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种有鳍状肢的海洋哺乳动物，能在海中游泳，也会到陆地上休息，即海豹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mammiferu tal-baħar li għandu xewk flok saqajn, jgħum fil-baħar u jistrieħ ukoll fuq l-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海豹，一种具有鳍状肢的海洋哺乳动物。

formal.mt: Il-ħaruf il-baħar huwa mammiferu li jqatta' parti minn ħajtu fil-baħar u parti fuq l-art.
formal.en: The seal is a mammal that spends part of its life in the sea and part on land.
formal.zh: 海豹是一种生活时间部分在海中、部分在陆地上的哺乳动物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak il-ħaruf il-baħar fuq il-blata! | Toni: Rajtu! Issa qed jinżel fl-ilma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that seal on the rock! | Toni: I see it! It's going into the water now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：看岩石上的那只海豹！ | Toni：看到了！它现在正下水呢。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak il-ħaruf il-baħar fuq il-blata!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak il-ħaruf il-baħar fuq il-blata!
messages.zh: 看岩石上的那只海豹！
messages.en: Look at that seal on the rock!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了！它现在正下水呢。
messages.en: I see it! It's going into the water now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħaruf il-baħar 整组贴在海豹图片上，配上“岩石休息、下海游泳”两个场景来记，不拆成其他动物。

gloss_zh: 天主的羔羊；上帝的羔羊

teaching_sense.en_definition: A Christian title for Jesus Christ, used especially in prayer and worship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基督教中称呼耶稣基督的称号，常用于祈祷和礼拜，中文可译为“天主的羔羊”或“上帝的羔羊”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titlu Nisrani għal Ġesù Kristu, użat b'mod speċjali fit-talb u fil-qima.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天主的羔羊；上帝的羔羊，基督教中对耶稣基督的称号。

formal.mt: Fit-talb Nisrani, it-titlu Ħaruf ta' Alla jirreferi għal Ġesù Kristu.
formal.en: In Christian prayer, the title Lamb of God refers to Jesus Christ.
formal.zh: 在基督教祈祷中，“天主的羔羊”这一称号指耶稣基督。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Xi jfisser Ħaruf ta' Alla f'din it-talba? | David: Huwa titlu għal Ġesù Kristu.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does Lamb of God mean in this prayer? | David: It is a title for Jesus Christ.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这篇祷文里的“天主的羔羊”是什么意思？ | David：这是耶稣基督的一个称号。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser Ħaruf ta' Alla f'din it-talba?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser Ħaruf ta' Alla f'din it-talba?
messages.zh: 这篇祷文里的“天主的羔羊”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does Lamb of God mean in this prayer?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.zh: 这是耶稣基督的一个称号。
messages.en: It is a title for Jesus Christ.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ħaruf ta' Alla 整组放进“祷文中的耶稣称号”记忆卡，中文对应“天主的羔羊”，同时留意称号中的大写。

gloss_zh: 沉重地呼吸；发出呼噜声；发出空洞声；呼吸沉重的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To breathe noisily and heavily, to purr, or to make a hollow sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 沉重而有声地呼吸；也可指发出呼噜声或空洞的声响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu n-nifs b'mod tqil u jinstema'; jista' wkoll jagħmel il-ħoss ta' qattus kuntent jew ħoss vojt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沉重地呼吸；发出粗重的喘息声。
发出呼噜声，尤指猫发出的声音。
发出空洞的声响。
呼吸沉重、喘息声很重的人。

collocations.en: the drum made a hollow sound

formal.mt: Wara li tela' t-taraġ kollu, ir-raġel ħarħar għal ftit u mbagħad qagħad bilqiegħda.
formal.en: After climbing all the stairs, the man breathed heavily for a little while and then sat down.
formal.zh: 爬完所有楼梯后，男子沉重地喘息了一会儿，然后坐了下来。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-qattus ħarħar meta messejtlu rasu. Luqa: Ara kemm hu kuntent ħdejk!
colloquial.en: Sara: The cat purred when I stroked its head. Luqa: Look how happy it is beside you!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我摸猫的头时，它发出了呼噜声。卢卡：看，它待在你身边多开心！

messages.speaker: Sara (猫主人)
messages.zh: 我摸猫的头时，它发出了呼噜声。
messages.en: The cat purred when I stroked its head.

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，它待在你身边多开心！
messages.en: Look how happy it is beside you!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三幅有声画面并排记：人粗重喘息、猫舒服呼噜、鼓声空洞；另用人物卡记名词义。

gloss_zh: 喉中或胸中的格格声；嘎啦声

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rattling sound, such as a rough noise heard during breathing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 格格或嘎啦作响的声音，例如呼吸时喉中或胸中发出的粗涩声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss li jqarqar, bħal dak li jista' jinstema' fil-gerżuma jew fis-sider waqt in-nifs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 格格声；嘎啦声，尤可指呼吸时发出的粗涩声。

collocations.en: a rattling sound in the chest
a rattling sound in the throat

formal.mt: Fid-deskrizzjoni tal-karattru, l-awtur isemmi ħarħara fil-gerżuma li tinstema' kull darba li jieħu n-nifs.
formal.en: In the character description, the author mentions a rattle in the throat that can be heard with every breath.
formal.zh: 描写人物时，作者提到他每次呼吸都会从喉中发出格格声。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'inhu dak il-ħoss fir-reġistrazzjoni? Ben: Ħarħara fil-gerżuma tal-attur.
colloquial.en: Anna: What is that sound in the recording? Ben: A rattle in the actor's throat.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：录音里那个是什么声音？本：是演员喉中发出的格格声。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: 录音里那个是什么声音？
messages.en: What is that sound in the recording?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 是演员喉中发出的格格声。
messages.en: A rattle in the actor's throat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它当作给声音贴的标签：听到喉中格格作响，就把这团声音标成这个名词。

gloss_zh: 发出粗重呼吸声的；格格作响的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Producing a heavy breathing sound or a rough rattling sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容发出粗重呼吸声或粗涩格格声的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħmel ħoss ta' nifs tqil jew ħoss li jqarqar.

sense_translations.en_definition: making the sound of heavy breathing
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出粗重呼吸声的。
格格作响的；发出粗涩颤响的。

formal.mt: L-attur ta lill-karattru nifs ħarħari biex juri kemm kien għajjien wara l-ġirja.
formal.en: The actor gave the character heavy, noisy breathing to show how tired he was after the run.
formal.zh: 演员让角色发出粗重的呼吸声，表现他跑步后的疲惫。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dan il-ħoss ħarħari ġej mill-kaxxa? Toni: Iva, hemm xi ħaġa maħlula ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Marta: Is this rattling sound coming from the box? Toni: Yes, there is something loose inside.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这个格格作响的声音是从盒子里传来的吗？托尼：是的，里面有东西松了。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个格格作响的声音是从盒子里传来的吗？
messages.en: Is this rattling sound coming from the box?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm xi ħaġa maħlula ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm xi ħaġa maħlula ġewwa.
messages.zh: 是的，里面有东西松了。
messages.en: Yes, there is something loose inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住这是描述性质的形容词：给呼吸或声音加上粗重、格格作响的听觉特征。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Heavy, audible breathing, or the purring sound made by a cat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 粗重而能听见的呼吸；也指猫发出的呼噜声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nifs tqil li jinstema', jew il-ħoss li jagħmel qattus meta jkun kuntent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粗重的呼吸；沉重的喘息声。
发出呼噜声；尤指猫的呼噜声。

formal.mt: Fid-deskrizzjoni tat-tellieqa, il-ħarħir tar-raġel juri l-isforz kbir li għamel.
formal.en: In the description of the race, the man's heavy breathing shows the great effort he made.
formal.zh: 在对比赛的描写中，男子粗重的呼吸表现了他付出的巨大努力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Laundry or the act of washing; in a financial context, money laundering.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指待洗或正在洗的衣物，也指洗涤行为；在金融语境中还可指洗钱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħwejjeġ li jinħaslu jew l-att tat-tindif bl-ilma; f'kuntest finanzjarju, il-ħasil ta' flus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 待洗或正在清洗的衣物；要洗的衣服。
洗涤；清洗这一行为。
洗钱，即掩饰非法所得来源，使其看似来自合法渠道。

formal.mt: Il-ħasil tal-idejn għandu jsir qabel il-preparazzjoni tal-ikel.
formal.en: Hands should be washed before food preparation.
formal.zh: 准备食物前应当洗手。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn inpoġġi l-ħasil? Mark: Poġġih fil-qoffa ħdejn il-magna tal-ħasil.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where should I put the laundry? Mark: Put it in the basket next to the washing machine.
colloquial.zh: Maja：待洗衣物放在哪里？Mark：放在洗衣机旁边的篮子里。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 待洗衣物放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put the laundry?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 放在洗衣机旁边的篮子里。
messages.en: Put it in the basket next to the washing machine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个场景区分词义：洗衣篮对应衣物，水龙头对应清洗，金融新闻对应洗钱。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of disguising the illegal origin of money so that it appears legitimate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过掩饰资金的非法来源，使其看起来来自合法渠道的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih tinħeba l-oriġini illegali tal-flus biex jidhru li ġejjin minn sorsi leġittimi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 洗钱；掩饰非法资金来源，使其表面上合法化。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi każ suspettat ta' ħasil ta' flus.
formal.en: The report describes a suspected case of money laundering.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一起涉嫌洗钱的案件。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser 'ħasil ta' flus' f'din l-aħbar? Pawlu: Ifisser li tinħeba l-oriġini illegali tal-flus biex jidhru leġittimi.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does 'money laundering' mean in this news story? Pawlu: It means hiding the illegal origin of money to make it appear legitimate.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这则新闻里的“洗钱”是什么意思？Pawlu：就是掩饰钱的非法来源，让它看起来合法。

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和中文“洗钱”一起记：这里掩饰的是资金来源，不是清洗纸币。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act or procedure of castration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次阉割行为或阉割手术。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew l-intervent li bih annimal jew persuna tiġi kkastrata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次阉割；一次阉割手术。

formal.mt: Ir-reġistru veterinarju jinkludi d-data tal-ħasja tal-annimal.
formal.en: The veterinary record includes the date of the animal's castration.
formal.zh: 兽医记录中列有该动物接受阉割的日期。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi 'ħasja' f'dan ir-reġistru? Toni: Tfisser kastrazzjoni; hawn qed jitkellmu dwar il-barri.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'ħasja' mean in this record? Toni: It means castration; here they are talking about the bull.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这份记录里的 ħasja 是什么意思？Toni：是阉割的意思；这里说的是那头公牛。

gloss_zh: 彻底清洗；狠狠训斥（用于 ħasla ħaslun）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cognate-object noun used in 'ħasla ħaslun' to express a thorough wash or a severe scolding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于 ħasla ħaslun 这一表达的同源宾语名词，表示彻底清洗或狠狠训斥。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom użat bħala oġġett tal-istess għerq fl-espressjoni 'ħasla ħaslun', li tfisser ħasla kbira jew ċanfira qawwija.

sense_translations.en_definition: cognate object of the verb used in 'ħasla ħaslun' meaning a big wash or a big scolding
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与动词同源的宾语，见于 ħasla ħaslun 这一表达，表示大洗一番或狠狠训斥一顿。

collocations.zh: 把地面彻底清洗了一遍

collocations.en: gave the boy a severe scolding

formal.zh: 工作结束后，工人把地面彻底清洗了一遍。

gloss_zh: 感到怜悯的；心生同情的

teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因他人的遭遇而感到怜悯或同情的。

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到怜悯的；正在心生同情的。

collocations.en: feeling pity for the poor person

formal.en: Feeling compassion for the family that had lost its home, the man offered his help.
formal.zh: 那名男子同情这个失去家园的家庭，主动提供了帮助。

colloquial.zh: Sara：Pawlu 为什么去帮助那个男孩？Mark：因为男孩孤身一人，他很同情他。

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有收割倾向的；具有收割习性的。

gloss_zh: 导致取消的；具有撤销效果的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing or resulting in the cancellation of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某事被取消或产生撤销效果的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jwassal għat-tħassir jew għall-kanċellazzjoni ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 导致取消的；产生撤销结果的。

an act that results in cancellation

messages.en: It means an effect that causes something to be cancelled.

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wash something vigorously; in a separate sense, to obtain something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用力或彻底地清洗某物；另一个义项是获得某物。

获得；取得。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel or touch something, or to work out and understand something.

gloss_zh: 发人深省的；引人思考的

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lil dak li jkun jaħseb sew jew fil-fond dwar idea jew kwistjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发人深省的；引人深入思考的。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jaf kif jitgħallem: josserva, jistaqsi u jipprattika.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jaf kif jitgħallem: josserva, jistaqsi u jipprattika.
messages.zh: 因为他懂得怎么学：观察、提问，再练习。
messages.en: Because he knows how to learn: he observes, asks questions and practises.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分成两张人物卡记忆：一张是洗衣的人，一张是懂得学技能的人；两个义项分开记，不强行联成词源故事。

gloss_zh: 有助于获取某物的事物；习得辅助物

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that makes it easier to acquire something, such as knowledge or a skill.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使获得某种事物变得更容易的辅助物，例如帮助获取知识或习得技能的材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tagħmilha aktar faċli li tinkiseb xi ħaġa, bħall-għarfien jew xi ħila.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 促进或便利某物获取的事物；有助于习得的辅助物。

collocations.zh: 帮助获取知识的辅助物
帮助习得技能的辅助物

formal.mt: Il-manwal iservi bħala ħassieli tal-ħiliet billi jgħaqqad spjegazzjonijiet ċari ma' eżerċizzji prattiċi.
formal.en: The manual serves as an aid to acquiring skills by combining clear explanations with practical exercises.
formal.zh: 这本手册结合清晰的讲解与实际练习，起到帮助习得技能的作用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ktieb jista' jkun ħassieli tal-għarfien? Pawlu: Iva, l-eżempji tiegħu jgħinuk tifhem ideat ġodda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can this book be an aid to acquiring knowledge? Pawlu: Yes, its examples help you understand new ideas.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这本书能成为帮助获取知识的辅助物吗？保罗：能，里面的例子可以帮助你理解新概念。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ktieb jista' jkun ħassieli tal-għarfien?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ktieb jista' jkun ħassieli tal-għarfien?
messages.zh: 这本书能成为帮助获取知识的辅助物吗？
messages.en: Can this book be an aid to acquiring knowledge?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, l-eżempji tiegħu jgħinuk tifhem ideat ġodda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, l-eżempji tiegħu jgħinuk tifhem ideat ġodda.
messages.zh: 能，里面的例子可以帮助你理解新概念。
messages.en: Yes, its examples help you understand new ideas.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一本放在学习阶梯旁的辅助教材：它帮助你获得知识或技能；本条按名词记作助你获取的事物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of washing the body with water; a bath.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用水清洗身体的一次活动，即洗澡或沐浴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħasla tal-ġisem bl-ilma; banju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次洗澡；沐浴。

formal.mt: Wara ġurnata ta' xogħol fiżiku, ħassula sħuna tista' tkun parti mir-rutina ta' filgħaxija.
formal.en: After a day of physical work, a warm bath can be part of the evening routine.
formal.zh: 经过一天的体力劳动后，洗个温水澡可以成为晚间日常安排的一部分。

colloquial.mt: Omm: Trid tagħmel ħassula qabel l-irqad? Sara: Iva, ħa nġib ix-xugaman u l-piġama.
colloquial.en: Mum: Do you want to have a bath before bed? Sara: Yes, I will get the towel and my pyjamas.
colloquial.zh: 妈妈：睡觉前想洗个澡吗？萨拉：想，我去拿毛巾和睡衣。

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 睡觉前想洗个澡吗？
messages.en: Do you want to have a bath before bed?

messages.speaker: Sara (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħa nġib ix-xugaman u l-piġama.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħa nġib ix-xugaman u l-piġama.
messages.zh: 想，我去拿毛巾和睡衣。
messages.en: Yes, I will get the towel and my pyjamas.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把毛巾、温水和睡衣放进同一个睡前画面，记住这个名词说的是一次洗澡或沐浴。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To join, make or repair fabric or clothing using stitches.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用针线缝合布料，制作或修补衣物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaqqad, jagħmel jew isewwi drapp jew ħwejjeġ bil-ponti tal-ħajt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缝；用针线缝制或缝补。

formal.mt: Il-ħajjat ħat il-qmis skont il-qisien tal-klijent u eżamina kull ponta qabel il-kunsinna.
formal.en: The tailor sewed the shirt to the customer's measurements and examined every stitch before delivery.
formal.zh: 裁缝按照顾客的尺寸缝制了衬衫，并在交付前检查了每一针。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min ħat din il-borża? Mark: Missieri; ħat kollox bl-idejn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who sewed this bag? Mark: My father; he sewed everything by hand.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个包是谁缝的？马克：我爸爸，他全是手工缝的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个包是谁缝的？
messages.en: Who sewed this bag?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我爸爸，他全是手工缝的。
messages.en: My father; he sewed everything by hand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见这个短词，就想象针穿过布料、线把两边连起来；用手工缝包的动作记住缝纫义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bet on an outcome or to gamble by risking money on an uncertain result.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某个结果打赌或下注，也指以金钱押在不确定结果上进行赌博。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel imħatra fuq riżultat jew jilgħab il-flus fuq riżultat mhux ċert.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打赌；对某个结果下注。
赌博；以金钱押在不确定的结果上。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, ir-raġel ħater għaxar ewro fuq ir-riżultat tat-tiġrija.
formal.en: According to the report, the man bet ten euros on the outcome of the race.
formal.zh: 据报告，该男子就比赛结果下注了十欧元。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu ħater fuq il-logħba tal-bieraħ? Mark: Iva, ħater ħames ewro, iżda tilef l-imħatra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu bet on yesterday's game? Mark: Yes, he bet five euros, but he lost the bet.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗对昨天那场比赛下注了吗？马克：下了，他押了五欧元，不过赌输了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗对昨天那场比赛下注了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu bet on yesterday's game?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħater ħames ewro, iżda tilef l-imħatra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħater ħames ewro, iżda tilef l-imħatra.
messages.zh: 下了，他押了五欧元，不过赌输了。
messages.en: Yes, he bet five euros, but he lost the bet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把五欧元押在尚未揭晓的比分旁：针对一个结果是下注，作为赌博活动理解时则对应赌博义。

gloss_zh: 抢夺；绑架；ħataf 的动名词

teaching_sense.en_definition: The verbal noun of ħataf, denoting an act of snatching or kidnapping.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 动词 ħataf 的动名词，表示抢夺的动作或绑架行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-nom verbali ta' ħataf, li jfisser teħid b'ħeffa jew bil-forza, jew teħid ta' persuna kontra r-rieda tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 动词 ħataf 的动名词，表示相应的动作或行为。
抢夺；突然或强行夺取某物的行为。
绑架；违背他人意愿将其劫持带走的行为。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddistingwi bejn il-ħatf ta' oġġett u l-ħatf ta' persuna, u jiddeskrivi kull każ separatament.
formal.en: The report distinguishes between the snatching of an object and the kidnapping of a person, describing each case separately.
formal.zh: 该报告区分了抢夺物品与绑架人员两种情况，并分别描述了各个案件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fl-aħbar semmew ħatf; kien ta' persuna? Pawlu: Le, kien ħatf ta' basket minn idejn mara.
colloquial.en: Lara: The news mentioned ħatf; was someone kidnapped? Pawlu: No, a bag was snatched from a woman's hands.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：新闻里提到了 ħatf，是有人遭绑架了吗？保罗：不是，是一名女子手里的包被抢走了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-aħbar semmew ħatf; kien ta' persuna?
messages.mt_standard: Fl-aħbar semmew ħatf; kien ta' persuna?
messages.zh: 新闻里提到了 ħatf，是有人遭绑架了吗？
messages.en: The news mentioned ħatf; was someone kidnapped?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kien ħatf ta' basket minn idejn mara.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kien ħatf ta' basket minn idejn mara.
messages.zh: 不是，是一名女子手里的包被抢走了。
messages.en: No, a bag was snatched from a woman's hands.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记它是动作名称，再看被夺走的对象：对象是包时想到抢夺，对象是人时想到绑架，靠宾语语境区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to sealing an object or closing an opening securely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与封缄物件或将开口密封有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mas-siġillar ta' oġġett jew mal-għeluq tiegħu b'mod sigur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与封缄或密封有关的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-proċess ħatmi u l-materjal użat biex jingħalaq il-kontenitur.
formal.en: The report describes the sealing process and the material used to close the container.
formal.zh: 报告描述了密封过程以及封闭容器所用的材料。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għandna bżonn dan il-materjal ħatmi? Toni: Biex nagħlqu l-kaxxa sew u ma jidħolx ilma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do we need this sealing material? Toni: To close the box securely and keep water out.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们为什么需要这种密封材料？托尼：为了把箱子封严，防止进水。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għandna bżonn dan il-materjal ħatmi?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għandna bżonn dan il-materjal ħatmi?
messages.zh: 我们为什么需要这种密封材料？
messages.en: Why do we need this sealing material?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex nagħlqu l-kaxxa sew u ma jidħolx ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Biex nagħlqu l-kaxxa sew u ma jidħolx ilma.
messages.zh: 为了把箱子封严，防止进水。
messages.en: To close the box securely and keep water out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放在“密封材料、密封过程”这两个搭配中记忆，看到形容词就联想到封严开口。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To strike someone or something with a piece of wood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用一块木头击打某人或某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jolqot lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa b'biċċa injam.

sense_translations.en_definition: to beat with a piece of wood
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用木块击打、敲打。

collocations.en: he struck the door with a piece of wood
he struck the box with a piece of wood

formal.mt: Ix-xhud qal li r-raġel ħattab il-bieb b'biċċa injam sakemm inkiser.
formal.en: The witness said that the man struck the door with a piece of wood until it broke.
formal.zh: 证人说，那名男子用木块击打门，直到门被打坏。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'kien dak il-ħoss? Pawlu: Xi ħadd ħattab il-kaxxa b'biċċa injam.
colloquial.en: Lara: What was that noise? Pawlu: Someone struck the box with a piece of wood.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：刚才是什么声音？保罗：有人用木块敲打了箱子。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 刚才是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that noise?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd ħattab il-kaxxa b'biċċa injam.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd ħattab il-kaxxa b'biċċa injam.
messages.zh: 有人用木块敲打了箱子。
messages.en: Someone struck the box with a piece of wood.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人拿木块敲箱子的声音，把“木块作工具”与“击打动作”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To close something with a seal or make its closure secure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给物件加上封缄，或将其封闭严实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħlaq xi ħaġa b'siġill jew jissiġillaha b'mod sigur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 封缄；密封。
封缄者；从事密封工作的人。

formal.mt: L-uffiċjal ħattam l-envelop qabel ma bagħtu lill-arkivju.
formal.en: The official sealed the envelope before sending it to the archive.
formal.zh: 工作人员先将信封封好，再寄往档案馆。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min ħattam il-kaxxa? Mark: Jien. Issa lesta biex tintbagħat.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who sealed the box? Mark: I did. It is ready to be sent now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁把箱子封好了？马克：我封的。现在可以寄出了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 谁把箱子封好了？
messages.en: Who sealed the box?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 我封的。现在可以寄出了。
messages.en: I did. It is ready to be sent now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“封好信封再寄出”的画面记动词；遇到名词用法时，再联想到完成封缄的人。

gloss_zh: 促使选择；促使当选；用棍击打；选人者；下注者；赌徒

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bring about someone's choice or election; in a separate sense, to strike with a stick.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 促使某人作出选择或促使某人当选；另有用棍击打的独立义项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jagħżel jew iwassal biex xi ħadd jiġi elett; f'tifsira oħra, jolqot b'bastun.

sense_translations.en_definition: to cause a choice to be made by sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 促使某人作出选择。

sense_translations.en_definition: to cause sb. to be elected
sense_translations.zh_definition: 促使某人当选。
用棍棒击打。
选中了某个人的人；作出人员选择者。

sense_translations.en_definition: better/bettor (one) who indulges in or makes/takes up bets or wagers
sense_translations.zh_definition: 下注者；参与、提出或接受赌注的人。
赌徒；参与赌博的人。

collocations.en: he struck his companion with a stick
the selector who chose the candidate

formal.mt: Ix-xhud stqarr li l-akkużat ħattar lil sieħbu b'bastun.
formal.en: The witness stated that the accused struck his companion with a stick.
formal.zh: 证人陈述，被告曾用棍子击打同伴。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min hu dak ir-raġel ħdejn il-mejda? David: Hu ħattar; spiss jagħmel imħatri fuq it-tiġrijiet.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who is that man by the table? David: He is a bettor; he often bets on races.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：桌子旁边那个人是谁？戴维：他是个投注者，经常在比赛上下注。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak ir-raġel ħdejn il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak ir-raġel ħdejn il-mejda?
messages.zh: 桌子旁边那个人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that man by the table?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu ħattar; spiss jagħmel imħatri fuq it-tiġrijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Hu ħattar; spiss jagħmel imħatri fuq it-tiġrijiet.
messages.zh: 他是个投注者，经常在比赛上下注。
messages.en: He is a bettor; he often bets on races.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做六张语境卡分别记忆：促人选择、促人当选、棍击、选人者、下注者、赌徒；先看词性再选义。

gloss_zh: 与选举有关的；倾向冒险下注的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to elections, or describing a tendency to risk money by betting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与选举有关的；也可形容倾向于冒险下注的性格或倾向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-elezzjonijiet, jew li juri tendenza li wieħed jirriskja l-flus fl-imħatri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与选举有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: having a tendency to bet money in risky situations
sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于在风险较大的情况下拿钱下注的。

collocations.en: a character inclined to risky betting

formal.mt: Id-dokument jispjega l-proċess ħattari u kif jingħaddu l-voti.
formal.en: The document explains the electoral process and how the votes are counted.
formal.zh: 该文件说明了选举过程以及选票的统计方式。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tgħid li għandu karattru ħattari? Leon: Għax jagħmel imħatri bi flusu anki meta r-riskju hu kbir.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you say he has a character inclined to risky betting? Leon: Because he bets his money even when the risk is high.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么说他性格上爱冒险下注？莱昂：因为即使风险很大，他也会拿自己的钱下注。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tgħid li għandu karattru ħattari?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tgħid li għandu karattru ħattari?
messages.zh: 你为什么说他性格上爱冒险下注？
messages.en: Why do you say he has a character inclined to risky betting?

messages.speaker: Leon (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jagħmel imħatri bi flusu anki meta r-riskju hu kbir.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jagħmel imħatri bi flusu anki meta r-riskju hu kbir.
messages.zh: 因为即使风险很大，他也会拿自己的钱下注。
messages.en: Because he bets his money even when the risk is high.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两幅小图：一幅是投票箱，一幅是冒险下注的人；靠周围的选举词或赌注词判断具体意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone bend forward or bend over.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人身体向前弯曲或弯下腰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitgħawweġ 'il quddiem jew jitbaxxa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to cause sb. to bend over
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人弯腰；使某人俯下身。

collocations.en: the weight made the man bend over
collocations.zh: 重物压得那名男子弯下腰

collocations.en: the pain made the patient bend over

formal.mt: It-toqol tal-ixkora ħatteb lill-ħaddiem waqt li kien qed iġorrha.
formal.en: The weight of the sack made the worker bend over while carrying it.
formal.zh: 工人搬运麻袋时，袋子的重量压得他弯下了腰。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex waqaft? Ġanni: It-toqol ħatteb lili wkoll. Għandi bżonn inpoġġi l-ixkora.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did you stop? Ġanni: The weight made me bend over too. I need to put the sack down.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你怎么停下来了？詹尼：这重量也压得我弯下腰了。我得把麻袋放下来。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 你怎么停下来了？
messages.en: Why did you stop?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: It-toqol ħatteb lili wkoll. Għandi bżonn inpoġġi l-ixkora.
messages.mt_standard: It-toqol ħatteb lili wkoll. Għandi bżonn inpoġġi l-ixkora.
messages.zh: 这重量也压得我弯下腰了。我得把麻袋放下来。
messages.en: The weight made me bend over too. I need to put the sack down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“重袋子使人弯腰”的完整画面，重点是某种力量或原因让另一个人弯下身体。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove the foreskin of the penis by circumcision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过包皮环切手术切除阴茎包皮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ineħħi l-prepuzju tal-pene permezz taċ-ċirkonċiżjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为某人施行包皮环切术。

collocations.zh: 他为病人施行了包皮环切术
他为一名成年男子施行了包皮环切术

formal.mt: Il-kirurgu ħatten lill-pazjent adult wara li kiseb il-kunsens tiegħu.
formal.en: The surgeon circumcised the adult patient after obtaining his consent.
formal.zh: 外科医生在取得这名成年病人的同意后，为其施行了包皮环切术。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'jiġifieri 'ħatten' f'din is-sentenza? Eva: Jiġifieri li t-tabib għamel ċirkonċiżjoni lill-pazjent.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does 'ħatten' mean in this sentence? Eva: It means that the doctor performed a circumcision on the patient.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这句话里的“ħatten”是什么意思？伊娃：意思是医生为病人做了包皮环切术。

messages.speaker: Mark (马耳他语学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的“ħatten”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ħatten' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Eva (马耳他语教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri li t-tabib għamel ċirkonċiżjoni lill-pazjent.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri li t-tabib għamel ċirkonċiżjoni lill-pazjent.
messages.zh: 意思是医生为病人做了包皮环切术。
messages.en: It means that the doctor performed a circumcision on the patient.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个动词放进“医生为病人施行包皮环切”的句框中记忆，同时记住施术者与接受者。

gloss_zh: 彻底拆毁；清楚勾画；工整书写

teaching_sense.en_definition: To demolish something completely; in separate senses, to delineate clearly or write neatly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某物彻底拆毁；另有清楚勾画和工整书写两个独立义项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iwaqqa' xi ħaġa għalkollox; f'tifsiriet oħra, ifassal b'mod ċar jew jikteb pulit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 彻底拆毁；完全拆除。
清楚地勾画、描绘或划定。
工整地书写；把字写得整洁清楚。

collocations.en: he thoroughly demolished the old building
he clearly delineated the boundaries on the map
collocations.zh: 他在地图上清楚地划出了边界

formal.mt: Il-kuntrattur ħattet il-bini l-qadim għalkollox qabel ma beda x-xogħol il-ġdid.
formal.en: The contractor completely demolished the old building before starting the new work.
formal.zh: 承包商在开始新工程之前，彻底拆除了旧建筑。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min ħattet l-ittra b'din il-kitba pulita? Ben: Ħija. Ħa l-ħin biex kull kelma tkun ċara.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who wrote the letter in this neat handwriting? Ben: My brother. He took his time to make every word clear.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：谁把这封信写得这么工整？本：我哥哥。他慢慢写，好让每个词都清清楚楚。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min ħattet l-ittra b'din il-kitba pulita?
messages.mt_standard: Min ħattet l-ittra b'din il-kitba pulita?
messages.zh: 谁把这封信写得这么工整？
messages.en: Who wrote the letter in this neat handwriting?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija. Ħa l-ħin biex kull kelma tkun ċara.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija. Ħa l-ħin biex kull kelma tkun ċara.
messages.zh: 我哥哥。他慢慢写，好让每个词都清清楚楚。
messages.en: My brother. He took his time to make every word clear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个宾语分开记义：建筑对应彻底拆毁，边界对应清楚勾画，书信对应工整书写。

gloss_zh: 使人弓背的；使人行动受限的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing a person to hunch over or severely impairing their ability to move.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人弯腰弓背，或严重妨碍身体活动的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lil persuna titgħawweġ 'il quddiem jew ifixkel serjament il-ħila tagħha li tiċċaqlaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人弯腰弓背的。
使人身体活动能力严重受损的；使人难以行动的。

collocations.en: a load that makes someone hunch over

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi piż ħattiebi li jġiegħel lill-ħaddiem jimxi mgħawweġ 'il quddiem.
formal.en: The report describes a load that makes the worker walk hunched forward.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一种重担，压得工人弓着背向前走。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed timxi mgħawweġ? Mark: Dan piż ħattiebi; għinni nniżżlu, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you walking hunched over? Mark: This load is making me hunch; please help me put it down.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么弓着背走路？Mark：这重担压得我直不起腰；请帮我把它放下来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么弓着背走路？
messages.en: Why are you walking hunched over?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan piż ħattiebi; għinni nniżżlu, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Dan piż ħattiebi; għinni nniżżlu, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 这重担压得我直不起腰；请帮我把它放下来。
messages.en: This load is making me hunch; please help me put it down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象重担把人的背压弯，再联想到疼痛让人难以行动；用这两幅画面记住两个形容词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who kidnaps someone, or a person who loots property.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 绑架他人的人；也可指抢掠财物的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taħtaf lil xi ħadd, jew persuna li tisraq proprjetà waqt serq u ħerba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绑架者；劫持他人的人。
抢掠者；趁混乱抢夺财物的人。

collocations.en: a looter who steals from shops

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-ħattief iżomm lit-tifel f'dar abbandunata sakemm jaslu l-pulizija.
formal.en: In the novel, the kidnapper holds the boy in an abandoned house until the police arrive.
formal.zh: 小说中，绑架者把男孩关在一所废弃房屋里，直到警察赶到。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu dak ir-raġel fl-istorja? Pawlu: Hu l-ħattief li ħataf lit-tifel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is that man in the story? Pawlu: He is the kidnapper who abducted the boy.
colloquial.zh: Lara：故事里的那个男人是谁？Pawlu：他就是绑架那个男孩的人。

messages.speaker: Lara (读书伙伴)
messages.zh: 故事里的那个男人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that man in the story?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (读书伙伴)
messages.zh: 他就是绑架那个男孩的人。
messages.en: He is the kidnapper who abducted the boy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两幅情景：绑走人的绑架者、抢走货物的抢掠者；阅读时看被夺走的是人还是财物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who unloads goods, or a person who draws lines.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从车辆等处卸下货物的人；另一个义项指画线的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħott il-merkanzija, jew persuna li tiġbed il-linji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卸货的人；负责把货物卸下的人。
画线的人；负责绘制线条的人。

formal.mt: Il-ħattiet tal-merkanzija jniżżel il-kaxxi mit-trakk u jqegħedhom fil-maħżen.
formal.en: The person unloading the goods takes the boxes off the truck and places them in the warehouse.
formal.zh: 卸货人员把箱子从卡车上搬下来，放进仓库。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min se jniżżel dawn il-kaxxi mit-trakk? Toni: Il-ħattiet; wasal issa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who is going to take these boxes off the truck? Toni: The unloader; he has just arrived.
colloquial.zh: Nina：谁来把这些箱子从卡车上卸下来？Toni：卸货的人；他刚到。

messages.speaker: Nina (仓库同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jniżżel dawn il-kaxxi mit-trakk?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jniżżel dawn il-kaxxi mit-trakk?
messages.zh: 谁来把这些箱子从卡车上卸下来？
messages.en: Who is going to take these boxes off the truck?

messages.speaker: Toni (仓库同事)
messages.zh: 卸货的人；他刚到。
messages.en: The unloader; he has just arrived.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词条配上两张人物卡：一人搬箱卸货，一人拿尺画线；两个义项分别记，靠上下文选择。

gloss_zh: 与拆除有关的；与卸货有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to demolition or to the unloading of goods or freight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与建筑物等的拆除有关的，或与商品、货物的卸载有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut mat-twaqqigħ ta' bini jew mal-ħatt ta' merkanzija jew tagħbijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与拆除、拆毁作业有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: related to unloading of merchandise or freight
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与商品或货物的卸载有关的。

collocations.en: demolition work on an old building

formal.mt: Il-pjan jiddeskrivi x-xogħol ħattieti meħtieġ biex jitwaqqa' l-bini l-antik.
formal.en: The plan describes the demolition work required to tear down the old building.
formal.zh: 该计划说明了拆除这座旧建筑所需的拆除作业。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'tip ta' xogħol qed tagħmel fil-port? Mark: Xogħol ħattieti: inħott il-merkanzija mill-vapuri.
colloquial.en: Sara: What kind of work are you doing at the port? Mark: Unloading work: I unload goods from ships.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你在港口做什么工作？Mark：卸货作业：我把货物从船上卸下来。

messages.mt_spoken: X'tip ta' xogħol qed tagħmel fil-port?
messages.mt_standard: X'tip ta' xogħol qed tagħmel fil-port?
messages.zh: 你在港口做什么工作？

messages.zh: 卸货作业：我把货物从船上卸下来。
messages.en: Unloading work: I unload goods from ships.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个形容词贴在两种作业旁：拆房作业和卸货作业；记住它描述工作性质，不表示工作人员。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Guilt: responsibility for wrongdoing, or the feeling of having done something wrong.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做错事所负的罪责，或因认为自己做错了事而产生的内疚感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-responsabbiltà għal għemil ħażin, jew is-sentiment li wieħed għamel xi ħaġa ħażina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 罪责；因做错事而产生的内疚、自责。

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, l-awtur jesprimi sens ta' ħatu għall-ħsara li kkawża.
formal.en: In his letter, the author expresses a sense of guilt for the harm he caused.
formal.zh: 作者在信中表达了对自己所造成伤害的内疚。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex trid titlob skuża lil Nina? Pawlu: Għandi sens ta' ħatu għax kellimtha ħażin.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do you want to apologize to Nina? Pawlu: I feel guilty because I spoke rudely to her.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么想向Nina道歉？Pawlu：我对她说话很不客气，心里很内疚。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex trid titlob skuża lil Nina?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex trid titlob skuża lil Nina?
messages.zh: 你为什么想向Nina道歉？
messages.en: Why do you want to apologize to Nina?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi sens ta' ħatu għax kellimtha ħażin.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi sens ta' ħatu għax kellimtha ħażin.
messages.zh: 我对她说话很不客气，心里很内疚。
messages.en: I feel guilty because I spoke rudely to her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象说了伤人的话后写信道歉的场景；把心里的内疚感与做错事所负的责任一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mixture formed by combining two or more substances or ingredients.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由两种或更多物质、材料或配料混合而成的混合物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħlita magħmula minn żewġ sustanzi jew ingredjenti jew aktar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 混合物；多种物质或成分混合而成的东西。

collocations.en: a mixture of flour and water

formal.mt: Għall-esperiment, ipprepara ħawda ta' ramel u ilma f'kontenitur trasparenti.
formal.en: For the experiment, prepare a mixture of sand and water in a transparent container.
formal.zh: 实验时，在透明容器中配制一份沙和水的混合物。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'hemm f'din l-iskutella? Toni: Ħawda ta' dqiq u ilma; ħawwadha ftit ieħor, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is in this bowl? Toni: A mixture of flour and water; please stir it a little more.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个碗里是什么？Toni：面粉和水的混合物；请再搅拌一下。

messages.speaker: Nina (一起做饭的朋友)

messages.en: What is in this bowl?

messages.mt_standard: Ħawda ta' dqiq u ilma; ħawwadha ftit ieħor, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 面粉和水的混合物；请再搅拌一下。
messages.en: A mixture of flour and water; please stir it a little more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把面粉和水倒进同一个碗，搅拌后得到一碗混合物；用这幅厨房画面记住名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of hollowing something out, or a reduction in the density of a material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物体内部挖空的过程，或材料密度降低的过程或变化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li jitneħħa l-materjal minn ġewwa oġġett biex isir vojt, jew tnaqqis fid-densità ta' materjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挖空；掏去物体内部材料、使其内部变空的过程。
密度降低；材料或物质变得较不密实。
很少；不常；表示某事发生的频率低。

collocations.en: a reduction in the density of the material

formal.mt: Il-ħawi tal-injam joħloq spazju vojt fiċ-ċentru tal-biċċa, filwaqt li l-ħitan ta' barra jibqgħu sħaħ.
formal.en: Hollowing out the wood creates an empty space in the center of the piece while the outer walls remain intact.
formal.zh: 挖空木材会在木块中央形成空腔，同时保留完整的外壁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tneħħi l-injam minn ġewwa? Mark: Qed nagħmel il-ħawi biex din il-biċċa ssir skutella.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you removing the wood from the inside? Mark: I am hollowing it out so this piece can become a bowl.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么把里面的木头挖掉？Mark：我在把它挖空，好把这块木头做成碗。

messages.speaker: Maja (木工学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tneħħi l-injam minn ġewwa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tneħħi l-injam minn ġewwa?
messages.zh: 你为什么把里面的木头挖掉？
messages.en: Why are you removing the wood from the inside?

messages.speaker: Mark (木工老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nagħmel il-ħawi biex din il-biċċa ssir skutella.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nagħmel il-ħawi biex din il-biċċa ssir skutella.
messages.zh: 我在把它挖空，好把这块木头做成碗。
messages.en: I am hollowing it out so this piece can become a bowl.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分三张卡记忆：木块被挖空、材料密度降低、事情很少发生；前两张是名词，最后一张是副词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An empty space inside something, or a hollow or depression in its surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体内部的空腔，或物体表面的凹洞、凹陷处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spazju vojt ġewwa xi ħaġa, jew parti mħaffra jew imdaħħla fil-wiċċ tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 空腔；物体内部或向内部延伸的空洞。
凹洞；中空处；凹陷的地方。

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, instabet ħawja fil-ħajt li ma kinitx tidher minn barra.
formal.en: During the inspection, a cavity was found in the wall that was not visible from the outside.
formal.zh: 检查时，人们发现墙内有一处从外面看不出来的空洞。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn daħal l-għasfur? Pawlu: F'dik il-ħawja fis-siġra; ħares ħdejn il-fergħa l-kbira.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did the bird go in? Pawlu: Into that hollow in the tree; look beside the large branch.
colloquial.zh: Lara：那只鸟钻到哪里去了？Pawlu：钻进树上的那个洞里了；看那根大树枝旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (散步的朋友)
messages.zh: 那只鸟钻到哪里去了？
messages.en: Where did the bird go in?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (散步的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dik il-ħawja fis-siġra; ħares ħdejn il-fergħa l-kbira.
messages.mt_standard: F'dik il-ħawja fis-siġra; ħares ħdejn il-fergħa l-kbira.
messages.zh: 钻进树上的那个洞里了；看那根大树枝旁边。
messages.en: Into that hollow in the tree; look beside the large branch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小鸟钻进树洞，洞里是空的；用这个具体空间记住空腔、凹洞和中空处的共同意思。

gloss_zh: 尚未产过幼崽的雌性动物，尤指尚未产羔的母山羊

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describes a female animal, especially a goat, that has not yet given birth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容尚未生育过的雌性动物，尤其用于母山羊；本身不表示没有生育能力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi annimal femminili, speċjalment mogħża, li għadu ma welled qatt.

sense_translations.en_definition: a female animal that has not borne offspring (used especially of goats)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 尚未产过幼崽的雌性动物，尤指尚未产羔的母山羊。

collocations.en: a goat that has not yet given birth
she has still never given birth

formal.mt: Fir-reġistru tar-razzett, din il-mogħża hija mniżżla bħala ħawlija għax għadha ma welldet qatt.
formal.en: In the farm register, this goat is recorded as having never given birth because she has not yet borne any young.
formal.zh: 农场登记簿将这只母山羊记为尚未生育，因为它还从未产过幼崽。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Din il-mogħża diġà welldet? Pawlu: Le, għadha ħawlija.
colloquial.en: Marija: Has this goat given birth before? Pawlu: No, she has never given birth yet.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这只母山羊以前产过羔吗？Pawlu：没有，它还没生育过。

messages.speaker: Marija (农场访客)
messages.zh: 这只母山羊以前产过羔吗？
messages.en: Has this goat given birth before?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (养殖户)
messages.zh: 没有，它还没生育过。
messages.en: No, she has never given birth yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħawlija 和母山羊的生育记录一起记：记录里还没有产羔经历，并不等于不能生育。

gloss_zh: 津津有味地吃；动物或鸟类喂养幼崽

teaching_sense.en_definition: To eat eagerly and with enjoyment; also, of an animal or bird, to feed its young.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指吃得起劲、津津有味；也指动物或鸟类给自己的幼崽喂食。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiekol b'ħerqa u bi pjaċir; jingħad ukoll għal annimal jew għasfur li jitma' liż-żgħar tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吃得起劲，津津有味地吃。

sense_translations.en_definition: to feed one's young (used of animals or birds)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给自己的幼崽喂食，用于动物或鸟类。

formal.mt: Wara l-mixja twila, il-kelb ħawsel l-ikel li tqiegħed quddiemu.
formal.en: After the long walk, the dog ate the food placed before it with gusto.
formal.zh: 长途散步后，那只狗津津有味地吃了放在面前的食物。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-kelb kiel illum? Mark: Iva, ħawsel l-ikel kollu!
colloquial.en: Lara: Has the dog eaten today? Mark: Yes, he ate all his food with gusto!
colloquial.zh: Lara：狗今天吃东西了吗？Mark：吃了，它吃得可香了，把食物全吃完了！

messages.speaker: Lara (宠物主人)
messages.zh: 狗今天吃东西了吗？
messages.en: Has the dog eaten today?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 吃了，它吃得可香了，把食物全吃完了！
messages.en: Yes, he ate all his food with gusto!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅喂食画面记 ħawsel：一幅是自己吃得香，另一幅是鸟亲给幼鸟喂食；注意谁在吃、谁在喂。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An underground reservoir where magma collects beneath a volcano.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 火山下方供岩浆聚集、储存的地下空间，称为岩浆房。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġibjun taħt l-art fejn tinġabar il-magma taħt vulkan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 岩浆房，即火山下方岩浆聚集、储存的地下空间。

collocations.en: the magma in the magma chamber
the pressure in the magma chamber

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi l-ħawt vulkaniku taħt il-vulkan, fejn tinġabar il-magma.
formal.en: The diagram shows the magma chamber beneath the volcano, where magma collects.
formal.zh: 示意图展示了火山下方的岩浆房，岩浆在其中聚集。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn tinġabar il-magma qabel titla'? Luka: Fil-ħawt vulkaniku, taħt il-vulkan.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where does magma collect before it rises? Luka: In the magma chamber, beneath the volcano.
colloquial.zh: Maja：岩浆上升之前聚集在哪里？Luka：在火山下方的岩浆房里。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 岩浆上升之前聚集在哪里？
messages.en: Where does magma collect before it rises?

messages.speaker: Luka (同学)
messages.zh: 在火山下方的岩浆房里。
messages.en: In the magma chamber, beneath the volcano.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħawt vulkaniku 想成火山地下的岩浆储存室：记住“地下聚集处”，并与地表火山口区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make an effort to achieve something or to get into action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为完成某件事而努力，或从准备、等待转为实际行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel sforz biex jilħaq għan jew jibda jaħdem u jieħu azzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作出努力，尽力去做某事。
开始行动，着手做事。

collocations.en: made an effort to finish the work
got into action and started working

formal.mt: Minkejja ż-żmien qasir li kellu, Pawlu ħawtel biex ilesti r-rapport fil-ħin.
formal.en: Despite having little time, Pawlu made an effort to finish the report on time.
formal.zh: 尽管时间紧迫，Pawlu 仍努力按时完成报告。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għad fadal ħafna x'nagħmlu. Ġorġ: Mela ħawtel, u jien ngħinek!
colloquial.en: Anna: We still have a lot to do. Ġorġ: Then get going, and I'll help you!
colloquial.zh: Anna：我们还有好多事要做。Ġorġ：那就动起来吧，我来帮你！

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 我们还有好多事要做。
messages.en: We still have a lot to do.

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (同事)
messages.zh: 那就动起来吧，我来帮你！
messages.en: Then get going, and I'll help you!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħawtel 放进赶工场景：先站起来动手，再努力把事情做好，串起“行动起来”和“尽力”两个义项。

gloss_zh: 勤奋的人；勤勉的人；积极寻求机会的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hardworking, diligent person who actively looks for opportunities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指勤奋肯干、做事勤勉的人，也可突出其积极寻找和把握机会的特点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taħdem b'ħeġġa u b'diliġenza u tfittex l-opportunitajiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 勤奋肯干的人，强调愿意投入劳动。
勤勉认真的人，强调持续用心做事。
积极寻找并力求抓住机会的人。

collocations.en: an enterprising person who seeks opportunities

formal.mt: Pawlu huwa ħawtiel li jaħdem b'diliġenza u jfittex opportunitajiet biex jitgħallem.
formal.en: Pawlu is a diligent, enterprising person who works carefully and seeks opportunities to learn.
formal.zh: Pawlu 是个勤勉进取的人，工作认真，也积极寻找学习机会。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Min jista' jgħinna norganizzaw il-fiera? Toni: Staqsi lil Pawlu; dak ħawtiel u dejjem isib xi ħaġa x'jagħmel.
colloquial.en: Rita: Who could help us organize the fair? Toni: Ask Pawlu; he's a hardworking person and always finds something useful to do.
colloquial.zh: Rita：谁能帮我们筹办集市？Toni：问问 Pawlu 吧，他很勤快，总能找到事情做。

messages.speaker: Rita (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 谁能帮我们筹办集市？
messages.en: Who could help us organize the fair?

messages.speaker: Toni (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Staqsi lil Pawlu; dak ħawtiel u dejjem isib xi ħaġa x'jagħmel.
messages.mt_standard: Staqsi lil Pawlu; dak ħawtiel u dejjem isib xi ħaġa x'jagħmel.
messages.zh: 问问 Pawlu 吧，他很勤快，总能找到事情做。
messages.en: Ask Pawlu; he's a hardworking person and always finds something useful to do.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħawtiel 记成一个勤快人的标签：肯干活、做事认真、主动找机会；本条按名词理解为“这样的人”。

gloss_zh: 爱惹乱子的；搞鬼、暗中耍手段的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describes someone who causes disorder or engages in underhand dealings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人爱制造混乱，或暗中搞鬼、采用不光明的手段办事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li joħloq il-kaos jew jidħol f'intriċċi u ftehimiet moħbija u diżonesti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容爱惹乱子、制造混乱的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who indulges in underhand dealings
sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容暗中搞鬼、惯于进行不光明交易或勾当的人。

collocations.en: a man who causes trouble or engages in shady dealings
collocations.zh: 爱惹事或暗中搞鬼的男人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru ħawwadi jxerred xnigħat u joħloq kunflitti bejn il-ġirien.
formal.en: In the story, the troublemaking character spreads rumours and creates conflicts between neighbours.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个爱惹事的角色散布谣言，引起邻里之间的冲突。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex kulħadd qed jargumenta? Samwel: Dak it-tifel ħawwadi beda jgħid affarijiet differenti lil kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is everyone arguing? Samwel: That troublemaking boy started telling everyone different things.
colloquial.zh: Nina：大家怎么都吵起来了？Samwel：那个爱惹事的男孩开始对每个人说不同的话。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 大家怎么都吵起来了？
messages.en: Why is everyone arguing?

messages.speaker: Samwel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak it-tifel ħawwadi beda jgħid affarijiet differenti lil kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Dak it-tifel ħawwadi beda jgħid affarijiet differenti lil kulħadd.
messages.zh: 那个爱惹事的男孩开始对每个人说不同的话。
messages.en: That troublemaking boy started telling everyone different things.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“把局面搅乱的人”记 ħawwadi：表面可以是惹事闹腾，暗地里也可以是搞鬼耍手段，带负面评价。

gloss_zh: 加香料或香草调味；增添风味；给故事添枝加叶；香草、香料及调味料商贩

teaching_sense.en_definition: To season food with spices or herbs, give something flavour, or embellish a story with added details.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给食物加入香料或香草来调味、增添风味；也可比喻给故事等添加细节，使叙述更丰富或更有趣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iżid ħwawar jew ħxejjex aromatiċi mal-ikel biex jagħtih togħma; jista' wkoll iżid dettalji ma' storja biex jagħmilha aktar interessanti.

sense_translations.en_definition: to add spices and herbs (to food)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给食物加入香料和香草调味。
使带有某种味道，为食物或饮品增添风味。

sense_translations.en_definition: to elaborate (used of a story, etc.)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给故事等增添细节，加以铺陈或添枝加叶。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who sells herbs, spices and seasoning
sense_translations.zh_definition: 出售香草、香料和调味料的人，香料商贩。

collocations.zh: 用迷迭香给肉增添风味

formal.mt: Il-kok ħawwar is-soppa bil-bżar u bit-tursin qabel servieha.
formal.en: The cook seasoned the soup with pepper and parsley before serving it.
formal.zh: 厨师在上汤之前，用胡椒和欧芹为汤调味。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Veru ġara hekk kollu? Pawlu: Le, Toni ħawwar l-istorja ftit biex idaħħakna.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did all of that really happen? Pawlu: No, Toni embellished the story a little to make us laugh.
colloquial.zh: Marija：那些事情真的都发生了吗？Pawlu：没有，Toni 给故事添了点枝叶，想逗我们笑。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 那些事情真的都发生了吗？
messages.en: Did all of that really happen?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, Toni ħawwar l-istorja ftit biex idaħħakna.
messages.mt_standard: Le, Toni ħawwar l-istorja ftit biex idaħħakna.
messages.zh: 没有，Toni 给故事添了点枝叶，想逗我们笑。
messages.en: No, Toni embellished the story a little to make us laugh.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħawwar 的动词义串成“给食物加味，给故事加料”；名词义另记为卖香料的人，辨认时留意词性。

gloss_zh: 滋味浓郁的；能增味的；辛香的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a rich or spicy flavour, or capable of adding flavour to food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容食物滋味浓郁、带有辛香味，或形容某种配料能够给食物增添风味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu togħma qawwija jew pikkanti, jew li jista' jżid it-togħma tal-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 滋味丰富的；味道浓郁可口的。

sense_translations.en_definition: having the potential to add flavour
sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够为食物增添风味的；具有增味作用的。
带有明显香料味或辛辣味的。

formal.mt: Il-kok serva brodu ħawwari u spjega li l-ħwawar kienu żiedu ħafna mat-togħma tiegħu.
formal.en: The chef served a flavoursome broth and explained that the herbs and spices had added greatly to its flavour.
formal.zh: 厨师端上滋味浓郁的汤，并解释说香草和香料为汤增添了不少风味。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif ġie l-brodu? Mark: Ġie ħawwari ħafna; x'żidt fih? Maja: Ftit bżar u ħwawar.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the broth turn out? Mark: It is full of flavour; what did you add? Maja: A little pepper and some herbs and spices.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：汤做得怎么样？马克：味道很浓郁；你加了什么？玛雅：一点胡椒，还有一些香草和香料。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 汤做得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the broth turn out?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 味道很浓郁；你加了什么？
messages.en: It is full of flavour; what did you add?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 一点胡椒，还有一些香草和香料。
messages.en: A little pepper and some herbs and spices.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一锅加了香料的浓汤，把“味道浓、能增味、带辛香”三个用法连在一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something hollow by removing material from its inside.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过去除内部材料使物体中空，即挖空或掏空其内部。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa vojta minn ġewwa billi jneħħi l-materjal ta' ġewwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使中空，挖去或掏去物体内部的材料。
进行肛交，指一种性行为。

collocations.en: hollowed out a piece of wood

formal.mt: L-artiġjan ħawwaħ biċċa injam biex jagħmel skutella, u mbagħad illixxa l-wiċċ ta' ġewwa.
formal.en: The craftsperson hollowed out a piece of wood to make a bowl and then smoothed the inside surface.
formal.zh: 工匠挖空一块木料来制作碗，然后磨平了内表面。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif għamilt din l-iskutella? David: Ħawwaħt biċċa injam u mbagħad illixxajtha.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did you make this bowl? David: I hollowed out a piece of wood and then smoothed it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这个碗是怎么做的？David：我把一块木料挖空，然后把它磨平。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个碗是怎么做的？
messages.en: How did you make this bowl?

messages.speaker: David (手工爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħawwaħt biċċa injam u mbagħad illixxajtha.
messages.mt_standard: Ħawwaħt biċċa injam u mbagħad illixxajtha.
messages.zh: 我把一块木料挖空，然后把它磨平。
messages.en: I hollowed out a piece of wood and then smoothed it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“把实心木块挖成空心碗”的画面记 ħawwaħ 的挖空义；另将性行为义单独记忆，按语境辨别。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who wanders from place to place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 四处游走或漫游的人，强调到处走动，不一定有明确目的地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ddur minn post għal ieħor, spiss mingħajr destinazzjoni ċara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 游荡者；四处漫游的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ħawwief jgħaddi minn raħal għal ieħor u jisma' l-istejjer tan-nies li jiltaqa' magħhom.
formal.en: In the story, the wanderer passes from village to village and listens to the stories of the people he meets.
formal.zh: 在故事里，漫游者从一个村庄走到另一个村庄，倾听途中所遇之人的故事。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn sejjer illum? Pawlu: Għadni ma nafx; illum inħossni ħawwief. Lara: Mela ejja nduru ftit ħdejn il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where are you going today? Pawlu: I do not know yet; today I feel like a wanderer. Lara: Then let us wander around by the sea for a while.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你今天要去哪里？保罗：还不知道；今天我觉得自己像个漫游者。拉拉：那我们去海边随意走走吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天要去哪里？
messages.en: Where are you going today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma nafx; illum inħossni ħawwief.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma nafx; illum inħossni ħawwief.
messages.zh: 还不知道；今天我觉得自己像个漫游者。
messages.en: I do not know yet; today I feel like a wanderer.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ejja nduru ftit ħdejn il-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ejja nduru ftit ħdejn il-baħar.
messages.zh: 那我们去海边随意走走吧。
messages.en: Then let us wander around by the sea for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词贴在故事中四处行走的人物身上，记住它是“漫游的人”这个名词。

gloss_zh: 爱游荡的；喜欢四处走动的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to wander about rather than remain in one place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人或动物有四处游走的倾向，喜欢到处走动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jdur minn post għal ieħor u ma jibqax f'post wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱四处游荡的；具有到处走动倾向的。

formal.mt: Il-karattru ewlieni huwa raġel ħawwiefi li jqatta' ħafna mill-ħin tiegħu jdur fit-toroq tal-belt.
formal.en: The main character is a man inclined to wander, who spends much of his time roaming the city streets.
formal.zh: 主人公是个爱四处游荡的男人，大部分时间都在城里的街道上闲逛。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-kelb dejjem ħdejn il-bieb? Toni: Għax hu ħawwiefi u dejjem irid joħroġ. Sara: Ejja noħorġuh għal mixja.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is the dog always by the door? Toni: Because he likes to roam and always wants to go out. Sara: Let us take him for a walk.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：狗为什么总待在门边？托尼：因为它爱到处跑，总想出去。萨拉：我们带它去散步吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 狗为什么总待在门边？
messages.en: Why is the dog always by the door?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu ħawwiefi u dejjem irid joħroġ.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu ħawwiefi u dejjem irid joħroġ.
messages.zh: 因为它爱到处跑，总想出去。
messages.en: Because he likes to roam and always wants to go out.

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 我们带它去散步吧。
messages.en: Let us take him for a walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 对照记忆：ħawwief 是漫游者，ħawwiefi 用来描述“爱漫游的”性情或习惯。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who plants seeds, plants, or trees.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从事播种或栽种植物、树木的人，强调实施种植这一动作的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiżra' ż-żrieragħ jew tħawwel il-pjanti u s-siġar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 种植者；播种或栽种植物的人。

formal.mt: Il-ħawwiel ħejja l-ħamrija qabel ma ħawwel is-siġar fil-ġnien tal-iskola.
formal.en: The planter prepared the soil before planting the trees in the school garden.
formal.zh: 种植者先整理土壤，然后在学校花园里栽下树木。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jħawwel is-siġra? Mark: Il-ħawwiel jasal dalwaqt. Maja: Tajjeb, inġiblu ftit ilma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is going to plant the tree? Mark: The planter will arrive soon. Maja: Good, I will get him some water.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁来种这棵树？马克：种树的人很快就到。玛雅：好，我给他拿点水。

messages.speaker: Maja (花园主人)
messages.zh: 谁来种这棵树？
messages.en: Who is going to plant the tree?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.zh: 种树的人很快就到。
messages.en: The planter will arrive soon.

messages.speaker: Maja (花园主人)
messages.zh: 好，我给他拿点水。
messages.en: Good, I will get him some water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个正把树苗放进土坑的人，用“谁在种植”这个问题记住它指种植者。

gloss_zh: 与种植有关的；可栽种的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Connected with planting, or capable of being planted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容事物与种植活动有关，或形容植物材料具备可以栽种的条件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mat-tħawwil, jew li jista' jitħawwel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与种植活动有关的；用于描述种植相关事物的。
可以栽种的；具备栽种条件的。

formal.mt: Il-mixtla żammet il-materjal ħawwieli f'kundizzjonijiet xierqa sakemm wasal iż-żmien tat-tħawwil.
formal.en: The nursery kept the plantable material in suitable conditions until planting time arrived.
formal.zh: 苗圃将可供栽种的材料保存在适宜条件下，直到种植时节到来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-basal għadu ħawwieli? Pawlu: Iva, għadu tajjeb biex tħawlu. Lara: Mela nħawlu llum.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are these bulbs still plantable? Pawlu: Yes, they are still suitable for planting. Lara: Then I will plant them today.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这些球茎还能栽种吗？保罗：能，还适合栽种。拉拉：那我今天就把它们种下。

messages.speaker: Lara (园艺爱好者)
messages.zh: 这些球茎还能栽种吗？
messages.en: Are these bulbs still plantable?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (苗圃店员)
messages.zh: 能，还适合栽种。
messages.en: Yes, they are still suitable for planting.

messages.speaker: Lara (园艺爱好者)
messages.zh: 那我今天就把它们种下。
messages.en: Then I will plant them today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面区分义项：种植设备表示“与种植有关”，待种球茎表示“可以栽种”。

gloss_zh: 填塞；填充物；粗俗的性交说法；欺骗；惹人烦的行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: Stuffing: material used to fill something, or the act of putting that material inside.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 填塞某物的动作，或放入其中的填充物；本词另有粗俗及贬义用法，须结合语境理解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal li jintuża biex timtela xi ħaġa, jew l-azzjoni li bih timtela; il-kelma għandha wkoll tifsiriet oħra vulgari jew negattivi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 填塞；填充物。
性交、交媾的粗俗说法。
欺骗；作弊；蒙骗他人的行为。
惹人烦、使人恼火的行为或事情。

formal.mt: Il-ħaxi tal-kuxxin għandu jitqassam b'mod uniformi biex il-kuxxin jibqa' komdu.
formal.en: The cushion stuffing should be distributed evenly so that the cushion remains comfortable.
formal.zh: 靠垫的填充物应分布均匀，使靠垫保持舒适。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-kuxxin sar ċatt. Paul: Għandu bżonn aktar ħaxi; nistgħu nimlewh mill-ġdid.
colloquial.en: Lara: This cushion has gone flat. Paul: It needs more stuffing; we can fill it again.
