colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个靠垫变扁了。保罗：它需要更多填充物，我们可以重新填一下。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 这个靠垫变扁了。
messages.en: This cushion has gone flat.

messages.speaker: Paul (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu bżonn aktar ħaxi; nistgħu nimlewh mill-ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu bżonn aktar ħaxi; nistgħu nimlewh mill-ġdid.
messages.zh: 它需要更多填充物，我们可以重新填一下。
messages.en: It needs more stuffing; we can fill it again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“给靠垫塞填充物”的画面记住 ħaxi 的填塞义，再另做语境卡区分欺骗、惹人烦和粗俗性用法，避免见词就套同一个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Maltese name for the grass species Aira cupaniana, known in English as small hairgrass.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 草本植物 Aira cupaniana 的马耳他语名称，对应英语 small hairgrass。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem bil-Malti għall-ispeċi ta' ħaxix Aira cupaniana, magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala small hairgrass.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 草本植物 Aira cupaniana，英语名为 small hairgrass。

collocations.mt: kampjun ta' ħaxixa rqiqa ta' kupani
collocations.zh: 一份 Aira cupaniana 标本

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jinkludi ritratt tal-ħaxixa rqiqa ta' kupani u l-isem xjentifiku tagħha, Aira cupaniana.
formal.en: The catalogue includes a photograph of small hairgrass and its scientific name, Aira cupaniana.
formal.zh: 目录收录了这种草本植物的照片及其学名 Aira cupaniana。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jisimha din il-pjanta fir-ritratt? Mark: Fil-ktieb hemm miktub ħaxixa rqiqa ta' kupani, Aira cupaniana.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this plant in the photograph called? Mark: The book calls it small hairgrass, Aira cupaniana.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：照片里的这种植物叫什么？马克：书上写的是 ħaxixa rqiqa ta' kupani，学名 Aira cupaniana。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 照片里的这种植物叫什么？
messages.en: What is this plant in the photograph called?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-ktieb hemm miktub ħaxixa rqiqa ta' kupani, Aira cupaniana.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-ktieb hemm miktub ħaxixa rqiqa ta' kupani, Aira cupaniana.
messages.zh: 书上写的是 ħaxixa rqiqa ta' kupani，学名 Aira cupaniana。
messages.en: The book calls it small hairgrass, Aira cupaniana.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把完整马耳他语名称与学名 Aira cupaniana 写在同一张植物卡片上，配一张经确认的图片，整组记忆，避免只记住长名称中的几个字。

gloss_zh: 狡猾的人；行骗或占便宜的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cunning person, especially someone who cheats others or takes advantage of them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 狡猾、会算计的人，尤其指欺骗别人或占别人便宜的人，通常带有贬义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna makakka, speċjalment waħda li tqarraq b'ħaddieħor jew tieħu vantaġġ minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狡猾的人；善于耍心眼、算计别人的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who cheats or takes advantage
sense_translations.zh_definition: 欺骗别人或占别人便宜的人。

collocations.en: to be wary of a cheat

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ħaxixu jqarraq bil-ġirien tiegħu biex jikseb flus li ma jistħoqqlux.
formal.en: In the story, the cheat deceives his neighbours to obtain money he does not deserve.
formal.zh: 故事里，那个骗子欺骗邻居，获取不应属于自己的钱财。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak il-bejjiegħ? Karl: Għax hu ħaxixu; darba ħallasni inqas milli konna ftehimna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why don't you trust that seller? Karl: Because he's a cheat; once he paid me less than we had agreed.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么不信任那个卖家？卡尔：因为他会坑人；有一次，他付给我的钱比我们说好的少。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak il-bejjiegħ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak il-bejjiegħ?
messages.zh: 你为什么不信任那个卖家？
messages.en: Why don't you trust that seller?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu ħaxixu; darba ħallasni inqas milli konna ftehimna.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu ħaxixu; darba ħallasni inqas milli konna ftehimna.
messages.zh: 因为他会坑人；有一次，他付给我的钱比我们说好的少。
messages.en: Because he's a cheat; once he paid me less than we had agreed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个结账时偷偷少付钱、总想占便宜的人，把 ħaxixu 贴在这个人物形象上；记住它评价的是人，而且带有贬义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The selvage of a piece of fabric: the finished edge that helps prevent it from fraying.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 织物的布边，即织成时形成的、不易散开的边缘。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tarf minsuġ u lest ta' biċċa drapp li jgħin biex id-drapp ma jinħallx mat-tarf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 布边；织物两侧织成的、不易散开的边缘。
填充物；用于填满内部空间的东西。
一次背叛或背信弃义的行为。

formal.mt: Qabel ma jitqiegħed il-mudell fuq id-drapp, għandha tiġi identifikata l-ħaxja tiegħu.
formal.en: Before the pattern is placed on the fabric, its selvage should be identified.
formal.zh: 把纸样放到织物上之前，应先辨认织物的布边。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din il-parti mat-tarf tad-drapp x'inhi? Rita: Dik hi l-ħaxja; ara kif hi differenti mill-bqija tad-drapp.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is this part along the edge of the fabric? Rita: That's the selvage; look at how it differs from the rest of the fabric.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：布料边缘的这一部分是什么？丽塔：那是布边，你看它和其余部分有什么不同。

messages.speaker: Sara (裁缝学徒)
messages.zh: 布料边缘的这一部分是什么？
messages.en: What is this part along the edge of the fabric?

messages.speaker: Rita (裁缝师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik hi l-ħaxja; ara kif hi differenti mill-bqija tad-drapp.
messages.mt_standard: Dik hi l-ħaxja; ara kif hi differenti mill-bqija tad-drapp.
messages.zh: 那是布边，你看它和其余部分有什么不同。
messages.en: That's the selvage; look at how it differs from the rest of the fabric.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用手指沿布料边缘划一圈，配合 ħaxja 记住“布边”；填充物和背信行为另配场景卡，别把三个义项混成一个意思。

gloss_zh: 把人紧压在某处；把东西挤进狭窄处

teaching_sense.en_definition: To press someone tightly against something or someone, or to squeeze an object into a tight space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某人紧紧压在某物或另一人身上；也指把物件挤进狭窄、紧凑的空间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħfas lil xi ħadd sewwa ma' xi ħaġa jew ma' persuna oħra, jew iddaħħal oġġett fi spazju dejjaq billi tagħfsu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to press sb. tightly against sth. or sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某人紧紧压在某物上或另一人身上。

sense_translations.en_definition: to fit sth. in a tight place
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物挤入或塞进狭窄的位置。

collocations.en: he squeezed the box between two shelves
collocations.zh: 他把箱子挤进两层搁板之间

collocations.en: he pressed his companion tightly against the wall
collocations.zh: 他把同伴紧紧压在墙上

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ħaxken il-kaxxa fi spazju dejjaq taħt l-ixkaffa, u wara sabha diffiċli biex joħroġha.
formal.en: The worker squeezed the box into a tight space under the shelf and later found it difficult to take out.
formal.zh: 工人把箱子挤进搁板下的狭窄空间，后来发现很难把它取出来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-kaxxa ma toħroġx? Toni: Ħija ħaxken il-kaxxa hemm taħt; issa bilkemm tiċċaqlaq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why won't the box come out? Toni: My brother squeezed the box under there; now it barely moves.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个箱子怎么拿不出来？托尼：我哥哥把箱子硬挤到那下面了，现在它几乎动不了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 这个箱子怎么拿不出来？
messages.en: Why won't the box come out?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija ħaxken il-kaxxa hemm taħt; issa bilkemm tiċċaqlaq.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija ħaxken il-kaxxa hemm taħt; issa bilkemm tiċċaqlaq.
messages.zh: 我哥哥把箱子硬挤到那下面了，现在它几乎动不了。
messages.en: My brother squeezed the box under there; now it barely moves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把大箱子硬挤进小空隙，边做挤压手势边读 ħaxken；用动作记住这是动词，核心画面是紧压或挤入。

gloss_zh: 把物件压入狭窄空间的器具

teaching_sense.en_definition: An implement or device that presses an object into a tight-fitting space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于将物件压入紧密、狭窄空间的器具或装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda jew apparat li jagħfas oġġett biex idaħħlu fi spazju dejjaq fejn jidħol issikkat.

sense_translations.en_definition: sth. that presses an object into tight-fitting spaces
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于把物件压入紧密、狭窄空间的东西，如器具或装置。

collocations.en: to use an implement for pressing an object into a tight space
collocations.zh: 使用把物件压入狭窄处的器具

collocations.en: an implement for pressing the piece into place
collocations.zh: 用来把部件压入就位的器具

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, il-ħaxkien jintuża biex jagħfas il-biċċa fi spazju dejjaq fejn ma tidħolx faċilment bl-idejn.
formal.en: In this example, the pressing implement is used to push the piece into a tight space where it cannot easily be inserted by hand.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，这种压入器具用于把部件压进狭窄空间，因为用手不容易将其装入。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Din il-biċċa ma tidħolx bl-idejn. Pawlu: Hawn ħaxkien; bih nistgħu nagħfsuha fl-ispazju.
colloquial.en: Lina: This piece won't go in by hand. Pawlu: Here's a pressing implement; we can use it to press the piece into the space.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这个部件用手装不进去。保罗：这里有个压入器具，我们可以用它把部件压进去。

messages.speaker: Lina (维修学徒)
messages.zh: 这个部件用手装不进去。
messages.en: This piece won't go in by hand.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (维修师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ħaxkien; bih nistgħu nagħfsuha fl-ispazju.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ħaxkien; bih nistgħu nagħfsuha fl-ispazju.
messages.zh: 这里有个压入器具，我们可以用它把部件压进去。
messages.en: Here's a pressing implement; we can use it to press the piece into the space.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ħaxkien 画一张“器具把部件压进窄槽”的图，并在旁边写“器具名词”；与表示挤压动作的 ħaxken 对照记忆。

gloss_zh: 能把物件压入狭窄空间的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to press an object into a tight-fitting space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有将物件压入紧密、狭窄空间的能力的，用来描述具备这种功能的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħila jagħfas oġġett biex idaħħlu fi spazju dejjaq fejn jidħol issikkat.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the ability to press into tight-fitting spaces
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有压入紧密、狭窄空间的能力的。

collocations.en: a device capable of pressing objects into tight spaces
collocations.zh: 能把物件压入狭窄空间的装置

collocations.en: a mechanism capable of pressing objects into tight spaces
collocations.zh: 具有向狭窄空间压入物件功能的机构

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, l-apparat huwa ħaxkieni: jista' jagħfas il-biċċa fl-ispazju dejjaq.
formal.en: In this example, the device can press objects into tight spaces: it can press the piece into the narrow gap.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，该装置具备向狭窄空间压入物件的能力：它能把部件压进窄缝。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dan l-apparat jista' jdaħħal il-biċċa f'dak l-ispazju dejjaq? Mark: Iva, hu ħaxkieni; jagħfasha biex tidħol.
colloquial.en: Rita: Can this device insert the piece into that tight space? Mark: Yes, it can press things into tight spaces; it presses the piece so that it goes in.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这个装置能把部件装进那个狭窄空间吗？马克：能，它具有这种压入能力，会把部件压进去。

messages.speaker: Rita (技术学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-apparat jista' jdaħħal il-biċċa f'dak l-ispazju dejjaq?
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-apparat jista' jdaħħal il-biċċa f'dak l-ispazju dejjaq?
messages.zh: 这个装置能把部件装进那个狭窄空间吗？
messages.en: Can this device insert the piece into that tight space?

messages.speaker: Mark (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu ħaxkieni; jagħfasha biex tidħol.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu ħaxkieni; jagħfasha biex tidħol.
messages.zh: 能，它具有这种压入能力，会把部件压进去。
messages.en: Yes, it can press things into tight spaces; it presses the piece so that it goes in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在装置图片旁写“它有压入窄处的能力”，用 ħaxkieni 描述这项能力；学习时对照 ħaxkien 的器具名词身份，分清物件与性质。

gloss_zh: 草率或粗劣的工作；敷衍完成的活儿

teaching_sense.en_definition: Work done hastily or badly, with insufficient care.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 仓促、草率或做得很差的工作，也指这样完成的活儿，带有批评意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xogħol magħmul bl-għaġla jew ħażin, mingħajr il-kura meħtieġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仓促草率或质量低劣的工作；敷衍做出来的活儿。

collocations.en: to do hasty or shoddy work
collocations.zh: 草率地干活；把活儿做得很差

collocations.en: shoddy work instead of a properly done job
collocations.zh: 敷衍了事而非把工作做好

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tiswija bħala ħaxlief, għax ix-xogħol sar bl-għaġla u l-problema baqgħet.
formal.en: The report describes the repair as shoddy work because it was done hastily and the problem remained.
formal.zh: 报告将这次维修评价为草率的活儿，因为工作完成得仓促，问题也没有解决。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Diġà spiċċajt iż-żebgħa? David: Iva, imma għamilt ħaxlief; għandi nerġa' ngħaddi fuq dawn il-partijiet.
colloquial.en: Anna: Have you already finished painting? David: Yes, but I did a sloppy job; I need to go over these parts again.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你已经刷完漆了？戴维：是，但我做得很草率，这几处还得重新刷。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 你已经刷完漆了？
messages.en: Have you already finished painting?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għamilt ħaxlief; għandi nerġa' ngħaddi fuq dawn il-partijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għamilt ħaxlief; għandi nerġa' ngħaddi fuq dawn il-partijiet.
messages.zh: 是，但我做得很草率，这几处还得重新刷。
messages.en: Yes, but I did a sloppy job; I need to go over these parts again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象赶时间刷墙，刷完却到处漏白，把这份需要返工的草率活儿标成 ħaxlief；记住它批评工作做得仓促或粗劣。

gloss_zh: 乱七八糟的；粗制滥造的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Disordered or badly put together; carelessly made and of poor quality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容东西杂乱、安排失当，或制作粗糙、质量低劣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li hu mħawwad jew magħmul ħażin, bla ħsieb u bi kwalità baxxa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乱七八糟的；被弄得杂乱或处理失当的。
粗制滥造的；做工草率、质量低劣的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tqassim tal-kamra bħala ħaxliefi u jirrakkomanda li l-għamara titqiegħed b'mod aktar ordnat.
formal.en: The report describes the room's layout as disorganized and recommends arranging the furniture more neatly.
formal.zh: 报告指出房间布局杂乱，并建议把家具摆放得更有条理。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan ix-xogħol jidher ħaxliefi. Mark: Għandek raġun; it-truf mhumiex lesti sew.
colloquial.en: Maja: This work looks shoddy. Mark: You're right; the edges aren't properly finished.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这活儿看起来做得很粗糙。Mark：你说得对，边缘都没处理好。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这活儿看起来做得很粗糙。
messages.en: This work looks shoddy.

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun; it-truf mhumiex lesti sew.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun; it-truf mhumiex lesti sew.
messages.zh: 你说得对，边缘都没处理好。
messages.en: You're right; the edges aren't properly finished.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它配上两幅学习画面：一间摆得乱七八糟的房间，以及一件边缘没做好的成品，分别记住“杂乱”和“粗劣”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Material used to fill an object, or a mixture put inside food as a filling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 放进物品内部使其充实的材料，也可指填入食物中的馅料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal li jitqiegħed ġewwa xi ħaġa biex jimlieha, jew taħlita li timla ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 填充物；填入物品内部的材料，或填入食物中的馅料。

formal.mt: Waqt it-tiswija tal-kuxxin, il-ħaxu l-qadim tneħħa u nbidel b'materjal ġdid.
formal.en: During the repair of the cushion, the old stuffing was removed and replaced with new material.
formal.zh: 修补靠垫时，旧填充物被取出，并换上了新材料。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għad fadal ħaxu għal dan il-kuxxin? Pawlu: Iva, hemm ftit fil-borża.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is there any stuffing left for this cushion? Pawlu: Yes, there's some in the bag.
colloquial.zh: Lara：还有填充物可以塞进这个靠垫吗？Pawlu：有，袋子里还有一些。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad fadal ħaxu għal dan il-kuxxin?
messages.mt_standard: Għad fadal ħaxu għal dan il-kuxxin?
messages.zh: 还有填充物可以塞进这个靠垫吗？
messages.en: Is there any stuffing left for this cushion?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 有，袋子里还有一些。
messages.en: Yes, there's some in the bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个空靠垫，往里面塞入软材料才变得饱满；用“塞进去的内容物”记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A filling placed inside food or material used to fill something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 填在食物内部的馅料，或用于填满某物内部的材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħlita li titqiegħed ġewwa ikel, jew materjal li jintuża biex jimla xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 馅料；填入食物内部的混合料，也可指填充某物的材料。

formal.mt: Il-ħaxwa tat-torta għandha tiksaħ qabel ma titqiegħed fuq l-għaġina.
formal.en: The pie filling should cool before it is placed on the pastry.
formal.zh: 馅饼的馅料应先放凉，再放到饼皮上。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'hemm fil-ħaxwa? Toni: Irkotta u ftit tursin; trid idduqha?
colloquial.en: Sara: What's in the filling? Toni: Ricotta and a little parsley; would you like to taste it?
colloquial.zh: Sara：馅料里有什么？Toni：乳清奶酪和一点欧芹；你想尝尝吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 馅料里有什么？
messages.en: What's in the filling?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Irkotta u ftit tursin; trid idduqha?
messages.mt_standard: Irkotta u ftit tursin; trid idduqha?
messages.zh: 乳清奶酪和一点欧芹；你想尝尝吗？
messages.en: Ricotta and a little parsley; would you like to taste it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把饺子或馅饼切开，注意里面露出的馅；学习时把 ħaxwa 与“包在里面的馅料”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An object or material that makes a light rustling sound when it moves or is handled.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 移动或被触碰时会发出轻微窸窣声的物件或材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett jew materjal li jagħmel ħoss ħafif ta' tħaxwix meta jiċċaqlaq jew jintmess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 会发出窸窣声的东西，如移动或受触碰时作响的材料。

collocations.zh: 口袋里窸窣作响的东西
把窸窣作响的东西拿走

formal.mt: Qabel ir-reġistrazzjoni, kull ħaxwiex għandu jitneħħa minn ħdejn il-mikrofonu biex ma jfixkilx il-ħoss.
formal.en: Before recording, anything that rustles should be removed from near the microphone so that it does not interfere with the sound.
formal.zh: 录音前，应把麦克风附近会窸窣作响的东西移走，以免干扰录音。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu dak il-ħaxwiex fil-but tiegħek? Ben: Karta tal-ħelu; se noħroġha.
colloquial.en: Nina: What's that rustling thing in your pocket? Ben: A sweet wrapper; I'll take it out.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你口袋里窸窣作响的是什么东西？Ben：一张糖纸；我这就拿出来。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你口袋里窸窣作响的是什么东西？
messages.en: What's that rustling thing in your pocket?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 一张糖纸；我这就拿出来。
messages.en: A sweet wrapper; I'll take it out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象口袋里的糖纸一动就响，记住这个词指“发声的那个东西”；可把它与表示声音本身的 ħaxwix 对照学习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Likely to make a light rustling sound when moved or touched.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容物件或材料移动、受触碰时容易发出窸窣声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jagħmel ħoss ħafif ta' tħaxwix meta jiċċaqlaq jew jintmess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易发出窸窣声的；一移动或受触碰就容易作响的。

collocations.zh: 容易发出窸窣声的材料

formal.mt: Għall-kostumi tal-palk, intgħażel drapp li ma kienx ħaxwiexi biex il-moviment tal-atturi ma jfixkilx id-djalogu.
formal.en: Fabric that did not rustle easily was chosen for the stage costumes so that the actors' movements would not interfere with the dialogue.
formal.zh: 舞台服装选用了不易窸窣作响的布料，以免演员的动作干扰对白。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dan id-drapp ħaxwiexi ħafna, hux? Luqa: Iva, jagħmel ħoss kull darba li tmissu.
colloquial.en: Marta: This fabric is very rustly, isn't it? Luqa: Yes, it makes a sound every time you touch it.
colloquial.zh: Marta：这块布很容易窸窣作响，对吧？Luqa：对，每次碰它都会响。

messages.speaker: Marta (顾客)
messages.zh: 这块布很容易窸窣作响，对吧？
messages.en: This fabric is very rustly, isn't it?

messages.speaker: Luqa (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jagħmel ħoss kull darba li tmissu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jagħmel ħoss kull darba li tmissu.
messages.zh: 对，每次碰它都会响。
messages.en: Yes, it makes a sound every time you touch it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用手揉一揉想象中的布料，听见窸窣声后说“这布容易响”；把整个词作为描述材料性质的形容词来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A light rustling or swishing sound made by things moving against one another or through the air.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体相互摩擦或在空气中移动时发出的轻微窸窣声、沙沙声或刷刷声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss ħafif li jagħmlu affarijiet meta jiċċaqilqu, jogħrku ma' xulxin jew jgħaddu fl-arja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 窸窣声；纸张、树叶等轻微移动或摩擦时发出的沙沙声。
刷刷声；物体摆动、掠过或轻擦时发出的连续轻响。

formal.mt: Fir-reġistrazzjoni jinstema' l-ħaxwix tal-weraq hekk kif ir-riħ jgħaddi mis-siġar.
formal.en: The recording captures the rustling of leaves as the wind passes through the trees.
formal.zh: 录音中可以听见风吹过树木时树叶发出的沙沙声。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Smajt dak il-ħaxwix? David: Iva, il-purtiera qed titħرك mar-riħ.
colloquial.en: Elena: Did you hear that swishing sound? David: Yes, the curtain is moving in the wind.
colloquial.zh: Elena：你听见那阵刷刷声了吗？David：听见了，是窗帘在随风摆动。

messages.speaker: Elena (室友)
messages.zh: 你听见那阵刷刷声了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that swishing sound?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.zh: 听见了，是窗帘在随风摆动。
messages.en: Yes, the curtain is moving in the wind.

cognitive_memory_aid: 闭眼想象风吹树叶的沙沙声，再想象窗帘摆动的刷刷声；这个名词让注意力落在“声音本身”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To deceive people habitually or repeatedly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 惯常或反复地欺骗别人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqarraq bin-nies ta' spiss jew darba wara l-oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 惯常欺骗；作动词理解，指反复实施骗人的行为。

formal.mt: Ix-xhieda spjegaw kif il-bejjiegħ ħaxxa lill-klijenti darba wara l-oħra billi ta informazzjoni falza dwar il-prodotti.
formal.en: The witnesses explained how the seller repeatedly deceived customers by giving false information about the products.
formal.zh: 证人说明了卖家如何通过提供虚假的产品信息，一次又一次地欺骗顾客。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak il-bejjiegħ? Karl: Għax ħaxxa lill-ġirien darba wara l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why don't you trust that seller? Karl: Because he deceived the neighbors time after time.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你为什么不信任那个卖家？Karl：因为他一次又一次地欺骗邻居们。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak il-bejjiegħ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak il-bejjiegħ?
messages.zh: 你为什么不信任那个卖家？
messages.en: Why don't you trust that seller?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ħaxxa lill-ġirien darba wara l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ħaxxa lill-ġirien darba wara l-oħra.
messages.zh: 因为他一次又一次地欺骗邻居们。
messages.en: Because he deceived the neighbors time after time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在学习卡片上画出同一个骗子连续几次说谎的场景，把重点记为“反复骗人的行为”，并按动词使用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something thicker, such as increasing a liquid's consistency or a layer's thickness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变得更稠或更厚，例如增加液体的稠度或某一层的厚度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa aktar ħoxna, bħal zalza jew saff ta' materjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物变稠或增厚。

formal.mt: Il-kok ħaxxeb iz-zalza bi ftit dqiq u ħawwadha sakemm saret lixxa.
formal.en: The cook thickened the sauce with a little flour and stirred it until it became smooth.
formal.zh: 厨师用少量面粉把酱汁调稠，并搅拌至细滑。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Is-soppa għadha rqiqa wisq. Pietru: Ħaxxeb is-soppa bi ftit dqiq u ħawwad sew.
colloquial.en: Anna: The soup is still too thin. Pietru: Thicken the soup with a little flour and stir well.
colloquial.zh: Anna：汤还是太稀了。Pietru：加一点面粉把汤调稠，再充分搅拌。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 汤还是太稀了。
messages.en: The soup is still too thin.

messages.speaker: Pietru (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħaxxeb is-soppa bi ftit dqiq u ħawwad sew.
messages.mt_standard: Ħaxxeb is-soppa bi ftit dqiq u ħawwad sew.
messages.zh: 加一点面粉把汤调稠，再充分搅拌。
messages.en: Thicken the soup with a little flour and stir well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象往稀汤里加一点面粉，搅拌后汤变稠；把这个词与“让某物更稠、更厚”的动作连起来记。

gloss_zh: 淫乱者；好色之徒；骗子；爱占人便宜的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A derogatory term for a person who engages in illicit sexual activity, pursues women, deceives others, or takes advantage of them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 贬称，可指有淫乱行为的人、玩弄女性的好色之徒，也可指欺骗别人或设法占别人便宜的人；具体含义取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma ta' disprezz għal persuna li tagħmel sess illeċitu, tiġri wara n-nisa, tqarraq b'ħaddieħor jew tipprova tieħu vantaġġ minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有淫乱行为的人；发生不正当性关系的人。
到处追逐女性、玩弄女性感情的男人；好色之徒。
惯于欺骗别人的人；狡诈之徒。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who seeks to take advantage of others
sense_translations.zh_definition: 设法占别人便宜或利用别人的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-kelma 'ħaxxej' tesprimi d-disprezz tan-narratur għal raġel li jqarraq bin-nies u jieħu vantaġġ minnhom.
formal.en: In the story, the word 'ħaxxej' expresses the narrator's contempt for a man who deceives people and takes advantage of them.
formal.zh: 在这个故事中，ħaxxej 一词表达了叙述者对一个欺骗并利用他人的男人的鄙视。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawnhekk, 'ħaxxej' tfisser raġel li jiġri wara n-nisa? Mark: Le, f'din is-silta tfisser wieħed li jqarraq bin-nies u jieħu vantaġġ minnhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does 'ħaxxej' mean a womaniser here? Mark: No, in this passage it means someone who deceives people and takes advantage of them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 ħaxxej 是指到处追逐女性的男人吗？马克：不是，在这段文字里，它指欺骗别人、占别人便宜的人。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk, 'ħaxxej' tfisser raġel li jiġri wara n-nisa?
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk, 'ħaxxej' tfisser raġel li jiġri wara n-nisa?
messages.zh: 这里的 ħaxxej 是指到处追逐女性的男人吗？
messages.en: Does 'ħaxxej' mean a womaniser here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, f'din is-silta tfisser wieħed li jqarraq bin-nies u jieħu vantaġġ minnhom.
messages.mt_standard: Le, f'din is-silta tfisser wieħed li jqarraq bin-nies u jieħu vantaġġ minnhom.
messages.zh: 不是，在这段文字里，它指欺骗别人、占别人便宜的人。
messages.en: No, in this passage it means someone who deceives people and takes advantage of them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“品行恶劣的人物”记忆卡：好色、骗人、占便宜分别对应不同义项，阅读时靠上下文判断，并记住它带贬义。

gloss_zh: 吃草；放牧取食；贪婪地吃

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feed on grass or graze; also, to eat greedily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指动物以草为食、在草地上取食；也可指贪婪地吃东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiekol il-ħaxix jew jirgħa; jista' jfisser ukoll li jiekol bir-regħba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以草为食；吃草。
在草地上吃草、取食。
贪婪地吃；狼吞虎咽。

formal.mt: Il-fenek ħaxxex fil-parti tal-għalqa fejn il-ħaxix kien għadu aħdar.
formal.en: The rabbit fed on grass in the part of the field where it was still green.
formal.zh: 兔子在田里草仍然青绿的那一处吃草。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-fenek kiel xi ħaġa dalgħodu? Mark: Iva, ħaxxex fil-ġnien għal ftit ħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the rabbit eat anything this morning? Mark: Yes, it grazed in the garden for a little while.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：兔子今天早上吃东西了吗？马克：吃了，它在花园里吃了一会儿草。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 兔子今天早上吃东西了吗？
messages.en: Did the rabbit eat anything this morning?

messages.speaker: Mark (兔子主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħaxxex fil-ġnien għal ftit ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħaxxex fil-ġnien għal ftit ħin.
messages.zh: 吃了，它在花园里吃了一会儿草。
messages.en: Yes, it grazed in the garden for a little while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象兔子低头吃草，再把画面换成一个人贪婪进食：同一个动词连接“吃草”和“贪吃”两组用法。

gloss_zh: 造成瘀伤的人或物；狼吞虎咽的人；贪婪的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: Someone or something that causes bruising; also, a person who gobbles food or is greedy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指会造成瘀伤的人或物，也指吃东西狼吞虎咽的人，或泛指贪婪的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew ħaġa li tbenġel; ukoll persuna li tibla' l-ikel bl-għaġla jew li tkun rgħiba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 会造成瘀伤的东西或人。
吃东西狼吞虎咽、急急吞咽的人。
贪婪的人；贪得无厌的人。

collocations.en: a greedy person with no self-restraint
a person who gobbles food at the table
collocations.zh: 在餐桌上狼吞虎咽的人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ħaxxiem bela' l-ikla kollha qabel ma l-oħrajn laħqu bdew jieklu.
formal.en: In the story, the greedy eater gobbled down the whole meal before the others had even started eating.
formal.zh: 在故事中，那个狼吞虎咽的人在其他人还没来得及动口之前，就吞下了整顿饭。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex sejjaħtlu 'ħaxxiem'? Mark: Għax bela' kollox f'daqqa u ma ħalla xejn għalina!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you call him a 'ħaxxiem'? Mark: Because he gobbled everything down at once and left nothing for us!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么叫他 ħaxxiem？马克：因为他一下子把东西全吞了，什么也没给我们留！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么叫他 ħaxxiem？
messages.en: Why did you call him a 'ħaxxiem'?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax bela' kollox f'daqqa u ma ħalla xejn għalina!
messages.mt_standard: Għax bela' kollox f'daqqa u ma ħalla xejn għalina!
messages.zh: 因为他一下子把东西全吞了，什么也没给我们留！
messages.en: Because he gobbled everything down at once and left nothing for us!

cognitive_memory_aid: 做三张并列画面卡：造成瘀伤的东西、吞饭很快的人、贪得无厌的人。三义分别记忆，不必硬编共同词源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to cause bruising; also used to describe a greedy person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容有造成瘀伤倾向的人或物；也可用来形容人贪婪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jbenġel; jintuża wkoll biex jiddeskrivi persuna rgħiba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有造成瘀伤倾向的；容易使人瘀青的。
形容人贪婪的、贪得无厌的。

formal.mt: L-awtur jippreżenta karattru ħaxxiemi li jitlob dejjem aktar u qatt ma jkun kuntent b'dak li għandu.
formal.en: The author presents a greedy character who always asks for more and is never content with what he has.
formal.zh: 作者塑造了一个贪婪的角色：他总是索取更多，从不满足于自己已经拥有的东西。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif tiddeskrivi lir-raġel f'dan ir-rakkont? Mark: Ħaxxiemi! Ħa sehmu u xorta jrid jieħu minn tagħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: How would you describe the man in this story? Mark: Greedy! He took his share and still wants some of ours.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你会怎样形容这个故事里的男人？马克：贪婪！他拿了自己那份，还想拿我们的。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 你会怎样形容这个故事里的男人？
messages.en: How would you describe the man in this story?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħaxxiemi! Ħa sehmu u xorta jrid jieħu minn tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Ħaxxiemi! Ħa sehmu u xorta jrid jieħu minn tagħna.
messages.zh: 贪婪！他拿了自己那份，还想拿我们的。
messages.en: Greedy! He took his share and still wants some of ours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时给这个词贴上“形容词”标签：它描述“容易造成瘀伤”或“贪婪”的性质。用“他很贪婪”帮助记住第二义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Likely to cause weight gain or make a person or animal fatter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容食物、饲料等具有使人或动物增重、发胖的作用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel persuna jew annimal iżid fil-piż jew jeħxien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人或动物发胖的；有催肥作用的。

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju tal-ktieb, il-bidwi jagħżel għalf ħaxxieni biex l-annimali jiżdiedu fil-piż.
formal.en: In the textbook example, the farmer chooses fattening feed to help the animals gain weight.
formal.zh: 在课本的例子中，农民选择有催肥作用的饲料，让动物增加体重。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'ikel ħaxxieni'? Mark: Ikel li jista' jġiegħlek iżżid fil-piż.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'ikel ħaxxieni' mean? Mark: Food that can make you gain weight.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：ikel ħaxxieni 是什么意思？马克：就是可能让人体重增加的食物。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: ikel ħaxxieni 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ikel ħaxxieni' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikel li jista' jġiegħlek iżżid fil-piż.
messages.mt_standard: Ikel li jista' jġiegħlek iżżid fil-piż.
messages.zh: 就是可能让人体重增加的食物。
messages.en: Food that can make you gain weight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象饲料袋旁画着一支体重上升箭头：这个形容词说的是“有使其变胖的作用”，不是单纯描述某人已经很胖。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A grass eater; also, a person who greedily takes or seeks more than their share.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指吃草的动物或食草者；也可指贪婪攫取、总想多占多拿的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal li jiekol il-ħaxix; ukoll persuna rgħiba li tipprova tieħu aktar minn sehemha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 食草者；吃草的动物。
贪婪攫取的人；贪得无厌、总想多占多拿的人。

collocations.en: a grass eater in the pasture
a rapacious person who wants everything for himself
collocations.zh: 想把一切据为己有的贪婪者

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, is-sid huwa deskritt bħala ħaxxiex li jipprova jieħu anki s-sehem tal-ħaddiema.
formal.en: In the story, the owner is described as a rapacious person who tries to take even the workers' share.
formal.zh: 在故事中，那个老板被描写成一个贪婪攫取的人，连工人应得的份额也想拿走。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawn 'ħaxxiex' qed tirreferi għal annimal li jiekol il-ħaxix? Mark: Le, qed tirreferi għal raġel rgħib li jrid kollox għalih.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is 'ħaxxiex' referring to a grass-eating animal here? Mark: No, it refers to a greedy man who wants everything for himself.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 ħaxxiex 是指吃草的动物吗？马克：不是，它指一个想把一切据为己有的贪婪男人。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn 'ħaxxiex' qed tirreferi għal annimal li jiekol il-ħaxix?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn 'ħaxxiex' qed tirreferi għal annimal li jiekol il-ħaxix?
messages.zh: 这里的 ħaxxiex 是指吃草的动物吗？
messages.en: Is 'ħaxxiex' referring to a grass-eating animal here?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, qed tirreferi għal raġel rgħib li jrid kollox għalih.
messages.mt_standard: Le, qed tirreferi għal raġel rgħib li jrid kollox għalih.
messages.zh: 不是，它指一个想把一切据为己有的贪婪男人。
messages.en: No, it refers to a greedy man who wants everything for himself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画分开记：一幅是草地上的食草动物，一幅是把所有东西往自己怀里拢的人。是否指人，是判断义项的重要线索。

gloss_zh: 习惯吃草的；容许草生长的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Habitually feeding on grass, or allowing grass to grow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容动物习惯性地以草为食；也可表示容许草生长的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiekol il-ħaxix regolarment, jew li jħalli l-ħaxix jikber.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 习惯吃草的；经常以草为食的。
容许草生长的；任草生长的。

collocations.en: an animal that habitually feeds on grass
a rabbit that habitually feeds on grass

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju tal-lezzjoni, l-aġġettiv 'ħaxxiexi' jiddeskrivi annimal li jiekol il-ħaxix regolarment.
formal.en: In the lesson's example, the adjective 'ħaxxiexi' describes an animal that regularly feeds on grass.
formal.zh: 在本课的例子中，形容词 ħaxxiexi 描述的是经常以草为食的动物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: 'Ħaxxiexi' tfisser biss li jiekol il-ħaxix? Mark: Le, tista' tfisser ukoll li jħalli l-ħaxix jikber. Ara kif tintuża fis-sentenza.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does 'ħaxxiexi' only mean feeding on grass? Mark: No, it can also mean allowing grass to grow. Look at how it is used in the sentence.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：ħaxxiexi 只表示吃草吗？马克：不是，它也可以表示容许草生长。要看它在句子里怎样使用。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: ħaxxiexi 只表示吃草吗？
messages.en: Does 'ħaxxiexi' only mean feeding on grass?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tista' tfisser ukoll li jħalli l-ħaxix jikber. Ara kif tintuża fis-sentenza.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tista' tfisser ukoll li jħalli l-ħaxix jikber. Ara kif tintuża fis-sentenza.
messages.zh: 不是，它也可以表示容许草生长。要看它在句子里怎样使用。
messages.en: No, it can also mean allowing grass to grow. Look at how it is used in the sentence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把草地画成两个场景：动物每天来吃草，以及草被允许继续生长。分别记“习惯取食”和“容许生长”，不要把两义混成一个动作。

gloss_zh: 笨重物；体积过大的东西

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bulky, cumbersome, or oversized thing that is awkward to handle or move.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指体积大、显得笨重，或尺寸过大而不便搬动、处理的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaġa goffa jew kbira wisq, li tkun tqila jew diffiċli biex iċċaqlaqha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 笨重而不便搬动或处理的东西。
尺寸过大、体积超出所需的东西。

formal.mt: Il-ħaxxub ma għaddiex mill-bieb tal-maħżen, u għalhekk kellhom idaħħluh minn daħla usa'.
formal.en: The bulky object would not fit through the storeroom door, so they had to bring it in through a wider entrance.
formal.zh: 那个大而笨重的东西过不了储藏室的门，因此他们只得从更宽的入口把它搬进去。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif se ndaħħlu dan il-ħaxxub fil-kamra? Mark: Ejja nkejlu l-bieb l-ewwel, imbagħad naraw jekk jgħaddix.
colloquial.en: Maja: How are we going to get this bulky thing into the room? Mark: Let's measure the door first, then see whether it will fit.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这么个笨重的大东西，我们怎么搬进房间？马克：先量一下门，再看看能不能搬进去。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se ndaħħlu dan il-ħaxxub fil-kamra?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se ndaħħlu dan il-ħaxxub fil-kamra?
messages.zh: 这么个笨重的大东西，我们怎么搬进房间？
messages.en: How are we going to get this bulky thing into the room?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nkejlu l-bieb l-ewwel, imbagħad naraw jekk jgħaddix.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nkejlu l-bieb l-ewwel, imbagħad naraw jekk jgħaddix.
messages.zh: 先量一下门，再看看能不能搬进去。
messages.en: Let's measure the door first, then see whether it will fit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象搬家时一件卡在门口的大东西：又大又难搬，对应“笨重物”；尺寸超过门框，对应“过大的东西”。用具体物件记住它的名词用法。

gloss_zh: 举止粗鲁或笨拙的人；粗俗的；笨拙的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose manners seem unrefined or whose behaviour is socially awkward or clumsy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 举止显得粗鲁、不懂社交礼数或行动笨拙的人；用于评价他人时可能带有贬义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna b'manjieri mhux raffinati jew li ġġib ruħha b'mod goff jew mingħajr ħila fis-soċjetà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 举止粗俗、缺乏文雅风度的人。
被认为带有乡气、举止不够文雅的人，含贬义。
不谙社交礼数的；举止拘拙、不自然的。
笨拙的；动作不灵巧的。
不善应酬、举止拘拙的人。
动作笨拙、不够灵巧的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-mistieden jidher bħala ħaxxun għax jinterrompi lill-oħrajn u ma jagħtix kas tal-manjieri.
formal.en: In the story, the guest comes across as an unrefined person because he interrupts others and pays no attention to manners.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这位客人总是打断别人，也不注意礼数，因此显得是个举止粗鲁的人。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Qaluli li jien ħaxxun għax waqqajt it-tazza. Lea: Tazza tista' taqa' lil kulħadd; darba waħda ma tfissirx li int ħaxxun.
colloquial.en: Mark: They called me clumsy because I dropped the cup. Lea: Anyone can drop a cup; doing it once doesn't mean you're a clumsy person.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我把杯子掉在地上，他们就说我是个笨手笨脚的人。莉娅：谁都可能失手掉杯子，一次失手不代表你就是个笨拙的人。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qaluli li jien ħaxxun għax waqqajt it-tazza.
messages.mt_standard: Qaluli li jien ħaxxun għax waqqajt it-tazza.
messages.zh: 我把杯子掉在地上，他们就说我是个笨手笨脚的人。
messages.en: They called me clumsy because I dropped the cup.

messages.speaker: Lea (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tazza tista' taqa' lil kulħadd; darba waħda ma tfissirx li int ħaxxun.
messages.mt_standard: Tazza tista' taqa' lil kulħadd; darba waħda ma tfissirx li int ħaxxun.
messages.zh: 谁都可能失手掉杯子，一次失手不代表你就是个笨拙的人。
messages.en: Anyone can drop a cup; doing it once doesn't mean you're a clumsy person.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħaxxun 放进两个画面记忆：席间乱插话对应举止粗鲁，端杯失手对应动作笨拙；作名词时指这样的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a soft swishing or rustling sound through movement or friction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因移动、摇动或摩擦而发出轻微的沙沙声或窸窣声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħoss ħafif u ripetut meta xi ħaġa tiċċaqlaq jew togħrok ma' oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出轻微的沙沙声或窸窣声，如叶片、纸张或衣料移动时作响。

formal.mt: Il-weraq niexef ħaxħax meta għaddiet żiffa minn bejn is-siġar.
formal.en: The dry leaves rustled when a breeze passed through the trees.
formal.zh: 一阵微风穿过树间，干叶随之沙沙作响。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'kien dak il-ħoss? Toni: Il-weraq ħaxħax meta għadda l-qattus. Sara: Issa fhimt minn fejn ġie.
colloquial.en: Sara: What was that sound? Toni: The leaves rustled when the cat passed by. Sara: Now I understand where it came from.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：刚才是什么声音？托尼：猫经过时，叶子沙沙响了一下。萨拉：现在我知道声音从哪儿来了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 刚才是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that sound?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 猫经过时，叶子沙沙响了一下。
messages.en: The leaves rustled when the cat passed by.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 现在我知道声音从哪儿来了。
messages.en: Now I understand where it came from.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读词时想象手指轻轻翻动干叶，把声音画面和“发出沙沙声”这个动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An object or material that makes a rustling sound when moved.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 移动时会发出沙沙声的物件或材料；这里指发声的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett jew materjal li jagħmel ħoss ħafif meta jitħarrek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 会发出沙沙声或窸窣声的东西。

collocations.zh: 口袋里会沙沙作响的东西
脚下会沙沙作响的东西

formal.mt: Qabel ir-reġistrazzjoni, kull ħaxħiex tneħħa minn fuq il-mejda biex ma jfixkilx il-ħoss.
formal.en: Before the recording, anything that could rustle was removed from the table so that it would not interfere with the sound.
formal.zh: 录音前，桌上所有会发出沙沙声的东西都被移走，以免干扰录音。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għandek fil-but li qed jagħmel dak il-ħoss? Mark: Għandi ftit ħaxħiex: karti mkemmxin. Maja: Oħroġhom qabel nibdew nirrekordjaw.
colloquial.en: Maja: What have you got in your pocket that is making that sound? Mark: I have some rustling stuff: crumpled papers. Maja: Take them out before we start recording.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你口袋里有什么东西在响？马克：有些会沙沙响的东西，就是揉皱的纸。玛雅：我们开始录音前，把它们拿出来吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (录音搭档)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għandek fil-but li qed jagħmel dak il-ħoss?
messages.mt_standard: X'għandek fil-but li qed jagħmel dak il-ħoss?
messages.zh: 你口袋里有什么东西在响？
messages.en: What have you got in your pocket that is making that sound?

messages.speaker: Mark (录音搭档)
messages.zh: 有些会沙沙响的东西，就是揉皱的纸。
messages.en: I have some rustling stuff: crumpled papers.

messages.speaker: Maja (录音搭档)
messages.zh: 我们开始录音前，把它们拿出来吧。
messages.en: Take them out before we start recording.

cognitive_memory_aid: 听见口袋里纸张沙沙响时，想“是什么东西在响”，用这个问题记住它是指物的名词。

gloss_zh: 容易沙沙作响的；易发出窸窣声的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to make a rustling sound when moved or touched.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容材料或物件在移动、触碰时容易发出沙沙声，强调其容易作响的特性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jagħmel ħoss ħafif meta jitħarrek jew jintmess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易发出沙沙声或窸窣声的；具有易作响特性的。

formal.mt: Għall-kostumi tal-atturi ntgħażel drapp artab u mhux ħaxħiexi, sabiex il-movimenti ma jfixklux ir-reġistrazzjoni.
formal.en: Soft fabric that did not tend to rustle was chosen for the actors' costumes so that their movements would not interfere with the recording.
formal.zh: 演员的戏服选用了柔软、不易窸窣作响的布料，以免动作干扰录音。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan id-drapp jogħġbok għall-purtieri? Pawlu: Iva, imma huwa ħaxħiexi wisq. Lara: Mela nfittxu wieħed li jagħmel inqas ħoss.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you like this fabric for the curtains? Pawlu: Yes, but it rustles too easily. Lara: Then let us look for one that makes less noise.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你喜欢用这块布做窗帘吗？保罗：喜欢，不过它太容易沙沙作响了。拉拉：那我们找一种声音小一点的吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 你喜欢用这块布做窗帘吗？
messages.en: Do you like this fabric for the curtains?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 喜欢，不过它太容易沙沙作响了。
messages.en: Yes, but it rustles too easily.

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nfittxu wieħed li jagħmel inqas ħoss.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nfittxu wieħed li jagħmel inqas ħoss.
messages.zh: 那我们找一种声音小一点的吧。
messages.en: Then let us look for one that makes less noise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把容易一碰就响的布料作为记忆画面，记住这个形容词描述“容易沙沙作响”的特性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A partridge; the Maltese noun used to name this kind of bird.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鹧鸪，指这一类鸟；本词作为鸟类名称使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala partridge.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鹧鸪，指鸟类。

formal.mt: Il-gwida tinkludi taqsima dwar il-ħaġel, b'ritratti li jgħinu lill-qarrej jagħraf dawn l-għasafar.
formal.en: The guide includes a section on partridges, with photographs that help the reader recognize these birds.
formal.zh: 指南设有介绍鹧鸪的章节，并配有照片，帮助读者辨认这种鸟。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'jissejħu dawn l-għasafar fir-ritratt? Mark: Ħaġel. Bl-Ingliż ngħidulhom partridges.
colloquial.en: Nina: What are these birds in the photograph called? Mark: Ħaġel. In English we call them partridges.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：照片里的这些鸟叫什么？马克：Ħaġel，也就是鹧鸪。英语叫 partridges。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 照片里的这些鸟叫什么？
messages.en: What are these birds in the photograph called?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.zh: Ħaġel，也就是鹧鸪。英语叫 partridges。
messages.en: Ħaġel. In English we call them partridges.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给鹧鸪图片贴上 ħaġel 标签，再把词尾 l 想成鸟旁边的一根细树枝；用“图片加拼写”记住鸟名，并与词尾为 m 的动词 ħaġem 分开。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To eat food very quickly and greedily; to wolf it down.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 急切而快速地吃东西，即狼吞虎咽地吃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiekol l-ikel malajr ħafna u b'għaġla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狼吞虎咽地吃东西。

collocations.zh: 他狼吞虎咽地吃了那些食物
他狼吞虎咽地吃了那顿饭

formal.mt: Wara l-vjaġġ twil, Mark ħaġem l-ikla li kienet tħejjiet għalih.
formal.en: After the long journey, Mark wolfed down the meal that had been prepared for him.
formal.zh: 长途旅行结束后，马克狼吞虎咽地吃了为他准备的饭。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark diġà spiċċa jiekol? Sara: Iva, ħaġem l-ikel kollu; kien bil-ġuħ ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has Mark already finished eating? Sara: Yes, he wolfed down all the food; he was very hungry.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克已经吃完了吗？萨拉：是啊，他把食物全都狼吞虎咽地吃完了，刚才饿极了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克已经吃完了吗？
messages.en: Has Mark already finished eating?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħaġem l-ikel kollu; kien bil-ġuħ ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħaġem l-ikel kollu; kien bil-ġuħ ħafna.
messages.zh: 是啊，他把食物全都狼吞虎咽地吃完了，刚才饿极了。
messages.en: Yes, he wolfed down all the food; he was very hungry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词尾 m 想成嘴巴嚼食物时的“嗯嗯”声，再想象一个饥饿的人飞快吃饭，用整个画面记住 ħaġem“狼吞虎咽”；这是人为助记，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To prevail in an argument or discussion; to win the argument.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在争论或讨论中占上风并获胜，即辩赢对方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Toħroġ rebbieħ f'argument jew f'diskussjoni.

sense_translations.en_definition: to win out in an argument
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在争论中获胜，辩赢对方。

collocations.zh: 他在那场争论中获胜了
他在那场讨论中占了上风

formal.mt: Wara li ppreżenta l-provi tiegħu u wieġeb għall-oġġezzjonijiet, Mark ħaġġ fl-argument.
formal.en: After presenting his evidence and responding to the objections, Mark won the argument.
formal.zh: 马克提出证据并回应反对意见后，在争论中获胜了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min ħaġġ fl-argument tal-bieraħ? Pawlu: Mark ħaġġ; ta raġunijiet ċari u wieġeb il-mistoqsijiet kollha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who won yesterday's argument? Pawlu: Mark did; he gave clear reasons and answered all the questions.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：昨天那场争论谁赢了？保罗：马克赢了，他给出了清楚的理由，还回答了所有问题。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 昨天那场争论谁赢了？
messages.en: Who won yesterday's argument?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark ħaġġ; ta raġunijiet ċari u wieġeb il-mistoqsijiet kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Mark ħaġġ; ta raġunijiet ċari u wieġeb il-mistoqsijiet kollha.
messages.zh: 马克赢了，他给出了清楚的理由，还回答了所有问题。
messages.en: Mark did; he gave clear reasons and answered all the questions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħaġġ 中并排的两个 ġ 想成辩论时摆出的两条有力理由，再联想裁判宣布“辩赢了”；记住它描述争论中的获胜，双字母画面只是拼写助记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put someone or something where they cannot easily be seen or found.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把人或东西藏在不容易被看见或找到的地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa fejn ma jkunux jistgħu jidhru jew jinstabu faċilment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 藏起；使人或东西不被看见或发现。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jaħbi lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

collocations.en: hid the present in the drawer

formal.mt: Pawlu ħaġġeb ir-rigal fil-kexxun biex jibqa' sorpriża għal oħtu.
formal.en: Paul hid the present in the drawer so that it would remain a surprise for his sister.
formal.zh: 保罗把礼物藏在抽屉里，好让妹妹收到时感到惊喜。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn mar ir-rigal? | Mark: Pawlu ħaġġeb ir-rigal fil-kexxun. Tgħidx lil oħtu!
colloquial.en: Lara: Where has the present gone? | Mark: Paul hid the present in the drawer. Don't tell his sister!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：礼物去哪儿了？ | 马克：保罗把礼物藏在抽屉里了。别告诉他妹妹！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 礼物去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where has the present gone?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu ħaġġeb ir-rigal fil-kexxun. Tgħidx lil oħtu!
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu ħaġġeb ir-rigal fil-kexxun. Tgħidx lil oħtu!
messages.zh: 保罗把礼物藏在抽屉里了。别告诉他妹妹！
messages.en: Paul hid the present in the drawer. Don't tell his sister!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把礼物推进抽屉、关上后看不见的画面，用“藏起礼物”记住这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To travel to Mecca as a Muslim pilgrim.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为穆斯林朝觐者前往麦加朝觐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imur il-Mekka bħala pellegrin Musulman.

sense_translations.en_definition: to go on a pilgrimage to Mecca
sense_translations.zh_definition: 前往麦加朝觐。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel pellegrinaġġ lejn il-Mekka.

collocations.en: went on a pilgrimage to Mecca
went on a pilgrimage to Mecca with his family
collocations.zh: 与家人一起赴麦加朝觐了

formal.mt: Is-sena li għaddiet, Ahmed ħaġġeġ lejn il-Mekka mal-familja tiegħu.
formal.en: Last year, Ahmed went on a pilgrimage to Mecca with his family.
formal.zh: 去年，艾哈迈德与家人一起前往麦加朝觐。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Ahmed ħaġġeġ din is-sena? | Sami: Iva, mar il-Mekka ma' ħuh u issa reġa' lura.
colloquial.en: Maria: Did Ahmed go on a pilgrimage to Mecca this year? | Sami: Yes, he went to Mecca with his brother and has now returned.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：艾哈迈德今年去麦加朝觐了吗？ | 萨米：去了，他和哥哥一起去的，现在已经回来了。

messages.speaker: Marija (邻居)
messages.zh: 艾哈迈德今年去麦加朝觐了吗？
messages.en: Did Ahmed go on a pilgrimage to Mecca this year?

messages.speaker: Sami (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, mar il-Mekka ma' ħuh u issa reġa' lura.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, mar il-Mekka ma' ħuh u issa reġa' lura.
messages.zh: 去了，他和哥哥一起去的，现在已经回来了。
messages.en: Yes, he went to Mecca with his brother and has now returned.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个动词放进“某人前往麦加”的旅行画面中，牢牢记住目的地和朝觐行为。

gloss_zh: 穆斯林朝觐者；生火的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A Muslim who makes a pilgrimage, especially to Mecca.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进行宗教朝觐的穆斯林，尤指赴麦加朝觐者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Musulman li jagħmel pellegrinaġġ, speċjalment lejn il-Mekka.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穆斯林朝觐者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pellegrin Musulman.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 点火或生火的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tqabbad nar.

collocations.en: the person who lit the fire

formal.mt: Il-ħaġġieġ Musulman kiteb dwar il-pellegrinaġġ tiegħu lejn il-Mekka.
formal.en: The Muslim pilgrim wrote about his pilgrimage to Mecca.
formal.zh: 这名穆斯林朝觐者写下了自己赴麦加朝觐的经历。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min qabbad in-nar għall-ikel? | Mark: Pawlu. Illum hu l-ħaġġieġ tal-grupp!
colloquial.en: Lara: Who lit the fire for cooking? | Mark: Paul. Today he's the group's fire starter!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁生的火做饭？ | 马克：保罗。今天他是咱们这组负责生火的人！

messages.speaker: Lara (露营同伴)
messages.zh: 谁生的火做饭？
messages.en: Who lit the fire for cooking?

messages.speaker: Mark (露营同伴)
messages.zh: 保罗。今天他是咱们这组负责生火的人！
messages.en: Paul. Today he's the group's fire starter!

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两张人物卡：一张是朝觐者，一张是生火的人。分别配上旅途和火堆，靠语境区分两个名词义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To laugh loudly and audibly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出响亮的笑声；放声大笑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jidħaq b'leħen għoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放声大笑；大声地笑。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jidħaq b'leħen għoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 笑；笑声。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-daħk jew il-ħoss tad-daħk.

formal.mt: Meta sema' ċ-ċajta, it-tifel ħaħa b'leħen għoli, u l-ħoss tal-ħaħa mela l-kamra.
formal.en: When he heard the joke, the boy laughed loudly, and the sound of laughter filled the room.
formal.zh: 男孩听到笑话后放声大笑，笑声充满了整个房间。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex Mark ħaħa hekk? | Lara: Sema' ċajta tajba. Issa rrid nismagħha jien ukoll!
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did Mark laugh so loudly? | Lara: He heard a good joke. Now I want to hear it too!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：马克怎么笑得那么大声？ | 拉拉：他听了个好笑话。现在我也想听听！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克怎么笑得那么大声？
messages.en: Why did Mark laugh so loudly?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sema' ċajta tajba. Issa rrid nismagħha jien ukoll!
messages.mt_standard: Sema' ċajta tajba. Issa rrid nismagħha jien ukoll!
messages.zh: 他听了个好笑话。现在我也想听听！
messages.en: He heard a good joke. Now I want to hear it too!

cognitive_memory_aid: 可把字形联想成中文“哈哈”的笑声来记忆；再用“他大笑”和“传来笑声”分别练习动词与名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The proper name of a village in Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他一个村镇的专有名称，书写为 Ħaż-Żebbuġ。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem proprju ta' raħal f'Malta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他的一个村镇，名为 Ħaż-Żebbuġ。

collocations.zh: 对 Ħaż-Żebbuġ 的一次游览

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-iskola jinkludi żjara f'Ħaż-Żebbuġ biex l-istudenti jsiru jafu aħjar il-lokalità.
formal.en: The school programme includes a visit to Ħaż-Żebbuġ so that students can get to know the locality better.
formal.zh: 学校的活动安排包括游览 Ħaż-Żebbuġ，让学生更好地了解这个地方。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sejrin il-Ħadd? Mark: Se mmorru Ħaż-Żebbuġ biex inżuru lil ħabib tagħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are we going on Sunday? Mark: We are going to Ħaż-Żebbuġ to visit a friend of ours.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们星期天去哪里？马克：我们去 Ħaż-Żebbuġ 看一位朋友。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们星期天去哪里？
messages.en: Where are we going on Sunday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmorru Ħaż-Żebbuġ biex inżuru lil ħabib tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmorru Ħaż-Żebbuġ biex inżuru lil ħabib tagħna.
messages.zh: 我们去 Ħaż-Żebbuġ 看一位朋友。
messages.en: We are going to Ħaż-Żebbuġ to visit a friend of ours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ħaż-Żebbuġ 整体当作地图上的地名卡片记忆，同时留意大写字母和中间的连字符。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take hold of someone or something firmly, including grasping, seizing, or clasping.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用手牢牢抓住某人或某物，可表示抓握、突然攫住或紧紧握住。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qabad lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa sew b'idu, kemm b'qabda soda kif ukoll b'moviment għal għarrieda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抓住；用手握牢。
猛然抓住；一把攫住。
紧握；紧紧扣住。

formal.mt: Meta d-dgħajsa resqet lejn ix-xatt, ir-raġel ħażaq il-ħabel biex iżommha f'postha.
formal.en: When the boat approached the shore, the man grasped the rope to hold it in place.
formal.zh: 小船靠近岸边时，那名男子抓牢绳子，把船固定住。

colloquial.mt: Lea: X'għamel Mark meta żlaqt? Pawlu: Ħażaq idek u għenek terġa' tqum.
colloquial.en: Lea: What did Mark do when I slipped? Pawlu: He clasped your hand and helped you get back up.
colloquial.zh: 莉娅：我滑倒时，马克做了什么？保罗：他紧紧握住你的手，扶你重新站起来。

messages.speaker: Lea (朋友)
messages.zh: 我滑倒时，马克做了什么？
messages.en: What did Mark do when I slipped?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħażaq idek u għenek terġa' tqum.
messages.mt_standard: Ħażaq idek u għenek terġa' tqum.
messages.zh: 他紧紧握住你的手，扶你重新站起来。
messages.en: He clasped your hand and helped you get back up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ħażaq 时想象一只手牢牢合拢：抓绳子是抓牢，突然出手是攫住，握住同伴的手是紧握。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The condition of lacking enough money or material resources to meet basic needs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缺少足够金钱或物质资源、难以满足基本生活需要的贫困状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' min m'għandux biżżejjed flus jew mezzi biex ilaħħaq mal-ħtiġijiet bażiċi tal-ħajja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贫困；缺乏维持基本生活所需经济或物质条件的状态。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-ħażar li kienu jgħixu fih ħafna familji u n-nuqqas ta' aċċess għall-edukazzjoni.
formal.en: The report describes the poverty in which many families lived and their lack of access to education.
formal.zh: 报告描述了许多家庭当时所处的贫困状况，以及他们缺乏受教育机会的问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: In-nannu jgħid li meta kien żgħir kien jgħix fil-ħażar. Mark: Iva, qalli li xi drabi lanqas kellhom biżżejjed x'jieklu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Grandad says he lived in poverty when he was young. Mark: Yes, he told me that sometimes they didn't even have enough to eat.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：爷爷说，他小时候生活很贫困。马克：是啊，他跟我说，他们有时连饭都吃不饱。

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nannu jgħid li meta kien żgħir kien jgħix fil-ħażar.
messages.mt_standard: In-nannu jgħid li meta kien żgħir kien jgħix fil-ħażar.
messages.zh: 爷爷说，他小时候生活很贫困。
messages.en: Grandad says he lived in poverty when he was young.

messages.speaker: Mark (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qalli li xi drabi lanqas kellhom biżżejjed x'jieklu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qalli li xi drabi lanqas kellhom biżżejjed x'jieklu.
messages.zh: 是啊，他跟我说，他们有时连饭都吃不饱。
messages.en: Yes, he told me that sometimes they didn't even have enough to eat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一进一出的情景记 ħażar：住在其中是生活贫困，从中走出是摆脱贫困；记住它表示一种生活状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To break material into smaller pieces or powder by grinding or pounding it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过碾磨或反复捣击，把材料弄成较小颗粒或粉末。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Farrak xi materjal f'biċċiet żgħar jew fi trab billi tħnu jew tħabbtu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 研磨或捣碎；通过碾压或捣击使材料变细。

collocations.en: pounded the pepper in the mortar

formal.mt: Qabel żied il-ħwawar mat-taħlita, il-kok ħażdaq iż-żrieragħ fil-mehrież sakemm saru trab fin.
formal.en: Before adding the spices to the mixture, the cook ground the seeds in the mortar until they became a fine powder.
formal.zh: 把香料加入混合物之前，厨师先在研钵里把种子研磨成细粉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-bżar lest għaz-zalza? Mark: Iva, Pawlu ħażdaq il-bżar fil-mehrież; issa tista' żżidu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this pepper ready for the sauce? Mark: Yes, Pawlu pounded the pepper in the mortar; you can add it now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些胡椒可以放进酱汁了吗？马克：可以了，保罗已经在研钵里把胡椒捣碎了，现在可以加进去。

messages.speaker: Maja (做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 这些胡椒可以放进酱汁了吗？
messages.en: Is this pepper ready for the sauce?

messages.speaker: Mark (帮厨的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, Pawlu ħażdaq il-bżar fil-mehrież; issa tista' żżidu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, Pawlu ħażdaq il-bżar fil-mehrież; issa tista' żżidu.
messages.zh: 可以了，保罗已经在研钵里把胡椒捣碎了，现在可以加进去。
messages.en: Yes, Pawlu pounded the pepper in the mortar; you can add it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħażdaq 与研钵里的胡椒联系起来：转动研杵是在磨，上下敲击是在捣，两种动作都让颗粒变小。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of wrapping something in cloth or applying a bandage around a body part.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用布料缠裹物体或身体的动作，也指用绷带包扎身体部位的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ddawwar drapp ma' xi ħaġa jew li tgeżwer parti tal-ġisem b'faxxa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用布料缠裹、裹住的动作。
包扎；用绷带缠裹身体部位的过程。

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi l-ħażma tad-driegħ b'faxxa u juri l-proċess permezz ta' stampi.
formal.en: The text describes the bandaging of the arm and illustrates the process with pictures.
formal.zh: 这篇文字描述了用绷带包扎手臂的过程，并配有图片说明。

colloquial.mt: Lea: X'turi din l-istampa fil-ktieb? Mark: Turi l-ħażma tad-driegħ; ara kif il-faxxa ddur miegħu.
colloquial.en: Lea: What does this picture in the book show? Mark: It shows the bandaging of an arm; look at how the bandage goes around it.
colloquial.zh: 莉娅：书里的这幅图画的是什么？马克：画的是手臂包扎，你看绷带是怎样绕着手臂缠的。

messages.speaker: Lea (学生)
messages.zh: 书里的这幅图画的是什么？
messages.en: What does this picture in the book show?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Turi l-ħażma tad-driegħ; ara kif il-faxxa ddur miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Turi l-ħażma tad-driegħ; ara kif il-faxxa ddur miegħu.
messages.zh: 画的是手臂包扎，你看绷带是怎样绕着手臂缠的。
messages.en: It shows the bandaging of an arm; look at how the bandage goes around it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见 ħażma 就想象布条绕上一圈又一圈：一般物体是缠裹，身体部位用绷带缠裹就是包扎。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A room or building used to keep goods, supplies, or other items until they are needed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于存放货物、用品或其他物件，留待日后使用的房间或建筑物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kamra jew binja fejn jinżammu oġġetti, provvisti jew merkanzija sakemm ikun hemm bżonnhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 储藏室；存放用品或货物的房间。
仓库；用于储存物资的建筑物。

formal.mt: Il-kaxxi bil-materjal tqiegħdu fil-ħażn wara l-ispezzjoni, u kull kaxxa ngħatat numru.
formal.en: The boxes of materials were placed in the storehouse after inspection, and each box was assigned a number.
formal.zh: 装有材料的箱子在检查后被放入仓库，每个箱子都编了号。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn poġġejt is-siġġijiet żejda? Mark: Fil-ħażn, ħdejn il-kaxxi; iċ-ċavetta qiegħda fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you put the extra chairs? Mark: In the storeroom, next to the boxes; the key is on the table.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你把多余的椅子放在哪里了？马克：在储藏室里，箱子旁边；钥匙在桌上。

messages.speaker: Maja (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 你把多余的椅子放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you put the extra chairs?

messages.speaker: Mark (活动助手)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-ħażn, ħdejn il-kaxxi; iċ-ċavetta qiegħda fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-ħażn, ħdejn il-kaxxi; iċ-ċavetta qiegħda fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 在储藏室里，箱子旁边；钥匙在桌上。
messages.en: In the storeroom, next to the boxes; the key is on the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ħażn 配一扇门、一串钥匙和几箱用品：小房间可译储藏室，整栋存货建筑可译仓库，核心都是存放物品的地方。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make written marks or drawings, often quickly, roughly, or casually.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 写下字迹或画出图形，常指快速、粗略或随意地乱写、勾画、速写或涂鸦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel kitba jew tpinġija, spiss malajr, b'mod mhux irfinut jew mingħajr pjan preċiż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 潦草地写；随手乱写。
画；用线条描绘形象。
画草图；作速写；粗略勾画。
随手涂画；漫不经心地涂鸦。
潦草的字迹；随手乱写的内容。
草图；速写；粗略勾勒的图画。
随手涂出的图案；涂鸦。

formal.mt: Qabel beda t-tpinġija finali, l-istudent ħażż il-forma tal-bini bil-lapes biex jistudja l-proporzjonijiet.
formal.en: Before starting the final drawing, the student sketched the shape of the building in pencil to study its proportions.
formal.zh: 开始绘制最终作品之前，学生先用铅笔勾画建筑的外形，以研究其比例。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ħażż dawn l-istilel fil-marġni? Mark: Jien, waqt li kont qed nistenna t-telefonata.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who doodled these stars in the margin? Mark: I did, while I was waiting for the phone call.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁在页边随手画了这些星星？马克：我画的，当时我在等电话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁在页边随手画了这些星星？
messages.en: Who doodled these stars in the margin?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, waqt li kont qed nistenna t-telefonata.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, waqt li kont qed nistenna t-telefonata.
messages.zh: 我画的，当时我在等电话。
messages.en: I did, while I was waiting for the phone call.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用笔尖在纸上游走的画面记 ħażż：写字可成潦草字迹，画形可成草图，随意画可成涂鸦；同时记住动作与作品两类词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To grasp something, or to reduce material to smaller pieces by grinding or pounding, depending on context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可表示抓住某物，也可表示通过研磨或捣击把材料弄碎；具体词义由上下文决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qabad xi ħaġa sew, jew farrak materjal billi tħnu jew tħabbtu, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抓住；用手握牢某物。
研磨；碾磨；把材料磨成较细颗粒或粉末。
捣；捣碎；通过反复敲击使材料破碎。

collocations.en: ground or pounded the spices in the mortar
collocations.zh: 在研钵里磨碎或捣碎了香料

formal.mt: Għat-tħejjija tat-taħlita, il-kok ħażżaq il-ħwawar fil-mehrież sakemm saru trab fin.
formal.en: To prepare the mixture, the cook ground the spices in the mortar until they became a fine powder.
formal.zh: 为了配制混合物，厨师在研钵里把香料磨成了细粉。

colloquial.mt: Lea: Kif żamm Mark id-dgħajsa qrib ix-xatt? Pawlu: Ħażżaq il-ħabel u żammu sew sakemm wasalna.
colloquial.en: Lea: How did Mark keep the boat close to the shore? Pawlu: He grasped the rope and held it firmly until we arrived.
colloquial.zh: 莉娅：马克是怎样让船停在岸边附近的？保罗：他抓住绳子，一直牢牢握着，直到我们赶到。

messages.speaker: Lea (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif żamm Mark id-dgħajsa qrib ix-xatt?
messages.mt_standard: Kif żamm Mark id-dgħajsa qrib ix-xatt?
messages.zh: 马克是怎样让船停在岸边附近的？
messages.en: How did Mark keep the boat close to the shore?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħażżaq il-ħabel u żammu sew sakemm wasalna.
messages.mt_standard: Ħażżaq il-ħabel u żammu sew sakemm wasalna.
messages.zh: 他抓住绳子，一直牢牢握着，直到我们赶到。
messages.en: He grasped the rope and held it firmly until we arrived.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 ħażżaq 设两张记忆卡：手抓绳子对应抓住，研杵处理香料对应磨或捣；根据宾语与场景选择词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who causes other people to become poor.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由于其行为而使别人陷入贫困的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li bl-għemil tagħha twassal lil oħrajn għall-faqar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 造成贫困、使别人穷困的人。

collocations.en: a ruthless person who impoverishes others
collocations.zh: 无情地使别人陷入贫困的人

collocations.en: a person who impoverishes others by exploiting workers
collocations.zh: 通过剥削工人使人陷入贫困的人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, is-sid jidher bħala ħażżar li jieħu l-qligħ kollu u jħalli lill-ħaddiema fil-faqar.
formal.en: In the story, the owner is portrayed as someone who impoverishes others by taking all the profits and leaving the workers in poverty.
formal.zh: 在故事中，老板被描写成一个使别人陷入贫困的人：他拿走全部利润，让工人生活贫困。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex tgħid li dak is-sid huwa ħażżar? Pawlu: Għax iħallas tant ftit li l-ħaddiema tiegħu ma jistgħux jixtru l-affarijiet meħtieġa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do you say that owner impoverishes people? Pawlu: Because he pays so little that his workers cannot buy basic necessities.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么说那个老板是使人陷入贫困的人？保罗：因为他的工资给得太少，工人连生活必需品都买不起。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tgħid li dak is-sid huwa ħażżar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tgħid li dak is-sid huwa ħażżar?
messages.zh: 你为什么说那个老板是使人陷入贫困的人？
messages.en: Why do you say that owner impoverishes people?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax iħallas tant ftit li l-ħaddiema tiegħu ma jistgħux jixtru l-affarijiet meħtieġa.
messages.mt_standard: Għax iħallas tant ftit li l-ħaddiema tiegħu ma jistgħux jixtru l-affarijiet meħtieġa.
messages.zh: 因为他的工资给得太少，工人连生活必需品都买不起。
messages.en: Because he pays so little that his workers cannot buy basic necessities.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用画面记忆：一个人拿走收益，身后的工人越来越穷；这个词指造成贫困的人。

gloss_zh: 储存；囤备；弄坏；腐化；损害；使人变得狡黠或世故

teaching_sense.en_definition: To store something or build up supplies; also to spoil, corrupt or mar something, or make someone cunning or worldly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西储存起来或备足物资；也可指弄坏、腐化、损害某物，或使人变得狡黠、世故。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tqiegħed xi ħaġa merfugħa jew tiġbor provvisti; ukoll tħassar xi ħaġa, tikkorrompi, jew tagħmel lil xi ħadd aktar makakk jew midħla tad-dinja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 储存；把东西存放起来。
囤备；积存物资以备使用。
弄坏；使原有的品质或状态变差。
腐化；使人在道德或行为上变坏。
损害；破坏原有的完好、美感或效果。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make sb. cunning or worldly
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人变得狡黠，或变得老练、世故。

collocations.en: stock up on supplies for winter

formal.mt: Qabel ix-xitwa, il-bidwi ħażżen il-qamħ f'post niexef biex iżommu f'kundizzjoni tajba.
formal.en: Before winter, the farmer stored the grain in a dry place to keep it in good condition.
formal.zh: 入冬前，农民把谷物储存在干燥的地方，以保持其良好状态。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ħażżent dan l-ikel kollu? Toni: Għax il-ġimgħa d-dieħla ġejjin ħafna mistednin.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you stock up on all this food? Toni: Because we have lots of guests coming next week.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么囤了这么多食物？托尼：因为下星期会来很多客人。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么囤了这么多食物？
messages.en: Why did you stock up on all this food?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-ġimgħa d-dieħla ġejjin ħafna mistednin.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-ġimgħa d-dieħla ġejjin ħafna mistednin.
messages.zh: 因为下星期会来很多客人。
messages.en: Because we have lots of guests coming next week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作两张情境卡：一张是仓库储粮，一张是品质或人品变坏；用宾语和上下文区分各义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To scribble, draw, sketch or doodle, making written marks or pictures.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 写画出字迹或图形，可指乱写、画图、勾画草图或随手涂画。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel kitba jew tpinġijiet, bħal meta tikteb bl-għaġla, tfassal abbozz jew tpinġi biex tgħaddi l-ħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 潦草地写；乱写。
画；用线条等描绘图形。
勾画；画出简略的草图。
随手涂画；漫不经心地画些线条或小图案。

collocations.en: sketch a rough draft in pencil

formal.mt: Qabel beda t-tpinġija finali, l-istudent ħażżeż abbozz bil-lapes biex jiddeċiedi fejn iqiegħed kull oġġett.
formal.en: Before starting the final drawing, the student sketched a draft in pencil to decide where to place each object.
formal.zh: 开始画正式作品前，学生先用铅笔勾画草图，决定每个物体的位置。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'ħażżiżt fil-ġenb tal-paġna? Adam: Ftit fjuri biss, waqt li kont qed nistenna.
colloquial.en: Nina: What did you doodle in the margin of the page? Adam: Just a few flowers while I was waiting.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你在页边随手画了什么？亚当：等人的时候画了几朵花而已。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你在页边随手画了什么？
messages.en: What did you doodle in the margin of the page?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit fjuri biss, waqt li kont qed nistenna.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit fjuri biss, waqt li kont qed nistenna.
messages.zh: 等人的时候画了几朵花而已。
messages.en: Just a few flowers while I was waiting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象铅笔在纸上留下潦草字迹、轮廓和小花，把乱写、画图、速写、涂画串成一个动作场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large supporting beam used in a structure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 建筑或其他结构中用于承受荷载的大梁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Travu kbir li jġorr it-tagħbija u jagħti appoġġ lil struttura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大梁；结构中起承重作用的梁。

formal.mt: Il-pjanta turi ħażżiem tal-azzar li jsostni s-saqaf fuq is-sala l-kbira.
formal.en: The plan shows a steel girder supporting the roof over the main hall.
formal.zh: 图纸标示出一根钢制大梁，用来支撑大厅上方的屋顶。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak it-travu kbir hemm fuq? Ben: Dak ħażżiem; qiegħed hemm biex isostni s-saqaf.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that big beam up there? Ben: That is a girder; it is there to support the roof.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：上面那根大梁是什么？本：那是承重梁，用来支撑屋顶。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak it-travu kbir hemm fuq?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak it-travu kbir hemm fuq?
messages.zh: 上面那根大梁是什么？
messages.en: What is that big beam up there?

messages.speaker: Ben (讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ħażżiem; qiegħed hemm biex isostni s-saqaf.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ħażżiem; qiegħed hemm biex isostni s-saqaf.
messages.zh: 那是承重梁，用来支撑屋顶。
messages.en: That is a girder; it is there to support the roof.

cognitive_memory_aid: 抬头想象大厅上方一根粗壮的大梁托住屋顶，把 ħażżiem 与承重梁的画面绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A band or belt around the body, such as a girth securing a saddle or a girdle worn around the waist.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围在身体上的带子，可指固定马鞍的肚带，也可指围在腰部的腰带或束腰带。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Faxxa jew ċinturin li jdawwar il-ġisem, bħal dak li jżomm is-sarġ f'postu jew jintlibes mal-qadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肚带；绕过马腹、用来固定马鞍的带子。
腰带；围绕腰部的束带或束腰带。

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni tal-ilbies issemmi ħażżiema tad-drapp li tintlibes mal-qadd fuq il-libsa.
formal.en: The clothing description mentions a fabric girdle worn around the waist over the dress.
formal.zh: 服装说明提到一条布制束腰带，围在连衣裙外面的腰部。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Is-sarġ għadu jiċċaqlaq. Rita: Ejja niċċekkjaw il-ħażżiema qabel titla' fuq iż-żiemel.
colloquial.en: Mark: The saddle is still moving. Rita: Let us check the girth before you get on the horse.
colloquial.zh: 马克：马鞍还是会晃动。丽塔：你上马之前，我们先检查一下肚带。

messages.speaker: Mark (骑马学员)
messages.zh: 马鞍还是会晃动。
messages.en: The saddle is still moving.

messages.speaker: Rita (骑马教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja niċċekkjaw il-ħażżiema qabel titla' fuq iż-żiemel.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja niċċekkjaw il-ħażżiema qabel titla' fuq iż-żiemel.
messages.zh: 你上马之前，我们先检查一下肚带。
messages.en: Let us check the girth before you get on the horse.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两条环身的带子：一条绕过马腹固定马鞍，一条围在人腰间；用佩戴位置区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Going around or encircling something, like a surrounding band.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 像带子一样环绕某物、形成围束的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jdawwar jew iħaddan xi ħaġa bħal faxxa madwarha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 环绕的；围束在某物周围的。

formal.mt: Il-pjanta turi ħajt ħażżiemi madwar il-ġnien, b'daħla waħda fuq in-naħa tat-triq.
formal.en: The plan shows an encircling wall around the garden, with one entrance on the street side.
formal.zh: 图纸显示，一道墙环绕花园，靠街的一侧设有一个入口。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jiġifieri 'ħażżiemi' fid-deskrizzjoni taċ-ċint? Noel: Jiġifieri li ċ-ċint idur madwar il-ġnien kollu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'ħażżiemi' mean in the description of the fence? Noel: It means that the fence goes around the whole garden.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：围栏说明里的 ħażżiemi 是什么意思？诺埃尔：意思是围栏环绕着整个花园。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 围栏说明里的 ħażżiemi 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ħażżiemi' mean in the description of the fence?

messages.speaker: Noel (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri li ċ-ċint idur madwar il-ġnien kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri li ċ-ċint idur madwar il-ġnien kollu.
messages.zh: 意思是围栏环绕着整个花园。
messages.en: It means that the fence goes around the whole garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给花园画一个完整的外圈；这个词描述环绕的状态，记忆时把它放在墙或围栏之后。

gloss_zh: 仓库管理员；对他人有不良影响的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who manages a store of goods; also a person who has a bad influence on others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责保管和管理库存物品的人；也可指对别人产生不良影响的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tieħu ħsieb maħżen u l-oġġetti fih; ukoll persuna li tinfluwenza lil oħrajn għall-ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仓库管理员；负责保管库存物品的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. with a bad influence on others
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对别人有不良影响、会把别人带坏的人。

collocations.en: the storekeeper in charge of the storeroom
collocations.zh: 负责库房的仓库管理员

collocations.mt: ħażżien li jħajjar lil oħrajn għall-ħażin
collocations.en: a bad influence who encourages others to do wrong
collocations.zh: 怂恿别人做坏事、带坏他人的人

formal.mt: Il-ħażżien irreġistra l-oġġetti li waslu u qabbel il-kwantitajiet mal-lista tal-kunsinna.
formal.en: The storekeeper recorded the items that arrived and checked the quantities against the delivery list.
formal.zh: 仓库管理员登记了到货物品，并按照送货清单核对数量。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tgħid li dak ir-raġel huwa ħażżien? Pawlu: Għax dejjem iħajjar lil sħabu jigdbu u jidħlu fl-inkwiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you say that man is a bad influence? Pawlu: Because he always encourages his friends to lie and get into trouble.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么说那个人会把别人带坏？保罗：因为他总是怂恿朋友撒谎、惹麻烦。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tgħid li dak ir-raġel huwa ħażżien?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tgħid li dak ir-raġel huwa ħażżien?
messages.zh: 你为什么说那个人会把别人带坏？
messages.en: Why do you say that man is a bad influence?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dejjem iħajjar lil sħabu jigdbu u jidħlu fl-inkwiet.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dejjem iħajjar lil sħabu jigdbu u jidħlu fl-inkwiet.
messages.zh: 因为他总是怂恿朋友撒谎、惹麻烦。
messages.en: Because he always encourages his friends to lie and get into trouble.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给这个名词配两张人物卡：一位清点库存，一位怂恿朋友做坏事；根据周围动作判断所指角色。

gloss_zh: 面包炉内的储柴空间；储水空腔

teaching_sense.en_definition: A space in a baker's oven used for storing wood, or a cavity used for holding water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指面包师烤炉内用来存放木柴的空间，也可指用于储水的空腔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spazju fil-forn tal-furnar fejn jinżamm il-ħatab, jew ħofra fejn jinżamm l-ilma.

sense_translations.en_definition: storage space for wood in a baker's oven
sense_translations.zh_definition: 面包师烤炉内用于存放木柴的空间
用于储存水的空腔

formal.mt: Il-furnar poġġa l-ħatab fil-ħażżiena tal-forn qabel beda jaħmi l-ħobż.
formal.en: The baker put the wood in the oven's storage space before he began baking the bread.
formal.zh: 面包师开始烤面包前，把木柴放进了烤炉的储柴空间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn jinżamm l-ilma? Pawlu: F'din il-ħażżiena taħt l-art.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the water stored? Pawlu: In this storage cavity underground.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：水储存在哪里？保罗：储存在地下的这个储水空腔里。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 水储存在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the water stored?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (向导)
messages.zh: 储存在地下的这个储水空腔里。
messages.en: In this storage cavity underground.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个义项画成两幅储物图：炉内小空间放木柴，地下空腔存清水；共同记住“存放东西的空间”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing something to become corrupt or to rot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容会引起腐败、腐化或腐烂的事物或因素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jikkawża l-korruzzjoni jew it-taħsir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 导致腐败或腐烂的

collocations.en: a factor causing corruption or rot
collocations.zh: 导致腐败或腐烂的因素

collocations.en: an effect that causes corruption or rot
collocations.zh: 引起腐败或腐烂的作用

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi dan l-effett bħala ħażżieni għax iwassal għat-taħsir tal-materjal.
formal.en: The author describes this effect as rot-causing because it leads to the decay of the material.
formal.zh: 作者把这种作用描述为会导致腐烂的作用，因为它会引起材料腐坏。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex sejjaħtlu fattur ħażżieni? Pawlu: Għax iġiegħel il-materjal jitħassar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you call it a rot-causing factor? Pawlu: Because it makes the material decay.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么说它是导致腐烂的因素？保罗：因为它会使材料腐坏。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么说它是导致腐烂的因素？
messages.en: Why did you call it a rot-causing factor?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 因为它会使材料腐坏。
messages.en: Because it makes the material decay.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时画一条因果箭头：某种因素指向腐败或腐烂。这个形容词强调“导致变坏”，而非仅描述已经坏了。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who seizes or holds something very tightly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指用很大的力气抓住或紧握某物的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taqbad xi ħaġa b'saħħa kbira u żżommha ssikkata.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who seizes sth. very tightly
sense_translations.zh_definition: 紧紧抓住某物的人

collocations.en: someone who grips the rope very tightly
a tight gripper who will not let go

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel huwa deskritt bħala ħażżieq għax iżomm il-ħabel b'saħħa kbira u ma jitilqux.
formal.en: In the story, the boy is described as a tight gripper because he holds the rope very firmly and does not let go.
formal.zh: 故事把这个男孩描述为紧抓不放的人，因为他用力握住绳子，不肯松手。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm qed iżżommha ssikkata dik il-ballun! Pawlu: Illum jien il-ħażżieq; ħadd mhu se jeħodhieli!
colloquial.en: Maja: You're holding that ball so tightly! Pawlu: Today I'm the tight gripper; nobody is going to take it from me!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你把那个球抓得真紧！保罗：今天我就是那个紧抓不放的人，谁也别想拿走我的球！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm qed iżżommha ssikkata dik il-ballun!
messages.mt_standard: Kemm qed iżżommha ssikkata dik il-ballun!
messages.zh: 你把那个球抓得真紧！
messages.en: You're holding that ball so tightly!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum jien il-ħażżieq; ħadd mhu se jeħodhieli!
messages.mt_standard: Illum jien il-ħażżieq; ħadd mhu se jeħodhieli!
messages.zh: 今天我就是那个紧抓不放的人，谁也别想拿走我的球！
messages.en: Today I'm the tight gripper; nobody is going to take it from me!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个双手紧握绳子、怎么也不松手的人，把这个词和“紧抓者”的人物画面一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bundle of things held together, or an amount that can be held in one hand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指聚拢在一起的一捆东西，也可指一只手能抓住的一把东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadd ta' affarijiet miġbura flimkien, jew kwantità li tista' tinżamm f'id waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一捆；聚拢在一起的一束东西
一把；一只手能抓住的量

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem rabat il-ħatab f'ħażżieqa waħda biex ikun jista' jġorru.
formal.en: The worker tied the firewood into one bundle so that he could carry it.
formal.zh: 工人把木柴扎成一捆，以便搬运。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm ross inżid? Pawlu: Żid ħażżieqa waħda biss; hekk ikun biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Maja: How much rice should I add? Pawlu: Add just one handful; that will be enough.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我要加多少米？保罗：只加一把就够了。

messages.speaker: Maja (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 我要加多少米？
messages.en: How much rice should I add?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żid ħażżieqa waħda biss; hekk ikun biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Żid ħażżieqa waħda biss; hekk ikun biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 只加一把就够了。
messages.en: Add just one handful; that will be enough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张量感图片记忆：绳子扎起来的是“一捆”，手掌抓起来的是“一把”；同一个词联系这两种聚拢的量。

gloss_zh: 爱抓握的；倾向于紧抱的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to grasp things or clasp them closely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容有抓握东西或将东西紧紧抱住的倾向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jaqbad l-affarijiet jew iżommhom magħfusin miegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于抓握或紧抱的

collocations.en: a boy inclined to grasp or clasp things
collocations.zh: 爱抓握或紧抱东西的男孩

collocations.en: a character inclined to grasp or clasp things
collocations.zh: 有抓握或紧抱东西倾向的角色

formal.mt: L-awtriċi tippreżenta karattru ħażżieqi li spiss iżomm l-oġġetti magħfusin ma' sidru.
formal.en: The author presents a character inclined to clasp things, who often holds objects pressed against his chest.
formal.zh: 作者塑造了一个爱紧抱东西的角色，他常常把物品紧紧抱在胸前。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dejjem iżomm l-ors miegħu? Pawlu: Huwa tifel ħażżieqi; iħobb jgħannaq il-ġugarelli.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does he always hold the teddy bear close? Pawlu: He's a boy who likes clasping things; he loves hugging his toys.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他为什么总把泰迪熊抱在身边？保罗：他是个爱紧抱东西的孩子，喜欢抱着玩具。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 他为什么总把泰迪熊抱在身边？
messages.en: Why does he always hold the teddy bear close?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa tifel ħażżieqi; iħobb jgħannaq il-ġugarelli.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa tifel ħażżieqi; iħobb jgħannaq il-ġugarelli.
messages.zh: 他是个爱紧抱东西的孩子，喜欢抱着玩具。
messages.en: He's a boy who likes clasping things; he loves hugging his toys.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象孩子经常把玩具紧抱在胸前，用反复出现的动作记住“爱抓握、爱紧抱”的倾向性形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who scribbles, making untidy writing or casual marks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指随意涂写、乱写乱画或写出潦草字迹的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tikteb jew tħażżeż b'mod mgħaġġel u bla ordni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乱写乱画或写字潦草的人

collocations.en: someone who scribbles in the margins

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ħażżież jimla l-marġni tal-ktieb b'linji u kliem li bilkemm jinqara.
formal.en: In the story, the scribbler fills the book's margins with lines and words that can barely be read.
formal.zh: 故事里，那个乱写乱画的人把书页边缘写满了线条和几乎无法辨认的字。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min mela din il-paġna b'dawn il-linji kollha? Pawlu: Jien il-ħażżież! Kont qed nistenna u bdejt inħażżeż.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who filled this page with all these lines? Pawlu: I'm the scribbler! I was waiting and started scribbling.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁在这一页上画了这么多线？保罗：我就是那个乱画的人！我等着等着就开始随手涂画了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min mela din il-paġna b'dawn il-linji kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Min mela din il-paġna b'dawn il-linji kollha?
messages.zh: 谁在这一页上画了这么多线？
messages.en: Who filled this page with all these lines?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien il-ħażżież! Kont qed nistenna u bdejt inħażżeż.
messages.mt_standard: Jien il-ħażżież! Kont qed nistenna u bdejt inħażżeż.
messages.zh: 我就是那个乱画的人！我等着等着就开始随手涂画了。
messages.en: I'm the scribbler! I was waiting and started scribbling.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词写在一张画满潦草线条的人物卡上：卡片代表“乱写乱画的人”，这样能同时记住词义和名词身份。

gloss_zh: 爱乱写乱画的；倾向于潦草涂写的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to scribble or make untidy written marks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容经常或容易随手涂写、乱写乱画的。
