teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jħażżeż jew jikteb bla ordni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于随手涂写或乱写乱画的

formal.mt: L-istudent ħażżieżi spiss jimla l-ispazji vojta fin-noti tiegħu b'linji u tpinġijiet żgħar.
formal.en: The student who tends to scribble often fills the blank spaces in his notes with lines and small drawings.
formal.zh: 这个爱随手涂写的学生常常在笔记的空白处画满线条和小图案。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm tpinġija fuq kull paġna tiegħek? Pawlu: Jien ħażżieżi; kull meta jkolli pinna f'idi nibda nħażżeż.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is there a drawing on every page of yours? Pawlu: I tend to scribble; whenever I have a pen in my hand, I start scribbling.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的每一页上怎么都有画？保罗：我爱随手涂写，一拿到笔就开始乱写乱画。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm tpinġija fuq kull paġna tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm tpinġija fuq kull paġna tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你的每一页上怎么都有画？
messages.en: Why is there a drawing on every page of yours?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien ħażżieżi; kull meta jkolli pinna f'idi nibda nħażżeż.
messages.mt_standard: Jien ħażżieżi; kull meta jkolli pinna f'idi nibda nħażżeż.
messages.zh: 我爱随手涂写，一拿到笔就开始乱写乱画。
messages.en: I tend to scribble; whenever I have a pen in my hand, I start scribbling.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一个学生每次拿到笔都开始涂画，用“经常这样做”的连续画面记住这个词是在形容习惯倾向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who eats too much or is excessively eager to eat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指吃得过多或过分贪恋食物的人，带有批评或打趣的意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiekol iżżejjed jew tkun rgħiba ħafna għall-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贪吃的人；贪食者

collocations.zh: 像贪食者一样吃个不停

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ħażżuq jiekol kważi l-ikel kollu u ftit iħalli għall-mistednin l-oħra.
formal.en: In the story, the glutton eats almost all the food and leaves little for the other guests.
formal.zh: 故事里，那个贪食者几乎吃光了所有食物，只给其他客人留下很少一点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħallejt xi kejk għalina? Pawlu: Iva, tinkwetax! M'iniex ħażżuq; ħadt biċċa waħda biss.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you leave any cake for us? Pawlu: Yes, don't worry! I'm not a glutton; I only took one slice.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你给我们留蛋糕了吗？保罗：留了，放心吧！我又不是贪吃鬼，只拿了一块。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你给我们留蛋糕了吗？
messages.en: Did you leave any cake for us?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tinkwetax! M'iniex ħażżuq; ħadt biċċa waħda biss.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tinkwetax! M'iniex ħażżuq; ħadt biċċa waħda biss.
messages.zh: 留了，放心吧！我又不是贪吃鬼，只拿了一块。
messages.en: Yes, don't worry! I'm not a glutton; I only took one slice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象聚餐时一个人不停添盘、差点吃光整桌食物，把夸张画面与“贪食者、大馋鬼”联系起来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A young friend; a diminutive form of 'ħabib'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 年幼的朋友、小朋友；是 ħabib 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħabib żgħir; forma diminuttiva ta' 'ħabib'.

sense_translations.en_definition: a young friend (the diminutive form of 'ħabib')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 年幼的朋友、小朋友（ħabib 的指小形式）

formal.mt: It-tifel kiteb ittra qasira lill-ħbejjeb tiegħu.
formal.en: The boy wrote a short letter to his young friend.
formal.zh: 男孩给他的小朋友写了一封短信。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak it-tifel? Mark: Dak hu l-ħbejjeb tiegħi mill-iskola.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that boy? Mark: That's my young friend from school.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个男孩是谁？马克：他是我在学校认识的小朋友。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个男孩是谁？
messages.en: Who is that boy?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他是我在学校认识的小朋友。
messages.en: That's my young friend from school.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħabib 想成“朋友”，再给朋友画一个小书包，用“小朋友”的画面记住指小形式 ħbejjeb。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short rope; a diminutive form of 'ħabel'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一段短绳、小绳子；是 ħabel 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħabel qasir; forma diminuttiva ta' 'ħabel'.

sense_translations.en_definition: a short rope (the diminutive form of 'ħabel')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 短绳、小绳子（ħabel 的指小形式）

collocations.en: to tie with a short rope

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem uża ħbejjel biex jorbot il-pakkett.
formal.en: The worker used a short rope to tie the parcel.
formal.zh: 工人用一根短绳捆住包裹。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek ħbejjel biex norbot dan il-pakkett? Pawlu: Iva, hemm wieħed fil-kexxun.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have a short rope so I can tie this parcel? Pawlu: Yes, there's one in the drawer.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你有短绳吗？我想捆一下这个包裹。保罗：有，抽屉里有一根。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek ħbejjel biex norbot dan il-pakkett?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek ħbejjel biex norbot dan il-pakkett?
messages.zh: 你有短绳吗？我想捆一下这个包裹。
messages.en: Do you have a short rope so I can tie this parcel?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 有，抽屉里有一根。
messages.en: Yes, there's one in the drawer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħabel 的长绳画成一小段，用“短绳捆小包裹”的画面记住 ħbejjel，不要与表示小朋友的 ħbejjeb 混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small loaf of bread; a diminutive form of 'ħobża'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个小面包或一小条面包；是 ħobża 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħobża żgħira; forma diminuttiva ta' 'ħobża'.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small loaf (the diminutive form of 'ħobża')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小面包、小条面包（ħobża 的指小形式）

formal.mt: Kull tifel ingħata ħbejża friska mal-ikla.
formal.en: Each child was given a fresh small loaf with the meal.
formal.zh: 每个孩子用餐时都分到了一个新鲜的小面包。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nista' nieħu ħbejża friska, jekk jogħġbok? Rita: Żgur, tridha f'borża?
colloquial.en: Mark: Could I have a fresh small loaf, please? Rita: Of course. Would you like it in a bag?
colloquial.zh: 马克：请给我一个新鲜的小面包，好吗？丽塔：当然，要装进袋子里吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nieħu ħbejża friska, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nieħu ħbejża friska, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.zh: 请给我一个新鲜的小面包，好吗？
messages.en: Could I have a fresh small loaf, please?

messages.speaker: Rita (面包店店员)
messages.zh: 当然，要装进袋子里吗？
messages.en: Of course. Would you like it in a bag?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħobża 的面包缩小到手掌大小，旁边写上 ħbejża；连同 friska 一起记成“新鲜的小面包”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state or period of being pregnant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 怀孕的状态或时期，即妊娠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat jew iż-żmien li fih mara tkun tqila.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 怀孕；妊娠

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi l-bidliet fil-ġisem matul il-ħbiela.
formal.en: The text describes changes in the body during pregnancy.
formal.zh: 这篇文字描述了怀孕期间身体的变化。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-kelma 'ħbiela' xi tfisser? Pawlu: Tfisser tqala, jiġifieri ż-żmien meta mara tkun tqila.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does this word 'ħbiela' mean? Pawlu: It means pregnancy, the period when a woman is pregnant.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：ħbiela 这个词是什么意思？保罗：意思是怀孕，也就是女性处于妊娠状态的时期。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: ħbiela 这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does this word 'ħbiela' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser tqala, jiġifieri ż-żmien meta mara tkun tqila.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser tqala, jiġifieri ż-żmien meta mara tkun tqila.
messages.zh: 意思是怀孕，也就是女性处于妊娠状态的时期。
messages.en: It means pregnancy, the period when a woman is pregnant.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ħbiela 配一张标有“妊娠期”的日历，重点记住怀孕的状态和持续时期，并与表示使之怀孕的 ħbil 区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of causing a woman or female animal to become pregnant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使女性或雌性动物怀孕的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih mara jew annimal femminili titwassal biex toħroġ tqila.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使怀孕；使受孕的行为或过程

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jiddeskrivi l-ħbil fl-annimali u l-bidu tat-tqala.
formal.en: The chapter describes impregnation in animals and the beginning of pregnancy.
formal.zh: 本章描述了使动物受孕的过程以及妊娠的开始。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'ħbil' f'dan it-test? Mark: Ifisser il-proċess li bih mara jew annimal femminili titwassal biex toħroġ tqila.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'ħbil' mean in this text? Mark: It means the process of causing a woman or female animal to become pregnant.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这篇文字里的 ħbil 是什么意思？马克：它指使女性或雌性动物怀孕的过程。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文字里的 ħbil 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ħbil' mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser il-proċess li bih mara jew annimal femminili titwassal biex toħroġ tqila.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser il-proċess li bih mara jew annimal femminili titwassal biex toħroġ tqila.
messages.zh: 它指使女性或雌性动物怀孕的过程。
messages.en: It means the process of causing a woman or female animal to become pregnant.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用箭头表示“使之怀孕”，在箭头上写 ħbil；再把怀孕期间标为 ħbiela，借图区分行为过程与妊娠状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or state of being confined in prison.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被关押在监狱中的行为或状态，即监禁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew l-istat li persuna tinżamm fil-ħabs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 监禁；关押

formal.mt: Il-qorti imponiet sentenza ta' sitt xhur ħbis.
formal.en: The court imposed a sentence of six months' imprisonment.
formal.zh: 法院判处了六个月监禁。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fl-aħbar semme ta' ħbis jew multa? Pawlu: Semme ta' sitt xhur ħbis.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did the news report mention imprisonment or a fine? Pawlu: It mentioned six months' imprisonment.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：新闻里说的是监禁还是罚款？保罗：说的是六个月监禁。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-aħbar semme ta' ħbis jew multa?
messages.mt_standard: Fl-aħbar semme ta' ħbis jew multa?
messages.zh: 新闻里说的是监禁还是罚款？
messages.en: Did the news report mention imprisonment or a fine?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 说的是六个月监禁。
messages.en: It mentioned six months' imprisonment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象判决书上写着“六个月监禁”，把 sitt xhur ħbis 整块记忆，突出 ħbis 表示被关押的处罚或状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of hitting or knocking; also, the occurrence of an event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 击打或敲击的行为；也可表示事件的发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tolqot jew tħabbat; ukoll, il-fatt li sseħħ ġrajja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 击打；敲击
事件的发生

formal.mt: Il-ħbit fuq il-bieb waqqaf il-laqgħa għal ftit mumenti.
formal.en: The knocking on the door interrupted the meeting for a few moments.
formal.zh: 敲门声使会议短暂中断。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt dak il-ħbit fuq il-bieb? Mark: Iva, sejjer niftaħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear that knocking on the door? Mark: Yes, I'm going to open it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听见刚才的敲门声了吗？马克：听见了，我去开门。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你听见刚才的敲门声了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that knocking on the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 听见了，我去开门。
messages.en: Yes, I'm going to open it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ħbit 画两张义项卡：一张是手敲门，记“击打、敲击”；另一张是事件发生的时间点，记“事件的发生”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Kind and pleasant toward other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 待人亲切友善、让人感到容易相处的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġib ruħu b'ġentilezza u b'qalb tajba ma' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 友好的；友善的；待人亲切的

formal.mt: Il-gwida kien ħbubi ħafna u wieġeb il-mistoqsijiet kollha tal-viżitaturi.
formal.en: The guide was very friendly and answered all the visitors' questions.
formal.zh: 导游十分友善，回答了游客的所有问题。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif kien il-wejter? Pawlu: Kien ħbubi ħafna u għenna nagħżlu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What was the waiter like? Pawlu: He was very friendly and helped us choose.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那个服务员怎么样？保罗：他很亲切，还帮我们挑选。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个服务员怎么样？
messages.en: What was the waiter like?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien ħbubi ħafna u għenna nagħżlu.
messages.mt_standard: Kien ħbubi ħafna u għenna nagħżlu.
messages.zh: 他很亲切，还帮我们挑选。
messages.en: He was very friendly and helped us choose.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位微笑着帮你点餐的服务员，把 wejter ħbubi 连起来记，提醒自己 ħbubi 描写友善的态度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Affection or love for someone; also, the friendly bond between people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人的爱与关怀；也指人与人之间的友谊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imħabba jew affezzjoni lejn xi ħadd; ukoll ir-rabta ta' ħbiberija bejn in-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱；对某人的深厚感情与关怀。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Imħabba jew affezzjoni lejn xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 友谊；朋友之间的亲近关系。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rabta ta' ħbiberija bejn persuni.

formal.mt: Il-proġett tal-komunità saħħaħ il-ħbubija bejn il-ġirien permezz ta' laqgħat u attivitajiet komuni.
formal.en: The community project strengthened friendship between neighbours through meetings and shared activities.
formal.zh: 社区项目通过聚会和共同活动增进了邻里之间的友谊。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek titkellem ma' Lara kuljum? Mark: Iva, il-ħbubija tagħna baqgħet qawwija minkejja d-distanza.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you still talk to Lara every day? Mark: Yes, our friendship has stayed strong despite the distance.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还每天和拉拉聊天吗？马克：是啊，虽然相隔很远，我们的友谊依然深厚。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还每天和拉拉聊天吗？
messages.en: Do you still talk to Lara every day?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-ħbubija tagħna baqgħet qawwija minkejja d-distanza.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-ħbubija tagħna baqgħet qawwija minkejja d-distanza.
messages.zh: 是啊，虽然相隔很远，我们的友谊依然深厚。
messages.en: Yes, our friendship has stayed strong despite the distance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象家人互相关爱、朋友彼此牵挂的两幅画面，把这个词同时联系到爱与友谊。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a slight green colour or a greenish tint.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 颜色略微发绿或带有绿色色调的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu lewn kemxejn aħdar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 微绿的；略带绿色色调的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ta' lewn kemxejn aħdar.

formal.mt: Il-ħġieġ tal-vażun għandu lewn ħdajjar li jidher aktar ċar fid-dawl naturali.
formal.en: The glass of the vase has a greenish tint that is more noticeable in natural light.
formal.zh: 花瓶的玻璃略带绿色，这种色调在自然光下更明显。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-ħġieġ jidher blu lilek? Pawlu: Le, għalija jidher ħdajjar, speċjalment ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this glass look blue to you? Pawlu: No, it looks greenish to me, especially near the window.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你觉得这块玻璃看起来是蓝色的吗？保罗：不是，我觉得它有点发绿，尤其是在窗边。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 你觉得这块玻璃看起来是蓝色的吗？
messages.en: Does this glass look blue to you?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għalija jidher ħdajjar, speċjalment ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għalija jidher ħdajjar, speċjalment ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 不是，我觉得它有点发绿，尤其是在窗边。
messages.en: No, it looks greenish to me, especially near the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象透明玻璃上淡淡的一层绿色，重点记住是略微发绿，而非鲜明的纯绿色。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small breast or bosom; also, a small quantity that can be carried in one's arms.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小小的胸脯或胸怀；也指可以用双臂抱住的一小份东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sider jew ħodon żgħir; ukoll kwantità żgħira li wieħed jista' jġorr f'dirgħajh.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small breast or bosom (the diminutive form of 'ħodon'
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小胸脯或小胸怀；是 ħodon 的指小形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sider jew ħodon żgħir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一小抱；双臂抱住的一小份东西。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kwantità żgħira ta' xi ħaġa li tinġarr f'dirgħajn.

formal.mt: It-tifel ġabar ħdajjen fjuri mill-ġnien u tahom lil ommu bħala rigal.
formal.en: The boy gathered a small armful of flowers from the garden and gave them to his mother as a gift.
formal.zh: 男孩从花园里采了一小抱鲜花，作为礼物送给母亲。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Iġġibli ftit ħatab minn barra? Ben: Iva, inġiblek ħdajjen ħatab issa.
colloquial.en: Anna: Could you bring me some firewood from outside? Ben: Yes, I'll bring you a small armful now.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：能帮我从外面拿点柴火来吗？本：可以，我现在就给你抱一小抱来。

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.zh: 能帮我从外面拿点柴火来吗？
messages.en: Could you bring me some firewood from outside?

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.zh: 可以，我现在就给你抱一小抱来。
messages.en: Yes, I'll bring you a small armful of firewood now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用双臂在胸前圈出一个小空间，联想小胸怀与胸前抱着的一小抱物品，串起两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 11,000, equal to eleven groups of one thousand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数值11000，即十一个一千，中文读作一万一千。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 11,000, jiġifieri ħdax immultiplikat b'elf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一万一千；数值为11000。
sense_translations.mt_definition: In-numru 11,000.

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport annwali, il-librerija għandha ħdax-il elf ktieb disponibbli għall-qarrejja.
formal.en: According to the annual report, the library has eleven thousand books available to readers.
formal.zh: 根据年度报告，这家图书馆有一万一千本书可供读者借阅。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm tiswa din il-karozza? Rita: Ħdax-il elf ewro, skont ir-reklam.
colloquial.en: Mark: How much does this car cost? Rita: Eleven thousand euros, according to the advert.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这辆车多少钱？丽塔：广告上写的是一万一千欧元。

messages.speaker: Mark (购车者)
messages.zh: 这辆车多少钱？
messages.en: How much does this car cost?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 广告上写的是一万一千欧元。
messages.en: Eleven thousand euros, according to the advert.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想十一组、每组一千，再合成一万一千；把11000写在短语旁边，练习数字与读法对应。

gloss_zh: 瘫痪状态；不能动弹的状态

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of being paralysed or unable to move.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体瘫痪或无法移动、不能动弹的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' paraliżi jew ta' nuqqas ta' ħila li wieħed jiċċaqlaq.

sense_translations.en_definition: the state of being paralysed or immobile
sense_translations.zh_definition: 瘫痪或无法动弹的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' min ikun paralizzat jew ma jkunx jista' jiċċaqlaq.

collocations.en: paralysis or immobility of the legs
collocations.zh: 双腿瘫痪或不能活动的状态

collocations.en: a state of paralysis or immobility
collocations.zh: 瘫痪或不能动弹的状态

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ħdil tar-riġlejn ma jħallix lill-karattru jimxi mingħajr għajnuna.
formal.en: In the story, the immobility of the character's legs prevents him from walking without assistance.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这个人物因双腿不能活动，无法在无人帮助的情况下行走。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser 'ħdil' f'din is-sentenza? Pawlu: Ifisser stat li fih persuna ma tkunx tista' tiċċaqlaq.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'ħdil' mean in this sentence? Pawlu: It means a state in which a person cannot move.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这句话里的 ħdil 是什么意思？保罗：指一个人不能动弹的状态。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 ħdil 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ħdil' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser stat li fih persuna ma tkunx tista' tiċċaqlaq.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser stat li fih persuna ma tkunx tista' tiċċaqlaq.
messages.zh: 指一个人不能动弹的状态。
messages.en: It means a state in which a person cannot move.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词配上一幅身体无法移动的定格画面，记住它表示不能动弹的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Work or activity carried out to accomplish something; in a separate sense, deception.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为完成某事而进行的工作或活动；另一个义项指欺骗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xogħol jew attività biex jitwettaq xi ħaġa; f'sens ieħor, qerq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 工作；为完成任务而进行的劳动或活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xogħol jew attività li ssir biex jitwettaq xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欺骗；使他人受蒙蔽的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qerq li bih wieħed iqarraq b'xi ħadd.

formal.mt: Il-ħdim fuq il-proġett jitlob paċenzja, koordinazzjoni u attenzjoni għad-dettall.
formal.en: Work on the project requires patience, coordination and attention to detail.
formal.zh: 这项项目工作需要耐心、协调和对细节的关注。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-kittieb isejjaħ dan il-pjan 'ħdim'? Toni: Hawn qed juża l-kelma fis-sens ta' qerq, għax il-pjan hu biex iqarraq bin-nies.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why does the writer call this plan 'ħdim'? Toni: Here he is using the word in the sense of deception, because the plan is intended to trick people.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：作者为什么把这个计划叫作 ħdim？托尼：这里用的是欺骗这个义项，因为这个计划是为了骗人。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 作者为什么把这个计划叫作 ħdim？
messages.en: Why does the writer call this plan 'ħdim'?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn qed juża l-kelma fis-sens ta' qerq, għax il-pjan hu biex iqarraq bin-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn qed juża l-kelma fis-sens ta' qerq, għax il-pjan hu biex iqarraq bin-nies.
messages.zh: 这里用的是欺骗这个义项，因为这个计划是为了骗人。
messages.en: Here he is using the word in the sense of deception, because the plan is intended to trick people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做两张情境卡：一张是认真工作，一张是设局骗人；遇到这个词时靠上下文选择对应义项。

gloss_zh: 绿色；草木；内心的苦涩或怨怼

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being green, green vegetation collectively, or bitterness in a person's feelings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呈现绿色的性质或状态；统指绿色草木；也可指情感上的苦涩或怨怼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-lewn aħdar, il-veġetazzjoni ħadra meħuda flimkien, jew imrar fis-sentimenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绿色；呈现绿色的性质或状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' xi ħaġa li tkun ħadra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绿色草木；植被。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjanti u veġetazzjoni ħadra meħuda flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感情上的苦涩、怨怼或不快。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Imrar fis-sentimenti ta' persuna.

formal.mt: Wara x-xita, il-ħdur tal-wied deher aktar frisk u l-mogħdija kienet imdawra bil-pjanti.
formal.en: After the rain, the valley's greenery looked fresher, and plants lined the path.
formal.zh: 雨后，山谷里的草木显得更加清新，小径两侧都是植物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad hemm ħdur f'qalbek wara dik il-kelma li qallek? Mark: Ftit, imma nixtieq nitkellem miegħu u nirranġaw.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is there still bitterness in your heart after what he said to you? Mark: A little, but I'd like to talk to him and make things right.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他说了那句话之后，你心里还觉得怨吗？马克：还有一点，不过我想和他谈谈，把事情说开。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad hemm ħdur f'qalbek wara dik il-kelma li qallek?
messages.mt_standard: Għad hemm ħdur f'qalbek wara dik il-kelma li qallek?
messages.zh: 他说了那句话之后，你心里还觉得怨吗？
messages.en: Is there still bitterness in your heart after what he said to you?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit, imma nixtieq nitkellem miegħu u nirranġaw.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit, imma nixtieq nitkellem miegħu u nirranġaw.
messages.zh: 还有一点，不过我想和他谈谈，把事情说开。
messages.en: A little, but I'd like to talk to him and make things right.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个义项放进三格图：叶子的绿色、山谷的草木、心里的苦涩；这是情境记忆，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 绿色；草木；感情上的苦涩

teaching_sense.en_definition: Greenness as a colour or quality, green plants collectively, or emotional bitterness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 绿色这一颜色或性质；统指绿色植物；也指情感上的苦涩或怨怼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kulur jew il-kwalità ta' dak li hu aħdar, il-pjanti ħodor meħuda flimkien, jew imrar fis-sentimenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绿色；事物呈现绿色的性质。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kulur aħdar jew il-kwalità ta' dak li hu aħdar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绿色植物的总称；草木或植被。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-pjanti ħodor u l-veġetazzjoni meħuda flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 情感上的苦涩、怨怼或不快。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Imrar li persuna tħoss f'qalbha.

formal.mt: Il-ħdurija tal-ġnien tagħti lill-iskola spazju pjaċevoli fejn l-istudenti jistgħu jistrieħu waqt il-brejk.
formal.en: The garden's greenery gives the school a pleasant space where students can rest during their break.
formal.zh: 花园里的绿色草木为学校提供了一处宜人的空间，学生可以在课间到这里休息。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Anna għadha ma tridx tiltaqa' magħhom? Rita: Għad għandha ħdurija f'qalbha wara dak li ġara.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does Anna still refuse to meet them? Rita: She still has bitterness in her heart after what happened.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：安娜为什么还是不愿意见他们？丽塔：发生了那件事之后，她心里还留着怨怼。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Anna għadha ma tridx tiltaqa' magħhom?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Anna għadha ma tridx tiltaqa' magħhom?
messages.zh: 安娜为什么还是不愿意见他们？
messages.en: Why does Anna still refuse to meet them?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad għandha ħdurija f'qalbha wara dak li ġara.
messages.mt_standard: Għad għandha ħdurija f'qalbha wara dak li ġara.
messages.zh: 发生了那件事之后，她心里还留着怨怼。
messages.en: She still has bitterness in her heart after what happened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作三张配图卡，分别写绿颜色、绿色草木、内心苦涩；看到这个词时先判断句子是在写景还是写感受。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Talkative; inclined to speak a lot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 健谈的，爱说话的；形容一个人说话较多。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħobb jitkellem ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 健谈的；爱说话的；话多的

formal.mt: L-istudent kien ħduti ħafna u spiss kien jibda diskussjonijiet fil-klassi.
formal.en: The student was very talkative and often started discussions in class.
formal.zh: 这名学生很健谈，经常在课堂上发起讨论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhu l-ġar il-ġdid? Mark: Ħduti ħafna! Tkellimna għal siegħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's the new neighbour like? Mark: Very talkative! We chatted for an hour.
colloquial.zh: Maja：新邻居怎么样？Mark：特别健谈！我们聊了一个小时。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 新邻居怎么样？
messages.en: What's the new neighbour like?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 特别健谈！我们聊了一个小时。
messages.en: Very talkative! We chatted for an hour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象新邻居一见面就聊上一小时，用这个爱聊天的画面记住 ħduti 表示健谈。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to go mad; also used figuratively for driving someone crazy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人发疯；也可用夸张语气表示把人烦得或逼得快要发疯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġiegħel lil xi ħadd jiġġennen; jista' jintuża wkoll b'mod figurattiv.

sense_translations.en_definition: to cause sb. to go mad
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人发疯；把某人逼疯

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, l-iżolament ħebbel lill-protagonist.
formal.en: In the novel, isolation drove the protagonist mad.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，与世隔绝把主人公逼疯了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-ġar kien irrabjat? Pawlu: Dak l-istorbju ħebbel lill-ġar; dam għaddej il-lejl kollu!
colloquial.en: Lara: Why was the neighbour angry? Pawlu: That noise drove the neighbour crazy; it went on all night!
colloquial.zh: Lara：邻居为什么生气了？Pawlu：那噪声简直把他烦疯了，整夜都没停！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 邻居为什么生气了？
messages.en: Why was the neighbour angry?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak l-istorbju ħebbel lill-ġar; dam għaddej il-lejl kollu!
messages.mt_standard: Dak l-istorbju ħebbel lill-ġar; dam għaddej il-lejl kollu!
messages.zh: 那噪声简直把他烦疯了，整夜都没停！
messages.en: That noise drove the neighbour crazy; it went on all night!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħebbel 记成一个因果画面：噪声是原因，邻居是被逼疯的人；重点记住使别人发疯。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone or something to withdraw or pull back.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人或某物退回、退缩或退出，强调有因素促成撤退。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġiegħel lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa jirtira jew imur lura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使撤回；使退缩；促使退出

collocations.en: caused the group to pull back

formal.mt: Il-periklu ħebbeż lill-grupp, li mbagħad reġa' lura lejn il-kamp.
formal.en: The danger caused the group to withdraw, and it then returned to camp.
formal.zh: 危险迫使小组撤退，随后他们返回了营地。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex il-grupp ma kompliex? Toni: Ir-riħ qawwi ħebbeż lill-grupp. Kulħadd mar lura.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why didn't the group carry on? Toni: The strong wind made the group pull back. Everyone went back.
colloquial.zh: Nina：小组为什么没有继续前进？Toni：大风迫使小组退回去了，大家都往回走了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 小组为什么没有继续前进？
messages.en: Why didn't the group carry on?

messages.speaker: Toni (徒步同行者)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-riħ qawwi ħebbeż lill-grupp. Kulħadd mar lura.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-riħ qawwi ħebbeż lill-grupp. Kulħadd mar lura.
messages.zh: 大风迫使小组退回去了，大家都往回走了。
messages.en: The strong wind made the group pull back. Everyone went back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象大风把前进的小组逼回营地：ħebbeż 的记忆重点是某个原因使别人退回。

gloss_zh: 发疯；对不寻常的事物有偏好

teaching_sense.en_definition: To go mad; in another sense, to have a penchant for something unusual.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示发疯；另一义是偏爱某种不寻常的事物，需按语境区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġġennen; f'sens ieħor, kellu ġibda lejn xi ħaġa mhux tas-soltu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发疯；变得精神失常

sense_translations.en_definition: to have a penchant for sth. unusual
sense_translations.zh_definition: 偏爱某种不寻常的事物；对不同寻常的东西有特别的爱好

formal.mt: Fl-aħħar tar-rakkont, ir-raġel ħebel u ma baqax jagħraf lil sħabu.
formal.en: At the end of the story, the man went mad and no longer recognised his friends.
formal.zh: 故事结尾，那个男人发疯了，再也认不出自己的朋友。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ġara lir-raġel fl-aħħar tal-ktieb? Ben: Ħebel. Ma baqax jagħraf lil ħadd.
colloquial.en: Sara: What happened to the man at the end of the book? Ben: He went mad. He no longer recognised anyone.
colloquial.zh: Sara：书的结尾，那个男人怎么了？Ben：他发疯了，谁都认不出来了。

messages.speaker: Sara (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 书的结尾，那个男人怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the man at the end of the book?

messages.speaker: Ben (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħebel. Ma baqax jagħraf lil ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Ħebel. Ma baqax jagħraf lil ħadd.
messages.zh: 他发疯了，谁都认不出来了。
messages.en: He went mad. He no longer recognised anyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张意义卡记 ħebel：一张是人物发疯，另一张是特别偏爱稀奇事物；读句子时先判断语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To withdraw or pull back from a place or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从某个位置或处境中退回、撤退或退出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Irtira jew mar lura minn post jew minn sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 退回；撤退；退出

formal.mt: Meta ra l-periklu, il-gwardjan ħebeż lura lejn il-bini.
formal.en: When he saw the danger, the guard withdrew towards the building.
formal.zh: 警卫看到危险后，向建筑物方向退去。

colloquial.mt: Emma: X'għamel Mark meta ra l-kelb? Luqa: Ħebeż lura u għalaq il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Emma: What did Mark do when he saw the dog? Luqa: He pulled back and closed the door.
colloquial.zh: Emma：Mark 看到那只狗时做了什么？Luqa：他往后退了退，把门关上了。

messages.speaker: Emma (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 看到那只狗时做了什么？
messages.en: What did Mark do when he saw the dog?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 他往后退了退，把门关上了。
messages.en: He pulled back and closed the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħebeż 配上看见危险后向后退的动作；与 ħebbeż 对照，前者是退回，后者是使别人退回。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To flicker, used of flames that vary unsteadily in brightness or movement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指火焰忽明忽暗地闪动或摇曳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża għan-nar meta l-fjammi jiċċaqalqu u d-dawl tagħhom ivarja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闪烁；摇曳，用于形容火焰

formal.mt: In-nar ħebħeb fil-fuklar u tefa' dellijiet fuq il-ħajt.
formal.en: The fire flickered in the fireplace and cast shadows on the wall.
formal.zh: 炉中的火焰摇曳，在墙上投下影子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt in-nar meta ftaħna t-tieqa? Mark: Iva, ħebħeb hekk kif daħal ir-riħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see the fire when we opened the window? Mark: Yes, it flickered as soon as the wind came in.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们开窗时，你看到火焰了吗？Mark：看到了，风一进来，火焰就摇曳起来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们开窗时，你看到火焰了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the fire when we opened the window?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħebħeb hekk kif daħal ir-riħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħebħeb hekk kif daħal ir-riħ.
messages.zh: 看到了，风一进来，火焰就摇曳起来。
messages.en: Yes, it flickered as soon as the wind came in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 朗读 ħebħeb 时想象火焰一闪一闪地晃动，把词形与火光摇曳的画面一起记住。

gloss_zh: 倦怠；精神不振；无精打采

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lethargy; a state of low energy and little desire to be active.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倦怠、精神不振的状态，表现为缺乏精力、不想活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' nuqqas ta' enerġija u ta' ħeġġa biex wieħed jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倦怠；无精打采；缺乏活力的状态

formal.mt: Wara l-vjaġġ twil, il-passiġġier ħass ħedla kbira u kellu bżonn jistrieħ.
formal.en: After the long journey, the passenger felt very lethargic and needed to rest.
formal.zh: 长途旅行后，这名乘客感到十分倦怠，需要休息。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid toħroġ għal mixja? Ben: Aktar tard. Għandi ħedla kbira llum.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you want to go out for a walk? Ben: Later. I'm feeling very lethargic today.
colloquial.zh: Sara：想出去散步吗？Ben：晚一点吧，我今天特别没精神。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 想出去散步吗？
messages.en: Do you want to go out for a walk?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aktar tard. Għandi ħedla kbira llum.
messages.mt_standard: Aktar tard. Għandi ħedla kbira llum.
messages.zh: 晚一点吧，我今天特别没精神。
messages.en: Later. I'm feeling very lethargic today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħedla 想成身体电量很低、连散步都想推迟的状态，记住它是表示倦怠的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To hollow something out; in another sense, to reduce a workload.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 挖去物体内部，使其成为中空；另一义是减轻工作量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Neħħa minn ġewwa xi ħaġa biex jagħmilha vojta; f'sens ieħor, naqqas l-ammont ta' xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挖空；掏空；使内部成为中空
减少工作量；减轻工作负担

formal.mt: L-artiġjan ħefa zokk biex jagħmel reċipjent tal-injam.
formal.en: The craftsperson hollowed out a log to make a wooden container.
formal.zh: 工匠挖空了一段树干，用来制作木容器。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan ir-reċipjent kif għamlu nannuk? Pawlu: Ħefa zokk u mbagħad xkatla l-wiċċ.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did your grandfather make this container? Pawlu: He hollowed out a log and then sanded the surface.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你爷爷是怎么做出这个容器的？Pawlu：他挖空了一段树干，然后把表面打磨光滑。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爷爷是怎么做出这个容器的？
messages.en: How did your grandfather make this container?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħefa zokk u mbagħad xkatla l-wiċċ.
messages.mt_standard: Ħefa zokk u mbagħad xkatla l-wiċċ.
messages.zh: 他挖空了一段树干，然后把表面打磨光滑。
messages.en: He hollowed out a log and then sanded the surface.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 ħefa：树干内部被挖空，待办任务被减少；分别对应挖空和减轻工作量。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of attacking or physically assaulting someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 攻击或对他人实施身体袭击的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tattakka lil xi ħadd jew tuża vjolenza fiżika kontrih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 攻击；向目标发起攻击的行为。
袭击；对他人实施身体暴力的行为。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-ħejb fuq il-vittma u jsemmi x-xhieda li kienu fil-post.
formal.en: The report describes the assault on the victim and mentions the witnesses who were at the scene.
formal.zh: 报告描述了针对受害者的袭击行为，并提及了当时在场的证人。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'rajt ħdejn il-ħanut? Ġorġ: Rajt ħejb fuq raġel u ċempilt lill-pulizija mill-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Anna: What did you see near the shop? Ġorġ: I saw an assault on a man and called the police immediately.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你在商店附近看到了什么？Ġorġ：我看到一名男子遭到袭击，就立刻报了警。

messages.speaker: Anna (邻居)
messages.zh: 你在商店附近看到了什么？
messages.en: What did you see near the shop?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (目击者)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt ħejb fuq raġel u ċempilt lill-pulizija mill-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Rajt ħejb fuq raġel u ċempilt lill-pulizija mill-ewwel.
messages.zh: 我看到一名男子遭到袭击，就立刻报了警。
messages.en: I saw an assault on a man and called the police immediately.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ħejb放进报告中的事件栏来记：它命名攻击或袭击这件事，学习时先抓住名词的行为意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of restoring vitality, or a revival after a period of decline or inactivity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 重新赋予活力的过程，或经历衰退、沉寂之后的复苏与复兴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li jerġa' jagħti l-ħajja u l-enerġija, jew qawmien mill-ġdid wara żmien ta' tnaqqis jew waqfien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恢复活力；使某事物重新充满生机的过程。
复苏；复兴；沉寂或衰退之后的重新兴盛。

formal.mt: Il-programm jimmira lejn il-ħeji tal-komunità permezz ta' attivitajiet kulturali u spazji ġodda għal-laqgħat.
formal.en: The programme aims to revitalise the community through cultural activities and new meeting spaces.
formal.zh: 该计划旨在通过文化活动和新的聚会空间恢复社区活力。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex qed torganizzaw dawn il-kunċerti? Mario: Irridu ħeji kulturali fir-raħal, biex in-nies jerġgħu jiltaqgħu u jieħdu sehem.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why are you organising these concerts? Mario: We want a cultural revival in the village so that people meet again and take part.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你们为什么组织这些音乐会？Mario：我们希望村里出现文化复兴，让大家重新相聚、参与活动。

messages.speaker: Rita (村民)
messages.zh: 你们为什么组织这些音乐会？
messages.en: Why are you organising these concerts?

messages.speaker: Mario (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Irridu ħeji kulturali fir-raħal, biex in-nies jerġgħu jiltaqgħu u jieħdu sehem.
messages.mt_standard: Irridu ħeji kulturali fir-raħal, biex in-nies jerġgħu jiltaqgħu u jieħdu sehem.
messages.zh: 我们希望村里出现文化复兴，让大家重新相聚、参与活动。
messages.en: We want a cultural revival in the village so that people meet again and take part.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象安静的村庄重新响起音乐、人们再次相聚，用ħeji记住恢复活力的过程和复兴的现象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To attack someone or subject them to a physical assault.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向他人发起攻击，或对其实施身体袭击。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tattakka lil xi ħadd jew tuża vjolenza fiżika kontrih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 攻击；向某个目标发起攻击。
袭击；对他人实施身体暴力。

formal.mt: Skont ix-xhud, ir-raġel ħejjeb fuq il-gwardjan qabel ma waslet il-pulizija.
formal.en: According to the witness, the man assaulted the guard before the police arrived.
formal.zh: 据证人所述，该男子在警方到达之前袭击了警卫。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex ġiet il-pulizija? Samwel: Raġel ħejjeb fuq il-gwardjan, u xi ħadd ċempel għall-għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why did the police come? Samwel: A man assaulted the guard, and someone called for help.
colloquial.zh: Elena：警察为什么来了？Samwel：一名男子袭击了警卫，有人打电话求助。

messages.speaker: Elena (顾客)
messages.zh: 警察为什么来了？
messages.en: Why did the police come?

messages.speaker: Samwel (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Raġel ħejjeb fuq il-gwardjan, u xi ħadd ċempel għall-għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Raġel ħejjeb fuq il-gwardjan, u xi ħadd ċempel għall-għajnuna.
messages.zh: 一名男子袭击了警卫，有人打电话求助。
messages.en: A man assaulted the guard, and someone called for help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用短句ħejjeb fuq il-gwardjan记住动作和对象：有人发动袭击，警卫是受袭者，整句帮助记忆动词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who attacks someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向他人发动攻击的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tattakka lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 攻击他人的人；袭击者。

formal.mt: Ix-xhud iddeskriva lill-ħejjieb u spjega kif bdiet il-ġlieda.
formal.en: The witness described the attacker and explained how the fight began.
formal.zh: 证人描述了袭击者，并说明了打斗是如何开始的。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Rajt lill-ħejjieb? Pawlu: Iva, imma tlaqt minn hemm biex ma nweġġax.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did you see the attacker? Pawlu: Yes, but I left the area so I wouldn't get hurt.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你看见袭击者了吗？Pawlu：看见了，但我离开了那里，免得受伤。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看见袭击者了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the attacker?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma tlaqt minn hemm biex ma nweġġax.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma tlaqt minn hemm biex ma nweġġax.
messages.zh: 看见了，但我离开了那里，免得受伤。
messages.en: Yes, but I left the area so I wouldn't get hurt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħejjieb 放进目击袭击的画面，记住它指发动攻击的那个人。

gloss_zh: 准备攻击的；蓄势待攻的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ready to launch an attack.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已做好准备、随时可能发动攻击的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab lest biex jattakka.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 准备发动攻击的；蓄势待攻的。

formal.mt: Il-kelb deher ħejjiebi, għalhekk il-gwardjan żamm lin-nies 'il bogħod minnu.
formal.en: The dog appeared ready to attack, so the guard kept people away from it.
formal.zh: 那只狗看起来随时准备攻击，因此警卫让人们远离它。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma tersaqx lejn il-kelb? Mark: Jidher ħejjiebi; aħjar nibqgħu hawn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why won't you go near the dog? Mark: It looks ready to attack; we'd better stay here.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么不靠近那只狗？Mark：它看起来准备攻击了；我们最好待在这里。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么不靠近那只狗？
messages.en: Why won't you go near the dog?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 它看起来准备攻击了；我们最好待在这里。
messages.en: It looks ready to attack; we'd better stay here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只绷紧身体、正要扑来的狗，用 ħejjiebi 描述它准备攻击的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who indulges someone else's whims or spoils them with excessive attention or concessions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 顺着别人的任性要求，或因过度迁就、宠爱而把对方惯坏的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taqta' kull kapriċċ ta' ħaddieħor jew tfissdu b'attenzjoni u konċessjonijiet żejda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一味顺从他人任性要求的人。
过度宠爱、迁就他人而使其被惯坏的人；溺爱者。

collocations.en: the role of the person who indulges others

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-missier huwa ħejjiem li jaċċetta kull xewqa ta' ibnu mingħajr ma jistabbilixxi limiti.
formal.en: In the story, the father is an indulger who accepts his son's every wish without setting limits.
formal.zh: 故事中的父亲是个溺爱者，对儿子的每个愿望都一味答应，不设限度。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Terġa' tixtrilu ġugarell għax qed jibki? Toni: Għandek raġun, qed inkun ħejjiem; irrid nitgħallem ngħid le.
colloquial.en: Rita: Are you buying him another toy because he's crying? Toni: You're right, I'm being an indulger; I need to learn to say no.
colloquial.zh: Rita：就因为他哭，你又要给他买玩具吗？Toni：你说得对，我太惯着他了；我得学会说不。

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Terġa' tixtrilu ġugarell għax qed jibki?
messages.mt_standard: Terġa' tixtrilu ġugarell għax qed jibki?
messages.zh: 就因为他哭，你又要给他买玩具吗？
messages.en: Are you buying him another toy because he's crying?

messages.speaker: Toni (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun, qed inkun ħejjiem; irrid nitgħallem ngħid le.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun, qed inkun ħejjiem; irrid nitgħallem ngħid le.
messages.zh: 你说得对，我太惯着他了；我得学会说不。
messages.en: You're right, I'm being an indulger; I need to learn to say no.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个总说“好好好”的大人，ħejjiem 指主动迁就、宠坏别人的人。

gloss_zh: 被宠坏的人；惯于受宠爱的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who is spoiled or accustomed to being indulged or caressed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被宠坏的人，或习惯了被迁就、被爱抚的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna mfissda jew imdorrija li jaqtgħulha x-xewqat jew iżiegħlu biha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被宠坏的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who is used to being indulged or caressed
sense_translations.zh_definition: 习惯了被迁就、被宠爱或被爱抚的人。

collocations.en: the behavior of a spoiled person
a pampered person accustomed to attention
collocations.zh: 习惯受人关注的娇宠者

formal.mt: Il-karattru prinċipali huwa ħejjum li jsibha diffiċli jaċċetta li mhux kull xewqa tiegħu tista' tinqata'.
formal.en: The main character is a spoiled person who finds it difficult to accept that not every wish of his can be granted.
formal.zh: 主人公是个被宠坏的人，很难接受自己的愿望并非个个都能得到满足。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Leo rrabja għax ma għażilniex il-logħba tiegħu. Samwel: Hu ħejjum; imdorri li dejjem nagħmlu kif irid hu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Leo got angry because we didn't choose his game. Samwel: He's spoiled; he's used to us always doing what he wants.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我们没选 Leo 想玩的游戏，他就生气了。Samwel：他被宠坏了；他习惯了我们总是顺着他的意思。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Leo rrabja għax ma għażilniex il-logħba tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Leo rrabja għax ma għażilniex il-logħba tiegħu.
messages.zh: 我们没选 Leo 想玩的游戏，他就生气了。
messages.en: Leo got angry because we didn't choose his game.

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu ħejjum; imdorri li dejjem nagħmlu kif irid hu.
messages.mt_standard: Hu ħejjum; imdorri li dejjem nagħmlu kif irid hu.
messages.zh: 他被宠坏了；他习惯了我们总是顺着他的意思。
messages.en: He's spoiled; he's used to us always doing what he wants.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħejjum 想成坐等别人哄的人，记住它指接受宠爱、习惯被迁就的一方。

gloss_zh: 娇惯；溺爱；被宠坏的状态

teaching_sense.en_definition: Indulgence or spoiling, or the state of being spoiled.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对人的娇惯、溺爱，也指一个人被宠坏的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tfissid ta' persuna, jew il-qagħda ta' min ikun imdorri li jaqtgħulu kull xewqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 娇惯；溺爱；过度迁就。
被宠坏的状态；娇惯养成的习性。

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont juri kif il-ħejm żejjed jagħmilha diffiċli għall-protagonist li jaċċetta ċ-ċaħda.
formal.en: The story shows how excessive indulgence makes it difficult for the protagonist to accept refusal.
formal.zh: 故事展示了过度娇惯如何使主人公难以接受拒绝。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex jippretendi rigal kull darba li noħorġu? David: Dan ġej mill-ħejm; dejjem xtrajna xi ħaġa biex nikkuntentawh.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why does he expect a present every time we go out? David: It comes from being spoiled; we've always bought something to please him.
colloquial.zh: Anna：为什么我们每次出门，他都指望得到礼物？David：这是娇惯出来的；我们过去总买点东西哄他开心。

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex jippretendi rigal kull darba li noħorġu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex jippretendi rigal kull darba li noħorġu?
messages.zh: 为什么我们每次出门，他都指望得到礼物？
messages.en: Why does he expect a present every time we go out?

messages.speaker: David (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ġej mill-ħejm; dejjem xtrajna xi ħaġa biex nikkuntentawh.
messages.mt_standard: Dan ġej mill-ħejm; dejjem xtrajna xi ħaġa biex nikkuntentawh.
messages.zh: 这是娇惯出来的；我们过去总买点东西哄他开心。
messages.en: It comes from being spoiled; we've always bought something to please him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“娇惯这件事、娇惯后的状态”来记 ħejm，把它作为抽象名词掌握。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fenugreek, a plant whose leaves and seeds are used in cooking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 胡芦巴，一种叶片和种子可用于烹饪的植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta li l-weraq u ż-żrieragħ tagħha jintużaw fit-tisjir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胡芦巴。

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob kuċċarina żrieragħ tal-ħelba, li jiżdiedu mat-taħlita tal-ħwawar.
formal.en: The recipe calls for a teaspoon of fenugreek seeds, which are added to the spice mixture.
formal.zh: 食谱要求取一茶匙胡芦巴籽，加入香料混合物中。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għandek żrieragħ tal-ħelba? Ġużeppi: Iva, qegħdin f'dan il-vażett ħdejn il-kemmun.
colloquial.en: Marta: Do you have fenugreek seeds? Ġużeppi: Yes, they're in this jar next to the cumin.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你有胡芦巴籽吗？Ġużeppi：有，在孜然旁边的这个罐子里。

messages.speaker: Marta (顾客)
messages.zh: 你有胡芦巴籽吗？
messages.en: Do you have fenugreek seeds?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qegħdin f'dan il-vażett ħdejn il-kemmun.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qegħdin f'dan il-vażett ħdejn il-kemmun.
messages.zh: 有，在孜然旁边的这个罐子里。
messages.en: Yes, they're in this jar next to the cumin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象厨房香料罐贴着 ħelba 标签，再把罐中的胡芦巴籽与词形一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove the husks or shells from something, such as nuts or seeds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 去除坚果、种子等物的外壳或外皮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Neħħa l-qoxra minn ġewż, żrieragħ jew affarijiet simili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 去除外皮或外壳；脱壳。

formal.mt: Il-kok ħellef il-ġewż u mbagħad qatta' l-qlub f'biċċiet żgħar.
formal.en: The cook shelled the walnuts and then chopped the kernels into small pieces.
formal.zh: 厨师给核桃去壳，然后把核桃仁切成小块。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Pawlu ħellef il-lewż diġà? Rita: Iva, ħellef il-lewż kollu u poġġieh fl-iskutella.
colloquial.en: Elena: Has Pawlu shelled the almonds already? Rita: Yes, he shelled all the almonds and put them in the bowl.
colloquial.zh: Elena：Pawlu 已经给杏仁去壳了吗？Rita：是的，他把杏仁全都去壳了，放在碗里。

messages.speaker: Elena (家人)
messages.zh: Pawlu 已经给杏仁去壳了吗？
messages.en: Has Pawlu shelled the almonds already?

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħellef il-lewż kollu u poġġieh fl-iskutella.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħellef il-lewż kollu u poġġieh fl-iskutella.
messages.zh: 是的，他把杏仁全都去壳了，放在碗里。
messages.en: Yes, he shelled all the almonds and put them in the bowl.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把核桃硬壳剥开、只留下果仁的动作，用 ħellef 记住“去壳”。

gloss_zh: 使人解脱的；能赋予自由的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Giving freedom or relief from constraints, or capable of granting freedom.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人获得自由、摆脱束缚的，或具有赋予自由的能力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jeħles lil xi ħadd minn rabtiet jew li jista' jagħtih il-libertà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人获得自由的；使人摆脱束缚、感到解脱的。
能够赋予自由的；具有使人自由的能力的。

collocations.en: a power capable of granting freedom

formal.mt: L-awtur jenfasizza l-poter ħelliesi tal-edukazzjoni, li tgħin lill-persuna tagħmel għażliet indipendenti.
formal.en: The author emphasizes the liberating power of education, which helps a person make independent choices.
formal.zh: 作者强调教育使人获得自由的力量，因为教育帮助个人作出独立选择。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif ħassejtek meta fl-aħħar għedt dak li taħseb? Daniel: Kelli ħafna biża', imma li nitkellem kellu effett ħelliesi fuqi.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did you feel when you finally said what you thought? Daniel: I was very afraid, but speaking had a liberating effect on me.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你终于说出自己的想法时，感觉怎么样？Daniel：我当时很害怕，但说出来让我感到解脱。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ħassejtek meta fl-aħħar għedt dak li taħseb?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ħassejtek meta fl-aħħar għedt dak li taħseb?
messages.zh: 你终于说出自己的想法时，感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How did you feel when you finally said what you thought?

messages.speaker: Daniel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kelli ħafna biża', imma li nitkellem kellu effett ħelliesi fuqi.
messages.mt_standard: Kelli ħafna biża', imma li nitkellem kellu effett ħelliesi fuqi.
messages.zh: 我当时很害怕，但说出来让我感到解脱。
messages.en: I was very afraid, but speaking had a liberating effect on me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象束缚松开后终于能自由呼吸，用 ħelliesi 描述带来自由或解脱的事物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A greeting used when meeting someone or beginning a conversation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 见面或开始交谈时使用的招呼语，相当于“你好”或“喂”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tislima li tintuża meta tiltaqa' ma' xi ħadd jew tibda konverżazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 你好；喂，用于打招呼。

formal.mt: Fil-bidu tad-djalogu, il-karattru jsellem lil ħabibu bil-kelma 'ħelow'.
formal.en: At the beginning of the dialogue, the character greets his friend with the word 'hello'.
formal.zh: 在对话开头，这个人物用“ħelow”一词向朋友打招呼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħelow, Mark! Kif int? Mark: Tajjeb, grazzi! U int?
colloquial.en: Maja: Hello, Mark! How are you? Mark: Good, thanks! And you?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你好，马克！你怎么样？马克：挺好的，谢谢！你呢？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你好，马克！你怎么样？
messages.en: Hello, Mark! How are you?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 挺好的，谢谢！你呢？
messages.en: Good, thanks! And you?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħelow 放在见面第一句话的位置，与英语 hello 一起记：先打招呼，再问近况。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of the capital city of Finland.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 芬兰首都的名称，即赫尔辛基。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem tal-belt kapitali tal-Finlandja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赫尔辛基，芬兰的首都。

formal.mt: Ħelsinki hija l-belt kapitali tal-Finlandja.
formal.en: Helsinki is the capital city of Finland.
formal.zh: 赫尔辛基是芬兰的首都。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se tmur għall-vaganzi? Mark: Se mmur Ħelsinki ma' ħabib tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you going on holiday? Mark: I'm going to Helsinki with a friend of mine.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你要去哪里度假？马克：我要和一位朋友去赫尔辛基。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmur Ħelsinki ma' ħabib tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmur Ħelsinki ma' ħabib tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我要和一位朋友去赫尔辛基。
messages.en: I'm going to Helsinki with a friend of mine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ħelsinki 与“芬兰首都赫尔辛基”整组记忆；作为地名，正文中首字母写大写 Ħ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a very sweet taste, used to emphasize how sweet something is.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 味道非常甜，用来强调食物或饮品的甜度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu togħma ħelwa ħafna, b'enfasi fuq kemm hu ħelu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常甜的；甜极了的。

formal.mt: Il-kejk kien ħelu manna, għalhekk ġie servut f'biċċiet żgħar.
formal.en: The cake was very sweet, so it was served in small pieces.
formal.zh: 蛋糕非常甜，因此被切成小块端上桌。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sibtu l-kejk? Mark: Ħelu manna! Biċċa żgħira biżżejjed għalija.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you find the cake? Mark: Very sweet! A small piece is enough for me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得蛋糕怎么样？马克：甜极了！我吃一小块就够了。

messages.speaker: Maja (主人)
messages.zh: 你觉得蛋糕怎么样？
messages.en: How did you find the cake?

messages.speaker: Mark (客人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħelu manna! Biċċa żgħira biżżejjed għalija.
messages.mt_standard: Ħelu manna! Biċċa żgħira biżżejjed għalija.
messages.zh: 甜极了！我吃一小块就够了。
messages.en: Very sweet! A small piece is enough for me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħelu manna 当作一个整体记为“甜极了”，联想甜蛋糕只需切一小块的场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very sweet in taste, with emphasis on a strong sweetness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 味道非常甜，强调甜味十分明显。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu togħma ħelwa ħafna u ħlewwa qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常甜的；甜极了的。

formal.mt: It-te kien ħelu zokkor, għalhekk ma żdidniex aktar zokkor.
formal.en: The tea was very sweet, so we did not add any more sugar.
formal.zh: 茶已经非常甜了，因此我们没有再加糖。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid aktar zokkor fit-te? Mark: Le, grazzi. Diġà ħelu zokkor!
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like more sugar in your tea? Mark: No, thanks. It's already very sweet!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的茶还要加糖吗？马克：不用，谢谢。已经甜极了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的茶还要加糖吗？
messages.en: Would you like more sugar in your tea?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 不用，谢谢。已经甜极了！
messages.en: No, thanks. It's already very sweet!

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 ħelu zokkor，就想象一杯已经甜得不用再加糖的茶，整组记住“非常甜”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Slightly or somewhat sweet in taste.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 味道略带甜味，甜的程度不强。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu togħma xi ftit ħelwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有点甜的；略带甜味的。

formal.mt: L-inbid kien ħelwan, b'togħma ħelwa ħafifa.
formal.en: The wine was somewhat sweet, with a mild sweetness.
formal.zh: 这款葡萄酒略甜，带有淡淡的甜味。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tè ħelu ħafna? Mark: Le, ħelwan biss. Jogħġobni hekk.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the tea very sweet? Mark: No, just slightly sweet. I like it this way.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：茶很甜吗？马克：没有，只是略甜。我喜欢这样。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 茶很甜吗？
messages.en: Is the tea very sweet?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 没有，只是略甜。我喜欢这样。
messages.en: No, just slightly sweet. I like it this way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħelwan 放在甜度尺较低的一格：有一点甜味；与“非常甜”的两个短语对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become silent or to settle down after being noisy or agitated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从说话、吵闹或激动的状态变得安静或平静。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jieqaf jitkellem jew jagħmel l-istorbju, jew li jsir kalm wara l-aġitazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安静下来；停止说话或发出声音。
平静下来；从激动或不安中恢复平静。

collocations.zh: 过了一会儿平静了下来

formal.mt: Meta bdiet il-preżentazzjoni, l-udjenza ħemdet biex tisma' lill-kelliem.
formal.en: When the presentation began, the audience fell silent to listen to the speaker.
formal.zh: 演讲开始时，观众安静下来，聆听发言者讲话。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tifel għadu qed jibki? Mark: Le, ħemed wara ftit u issa qed jilgħab.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the boy still crying? Mark: No, he calmed down after a while and is playing now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那孩子还在哭吗？马克：没有，过了一会儿他就平静下来了，现在正在玩。

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.zh: 那孩子还在哭吗？
messages.en: Is the boy still crying?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ħemed wara ftit u issa qed jilgħab.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ħemed wara ftit u issa qed jilgħab.
messages.zh: 没有，过了一会儿他就平静下来了，现在正在玩。
messages.en: No, he calmed down after a while and is playing now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象声音和情绪一起降下来：停止说话对应“安静”，停止激动对应“平静”，两义都记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a short sound in the throat to clear it, often before speaking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出短促的喉音以清嗓子，常发生在开口说话之前。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħoss qasir fil-griżmejn biex jiċċarahom, spiss qabel jitkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 清嗓子；清一清喉咙。

formal.mt: Il-kelliem ħemm qabel beda jaqra d-diskors tiegħu.
formal.en: The speaker cleared his throat before he began reading his speech.
formal.zh: 发言人在开始宣读讲稿前清了清嗓子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Pawlu ħemm qabel tkellem? Ben: Għax ħass xi ħaġa fi griżmejh.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Pawlu clear his throat before speaking? Ben: Because he felt something in his throat.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗说话前为什么清了清嗓子？本：因为他觉得喉咙里有点东西。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗说话前为什么清了清嗓子？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu clear his throat before speaking?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ħass xi ħaġa fi griżmejh.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ħass xi ħaġa fi griżmejh.
messages.zh: 因为他觉得喉咙里有点东西。
messages.en: Because he felt something in his throat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħemm 放进“上台发言前，先清一下嗓子”的画面中记忆；这里联想的是动作场景，并非词源。

gloss_zh: 使某人安静；使某人住声

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone stop speaking or making noise.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人停止说话或发出声音，让对方安静下来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jieqaf jitkellem jew jagħmel l-istorbju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人住声；使某人安静下来。

formal.mt: Il-president ħemmed lill-folla qabel ta l-kelma lill-mistieden.
formal.en: The chair silenced the crowd before inviting the guest to speak.
formal.zh: 主持人先让人群安静下来，然后请嘉宾发言。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ħemmed lit-tfal? Mark: Missierhom. Talabhom jitkellmu wieħed wieħed.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who got the children to quiet down? Mark: Their father. He asked them to speak one at a time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁让孩子们安静下来了？马克：他们的爸爸。他让他们一个一个说。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 谁让孩子们安静下来了？
messages.en: Who got the children to quiet down?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.zh: 他们的爸爸。他让他们一个一个说。
messages.en: Their father. He asked them to speak one at a time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“有人原本正在说话，另一个人让他住声”的双人画面；ħemmed 的重点是让别人安静。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause a substance to undergo fermentation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某种物质发生发酵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel sustanza tiffermenta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使发酵；促使某物发生发酵。

collocations.en: caused the grape must to ferment

formal.mt: Il-produttur ħemmer il-most f'kontenitur adattat.
formal.en: The producer caused the grape must to ferment in a suitable container.
formal.zh: 生产者在合适的容器中使葡萄汁发酵。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'għamel Toni b'dik it-taħlita? David: Ħemmer it-taħlita; issa rridu nistennew.
colloquial.en: Anna: What did Toni do with that mixture? David: He got the mixture fermenting; now we need to wait.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：托尼对那份混合物做了什么？戴维：他让混合物开始发酵了；现在我们得等。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 托尼对那份混合物做了什么？
messages.en: What did Toni do with that mixture?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 他让混合物开始发酵了；现在我们得等。
messages.en: He got the mixture fermenting; now we need to wait.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只标着 ħemmer 的发酵容器：有人处理其中的原料，使它开始发酵，抓住“使发生”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To produce chickpeas as a crop.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出产鹰嘴豆，指农地等产出这种作物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti ċ-ċiċri bħala prodott tar-raba'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出产鹰嘴豆。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport tal-bidwi, ir-raba' ħemmes sew din is-sena.
formal.en: According to the farmer's report, the farmland produced a good crop of chickpeas this year.
formal.zh: 根据农民的报告，这片农地今年的鹰嘴豆收成不错。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ir-raba' ħemmes din is-sena? Ġanni: Iva, u ġbarna ħafna ċiċri.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did the farmland produce chickpeas this year? Ġanni: Yes, and we harvested lots of chickpeas.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这片农地今年出产鹰嘴豆了吗？詹尼：是的，我们收了很多鹰嘴豆。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.zh: 这片农地今年出产鹰嘴豆了吗？
messages.en: Did the farmland produce chickpeas this year?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (农民)
messages.zh: 是的，我们收了很多鹰嘴豆。
messages.en: Yes, and we harvested lots of chickpeas.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħemmes 配上“田里收出一篮鹰嘴豆”的动态图像；重点记作出产这种作物的动作。

gloss_zh: 使周围平静、无声的人或事物

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or thing that brings stillness and silence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带来平静和寂静的人或事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew ħaġa li ġġib il-kwiet u s-skiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使周围归于平静和寂静的人或事物。

collocations.en: someone who brings a crowd to silence
the role of someone who brings stillness and silence
collocations.zh: 使周围平静、无声的人的角色

formal.mt: Fit-test, il-kelliem jissejjaħ ħemmiedi għax iġib il-kwiet u s-skiet fost in-nies.
formal.en: In the text, the speaker is called a bringer of stillness and silence because he makes the people quiet.
formal.zh: 在这篇文字中，发言人被称为使周围平静、无声的人，因为他让人们安静下来。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser ħemmiedi hawn? Luqa: Xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa li ġġib il-kwiet u s-skiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does ħemmiedi mean here? Luqa: Someone or something that brings stillness and silence.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这里的 ħemmiedi 是什么意思？卢卡：指带来平静和寂静的人或事物。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 ħemmiedi 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does ħemmiedi mean here?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa li ġġib il-kwiet u s-skiet.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa li ġġib il-kwiet u s-skiet.
messages.zh: 指带来平静和寂静的人或事物。
messages.en: Someone or something that brings stillness and silence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中给“让全场安静的人或事物”贴上 ħemmiedi 标签；按本条名词用法，记住它指带来寂静者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A piece of land used for growing chickpeas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于种植鹰嘴豆的一块土地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa art fejn jitkabbru ċ-ċiċri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于种植鹰嘴豆的土地；鹰嘴豆种植地。

collocations.en: a large plot for growing chickpeas
a fertile plot for growing chickpeas
collocations.zh: 一块肥沃的鹰嘴豆种植地

formal.mt: Il-bidwi ħejja l-ħemmiesa għaż-żrigħ taċ-ċiċri.
formal.en: The farmer prepared the chickpea plot for sowing chickpeas.
formal.zh: 农民整理了鹰嘴豆种植地，准备播种鹰嘴豆。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'se tkabbar f'din il-ħemmiesa? Toni: Ċiċri; l-art diġà lesta għaż-żrigħ.
colloquial.en: Marija: What are you going to grow in this chickpea plot? Toni: Chickpeas; the land is already ready for sowing.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你准备在这块鹰嘴豆种植地里种什么？托尼：鹰嘴豆；地已经整理好，可以播种了。

messages.speaker: Marija (邻居)
messages.zh: 你准备在这块鹰嘴豆种植地里种什么？
messages.en: What are you going to grow in this chickpea plot?

messages.speaker: Toni (农民)
messages.zh: 鹰嘴豆；地已经整理好，可以播种了。
messages.en: Chickpeas; the land is already ready for sowing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象田边竖着一块写有 ħemmiesa 的地名牌，牌子圈定整块鹰嘴豆种植地，帮助记住它指土地。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing land that tends to produce chickpeas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容土地倾向于出产鹰嘴豆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi raba' li għandu tendenza jagħti ċ-ċiċri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于出产鹰嘴豆的。

collocations.en: farmland that tends to produce chickpeas
collocations.zh: 倾向于出产鹰嘴豆的农地

collocations.en: terrain that tends to produce chickpeas
collocations.zh: 倾向于出产鹰嘴豆的土地

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, ir-raba' ġie deskritt bħala ħemsi minħabba t-tendenza tiegħu li jagħti ċ-ċiċri.
formal.en: In the report, the farmland was described as tending to produce chickpeas.
formal.zh: 报告将这片农地描述为倾向于出产鹰嘴豆的土地。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser meta tgħid li dan ir-raba' huwa ħemsi? Pawlu: Li għandu tendenza jagħti ċ-ċiċri.
colloquial.en: Nina: What do you mean when you say this farmland is ħemsi? Pawlu: That it tends to produce chickpeas.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你说这片农地是 ħemsi，是什么意思？保罗：就是说它倾向于出产鹰嘴豆。

messages.speaker: Nina (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser meta tgħid li dan ir-raba' huwa ħemsi?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser meta tgħid li dan ir-raba' huwa ħemsi?
messages.zh: 你说这片农地是 ħemsi，是什么意思？
messages.en: What do you mean when you say this farmland is ħemsi?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.zh: 就是说它倾向于出产鹰嘴豆。
messages.en: That it tends to produce chickpeas.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 ħemsi 给一块地写评语：“这地常出鹰嘴豆。”把它记成描述土地出产倾向的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To clear one's throat repeatedly or frequently say an interjection such as 'ahem'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反复清嗓子，或在说话时频繁发出类似“嗯哼”的插入语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jnaddaf griżmejh ripetutament jew juża ta' spiss interjezzjoni bħal 'ahem'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复清嗓子。

sense_translations.en_definition: to use an interjection such as 'ahem' a lot
sense_translations.zh_definition: 频繁使用类似“嗯哼”的插入语。

formal.mt: Il-kelliem ħemħem diversi drabi qabel ma beda jaqra t-test.
formal.en: The speaker cleared his throat several times before beginning to read the text.
formal.zh: 发言者在开始朗读文本之前清了好几次嗓子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ħemħem daqshekk waqt id-diskors? Mark: Ma nafx, imma qal 'ahem' qabel kważi kull sentenza.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did he say 'ahem' so much during the speech? Mark: I don't know, but he said 'ahem' before almost every sentence.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他讲话时为什么总是说“嗯哼”？马克：我不知道，不过他几乎每句话前都会说一声“嗯哼”。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 他讲话时为什么总是说“嗯哼”？
messages.en: Why did he say 'ahem' so much during the speech?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx, imma qal 'ahem' qabel kważi kull sentenza.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx, imma qal 'ahem' qabel kważi kull sentenza.
messages.zh: 我不知道，不过他几乎每句话前都会说一声“嗯哼”。
messages.en: I don't know, but he said 'ahem' before almost every sentence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħemħem 的字形分成两段来记，联想连续两次清嗓；这是记忆画面，也可提醒“反复”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who tends to use interjections such as 'ahem' frequently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人说话时习惯频繁使用类似“嗯哼”的插入语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza juża ta' spiss interjezzjonijiet bħal 'ahem' waqt li jitkellem.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to make frequent use of interjections such as 'ahem'
sense_translations.zh_definition: 说话时爱频繁使用类似“嗯哼”的插入语的。

collocations.zh: 一位频频说“嗯哼”的发言者

collocations.en: a man who tends to say 'ahem' frequently
collocations.zh: 一个说话时爱说“嗯哼”的男人

formal.mt: Il-kelliem kien ħemħumi u spiss beda s-sentenzi tiegħu bl-interjezzjoni 'ahem'.
formal.en: The speaker tended to say 'ahem' frequently and often began his sentences with that interjection.
formal.zh: 这位发言者爱频频说“嗯哼”，常常用这个插入语开始一句话。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Illum Mark kien ħemħumi ħafna waqt il-preżentazzjoni. Sara: Iva, qal 'ahem' qabel kważi kull sentenza.
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark said 'ahem' a lot during today's presentation. Sara: Yes, he said 'ahem' before almost every sentence.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克今天做报告时总是说“嗯哼”。萨拉：是啊，他几乎每句话前都会说一声“嗯哼”。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum Mark kien ħemħumi ħafna waqt il-preżentazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Illum Mark kien ħemħumi ħafna waqt il-preżentazzjoni.
messages.zh: 马克今天做报告时总是说“嗯哼”。
messages.en: Mark said 'ahem' a lot during today's presentation.

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qal 'ahem' qabel kważi kull sentenza.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qal 'ahem' qabel kważi kull sentenza.
messages.zh: 是啊，他几乎每句话前都会说一声“嗯哼”。
messages.en: Yes, he said 'ahem' before almost every sentence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 ħemħem 记“反复做这个动作”，用 ħemħumi 记“有这种说话习惯的人”；对照动作与人物特征。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To eat eagerly and with obvious enjoyment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吃得起劲，明显享受食物；津津有味地吃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiekol b'ħerqa u b'gost.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 津津有味地吃；吃得很起劲。

collocations.en: ate with gusto during the meal

formal.mt: Wara ġurnata xogħol, il-ħaddiem ħendeb waqt l-ikla ta' filgħaxija.
formal.en: After a day's work, the worker ate his evening meal with gusto.
formal.zh: 工作了一天后，这位工人津津有味地吃着晚饭。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Mark ħendeb illum! Sam: Iva, għoġbitu ħafna l-ikla u talab iżjed.
colloquial.en: Elena: Mark really ate with gusto today! Sam: Yes, he loved the meal and asked for more.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：马克今天吃得真起劲！萨姆：是啊，他特别喜欢这顿饭，还要求再来一些。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克今天吃得真起劲！
messages.en: Mark really ate with gusto today!

messages.speaker: Sam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għoġbitu ħafna l-ikla u talab iżjed.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għoġbitu ħafna l-ikla u talab iżjed.
messages.zh: 是啊，他特别喜欢这顿饭，还要求再来一些。
messages.en: Yes, he loved the meal and asked for more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħendeb 联想成“饭菜太香，吃得起劲还想添一份”的画面；记住其中享受食物的感觉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To shake something very thoroughly, or to quake.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物充分、彻底地摇晃；也可指发生震颤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tħawwad xi ħaġa sewwa ħafna, jew li titriegħed bil-qawwi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物摇得非常充分、彻底。
震颤；剧烈颤动。

formal.mt: It-tekniku ħendem il-flixkun sewwa biex it-trab jitħallat mal-ilma.
formal.en: The technician shook the bottle very thoroughly so that the powder would mix with the water.
formal.zh: 技术员把瓶子充分摇晃，使粉末与水混合。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad hemm trab fil-qiegħ tal-flixkun? Luqa: Le, Mark ħendem il-flixkun sewwa u issa kollox imħallat.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is there still powder at the bottom of the bottle? Luqa: No, Mark shook the bottle very thoroughly, and now everything is mixed.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：瓶底还有粉末吗？卢卡：没有，马克把瓶子充分摇过了，现在全混匀了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 瓶底还有粉末吗？
messages.en: Is there still powder at the bottom of the bottle?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, Mark ħendem il-flixkun sewwa u issa kollox imħallat.
messages.mt_standard: Le, Mark ħendem il-flixkun sewwa u issa kollox imħallat.
messages.zh: 没有，马克把瓶子充分摇过了，现在全混匀了。
messages.en: No, Mark shook the bottle very thoroughly, and now everything is mixed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用力摇瓶直到瓶底粉末散开，记住“彻底摇晃”；再联想到地面震颤，连接第二义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The henna plant, or the dye made from it and used to colour hair or skin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指甲花这种植物，或由它制成、用于染头发或皮肤的海娜染料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta li minnha ssir żebgħa għax-xagħar jew għall-ġilda; ukoll iż-żebgħa magħmula minnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指甲花（植物）；由其制成的海娜染料。

formal.mt: Il-ħenna tintuża biex tagħti kulur lix-xagħar u biex isiru disinji fuq il-ġilda.
formal.en: Henna is used to colour hair and to make designs on the skin.
formal.zh: 海娜用于给头发染色，也用于在皮肤上绘制图案。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dan it-trab? Maja: Huwa trab tal-ħenna; se nużah biex niżbogħ xagħri.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is this powder? Maja: It's henna powder; I'm going to use it to dye my hair.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这是什么粉末？玛雅：这是海娜粉，我准备用它染头发。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是什么粉末？
messages.en: What is this powder?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa trab tal-ħenna; se nużah biex niżbogħ xagħri.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa trab tal-ħenna; se nużah biex niżbogħ xagħri.
messages.zh: 这是海娜粉，我准备用它染头发。
messages.en: It's henna powder; I'm going to use it to dye my hair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“指甲花植物—海娜粉—染发或画皮肤图案”连成画面，同一个词兼指植物和染料。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To get up early, or to be quick in acting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 早早起床；也可指行动迅速、抓紧做事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tqum kmieni jew li taġixxi malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 早起；在较早的时间起床。
动作快；迅速行动。

collocations.en: was quick so as to catch the bus
collocations.zh: 赶快行动以赶上公交车

formal.mt: Il-bidwi ħerek kmieni biex jibda x-xogħol qabel is-sħana.
formal.en: The farmer got up early to begin work before the heat.
formal.zh: 农民早早起床，趁天气还没热起来就开始干活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif laħaq il-karozza tal-linja Pawlu? Sara: Ħerek malli ra l-ħin u ħareġ minnufih.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Pawlu manage to catch the bus? Sara: He acted quickly as soon as he saw the time and went out immediately.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗怎么赶上公交车的？萨拉：他一看时间就赶紧行动，马上出门了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗怎么赶上公交车的？
messages.en: How did Pawlu manage to catch the bus?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħerek malli ra l-ħin u ħareġ minnufih.
messages.mt_standard: Ħerek malli ra l-ħin u ħareġ minnufih.
messages.zh: 他一看时间就赶紧行动，马上出门了。
messages.en: He acted quickly as soon as he saw the time and went out immediately.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个闹钟画面记忆：清晨响铃就起床，是“早起”；快迟到时立刻动身，是“行动快”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: With keen interest, enthusiasm, or a strong desire for something to happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带着浓厚兴趣、热情或强烈期待地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'interess qawwi, b'ħeġġa jew b'xewqa kbira li sseħħ xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 热切地；怀着强烈兴趣或期待地。

formal.mt: L-istudenti qraw ħerqanament l-ittra li kienet tħabbar id-dettalji tal-vjaġġ.
formal.en: The students eagerly read the letter announcing the details of the trip.
formal.zh: 学生们兴致勃勃地阅读了公布旅行详情的信。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għada joħroġ il-ktieb il-ġdid! Mark: Naf! Qed nistennieh ħerqanament.
colloquial.en: Sara: The new book comes out tomorrow! Mark: I know! I'm eagerly waiting for it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：新书明天出版！马克：我知道！我正热切地等着呢。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 新书明天出版！
messages.en: The new book comes out tomorrow!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我知道！我正热切地等着呢。
messages.en: I know! I'm eagerly waiting for it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象等新书时眼睛发亮、迫不及待的样子；这个词描述等待或阅读时“热切地”的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To talk in a way that makes little sense, or to babble at length.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说让人听不出意思的话；也可指没什么条理地说个不停。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li titkellem b'mod li ma jagħmilx sens, jew li tgħid ħafna kliem bla ordni ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胡言乱语；说难以理解、没有明确意义的话。
絮叨；杂乱或缺少条理地说个不停。

formal.mt: Il-karattru ħettef għal diversi minuti, u l-qarrej ma setax jifhem x'ried jgħid.
formal.en: The character babbled for several minutes, and the reader could not understand what he meant.
formal.zh: 这个角色胡言乱语了好几分钟，读者无法理解他想表达什么。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fhimt x'ried jgħid il-karattru? Mark: Le, ħettef tant li tlift il-ħsieb ewlieni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you understand what the character meant? Mark: No, he babbled so much that I lost track of the main point.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听懂那个角色想说什么了吗？马克：没有，他絮叨得太多，我都抓不住重点了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你听懂那个角色想说什么了吗？
messages.en: Did you understand what the character meant?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ħettef tant li tlift il-ħsieb ewlieni.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ħettef tant li tlift il-ħsieb ewlieni.
messages.zh: 没有，他絮叨得太多，我都抓不住重点了。
messages.en: No, he babbled so much that I lost track of the main point.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象嘴巴一直说、听者却找不到意思；把“说话无意义”和“絮叨不停”两个动词义并排记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to complain in an irritated or dissatisfied way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易带着不满或烦躁的语气抱怨、发牢骚的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jilmenta ta' spiss u juri dwejjaq jew nuqqas ta' sodisfazzjon.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱抱怨的；动辄发牢骚、显得不满的。

formal.mt: Il-klijent wieġeb b'ton ħettief u reġa' lmenta dwar il-ħin tal-istennija.
formal.en: The customer replied in a querulous tone and complained again about the waiting time.
formal.zh: 顾客用满是牢骚的语气回答，又抱怨了一遍等待时间。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Mark qed jilmenta fuq kull ħaġa llum? Maja: Ma nafx; illum għandu ton ħettief anki meta jitkellem fuq l-ikel.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is Mark complaining about everything today? Maja: I don't know; today he has a querulous tone even when he talks about food.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克今天怎么什么都要抱怨？玛雅：我不知道，他今天连说到吃的都一副牢骚口吻。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark qed jilmenta fuq kull ħaġa llum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark qed jilmenta fuq kull ħaġa llum?
messages.zh: 马克今天怎么什么都要抱怨？
messages.en: Why is Mark complaining about everything today?

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx; illum għandu ton ħettief anki meta jitkellem fuq l-ikel.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx; illum għandu ton ħettief anki meta jitkellem fuq l-ikel.
messages.zh: 我不知道，他今天连说到吃的都一副牢骚口吻。
messages.en: I don't know; today he has a querulous tone even when he talks about food.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住一张皱眉抱怨的脸：重点是“不满、发牢骚”的态度，不是单纯说话很多。

gloss_zh: 爱絮叨的；容易说个不停的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to babble or to keep talking without much clear order.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有絮叨倾向的，容易缺少条理地说个不停的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jgħid ħafna kliem bla ordni ċar u jibqa' jitkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱絮叨的；容易杂乱地说个不停的。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel ħettiefi jaqbeż minn suġġett għal ieħor mingħajr ma jtemm il-ħsieb tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the boy who tends to babble jumps from one subject to another without finishing his thought.
formal.zh: 故事里，那个爱絮叨的男孩一个念头还没说完，就跳到另一个话题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Luqa dejjem jaqbeż minn suġġett għal ieħor? Sara: Iva, huwa ħettiefi, speċjalment meta jkun eċċitat.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does Luqa always jump from one subject to another? Sara: Yes, he tends to babble, especially when he's excited.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：卢卡总是这样换来换去地说话题吗？萨拉：是啊，他爱絮叨，尤其是兴奋的时候。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Luqa dejjem jaqbeż minn suġġett għal ieħor?
messages.mt_standard: Luqa dejjem jaqbeż minn suġġett għal ieħor?
messages.zh: 卢卡总是这样换来换去地说话题吗？
messages.en: Does Luqa always jump from one subject to another?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa ħettiefi, speċjalment meta jkun eċċitat.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa ħettiefi, speċjalment meta jkun eċċitat.
messages.zh: 是啊，他爱絮叨，尤其是兴奋的时候。
messages.en: Yes, he tends to babble, especially when he's excited.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给人物贴上“容易絮叨”的形容词标签：想象他说着说着就跳话题，以此记住说话倾向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who talks a lot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话很多的人；常可用“话匣子”来理解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li titkellem ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 话多的人；爱说个不停的人。

collocations.en: someone who talks a lot in meetings

formal.mt: L-awtur jippreżenta lill-protagonist bħala ħettuf li jirrakkonta kull dettall tal-ġurnata tiegħu.
formal.en: The author presents the protagonist as a chatterbox who recounts every detail of his day.
formal.zh: 作者把主人公塑造成一个话匣子，连一天中的每个细节都要讲出来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark għadu jirrakkonta l-vjaġġ tiegħu? Sara: Iva, huwa ħettuf kbir; għadu kemm wasal għat-tieni jum!
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Mark still telling the story of his trip? Sara: Yes, he's a real chatterbox; he's only just reached the second day!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克还在讲他的旅行吗？萨拉：是啊，他真是个话匣子，这才刚讲到第二天！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克还在讲他的旅行吗？
messages.en: Is Mark still telling the story of his trip?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa ħettuf kbir; għadu kemm wasal għat-tieni jum!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa ħettuf kbir; għadu kemm wasal għat-tieni jum!
messages.zh: 是啊，他真是个话匣子，这才刚讲到第二天！
messages.en: Yes, he's a real chatterbox; he's only just reached the second day!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个打开后停不下来的“话匣子”，再把画面落到说话的人身上，记住这是指人的名词。

gloss_zh: 挖空；使变稀薄；降低密度；新鲜空气（名词义）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something hollow, thinner, or less dense by removing some of its material or contents.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过去掉部分材料或内容物，使某物内部中空、变得稀薄或密度降低。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa vojta minn ġewwa, irqaq jew inqas densa billi jneħħi parti mill-materjal jew mill-kontenut tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挖去内部，使中空。
使变薄或变稀。
使密度降低，使不再那么稠密。
新鲜空气。

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa ħewa z-zokk biex jagħmel reċipjent tal-injam.
formal.en: The carpenter hollowed out the tree trunk to make a wooden container.
formal.zh: 木匠挖空了树干，用来制作一个木制容器。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif għamel dan ir-reċipjent? Pawlu: Ħa zokk u ħewa n-nofs tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Marta: How did he make this container? Pawlu: He took a tree trunk and hollowed out its middle.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：他是怎么做出这个容器的？保罗：他拿了一段树干，把中间挖空了。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 他是怎么做出这个容器的？
messages.en: How did he make this container?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħa zokk u ħewa n-nofs tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Ħa zokk u ħewa n-nofs tiegħu.
messages.zh: 他拿了一段树干，把中间挖空了。
messages.en: He took a tree trunk and hollowed out its middle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把动词义想成从实物中移走一部分：树干被挖空，植被被疏稀；名词“新鲜空气”另作一张词义卡记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A beam or lever; also a large object that is awkward to handle or move.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 梁或杠杆；也可指体积大、难以搬动或操作的笨重东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Travu jew lieva; ukoll oġġett kbir u goff li jkun diffiċli biex iġġorru jew iċċaqalqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 梁或杠杆。
体积庞大、搬动或使用起来不方便的东西。

collocations.en: a heavy beam or cumbersome object

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema użaw ħexba bħala lieva biex jerfgħu l-ġebla l-kbira.
formal.en: The workers used a beam as a lever to lift the large stone.
formal.zh: 工人们用一根梁作杠杆，抬起那块大石头。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din il-ħexba ma tgħaddix mill-bieb! Mark: Ejja ndawruha ftit u nippruvaw flimkien.
colloquial.en: Nina: This bulky thing won't fit through the door! Mark: Let's turn it a little and try together.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个笨重的大家伙过不了门！马克：我们把它转一点，一起试试。

messages.speaker: Nina (搬家者)
messages.zh: 这个笨重的大家伙过不了门！
messages.en: This bulky thing won't fit through the door!

messages.speaker: Mark (帮忙的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja ndawruha ftit u nippruvaw flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja ndawruha ftit u nippruvaw flimkien.
messages.zh: 我们把它转一点，一起试试。
messages.en: Let's turn it a little and try together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象一根难搬的大梁，再把画面扩展到任何笨重大家伙；同一根梁还可以拿来当杠杆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Enthusiasm for doing something, or encouragement that helps someone act.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做某事时的热情、干劲，也指促使别人行动的鼓励。
