teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entużjaż biex tagħmel xi ħaġa, jew kuraġġ li tagħti lil xi ħadd biex jaġixxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 热情；积极投入某事的干劲。
鼓励；使人获得信心并愿意行动的支持。

formal.mt: L-istudenti ħadmu b'ħeġġa kbira fuq il-proġett, u l-appoġġ tal-għalliema tahom aktar ħeġġa.
formal.en: The students worked on the project with great enthusiasm, and their teachers' support gave them further encouragement.
formal.zh: 学生们满怀热情地开展项目，老师们的支持又给了他们更多鼓励。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad għandek ħeġġa biex titgħallem il-Malti? Mark: Iva! Kull darba li nifhem sentenza ġdida, inħoss aktar ħeġġa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you still enthusiastic about learning Maltese? Mark: Yes! Every time I understand a new sentence, I feel more enthusiastic.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你现在还很有热情学马耳他语吗？Mark：有啊！每听懂一个新句子，我就更有干劲。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad għandek ħeġġa biex titgħallem il-Malti?
messages.mt_standard: Għad għandek ħeġġa biex titgħallem il-Malti?
messages.zh: 你现在还很有热情学马耳他语吗？
messages.en: Are you still enthusiastic about learning Maltese?

messages.speaker: Mark (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Kull darba li nifhem sentenza ġdida, inħoss aktar ħeġġa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Kull darba li nifhem sentenza ġdida, inħoss aktar ħeġġa.
messages.zh: 有啊！每听懂一个新句子，我就更有干劲。
messages.en: Yes! Every time I understand a new sentence, I feel more enthusiastic.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ħeġġa和学习时的干劲联系起来：自己有热情，别人给鼓励，两种意义都能推动行动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who eats food very quickly and greedily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吃东西很急、狼吞虎咽的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiekol malajr ħafna u b'regħba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狼吞虎咽地吃东西的人；吃相急切的人。

collocations.en: a person who wolfs down food
someone who wolfs down food at the table

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ħeġġiem spiċċa l-ikla tiegħu qabel ma l-mistednin l-oħra bdew jieklu.
formal.en: In the story, the person who wolfed down his food finished his meal before the other guests began eating.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个狼吞虎咽的人在其他客人开始吃饭之前就吃完了自己的饭。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Diġà spiċċajt il-platt kollu? Int ħeġġiem! Toni: Kelli ġuħ kbir; id-darba d-dieħla niekol aktar bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you already finished the whole plate? You really wolf your food down! Toni: I was very hungry; next time I will eat more slowly.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你已经把整盘都吃完了？你真是个狼吞虎咽的家伙！Toni：我刚才太饿了，下次我会吃慢一点。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Diġà spiċċajt il-platt kollu? Int ħeġġiem!
messages.mt_standard: Diġà spiċċajt il-platt kollu? Int ħeġġiem!
messages.zh: 你已经把整盘都吃完了？你真是个狼吞虎咽的家伙！
messages.en: Have you already finished the whole plate? You really wolf your food down!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kelli ġuħ kbir; id-darba d-dieħla niekol aktar bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Kelli ġuħ kbir; id-darba d-dieħla niekol aktar bil-mod.
messages.zh: 我刚才太饿了，下次我会吃慢一点。
messages.en: I was very hungry; next time I will eat more slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同桌的人三两口就吃光整盘食物，把ħeġġiem贴在这个人身上，记住名词指吃得很急的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to eat food very quickly and greedily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有吃东西过急、狼吞虎咽倾向的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jiekol malajr ħafna u b'regħba.

sense_translations.en_definition: having a tendency to wolf down food
sense_translations.zh_definition: 惯于狼吞虎咽的；有急切吞食习惯的。

collocations.en: a boy who tends to wolf down his food
collocations.zh: 吃饭惯于狼吞虎咽的男孩

collocations.en: a man who tends to wolf down his food
collocations.zh: 吃饭惯于狼吞虎咽的男子

formal.mt: Il-karattru ewlieni huwa raġel ħeġġiemi li spiss jispiċċa l-ikel tiegħu qabel kulħadd.
formal.en: The main character is a man who tends to wolf down his food and often finishes before everyone else.
formal.zh: 主角是一名惯于狼吞虎咽的男子，常常比所有人都先吃完。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Ħuk dejjem jiekol hekk malajr? Luqa: Iva, hu ħeġġiemi ħafna; spiss infakkru biex jiekol bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Marija: Does your brother always eat that quickly? Luqa: Yes, he really tends to wolf down his food; we often remind him to eat slowly.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你兄弟总是吃得这么快吗？Luqa：是啊，他特别容易狼吞虎咽，我们经常提醒他慢点吃。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟总是吃得这么快吗？
messages.en: Does your brother always eat that quickly?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu ħeġġiemi ħafna; spiss infakkru biex jiekol bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu ħeġġiemi ħafna; spiss infakkru biex jiekol bil-mod.
messages.zh: 是啊，他特别容易狼吞虎咽，我们经常提醒他慢点吃。
messages.en: Yes, he really tends to wolf down his food; we often remind him to eat slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用例句中的raġel ħeġġiemi记性质：这个人经常吃得很急；把它作为形容词描述习惯来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who encourages others and gives them confidence to continue.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鼓励他人、给人信心并支持其继续努力的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel kuraġġ lil ħaddieħor u tgħinu jkompli jagħmel sforz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鼓励他人的人；给别人打气、增添信心的人。

formal.mt: Bħala ħeġġieġ tal-istudenti, l-għalliem jagħtihom il-kuraġġ biex jippruvaw anki meta jsibu diffikultà.
formal.en: As someone who encourages the students, the teacher gives them the confidence to try even when they encounter difficulty.
formal.zh: 作为鼓励学生的人，这位老师给他们信心，让他们即使遇到困难也愿意尝试。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min jagħtik il-kuraġġ meta tkun se taqta' qalbek? Pawlu: Ħija! Hu l-ħeġġieġ tiegħi; dejjem jgħidli biex nerġa' nipprova.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who encourages you when you are about to give up? Pawlu: My brother! He is the person who cheers me on; he always tells me to try again.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你快要放弃的时候，谁会鼓励你？Pawlu：我哥哥！他就是给我打气的人，总叫我再试一次。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min jagħtik il-kuraġġ meta tkun se taqta' qalbek?
messages.mt_standard: Min jagħtik il-kuraġġ meta tkun se taqta' qalbek?
messages.zh: 你快要放弃的时候，谁会鼓励你？
messages.en: Who encourages you when you are about to give up?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija! Hu l-ħeġġieġ tiegħi; dejjem jgħidli biex nerġa' nipprova.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija! Hu l-ħeġġieġ tiegħi; dejjem jgħidli biex nerġa' nipprova.
messages.zh: 我哥哥！他就是给我打气的人，总叫我再试一次。
messages.en: My brother! He is the person who cheers me on; he always tells me to try again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象比赛场边不断为你加油的那个人，用ħeġġieġ给这个鼓励者贴标签，记住它指人。

gloss_zh: 鼓舞人心的；激发热情的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inspiring enthusiasm and making people eager to act or take part.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够激发热情，使人愿意行动或参与的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jqanqal l-entużjażmu u jħajjar lin-nies jaġixxu jew jieħdu sehem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鼓舞人心的；能唤起热情、使人振奋的。

formal.mt: Id-direttur għamel diskors ħeġġieġi li ħajjar lill-parteċipanti jaħdmu flimkien fuq il-proġett.
formal.en: The director gave an inspiring speech that encouraged the participants to work together on the project.
formal.zh: 主任发表了一场鼓舞人心的演讲，激发参与者共同推进项目的热情。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għoġbok il-messaġġ tal-kowċ? David: Iva, kien ħeġġieġi ħafna! Issa għandi aktar aptit nitħarreġ.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you like the coach's message? David: Yes, it was very inspiring! Now I feel more eager to train.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你喜欢教练说的那番话吗？David：喜欢，特别鼓舞人心！我现在更想训练了。

messages.speaker: Nina (队友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢教练说的那番话吗？
messages.en: Did you like the coach's message?

messages.speaker: David (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien ħeġġieġi ħafna! Issa għandi aktar aptit nitħarreġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien ħeġġieġi ħafna! Issa għandi aktar aptit nitħarreġ.
messages.zh: 喜欢，特别鼓舞人心！我现在更想训练了。
messages.en: Yes, it was very inspiring! Now I feel more eager to train.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ħeġġieġi放在演讲或信息旁边记：听完就想行动，说明内容具有鼓舞人心的性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Somewhat light in weight, without necessarily being extremely light.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 重量比较轻的，表示一定程度的轻，并不一定轻得几乎没有重量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu piż pjuttost baxx, iżda mhux bilfors baxx ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有些轻的；比较轻的。

formal.mt: Il-pakkett huwa ħfejjef u jista' jinġarr faċilment minn persuna waħda.
formal.en: The parcel is fairly light and can easily be carried by one person.
formal.zh: 这个包裹比较轻，一个人就能轻松搬动。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tridni ngħinek bil-basket? Ġanni: Le, grazzi. Hu ħfejjef; nista' nġorru jien.
colloquial.en: Sara: Would you like me to help you with the basket? Ġanni: No, thanks. It's fairly light; I can carry it myself.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：要我帮你提篮子吗？詹尼：不用，谢谢。它比较轻，我自己提得动。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 要我帮你提篮子吗？
messages.en: Would you like me to help you with the basket?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, grazzi. Hu ħfejjef; nista' nġorru jien.
messages.mt_standard: Le, grazzi. Hu ħfejjef; nista' nġorru jien.
messages.zh: 不用，谢谢。它比较轻，我自己提得动。
messages.en: No, thanks. It's fairly light; I can carry it myself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象提起一个装了少量东西的篮子：有点重量，却提得轻松，用“比较轻”记住这个形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small hole or pit; the diminutive form of ħofra.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小洞或小坑，是 ħofra 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħofra żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' ħofra.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small hole (the diminutive form of 'ħofra')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小洞或小坑，是 ħofra 的指小形式。

collocations.en: a small hole in the soil

formal.mt: Qabel iż-żrigħ, agħmel ħfejra fil-ħamrija u poġġi ż-żerriegħa fiha.
formal.en: Before sowing, make a small hole in the soil and place the seed in it.
formal.zh: 播种前，先在土里挖一个小坑，再把种子放进去。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn inpoġġi ż-żerriegħa? Rita: F'din il-ħfejra, u mbagħad għattiha bi ftit ħamrija.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where do I put the seed? Rita: In this little hole, and then cover it with a little soil.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：种子放在哪里？丽塔：放进这个小坑里，然后用一点土盖住。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.zh: 种子放在哪里？
messages.en: Where do I put the seed?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: F'din il-ħfejra, u mbagħad għattiha bi ftit ħamrija.
messages.mt_standard: F'din il-ħfejra, u mbagħad għattiha bi ftit ħamrija.
messages.zh: 放进这个小坑里，然后用一点土盖住。
messages.en: In this little hole, and then cover it with a little soil.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħofra 想成普通的坑，把 ħfejra 想成只容得下一粒种子的小坑，用大小画面对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of holding something enclosed in one's fist.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西包在握拢的拳头里、攥在手中的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li żżomm xi ħaġa f'idek magħluqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物攥在拳头里；握在拳中的动作。

collocations.en: a tight grip with the fist

formal.mt: Il-ħfin qawwi tal-karta jista' jħalliha mkemmxa.
formal.en: Holding paper tightly in one's fist can leave it crumpled.
formal.zh: 把纸紧紧攥在拳头里，可能会把它弄皱。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Ħoll idek ftit; dan il-ħfin hu qawwi wisq. Leo: Sewwa, ma rridx ngħaffeġ il-fjura.
colloquial.en: Marija: Loosen your hand a little; that grip is too tight. Leo: All right, I don't want to crush the flower.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：手稍微松一点，你攥得太紧了。利奥：好，我不想把花捏坏。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħoll idek ftit; dan il-ħfin hu qawwi wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Ħoll idek ftit; dan il-ħfin hu qawwi wisq.
messages.zh: 手稍微松一点，你攥得太紧了。
messages.en: Loosen your hand a little; that grip is too tight.

messages.speaker: Leo (儿子)
messages.zh: 好，我不想把花捏坏。
messages.en: All right, I don't want to crush the flower.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做一次把小纸团攥进拳头的动作：记住 ħfin 指的是“攥握这个动作”，而不是手中的纸团。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of forgiving a wrong or granting a pardon.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对过错给予原谅、宽恕，或给予赦免的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li taħfer ħtija jew tagħti maħfra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原谅、宽恕他人过错的行为。
赦免的行为；免除对某项过错的追究或处罚。

collocations.en: a request for forgiveness or pardon

formal.mt: L-ittra tinkludi ammissjoni tal-iżball u talba għall-ħfir.
formal.en: The letter includes an admission of the mistake and a request for forgiveness.
formal.zh: 信中承认了错误，并请求原谅。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Taħseb li l-ħfir hu possibbli wara dak li għedt? David: Iva, imma l-ewwel irrid nisma' apoloġija sinċiera.
colloquial.en: Anna: Do you think forgiveness is possible after what I said? David: Yes, but first I want to hear a sincere apology.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我说了那些话之后，你觉得还有可能得到原谅吗？戴维：有，但我想先听到真诚的道歉。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li l-ħfir hu possibbli wara dak li għedt?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li l-ħfir hu possibbli wara dak li għedt?
messages.zh: 我说了那些话之后，你觉得还有可能得到原谅吗？
messages.en: Do you think forgiveness is possible after what I said?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-ewwel irrid nisma' apoloġija sinċiera.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-ewwel irrid nisma' apoloġija sinċiera.
messages.zh: 有，但我想先听到真诚的道歉。
messages.en: Yes, but first I want to hear a sincere apology.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一封先认错、再请求宽恕的信；ħfir 是信中所求的“原谅或赦免”这一行为名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to be forgiven or excused, especially when describing a mistake or fault.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可以得到原谅或宽恕的，常用于描述错误或过失。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jinħafer, speċjalment meta jingħad għal żball jew nuqqas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可原谅的；可宽恕的。

formal.mt: Dan in-nuqqas huwa ħfuri, iżda għandu jiġi kkoreġut qabel il-pubblikazzjoni.
formal.en: This failing is forgivable, but it should be corrected before publication.
formal.zh: 这个过失可以原谅，但应当在发表前改正。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Ktibt l-isem ħażin. Hu żball ħfuri? Emma: Iva, jiġri lil kulħadd. Ikkoreġih u ibgħat il-messaġġ mill-ġdid.
colloquial.en: Ben: I wrote the name incorrectly. Is it a forgivable mistake? Emma: Yes, it happens to everyone. Correct it and send the message again.
colloquial.zh: 本：我把名字写错了。这算可以原谅的错误吗？埃玛：算，谁都会遇到。改好后把消息重新发一次。

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ktibt l-isem ħażin. Hu żball ħfuri?
messages.mt_standard: Ktibt l-isem ħażin. Hu żball ħfuri?
messages.zh: 我把名字写错了。这算可以原谅的错误吗？
messages.en: I wrote the name incorrectly. Is it a forgivable mistake?

messages.speaker: Emma (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jiġri lil kulħadd. Ikkoreġih u ibgħat il-messaġġ mill-ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jiġri lil kulħadd. Ikkoreġih u ibgħat il-messaġġ mill-ġdid.
messages.zh: 算，谁都会遇到。改好后把消息重新发一次。
messages.en: Yes, it happens to everyone. Correct it and send the message again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħfuri 写在一张小错误清单旁，表示“这个错误可以原谅”；记住它是描述过失性质的形容词。

gloss_zh: 赠礼给；向某人赠送礼物

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give someone a gift.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把礼物赠送给某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti rigal lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赠礼给某人；向某人赠送礼物

collocations.en: he gave his friend a gift
he gave his daughter a book as a gift
collocations.zh: 他送给女儿一本书作为礼物

formal.mt: Fi tmiem iċ-ċerimonja, id-direttur ħieb lill-għalliem b'ktieb bħala sinjal ta' apprezzament.
formal.en: At the end of the ceremony, the director presented the teacher with a book as a token of appreciation.
formal.zh: 仪式结束时，主任向老师赠送了一本书，以表谢意。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'għamel Pawlu għal għeluq snin bintu? Marija: Ħieb lil bintu b'ktieb li kienet ilha tixtieq.
colloquial.en: Rita: What did Pawlu do for his daughter's birthday? Marija: He gave his daughter a book she had wanted for a long time.
colloquial.zh: Rita：Pawlu在女儿生日时做了什么？Marija：他送给女儿一本她想要很久的书。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għamel Pawlu għal għeluq snin bintu?
messages.mt_standard: X'għamel Pawlu għal għeluq snin bintu?
messages.zh: Pawlu在女儿生日时做了什么？
messages.en: What did Pawlu do for his daughter's birthday?

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħieb lil bintu b'ktieb li kienet ilha tixtieq.
messages.mt_standard: Ħieb lil bintu b'ktieb li kienet ilha tixtieq.
messages.zh: 他送给女儿一本她想要很久的书。
messages.en: He gave his daughter a book she had wanted for a long time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ħieb放进生日送书的画面：一人把礼物递给另一人，记住它表达“赠礼给某人”这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To form a mental picture or create an idea in one's imagination.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在脑海中形成画面，或凭想象构思某个事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġġib quddiem moħħok stampa jew tifforma idea fl-immaġinazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 想象；在脑海中形成画面
在想象中构想；凭想象形成某个想法

collocations.zh: 他构想了一个不同的结局

formal.mt: L-awtur ħiel belt taħt il-baħar u għamilha ċ-ċentru tal-istorja tiegħu.
formal.en: The author imagined a city under the sea and made it the centre of his story.
formal.zh: 作者构想了一座海底城市，并让它成为故事的核心场景。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif ġietu l-idea għal din l-istampa? Samwel: Ħiel ġnien fuq il-qamar u mbagħad pinġieh.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did he get the idea for this picture? Samwel: He imagined a garden on the moon and then drew it.
colloquial.zh: Nina：他怎么想到画这幅画的？Samwel：他想象月球上有一座花园，然后把它画了出来。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ġietu l-idea għal din l-istampa?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ġietu l-idea għal din l-istampa?
messages.zh: 他怎么想到画这幅画的？
messages.en: How did he get the idea for this picture?

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħiel ġnien fuq il-qamar u mbagħad pinġieh.
messages.mt_standard: Ħiel ġnien fuq il-qamar u mbagħad pinġieh.
messages.zh: 他想象月球上有一座花园，然后把它画了出来。
messages.en: He imagined a garden on the moon and then drew it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 闭眼在脑中画一座月球花园，用这个动作记ħiel：既能“想象画面”，也能“构想点子”。

gloss_zh: 装腔作势的态度；做作姿态

teaching_sense.en_definition: An artificial or put-on attitude adopted to make an impression.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了给人某种印象而刻意摆出的、不自然的态度或姿态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attitudni artifiċjali li wieħed juri biex jagħmel impressjoni fuq ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 做作的态度；装腔作势的姿态

collocations.en: to speak with an affected attitude

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-ħiema tal-karattru tidher fil-mod kif jitkellem mal-mistednin.
formal.en: In the novel, the character's affected attitude is apparent in the way he speaks to the guests.
formal.zh: 小说中，这个人物与宾客交谈的方式显露出他做作的态度。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex qed jitkellem b'dik il-ħiema kollha? Pawlu: Naħseb li jrid jimpressjona lill-mistednin.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why is he speaking with such an affected attitude? Pawlu: I think he wants to impress the guests.
colloquial.zh: Marija：他怎么说话这么装腔作势？Pawlu：我想他是想给客人留下深刻印象。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed jitkellem b'dik il-ħiema kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed jitkellem b'dik il-ħiema kollha?
messages.zh: 他怎么说话这么装腔作势？
messages.en: Why is he speaking with such an affected attitude?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我想他是想给客人留下深刻印象。
messages.en: I think he wants to impress the guests.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人见到客人就刻意拿腔拿调，用这副做作的样子记ħiema；重点是人为摆出的态度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Deceitful; willing to mislead others through lies or dishonest behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用谎言或不诚实的行为误导他人的；欺诈的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jqarraq b'ħaddieħor bil-gideb jew b'imġiba diżonesta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欺诈的；惯于欺骗他人的。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-bejjiegħ ħieni jaħbi l-verità dwar il-prezz tal-oġġett.
formal.en: In the story, the deceitful seller hides the truth about the item's price.
formal.zh: 在故事中，那个不诚实的卖家隐瞒了商品价格的真相。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak il-bejjiegħ? Mark: Għax hu ħieni; qalli prezz u mbagħad talab aktar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why don't you trust that seller? Mark: Because he's deceitful; he quoted one price and then asked for more.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么不信任那个卖家？马克：因为他不诚实；他先报了一个价格，后来又要更多钱。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak il-bejjiegħ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak il-bejjiegħ?
messages.zh: 你为什么不信任那个卖家？
messages.en: Why don't you trust that seller?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu ħieni; qalli prezz u mbagħad talab aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu ħieni; qalli prezz u mbagħad talab aktar.
messages.zh: 因为他不诚实；他先报了一个价格，后来又要更多钱。
messages.en: Because he's deceitful; he quoted one price and then asked for more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħieni 和故事中故意隐瞒真相的卖家联系起来，记住它描述的是欺骗他人的品性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sew or stitch material with a needle and thread, joining pieces or repairing a tear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用针线缝纫或缝合材料，把几块材料连接起来或修补破口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaqqad biċċiet ta' drapp jew sewwa tiċrita bil-labra u l-ħajt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缝纫；用针线缝合或缝补。

formal.mt: Il-ħajjat ħiet il-kmiem tal-qmis b'attenzjoni kbira.
formal.en: The tailor sewed the shirt's sleeves with great care.
formal.zh: 裁缝十分仔细地缝好了衬衫的袖子。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min ħiet din il-buttuna? Pawlu: Missieri. Issa l-qmis lesta biex tilbesha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who sewed on this button? Pawlu: My father. Now the shirt is ready for you to wear.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这颗纽扣是谁缝上的？保罗：我爸爸。现在这件衬衫可以穿了。

messages.speaker: Sara (女儿)
messages.zh: 这颗纽扣是谁缝上的？
messages.en: Who sewed on this button?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (兄弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Missieri. Issa l-qmis lesta biex tilbesha.
messages.mt_standard: Missieri. Issa l-qmis lesta biex tilbesha.
messages.zh: 我爸爸。现在这件衬衫可以穿了。
messages.en: My father. Now the shirt is ready for you to wear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 ħiet 就想象针线穿过衬衫、把纽扣缝牢的动作，用具体画面记住“缝”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A need, or something required for a purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某种需要，或为达到某个目的而必须具备的事物或条件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bżonn, jew xi ħaġa meħtieġa biex jintlaħaq għan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 需要；需求
要求；必须具备的条件

formal.mt: Il-ħieġ għal aktar ilma nadif jidher ċar fir-rapport dwar ir-raħal.
formal.en: The need for more clean water is clear in the report about the village.
formal.zh: 关于该村庄的报告清楚地显示，当地需要更多清洁用水。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed niġbru dawn il-flus? Toni: Hemm ħieġ urġenti għal kutri fil-kenn.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are we collecting this money? Toni: There is an urgent need for blankets at the shelter.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们为什么筹这些钱？Toni：收容所急需毯子。

messages.speaker: Sara (志愿者)
messages.zh: 我们为什么筹这些钱？
messages.en: Why are we collecting this money?

messages.speaker: Toni (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm ħieġ urġenti għal kutri fil-kenn.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm ħieġ urġenti għal kutri fil-kenn.
messages.zh: 收容所急需毯子。
messages.en: There is an urgent need for blankets at the shelter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用清单记ħieġ：缺什么是“需要”，必须具备什么是“要求”；两个义项都围绕必要之物来理解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Needed or necessary for a particular purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为某个目的所需要的；必要的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meħtieġ jew neċessarju għal għan partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 需要的；必要的

formal.mt: Il-kontroll tad-dokumenti huwa pass ħieġi qabel l-approvazzjoni tat-talba.
formal.en: Checking the documents is a necessary step before approving the request.
formal.zh: 批准申请之前，核查文件是必要的步骤。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Irridu nieħdu dan it-tagħmir kollu? Lara: Iva, huwa ħieġi għax-xogħol ta' għada.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do we have to take all this equipment? Lara: Yes, it is needed for tomorrow's work.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我们得把这些设备全带上吗？Lara：对，明天的工作需要这些设备。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 我们得把这些设备全带上吗？
messages.en: Do we have to take all this equipment?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa ħieġi għax-xogħol ta' għada.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa ħieġi għax-xogħol ta' għada.
messages.zh: 对，明天的工作需要这些设备。
messages.en: Yes, it is needed for tomorrow's work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出门前给必需装备打勾：ħieġi就是给物品贴上“必要的”标签。与名词ħieġ对照记词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Skillful in carrying out a task, or courageous when facing difficulty or danger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做事有技巧、熟练的；也可指面对困难或危险时勇敢的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħila f'dak li jagħmel, jew li juri kuraġġ quddiem diffikultà jew periklu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有技巧的，熟练的；勇敢的，有胆量的。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ħili sewwa l-mekkaniżmu b'preċiżjoni u temm ix-xogħol fil-ħin.
formal.en: The skillful worker repaired the mechanism precisely and finished the work on time.
formal.zh: 那名技术熟练的工人精确地修好了机械装置，并按时完成了工作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min jista' jsewwi dan is-siġġu? Toni: Staqsi lil Ġanni; hu ħili u jaħdem bir-reqqa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who can repair this chair? Toni: Ask Ġanni; he's skillful and works carefully.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：谁能修这把椅子？托尼：问问詹尼吧；他手艺好，做事也仔细。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 谁能修这把椅子？
messages.en: Who can repair this chair?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Staqsi lil Ġanni; hu ħili u jaħdem bir-reqqa.
messages.mt_standard: Staqsi lil Ġanni; hu ħili u jaħdem bir-reqqa.
messages.zh: 问问詹尼吧；他手艺好，做事也仔细。
messages.en: Ask Ġanni; he's skillful and works carefully.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记 ħili：工人巧手修物表示熟练，士兵勇敢面对危险表示勇敢；根据语境选择。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Hindi, the language referred to when discussing speaking, reading, writing, or learning it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 印地语这一语言的名称，可用于谈论说、读、写或学习印地语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem tal-lingwa Ħindi, li wieħed jista' jitkellem, jaqra, jikteb jew jitgħallem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 印地语，语言名称。

formal.mt: Il-kors tal-Ħindi jinkludi eżerċizzji fil-qari, fil-kitba u fit-taħdit.
formal.en: The Hindi course includes exercises in reading, writing, and speaking.
formal.zh: 这门印地语课程包括阅读、写作和口语练习。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema lingwa qed titgħallem? Mark: Qed nitgħallem il-Ħindi, u nipprattika ftit kuljum.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which language are you learning? Mark: I'm learning Hindi, and I practise a little every day.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你正在学哪种语言？马克：我正在学印地语，每天都练习一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你正在学哪种语言？
messages.en: Which language are you learning?

messages.speaker: Mark (语言学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nitgħallem il-Ħindi, u nipprattika ftit kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nitgħallem il-Ħindi, u nipprattika ftit kuljum.
messages.zh: 我正在学印地语，每天都练习一点。
messages.en: I'm learning Hindi, and I practise a little every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ħindi 放进“学习印地语、说印地语”两个场景记忆，先牢牢记住它是语言名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To persuade someone gently, using reassuring, pleasing, or encouraging words.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用安抚、讨好或鼓励的话温和地劝说某人做某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ipprova jipperswadi lil xi ħadd bi kliem ħelu, ta' faraġ jew ta' inkoraġġiment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用好话或讨好的言辞哄劝某人。
耐心而温和地劝说、引导某人做某事。

collocations.en: cajoled his friend into helping him

formal.mt: L-għalliem ħinn lit-tifel biex jaqra l-ewwel sentenza quddiem il-klassi.
formal.en: The teacher gently coaxed the boy into reading the first sentence in front of the class.
formal.zh: 老师温和地鼓励那个男孩在全班面前读出第一句话。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif ikkonvinċieh lil ħuh biex jiġi? Pawlu: Ħinn lil ħuh bi kliem ħelu sakemm aċċetta.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did he convince his brother to come? Pawlu: He cajoled his brother with sweet words until he agreed.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：他是怎么说服弟弟来的？保罗：他一直用好话哄劝弟弟，直到弟弟答应。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ikkonvinċieh lil ħuh biex jiġi?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ikkonvinċieh lil ħuh biex jiġi?
messages.zh: 他是怎么说服弟弟来的？
messages.en: How did he convince his brother to come?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħinn lil ħuh bi kliem ħelu sakemm aċċetta.
messages.mt_standard: Ħinn lil ħuh bi kliem ħelu sakemm aċċetta.
messages.zh: 他一直用好话哄劝弟弟，直到弟弟答应。
messages.en: He cajoled his brother with sweet words until he agreed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħinn 想成低声说好话、慢慢劝动对方的动作；两个义项都围绕温和劝说来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To converge; to move or come together towards a common point.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从不同方向向同一地点靠拢或汇合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Resaq jew iltaqa' f'punt wieħed ma' dak li ġej minn direzzjoni oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 汇合；从不同方向向同一点靠拢。
码头；伸向水中供船只停靠等用途的平台。
门柱；门框侧边竖立的支柱。

formal.mt: L-ilma miż-żewġ kanali ħiser f'punt wieħed qabel ma daħal fil-ġibjun.
formal.en: The water from the two channels converged at one point before entering the reservoir.
formal.zh: 两条水渠的水先汇合到同一点，然后流入蓄水池。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn se nistennew id-dgħajsa? Toni: Fuq il-ħiser, ħdejn dik il-lampa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where shall we wait for the boat? Toni: On the pier, next to that lamp.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：我们在哪里等船？托尼：在码头上，那盏灯旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (乘客)
messages.zh: 我们在哪里等船？
messages.en: Where shall we wait for the boat?

messages.speaker: Toni (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 在码头上，那盏灯旁边。
messages.en: On the pier, next to that lamp.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ħiser 做三张独立词卡：水流汇合是动词，等船的码头和门边的门柱是名词，分别用场景记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cucumbers; long vegetables often sliced and eaten fresh in salads.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 黄瓜，常切片后鲜食或用来拌沙拉的长形蔬菜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxix tawwali li spiss jinqata' f'roti u jittiekel frisk fl-insalata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黄瓜，指这类蔬菜或若干黄瓜。

formal.mt: Għal din l-insalata, aħsel il-ħjar u aqtagħhom f'roti rqaq.
formal.en: For this salad, wash the cucumbers and cut them into thin slices.
formal.zh: 制作这道沙拉时，先洗净黄瓜，再切成薄片。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek ħjar frisk illum? Rita: Iva, kemm trid?
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have fresh cucumbers today? Rita: Yes, how much would you like?
colloquial.zh: 马克：你今天有新鲜黄瓜吗？丽塔：有，你要多少？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 你今天有新鲜黄瓜吗？
messages.en: Do you have fresh cucumbers today?

messages.speaker: Rita (菜贩)
messages.zh: 有，你要多少？
messages.en: Yes, how much would you like?

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 ħjar 就想象菜摊上一堆绿色黄瓜，再把它们切片拌进沙拉，用买菜和做菜两个场景巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Imaginary; existing in the imagination rather than as something real.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 存在于想象中、并非实际存在的；虚构的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jeżisti fl-immaġinazzjoni u mhux fir-realtà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 想象中的；虚构的，并非真实存在的。

formal.mt: Ir-rumanz iseħħ f'pajjiż ħjieli li l-awtur jiddeskrivi fid-dettall.
formal.en: The novel takes place in an imaginary country that the author describes in detail.
formal.zh: 这部小说发生在一个虚构的国家，作者对它作了详细描写。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-post jeżisti tassew? Leo: Le, hu post ħjieli li ħloqt għall-istorja tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this place really exist? Leo: No, it's an imaginary place I created for my story.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个地方真的存在吗？利奥：不存在，这是我为自己的故事创造的虚构地点。

messages.speaker: Maja (读者)
messages.zh: 这个地方真的存在吗？
messages.en: Does this place really exist?

messages.speaker: Leo (故事作者)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hu post ħjieli li ħloqt għall-istorja tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hu post ħjieli li ħloqt għall-istorja tiegħi.
messages.zh: 不存在，这是我为自己的故事创造的虚构地点。
messages.en: No, it's an imaginary place I created for my story.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħjieli 配上一张自己画的幻想地图：故事里有这个国家，现实地图上找不到，便记住“想象中的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The exercise of authority over a country, community, or group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对国家、社群或群体行使权力，进行统治或治理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-eżerċizzju tas-setgħa fuq pajjiż, komunità jew grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 统治；对某个国家或群体行使支配权。
治理；管理国家或社群的公共事务。

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina kif il-ħkim barrani biddel il-ħajja ta' kuljum tal-popolazzjoni.
formal.en: The study examines how foreign rule changed the population's everyday life.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察外国统治如何改变当地居民的日常生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dwar xiex inhu dan il-ktieb? Pawlu: Dwar il-ħajja taħt il-ħkim barrani.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this book about? Pawlu: About life under foreign rule.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这本书讲什么？保罗：讲外国统治下的生活。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这本书讲什么？
messages.en: What is this book about?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 讲外国统治下的生活。
messages.en: About life under foreign rule.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“谁在行使权力”的画面里记：谈国家受谁统治、公共事务由谁治理时想到 ħkim。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short spell of rain that soon passes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 持续时间很短、很快就会过去的一阵雨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Perjodu qasir ta' xita li jgħaddi malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一阵短雨；短暂的降雨时段。

formal.mt: Wara ħlejba xita filgħodu, l-attivitajiet fil-beraħ komplew kif ippjanat.
formal.en: After a brief spell of rain in the morning, the outdoor activities continued as planned.
formal.zh: 早晨一阵短雨过后，户外活动按计划继续进行。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Se nistennew qabel noħorġu? Mark: Iva, hemm ħlejba xita. Noħorġu meta tieqaf.
colloquial.en: Lara: Shall we wait before going out? Mark: Yes, there's a brief spell of rain. We'll go out when it stops.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们等一等再出去吗？马克：好，现在正下一阵短雨。等雨停了再出去。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们等一等再出去吗？
messages.en: Shall we wait before going out?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm ħlejba xita. Noħorġu meta tieqaf.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm ħlejba xita. Noħorġu meta tieqaf.
messages.zh: 好，现在正下一阵短雨。等雨停了再出去。
messages.en: Yes, there's a brief spell of rain. We'll go out when it stops.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刚撑开伞，雨就停了：ħlejba 的记忆重点是“雨只下一小会儿”，不是整天阴雨。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small mouth, expressed by the diminutive form of ħalq.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小嘴；ħalq（嘴）的指小形式，用来表示嘴很小。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħalq żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva tal-kelma ħalq.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small mouth (the diminutive form of 'ħalq')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小嘴；ħalq（嘴）的指小形式。

formal.mt: Fl-istampa, it-tarbija tidher rieqda bil-ħlejjaq magħluq.
formal.en: In the picture, the baby is shown asleep with its little mouth closed.
formal.zh: 画面中的婴儿正闭着小嘴睡觉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara l-ħlejjaq tat-tarbija! Nina: Iva, fetħitu biex titbissem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at the baby's little mouth! Nina: Yes, she opened it to smile.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看宝宝的小嘴！妮娜：是啊，她张开小嘴笑了。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 看宝宝的小嘴！
messages.en: Look at the baby's little mouth!

messages.speaker: Nina (母亲)
messages.zh: 是啊，她张开小嘴笑了。
messages.en: Yes, she opened it to smile.

cognitive_memory_aid: 本词条把 ħalq“嘴”缩成宝宝的“小嘴”来记；看到 ħlejjaq，就回想小嘴张开又闭上的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a mildly sweet taste.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有轻微甜味的；吃起来或喝起来有点甜的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu togħma xi ftit ħelwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 略甜的；带一点甜味的。

formal.mt: Il-meraq huwa ħlejju u jista' jiġi servut mal-kolazzjon.
formal.en: The juice is mildly sweet and can be served with breakfast.
formal.zh: 这种果汁略带甜味，可以在早餐时饮用。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif inhu dan il-meraq? Lara: Ħlejju. Togħġobni t-togħma tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Mark: What's this juice like? Lara: Slightly sweet. I like its taste.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这果汁味道怎么样？拉拉：有点甜。我喜欢这个味道。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 这果汁味道怎么样？
messages.en: What's this juice like?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 有点甜。我喜欢这个味道。
messages.en: Slightly sweet. I like its taste.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象喝一口果汁，舌尖只尝到一点甜：ħlejju 要连着“略微、有点”的程度一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An individual living being, such as an animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个有生命的个体，例如一只动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entità ħajja individwali, bħal annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生物；动物等有生命的个体。
生命个体；有生命的东西。

formal.mt: Kull ħlejqa f'dan l-ambjent għandha rwol fis-sistema ekoloġika.
formal.en: Every living thing in this environment has a role in the ecosystem.
formal.zh: 这个环境中的每一个生命个体都在生态系统中发挥作用。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'hemm taħt dik il-werqa? Pawlu: Ħlejqa żgħira. Ejja nħalluha hemm.
colloquial.en: Nina: What's under that leaf? Pawlu: A small creature. Let's leave it there.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：那片叶子下面有什么？保罗：一只小生物。我们就让它待在那里吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 那片叶子下面有什么？
messages.en: What's under that leaf?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 一只小生物。我们就让它待在那里吧。
messages.en: A small creature. Let's leave it there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象翻开叶子，发现一个会动的小生命：ħlejqa 指那个生物个体，大小可以用别的词补充。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of extracting milk from an animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从动物身上挤取乳汁的动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih jinġabar il-ħalib minn annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挤奶；从动物身上挤取乳汁的过程。

formal.mt: Il-ħlib tal-baqar isir kuljum skont proċeduri ta' iġjene stretti.
formal.en: The cows are milked daily according to strict hygiene procedures.
formal.zh: 每天都按照严格的卫生程序给奶牛挤奶。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Meta jibda l-ħlib? Ġużeppi: Fis-sitta. Tista' tiġi tara kif isir.
colloquial.en: Mark: When does the milking start? Ġużeppi: At six. You can come and see how it's done.
colloquial.zh: 马克：什么时候开始挤奶？朱塞佩：六点。你可以过来看看怎么挤。

messages.speaker: Mark (农场访客)
messages.zh: 什么时候开始挤奶？
messages.en: When does the milking start?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农场主)
messages.mt_spoken: Fis-sitta. Tista' tiġi tara kif isir.
messages.mt_standard: Fis-sitta. Tista' tiġi tara kif isir.
messages.zh: 六点。你可以过来看看怎么挤。
messages.en: At six. You can come and see how it's done.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“动作与产物”配对记：ħlib 是挤奶这个过程，ħalib 是挤出来的奶；脑中分别放一双手和一桶奶。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of bringing something into existence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某种事物产生、出现或存在的创造行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li bih xi ħaġa tinġieb fl-eżistenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 创造这一行为；使事物产生或存在的过程。

formal.mt: L-awtur iqabbel żewġ rakkonti dwar il-ħliq tad-dinja.
formal.en: The author compares two accounts of the creation of the world.
formal.zh: 作者比较了两个关于世界创生的叙事。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dwar xiex kienet il-lezzjoni llum? Maja: Dwar rakkont tal-ħliq tad-dinja.
colloquial.en: Lara: What was today's lesson about? Maja: About a story of the creation of the world.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：今天的课讲了什么？玛雅：讲了一个关于世界创生的故事。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 今天的课讲了什么？
messages.en: What was today's lesson about?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 讲了一个关于世界创生的故事。
messages.en: About a story of the creation of the world.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张空白画面逐渐出现世界：ħliq 记的是“使之出现”的创造行为，把注意力放在产生的过程上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of freeing someone or something from captivity, restriction, or control.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或事物摆脱囚禁、束缚或控制的释放、解放行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li bih persuna jew ħaġa tinħeles mill-jasar, minn restrizzjoni jew minn kontroll.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 释放；使人或动物恢复自由。
解放；使人或群体摆脱束缚、压迫或控制。

collocations.zh: 摆脱奴役；从束缚中解放

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jipprovdi għall-ħlis tal-priġunieri sa tmiem ix-xahar.
formal.en: The agreement provides for the release of the prisoners by the end of the month.
formal.zh: 协议规定在本月底前释放囚犯。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Meta se jsir il-ħlis tal-għasfur? Nina: Għada, jekk ikun jista' jtir sew.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: When will the bird be released? Nina: Tomorrow, if it can fly properly.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：什么时候放飞这只鸟？妮娜：明天，前提是它能正常飞行。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (救护志愿者)
messages.zh: 什么时候放飞这只鸟？
messages.en: When will the bird be released?

messages.speaker: Nina (救护工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għada, jekk ikun jista' jtir sew.
messages.mt_standard: Għada, jekk ikun jista' jtir sew.
messages.zh: 明天，前提是它能正常飞行。
messages.en: Tomorrow, if it can fly properly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象笼门打开，小鸟重新飞向天空：ħlis 表示让受限制者恢复自由，可联系“释放”和“解放”一起记。

gloss_zh: 嘴馋的；想吃某种食物的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a particular desire to eat a certain kind of food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 特别想吃某一种食物的，侧重嘴馋或对特定食物的渴望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkollu xewqa li jiekol xi ikel partikolari.

sense_translations.en_definition: having a craving for some kind of food
sense_translations.zh_definition: 嘴馋的；特别想吃某种食物的

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, Pawlu kiteb li kien ħluqi għall-ħobż frisk li kienet tagħmel ommu.
formal.en: In his letter, Pawlu wrote that he was craving the fresh bread his mother used to make.
formal.zh: 保罗在信中写道，他特别想吃母亲以前做的新鲜面包。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Illum jien ħluqi għaċ-ċikkulata. Sara: Għandi ftit id-dar. Trid biċċa?
colloquial.en: Mark: I'm craving chocolate today. Sara: I've got some at home. Would you like a piece?
colloquial.zh: 马克：我今天特别想吃巧克力。萨拉：我家里有一些。你想来一块吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我今天特别想吃巧克力。
messages.en: I'm craving chocolate today.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我家里有一些。你想来一块吗？
messages.en: I've got some at home. Would you like a piece?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象眼睛盯着巧克力、心里一直惦记的样子，把 ħluqi 和“特别馋这一口”一起记。

gloss_zh: 迅速的；容易的；自然的；自由的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Natural or easy, without strain or constraint; also used with the senses prompt and free.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容自然、轻松而不受拘束的状态；另有迅速、容易和自由等义，具体依语境判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun naturali jew faċli, mingħajr sforz jew xkiel; jista' jfisser ukoll fil-pront jew ħieles.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 迅速的；及时的；不拖延的
容易的；轻松的；不费力的
自然的；不做作的
自由的；不受拘束的

formal.mt: Fir-reċensjoni, il-kritiku ddeskriva l-moviment tal-attur bħala ħlusi, naturali u mingħajr sforz.
formal.en: In the review, the critic described the actor's movement as natural and effortless.
formal.zh: 评论家在剧评中将演员的动作描述为自然轻松、毫不费力。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-ġest jidher ħlusi? Toni: Iva, jidher naturali, qisek m'intix taħseb fih.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this gesture look natural? Toni: Yes, it looks natural, as if you're not thinking about it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个姿势看起来自然吗？托尼：嗯，看起来自然，就像你没有刻意去想一样。

messages.speaker: Lara (戏剧学员)
messages.zh: 这个姿势看起来自然吗？
messages.en: Does this gesture look natural?

messages.speaker: Toni (戏剧老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jidher naturali, qisek m'intix taħseb fih.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jidher naturali, qisek m'intix taħseb fih.
messages.zh: 嗯，看起来自然，就像你没有刻意去想一样。
messages.en: Yes, it looks natural, as if you're not thinking about it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“动作自然、做来轻松、没有拘束”的画面串联几个义项；遇到具体句子，再判断是否表示迅速。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of being free, with the ability to choose or act without undue restriction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 自由，即能够作出选择或采取行动而不受不当限制的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' min hu ħieles u jista' jagħżel jew jaġixxi mingħajr restrizzjonijiet mhux xierqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自由；不受束缚的状态
自由；自主选择和行动的空间
自由；个人能够自主选择或行动的状态

formal.mt: L-awtur jargumenta li l-ħlusija tal-individwu għandha tkun akkumpanjata minn rispett lejn l-oħrajn.
formal.en: The author argues that individual liberty should be accompanied by respect for others.
formal.zh: 作者认为，个人自由应当伴随着对他人的尊重。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex tħobb tgħix waħdek? Pawlu: Għax ngħożż il-ħlusija li nagħżel kif inqatta' l-ġurnata.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why do you like living alone? Pawlu: Because I cherish the freedom to choose how I spend my day.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么喜欢独自生活？保罗：因为我珍惜自由安排一天生活的空间。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么喜欢独自生活？
messages.en: Why do you like living alone?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ngħożż il-ħlusija li nagħżel kif inqatta' l-ġurnata.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ngħożż il-ħlusija li nagħżel kif inqatta' l-ġurnata.
messages.zh: 因为我珍惜自由安排一天生活的空间。
messages.en: Because I cherish the freedom to choose how I spend my day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面前有几条路，可以自己决定走哪条，把 ħlusija 记成“能够自主选择的自由”。

gloss_zh: 小负载；小担子；少量搬运物

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small load to be carried; the diminutive form of ħemel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 需要搬运的一小份东西或一个小担子，是 ħemel 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħbija żgħira li tinġarr; il-forma diminuttiva ta' ħemel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小负载；一小担东西，是 ħemel 的指小形式

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ġarr ħmejjel ħatab mill-maħżen sal-kċina.
formal.en: The worker carried a small load of firewood from the storeroom to the kitchen.
formal.zh: 工人把一小担柴火从储藏室搬到了厨房。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għandek bżonn l-għajnuna biex iġġorr dak? Ġużeppi: Le, grazzi. Dan ħmejjel biss; nista' nġorru waħdi.
colloquial.en: Marija: Do you need help carrying that? Ġużeppi: No, thanks. It's only a small load; I can carry it myself.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：搬那个需要帮忙吗？朱塞佩：不用，谢谢。只是一小份东西，我自己搬得动。

messages.speaker: Marija (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek bżonn l-għajnuna biex iġġorr dak?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek bżonn l-għajnuna biex iġġorr dak?
messages.zh: 搬那个需要帮忙吗？
messages.en: Do you need help carrying that?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, grazzi. Dan ħmejjel biss; nista' nġorru waħdi.
messages.mt_standard: Le, grazzi. Dan ħmejjel biss; nista' nġorru waħdi.
messages.zh: 不用，谢谢。只是一小份东西，我自己搬得动。
messages.en: No, thanks. It's only a small load; I can carry it myself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħmejjel 想成一次抱得走的一小捆柴；重点记住负载的“小”，不要只记成泛指货物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A boil: a localized swollen lump on the skin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 疖，即皮肤上局部隆起的疖肿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nefħa lokalizzata fil-ġilda li tissejjaħ ukoll tagħlija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 皮肤上的疖；疖肿

formal.mt: Il-pazjent qal li kellu ħmewwa fuq id-driegħ li kienet tuġgħu.
formal.en: The patient said that he had a painful boil on his arm.
formal.zh: 患者说，他手臂上长了一个疼痛的疖肿。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex trid appuntament mat-tabib? David: Għandi ħmewwa fuq id-driegħ u qed tweġġagħni.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why do you want a doctor's appointment? David: I've got a boil on my arm, and it hurts.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你为什么想预约看医生？戴维：我手臂上长了个疖，很疼。

messages.speaker: Rita (诊所接待员)
messages.zh: 你为什么想预约看医生？
messages.en: Why do you want a doctor's appointment?

messages.speaker: David (患者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi ħmewwa fuq id-driegħ u qed tweġġagħni.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi ħmewwa fuq id-driegħ u qed tweġġagħni.
messages.zh: 我手臂上长了个疖，很疼。
messages.en: I've got a boil on my arm, and it hurts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“手臂上鼓起一个疼痛的疖”的具体画面记 ħmewwa，并把它和表示沸腾的英语 boil 区分开。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Stillness: a state in which there is little or no movement or sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 静止或静谧，指几乎没有动静、运动或声音的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' kwiet li fih ma jkun hemm kważi ebda moviment jew ħoss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 静止；寂静；没有动静的状态

formal.mt: Fil-ħmied tal-lejl, il-passi tal-vjaġġatur kienu jinstemgħu minn tarf it-triq.
formal.en: In the stillness of the night, the traveller's footsteps could be heard from the end of the street.
formal.zh: 夜晚一片静谧，从街道尽头就能听见旅人的脚步声。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Hawn ħmied sħiħ dalgħodu. Ben: Iva, lanqas il-weraq mhu qed jiċċaqlaq.
colloquial.en: Anna: It's completely still here this morning. Ben: Yes, even the leaves aren't moving.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：今天早上这里一点动静也没有。本：是啊，连树叶都没有动。

messages.speaker: Anna (散步的朋友)
messages.zh: 今天早上这里一点动静也没有。
messages.en: It's completely still here this morning.

messages.speaker: Ben (散步的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, lanqas il-weraq mhu qed jiċċaqlaq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, lanqas il-weraq mhu qed jiċċaqlaq.
messages.zh: 是啊，连树叶都没有动。
messages.en: Yes, even the leaves aren't moving.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象夜里风停、树叶不动、四周无声，把 ħmied 记成整个场景都安静下来的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 15,000, equal to fifteen groups of one thousand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数词一万五千，即十五个一千，写作 15,000。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 15,000, jiġifieri ħmistax immultiplikat b'elf.

formal.mt: L-organizzazzjoni ġabret ħmistax-il elf ewro biex tixtri tagħmir ġdid għall-iskola.
formal.en: The organization raised fifteen thousand euros to buy new equipment for the school.
formal.zh: 该组织筹集了一万五千欧元，用于为学校购买新设备。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm tiswa din il-karozza? Lara: Ħmistax-il elf ewro, skont ir-reklam.
colloquial.en: Mark: How much does this car cost? Lara: Fifteen thousand euros, according to the advertisement.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这辆车多少钱？拉拉：广告上说是一万五千欧元。

messages.speaker: Mark (购车者)
messages.zh: 这辆车多少钱？
messages.en: How much does this car cost?

messages.speaker: Lara (陪同看车的朋友)
messages.zh: 广告上说是一万五千欧元。
messages.en: Fifteen thousand euros, according to the advertisement.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先按“十五个一千”算出 15,000，再换成中文的一万五千；跟读时把 ħmistax-il elf 连成一个数词单位。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Redness: the red colour or appearance of something, including skin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 红色或发红的状态，可用于描述皮肤等事物呈现出的红色外观。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kulur jew id-dehra ħamra ta' xi ħaġa, inkluża l-ġilda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 红色；发红；呈现红色的状态

formal.mt: Wara l-ġirja, kienet tidher ħmurija ħafifa fuq wiċċ l-atleta.
formal.en: After the run, a slight redness was visible on the athlete's face.
formal.zh: 跑步后，运动员的脸上能看出轻微的红晕。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għad għandi ħmurija f'wiċċi? Nina: Iva, ftit. Għadek kif spiċċajt tiġri.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is my face still red? Nina: Yes, a little. You've only just finished running.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我的脸还红着吗？妮娜：嗯，还有一点。你才刚跑完步。

messages.speaker: Sara (跑步者)
messages.zh: 我的脸还红着吗？
messages.en: Is my face still red?

messages.speaker: Nina (跑步的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ftit. Għadek kif spiċċajt tiġri.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ftit. Għadek kif spiċċajt tiġri.
messages.zh: 嗯，还有一点。你才刚跑完步。
messages.en: Yes, a little. You've only just finished running.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象跑完步照镜子，看到脸上的红晕；用 ħmurija 指那一片“发红的状态”，而不是发红这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small trench or ditch; the diminutive of 'ħandaq'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小型沟渠或壕沟，是 ħandaq 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħandaq żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva ta' 'ħandaq'.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small trench (the diminutive form of 'ħandaq')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小沟；小壕沟，是 ħandaq 的指小形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħandaq żgħir.

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar ħaffer ħnejdaq madwar is-siġra biex l-ilma jasal sal-għeruq.
formal.en: The gardener dug a small trench around the tree so that the water would reach the roots.
formal.zh: 园丁在树周围挖了一条小沟，让水流到树根处。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għaliex qed tħaffer ħnejdaq hawn? Pawlu: Biex l-ilma jgħaddi lejn il-pjanti.
colloquial.en: Lina: Why are you digging a small trench here? Pawlu: So the water can flow towards the plants.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你为什么在这里挖小沟？保罗：让水流向那些植物。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么在这里挖小沟？
messages.en: Why are you digging a small trench here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园丁)
messages.zh: 让水流向那些植物。
messages.en: So the water can flow towards the plants.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħandaq 想成壕沟，再把画面缩小成树边引水的小沟，记住 ħnejdaq 的指小意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small worm; the diminutive of 'ħanex'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体型很小的蠕虫，是 ħanex 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħanex żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva ta' 'ħanex'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小蠕虫，是 ħanex 的指小形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħanex żgħir.

collocations.en: a small worm in the soil

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-ħamrija, l-istudenta sabet ħnejjex taħt werqa.
formal.en: While observing the soil, the student found a small worm under a leaf.
formal.zh: 观察土壤时，这名学生在一片叶子下面发现了一条小蠕虫。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara, hemm ħnejjex taħt il-werqa! Toni: Ħallih hemm; ejja naraw kif jiċċaqlaq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look, there's a small worm under the leaf! Toni: Leave it there; let's watch how it moves.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看，叶子下面有一条小蠕虫！托尼：让它待在那里吧，我们看看它怎么动。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 看，叶子下面有一条小蠕虫！
messages.en: Look, there's a small worm under the leaf!

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħallih hemm; ejja naraw kif jiċċaqlaq.
messages.mt_standard: Ħallih hemm; ejja naraw kif jiċċaqlaq.
messages.zh: 让它待在那里吧，我们看看它怎么动。
messages.en: Leave it there; let's watch how it moves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħanex 和 ħnejjex 配成大小两张虫子图片；看到后者，就想起叶片下的小蠕虫。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small pig; the diminutive of 'ħanżir'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体型小的猪，是 ħanżir 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħanżir żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva ta' 'ħanżir'.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small pig (the diminutive form of 'ħanżir')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小猪，是 ħanżir 的指小形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħanżir żgħir.

collocations.en: a small pig on the farm

formal.mt: Matul iż-żjara fir-razzett, it-tfal raw ħnejżer jiekol ħdejn ommu.
formal.en: During the farm visit, the children saw a small pig eating beside its mother.
formal.zh: 参观农场时，孩子们看见一只小猪在猪妈妈旁边进食。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nista' nitma' lill-ħnejżer? Mark: Iva, imma uża l-ikel li tak il-bidwi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can I feed the little pig? Mark: Yes, but use the food the farmer gave you.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我可以喂那只小猪吗？马克：可以，不过要用农场主给你的食物。

messages.speaker: Sara (女儿)
messages.zh: 我可以喂那只小猪吗？
messages.en: Can I feed the little pig?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma uża l-ikel li tak il-bidwi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma uża l-ikel li tak il-bidwi.
messages.zh: 可以，不过要用农场主给你的食物。
messages.en: Yes, but use the food the farmer gave you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħanżir 的猪形象缩小，想成跟在猪妈妈旁边的小猪，用这幅画记住 ħnejżer。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of strangling: squeezing someone's neck so that they cannot breathe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 勒住或掐住他人颈部、使其无法呼吸的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tagħfas għonq xi ħadd b'mod li ma jkunx jista' jieħu n-nifs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 勒颈；扼颈，使人无法呼吸的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li tagħfas għonq xi ħadd u twaqqaflu n-nifs.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi każ ta' ħniq u jiġbor ix-xhieda dwar l-inċident.
formal.en: The report describes a case of strangling and brings together the testimony about the incident.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一起勒颈事件，并汇集了有关该事件的证词。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi tfisser 'ħniq' f'dan ir-rapport? David: Tfisser li xi ħadd jagħfas għonq persuna u ma jħallihiex tieħu n-nifs.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does 'ħniq' mean in this report? David: It means someone squeezing a person's neck and preventing them from breathing.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这份报告里的 ħniq 是什么意思？戴维：指有人勒住或掐住一个人的颈部，使其无法呼吸。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: 这份报告里的 ħniq 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ħniq' mean in this report?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li xi ħadd jagħfas għonq persuna u ma jħallihiex tieħu n-nifs.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li xi ħadd jagħfas għonq persuna u ma jħallihiex tieħu n-nifs.
messages.zh: 指有人勒住或掐住一个人的颈部，使其无法呼吸。
messages.en: It means someone squeezing a person's neck and preventing them from breathing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“颈部受压、呼吸受阻”这组关键词记住 ħniq，并把整个词当作行为名词来学。

gloss_zh: 与猪有关的事物；肮脏邋遢；粗劣的工作

teaching_sense.en_definition: Filth or squalor, or work done very badly; the word also has a sense relating to pigs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指肮脏邋遢的状态，或做得很差的工作；另有与猪有关的义项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħmieġ jew nuqqas ta' ndafa, jew xogħol magħmul ħażin ħafna; il-kelma għandha wkoll sens marbut mal-ħnieżer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与猪有关的事物或事项。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dak li għandu x'jaqsam mal-ħnieżer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肮脏邋遢、污秽不洁的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stat ta' ħmieġ u nuqqas ta' ndafa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 做得很差的工作；粗制滥造的活儿。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xogħol magħmul ħażin.

collocations.en: to leave a filthy mess behind

formal.mt: Fl-ilment tiegħu, il-klijent iddeskriva t-tiswija bħala ħniżrija ta' xogħol minħabba l-ħafna difetti.
formal.en: In his complaint, the customer described the repair as a badly botched job because of its many defects.
formal.zh: 顾客在投诉中指出，这次维修有许多缺陷，活儿做得一塌糊涂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ħniżrija ħallejna fil-kċina! Toni: Għandek raġun; ejja naħslu l-platti u nnaddfu l-mejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: What a filthy mess we've left in the kitchen! Toni: You're right; let's wash the dishes and clean the table.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们把厨房弄得真脏乱！托尼：你说得对，我们来洗碗、擦桌子吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 我们把厨房弄得真脏乱！
messages.en: What a filthy mess we've left in the kitchen!

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun; ejja naħslu l-platti u nnaddfu l-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun; ejja naħslu l-platti u nnaddfu l-mejda.
messages.zh: 你说得对，我们来洗碗、擦桌子吧。
messages.en: You're right; let's wash the dishes and clean the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做三张义项卡：“与猪有关”“环境脏乱”“活儿粗劣”；用语境选择 ħniżrija 的具体意思，不把三个义项混成一个。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bosom: the chest or breast area, especially as a place where someone or something is held close.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 胸前或胸怀，尤其指将人或物贴近胸前搂抱的位置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-sider jew il-parti ta' quddiem tal-ġisem fejn wieħed jista' jħaddan lil xi ħadd jew iżomm xi ħaġa qrib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胸怀；怀抱；胸前部位。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-sider, speċjalment bħala l-post fejn wieħed iħaddan lil xi ħadd.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel sab il-faraġ f'ħobb ommu wara ġurnata diffiċli.
formal.en: In the story, the boy found comfort in his mother's bosom after a difficult day.
formal.zh: 故事中，男孩在经历了艰难的一天后，在母亲怀中得到了安慰。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser 'f'ħobb ommu' f'din l-istorja? Marija: Jiġifieri f'idejn ommu, qrib sidirha.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does 'f'ħobb ommu' mean in this story? Marija: It means in his mother's arms, close to her chest.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个故事里的 f'ħobb ommu 是什么意思？玛丽亚：就是在他妈妈怀里，贴近她的胸前。

messages.speaker: Sara (女儿)
messages.zh: 这个故事里的 f'ħobb ommu 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'f'ħobb ommu' mean in this story?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 就是在他妈妈怀里，贴近她的胸前。
messages.en: It means in his mother's arms, close to her chest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到名词 ħobb，就想起孩子贴在母亲胸前的画面，用“胸前的怀抱”把位置和含义连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Mallow, a type of plant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 锦葵，一种植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta magħrufa bl-isem Ingliż 'mallow'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锦葵。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-pjanta msejħa 'mallow' bl-Ingliż.

formal.mt: Fl-attività tal-botanika, l-istudenti osservaw il-weraq u l-fjuri tal-ħobbejż.
formal.en: In the botany activity, the students observed the leaves and flowers of the mallow.
formal.zh: 在植物学活动中，学生们观察了锦葵的叶子和花。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'jisimha din il-pjanta? Pawlu: Ħobbejż. Ejja nieħdu ritratt tal-weraq u l-fjuri tagħha.
colloquial.en: Lina: What's this plant called? Pawlu: Mallow. Let's take a photo of its leaves and flowers.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这种植物叫什么？保罗：锦葵。我们给它的叶子和花拍张照吧。

messages.speaker: Lina (同学)
messages.zh: 这种植物叫什么？
messages.en: What's this plant called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħobbejż. Ejja nieħdu ritratt tal-weraq u l-fjuri tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Ħobbejż. Ejja nieħdu ritratt tal-weraq u l-fjuri tagħha.
messages.zh: 锦葵。我们给它的叶子和花拍张照吧。
messages.en: Mallow. Let's take a photo of its leaves and flowers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在锦葵照片旁并排写下 ħobbejż、mallow、锦葵，再用“叶子”和“花”两个搭配帮助巩固植物名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become pregnant; to enter the state of pregnancy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 开始怀孕，进入妊娠状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibda jkun hemm tqala.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 怀孕；开始进入妊娠状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jibda jkun hemm tqala.

formal.mt: Fil-glossarju tat-test, il-verb 'ħobol' huwa definit bħala l-bidu ta' tqala.
formal.en: In the text's glossary, the verb 'ħobol' is defined as becoming pregnant.
formal.zh: 该文本的词汇表将动词 ħobol 释为“开始怀孕”。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser il-verb 'ħobol'? David: Ifisser li tibda tqala; bl-Ingliż ngħidu 'to become pregnant'.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the verb 'ħobol' mean? David: It means that a pregnancy begins; in English, we say 'to become pregnant'.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：动词 ħobol 是什么意思？戴维：意思是开始怀孕，英语说 to become pregnant。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 动词 ħobol 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the verb 'ħobol' mean?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li tibda tqala; bl-Ingliż ngħidu 'to become pregnant'.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li tibda tqala; bl-Ingliż ngħidu 'to become pregnant'.
messages.zh: 意思是开始怀孕，英语说 to become pregnant。
messages.en: It means that a pregnancy begins; in English, we say 'to become pregnant'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħobol 放在“开始怀孕”的时间点上记忆，配对英语 become pregnant，突出进入妊娠状态这个变化。

gloss_zh: 布满孔洞的；坑坑洼洼的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having many holes or pits in its surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面有许多孔洞或凹坑的，用来描述墙壁、岩石等的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħafna toqob jew ħofor fil-wiċċ tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 布满孔洞的；表面坑坑洼洼的

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi ħajt ħofri li jeħtieġ tiswija.
formal.en: The report describes a wall riddled with holes that needs repair.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一面布满孔洞、需要修缮的墙。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara kemm hu ħofri dan il-ħajt! Mark: Iva, hemm ħafna toqob fih. Irridu nsewwuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look how full of holes this wall is! Mark: Yes, it has lots of holes. We need to repair it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看这面墙有多少洞！马克：是啊，上面有很多孔洞。我们得修一修。

messages.speaker: Maja (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm hu ħofri dan il-ħajt!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm hu ħofri dan il-ħajt!
messages.zh: 你看这面墙有多少洞！
messages.en: Look how full of holes this wall is!

messages.speaker: Mark (同住者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm ħafna toqob fih. Irridu nsewwuh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm ħafna toqob fih. Irridu nsewwuh.
messages.zh: 是啊，上面有很多孔洞。我们得修一修。
messages.en: Yes, it has lots of holes. We need to repair it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一面墙上密密麻麻都是洞，把 ħofri 和“布满孔洞的表面”一起记；它描述的是状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A team sport in which players use sticks to hit a ball or puck towards the opposing goal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 球员用球杆击打球或冰球、争取将其打入对方球门的团队运动；具体译作曲棍球或冰球取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sport bejn żewġ timijiet li fih il-plejers jużaw stikek biex jolqtu ballun jew diska lejn il-lasta tal-avversarji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 曲棍球运动；在冰上运动的语境中指冰球

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of being widespread or having the greatest presence or influence in a situation.

gloss_zh: 扼住；使窒息；使声嘶；阻碍；堵塞

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħfas il-gerżuma jew ifixkel in-nifs; jagħmel il-leħen maħnuq; jew, b'mod figurattiv, iwaqqaf żvilupp jew jimla post iżżejjed.

gloss_zh: 一次换羽；一次换毛或蜕皮

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instance of an animal shedding and replacing its feathers, fur, or outer covering.
