formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem poġġa ħoxba tal-injam taħt l-istruttura biex iżommha wieqfa.
formal.en: The worker placed a wooden beam beneath the structure to keep it upright.
formal.zh: 工人在结构下方放了一根木梁，使其保持直立。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser meta ssejjaħ lil xi ħadd ħoxba? Toni: Tfisser li hu goff u bla manjieri.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does it mean when you call someone a ħoxba? Toni: It means that he is rude and ill-mannered.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：把一个人叫作 ħoxba 是什么意思？托尼：意思是他粗鲁无礼，没有教养。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser meta ssejjaħ lil xi ħadd ħoxba?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser meta ssejjaħ lil xi ħadd ħoxba?
messages.zh: 把一个人叫作 ħoxba 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean when you call someone a ħoxba?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li hu goff u bla manjieri.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li hu goff u bla manjieri.
messages.zh: 意思是他粗鲁无礼，没有教养。
messages.en: It means that he is rude and ill-mannered.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做两张记忆卡：一张画木梁或木杆，一张写“粗鲁无礼的人”；靠语境区分物件义和贬义称呼。

gloss_zh: 粗麸皮；一种质地较粗的麸皮

teaching_sense.en_definition: A coarse variety of bran.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种质地较粗的麸皮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' nuħħala b'biċċiet relattivament kbar u ħorox.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种质地较粗的麸皮。

formal.mt: Il-kampjun fih ħoxna, tip ta' nuħħala b'biċċiet relattivament kbar.
formal.en: The sample contains coarse bran, a type of bran with relatively large particles.
formal.zh: 该样品含有粗麸皮，这是一种颗粒相对较大的麸皮。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: X'hemm f'din l-ixkora? Rita: Hemm il-ħoxna, jiġifieri tip ta' nuħħala ħarxa.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: What is in this sack? Rita: It contains ħoxna, meaning a coarse type of bran.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：这个袋子里装的是什么？丽塔：装的是 ħoxna，也就是一种粗麸皮。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个袋子里装的是什么？
messages.en: What is in this sack?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm il-ħoxna, jiġifieri tip ta' nuħħala ħarxa.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm il-ħoxna, jiġifieri tip ta' nuħħala ħarxa.
messages.zh: 装的是 ħoxna，也就是一种粗麸皮。
messages.en: It contains ħoxna, meaning a coarse type of bran.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象袋里装着颗粒较粗的麸皮，并给袋子贴上 ħoxna 标签；本词条按名词“粗麸皮”来记。

gloss_zh: 胖的；笨拙不得体的；举止粗俗的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fat in body; also socially awkward or coarse in manners.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体肥胖的；也指社交表现笨拙不得体，或举止粗俗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħafna xaħam f'ġismu; ukoll goff fl-imġiba jew bla manjieri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胖的；身体脂肪较多的。
社交表现笨拙、拘拙而不得体的。
举止粗俗的；待人缺乏礼貌和教养的。

collocations.zh: 举止粗俗或笨拙不得体

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-mistieden jidher ħoxni fl-imġiba: jaqta' kliem ħaddieħor u jagħmel kummenti bla ħsieb.
formal.en: In the story, the guest appears coarse in manner: he interrupts others and makes thoughtless comments.
formal.zh: 故事中的客人显得举止粗俗：他打断别人说话，还随口发表欠考虑的评论。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara kemm hu ħoxni dan il-qattus! Mark: Iva, imma għadu jiġri wara l-ġugarell tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look how fat this cat is! Mark: Yes, but he still runs after his toy.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看这只猫多胖！马克：是啊，不过它还是会追着自己的玩具跑。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm hu ħoxni dan il-qattus!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm hu ħoxni dan il-qattus!
messages.zh: 看这只猫多胖！
messages.en: Look how fat this cat is!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għadu jiġri wara l-ġugarell tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għadu jiġri wara l-ġugarell tiegħu.
messages.zh: 是啊，不过它还是会追着自己的玩具跑。
messages.en: Yes, but he still runs after his toy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分三格记忆：体形胖、社交笨拙、举止粗俗；看到体形或行为语境后，再选对应的中文义项。

gloss_zh: 胖婴儿；胖乎乎的小宝宝

teaching_sense.en_definition: An infant with a fat or plump body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体胖乎乎的婴儿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tarbija li għandha ġisem smin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胖婴儿；身体胖乎乎的小宝宝。

collocations.en: a plump infant in his mother's arms

formal.mt: Il-ħoxon kien rieqed bil-kwiet f'dirgħajn ommu.
formal.en: The plump infant was sleeping peacefully in his mother's arms.
formal.zh: 胖宝宝在妈妈怀里安静地睡着。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Ara l-ħoxon, raqad! Pawlu: Iva, ħallih jistrieħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Marija: Look at the plump little baby; he's fallen asleep! Pawlu: Yes, let him rest for a while.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：瞧这个胖宝宝，睡着了！保罗：是啊，让他休息一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 瞧这个胖宝宝，睡着了！
messages.en: Look at the plump little baby; he's fallen asleep!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 是啊，让他休息一会儿吧。
messages.en: Yes, let him rest for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词和妈妈怀里圆嘟嘟的宝宝联系起来，整组记住 ħoxon rieqed，意为熟睡的胖宝宝。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The horizontal ledge at the bottom of a window.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 窗户下沿的水平台面，可以用来放置花盆等物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti orizzontali fil-qiegħ ta' tieqa, li fuqha jistgħu jitqiegħdu oġġetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 窗台；窗户底部的水平台面

formal.mt: Il-pjanta tqiegħdet fuq ħoġor it-tieqa biex tirċievi aktar dawl.
formal.en: The plant was placed on the windowsill to receive more light.
formal.zh: 这株植物被放在窗台上，以获得更多光照。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn inpoġġi din il-pjanta? Pawlu: Poġġiha fuq ħoġor it-tieqa, ħdejn il-vażun.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where shall I put this plant? Pawlu: Put it on the windowsill, next to the vase.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这株植物放在哪里？保罗：放在窗台上，花瓶旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 这株植物放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall I put this plant?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġiha fuq ħoġor it-tieqa, ħdejn il-vażun.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġiha fuq ħoġor it-tieqa, ħdejn il-vażun.
messages.zh: 放在窗台上，花瓶旁边。
messages.en: Put it on the windowsill, next to the vase.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħoġor it-tieqa 当作完整短语记忆：看见窗户下方摆花盆的小平台，就联想到“窗台”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The band around the waist of a garment, such as trousers or a skirt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 裤子、裙子等衣物围在腰部的一圈带状部分，即腰头。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strixxa ta' drapp madwar il-qadd li tifforma parti minn qalziet jew dublett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 裤子或裙子等衣物的腰头；围住腰部的带状部分。

formal.mt: Dan il-qalziet għandu ħożża elastika għal aktar kumdità.
formal.en: These trousers have an elastic waistband for greater comfort.
formal.zh: 这条裤子采用松紧腰头，穿着更舒适。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-ħożża ta' dan il-qalziet issikkani wisq. Rita: Nista' nwessagħha ftit.
colloquial.en: Mark: The waistband of these trousers is too tight on me. Rita: I can widen it a little.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这条裤子的腰头勒得我太紧了。丽塔：我可以把它稍微放宽一点。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħożża ta' dan il-qalziet issikkani wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħożża ta' dan il-qalziet issikkani wisq.
messages.zh: 这条裤子的腰头勒得我太紧了。
messages.en: The waistband of these trousers is too tight on me.

messages.speaker: Rita (裁缝)
messages.zh: 我可以把它稍微放宽一点。
messages.en: I can widen it a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象裤腰上围成一圈的布料，用手指沿腰头画一圈，再记 ħożża elastika 是松紧腰头。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Harsh and unjust treatment that keeps people under another person's or group's control.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以严酷、不公正的方式控制或对待他人的行为或处境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Trattament aħrax u inġust li jżomm lin-nies taħt il-kontroll ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 压迫；使人遭受严酷、不公正控制的行为或状态。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddokumenta l-ħqir tal-ħaddiema u jitlob li jitħarsu d-drittijiet tagħhom.
formal.en: The report documents the oppression of workers and calls for their rights to be protected.
formal.zh: 报告记录了工人遭受的压迫，并呼吁保障他们的权利。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-ħaddiema qed jipprotestaw? David: Qed jipprotestaw kontra l-ħqir fuq il-post tax-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are the workers protesting? David: They are protesting against oppression in the workplace.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：工人们为什么在抗议？戴维：他们在抗议工作场所的压迫。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 工人们为什么在抗议？
messages.en: Why are the workers protesting?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed jipprotestaw kontra l-ħqir fuq il-post tax-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Qed jipprotestaw kontra l-ħqir fuq il-post tax-xogħol.
messages.zh: 他们在抗议工作场所的压迫。
messages.en: They are protesting against oppression in the workplace.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一幅有人被不公平力量压住的画面记住 ħqir，再连着记 kontra l-ħqir，表示反对压迫。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small or brief escape, expressed as a diminutive of 'ħarba'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小规模或短暂的逃离、脱身，是 ħarba 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħarba żgħira jew qasira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' 'ħarba'.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small escape (the diminutive form of 'ħarba')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小小的逃离或短暂脱身；ħarba 的指小形式。

collocations.en: a little escape from the noise

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, għamel ħrajba qasira biex jieħu ftit arja.
formal.en: During the meeting, he slipped away briefly to get some air.
formal.zh: 开会期间，他短暂离开了一会儿，出去透透气。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi bżonn ħrajba mill-istorbju. Ben: Ejja noħorġu għal ftit minuti.
colloquial.en: Lara: I need a little escape from the noise. Ben: Let's go outside for a few minutes.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我得暂时躲开这些吵闹声。本：我们出去待几分钟吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我得暂时躲开这些吵闹声。
messages.en: I need a little escape from the noise.

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们出去待几分钟吧。
messages.en: Let's go outside for a few minutes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħarba 想成一次逃离，再把画面缩小为出去透几分钟气，便能记住指小形式 ħrajba。

gloss_zh: 引起刺激或瘙痒的真菌性皮肤病

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fungal skin disease, called thrush, that causes irritation or itching.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种称为 thrush、会引起皮肤刺激或瘙痒的真菌性皮肤病。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marda tal-ġilda kkawżata minn fungi li ġġib irritazzjoni jew ħakk.

sense_translations.en_definition: thrush (a fungal skin disease resulting in irritation or itch)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 真菌性皮肤病，称为 thrush，可导致皮肤刺激或瘙痒。

collocations.zh: 这种真菌性皮肤病引起的瘙痒

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi ħrar tal-ġilda li jikkawża irritazzjoni u ħakk.
formal.en: The report describes thrush affecting the skin and causing irritation and itching.
formal.zh: 报告描述了引起皮肤刺激和瘙痒的真菌性皮肤病。

colloquial.mt: Mark: It-tabib qal li dan il-ħakk ġej mill-ħrar. Lara: Se nniżżel dan fil-fajl tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Mark: The doctor said this itching is caused by thrush. Lara: I'll record that in your file.
colloquial.zh: 马克：医生说，这种瘙痒是这种真菌性皮肤病引起的。拉拉：我会把这点记在你的病历里。

messages.speaker: Mark (患者)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tabib qal li dan il-ħakk ġej mill-ħrar.
messages.mt_standard: It-tabib qal li dan il-ħakk ġej mill-ħrar.
messages.zh: 医生说，这种瘙痒是这种真菌性皮肤病引起的。
messages.en: The doctor said this itching is caused by thrush.

messages.speaker: Lara (护士)
messages.zh: 我会把这点记在你的病历里。
messages.en: I'll record that in your file.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用皮肤发痒的情景记住 ħrar，并把 ħakk minħabba l-ħrar 整组记成由这种真菌性皮肤病引起的瘙痒。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become rough in texture or stern in manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面变得粗糙，或人的态度变得严厉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jsir aħrax fil-wiċċ jew aktar sever fl-imġiba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得粗糙。
变得严厉；态度变得严肃而严格。

formal.mt: Il-kap ħrax meta l-istess żball reġa' deher fir-rapport.
formal.en: The manager became stern when the same mistake appeared in the report again.
formal.zh: 当报告中再次出现同一个错误时，主管的态度变得严厉起来。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-wiċċ ta' dan l-injam ħrax. Toni: Iva, m'għadux lixx bħal qabel.
colloquial.en: Nina: The surface of this wood has become rough. Toni: Yes, it isn't smooth like before anymore.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这块木头的表面变粗糙了。托尼：是啊，已经不像以前那么光滑了。

messages.speaker: Nina (木工学徒)
messages.zh: 这块木头的表面变粗糙了。
messages.en: The surface of this wood has become rough.

messages.speaker: Toni (木工师傅)
messages.zh: 是啊，已经不像以前那么光滑了。
messages.en: Yes, it isn't smooth like before anymore.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排想象两幅变化画面：木面由光滑变粗糙，主管由温和变严厉；两幅都用动词 ħrax 来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short tale that can be told or read in a brief time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 篇幅较短、可以在较短时间内讲述或读完的故事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Storja qasira li tista' tingħad jew tinqara fi ftit ħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 短篇故事；简短的小故事。

formal.mt: L-awtur jiftaħ il-ktieb b'ħrejfa dwar tifel li jitgħallem jaqsam ma' ħaddieħor.
formal.en: The author opens the book with a short tale about a boy who learns to share with others.
formal.zh: 作者以一个男孩学会与他人分享的小故事作为全书的开篇。

colloquial.mt: Ella: Tgħidli ħrejfa qabel norqod? Pawlu: Iva, waħda qasira dwar qattus.
colloquial.en: Ella: Will you tell me a short tale before I go to sleep? Pawlu: Yes, a short one about a cat.
colloquial.zh: 埃拉：睡觉前给我讲个小故事好吗？保罗：好，讲一个关于猫的小故事。

messages.speaker: Ella (女儿)
messages.zh: 睡觉前给我讲个小故事好吗？
messages.en: Will you tell me a short tale before I go to sleep?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 好，讲一个关于猫的小故事。
messages.en: Yes, a short one about a cat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象睡前只讲几分钟的小故事，把 ħrejfa 和 qabel l-irqad 连起来记，突出故事篇幅短。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of escaping from a place or situation, or evading something; also, war.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从某个地方或处境中逃脱，或回避某事的行为；另有战争之义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħarba minn post jew sitwazzjoni, evitar ta' xi ħaġa, jew gwerra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逃脱；逃离某个地方或处境。
逃避；回避某事、某项责任或某种处境。
战争。

collocations.en: the war between the two countries

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-ħrib tal-priġunieri matul il-lejl.
formal.en: The report describes the prisoners' escape during the night.
formal.zh: 报告描述了囚犯在夜间逃脱的经过。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ħrib mir-responsabbiltà mhux se jsolvi l-problema. Mark: Għandek raġun; ejja nitkellmu dwar x'nistgħu nagħmlu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Evading responsibility won't solve the problem. Mark: You're right; let's talk about what we can do.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：逃避责任解决不了问题。马克：你说得对，我们谈谈能做些什么吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħrib mir-responsabbiltà mhux se jsolvi l-problema.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħrib mir-responsabbiltà mhux se jsolvi l-problema.
messages.zh: 逃避责任解决不了问题。
messages.en: Evading responsibility won't solve the problem.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun; ejja nitkellmu dwar x'nistgħu nagħmlu.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun; ejja nitkellmu dwar x'nistgħu nagħmlu.
messages.zh: 你说得对，我们谈谈能做些什么吧。
messages.en: You're right; let's talk about what we can do.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ħrib 配三张情景卡：逃出险境、回避责任、两国交战；分开记住三个义项，再靠上下文判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: War or a disaster that brings destruction and suffering.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指战争，或造成破坏与苦难的灾难。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Gwerra jew diżastru li jġib qerda u tbatija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 战争；武装冲突。
灾难；造成严重破坏或苦难的事件。

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi l-ħrieb tal-gwerra u t-tbatija tal-familji li tilfu djarhom.
formal.en: The author describes the devastation of war and the suffering of families who lost their homes.
formal.zh: 作者描写了战争的浩劫，以及失去家园的家庭所承受的苦难。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jifisser ħrieb f'din is-silta? Pawlu: Hawn ifisser gwerra; f'kuntest ieħor jista' jfisser diżastru.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does ħrieb mean in this passage? Pawlu: Here it means war; in another context it can mean a disaster.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这段文字里的 ħrieb 是什么意思？Pawlu：这里指战争；换一个语境，也可以指灾难。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这段文字里的 ħrieb 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does ħrieb mean in this passage?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ifisser gwerra; f'kuntest ieħor jista' jfisser diżastru.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ifisser gwerra; f'kuntest ieħor jista' jfisser diżastru.
messages.zh: 这里指战争；换一个语境，也可以指灾难。
messages.en: Here it means war; in another context it can mean a disaster.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħrieb 配上两幅学习图：一幅是战争，一幅是灾难；共同记住破坏与苦难的画面，再靠上下文选择词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of moulting or shedding feathers, leaves, or hair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指鸟兽换羽、植物脱叶，或毛发脱落的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih għasfur iwaqqa' r-rix, siġra twaqqa' l-weraq, jew annimal jitlef ix-xagħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 换羽；动物脱换羽毛或体表覆盖物的过程。
脱叶；植物的叶片脱落。
脱毛；毛发脱落。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw il-ħrif tal-weraq u rreġistraw kemm waqgħu weraq minn kull siġra.
formal.en: The students observed the shedding of leaves and recorded how many leaves fell from each tree.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了脱叶现象，并记录每棵树落下了多少片叶子。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ħrif jintuża biss għar-rix tal-għasafar? Mark: Le, jista' jfisser ukoll it-twaqqigħ tal-weraq jew it-telf tax-xagħar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is ħrif used only for birds shedding feathers? Mark: No, it can also mean the shedding of leaves or hair.
colloquial.zh: Sara：ħrif 只用于鸟类脱换羽毛吗？Mark：不是，它也可以指脱叶或脱毛。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: ħrif 只用于鸟类脱换羽毛吗？
messages.en: Is ħrif used only for birds shedding feathers?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jista' jfisser ukoll it-twaqqigħ tal-weraq jew it-telf tax-xagħar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jista' jfisser ukoll it-twaqqigħ tal-weraq jew it-telf tax-xagħar.
messages.zh: 不是，它也可以指脱叶或脱毛。
messages.en: No, it can also mean the shedding of leaves or hair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 ħrif 串起三个脱落画面：羽毛落下、树叶落下、毛发落下。先记共同动作，再看脱落的是什么。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of stirring something or the movement of a person or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指搅动物体的动作，也指人或物的移动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tħawwad xi ħaġa, jew il-moviment ta' persuna jew oġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 搅动；使液体或其他物质混合、转动的动作。
移动；人或物改变位置或姿态的动作。

formal.mt: Il-ħrik bil-mod tas-soppa jgħin biex l-ingredjenti jitħalltu sewwa.
formal.en: Slow stirring of the soup helps the ingredients mix thoroughly.
formal.zh: 缓慢搅动汤有助于让食材充分混合。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawn, ħrik ifisser li nħawwad is-soppa? Toni: Iva, iżda jista' jfisser ukoll moviment, bħall-ħrik tal-id.
colloquial.en: Maja: Here, does ħrik mean stirring the soup? Toni: Yes, but it can also mean movement, such as the movement of a hand.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里的 ħrik 是指搅动汤吗？Toni：对，不过它也可以指移动，比如手的移动。

messages.speaker: Maja (学厨者)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn, ħrik ifisser li nħawwad is-soppa?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn, ħrik ifisser li nħawwad is-soppa?
messages.zh: 这里的 ħrik 是指搅动汤吗？
messages.en: Here, does ħrik mean stirring the soup?

messages.speaker: Toni (烹饪教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iżda jista' jfisser ukoll moviment, bħall-ħrik tal-id.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iżda jista' jfisser ukoll moviment, bħall-ħrik tal-id.
messages.zh: 对，不过它也可以指移动，比如手的移动。
messages.en: Yes, but it can also mean movement, such as the movement of a hand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ħrik 时想象手带着汤匙转动：汤被搅动，手也在移动；一个画面同时记住两个名词义。

gloss_zh: 淫欲；对性话题的过度兴趣

teaching_sense.en_definition: An excessive or indecent interest in sexual matters.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指对性事过度或有失体面的兴趣，带有贬义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Interess żejjed jew indiċenti fi kwistjonijiet sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 淫欲；对性事的过度或猥亵性兴趣。

collocations.zh: 文字中流露的淫猥趣味
评论中流露的淫猥趣味

formal.mt: Il-kritiku jargumenta li l-ħrim fil-kitba jtellef l-attenzjoni mit-tema ewlenija tar-rumanz.
formal.en: The critic argues that the prurience in the writing distracts attention from the novel's main theme.
formal.zh: 评论者认为，文字中的淫猥趣味分散了读者对小说主题的注意力。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-kritiku uża l-kelma ħrim? Pawlu: Għax ra interess sesswali żejjed fil-kitba, u ried jikkritikah.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did the critic use the word ħrim? Pawlu: Because he saw excessive sexual interest in the writing and wanted to criticize it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：评论者为什么用了 ħrim 这个词？Pawlu：因为他觉得文字中对性事的兴趣过度，想对此提出批评。

messages.speaker: Sara (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 评论者为什么用了 ħrim 这个词？
messages.en: Why did the critic use the word ħrim?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (读书会主持人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ra interess sesswali żejjed fil-kitba, u ried jikkritikah.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ra interess sesswali żejjed fil-kitba, u ried jikkritikah.
messages.zh: 因为他觉得文字中对性事的兴趣过度，想对此提出批评。
messages.en: Because he saw excessive sexual interest in the writing and wanted to criticize it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ħrim 配一张写着“过度关注性事”的批评便签，提醒自己它表达带贬义的淫猥兴趣，而非一般兴趣。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing something that should be avoided or shunned.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某事物应当避开或远离。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu jiġi evitat jew li wieħed għandu jżomm ruħu 'l bogħod minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 应当避开的；应当远离的，用来形容某事物。

formal.mt: L-awtur iqis l-insulti bħala aġir ħrubi u jħeġġeġ lill-qarrejja jitkellmu b'rispett.
formal.en: The author regards insults as conduct to be shunned and encourages readers to speak respectfully.
formal.zh: 作者认为辱骂是应当避免的行为，并鼓励读者以尊重的态度说话。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'jiġifieri aġir ħrubi? Maja: Aġir li għandek tevita, bħal li tinsulta lil xi ħadd.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does aġir ħrubi mean? Maja: Conduct you should avoid, such as insulting someone.
colloquial.zh: Mark：aġir ħrubi 是什么意思？Maja：就是应当避免的行为，比如辱骂别人。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: aġir ħrubi 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does aġir ħrubi mean?

messages.speaker: Maja (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Aġir li għandek tevita, bħal li tinsulta lil xi ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Aġir li għandek tevita, bħal li tinsulta lil xi ħadd.
messages.zh: 就是应当避免的行为，比如辱骂别人。
messages.en: Conduct you should avoid, such as insulting someone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħrubi 想成贴在言行旁的“请避开”标记：它是形容词，说明某种言行应当避免或远离。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Burning or scorching, inflammation, or an injury caused by burning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指燃烧或灼烤，也可指炎症，或由灼烧造成的伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li xi ħaġa tinħaraq jew tinxtewa bis-sħana, infjammazzjoni, jew ferita kkawżata minn ħaġa li taħraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 燃烧；物质被火烧的过程。
灼烤；高温使物体表面受灼或焦损。
炎症；发炎。
烧伤；烫伤；由灼烧造成的损伤。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-ħruq tal-injam u l-ħsara li s-sħana kkawżat lill-ħitan.
formal.en: The report describes the burning of the wood and the damage that the heat caused to the walls.
formal.zh: 报告描述了木材的燃烧，以及热量对墙壁造成的损坏。

colloquial.mt: Mark: F'ħruq mix-xemx, ħruq ifisser li xi ħaġa qed taqbad? Sara: Le, hawn ifisser il-ħsara li tagħmel ix-xemx lill-ġilda.
colloquial.en: Mark: In ħruq mix-xemx, does ħruq mean that something is on fire? Sara: No, here it means the damage the sun causes to the skin.
colloquial.zh: Mark：在 ħruq mix-xemx 里，ħruq 是指有东西着火了吗？Sara：不是，这里指阳光对皮肤造成的损伤。

messages.speaker: Mark (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: F'ħruq mix-xemx, ħruq ifisser li xi ħaġa qed taqbad?
messages.mt_standard: F'ħruq mix-xemx, ħruq ifisser li xi ħaġa qed taqbad?
messages.zh: 在 ħruq mix-xemx 里，ħruq 是指有东西着火了吗？
messages.en: In ħruq mix-xemx, does ħruq mean that something is on fire?

messages.speaker: Sara (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hawn ifisser il-ħsara li tagħmel ix-xemx lill-ġilda.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hawn ifisser il-ħsara li tagħmel ix-xemx lill-ġilda.
messages.zh: 不是，这里指阳光对皮肤造成的损伤。
messages.en: No, here it means the damage the sun causes to the skin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ħruq 做四格词义卡：燃烧的木头、灼焦的表面、发炎的部位、烧伤的皮肤。用画面区分过程与损伤。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surface or part of a surface that feels rough rather than smooth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指摸起来不光滑的表面或表面上的粗糙部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wiċċ jew parti minn wiċċ li ma tinħassx lixxa meta tmissha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粗糙表面；物体表面不光滑的部分。

collocations.en: the rough surface of the wall
the rough surface of the stone

formal.mt: Qabel iż-żebgħa, il-ħaddiem xkatla l-ħrux tal-ħajt sakemm il-wiċċ sar lixx.
formal.en: Before painting, the worker sanded the rough surface of the wall until it became smooth.
formal.zh: 上漆之前，工人打磨了墙壁的粗糙表面，直到表面变得光滑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħassejt il-ħrux tal-ġebla? Toni: Iva, din in-naħa mhix lixxa. In-naħa l-oħra aktar lixxa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you feel the rough surface of the stone? Toni: Yes, this side isn't smooth. The other side is smoother.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你摸到石头的粗糙表面了吗？Toni：摸到了，这一面不光滑。另一面更光滑一些。

messages.speaker: Maja (手工教师)
messages.zh: 你摸到石头的粗糙表面了吗？
messages.en: Did you feel the rough surface of the stone?

messages.speaker: Toni (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, din in-naħa mhix lixxa. In-naħa l-oħra aktar lixxa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, din in-naħa mhix lixxa. In-naħa l-oħra aktar lixxa.
messages.zh: 摸到了，这一面不光滑。另一面更光滑一些。
messages.en: Yes, this side isn't smooth. The other side is smoother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指摸过石头上凹凸的一面，把这一片粗糙表面标成 ħrux；本条按名词记，指具体的表面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being rough, especially the uneven texture of a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 粗糙的性质，尤其指表面不平滑、摸起来有颗粒或起伏的质感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' wiċċ li mhuwiex lixx u li jinħass mhux uniformi meta tmissu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粗糙；表面不平滑的性质或程度。

formal.mt: Qabel ma tinżebagħ il-mejda, għandha titnaqqas il-ħruxa tal-wiċċ tagħha.
formal.en: Before the table is painted, the roughness of its surface should be reduced.
formal.zh: 给桌子上漆之前，应先降低其表面的粗糙程度。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed togħrok l-injam? Toni: Biex innaqqas il-ħruxa u nagħmlu aktar lixx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you sanding the wood? Toni: To reduce the roughness and make it smoother.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么在打磨木头？托尼：为了降低粗糙程度，让它更光滑。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么在打磨木头？
messages.en: Why are you sanding the wood?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex innaqqas il-ħruxa u nagħmlu aktar lixx.
messages.mt_standard: Biex innaqqas il-ħruxa u nagħmlu aktar lixx.
messages.zh: 为了降低粗糙程度，让它更光滑。
messages.en: To reduce the roughness and make it smoother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手掌摸过粗木板的触感，把 ħruxa 记成可以通过打磨减轻的“粗糙”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An exit, or the act of publishing or issuing something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指供人离开的出口，也指出版或发出、发行某物的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post minn fejn wieħed joħroġ, jew l-att li jiġi ppubblikat jew jinħareġ xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出口；供人离开某处的通道或位置。
出版；将书籍等内容刊行、公开发表的行为。
发出；签发；发行，具体含义取决于所发出的事物。

formal.mt: Il-ħruġ tal-ktieb il-ġdid tħabbar fuq is-sit tal-pubblikatur.
formal.en: The publication of the new book was announced on the publisher's website.
formal.zh: 出版社的网站公布了新书出版的消息。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hu l-ħruġ? Toni: Hemm, ħdejn it-taraġ. Segwi s-sinjal aħdar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is the exit? Toni: Over there, next to the stairs. Follow the green sign.
colloquial.zh: Sara：出口在哪里？Toni：在那边，楼梯旁边。跟着绿色标志走。

messages.speaker: Sara (访客)
messages.zh: 出口在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the exit?

messages.speaker: Toni (工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm, ħdejn it-taraġ. Segwi s-sinjal aħdar.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm, ħdejn it-taraġ. Segwi s-sinjal aħdar.
messages.zh: 在那边，楼梯旁边。跟着绿色标志走。
messages.en: Over there, next to the stairs. Follow the green sign.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个学习画面记 ħruġ：人走向出口、书出版面世、文件正式发出。看到搭配对象，就能判断具体词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small or brief wash; the diminutive form of ħasla.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次简短或小规模的清洗；是 ħasla 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħasla żgħira jew qasira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' ħasla.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small wash (the diminutive form of 'ħasla')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小洗一下；一次简单清洗，是 ħasla 的指小形式。

collocations.en: to give the hands a little wash

formal.mt: Wara x-xogħol fil-ġnien, Lara tat ħsajla liż-żraben biex tneħħi t-tajn.
formal.en: After working in the garden, Lara gave her shoes a little wash to remove the mud.
formal.zh: 在花园干完活后，拉拉简单洗了一下鞋子，去掉上面的泥。

colloquial.mt: Omm: Idejk għadhom maħmuġin. Lara: Se nagħtihom ħsajla malajr qabel niekol.
colloquial.en: Mother: Your hands are still dirty. Lara: I'll give them a quick little wash before I eat.
colloquial.zh: 妈妈：你的手还脏着呢。拉拉：我吃饭前马上简单洗一下。

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 你的手还脏着呢。
messages.en: Your hands are still dirty.

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nagħtihom ħsajla malajr qabel niekol.
messages.mt_standard: Se nagħtihom ħsajla malajr qabel niekol.
messages.zh: 我吃饭前马上简单洗一下。
messages.en: I'll give them a quick little wash before I eat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħsajla 和“吃饭前小洗一下手”连在一起记；它表示一次小清洗，是 ħasla 的指小形式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small thought or brief idea that comes to mind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 脑海中出现的一个小念头或简短想法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħsieb żgħir jew idea qasira li tiġi f'moħħ persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小念头；一个小小的想法。

collocations.en: a little thought that crossed my mind
collocations.zh: 从我脑海中闪过的小念头

formal.mt: L-awtriċi kitbet ħsejba fin-notebook tagħha u aktar tard żviluppatha fi storja.
formal.en: The author wrote a little thought in her notebook and later developed it into a story.
formal.zh: 这位作家在笔记本里记下了一个小念头，后来把它发展成了一个故事。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaddietli ħsejba minn moħħi. Mark: Għidli, forsi nistgħu nagħmlu xi ħaġa biha.
colloquial.en: Maja: A little thought just crossed my mind. Mark: Tell me; perhaps we can do something with it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我脑子里刚闪过一个小念头。马克：说来听听，也许我们可以用它做点什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我脑子里刚闪过一个小念头。
messages.en: A little thought just crossed my mind.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għidli, forsi nistgħu nagħmlu xi ħaġa biha.
messages.mt_standard: Għidli, forsi nistgħu nagħmlu xi ħaġa biha.
messages.zh: 说来听听，也许我们可以用它做点什么。
messages.en: Tell me; perhaps we can do something with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象脑海里冒出一颗小小的想法气泡，把 ħsejba 记成“刚刚闪过的小念头”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The mental activity of considering ideas, questions, or possible decisions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在头脑中考虑想法、问题或可能决定的思考活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività tal-moħħ meta persuna tqis ideat, mistoqsijiet jew deċiżjonijiet possibbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 思考这一行为；进行思索的活动。

formal.mt: Qabel ma jieħdu deċiżjoni, l-istudenti jingħataw ħin għall-ħsib.
formal.en: Before making a decision, the students are given time for thinking.
formal.zh: 学生在作出决定之前，会获得一些思考时间。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Diġà ddeċidejt? Pawlu: Le, għandi bżonn ftit ħin għall-ħsib.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you decided already? Pawlu: No, I need a little time to think.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你已经决定了吗？保罗：没有，我需要一点时间思考。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你已经决定了吗？
messages.en: Have you decided already?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għandi bżonn ftit ħin għall-ħsib.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għandi bżonn ftit ħin għall-ħsib.
messages.zh: 没有，我需要一点时间思考。
messages.en: No, I need a little time to think.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħsib 放进“留一点时间思考”的画面，重点记住它指思考的活动，而非某个具体念头。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of cleaning something with water, often with soap or another cleaning substance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用水清洁物品或身体部位的活动，通常也会使用肥皂等清洁用品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività tat-tindif bl-ilma, spiss bis-sapun jew b'sustanza oħra għat-tindif.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 洗涤；用水进行清洗的活动。
一次发生的事情；一件事件。

formal.mt: Il-ħsil tal-idejn bis-sapun huwa parti mir-rutina ta' kuljum fl-iskola.
formal.en: Washing hands with soap is part of the daily routine at school.
formal.zh: 用肥皂洗手是学校日常安排的一部分。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Spiċċajt il-ħsil tal-ħwejjeġ? Nina: Iva, issa se nonxorhom.
colloquial.en: Mark: Have you finished washing the clothes? Nina: Yes, now I'm going to hang them out.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你洗完衣服了吗？妮娜：洗完了，我现在要把它们晾出去。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 你洗完衣服了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished washing the clothes?

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 洗完了，我现在要把它们晾出去。
messages.en: Yes, now I'm going to hang them out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“洗手、洗衣服”的日常画面记住 ħsil 的洗涤义，再单独做卡片记“一次发生的事情”这一义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The convergence of architectural structures, such as arches, as they come together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 建筑结构彼此靠近并汇合的情况，例如拱形结构的会聚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-konverġenza ta' strutturi arkitettoniċi, bħal arkati, meta jersqu lejn xulxin u jiltaqgħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: convergence (architectural term, referring to the convergence of structures such as arches)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 会聚；汇合，建筑术语，指拱等结构的会聚。

formal.mt: Id-disinn juri l-ħsir tal-arkati fil-parti ta' fuq tal-binja.
formal.en: The drawing shows the convergence of the arches in the upper part of the building.
formal.zh: 这幅图展示了建筑物上部拱形结构的会聚。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ifisser ħsir f'dan id-disinn? Toni: Hawn jirreferi għall-arkati li jersqu lejn xulxin u jiltaqgħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does ħsir mean in this drawing? Toni: Here it refers to the arches coming together and meeting.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这幅图里的 ħsir 是什么意思？托尼：这里指这些拱形结构彼此靠近并汇合。

messages.speaker: Lara (建筑专业学生)
messages.zh: 这幅图里的 ħsir 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does ħsir mean in this drawing?

messages.speaker: Toni (建筑教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn jirreferi għall-arkati li jersqu lejn xulxin u jiltaqgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn jirreferi għall-arkati li jersqu lejn xulxin u jiltaqgħu.
messages.zh: 这里指这些拱形结构彼此靠近并汇合。
messages.en: Here it refers to the arches coming together and meeting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在纸上画几条拱线朝同一位置靠拢，把 ħsir 标在汇合处，用建筑图像记住“会聚”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A faint or slight noise that can be heard.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够听见但声音很轻的声响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss żgħir jew baxx li jista' jinstema'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻微的声响；细小的声音。

collocations.en: a slight noise behind the door

formal.mt: Fil-kwiet tal-librerija, instemgħet ħsisa meta waqgħet karta mal-art.
formal.en: In the quiet library, a slight noise was heard when a sheet of paper fell to the floor.
formal.zh: 安静的图书馆里，一张纸落到地上时发出了一声轻响。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Smajt ħsisa wara l-bieb? Mark: Iva, naħseb li l-qattus qiegħed hemm.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you hear a slight noise behind the door? Mark: Yes, I think the cat is there.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你听到门后那一声轻响了吗？马克：听到了，我想猫在那里。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 你听到门后那一声轻响了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear a slight noise behind the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, naħseb li l-qattus qiegħed hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, naħseb li l-qattus qiegħed hemm.
messages.zh: 听到了，我想猫在那里。
messages.en: Yes, I think the cat is there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象安静房间里纸片落地的一声细响，用需要侧耳倾听的画面记住 ħsisa。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Strife, effort, or hard work involved in facing difficulties or trying to achieve something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面对困难或争取实现目标时的争斗、努力或辛勤劳动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taqbid, sforz jew xogħol iebes biex persuna tiffaċċja diffikultajiet jew tilħaq għan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 争斗；冲突或纷争。
努力；为完成某事而付出的心力或体力。
辛勤劳动；艰苦或费力的工作。

formal.mt: Wara ħafna ħtabit, it-tim temm ix-xogħol u fetaħ iċ-ċentru għall-pubbliku.
formal.en: After much hard work, the team completed the work and opened the centre to the public.
formal.zh: 经过大量辛勤劳动，团队完成了工作，并向公众开放了该中心。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kien hemm ħafna ħtabit biex tlestu l-kamra? Pawlu: Iva, ħdimna kuljum, imma issa lesta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did it take a lot of hard work to finish the room? Pawlu: Yes, we worked every day, but now it's ready.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：把这个房间弄好费了很多工夫吗？保罗：是啊，我们每天都干活，不过现在已经弄好了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm ħafna ħtabit biex tlestu l-kamra?
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm ħafna ħtabit biex tlestu l-kamra?
messages.zh: 把这个房间弄好费了很多工夫吗？
messages.en: Did it take a lot of hard work to finish the room?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħdimna kuljum, imma issa lesta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħdimna kuljum, imma issa lesta.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们每天都干活，不过现在已经弄好了。
messages.en: Yes, we worked every day, but now it's ready.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ħtabit 配三张学习图卡：双方争斗、用力完成任务、每天辛勤劳作，分别对应三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small piece of wood, such as one used for a simple craft or to help light a fire.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一小块或一小片木头，可用于简单手工或帮助生火。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa żgħira tal-injam, bħal waħda li tintuża għal xogħol bl-idejn jew biex jitqabbad in-nar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一小块木头；一小片木料。

collocations.en: a small piece of wood for the model
collocations.zh: 用于模型的一小块木料

formal.mt: Għall-mudell tad-dar, l-istudent uża ħtajba bħala bażi.
formal.en: For the model house, the student used a small piece of wood as a base.
formal.zh: 制作房屋模型时，学生用一小块木头作底座。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek ħtajba għall-mudell tiegħi? Pawlu: Iva, hemm waħda żgħira fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a small piece of wood for my model? Pawlu: Yes, there's a small one on the table.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有一小块木头给我做模型吗？保罗：有，桌上有一小块。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你有一小块木头给我做模型吗？
messages.en: Do you have a small piece of wood for my model?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm waħda żgħira fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm waħda żgħira fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 有，桌上有一小块。
messages.en: Yes, there's a small one on the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħtajba 和掌心里的一小块模型木料配对记忆，重点抓住“小块木头”的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small stick; the diminutive form of ħatar, used when referring to a little stick.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一根小棍或小木棒，是 ħatar 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bastun żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva ta' ħatar.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small stick (the diminutive form of 'ħatar')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小棍；小木棒，是 ħatar 的指小形式。

formal.mt: L-għalliema użat ħtajjar biex tiġbed ċirku fir-ramel.
formal.en: The teacher used a small stick to draw a circle in the sand.
formal.zh: 老师用一根小棍在沙地上画了一个圆。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Biex ġbidt dak iċ-ċirku fir-ramel? Mark: B'dan il-ħtajjar li sibt hawn.
colloquial.en: Nina: What did you use to draw that circle in the sand? Mark: This little stick I found here.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你用什么在沙地上画了那个圆？马克：用我在这里找到的这根小棍。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你用什么在沙地上画了那个圆？
messages.en: What did you use to draw that circle in the sand?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 用我在这里找到的这根小棍。
messages.en: This little stick I found here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用一根小棍在沙上画圆，把 ħtajjar 记成“小木棒”；也可结合给定的 ħatar 指小关系记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become mixed together or confused, so that things are no longer clearly separate or in order.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 原本分开或有序的东西混到一起，变得难以区分或理清。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitħallat jew jitħawwad, hekk li l-affarijiet ma jibqgħux separati jew fl-ordni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 混在一起；变得混乱或混淆。

collocations.en: got mixed up with other things
collocations.zh: 与其他东西混在了一起

formal.mt: Waqt it-trasport, kollox ħtalat fil-kaxxa u l-materjal kellu jerġa' jitqassam.
formal.en: During transport, everything got mixed up in the box and the material had to be sorted again.
formal.zh: 运输途中，箱内的东西全混在了一起，材料只好重新分类。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-karti mhumiex fl-ordni? Luka: Il-kaxxa waqgħet u kollox ħtalat.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are the papers out of order? Luka: The box fell and everything got mixed up.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这些纸怎么都乱了？卢卡：箱子掉了，东西全混在一起了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 这些纸怎么都乱了？
messages.en: Why are the papers out of order?

messages.speaker: Luka (同事)
messages.zh: 箱子掉了，东西全混在一起了。
messages.en: The box fell and everything got mixed up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象装着分类纸张的箱子掉到地上，纸张混成一堆，用这个变化画面记住 ħtalat。

gloss_zh: 嗓音变沙哑；勒住自己的脖子

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become hoarse, with the voice turning rough or weak, for example after prolonged speaking or singing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 嗓音变得沙哑、粗涩或无力，例如长时间说话或唱歌之后。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir b'leħen maħnuq jew dgħajjef, pereżempju wara ħafna taħdit jew kant.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嗓音变得沙哑；声音变哑。
勒住自己的脖子，使自己窒息。

collocations.en: grew hoarse after a lot of singing
collocations.zh: 唱了很久之后嗓子哑了

formal.mt: Il-kantant ħtanaq wara l-prova twila u kellu jistrieħ.
formal.en: The singer grew hoarse after the long rehearsal and had to rest.
formal.zh: 歌手在长时间排练后嗓音沙哑，不得不休息。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex Ben qed jitkellem daqshekk baxx? Ġorġ: Ħtanaq wara li kanta għal sagħtejn.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why is Ben speaking so quietly? Ġorġ: He grew hoarse after singing for two hours.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：本为什么说话这么轻？乔治：他唱了两个小时，嗓子哑了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Ben qed jitkellem daqshekk baxx?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Ben qed jitkellem daqshekk baxx?
messages.zh: 本为什么说话这么轻？
messages.en: Why is Ben speaking so quietly?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħtanaq wara li kanta għal sagħtejn.
messages.mt_standard: Ħtanaq wara li kanta għal sagħtejn.
messages.zh: 他唱了两个小时，嗓子哑了。
messages.en: He grew hoarse after singing for two hours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“唱久了声音变哑”的场景记住常用教学义；另给“自己勒颈”单设义项卡，避免把两个意思混读。

gloss_zh: 为自己挑选；挑选很讲究

teaching_sense.en_definition: To choose something for oneself, or to be very selective about what one chooses.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为自己挑选某样东西，也可指挑选时非常讲究或挑剔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħżel xi ħaġa għalih innifsu, jew ikun selettiv ħafna f'dak li jagħżel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为自己挑选某物。
挑选时非常讲究；十分挑剔。

formal.mt: Wara li qabbel diversi kotba, l-istudent ħtar ktieb għalih biex jaqrah matul il-vaganzi.
formal.en: After comparing several books, the student chose a book for himself to read during the holidays.
formal.zh: 比较了几本书后，学生为自己挑了一本，准备在假期阅读。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Liema ktieb ħtar Ben għalih? David: Dak dwar il-baħar; dam ħafna biex għażel.
colloquial.en: Anna: Which book did Ben choose for himself? David: The one about the sea; he took a long time to choose.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：本给自己挑了哪本书？戴维：讲海洋的那本；他挑了很久。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 本给自己挑了哪本书？
messages.en: Which book did Ben choose for himself?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak dwar il-baħar; dam ħafna biex għażel.
messages.mt_standard: Dak dwar il-baħar; dam ħafna biex għażel.
messages.zh: 讲海洋的那本；他挑了很久。
messages.en: The one about the sea; he took a long time to choose.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己在书架前反复比较，最后给自己挑一本书：既记住“为自己选”，也联想到“挑得很讲究”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A choice: the act of selecting something or the selection that results.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 选择或挑选，既可指作出选择的行为，也可指选择的结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għażla ta' xi ħaġa, kemm bħala att kif ukoll bħala riżultat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 选择；挑选；所作的选择。

formal.mt: Il-ħtara tal-ktieb kienet personali u kienet ibbażata fuq l-interessi tal-istudent.
formal.en: The choice of book was personal and was based on the student's interests.
formal.zh: 书籍的选择由学生个人作出，并以其兴趣为依据。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Din kienet il-ħtara tiegħek? Toni: Iva, għażilt dan il-ktieb għax inħobb il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Elena: Was this your choice? Toni: Yes, I chose this book because I love the sea.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：这是你自己的选择吗？托尼：是的，我选这本书是因为我喜欢海洋。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是你自己的选择吗？
messages.en: Was this your choice?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għażilt dan il-ktieb għax inħobb il-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għażilt dan il-ktieb għax inħobb il-baħar.
messages.zh: 是的，我选这本书是因为我喜欢海洋。
messages.en: Yes, I chose this book because I love the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħtara 写在已经选好的书旁边，记成“这个选择”；与动词 ħtar 对照练习，区分选择行为和名词表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be loved or held dear by another person or by a group of people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到某个人或一群人的爱与喜爱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun maħbub minn persuna oħra jew minn grupp ta' nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被爱；受到喜爱。

formal.mt: L-għalliem ħtebb mill-istudenti għax kien jispjega bil-paċenzja u jisma' lil kulħadd.
formal.en: The teacher was loved by the students because he explained patiently and listened to everyone.
formal.zh: 这位老师受到学生们的喜爱，因为他耐心讲解，也倾听每个人的想法。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex is-Sur Borg ħtebb minn kulħadd? Samwel: Għax dejjem sab ħin biex jgħin.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why was Mr Borg loved by everyone? Samwel: Because he always found time to help.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：博尔格先生为什么受到大家的喜爱？萨姆韦尔：因为他总会抽时间帮助别人。

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex is-Sur Borg ħtebb minn kulħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex is-Sur Borg ħtebb minn kulħadd?
messages.zh: 博尔格先生为什么受到大家的喜爱？
messages.en: Why was Mr Borg loved by everyone?

messages.speaker: Samwel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dejjem sab ħin biex jgħin.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dejjem sab ħin biex jgħin.
messages.zh: 因为他总会抽时间帮助别人。
messages.en: Because he always found time to help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个人站在爱心中央，周围的人把爱心送向他，用 ħtebb 记“受到喜爱”，注意主语是被爱的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose back is slightly hunched or rounded.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 背部略微弯曲、稍有驼背的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha daharha ftit mgħawweġ jew imħattab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 略微驼背的；本名词条中指略微驼背的人。

collocations.en: an elderly person with a slight hunch
the person with a slight hunch in the story
collocations.zh: 故事中那位略微驼背的人

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, il-ħtejbi kien ġardinar anzjan li kien jieħu ħsieb is-siġar tar-raħal.
formal.en: In the story, the person with a slight hunch was an elderly gardener who cared for the village trees.
formal.zh: 故事中，那位略微驼背的人是一位年长的园丁，负责照料村里的树木。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu l-ħtejbi fl-istorja li qrajna? Noel: Huwa l-ġardinar li jgħix ħdejn il-pjazza.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is the person with a slight hunch in the story we read? Noel: He's the gardener who lives near the square.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们读的故事里，那个略微驼背的人是谁？诺埃尔：就是住在广场附近的园丁。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu l-ħtejbi fl-istorja li qrajna?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu l-ħtejbi fl-istorja li qrajna?
messages.zh: 我们读的故事里，那个略微驼背的人是谁？
messages.en: Who is the person with a slight hunch in the story we read?

messages.speaker: Noel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa l-ġardinar li jgħix ħdejn il-pjazza.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa l-ġardinar li jgħix ħdejn il-pjazza.
messages.zh: 就是住在广场附近的园丁。
messages.en: He's the gardener who lives near the square.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用故事人物的侧面轮廓记 ħtejbi：背部只有轻微弯曲，重点记住“略微”，本词条按指人的名词学习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A young member of one's extended family.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 家族中年纪较小的一位亲属。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qarib ta' età żgħira fil-familja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 年幼的亲属；家族中年纪较小的成员。

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa tal-familja, il-ħtejjen qagħad ħdejn in-nanna u sema' l-istejjer tagħha.
formal.en: During the family gathering, the young relative sat beside his grandmother and listened to her stories.
formal.zh: 在家庭聚会上，那位年幼的亲属坐在奶奶身旁，听她讲故事。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Min ġie miegħek illum? Pawlu: Ġie l-ħtejjen tiegħi; ried jiltaqa' mal-familja kollha.
colloquial.en: Marta: Who came with you today? Pawlu: My young relative came; he wanted to meet the whole family.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：今天谁和你一起来了？保罗：我那位年幼的亲属来了；他想见见全家人。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天谁和你一起来了？
messages.en: Who came with you today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġie l-ħtejjen tiegħi; ried jiltaqa' mal-familja kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Ġie l-ħtejjen tiegħi; ried jiltaqa' mal-familja kollha.
messages.zh: 我那位年幼的亲属来了；他想见见全家人。
messages.en: My young relative came; he wanted to meet the whole family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把家庭合照中年纪较小的亲属圈出来，旁边写上 ħtejjen，记住重点是亲属而且年幼。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be burned or damaged by fire or excessive heat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到火或过高温度的作用而烧着、烧焦或烧坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġrilu ħsara bin-nar jew bi sħana qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被烧；因火或高温而烧着、烧焦或烧坏。

collocations.en: the cardboard was burnt in the fire

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li l-kartun ħteraq, iżda l-kaxxa tal-metall baqgħet sħiħa.
formal.en: The report indicates that the cardboard was burnt, but the metal box remained intact.
formal.zh: 报告指出，纸板被烧掉了，但金属箱仍然完好。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex hemm riħa ta' ħruq fil-kċina? Mark: Il-ħobż ħteraq fil-forn; insejt noħorġu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is there a burning smell in the kitchen? Mark: The bread got burnt in the oven; I forgot to take it out.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：厨房里为什么有股焦味？马克：面包在烤箱里烤焦了；我忘了把它拿出来。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm riħa ta' ħruq fil-kċina?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm riħa ta' ħruq fil-kċina?
messages.zh: 厨房里为什么有股焦味？
messages.en: Why is there a burning smell in the kitchen?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 面包在烤箱里烤焦了；我忘了把它拿出来。
messages.en: The bread got burnt in the oven; I forgot to take it out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象烤箱里一片焦黑的面包，用 il-ħobż ħteraq 整句记忆，把这个词与烧焦的结果联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of bringing people together as possible marriage partners.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为可能成为婚姻伴侣的人牵线介绍、撮合婚事的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li tlaqqa' nies ma' xulxin bil-ħsieb li jiżżewġu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 说媒；为他人牵线介绍并撮合婚事。

collocations.zh: 两个家庭之间的婚事撮合

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, iz-zija tagħmel il-ħtib billi tlaqqa' żewġ persuni li jixtiequ jiżżewġu.
formal.en: In the story, the aunt acts as a matchmaker by introducing two people who wish to marry.
formal.zh: 在故事中，姑妈为两位有意结婚的人牵线介绍，替他们说媒。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Iz-zija reġgħet stednitek biex tiltaqa' ma' xi ħadd? Rita: Iva, tħobb tagħmel il-ħtib, imma jien għedtilha li bħalissa ma rridx.
colloquial.en: Nina: Has your aunt invited you to meet someone again? Rita: Yes, she likes matchmaking, but I told her I don't want that at the moment.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你姑妈又邀请你去认识谁了吗？丽塔：是啊，她喜欢替人说媒，不过我告诉她，我暂时不想。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iz-zija reġgħet stednitek biex tiltaqa' ma' xi ħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Iz-zija reġgħet stednitek biex tiltaqa' ma' xi ħadd?
messages.zh: 你姑妈又邀请你去认识谁了吗？
messages.en: Has your aunt invited you to meet someone again?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tħobb tagħmel il-ħtib, imma jien għedtilha li bħalissa ma rridx.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tħobb tagħmel il-ħtib, imma jien għedtilha li bħalissa ma rridx.
messages.zh: 是啊，她喜欢替人说媒，不过我告诉她，我暂时不想。
messages.en: Yes, she likes matchmaking, but I told her I don't want that at the moment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位姑妈把两个人介绍到同一张桌旁，桌上写着 ħtib，帮助记住牵线说媒这个活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A family relationship established through marriage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由于结婚而形成的亲属关系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rabta ta' familja li tinħoloq permezz taż-żwieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因婚姻而获得的亲属关系；姻亲关系。

collocations.en: a bond of kinship through marriage
the relationship by marriage between two families
collocations.zh: 两个家庭之间的姻亲关系

formal.mt: Iż-żwieġ ta' Marija u Pawlu ħoloq rabta ta' ħtiena bejn iż-żewġ familji.
formal.en: Marija and Pawlu's marriage created a bond of kinship between the two families.
formal.zh: 玛丽亚和保罗的婚姻使两个家庭建立了姻亲关系。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif tiġi minnek dik il-familja? Toni: Hemm rabta ta' ħtiena bejnietna; oħti żżewġet lil binhom.
colloquial.en: Sara: How is that family related to you? Toni: We're related through marriage; my sister married their son.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：那一家和你是什么亲戚关系？托尼：我们有姻亲关系；我姐姐嫁给了他们的儿子。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那一家和你是什么亲戚关系？
messages.en: How is that family related to you?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm rabta ta' ħtiena bejnietna; oħti żżewġet lil binhom.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm rabta ta' ħtiena bejnietna; oħti żżewġet lil binhom.
messages.zh: 我们有姻亲关系；我姐姐嫁给了他们的儿子。
messages.en: We're related through marriage; my sister married their son.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在两张家谱之间画一枚结婚戒指，再写 ħtiena，用婚姻连接两个家庭的画面记住姻亲关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a sudden movement; also, to disappear from view.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 突然做出一个动作；也可表示从视线中消失。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel moviment għal għarrieda; jista' jfisser ukoll li jisparixxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 突然动一下；做出突如其来的动作。
消失；从视线中不见。

formal.mt: Malli sema' l-ħoss, l-għasfur ħtileġ għal għarrieda; ftit wara ħtileġ minn quddiem għajnejna.
formal.en: As soon as it heard the sound, the bird made a sudden movement; shortly afterwards, it disappeared from our sight.
formal.zh: 鸟一听到声音就突然动了一下；不久后，它从我们眼前消失了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt il-qattus jiċċaqlaq? Leo: Iva, ħtileġ għal għarrieda, u mbagħad ħtileġ minn quddiem għajnejja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see the cat move? Leo: Yes, it made a sudden movement, and then it disappeared from my sight.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到那只猫动了吗？莱奥：看到了，它突然动了一下，然后就从我眼前消失了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到那只猫动了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the cat move?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħtileġ għal għarrieda, u mbagħad ħtileġ minn quddiem għajnejja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħtileġ għal għarrieda, u mbagħad ħtileġ minn quddiem għajnejja.
messages.zh: 看到了，它突然动了一下，然后就从我眼前消失了。
messages.en: Yes, it made a sudden movement, and then it disappeared from my sight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两格漫画记两个义项：第一格小猫突然一动，第二格眼前已经空了；两格都标 ħtileġ，再靠语境区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of closing or securing something with a seal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用封口或封印将物件封闭、封好的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tagħlaq jew tassigura xi ħaġa b'siġill.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 封缄；将物件封口或加上封印的行为。

formal.mt: Il-ħtim tal-envelop sar wara li d-dokumenti kollha tqiegħdu ġewwa.
formal.en: The envelope was sealed after all the documents had been placed inside.
formal.zh: 所有文件放入信封后，才进行了封口。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Daħħalt il-karti kollha fl-envelop? Ben: Iva, issa fadal biss il-ħtim, u mbagħad nista' nibagħtu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Have you put all the papers in the envelope? Ben: Yes, only the sealing remains, and then I can send it.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你把所有纸张都放进信封了吗？本：放好了，现在只差封口，然后就可以寄出了。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 你把所有纸张都放进信封了吗？
messages.en: Have you put all the papers in the envelope?

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa fadal biss il-ħtim, u mbagħad nista' nibagħtu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa fadal biss il-ħtim, u mbagħad nista' nibagħtu.
messages.zh: 放好了，现在只差封口，然后就可以寄出了。
messages.en: Yes, only the sealing remains, and then I can send it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把文件装入信封，再用蜡封住开口；把最后这一步标成 ħtim，记住它表示封缄这个行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The removal of the foreskin of the penis, whether for medical, religious, or cultural reasons.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 切除阴茎包皮的操作，可出于医疗、宗教或文化原因。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tneħħija tal-ġilda li tgħatti r-ras tal-pene, għal raġunijiet mediċi, reliġjużi jew kulturali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 包皮环切；在宗教或文化语境中也称割礼。

collocations.zh: 出于宗教原因进行的割礼

formal.mt: Il-fuljett jagħti informazzjoni dwar il-proċedura tal-ħtin u l-kura ta' wara.
formal.en: The leaflet provides information about the circumcision procedure and aftercare.
formal.zh: 这份宣传册介绍了包皮环切操作及术后护理。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Xi tfisser il-kelma ħtin f'dan il-fuljett? David: Tfisser it-tneħħija tal-ġilda li tgħatti r-ras tal-pene.
colloquial.en: Marija: What does the word ħtin mean in this leaflet? David: It means the removal of the skin covering the head of the penis.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：这份宣传册里的 ħtin 是什么意思？戴维：指切除覆盖阴茎头的包皮。

messages.speaker: Marija (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma ħtin f'dan il-fuljett?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma ħtin f'dan il-fuljett?
messages.zh: 这份宣传册里的 ħtin 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word ħtin mean in this leaflet?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser it-tneħħija tal-ġilda li tgħatti r-ras tal-pene.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser it-tneħħija tal-ġilda li tgħatti r-ras tal-pene.
messages.zh: 指切除覆盖阴茎头的包皮。
messages.en: It means the removal of the skin covering the head of the penis.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张双面词卡：正面写 ħtin，背面写包皮环切与割礼，分别联系医疗说明和宗教文化语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The election or selection of a person, or the act of assigning someone a post or responsibility.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过选举或挑选确定某人，或把职位、职责授予某人的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-elezzjoni jew l-għażla ta' persuna, jew l-għoti ta' kariga jew responsabbiltà lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 选举；通过投票等选举程序产生人选。
挑选某人；选定人选。

sense_translations.en_definition: giving of a post or responsibility to sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 任命某人；把职位或职责授予某人。

collocations.en: the election of the president by vote
the appointment of a new director

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ħabbar il-ħtir ta' Marija bħala direttur ġdid u ddeskriva r-responsabbiltajiet tagħha.
formal.en: The committee announced Marija's appointment as the new director and described her responsibilities.
formal.zh: 委员会宣布任命玛丽亚为新主管，并说明了她的职责。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Sar il-ħtir tal-president il-ġdid? Mark: Iva, il-membri vvutaw ilbieraħ u għażlu lil Pawlu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Has the new president been elected? Mark: Yes, the members voted yesterday and chose Pawlu.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：新主席已经选出来了吗？马克：是的，成员们昨天投了票，选中了保罗。

messages.speaker: Rita (协会会员)
messages.zh: 新主席已经选出来了吗？
messages.en: Has the new president been elected?

messages.speaker: Mark (协会会员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-membri vvutaw ilbieraħ u għażlu lil Pawlu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-membri vvutaw ilbieraħ u għażlu lil Pawlu.
messages.zh: 是的，成员们昨天投了票，选中了保罗。
messages.en: Yes, the members voted yesterday and chose Pawlu.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħtir 放在三张图卡中央：投票箱对应选举，圈出一个名字对应选定，交付职位书对应任命；根据上下文选择中文义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming void, or the loss of compactness in a material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物变空的过程，或材料失去紧实性的现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir vojta, jew materjal jitlef il-kompattezza tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变空；成为空无的过程。
失去紧实性；原本紧密的结构变得松散。

collocations.en: loss of compactness in the material

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-ħtuf tal-materjal u t-telf tal-kompattezza tiegħu.
formal.en: The report describes the material's loss of compactness and the loosening of its structure.
formal.zh: 报告描述了材料紧实度的丧失及其结构的松散。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser ħtuf f'din is-sentenza? Pawlu: Ifisser li l-materjal qed jitlef il-kompattezza tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does ħtuf mean in this sentence? Pawlu: It means that the material is losing its compactness.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这句话里的 ħtuf 是什么意思？Pawlu：意思是材料正在失去紧实性。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 ħtuf 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does ħtuf mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li l-materjal qed jitlef il-kompattezza tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-materjal qed jitlef il-kompattezza tiegħu.
messages.zh: 意思是材料正在失去紧实性。
messages.en: It means that the material is losing its compactness.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“原本紧实的一团逐渐松散、出现空隙”的学习画面，把“变空”和“失去紧实性”两个义项联系起来；这只是记忆联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of taking something, or of accepting something offered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拿取某物的行为，也可指接受别人所提供的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att ta' teħid ta' xi ħaġa, jew ta' aċċettazzjoni ta' xi ħaġa offruta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次拿取；取走某物的行为。
接受；对所提供事物的接纳。

formal.mt: Il-ħudja tal-offerta ġiet irreġistrata bil-miktub.
formal.en: Acceptance of the offer was recorded in writing.
formal.zh: 对该提议的接受已作书面记录。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hawnhekk ħudja tfisser li xi ħadd ħa oġġett? Toni: Le, f'din is-sentenza tfisser li aċċetta offerta.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does ħudja here mean that someone took an object? Toni: No, in this sentence it means that they accepted an offer.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这里的 ħudja 是说有人拿了一件物品吗？Toni：不是，在这句话里是说接受了一项提议。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk ħudja tfisser li xi ħadd ħa oġġett?
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk ħudja tfisser li xi ħadd ħa oġġett?
messages.zh: 这里的 ħudja 是说有人拿了一件物品吗？
messages.en: Does ħudja here mean that someone took an object?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, f'din is-sentenza tfisser li aċċetta offerta.
messages.mt_standard: Le, f'din is-sentenza tfisser li aċċetta offerta.
messages.zh: 不是，在这句话里是说接受了一项提议。
messages.en: No, in this sentence it means that they accepted an offer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象“伸手拿取物品”和“点头接受提议”两幅画面：ħudja 都表示一个行为，具体是哪种行为要看上下文。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The skin rash known as urticaria, hives, or nettle-rash.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 称为荨麻疹的一种皮疹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' raxx fuq il-ġilda magħruf bħala urtikarja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 荨麻疹。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport mediku ġie rreġistrat każ ta' ħurriqija.
formal.en: A case of urticaria was recorded in the medical report.
formal.zh: 医疗报告中记录了一例荨麻疹。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-tabib kiteb ħurriqija; xi tfisser? Nina: Hija l-kelma għal dak it-tip ta' raxx li bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ hives.
colloquial.en: Lara: The doctor wrote ħurriqija; what does it mean? Nina: It is the word for the type of rash called hives in English.
colloquial.zh: Lara：医生写了 ħurriqija，是什么意思？Nina：指荨麻疹，就是英语里叫 hives 的那种皮疹。

messages.speaker: Lara (患者)
messages.zh: 医生写了 ħurriqija，是什么意思？
messages.en: The doctor wrote ħurriqija; what does it mean?

messages.speaker: Nina (护士)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija l-kelma għal dak it-tip ta' raxx li bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ hives.
messages.mt_standard: Hija l-kelma għal dak it-tip ta' raxx li bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ hives.
messages.zh: 指荨麻疹，就是英语里叫 hives 的那种皮疹。
messages.en: It is the word for the type of rash called hives in English.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张三语词卡：“ħurriqija—荨麻疹—urticaria / hives”，旁边画皮肤上的疹块，用同一画面连接三个名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Brome, a type of grass.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 雀麦，一类禾本科草本植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' ħaxix magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala brome.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雀麦；雀麦类禾草。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport dwar il-veġetazzjoni jirreġistra l-preżenza tal-ħurtan fl-għalqa.
formal.en: The vegetation report records the presence of brome in the field.
formal.zh: 植被报告记录了该田地中雀麦的存在。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'jismu dan il-ħaxix? Rita: Dan ħurtan; bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ brome.
colloquial.en: Mark: What is this grass called? Rita: This is ħurtan; it is called brome in English.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这种草叫什么？Rita：这是雀麦，马耳他语叫 ħurtan，英语叫 brome。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 这种草叫什么？
messages.en: What is this grass called?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.zh: 这是雀麦，马耳他语叫 ħurtan，英语叫 brome。
messages.en: This is ħurtan; it is called brome in English.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一块插在田边草丛里的植物牌，上面并列写着“ħurtan、雀麦、brome”，用植物标签记住这个草名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A gurgling or rattling sound sometimes made by a person who is dying.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 临终者有时发出的咕噜声或喉部杂响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss ta' gargar jew ta' taħشرiħ li kultant jagħmel persuna li tkun qed tmut.

sense_translations.en_definition: death rattle (gurgling sound sometimes made by a dying person)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 临终喉鸣；临终者有时发出的咕噜声或喉部杂响。

collocations.en: the sound of the death rattle

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi l-ħurħara tal-mewt bħala ħoss ta' gargar li kultant jinstema' meta persuna tkun qed tmut.
formal.en: The text describes the death rattle as a gurgling sound sometimes heard when a person is dying.
formal.zh: 文章将临终喉鸣描述为人在临终时有时会发出的咕噜声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi l-ħurħara tal-mewt li tissemma fit-test? Pawlu: Hija ħoss ta' gargar li kultant jagħmel xi ħadd li jkun qed imut.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is the death rattle mentioned in the text? Pawlu: It is a gurgling sound sometimes made by someone who is dying.
colloquial.zh: Maja：文中提到的临终喉鸣是什么？Pawlu：是临终者有时发出的咕噜声。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi l-ħurħara tal-mewt li tissemma fit-test?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi l-ħurħara tal-mewt li tissemma fit-test?
messages.zh: 文中提到的临终喉鸣是什么？
messages.en: What is the death rattle mentioned in the text?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija ħoss ta' gargar li kultant jagħmel xi ħadd li jkun qed imut.
messages.mt_standard: Hija ħoss ta' gargar li kultant jagħmel xi ħadd li jkun qed imut.
messages.zh: 是临终者有时发出的咕噜声。
messages.en: It is a gurgling sound sometimes made by someone who is dying.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将整个短语与“临终时有时听到的咕噜声”配对记忆；重点记住它指一种声音，而不是死亡这个事件本身。

gloss_zh: 鱼（集合称呼）；双鱼座（星座或黄道星座）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fish considered collectively, whether several individual fish or fish as a mass.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对鱼的集合称呼，可指多条鱼，也可将鱼作为整体或食材来指称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħut meqjus bħala grupp jew bħala massa, aktar milli bħala ħuta waħda.

sense_translations.en_definition: fish (several fish; fish as a mass)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 鱼的集合称呼；多条鱼，或作为整体、食材的鱼。
双鱼座，天文学中的星座名称。
双鱼座，黄道十二星座之一的名称，用于占星语境。

formal.mt: Is-suq joffri ħut frisk għall-bejgħ kuljum.
formal.en: The market offers fresh fish for sale every day.
formal.zh: 市场每天出售鲜鱼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandkom ħut frisk illum? Mark: Iva, kemm trid?
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have fresh fish today? Mark: Yes, how much would you like?
colloquial.zh: Maja：你们今天有鲜鱼吗？Mark：有，你想要多少？

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 你们今天有鲜鱼吗？
messages.en: Do you have fresh fish today?

messages.speaker: Mark (鱼贩)
messages.zh: 有，你想要多少？
messages.en: Yes, how much would you like?

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一篮鱼来记 ħut 的集合义，再另画两张写着 Ħut 的卡片，分别标“天文学”和“占星”；用场景区分普通名词与专名。

gloss_zh: 双鱼座（天文学星座或黄道星座）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name Pisces, referring either to the astronomical constellation or to the zodiac sign.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 双鱼座这一专名，可指天文学中的星座，也可指占星语境中的黄道星座。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem li jirreferi għall-kostellazzjoni ta' Pisces jew għas-sinjal taż-żodijaku bl-istess isem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 双鱼座，天文学中的星座名称。
双鱼座，黄道十二星座之一的名称，用于占星语境。

formal.mt: Fil-kapitlu tal-astronomija, l-isem Ħutiet jirreferi għall-kostellazzjoni; fil-kapitlu tal-astroloġija, jirreferi għas-sinjal taż-żodijaku.
formal.en: In the astronomy chapter, the name Ħutiet refers to the constellation; in the astrology chapter, it refers to the zodiac sign.
formal.zh: 在天文学章节中，Ħutiet 指双鱼座这一星座；在占星学章节中，它指黄道星座双鱼座。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hawnhekk Ħutiet huwa isem ta' kostellazzjoni jew ta' sinjal taż-żodijaku? Toni: Ta' kostellazzjoni, għax qed inħarsu lejn mappa tas-sema.
colloquial.en: Lara: Here, is Ħutiet the name of a constellation or a zodiac sign? Toni: A constellation, because we are looking at a sky map.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这里的 Ħutiet 是天文学星座的名称，还是黄道星座的名称？Toni：是天文学星座，因为我们正在看星图。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk Ħutiet huwa isem ta' kostellazzjoni jew ta' sinjal taż-żodijaku?
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk Ħutiet huwa isem ta' kostellazzjoni jew ta' sinjal taż-żodijaku?
messages.zh: 这里的 Ħutiet 是天文学星座的名称，还是黄道星座的名称？
messages.en: Here, is Ħutiet the name of a constellation or a zodiac sign?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ta' kostellazzjoni, għax qed inħarsu lejn mappa tas-sema.
messages.mt_standard: Ta' kostellazzjoni, għax qed inħarsu lejn mappa tas-sema.
messages.zh: 是天文学星座，因为我们正在看星图。
messages.en: A constellation, because we are looking at a sky map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ħutiet 放在“星图”和“占星表”两张学习卡上，两张都译作双鱼座；看到 kostellazzjoni 联想天文学，看到 sinjal 联想黄道星座。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The sudden death of an infant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指婴儿突然死亡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mewt għal għarrieda ta' tarbija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 婴儿猝死；婴儿突然死亡。

collocations.en: a case of sudden infant death
a study of sudden infant death
collocations.zh: 一项关于婴儿猝死的研究

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi każ ta' ħuttafa u l-effett tiegħu fuq il-familja.
formal.en: The report describes a case of sudden infant death and its effect on the family.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一起婴儿猝死个案及其对家庭的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'ħuttafa' f'dan ir-rapport? Lara: Hawn tfisser il-mewt għal għarrieda ta' tarbija.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'ħuttafa' mean in this report? Lara: Here it means the sudden death of an infant.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这份报告里的 ħuttafa 是什么意思？拉拉：这里指婴儿突然死亡。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这份报告里的 ħuttafa 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ħuttafa' mean in this report?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser il-mewt għal għarrieda ta' tarbija.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser il-mewt għal għarrieda ta' tarbija.
messages.zh: 这里指婴儿突然死亡。
messages.en: Here it means the sudden death of an infant.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħuttafa 和“婴儿、突然死亡、个案报告”组成记忆卡，借完整语境记住本条词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to catch fire easily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易着火、能够轻易燃烧的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jieħu n-nar malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 易燃的；容易着火的。

formal.mt: It-tikketta tindika li l-kontenitur fih likwidu ħuġġieġi.
formal.en: The label indicates that the container holds a flammable liquid.
formal.zh: 标签注明容器内装有易燃液体。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Xi jfisser ħuġġieġi fuq it-tikketta? Rita: Ifisser li l-likwidu jista' jieħu n-nar malajr.

colloquial.zh: Mark：标签上的 ħuġġieġi 是什么意思？Rita：意思是这种液体很容易着火。

messages.zh: 标签上的 ħuġġieġi 是什么意思？

messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-likwidu jista' jieħu n-nar malajr.
messages.zh: 意思是这种液体很容易着火。
messages.en: It means that the liquid can catch fire easily.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħuġġieġi 写在想象中的火焰标签旁，再连读“materjal ħuġġieġi＝易燃材料”，用标签画面记住形容词含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who deceives others or acts dishonestly to gain an advantage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过欺骗他人或作弊来谋取好处的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqarraq b'ħaddieħor jew tikser ir-regoli biex tikseb vantaġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 骗子；以欺骗或作弊手段谋利的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ħwajjen iqarraq bil-klijenti biex jieħu flushom.
formal.en: In the story, the cheat deceives customers to take their money.
formal.zh: 故事中，骗子欺骗顾客以骗取他们的钱。

colloquial.en: Mark: Why don't you want to play with Pawlu? Rita: Because he's a cheat; he hides the cards when I'm not looking.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你为什么不想和保罗玩？丽塔：因为他作弊；我没看着的时候，他就把牌藏起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small ring, expressed by a diminutive form of the word for a signet ring.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小戒指，词形上是表示“印章戒指”的词的小称形式。

sense_translations.en_definition: a small ring (the diminutive form of 'signet ring')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小戒指；“印章戒指”一词的小称形式。

formal.zh: 目录介绍了一枚设计简洁的小银戒指。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A term for something that is somewhat barren or unproductive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某物有些贫瘠或缺乏产出的词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma għal xi ħaġa xi ftit ħawlija jew li tagħti ftit prodott.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有些贫瘠；不太丰产。
无产出的；产出低的。

collocations.zh: 被描述为有些贫瘠的土地

formal.mt: Fit-test, il-kelma 'ħwejjel' tintuża għal art li tagħti ftit prodott.
formal.en: In the text, the word 'ħwejjel' is used for land that yields little produce.
formal.zh: 文中用 ħwejjel 一词表示产出很少的土地。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'ħwejjel' hawn? Mark: Tfisser li l-art tagħti ftit prodott; mhix għammiela ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'ħwejjel' mean here? Mark: It means that the land yields little produce; it isn't very fertile.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 ħwejjel 是什么意思？马克：意思是这片土地出产很少，不太肥沃。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 ħwejjel 是什么意思？

messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li l-art tagħti ftit prodott; mhix għammiela ħafna.

messages.en: It means that the land yields little produce; it isn't very fertile.

teaching_sense.en_definition: Clothes worn on the body; also goods or merchandise.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人穿着的衣服；也可指货物、商品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dak li nilbsu fuq ġisimna; ukoll oġġetti jew merkanzija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿着用的东西；衣服、衣物。
货物；商品。

formal.zh: 待售货物清单包括工具、家具和书籍。

colloquial.en: Marija: Do you have clean clothes for the trip? Luqa: Yes, I put them in the suitcase along with the winter clothes.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你有旅行要穿的干净衣服吗？卢卡：有，我把它们和冬衣一起放进行李箱了。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small piece of thread, or a small wall, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指一小段线，也可指一堵小墙，具体含义由上下文确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa ħajta żgħira jew ħajt żgħir, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.en_definition: small piece of thread (the diminutive form of 'ħajta')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一小段线；ħajta 的小称形式。

sense_translations.en_definition: a small wall (the diminutive form of 'ħajt')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一堵小墙；ħajt 的小称形式。

collocations.en: a small piece of cotton thread
a small piece of red thread

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small thing or a minor matter of little importance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体积小的东西，或不太重要的小事、琐事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaġa żgħira jew kwistjoni ta' ftit importanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个小东西；一件小物品。
小事；琐事；ħaġa 的小称形式。
