formal.en: On the shelf was a small wooden thing that the children had made in class.
formal.zh: 架子上放着一件孩子们在课堂上做的木制小物品。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għadek irrabjata dwar dak li ġara? Maja: Le, kienet biss ħwejġa bla importanza.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you still angry about what happened? Maja: No, it was just an unimportant trifle.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你还在为那件事生气吗？玛雅：没有，那只是件无关紧要的小事。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek irrabjata dwar dak li ġara?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek irrabjata dwar dak li ġara?
messages.zh: 你还在为那件事生气吗？
messages.en: Are you still angry about what happened?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kienet biss ħwejġa bla importanza.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kienet biss ħwejġa bla importanza.
messages.zh: 没有，那只是件无关紧要的小事。
messages.en: No, it was just an unimportant trifle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ħwejġa 画两张图：手心里的小物件和日历上的小琐事，同时记住具体与抽象两种用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small eyebrow, expressed by the diminutive form of 'ħaġeb'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小眉毛，是 ħaġeb 的小称形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaġeb żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva ta' 'ħaġeb'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小眉毛；ħaġeb 的小称形式。

formal.mt: Fid-disinn, l-artist żied ħwejġeb irqiq fuq kull għajn.
formal.en: In the drawing, the artist added a thin little eyebrow above each eye.
formal.zh: 在这幅画里，画家在每只眼睛上方都添了一道细细的小眉毛。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'jonqos minn wiċċ il-pupa? Sara: Ħwejġeb fuq din l-għajn; pinġih bil-lapes.
colloquial.en: Nina: What's missing from the doll's face? Sara: A little eyebrow above this eye; draw it with a pencil.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：娃娃脸上还缺什么？萨拉：这只眼睛上方缺一道小眉毛；用铅笔画上吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 娃娃脸上还缺什么？
messages.en: What's missing from the doll's face?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħwejġeb fuq din l-għajn; pinġih bil-lapes.
messages.mt_standard: Ħwejġeb fuq din l-għajn; pinġih bil-lapes.
messages.zh: 这只眼睛上方缺一道小眉毛；用铅笔画上吧。
messages.en: A little eyebrow above this eye; draw it with a pencil.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在眼睛上方画一道小眉毛并标上 ħwejġeb，再与 ħaġeb 对照记住小称含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Somewhat fat; describing someone or something as a little fat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人或动物有点胖，程度较轻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ftit oħxon; jiddeskrivi persuna jew annimal b'daqsxejn ta' ħxuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有点胖的；微胖的。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-qattus huwa ħxejjen u jqatta' ħafna ħin rieqed ħdejn it-tieqa.
formal.en: In the story, the cat is somewhat fat and spends much of its time sleeping beside the window.
formal.zh: 故事里的猫有点胖，经常在窗边睡觉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-qattus tiegħek ħxejjen, hux? Pawlu: Iva, ftit, u jħobb jorqod fuq is-sufan.
colloquial.en: Maja: Your cat is a little fat, isn't he? Pawlu: Yes, a little, and he likes sleeping on the sofa.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的猫有点胖，对吧？保罗：是啊，有一点，而且它喜欢在沙发上睡觉。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的猫有点胖，对吧？
messages.en: Your cat is a little fat, isn't he?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (猫主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ftit, u jħobb jorqod fuq is-sufan.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ftit, u jħobb jorqod fuq is-sufan.
messages.zh: 是啊，有一点，而且它喜欢在沙发上睡觉。
messages.en: Yes, a little, and he likes sleeping on the sofa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只肚子稍圆的小猫，把 ħxejjen 和“只是有点胖”一起记，突出程度较轻。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small plant; the diminutive form of 'ħaxixa'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一株小植物或小草，是 ħaxixa 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' 'ħaxixa'.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small plant (the diminutive form of 'ħaxixa')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一株小植物或小草（ħaxixa 的指小形式）。

collocations.en: a small plant in a pot

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw ħxejxa li kienet qed tikber bejn żewġ ġebel fil-ġnien.
formal.en: The students observed a small plant growing between two stones in the garden.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了花园里一株长在两块石头之间的小植物。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara dik il-ħxejxa ħdejn it-tieqa! Mark: Ħelwa! Se npoġġiha f'qasrija akbar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at that little plant by the window! Mark: It's lovely! I'll put it in a bigger pot.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看窗边那株小植物！马克：真可爱！我要把它移到大一点的花盆里。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 看窗边那株小植物！
messages.en: Look at that little plant by the window!

messages.speaker: Mark (植物主人)
messages.zh: 真可爱！我要把它移到大一点的花盆里。
messages.en: It's lovely! I'll put it in a bigger pot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħaxixa 和 ħxejxa 配成“大植物与小植物”图卡，用花盆里的一株小草记住指小意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of catching or pinching one's finger, for example in a door; also the act of gobbling down food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指手指被门等夹住的动作或情况；也指狼吞虎咽地吃东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għafsa ta' saba', pereżempju f'bieb; ukoll l-azzjoni li wieħed jiekol bil-għaġla u b'gidmiet kbar.

sense_translations.en_definition: catching one's finger (e.g. in a door)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 夹到自己的手指，例如关门时把手指夹住。
狼吞虎咽；急急忙忙地大口吃东西。

collocations.en: catching one's fingers in the door

formal.mt: L-għalliem wissa lit-tfal dwar il-periklu tal-ħxim tas-swaba' meta jagħlqu l-bieb.
formal.en: The teacher warned the children about the danger of catching their fingers when closing the door.
formal.zh: 老师提醒孩子们，关门时有夹到手指的危险。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'inhu dan il-ħxim tal-ikel? Għandna ħin! Ben: Għandi l-ġuħ ħafna, imma se niekol aktar bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why are you gobbling down your food? We have time! Ben: I'm very hungry, but I'll eat more slowly.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：怎么吃得这么狼吞虎咽？我们有时间！本：我太饿了，不过我会吃慢一点。

messages.speaker: Rita (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dan il-ħxim tal-ikel? Għandna ħin!
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dan il-ħxim tal-ikel? Għandna ħin!
messages.zh: 怎么吃得这么狼吞虎咽？我们有时间！
messages.en: Why are you gobbling down your food? We have time!

messages.speaker: Ben (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi l-ġuħ ħafna, imma se niekol aktar bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi l-ġuħ ħafna, imma se niekol aktar bil-mod.
messages.zh: 我太饿了，不过我会吃慢一点。
messages.en: I'm very hungry, but I'll eat more slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ħxim 画两格记忆图：第一格手指被门夹，第二格大口急吃饭；靠场景区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A little stone; the diminutive form of ħaġra.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小石头，是 ħaġra 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġebla żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' ħaġra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小石头，是 ħaġra 的指小形式。

collocations.en: a little stone in a shoe

formal.mt: L-istudent poġġa ħġajra lixxa ħdejn il-ħakkiem biex ikejjel it-tul tagħha.
formal.en: The student placed a smooth little stone beside the ruler to measure its length.
formal.zh: 学生把一颗光滑的小石头放在尺子旁，测量它的长度。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Stenna ftit, għandi ħġajra fiż-żarbun. Mia: Oqgħod bilqiegħda hawn u neħħiha.
colloquial.en: Luca: Wait a moment, I've got a little stone in my shoe. Mia: Sit down here and take it out.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：等一下，我鞋里有颗小石头。米娅：坐在这里，把它取出来。

messages.speaker: Luca (同行的朋友)
messages.zh: 等一下，我鞋里有颗小石头。
messages.en: Wait a moment, I've got a little stone in my shoe.

messages.speaker: Mia (同行的朋友)
messages.zh: 坐在这里，把它取出来。
messages.en: Sit down here and take it out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħaġra 和 ħġajra 并排画出来：前者是石头，后者缩成能钻进鞋里的一颗小石子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small quantity of food swallowed in one mouthful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一小口被吞咽下去的食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ammont żgħir ta' ikel li jinbela' f'daqqa.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small amount of food swallowed down
sense_translations.zh_definition: 吞咽下去的一小口食物

formal.mt: It-tifel bela' ħġejma ħobż u mbagħad xorob ftit ilma.
formal.en: The boy swallowed a small mouthful of bread and then drank some water.
formal.zh: 男孩吞下一小口面包，然后喝了点水。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kilt xi ħaġa qabel ħriġt? Pawlu: Iva, ħġejma ħobż biss.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did you eat anything before you went out? Pawlu: Yes, just a small mouthful of bread.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你出门前吃东西了吗？Pawlu：吃了，就一小口面包。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你出门前吃东西了吗？
messages.en: Did you eat anything before you went out?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 吃了，就一小口面包。
messages.en: Yes, just a small mouthful of bread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象只吞下一小口面包的画面：ħġejma强调吞下的少量食物，可记成“肚子里的一小口”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of hiding someone or something from view or discovery.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把人或东西藏起来，使其不被看见或发现的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li taħbi persuna jew ħaġa biex ma tidhirx jew ma tinstabx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 藏匿；把人或东西隐藏起来的行为

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-ħġib tad-dokumenti f'kaxxa taħt l-iskrivanija.
formal.en: The report describes the hiding of the documents in a box under the desk.
formal.zh: 报告描述了将文件藏在书桌下面一个箱子里的行为。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ħbejt iċ-ċavetta? Mark: Biex nipprepara sorpriża. Lara: Dan il-ħġib kollu għal sorpriża waħda!
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you hide the key? Mark: To prepare a surprise. Lara: All this hiding for one surprise!
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么把钥匙藏起来？Mark：为了准备一个惊喜。Lara：就为了一个惊喜，还这么藏来藏去！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把钥匙藏起来？
messages.en: Why did you hide the key?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 为了准备一个惊喜。
messages.en: To prepare a surprise.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ħġib kollu għal sorpriża waħda!
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ħġib kollu għal sorpriża waħda!
messages.zh: 就为了一个惊喜，还这么藏来藏去！
messages.en: All this hiding for one surprise!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“把钥匙藏进抽屉”的动作来记ħġib；它是名词，指隐藏这件事，而不是抽屉这个藏身地点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of eating food very quickly and greedily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 急切而快速地吞吃食物的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tiekol l-ikel bil-għaġla u bir-regħba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狼吞虎咽地吃东西；急吞食物的行为

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, il-ħġim tal-ikel juri kemm il-vjaġġatur kien bil-ġuħ.
formal.en: In the story, the wolfing down of food shows how hungry the traveller was.
formal.zh: 故事中，旅人狼吞虎咽地吃东西，表现出他当时有多饿。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan il-ħġim kollu! Għandek daqshekk ġuħ? Ġużeppi: Iva, ma kilt xejn minn filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Anna: You're wolfing everything down! Are you that hungry? Ġużeppi: Yes, I haven't eaten anything since this morning.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你吃得这么狼吞虎咽！有那么饿吗？Ġużeppi：有啊，我从早上到现在什么都没吃。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ħġim kollu! Għandek daqshekk ġuħ?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ħġim kollu! Għandek daqshekk ġuħ?
messages.zh: 你吃得这么狼吞虎咽！有那么饿吗？
messages.en: You're wolfing everything down! Are you that hungry?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ma kilt xejn minn filgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ma kilt xejn minn filgħodu.
messages.zh: 有啊，我从早上到现在什么都没吃。
messages.en: Yes, I haven't eaten anything since this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象饿了一天的人飞快吞饭：ħġim记“狼吞虎咽这个行为”；与ħġejma的“一小口食物”对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A collection of valuable things, a hidden stash, or a supply of something kept for later use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 集中收藏的珍贵物品、藏起来的一批东西，或留待日后使用的储备。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġabra ta' affarijiet prezzjużi, affarijiet moħbija, jew provvista miżmuma għal meta jkun hemm bżonnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宝藏；集中收藏或发现的一批珍贵物品。
私藏物；藏起来或暗中留存的一批东西。

sense_translations.en_definition: a store or stock of sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 某物的储备、存货或库存。

formal.mt: Il-komunità żammet ħżana ta' ikel u ilma għall-ġranet meta t-trasport ma setax jasal.
formal.en: The community kept a stock of food and water for days when transport could not get through.
formal.zh: 社区储备了食物和水，以应对运输无法到达的日子。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Minn fejn ġibt dan iċ-ċikkulata kollu? Toni: Għandi ħżana moħbija fil-kexxun!
colloquial.en: Nina: Where did you get all this chocolate? Toni: I've got a stash hidden in the drawer!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你从哪儿弄来这么多巧克力？托尼：我在抽屉里藏了一批！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn ġibt dan iċ-ċikkulata kollu?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn ġibt dan iċ-ċikkulata kollu?
messages.zh: 你从哪儿弄来这么多巧克力？
messages.en: Where did you get all this chocolate?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 我在抽屉里藏了一批！
messages.en: I've got a stash hidden in the drawer!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个装东西的箱子：装金币是宝藏，藏零食是私藏，放粮食是储备，一图记住 ħżana 三义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A term for someone who is somewhat malicious; the diminutive form of 'ħażin'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 称呼有点坏心眼、带一点恶意的人；是 ħażin 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma għal xi ħadd xi ftit ħażin jew malizzjuż; il-forma diminuttiva ta' 'ħażin'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有点坏心眼的人；带一点恶意的人（ħażin 的指小形式）。

collocations.zh: 那个有点坏心眼的家伙

collocations.en: the slightly malicious character in the story
collocations.zh: 故事里那个有点坏心眼的人物

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ħżejjen jaħbi l-ittra biex joħloq nuqqas ta' ftehim bejn żewġ ħbieb.
formal.en: In the story, the slightly malicious character hides the letter to cause a misunderstanding between two friends.
formal.zh: 故事里，那个有点坏心眼的人物把信藏了起来，想让两个朋友产生误会。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak il-ħżejjen ħbieli l-pinna biex jirrabjani! Lara: Għidlu jagħtihielek lura.
colloquial.en: Maja: That little schemer hid my pen to annoy me! Lara: Tell him to give it back to you.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个坏心眼的家伙把我的笔藏起来，故意惹我生气！拉拉：叫他把笔还给你。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-ħżejjen ħbieli l-pinna biex jirrabjani!
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-ħżejjen ħbieli l-pinna biex jirrabjani!
messages.zh: 那个坏心眼的家伙把我的笔藏起来，故意惹我生气！
messages.en: That little schemer hid my pen to annoy me!

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 叫他把笔还给你。
messages.en: Tell him to give it back to you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“藏起同学的笔来惹人生气”的小故事记 ħżejjen，抓住“有点坏心眼的人”这一称呼。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small mark or stroke made with a pen, pencil, or another writing implement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用笔或其他书写工具留下的一道小痕迹或短笔画。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marka żgħira jew linja qasira magħmula b'pinna, lapes jew għodda oħra tal-kitba.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small mark made with a writing implement
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用书写工具留下的一小道痕迹；小笔痕。

collocations.en: a small mark on the paper

formal.mt: L-istudent għamel ħżejża bil-lapes ħdejn il-kelma li ried ifittex fid-dizzjunarju.
formal.en: The student made a small pencil mark beside the word he wanted to look up in the dictionary.
formal.zh: 学生在想查词典的那个词旁边，用铅笔做了一个小记号。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhi din il-ħżejża fuq il-paġna? Mark: Għamiltha bil-lapes biex nimmarka fejn waqaft naqra.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's this little mark on the page? Mark: I made it in pencil to mark where I stopped reading.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：书页上这个小笔痕是什么？马克：我用铅笔做的，标一下上次读到哪里。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 书页上这个小笔痕是什么？
messages.en: What's this little mark on the page?

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamiltha bil-lapes biex nimmarka fejn waqaft naqra.
messages.mt_standard: Għamiltha bil-lapes biex nimmarka fejn waqaft naqra.
messages.zh: 我用铅笔做的，标一下上次读到哪里。
messages.en: I made it in pencil to mark where I stopped reading.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象铅笔轻轻划过纸面，只留下一小道笔痕，把这个微小记号和 ħżejża 配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ringworm, a fungal infection of the skin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 癣，一种由真菌引起的皮肤感染。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marda tal-ġilda kkawżata minn infezzjoni fungali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 癣；一种皮肤真菌感染。

formal.mt: Wara l-eżami, it-tabib ikkonferma li l-pazjent kellu l-ħżieża u spjegalu l-kura.
formal.en: After the examination, the doctor confirmed that the patient had ringworm and explained the treatment.
formal.zh: 检查后，医生确认患者得了癣，并向他说明了治疗方法。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-tabib qalli li għandi l-ħżieża. Maja: Spjegalek kif għandek tuża l-krema?
colloquial.en: Lara: The doctor told me I have ringworm. Maja: Did he explain how you should use the cream?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：医生说我得了癣。玛雅：他告诉你该怎么用药膏了吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (患者)
messages.zh: 医生说我得了癣。
messages.en: The doctor told me I have ringworm.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他告诉你该怎么用药膏了吗？
messages.en: Did he explain how you should use the cream?

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ħżieża 配一张“皮肤上的癣”词卡，并与表示小笔痕的 ħżejża 对照，注意中间元音次序。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The keeping of things for later use; also mourning or remembrance of people who have died.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品保存起来以备日后使用；也指哀悼或追念逝者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iż-żamma ta' affarijiet għal użu aktar tard; ukoll in-niket għal min miet jew it-tifkira tal-mejtin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 储存；贮藏；把物品保存起来以备使用。
哀悼；因他人去世而表达悲伤。
追念亡者；对逝者的纪念与缅怀。

formal.mt: Il-pjan tal-bini jinkludi kamra għall-ħżin tal-kotba u tad-dokumenti.
formal.en: The building plan includes a room for storing books and documents.
formal.zh: 建筑规划中包括一间用于存放书籍和文件的房间。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Din il-kamra għandha biżżejjed spazju għall-ħżin? Pawlu: Iva, hawn nistgħu nżommu l-kaxxi kollha.
colloquial.en: Anna: Does this room have enough storage space? Pawlu: Yes, we can keep all the boxes here.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这个房间的储物空间够吗？保罗：够，我们可以把所有箱子都放在这里。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-kamra għandha biżżejjed spazju għall-ħżin?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-kamra għandha biżżejjed spazju għall-ħżin?
messages.zh: 这个房间的储物空间够吗？
messages.en: Does this room have enough storage space?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn nistgħu nżommu l-kaxxi kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn nistgħu nżommu l-kaxxi kollha.
messages.zh: 够，我们可以把所有箱子都放在这里。
messages.en: Yes, we can keep all the boxes here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħżin 分成两张场景卡：仓库对应“储存”，纪念逝者对应“哀悼、追念”；这是记忆分组，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of taking or keeping a firm hold of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用手抓住或紧紧握住某物的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li taqbad jew iżżomm xi ħaġa sew b'idek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抓握；抓紧或握牢某物的动作。

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżerċizzju, il-ħżiq tal-ħabel għandu jkun sod.
formal.en: During the exercise, the rope should be grasped firmly.
formal.zh: 练习时，应当牢牢抓住绳索。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ħżiq tiegħi tajjeb hekk? Pawlu: Iva, żomm il-ħabel sew, imma tirfesx fuq is-swaba'.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is my grasp all right like this? Pawlu: Yes, hold the rope firmly, but don't step on your fingers.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我这样抓握可以吗？保罗：可以，抓牢绳子，不过别踩到自己的手指。

messages.speaker: Maja (学员)
messages.zh: 我这样抓握可以吗？
messages.en: Is my grasp all right like this?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żomm il-ħabel sew, imma tirfesx fuq is-swaba'.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żomm il-ħabel sew, imma tirfesx fuq is-swaba'.
messages.zh: 可以，抓牢绳子，不过别踩到自己的手指。
messages.en: Yes, hold the rope firmly, but don't step on your fingers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手抓牢一根绳索，把这个词与手指收紧的抓握动作联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Subtle or cunning cleverness, sometimes involving wickedness; it can also refer to worldly wisdom.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 微妙或狡黠的心思，有时带有恶意；也可表示通晓世故的老练。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Finezza jew għaqal li jista' jkun marbut mal-ħażen; tista' tfisser ukoll għarfien ta' kif timxi d-dinja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 微妙；细腻；不易立即察觉的精巧之处。
邪恶；恶意；存心伤害他人的恶劣心性。
狡猾；狡黠；为达到目的而运用的机巧心思。
世故；通晓人情世事的老练。

collocations.zh: 狡猾地或怀着恶意行事

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ħżunija tal-karattru tidher fil-mod kif iqarraq b'sħabu.
formal.en: In the story, the character's wickedness is shown by the way he deceives his companions.
formal.zh: 故事通过这个人物欺骗同伴的方式，展现了他的邪恶。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qallu hekk quddiem kulħadd? Mark: Bil-ħżunija, biex iġiegħlu jistħi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did he say that to him in front of everyone? Mark: Out of malice, to embarrass him.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：他为什么当着大家的面对那个人说这种话？马克：他是怀着恶意，想让那个人难堪。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么当着大家的面对那个人说这种话？
messages.en: Why did he say that to him in front of everyone?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他是怀着恶意，想让那个人难堪。
messages.en: Out of malice, to embarrass him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四张情景卡记忆：话中有微妙之处、心中有恶意、做事耍机巧、处世很老练；依语境辨别词义。

gloss_zh: 潦草写成的；乱涂乱写的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Written in a hurried, untidy way, with poorly formed letters or marks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 写得匆忙而凌乱、字迹或笔画不清楚的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Miktub bl-għaġla u bla ordni, b'ittri jew marki li diffiċli tagħrafhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 潦草写成的；字迹凌乱难辨的。

formal.mt: Id-dokument fih test ħżużi li diffiċli jinqara.
formal.en: The document contains scrawled text that is difficult to read.
formal.zh: 这份文件中有一段字迹潦草、难以辨认的文字。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Tista' taqra dan il-messaġġ ħżużi? David: Bilkemm! Naħseb li jgħid biex niltaqgħu fis-sitta.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can you read this scrawled message? David: Barely! I think it says to meet at six.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你看得懂这张字迹潦草的留言吗？戴维：勉强能！我觉得上面说六点见面。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你看得懂这张字迹潦草的留言吗？
messages.en: Can you read this scrawled message?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Bilkemm! Naħseb li jgħid biex niltaqgħu fis-sitta.
messages.mt_standard: Bilkemm! Naħseb li jgħid biex niltaqgħu fis-sitta.
messages.zh: 勉强能！我觉得上面说六点见面。
messages.en: Barely! I think it says to meet at six.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象赶时间写下的一张留言，字母挤成乱线；用这个画面记住字迹潦草的意思。
